sanskrit_iast:
kūrmapurāṇam-1
atha śrīkūrmapurāṇam
pūrvavibhāgaḥ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam /
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayamudīrayet //
meaning:
कूर्मपुराणम्-1
अथ श्रीकूर्मपुराणम्
पूर्वविभागः
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् /
देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत् //
text_mt:
Kūrma Purāṇa 1
Now begins the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.
Former Section.
Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa, and to Nara, best of men, / and to the goddess Sarasvatī, one should then utter the word "Victory!"

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtvāprameyāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe /
purāṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ viśvayoninā //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्वाप्रमेयाय विष्णवे कूर्मरूपिणे /
पुराणं संप्रवक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं विश्वयोनिना //
text_mt: Having bowed down to the immeasurable Viṣṇu, embodied as a tortoise, / I shall proclaim the Purāṇa that was spoken by the source of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
satrānte sūtamanaghaṃ naimiṣīyā maharṣayaḥ /
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ papracchū romaharṣaṇam //
meaning:
सत्रान्ते सूतमनघं नैमिषीया महर्षयः /
पुराणसंहितां पुण्यां पप्रच्छू रोमहर्षणम् //
text_mt: At the conclusion of a sacrificial session, the great sages, dwellers of Naimiṣa forest, / asked the sinless Sūta Romaharṣaṇa for the holy Purāṇa compilation:

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā sūta mahābuddhe bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ /
itihāsapurāṇārthaṃ vyāsaḥ samyagupāsitaḥ //
meaning:
त्वया सूत महाबुद्धे भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः /
इतिहासपुराणार्थं व्यासः सम्यगुपासितः //
text_mt: "O Sūta of great intellect, you duly served the venerable Vyāsa, / the best of knowers of Brahman, for the sake of the histories and the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya te sarvaromāṇi vacasā hṛṣitāni yat /
dvaipāyanasya bhagavāṃstato vai romaharṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य ते सर्वरोमाणि वचसा हृषितानि यत् /
द्वैपायनस्य भगवांस्ततो वै रोमहर्षणः //
text_mt: Because all your bodily hairs bristled at the words / of that venerable Dvaipāyana, you indeed became known as Romaharṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantameva bhagavān vyājahāra svayaṃ prabhuḥ /
munīnāṃ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ vyāsaḥ paurāṇikīṃ purā //
meaning:
भवन्तमेव भगवान् व्याजहार स्वयं प्रभुः /
मुनीनां संहितां वक्तुं व्यासः पौराणिकीं पुरा //
text_mt: Formerly, the venerable lord Vyāsa himself spoke to you alone, / directing you to recite the Purāṇa compilation to the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi svāyaṃbhuve yajñe sutyāhe vitate hariḥ /
saṃbhūtaḥ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ svāṃśena puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं हि स्वायंभुवे यज्ञे सुत्याहे वितते हरिः /
संभूतः संहितां वक्तुं स्वांशेन पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: For you, as Hari, the Supreme Spirit, were born of your own portion / on the day of soma extraction at the extensive sacrifice of Svāyambhuva, to recite the compilation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād bhavantaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ purāṇaṃ kaurmamuttamam /
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ purāṇārthaviśārada //
meaning:
तस्माद् भवन्तं पृच्छामः पुराणं कौर्ममुत्तमम् /
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं पुराणार्थविशारद //
text_mt: Therefore we ask you for the excellent Kūrma Purāṇa; / you should recount it to us, O scholar skilled in the meaning of the Purāṇas."

sanskrit_iast:
munīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ /
praṇamya manasā prāha guruṃ satyavatīsutam //
meaning:
मुनीनां वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः /
प्रणम्य मनसा प्राह गुरुं सत्यवतीसुतम् //
text_mt: Having heard the words of the sages, the Sūta, the foremost of Purāṇa reciters, / bowed mentally to his teacher, the son of Satyavatī, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
romaharṣaṇa uvāca
namaskṛtvā jagadyoniṃ kūrmarūpadharaṃ harim /
vakṣye paurāṇikīṃ divyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm //
meaning:
रोमहर्षण उवाच
नमस्कृत्वा जगद्योनिं कूर्मरूपधरं हरिम् /
वक्ष्ये पौराणिकीं दिव्यां कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् //
text_mt:
Romaharṣaṇa said:
"Having bowed down to Hari, the source of the universe, who assumed the form of a tortoise, / I shall tell the divine Purāṇa narrative that destroys sin,

sanskrit_iast:
yāṃ śrutvā pāpakarmāpi gaccheta paramāṃ gatim /
na nāstike kathāṃ puṇyāmimāṃ brūyāt kadācana //
meaning:
यां श्रुत्वा पापकर्मापि गच्छेत परमां गतिम् /
न नास्तिके कथां पुण्यामिमां ब्रूयात् कदाचन //
text_mt: hearing which even an evil-doer would attain the supreme destination. / One must never recount this holy narrative to a denier [of sacred authority].

sanskrit_iast:
śraddadhānāya śāntāya dhārmikāya dvijātaye /
imāṃ kathāmanubrūyāt sākṣānnārāyaṇeritām //
meaning:
श्रद्दधानाय शान्ताय धार्मिकाय द्विजातये /
इमां कथामनुब्रूयात् साक्षान्नारायणेरिताम् //
text_mt: One should recount this narrative, spoken directly by Nārāyaṇa, / to a faithful, calm, and righteous twice-born person.

sanskrit_iast:
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca /
vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च /
वंशानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् //
text_mt: Primary creation, secondary recreation, genealogy, the cosmic eras of Manus, / and dynastic history are the five defining characteristics of a Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ purāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca /
śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyakam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मं पुराणं प्रथमं पाद्मं वैष्णवमेव च /
शैवं भागवतं चैव भविष्यं नारदीयकम् //
text_mt: The Brāhma Purāṇa is the first; the Pādma, the Vaiṣṇava, / the Śaiva, the Bhāgavata, the Bhaviṣya, and the Nāradīyaka;

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyamathāgneyaṃ brahmavaivartameva ca /
laiṅgaṃ tathā ca vārāhaṃ skāndaṃ vāmanameva ca //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयमथाग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तमेव च /
लैङ्गं तथा च वाराहं स्कान्दं वामनमेव च //
text_mt: then the Mārkaṇḍeya, the Āgneya, the Brahmavaivarta, / the Laiṅga, the Vārāha, the Skānda, and the Vāmana;

sanskrit_iast:
kaurmaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍaṃ ca vāyavīyamanantaram /
aṣṭādaśaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ brahmaṇḍamiti saṃjñitam //
meaning:
कौर्मं मात्स्यं गारुडं च वायवीयमनन्तरम् /
अष्टादशं समुद्दिष्टं ब्रह्मण्डमिति संज्ञितम् //
text_mt: the Kaurma, the Mātsya, the Gāruḍa, and next the Vāyavīya; / the eighteenth is designated as that called the Brahmāṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
anyānyuparāṇāni munibhiḥ kathitāni tu /
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni śrutvā saṃkṣepato dvijāḥ //
meaning:
अन्यान्युपराणानि मुनिभिः कथितानि तु /
अष्टादशपुराणानि श्रुत्वा संक्षेपतो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Other secondary Purāṇas have been spoken by the sages, / having heard the eighteen Purāṇas in brief, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasihamataḥ param /
tṛtīyaṃ skāndamuddiṣṭaṃ kumāreṇa tu bhāṣitam //
meaning:
आद्यं सनत्कुमारोक्तं नारसिहमतः परम् /
तृतीयं स्कान्दमुद्दिष्टं कुमारेण तु भाषितम् //
text_mt: The first was spoken by Sanatkumāra; next to that is the Nārasiṃha; / the third is taught as the Skānda, spoken by Kumāra;

sanskrit_iast:
caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ sākṣānnandīśabhāṣitam /
durvāsasoktamāścaryaṃ nāradoktamataḥ param //
meaning:
चतुर्थं शिवधर्माख्यं साक्षान्नन्दीशभाषितम् /
दुर्वाससोक्तमाश्चर्यं नारदोक्तमतः परम् //
text_mt: the fourth is called the Śivadharma, spoken directly by Nandīśvara; / the wonderful one spoken by Durvāsas, and next that spoken by Nārada;

sanskrit_iast:
kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam /
brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cātha kālikāhvayameva ca //
meaning:
कापिलं मानवं चैव तथैवोशनसेरितम् /
ब्रह्माण्डं वारुणं चाथ कालिकाह्वयमेव च //
text_mt: the Kāpila, the Mānava, and likewise that uttered by Uśanas; / the Brahmāṇḍa, the Vāruṇa, and the one named Kālikā;

sanskrit_iast:
māheśvaraṃ tathā sāmbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam /
parāśaroktamaparaṃ mārīcaṃ bhārgavāhvayam //
meaning:
माहेश्वरं तथा साम्बं सौरं सर्वार्थसंचयम् /
पराशरोक्तमपरं मारीचं भार्गवाह्वयम् //
text_mt: the Māheśvara, the Sāmba, the Saura, a collection of all aims; / another spoken by Parāśara, the Mārīca, and the one named Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tu pañcadaśamaṃ purāṇaṃ kaurmamuttamam /
caturdhā saṃsthitaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃhitānāṃ prabhedataḥ //
meaning:
इदं तु पञ्चदशमं पुराणं कौर्ममुत्तमम् /
चतुर्धा संस्थितं पुण्यं संहितानां प्रभेदतः //
text_mt: This holy, excellent Kūrma Purāṇa, the fifteenth, / is established in four parts by division into compilations.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī bhagavatī saurī vaiṣṇavī ca prakīrtitāḥ /
catastraḥ saṃhitāḥ puṇyā dharmakāmārthamokṣadāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी भगवती सौरी वैष्णवी च प्रकीर्तिताः /
चतस्त्रः संहिताः पुण्या धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदाः //
text_mt: The Brāhmī, the Bhāgavatī, the Saurī, and the Vaiṣṇavī / are proclaimed to be the four holy compilations that grant duty, desire, wealth, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ tu saṃhitā brāhmī caturvedaistu sammitā /
bhavanti ṣaṭsahastrāṇi ślokānāmatra saṃkhyayā //
meaning:
इयं तु संहिता ब्राह्मी चतुर्वेदैस्तु सम्मिता /
भवन्ति षट्सहस्त्राणि श्लोकानामत्र संख्यया //
text_mt: Now this Brāhmī compilation is commensurate with the four Vedas; / in it there are six thousand verses by count,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasya ca munīśvarāḥ /
māhātmyamakhilaṃ brahma jñāyate parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यत्र धर्मार्थकामानां मोक्षस्य च मुनीश्वराः /
माहात्म्यमखिलं ब्रह्म ज्ञायते परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: wherein the majesty of duty, wealth, desire, and liberation / is completely [set forth], O lords of sages, and Brahman, the Supreme Lord, is known,

sanskrit_iast:
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca /
vaṃśānucaritaṃ divyāḥ puṇyāḥ prāsaṅgikīḥ kathāḥ //
meaning:
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च /
वंशानुचरितं दिव्याः पुण्याः प्रासङ्गिकीः कथाः //
text_mt: along with primary creation, secondary recreation, genealogy, cosmic eras of Manus, / dynastic history, and divine, holy episodic narratives.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādyairiyaṃ dhāryā dhārmikaiḥ śāntamānasaiḥ /
tāmahaṃ vartayiṣyāmi vyāsena kathitāṃ purā //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाद्यैरियं धार्या धार्मिकैः शान्तमानसैः /
तामहं वर्तयिष्यामि व्यासेन कथितां पुरा //
text_mt: This is to be retained by brāhmaṇas and others who are righteous and peaceful of mind. / I shall set forth that which was formerly narrated by Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
purāmṛtārthaṃ daiteyadānavaiḥ saha devatāḥ /
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram //
meaning:
पुरामृतार्थं दैतेयदानवैः सह देवताः /
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा ममन्थुः क्षीरसागरम् //
text_mt: Long ago, for the sake of the nectar, the gods along with the Daiteyas and Dānavas / made Mount Mandara the churning stick and churned the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamāne tadā tasmin kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ /
babhāra mandaraṃ devo devānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
मथ्यमाने तदा तस्मिन् कूर्मरूपी जनार्दनः /
बभार मन्दरं देवो देवानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: While it was being churned, the divine Janārdana, embodied as a tortoise, / supported Mount Mandara out of a desire for the welfare of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca tuṣṭuvurdevaṃ nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ /
kūrmarūpadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā sākṣiṇaṃ viṣṇumavyayam //
meaning:
देवाश्च तुष्टुवुर्देवं नारदाद्या महर्षयः /
कूर्मरूपधरं दृष्ट्वा साक्षिणं विष्णुमव्ययम् //
text_mt: And the gods and the great sages headed by Nārada praised the god, / having beheld the imperishable Viṣṇu, the witness, who had assumed the form of a tortoise.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare 'bhavad devī śrīrnārāyaṇavallabhā /
jagrāha bhagavān viṣṇustāmeva puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
तदन्तरे ऽभवद् देवी श्रीर्नारायणवल्लभा /
जग्राह भगवान् विष्णुस्तामेव पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: At that moment arose the goddess Śrī, the beloved of Nārāyaṇa; / the venerable Viṣṇu, the Supreme Spirit, took her alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā viṣṇumavyaktaṃ nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ /
mohitāḥ saha śakreṇa śriyo vacanamabruvan //
meaning:
तेजसा विष्णुमव्यक्तं नारदाद्या महर्षयः /
मोहिताः सह शक्रेण श्रियो वचनमब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Bewildered by the unmanifest splendor of Viṣṇu, / the great sages headed by Nārada, along with Śakra, spoke to Śrī:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan devadeveśa nārāyaṇa jaganmaya /
kaiṣā devī viśālākṣī yathāvad brūhi pṛcchatām //
meaning:
भगवन् देवदेवेश नारायण जगन्मय /
कैषा देवी विशालाक्षी यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छताम् //
text_mt: "O Lord, ruler of the gods, Nārāyaṇa, composed of the universe, / who is this large-eyed goddess? Tell us truly as we ask."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ viṣṇurdānavamardanaḥ /
provāca devīṃ saṃprekṣya nāradādīnakalmaṣān //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं विष्णुर्दानवमर्दनः /
प्रोवाच देवीं संप्रेक्ष्य नारदादीनकल्मषान् //
text_mt: Having heard their words, Viṣṇu, the crusher of the Dānavas, / looked toward the goddess and said to the stainless sages headed by Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ sā paramā śaktirmanmayī brahmarūpiṇī /
māyā mama priyānantā yayedaṃ mohitaṃ jagat //
meaning:
इयं सा परमा शक्तिर्मन्मयी ब्रह्मरूपिणी /
माया मम प्रियानन्ता ययेदं मोहितं जगत् //
text_mt: "She is that supreme power, identical with me, having the nature of Brahman, / my endless, beloved illusory creative power by which this universe is bewildered.

sanskrit_iast:
anayaiva jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
mohayāmi dvijaśreṣṭhā grasāmi visṛjāmi ca //
meaning:
अनयैव जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
मोहयामि द्विजश्रेष्ठा ग्रसामि विसृजामि च //
text_mt: By her alone do I bewilder the whole universe, / including the gods, asuras, and humans, O best of the twice-born; and I swallow and emit it.

sanskrit_iast:
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtanāmāgatiṃ gatim /
vijñāyānvīkṣya cātmānaṃ taranti vipulāmimām //
meaning:
उत्पत्तिं प्रलयं चैव भूतनामागतिं गतिम् /
विज्ञायान्वीक्ष्य चात्मानं तरन्ति विपुलामिमाम् //
text_mt: Knowing the origin and dissolution, the arrival and departure of living beings, / and examining the Self, they cross over this vast [power].

sanskrit_iast:
asyāstvaṃśānadhiṣṭhāya śaktimanto 'bhavan dvijāḥ /
brahmeśānādayo devāḥ sarvaśaktiriyaṃ mama //
meaning:
अस्यास्त्वंशानधिष्ठाय शक्तिमन्तो ऽभवन् द्विजाः /
ब्रह्मेशानादयो देवाः सर्वशक्तिरियं मम //
text_mt: Relying on portions of her, O twice-born, the gods headed by Brahmā and Īśāna / have become empowered; she is my all-encompassing power.

sanskrit_iast:
saiṣā sarvajagatsūtiḥ prakṛtistriguṇātmikā /
prāgeva mattaḥ saṃjātā śrīkalpe padmavāsinī //
meaning:
सैषा सर्वजगत्सूतिः प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मिका /
प्रागेव मत्तः संजाता श्रीकल्पे पद्मवासिनी //
text_mt: She is the progenitor of the entire universe, primordial matter composed of the three qualities; / she was born of me even before, in the Śrīkalpa, as the one who dwells in the lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā śaṅkhacakrapadmahastā śubhānvitā /
koṭisūryapratīkāśā mohinī sarvadehinām //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा शङ्खचक्रपद्महस्ता शुभान्विता /
कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशा मोहिनी सर्वदेहिनाम् //
text_mt: four-armed, holding a conch, discus, and lotus in her hands, endowed with auspiciousness, / resplendent as ten million suns, the enchantress of all embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
nālaṃ devā na pitaro mānavā vasavo 'pi ca /
māyāmetāṃ samuttartuṃ ye cānye bhuvi dehinaḥ //
meaning:
नालं देवा न पितरो मानवा वसवो ऽपि च /
मायामेतां समुत्तर्तुं ये चान्ये भुवि देहिनः //
text_mt: The gods, the ancestors, humans, and the Vasus are not able, / nor are any other embodied beings on earth, to cross over this illusory creative power.

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto vāsudevena munayo viṣṇumabruvan /
brūhi tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa yadi kālatraye 'pi ca /
ko vā tarati tāṃ māyāṃ durjayāṃ devanirmitām //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन मुनयो विष्णुमब्रुवन् /
ब्रूहि त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष यदि कालत्रये ऽपि च /
को वा तरति तां मायां दुर्जयां देवनिर्मिताम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by Vāsudeva, the sages said to Viṣṇu: / "Tell us, O lotus-eyed one, whether at any of the three times / anyone at all crosses over that unconquerable illusory creative power fashioned by the god?"

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca hṛṣīkeśo munīn munigaṇārcitaḥ /
asti dvijātipravara indradyumna iti śrutaḥ //
meaning:
अथोवाच हृषीकेशो मुनीन् मुनिगणार्चितः /
अस्ति द्विजातिप्रवर इन्द्रद्युम्न इति श्रुतः //
text_mt: Then Hṛṣīkeśa, worshiped by the multitude of sages, said to the sages: / "There is an excellent twice-born known as Indradyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvajanmani rājāsāvadhṛṣyaḥ śaṅkarādibhiḥ /
dṛṣṭvā māṃ kūrmasaṃsthānaṃ śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ svayam /
saṃhitāṃ manmukhād divyāṃ puraskṛtya munīśvarān //
meaning:
पूर्वजन्मनि राजासावधृष्यः शङ्करादिभिः /
दृष्ट्वा मां कूर्मसंस्थानं श्रुत्वा पौराणिकीं स्वयम् /
संहितां मन्मुखाद् दिव्यां पुरस्कृत्य मुनीश्वरान् //
text_mt: In a previous birth he was a king, unassailable even by Śaṅkara and the rest. / Having seen me residing as the tortoise and having heard directly from my mouth the divine / Purāṇa compilation, placing the chief sages in front,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ ca mahādevaṃ devāṃścānyān svaśaktibhiḥ /
macchaktau saṃsthitān buddhvā māmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं च महादेवं देवांश्चान्यान् स्वशक्तिभिः /
मच्छक्तौ संस्थितान् बुद्ध्वा मामेव शरणं गतः //
text_mt: and understanding that Brahmā, Mahādeva, and the other gods, with their respective powers, / abide within my power, he took refuge in me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhāṣito mayā cātha viprayoniṃ gamiṣyasi /
indradyumna iti khyāto jātiṃ smarasi paurvikīm //
meaning:
संभाषितो मया चाथ विप्रयोनिं गमिष्यसि /
इन्द्रद्युम्न इति ख्यातो जातिं स्मरसि पौर्विकीम् //
text_mt: He was addressed by me: 'Then you shall go to a brāhmaṇa womb; / renowned as Indradyumna, you will remember your previous birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ devānāmapyagocaram /
vaktavyaṃ yad guhyatamaṃ dāsye jñānaṃ tavānagha /
labdhvā tanmāmakaṃ jñānaṃ māmevānte pravekṣyasi //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां देवानामप्यगोचरम् /
वक्तव्यं यद् गुह्यतमं दास्ये ज्ञानं तवानघ /
लब्ध्वा तन्मामकं ज्ञानं मामेवान्ते प्रवेक्ष्यसि //
text_mt: Beyond the range of all beings and even of the gods, / which is the most secret knowledge that can be spoken, I shall grant to you, O sinless one. / Having attained that knowledge of mine, you shall enter into me alone at the end.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśāntareṇa bhūmyāṃ tvaṃ tatra tiṣṭha sunirdṛtaḥ /
vaivasvate 'ntare 'tite kāryārthaṃ māṃ pravekṣyasi //
meaning:
अंशान्तरेण भूम्यां त्वं तत्र तिष्ठ सुनिर्दृतः /
वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे ऽतिते कार्यार्थं मां प्रवेक्ष्यसि //
text_mt: With another portion of yourself, dwell on earth, well composed there; / when the cosmic era of Vaivasvata has passed, you shall enter me for the sake of divine purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ praṇamya purīṃ gatvā pālayāmāsa medinīm /
kāladharmaṃ gataḥ kālācchvetadvīpe mayā saha //
meaning:
मां प्रणम्य पुरीं गत्वा पालयामास मेदिनीम् /
कालधर्मं गतः कालाच्छ्वेतद्वीपे मया सह //
text_mt: Bowing to me and having gone to his city, he ruled the earth; / in the course of time, subject to the law of time, he went to Śvetadvīpa along with me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvā tān vaiṣṇavān bhogān yogināmapyagocarān /
madājñayā muniśreṣṭhā jajñe viprakule punaḥ //
meaning:
भुक्त्वा तान् वैष्णवान् भोगान् योगिनामप्यगोचरान् /
मदाज्ञया मुनिश्रेष्ठा जज्ञे विप्रकुले पुनः //
text_mt: Having enjoyed those Vaiṣṇava pleasures, beyond the reach even of yogins, / by my command, O best of sages, he was born again in a brahmin family.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā māṃ vāsudevākhyaṃ yatra dve nihite 'kṣare /
vidyāvidye gūḍharūpe yattad brahma paraṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा मां वासुदेवाख्यं यत्र द्वे निहिते ऽक्षरे /
विद्याविद्ये गूढरूपे यत्तद् ब्रह्म परं विदुः //
text_mt: Having known me as named Vāsudeva, in whom the two imperishable principles are deposited— / knowledge and ignorance, hidden in form—which the wise know as the highest Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
sor'cayāmāsa bhūtānāmāśrayaṃ parameśvaram /
vratopavāsaniyamairhemairbrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
सोर्ऽचयामास भूतानामाश्रयं परमेश्वरम् /
व्रतोपवासनियमैर्हेमैर्ब्राह्मणतर्पणैः //
text_mt: he worshipped the supreme lord, the refuge of beings, / with vows, fasts, observances, offerings, and satisfying of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāśīstannamaskārastanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ /
ārādhayan mahādevaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam //
meaning:
तदाशीस्तन्नमस्कारस्तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः /
आराधयन् महादेवं योगिनां हृदि संस्थितम् //
text_mt: Finding his blessing in him, bowing to him, devoted to him, intent upon him, / he worshipped Mahādeva, who resides in the hearts of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadācit paramā kalā /
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ viṣṇusamudbhavam //
meaning:
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कदाचित् परमा कला /
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास दिव्यं विष्णुसमुद्भवम् //
text_mt: While he was living in this manner, once the supreme portion / revealed her divine form, arisen from Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā viṣṇorbhagavataḥ priyām /
saṃstūya vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य शिरसा विष्णोर्भगवतः प्रियाम् /
संस्तूय विविधैः स्तोत्रैः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत //
text_mt: Seeing her, bowing with his head to the beloved of the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu, / and praising her with various hymns, he spoke with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
irnddayumna uvāca
kā tvaṃ deviviśālākṣi viṣṇucihnaṅkite śubhe /
yāthātathyena vai bhāvaṃ tavedānīṃ bravīhi me //
meaning:
इर्न्द्दयुम्न उवाच
का त्वं देविविशालाक्षि विष्णुचिह्नङ्किते शुभे /
याथातथ्येन वै भावं तवेदानीं ब्रवीहि मे //
text_mt:
Indradyumna said:
Who are you, O large-eyed goddess, auspicious one, marked with the insignia of Viṣṇu? / Tell me truly now your nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tad vākyamākarṇya suprasannā sumaṅgalā /
hasantī saṃsmaran viṣṇuṃ priyaṃ brāhmaṇamabravīt //
meaning:
तस्य तद् वाक्यमाकर्ण्य सुप्रसन्ना सुमङ्गला /
हसन्ती संस्मरन् विष्णुं प्रियं ब्राह्मणमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing his speech, exceedingly pleased, highly auspicious, / smiling and remembering Viṣṇu, she spoke to the dear brahmin:

sanskrit_iast:
na māṃ paśyanti munayo devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ /
nārāyaṇātmikā caikā māyāhaṃ tanmayā parā //
meaning:
न मां पश्यन्ति मुनयो देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः /
नारायणात्मिका चैका मायाहं तन्मया परा //
text_mt: Sages do not see me, nor do the gods led by Indra; / I am the singular illusory creative power, identical with Nārāyaṇa, supreme and composed of him.

sanskrit_iast:
na me nārāyaṇād bhedo vidyate hi vicārataḥ /
tanmayāhaṃ paraṃ brahma sa viṣṇuḥ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
न मे नारायणाद् भेदो विद्यते हि विचारतः /
तन्मयाहं परं ब्रह्म स विष्णुः परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Indeed, upon reflection, there is no difference between me and Nārāyaṇa; / I am composed of him, the supreme Brahman; he is Viṣṇu, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yer'cayantīha bhūtānāmāśrayaṃ parameśvaram /
jñānena karmayogena na teṣāṃ prabhavāmyaham //
meaning:
येर्ऽचयन्तीह भूतानामाश्रयं परमेश्वरम् /
ज्ञानेन कर्मयोगेन न तेषां प्रभवाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Over those who worship here the supreme lord, the refuge of all beings, / by means of knowledge and the yoga of action, I have no power.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanādinidhanaṃ karmayogaparāyaṇaḥ /
jñānenārādhayānantaṃ tato mokṣamavāpsyasi //
meaning:
तस्मादनादिनिधनं कर्मयोगपरायणः /
ज्ञानेनाराधयानन्तं ततो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि //
text_mt: Therefore, intent on the yoga of action, worship through knowledge / the beginningless and endless, infinite Lord; thence you will attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sa muniśreṣṭha indradyumno mahāmatiḥ /
praṇamya śirasā devīṃ prāñjaliḥ punarabravīt //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः स मुनिश्रेष्ठ इन्द्रद्युम्नो महामतिः /
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं प्राञ्जलिः पुनरब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Thus addressed, that best of sages, the wise Indradyumna, / bowing his head to the goddess, spoke again with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ śāśvato niṣkalo 'cyutaḥ /
jñātuṃ hi śakyate devi brūhi me parameśvari //
meaning:
कथं स भगवानीशः शाश्वतो निष्कलो ऽच्युतः /
ज्ञातुं हि शक्यते देवि ब्रूहि मे परमेश्वरि //
text_mt: How can that Blessed Lord, eternal, partless, and infallible, / be known, O goddess? Tell me, O supreme mistress!

sanskrit_iast:
ekamuktātha vipreṇa devī kamalavāsinī /
sākṣānnārāyaṇo jñānaṃ dāsyatītyāha taṃ munim //
meaning:
एकमुक्ताथ विप्रेण देवी कमलवासिनी /
साक्षान्नारायणो ज्ञानं दास्यतीत्याह तं मुनिम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the brahmin, the goddess who dwells in the lotus / said to that sage, 'Nārāyaṇa in person will give you knowledge.'

sanskrit_iast:
ubhābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśya praṇataṃ munim /
smṛtvā parātparaṃ viṣṇuṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
उभाभ्यामथ हस्ताभ्यां संस्पृश्य प्रणतं मुनिम् /
स्मृत्वा परात्परं विष्णुं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Then, touching the bowed sage with both hands / and remembering Viṣṇu who is higher than the high, she vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi nārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ parameṇa samādhinā /
ārādhayaddhṛṣīkeśaṃ praṇatārtiprabhañjanam //
meaning:
सो ऽपि नारायणं द्रष्टुं परमेण समाधिना /
आराधयद्धृषीकेशं प्रणतार्तिप्रभञ्जनम् //
text_mt: He too, in order to see Nārāyaṇa, through supreme absorption, / worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa, who destroys the affliction of those who bow to him.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bahutithe kāle gate nārāyaṇaḥ svayam /
prādurāsīnmahāyogī pītavāsā jaganmayaḥ //
meaning:
ततो बहुतिथे काले गते नारायणः स्वयम् /
प्रादुरासीन्महायोगी पीतवासा जगन्मयः //
text_mt: Then, after a long time had passed, Nārāyaṇa himself, / the great yogin, yellow-robed and comprising the universe, manifested.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ samāyāntaṃ viṣṇumātmānamavyayam /
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā tuṣṭāva garuḍadhvajam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा देवं समायान्तं विष्णुमात्मानमव्ययम् /
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा तुष्टाव गरुडध्वजम् //
text_mt: Seeing the god approaching—Viṣṇu, the imperishable Self— / he went to the ground on his knees and praised him whose banner bears Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumna uvāca
yajñeśācyuta govinda mādhavānanta keśava /
kuṣṇa viṣṇo hṛṣīkeśa tubhyaṃ viśvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच
यज्ञेशाच्युत गोविन्द माधवानन्त केशव /
कुष्ण विष्णो हृषीकेश तुभ्यं विश्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
Indradyumna said:
O Lord of sacrifice, O infallible one, Govinda, Mādhava, Ananta, Keśava, / Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Hṛṣīkeśa, homage to you, the Self of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te purāṇāya haraye viśvamūrtaye /
sargasthitivināśānāṃ hetave 'nantaśakye //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते पुराणाय हरये विश्वमूर्तये /
सर्गस्थितिविनाशानां हेतवे ऽनन्तशक्ये //
text_mt: Homage be to you, the ancient one, Hari, the universal form, / the cause of creation, maintenance, and destruction, endowed with infinite power!

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇāya namastubhyaṃ niṣkalāyāmalātmane /
puruṣāya namastubhyaṃ viśvarūpāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
निर्गुणाय नमस्तुभ्यं निष्कलायामलात्मने /
पुरुषाय नमस्तुभ्यं विश्वरूपाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Homage to you, devoid of qualities, partless, of pure nature! / Homage to you, the Spirit, whose form is the universe, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vāsudevāya viṣṇave viśvayonaye /
ādimadhyāntahīnāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते वासुदेवाय विष्णवे विश्वयोनये /
आदिमध्यान्तहीनाय ज्ञानगम्याय ते नमः //
text_mt: Homage to you, Vāsudeva, Viṣṇu, origin of the universe, / devoid of beginning, middle, and end, accessible through knowledge, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste nirvikārāya niṣprapañcāya te namaḥ /
bhedābhedavihīnāya namo 'stvānandarūpiṇe //
meaning:
नमस्ते निर्विकाराय निष्प्रपञ्चाय ते नमः /
भेदाभेदविहीनाय नमो ऽस्त्वानन्दरूपिणे //
text_mt: Homage to you, changeless one; homage to you, devoid of phenomenal expansion; / homage be to the one devoid of distinction and non-distinction, whose nature is bliss!

sanskrit_iast:
namastārāya śāntāya namo 'pratihatātmane /
anantamūrtaye tubhyamamūrtāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ताराय शान्ताय नमो ऽप्रतिहतात्मने /
अनन्तमूर्तये तुभ्यममूर्ताय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the savior, the tranquil one; homage to the unhindered Self; / homage, homage to you, of endless form, who are formless!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste paramārthāya māyātītāya te namaḥ /
namaste parameśāya brahmaṇe paramātmane //
meaning:
नमस्ते परमार्थाय मायातीताय ते नमः /
नमस्ते परमेशाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to you, the supreme reality; homage to you who transcend illusory creative power; / homage to you, the supreme ruler, Brahman, the supreme Self!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te susūkṣmāya mahādevāya te namaḥ /
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya namaste parameṣṭhine //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते सुसूक्ष्माय महादेवाय ते नमः /
नमः शिवाय शुद्धाय नमस्ते परमेष्ठिने //
text_mt: Homage be to you, the extremely subtle one; homage to you, Mahādeva; / homage to Śiva, the pure; homage to you, the supreme lord!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvameva paramā gatiḥ /
tvaṃ pitā sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ mātā puruṣottama //
meaning:
त्वयैव सृष्टमखिलं त्वमेव परमा गतिः /
त्वं पिता सर्वभूतानां त्वं माता पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: By you alone all this was created; you alone are the supreme goal; / you are the father of all beings, you are the mother, O Supreme Spirit!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma cinmātraṃ vyoma niṣkalam /
sarvasyādhāramavyaktamanantaṃ tamasaḥ param //
meaning:
त्वमक्षरं परं धाम चिन्मात्रं व्योम निष्कलम् /
सर्वस्याधारमव्यक्तमनन्तं तमसः परम् //
text_mt: You are the imperishable, supreme abode, pure consciousness, partless space, / the foundation of everything, unmanifest, infinite, beyond darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
prapaśyanti parātmānaṃ jñānadīpena kevalam /
prapadye bhavato rūpaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
प्रपश्यन्ति परात्मानं ज्ञानदीपेन केवलम् /
प्रपद्ये भवतो रूपं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: They perceive the supreme Self solely through the lamp of knowledge; / I surrender to that form of yours, the supreme step of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavān bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ /
ubhābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ pasparśa prahasanniva //
meaning:
एवं स्तुवन्तं भगवान् भूतात्मा भूतभावनः /
उभाभ्यामथ हस्ताभ्यां पस्पर्श प्रहसन्निव //
text_mt: As he was thus praising, the Blessed Lord, the Self of beings, creator of beings, / touched him with both hands, as if smiling.

sanskrit_iast:
spṛṣṭamātro bhagavatā viṣṇunā munipuṅgavaḥ /
yathāvat paramaṃ tattvaṃ jñātavāṃstatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
स्पृष्टमात्रो भगवता विष्णुना मुनिपुङ्गवः /
यथावत् परमं तत्त्वं ज्ञातवांस्तत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Merely touched by the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu, the eminent sage / knew the supreme truth properly, by his grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā praṇipatya janārdanam /
provāconnidrapadmākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam //
meaning:
ततः प्रहृष्टमनसा प्रणिपत्य जनार्दनम् /
प्रोवाचोन्निद्रपद्माक्षं पीतवाससमच्युतम् //
text_mt: Then, with a delighted mind, bowing down to Janārdana, / he spoke to the infallible one, who has eyes like blooming lotuses and wears yellow robes:

sanskrit_iast:
tvatprasādādasaṃdigdhamutpannaṃ puruṣottama /
jñānaṃ brahmaikaviṣayaṃ paramānandasiddhidam //
meaning:
त्वत्प्रसादादसंदिग्धमुत्पन्नं पुरुषोत्तम /
ज्ञानं ब्रह्मैकविषयं परमानन्दसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: By your grace, O Supreme Spirit, there has arisen beyond doubt / the knowledge directed solely to Brahman, granting the attainment of supreme bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya vedhase /
kiṃ kariṣyāmi yogeśa tanme vada jaganmaya //
meaning:
नमो भगवते तुभ्यं वासुदेवाय वेधसे /
किं करिष्यामि योगेश तन्मे वद जगन्मय //
text_mt: Homage to you, the Blessed Lord Vāsudeva, the creator; / what shall I do, O Lord of yoga? Tell me that, O you who comprise the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyamindradyumnasya mādhavaḥ /
uvāca sasmitaṃ vākyamaśeṣajagato hitam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यमिन्द्रद्युम्नस्य माधवः /
उवाच सस्मितं वाक्यमशेषजगतो हितम् //
text_mt: Hearing the speech of Indradyumna, Nārāyaṇa, Mādhava, / spoke smilingly words beneficial to the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
varṇāśramācāravatāṃ puṃsāṃ devo maheśvaraḥ /
jñānena bhaktiyogena pūjanīyo na cānyathā //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
वर्णाश्रमाचारवतां पुंसां देवो महेश्वरः /
ज्ञानेन भक्तियोगेन पूजनीयो न चान्यथा //
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
By men possessing the conduct of their social class and stage of life, the god Maheśvara / is to be worshipped through knowledge and the yoga of devotion, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāya tatparaṃ tattvaṃ vibhūtiṃ kāryakāraṇam /
pravṛtiṃ cāpi me jñātvā mokṣārthośvaramarcayet //
meaning:
विज्ञाय तत्परं तत्त्वं विभूतिं कार्यकारणम् /
प्रवृतिं चापि मे ज्ञात्वा मोक्षार्थोश्वरमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Having known that supreme reality, the divine manifestation, the cause and effect, / and also knowing my activity, one desiring liberation should worship the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṅgān parityajya jñātvā māyāmayaṃ jagat /
advaitaṃ bhāvayātmānaṃ drakṣyase parameśvaram //
meaning:
सर्वसङ्गान् परित्यज्य ज्ञात्वा मायामयं जगत् /
अद्वैतं भावयात्मानं द्रक्ष्यसे परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Abandoning all attachments, knowing the world to be composed of illusory creative power, / meditate upon the Self as non-dual; [then] you shall see the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
trividhā bhāvanā brahman procyamānā nibodha me /
ekā madviṣayā tatra dvitīyā vyaktasaṃśrayā /
anyā ca bhāvanā brāhmī vijñeyā sā guṇātigā //
meaning:
त्रिविधा भावना ब्रह्मन् प्रोच्यमाना निबोध मे /
एका मद्विषया तत्र द्वितीया व्यक्तसंश्रया /
अन्या च भावना ब्राह्मी विज्ञेया सा गुणातिगा //
text_mt: Threefold is the meditation, O brahmin; listen to it being proclaimed by me: / one is focused on me, the second rests on the manifest, / and another meditation, of Brahman, is to be known as transcending the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
āsāmanyatamāṃ cātha bhāvanāṃ bhāvayed budhaḥ /
aśaktaḥ saṃśrayedādyāmityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
आसामन्यतमां चाथ भावनां भावयेद् बुधः /
अशक्तः संश्रयेदाद्यामित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: A wise man should practice any one of these meditations; / if incapable, he should resort to the first—such is the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ /
samārādhaya viśveśaṃ tato mokṣamavāpsyasi //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः /
समाराधय विश्वेशं ततो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि //
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort, devoted to him, intent upon him, / worship the Lord of the universe; thence you shall attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumna uvāca
kiṃ tat parataraṃ tattvaṃ kā vibhūtirjanārdana /
kiṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ kastvaṃ pravṛttiścāpi kā tava //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच
किं तत् परतरं तत्त्वं का विभूतिर्जनार्दन /
किं कार्यं कारणं कस्त्वं प्रवृत्तिश्चापि का तव //
text_mt:
Indradyumna said:
What is that higher truth? What is the divine manifestation, O Janārdana? / What is the effect and the cause? Who are you, and what is your activity?

sanskrit_iast:
parātparataraṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ brahmaikamavyayam /
nityānandaṃ svayañjyotirakṣaraṃ tamasaḥ param //
meaning:
परात्परतरं तत्त्वं परं ब्रह्मैकमव्ययम् /
नित्यानन्दं स्वयञ्ज्योतिरक्षरं तमसः परम् //
text_mt: The supreme principle, higher than the highest, is the one immutable supreme Brahman, / eternal bliss, self-luminous, imperishable, and beyond darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryaṃ tasya yannityaṃ vibhūtiriti gīyate /
kāryaṃ jagadathāvyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ śuddhamakṣaram //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्यं तस्य यन्नित्यं विभूतिरिति गीयते /
कार्यं जगदथाव्यक्तं कारणं शुद्धमक्षरम् //
text_mt: Its eternal sovereignty is proclaimed as divine majesty; / the effect is the universe, while the unmanifest, pure, and imperishable is the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ hi sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ /
sargasthityantakartṛtvaṃ pravṛttirmama gīyate //
meaning:
अहं हि सर्वभूतानामन्तर्यामीश्वरः परः /
सर्गस्थित्यन्तकर्तृत्वं प्रवृत्तिर्मम गीयते //
text_mt: Indeed, I am the inner controller, the supreme Lord of all beings; / my activity is proclaimed to be the agency of creation, maintenance, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
etad vijñāya bhāvena yathāvadakhilaṃ dvija /
tatastvaṃ karmayogena śāśvataṃ samyagarcaya //
meaning:
एतद् विज्ञाय भावेन यथावदखिलं द्विज /
ततस्त्वं कर्मयोगेन शाश्वतं सम्यगर्चय //
text_mt: Having understood all this completely in your heart according to reality, O twice-born, / you should then duly worship the eternal one through the discipline of action.

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumna uvāca
ke te varṇāśramācārā yaiḥ samārādhyate paraḥ /
jñānaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ divyaṃ bhāvanātrayasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच
के ते वर्णाश्रमाचारा यैः समाराध्यते परः /
ज्ञानं च कीदृशं दिव्यं भावनात्रयसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: Indradyumna said: / What are those conduct rules of class and stage of life by which the Supreme is worshipped, / and of what kind is that divine knowledge founded on the three meditations?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sṛṣṭamidaṃ pūrvaṃ kathaṃ saṃhriyate punaḥ /
kiyatyaḥ sṛṣṭayo loke vaṃśā manvantarāṇi ca /
kāni teṣāṃ pramāṇāni pāvanāni vratāni ca //
meaning:
कथं सृष्टमिदं पूर्वं कथं संह्रियते पुनः /
कियत्यः सृष्टयो लोके वंशा मन्वन्तराणि च /
कानि तेषां प्रमाणानि पावनानि व्रतानि च //
text_mt: How was this universe created in the beginning, and how is it dissolved again? / How many creations are there in the world, and what are the genealogies and cosmic eras of Manus? / What are their measures, and what are the purifying religious observances?

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānyarkādisaṃsthānaṃ pṛthivyāyāmavistare /
kati dvīpāḥ samudrāśca parvatāśca nadīnadāḥ /
brūhi me puṇḍarīkākṣa yathāvadadhunākhilam //
meaning:
तीर्थान्यर्कादिसंस्थानं पृथिव्यायामविस्तरे /
कति द्वीपाः समुद्राश्च पर्वताश्च नदीनदाः /
ब्रूहि मे पुण्डरीकाक्ष यथावदधुनाखिलम् //
text_mt: Tell me of the sacred pilgrimage places, the positions of the sun and other heavenly bodies, the extent and width of the earth, / how many islands, oceans, mountains, and rivers there are, / O lotus-eyed one, tell me everything now according to reality.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
evamukto 'tha tenāhaṃ bhaktānugrahakāmyayā /
yathāvadakhilaṃ sarvamavocaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
एवमुक्तो ऽथ तेनाहं भक्तानुग्रहकाम्यया /
यथावदखिलं सर्वमवोचं मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: The holy Kūrma said: / Thus addressed by him, O best of sages, out of a desire to show grace to my devotee, / I spoke everything in full according to reality.

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyāyāśeṣamevedaṃ yatpṛṣṭo 'haṃ dvijena tu /
anugṛhya ca taṃ vipraṃ tatraivāntarhito 'bhavam //
meaning:
व्याख्यायाशेषमेवेदं यत्पृष्टो ऽहं द्विजेन तु /
अनुगृह्य च तं विप्रं तत्रैवान्तर्हितो ऽभवम् //
text_mt: Having explained completely all that I was asked by the twice-born, / and having bestowed grace upon that brāhmaṇa, I vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi tena vidhānena maduktena dvijottamaḥ /
ārādhayāmāsa paraṃ bhāvapūtaḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि तेन विधानेन मदुक्तेन द्विजोत्तमः /
आराधयामास परं भावपूतः समाहितः //
text_mt: He too, following that method declared by me, O best of the twice-born, / worshipped the Supreme with a purified disposition and a concentrated mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā putrādiṣu snehaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ /
saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi paraṃ vairāgyamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा पुत्रादिषु स्नेहं निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः /
संन्यस्य सर्वकर्माणि परं वैराग्यमाश्रितः //
text_mt: Having abandoned affection for sons and other relatives, free from dualities, devoid of possessions, / having renounced all actions, he took refuge in supreme detachment.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyātmānamanvīkṣya svātmanyevākhilaṃ jagat /
saṃprāpya bhāvanāmantyāṃ brāhmīmakṣarapūrvikām //
meaning:
आत्मन्यात्मानमन्वीक्ष्य स्वात्मन्येवाखिलं जगत् /
संप्राप्य भावनामन्त्यां ब्राह्मीमक्षरपूर्विकाम् //
text_mt: Seeing the Self in the self, and the entire universe within his very self, / having attained the ultimate meditation, belonging to Brahman and preceded by the imperishable,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa paramaṃ yogaṃ yenaikaṃ paripaśyati /
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ kāṅkṣante mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
अवाप परमं योगं येनैकं परिपश्यति /
यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः काङ्क्षन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt: he attained the supreme yoga by which one perceives the One, / which the sleepless, who have conquered their breath and seek liberation, desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kadācid yogīndro brahmāṇaṃ draṣṭumavyayam /
jagāmādityanirdeśānmānasottaraparvatam /
ākāśenaiva viprendro yogaiśvaryaprabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
ततः कदाचिद् योगीन्द्रो ब्रह्माणं द्रष्टुमव्ययम् /
जगामादित्यनिर्देशान्मानसोत्तरपर्वतम् /
आकाशेनैव विप्रेन्द्रो योगैश्वर्यप्रभावतः //
text_mt: Then once, to behold the imperishable Brahmā, that lord of yogins / went by the direction of the sun to Mount Mānasottara / through the sky, the best of brāhmaṇas, by the power of his yogic majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānaṃ sūryasaṃkāśaṃ prādhurbhūtamanuttamam /
anvagacchan devagaṇā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ /
dṛṣṭvānye pathi yogīndraṃ siddhā brahmarṣayo yayuḥ //
meaning:
विमानं सूर्यसंकाशं प्राधुर्भूतमनुत्तमम् /
अन्वगच्छन् देवगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः /
दृष्ट्वान्ये पथि योगीन्द्रं सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो ययुः //
text_mt: An incomparable aerial chariot, resembling the sun, appeared; / hosts of gods, gandharvas, and apsarases followed it; / seeing the lord of yogins on his way, other perfected beings and brāhmaṇa sages set forth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa gatvā tu giriṃ viveśa suravanditam /
sthānaṃ tadyogibhirjuṣṭaṃ yatrāste paramaḥ pumān //
meaning:
ततः स गत्वा तु गिरिं विवेश सुरवन्दितम् /
स्थानं तद्योगिभिर्जुष्टं यत्रास्ते परमः पुमान् //
text_mt: Then, having reached the mountain, he entered the place praised by the gods, / frequented by yogins, where the Supreme Person resides.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya paramaṃ sthānaṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham /
viveśa cāntarbhavanaṃ devānāṃ ca durāsadam //
meaning:
संप्राप्य परमं स्थानं सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् /
विवेश चान्तर्भवनं देवानां च दुरासदम् //
text_mt: Having reached the supreme abode, radiant as ten thousand suns, / he entered the inner mansion, difficult of access even for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vicintayāmāsa paraṃ śaraṇyaṃ sarvadehinām /
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
विचिन्तयामास परं शरण्यं सर्वदेहिनाम् /
अनादिनिधनं देवं देवदेवं पितामहम् //
text_mt: He meditated on the Supreme, the refuge of all embodied beings, / the god without beginning or end, the god of gods, the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prādurabhūt tasmin prakāśaḥ paramātmanaḥ /
tanmadhye puruṣaṃ pūrvamapaśyat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ततः प्रादुरभूत् तस्मिन् प्रकाशः परमात्मनः /
तन्मध्ये पुरुषं पूर्वमपश्यत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Then, within that place, the light of the Supreme Self appeared; / in its midst, he saw the ancient Person, the supreme state,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāntaṃ tejaso rāśimagamyaṃ brahmavidviṣām /
caturmukhamudārāṅgamarcibhirupaśobhitam //
meaning:
महान्तं तेजसो राशिमगम्यं ब्रह्मविद्विषाम् /
चतुर्मुखमुदाराङ्गमर्चिभिरुपशोभितम् //
text_mt: a great mass of splendor, inaccessible to those who hate Brahman, / having four faces, noble limbs, and adorned with rays of light.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi yoginamanvīkṣya praṇamantamupasthitam /
pratyudgamya svayaṃ devo viśvātmā pariṣasvaje //
meaning:
सो ऽपि योगिनमन्वीक्ष्य प्रणमन्तमुपस्थितम् /
प्रत्युद्गम्य स्वयं देवो विश्वात्मा परिषस्वजे //
text_mt: He too, beholding the yogin who approached and bowed down, / the god himself, the self of the universe, came forward to meet him and embraced him.

sanskrit_iast:
pariṣvaktasya devena dvijendrasyātha dehataḥ /
nirgatya mahatī jyotsnā viveśādityamaṇḍalam /
ṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃjñaṃ tat pavitramamalaṃ padam //
meaning:
परिष्वक्तस्य देवेन द्विजेन्द्रस्याथ देहतः /
निर्गत्य महती ज्योत्स्ना विवेशादित्यमण्डलम् /
ऋग्यजुः सामसंज्ञं तत् पवित्रममलं पदम् //
text_mt: Then, from the body of the best of the twice-born embraced by the god, / a great moonlight emerged and entered the orb of the sun— / that pure, stainless state known as the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān yatrāste havyakavyabhuk /
dvāraṃ tad yogināmādyaṃ vedānteṣu pratiṣṭhitam /
brahmatejomayaṃ śrīmanniṣṭhā caiva manīṣiṇām //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् यत्रास्ते हव्यकव्यभुक् /
द्वारं तद् योगिनामाद्यं वेदान्तेषु प्रतिष्ठितम् /
ब्रह्मतेजोमयं श्रीमन्निष्ठा चैव मनीषिणाम् //
text_mt: where the blessed Hiraṇyagarbha resides, consumer of oblations to gods and ancestors, / that primeval portal for yogins, established in the Upaniṣads, / consisting of the splendor of Brahman, glorious, the ultimate goal of the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭamātro bhagavatāta brahmaṇārcirmayo muniḥ /
apaśyadaiśvaraṃ tejaḥ śāntaṃ sarvatragaṃ śivam //
meaning:
दृष्टमात्रो भगवतात ब्रह्मणार्चिर्मयो मुनिः /
अपश्यदैश्वरं तेजः शान्तं सर्वत्रगं शिवम् //
text_mt: As soon as he was seen by the blessed Brahmā, the sage, made of radiance, / beheld the sovereign splendor, peaceful, all-pervading, and auspicious,

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānamakṣaraṃ vyomatad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam /
ānandamacalaṃ brahma sthānaṃ tatpārameśvaram //
meaning:
स्वात्मानमक्षरं व्योमतद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् /
आनन्दमचलं ब्रह्म स्थानं तत्पारमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: his own self, the imperishable ether, that highest state of Viṣṇu, / bliss, the immovable Brahman, that realm of the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtātmabhūtaḥ sa paramaiśvaryamāsthitaḥ /
prāptavānātmano dhāma yattanmokṣākhyamavyayam //
meaning:
सर्वभूतात्मभूतः स परमैश्वर्यमास्थितः /
प्राप्तवानात्मनो धाम यत्तन्मोक्षाख्यमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Having become the self of all beings, established in supreme sovereignty, / he attained the abode of the Self, which is called imperishable liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena varṇāśramavidhau sthitaḥ /
samāśrityāntimaṃ bhāvaṃ māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ tared budhaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वर्णाश्रमविधौ स्थितः /
समाश्रित्यान्तिमं भावं मायां लक्ष्मीं तरेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Therefore, standing steadfast in the rule of class and stage of life with every effort, / resorting to the ultimate meditation, a wise man should cross beyond Māyā, which is Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vyāhṛtā hariṇā tvevaṃ nārādādyā maharṣayaḥ /
śakreṇa sahitāḥ sarve papracchurgaruḍadhvajam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
व्याहृता हरिणा त्वेवं नारादाद्या महर्षयः /
शक्रेण सहिताः सर्वे पप्रच्छुर्गरुडध्वजम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by Hari, the great sages, Nārada and the others, / along with Indra, questioned the deity whose banner is Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
devadeva hṛṣīkeśa nātha nārāyaṇāmala /
tad vadāśeṣamasmākaṃ yaduktaṃ bhavatā purā //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
देवदेव हृषीकेश नाथ नारायणामल /
तद् वदाशेषमस्माकं यदुक्तं भवता पुरा //
text_mt: The sages said: / O god of gods, Hṛṣīkeśa, Lord, stainless Nārāyaṇa, / tell us in full that which was spoken by you of old

sanskrit_iast:
indradyumnāya viprayā jñānaṃ dharmādigocaram /
śuśrūṣuścāpyayaṃ śakraḥ sakhā tava jaganmaya //
meaning:
इन्द्रद्युम्नाय विप्रया ज्ञानं धर्मादिगोचरम् /
शुश्रूषुश्चाप्ययं शक्रः सखा तव जगन्मय //
text_mt: to the brāhmaṇa Indradyumna, the knowledge regarding duty and the rest; / and this Indra, your friend, O universe-formed one, also desires to hear it.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ /
rasātalagato devo nāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् विष्णुः कूर्मरूपी जनार्दनः /
रसातलगतो देवो नारदाद्यैर्महर्षिभिः //
text_mt: Then the blessed Viṣṇu, Janārdana embodied as a tortoise, / the god who had gone to the netherworld, [being questioned] by the great sages headed by Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭaḥ provāca sakalaṃ purāṇaṃ kaurmamuttamam /
sannidhau devarājasya tad vakṣye bhavatāmaham //
meaning:
पृष्टः प्रोवाच सकलं पुराणं कौर्ममुत्तमम् /
सन्निधौ देवराजस्य तद् वक्ष्ये भवतामहम् //
text_mt: having been questioned, spoke the entire excellent Kūrma Purāṇa / in the presence of the king of gods; that I shall declare to you.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyāmāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām /
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ viprāḥ kathanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यामायुष्यं पुण्यं मोक्षप्रदं नृणाम् /
पुराणश्रवणं विप्राः कथनं च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Hearing the Purāṇa, O brāhmaṇas, and especially narrating it, / is auspicious, conducive to fame, life-prolonging, meritorious, and bestows liberation upon human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā cādhyāyamevaikaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
upākhyānamathaikaṃ vā brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा चाध्यायमेवैकं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
उपाख्यानमथैकं वा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Having heard even a single chapter, one is freed from all sins; / or [hearing] a single episode, one is exalted in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ purāṇaṃ paramaṃ kaurmaṃ kūrmasvarūpiṇā /
uktaṃ devādhidevena śraddhātavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इदं पुराणं परमं कौर्मं कूर्मस्वरूपिणा /
उक्तं देवाधिदेवेन श्रद्धातव्यं द्विजातिभिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे प्रथमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This supreme Kūrma Purāṇa, spoken by the god of gods / in the form of a tortoise, is to be revered with faith by the twice-born.

Thus ends the first chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve yatpṛṣṭo 'haṃ jagaddhitam /
vakṣyamāṇaṃ mayā sarvamindradyumnāya bhāṣitam //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे यत्पृष्टो ऽहं जगद्धितम् /
वक्ष्यमाणं मया सर्वमिन्द्रद्युम्नाय भाषितम् //
title: dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The holy Kūrma said: / Listen, all you sages, to that which is beneficial to the world about which I was asked; / all that was spoken by me to Indradyumna shall now be declared.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtairbhavyairbhaviṣyadbhiścaritairupabṛṃhitam /
purāṇaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṛṇāṃ mokṣadharmānukīrtanam //
meaning:
भूतैर्भव्यैर्भविष्यद्भिश्चरितैरुपबृंहितम् /
पुराणं पुण्यदं नृणां मोक्षधर्मानुकीर्तनम् //
text_mt: It is enriched with past, present, and future deeds, / a Purāṇa bestowing merit on men, proclaiming the principles of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ pūrvamāsaṃ na me param /
upāsya vipulāṃ nidrāṃ bhogiśayyāṃ samāśritaḥ //
meaning:
अहं नारायणो देवः पूर्वमासं न मे परम् /
उपास्य विपुलां निद्रां भोगिशय्यां समाश्रितः //
text_mt: In the beginning, I was the god Nārāyaṇa; there was nothing beyond me. / Resorting to vast sleep, I rested upon the serpent-bed.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayāmi punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ niśānte pratibudhya tu /
tato me sahasotpannaḥ prasādo munipuṅgavā //
meaning:
चिन्तयामि पुनः सृष्टिं निशान्ते प्रतिबुध्य तु /
ततो मे सहसोत्पन्नः प्रसादो मुनिपुङ्गवा //
text_mt: At the end of the cosmic night, having awakened, I contemplated creation anew; / then, O best of sages, grace suddenly arose within me.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhastato jāto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
tadantare 'bhavat krodhaḥ kasmāccit kāraṇāt tadā //
meaning:
चतुर्मुखस्ततो जातो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
तदन्तरे ऽभवत् क्रोधः कस्माच्चित् कारणात् तदा //
text_mt: From that grace arose four-faced Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds; / in the interim, for some reason, wrath then arose.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano muniśārdūlāstatra devo maheśvaraḥ /
rudraḥ krodhātmajo jajñe śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ /
tejasā sūryasaṃkāśastrailokyaṃ saṃharanniva //
meaning:
आत्मनो मुनिशार्दूलास्तत्र देवो महेश्वरः /
रुद्रः क्रोधात्मजो जज्ञे शूलपाणिस्त्रिलोचनः /
तेजसा सूर्यसंकाशस्त्रैलोक्यं संहरन्निव //
text_mt: From myself, O tigers among sages, the god Maheśvara, / Rudra, born of wrath, was born there, trident in hand, three-eyed, / resembling the sun in splendor, as if destroying the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śrīrabhavad devi kamalāyatalocanā /
surūpā saumyavadanā mohinī sarvadehinām //
meaning:
ततः श्रीरभवद् देवि कमलायतलोचना /
सुरूपा सौम्यवदना मोहिनी सर्वदेहिनाम् //
text_mt: Then Śrī arose, the goddess with large lotus eyes, / beautiful of form, of gentle countenance, who enchants all embodied beings,

sanskrit_iast:
śucismitā suprasannā maṅgalā mahimāspadā /
divyakāntisamāyuktā divyamālyopaśobhitā //
meaning:
शुचिस्मिता सुप्रसन्ना मङ्गला महिमास्पदा /
दिव्यकान्तिसमायुक्ता दिव्यमाल्योपशोभिता //
text_mt: pure of smile, very gracious, auspicious, the abode of majesty, / endowed with divine radiance, and adorned with divine garlands.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇī mahāmāyā mūlaprakṛtiravyayā /
svadhāmnā pūrayantīdaṃ matpārśvaṃ samupāviśat //
meaning:
नारायणी महामाया मूलप्रकृतिरव्यया /
स्वधाम्ना पूरयन्तीदं मत्पार्श्वं समुपाविशत् //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇī, the great illusory creative power, imperishable primordial matter, / filling this [universe] with her own radiance, sat down beside me.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭavā bhagavān brahmā māmuvāca jagatpatiḥ /
mohāyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ niyojaya surūpiṇīm /
yeneyaṃ vipulā sṛṣṭirvardhate mama mādhava //
meaning:
तां दृष्टवा भगवान् ब्रह्मा मामुवाच जगत्पतिः /
मोहायाशेषभूतानां नियोजय सुरूपिणीम् /
येनेयं विपुला सृष्टिर्वर्धते मम माधव //
text_mt: Seeing her, the blessed Brahmā, the lord of the universe, said to me: / ‘Direct this beautifully formed one toward deluding all creatures, / so that this vast creation of mine may increase, O Mādhava.’

sanskrit_iast:
tathokto 'haṃ śriyaṃ devīmabruvaṃ prahasanniva /
devīdamakhilaṃ viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
mohayitvā mamādeśāt saṃsāre vinipātaya //
meaning:
तथोक्तो ऽहं श्रियं देवीमब्रुवं प्रहसन्निव /
देवीदमखिलं विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
मोहयित्वा ममादेशात् संसारे विनिपातय //
text_mt: Being addressed thus, I, smiling as it were, spoke to goddess Śrī: / ‘O goddess, deluding this entire universe together with gods, asuras, and humans, / cast [them] down into worldly existence by my command!

sanskrit_iast:
jñānayogaratān dāntān brahmiṣṭhān brahmavādinaḥ /
akrodhanān satyaparān dūrataḥ parivarjaya //
meaning:
ज्ञानयोगरतान् दान्तान् ब्रह्मिष्ठान् ब्रह्मवादिनः /
अक्रोधनान् सत्यपरान् दूरतः परिवर्जय //
text_mt: Those devoted to the discipline of knowledge, the self-controlled, the most steadfast in Brahman, those who proclaim Brahman, / free from anger, dedicated to truth—avoid them from afar!

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyino nirmamān śāntān dhārmikān vedapāragān /
jāpinastāpasān viprān dūrataḥ parivarjaya //
meaning:
ध्यायिनो निर्ममान् शान्तान् धार्मिकान् वेदपारगान् /
जापिनस्तापसान् विप्रान् दूरतः परिवर्जय //
text_mt: Meditators, free from possessiveness, calm, righteous, those who have mastered the Vedas, / mutterers of prayers, ascetics, brahmins—avoid them from afar!

sanskrit_iast:
vedavedāntavijñānasaṃchinnāśeṣasaṃśayān /
mahāyajñaparān viprān dūrataḥ parivarjaya //
meaning:
वेदवेदान्तविज्ञानसंछिन्नाशेषसंशयान् /
महायज्ञपरान् विप्रान् दूरतः परिवर्जय //
text_mt: Brahmins whose all doubts are severed by understanding of the Veda and Vedānta, / dedicated to the great sacrifices—avoid them from afar!

sanskrit_iast:
ye yajanti japairhemairdevadevaṃ maheśvaram /
svādhyāyenejyayā dūrāt tān prayatnena varjaya //
meaning:
ये यजन्ति जपैर्हेमैर्देवदेवं महेश्वरम् /
स्वाध्यायेनेज्यया दूरात् तान् प्रयत्नेन वर्जय //
text_mt: Those who sacrifice to the god of gods, the great lord [Śiva], through muttered prayers, oblations, / self-study, and worship—carefully keep far away from them!

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiyogasamāyuktānīśvarārpitamānasān /
prāṇāyāmādiṣu ratān dūrāt pariharāmalān //
meaning:
भक्तियोगसमायुक्तानीश्वरार्पितमानसान् /
प्राणायामादिषु रतान् दूरात् परिहरामलान् //
text_mt: Those endowed with the discipline of devotion, their minds offered to the Lord, / devoted to breath control and the like—shun these pure ones from afar!

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavāsaktamanaso rudrajapyaparāyaṇān /
atharvaśiraso 'dhyetṛn dharmajñān parivarjaya //
meaning:
प्रणवासक्तमनसो रुद्रजप्यपरायणान् /
अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येतृन् धर्मज्ञान् परिवर्जय //
text_mt: Those whose minds are fixed upon the sacred syllable Om, intent on muttering the Rudra-hymn, / reciters of the Atharvaśiras, knowers of duty—avoid them!

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena svadharmaparipālakān /
īśvarārādhanaratān manniyogānna mohaya //
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन स्वधर्मपरिपालकान् /
ईश्वराराधनरतान् मन्नियोगान्न मोहय //
text_mt: What need is there to say much here? Do not delude those who maintain their own duty, / who are devoted to worshipping the Lord, by my instruction.’

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mayā mahāmāyā preritā harivallabhā /
yathādeśaṃ cakārāsau tasmāllakṣmīṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
एवं मया महामाया प्रेरिता हरिवल्लभा /
यथादेशं चकारासौ तस्माल्लक्ष्मीं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: Thus the great illusory creative power, beloved of Hari, was directed by me; / she acted according to the command; therefore one should revere Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
śriyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ puṣṭiṃ medhāṃ yaśo balam /
arcitā bhagavatpatnī tasmāllakṣmīṃ samarcayet //
meaning:
श्रियं ददाति विपुलां पुष्टिं मेधां यशो बलम् /
अर्चिता भगवत्पत्नी तस्माल्लक्ष्मीं समर्चयेत् //
text_mt: When worshipped, the Lord's consort grants abundant prosperity, nourishment, intellect, fame, and strength; / therefore one should revere Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sṛjat sa bhagavān brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
carācarāṇi bhūtāni yathāpūrvaṃ mamājñayā //
meaning:
ततो ऽसृजत् स भगवान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
चराचराणि भूतानि यथापूर्वं ममाज्ञया //
text_mt: Then the blessed Brahmā, grandfather of the worlds, / created the moving and unmoving beings as before, according to my command.

sanskrit_iast:
parīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaḥ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum /
dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā //
meaning:
परीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसः पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् /
दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद् योगविद्यया //
text_mt: Marīci, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Dakṣa, Atri, and Vasiṣṭha—he created through the lore of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
navaite brahmaṇaḥ putrā brahmāṇo brāhmaṇottamāḥ /
brahmavādina evaite marīcyādyāstu sādhakāḥ //
meaning:
नवैते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा ब्रह्माणो ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः /
ब्रह्मवादिन एवैते मरीच्याद्यास्तु साधकाः //
text_mt: These nine sons of Brahmā are Brahmās, best of brahmins; / Marīci and the rest are indeed declarers of Brahman and accomplished adepts.

sanskrit_iast:
sasarja brāhmaṇān vaktrāt kṣatriyāṃśca bhujād vibhuḥ /
vaiśyānūrudvayād devaḥ pādārchūdrān pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
ससर्ज ब्राह्मणान् वक्त्रात् क्षत्रियांश्च भुजाद् विभुः /
वैश्यानूरुद्वयाद् देवः पादार्छूद्रान् पितामहः //
text_mt: The omnipresent Lord created the brahmins from his mouth, the kṣatriyas from his arms, / the vaiśyas from his two thighs, and the grandfather [created] the śūdras from his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñaniṣpattaye brahmā śūdravarjaṃ sasarja ha /
guptaye sarvavedānāṃ tebhyo yajño hi nirbabhau //
meaning:
यज्ञनिष्पत्तये ब्रह्मा शूद्रवर्जं ससर्ज ह /
गुप्तये सर्ववेदानां तेभ्यो यज्ञो हि निर्बभौ //
text_mt: For the performance of sacrifice, Brahmā created them, excluding the śūdra; / for the preservation of all the Vedas—indeed, the sacrifice shone forth from them.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni tathaivātharvaṇāni ca /
brahmaṇaḥ sahajaṃ rūpaṃ nityaiṣā śaktiravyayā //
meaning:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि तथैवाथर्वणानि च /
ब्रह्मणः सहजं रूपं नित्यैषा शक्तिरव्यया //
text_mt: The Ṛg, Yajus, Sāman, and likewise the Atharvan hymns / are the innate form of Brahman; this power is eternal and imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhanā divyā vāgutsṛṣṭā svayaṃbhuvā /
ādau vedamayī bhūtā yataḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
अनादिनिधना दिव्या वागुत्सृष्टा स्वयंभुवा /
आदौ वेदमयी भूता यतः सर्वाः प्रवृत्तयः //
text_mt: Divine Speech, beginningless and endless, was emitted by the Self-born; / in the beginning it became composed of the Veda, from which all activities proceed.

sanskrit_iast:
ato 'nyānitu śāstrāṇipṛthivyāṃyānikānicit /
na teṣu ramate dhīraḥ pāṣaṇḍī tena jāyate //
meaning:
अतो ऽन्यानितु शास्त्राणिपृथिव्यांयानिकानिचित् /
न तेषु रमते धीरः पाषण्डी तेन जायते //
text_mt: Therefore, whatever other treatises there may be on earth, / the wise man takes no pleasure in them; thereby one becomes a heretic.

sanskrit_iast:
vedārthavittamaiḥ kāryaṃ yatsmṛtaṃ munibhiḥ purā /
sa jñeyaḥ paramo dharmo nānyaśāstreṣu saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
वेदार्थवित्तमैः कार्यं यत्स्मृतं मुनिभिः पुरा /
स ज्ञेयः परमो धर्मो नान्यशास्त्रेषु संस्थितः //
text_mt: Whatever was recorded by ancient sages who were best among knowers of the Veda's meaning / is to be known as the supreme duty; it is not established in other treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
yā vedabāhyāḥ smṛtayo yāśca kāśca kudṛṣṭayaḥ /
sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ pretyatamoniṣṭhāhitāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
या वेदबाह्याः स्मृतयो याश्च काश्च कुदृष्टयः /
सर्वास्ता निष्फलाः प्रेत्यतमोनिष्ठाहिताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Whatever traditional texts are outside the Veda, and whatever false doctrines there are, / all of them are recorded as fruitless in the hereafter, grounded in darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvakalpe prajā jātāḥ sarvabādāvivarjitāḥ /
śuddhāntaḥ karaṇāḥ sarvāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sadā //
meaning:
पूर्वकल्पे प्रजा जाताः सर्वबादाविवर्जिताः /
शुद्धान्तः करणाः सर्वाः स्वधर्मनिरताः सदा //
text_mt: The creatures born in the previous kalpa were free from all afflictions, / all of them pure in mind, always devoted to their own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālavaśāt tāsāṃ rāgadveṣādiko 'bhavat /
adharmo muniśārdūlāḥ svadharmapratibandhakaḥ //
meaning:
ततः कालवशात् तासां रागद्वेषादिको ऽभवत् /
अधर्मो मुनिशार्दूलाः स्वधर्मप्रतिबन्धकः //
text_mt: Then, under the influence of time, there arose among them unrighteousness— / passion, hatred, and the like, O tigers among sages, an obstruction to their own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā sahajā siddhistāsāṃ nātīva jāyate /
rajomātrātmikāstāsāṃ siddhayo 'nyāstadābhavan //
meaning:
ततः सा सहजा सिद्धिस्तासां नातीव जायते /
रजोमात्रात्मिकास्तासां सिद्धयो ऽन्यास्तदाभवन् //
text_mt: Then that innate perfection no longer arose strongly for them; / other perfections consisting of passion alone then arose for them.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsu kṣīṇāsvaśeṣāsu kālayogena tāḥ punaḥ /
vārtopāyaṃ punaścakrurhastasiddhiṃ ca karmajām /
tatastāsāṃ vibhurbrahmā karmājīvamakalpayat //
meaning:
तासु क्षीणास्वशेषासु कालयोगेन ताः पुनः /
वार्तोपायं पुनश्चक्रुर्हस्तसिद्धिं च कर्मजाम् /
ततस्तासां विभुर्ब्रह्मा कर्माजीवमकल्पयत् //
text_mt: When those [perfections] were completely exhausted in the course of time, they again / devised means of livelihood and manual skills arising from action; / then the all-pervading Brahmā fashioned an active livelihood for them.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ dharmān provāca dharmadṛk /
sākṣāt prajāpatermūrtirnisṛṣṭā brahmaṇā dvijāḥ /
bhṛgvādayastadvadanācchrutvā dharmānathocire //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं धर्मान् प्रोवाच धर्मदृक् /
साक्षात् प्रजापतेर्मूर्तिर्निसृष्टा ब्रह्मणा द्विजाः /
भृग्वादयस्तद्वदनाच्छ्रुत्वा धर्मानथोचिरे //
text_mt: Formerly, Svāyambhuva Manu, who saw the truth of duty, / the direct embodiment of the Lord of Creatures created by Brahmā, proclaimed the duties, O twice-born; / Bhṛgu and the others, having heard them from his mouth, then proclaimed the duties:

sanskrit_iast:
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇasya pratigraham /
adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ ṣaṭ karmāṇi dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
यजनं याजनं दानं ब्राह्मणस्य प्रतिग्रहम् /
अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं षट् कर्माणि द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Sacrificing, conducting sacrifice, giving, accepting gifts, / teaching, and studying [the Veda] are the six duties of a brahmin, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
dānamadhyayanaṃ yajño dharmaḥ kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ /
daṇḍo yuddhaṃ kṣatriyasya kṛṣirvaiśyasya śasyate //
meaning:
दानमध्ययनं यज्ञो धर्मः क्षत्रियवैश्ययोः /
दण्डो युद्धं क्षत्रियस्य कृषिर्वैश्यस्य शस्यते //
text_mt: Giving, studying [the Veda], and sacrifice are the duty of the kṣatriya and the vaiśya; / punishment and warfare are commended for the kṣatriya, and agriculture for the vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣaiva dvijātīnāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ dharmasādhanam /
kārukarma tathājīvaḥ pākayajño 'pi dharmataḥ //
meaning:
शुश्रूषैव द्विजातीनां शूद्राणां धर्मसाधनम् /
कारुकर्म तथाजीवः पाकयज्ञो ऽपि धर्मतः //
text_mt: Service alone to the twice-born is the means of duty for śūdras, / and craft-work is their livelihood, as well as the domestic cooked-food offering according to duty.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sthiteṣu varṇeṣu sthāpayāmāsa cāśramān /
gṛhasthaṃ ca vanasthaṃ ca bhikṣukaṃ brahmacāriṇam //
meaning:
ततः स्थितेषु वर्णेषु स्थापयामास चाश्रमान् /
गृहस्थं च वनस्थं च भिक्षुकं ब्रह्मचारिणम् //
text_mt: Then, when the social classes were established, he also instituted the stages of life: / the householder, the forest-dweller, the mendicant, and the celibate student.

sanskrit_iast:
agnayo 'tithiśuśrūṣā yajño dānaṃ surārcanam /
gṛhasthasya samāsena dharmo 'yaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
अग्नयो ऽतिथिशुश्रूषा यज्ञो दानं सुरार्चनम् /
गृहस्थस्य समासेन धर्मो ऽयं मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: The sacred fires, service to guests, sacrifice, giving, and worship of the gods / are, in brief, this duty of the householder, O eminent sages.

sanskrit_iast:
homo mūlaphalāśitvaṃ svādhyāyastapa eva ca /
saṃvibhāgo yathānyāyaṃ dharmo 'yaṃ vanavāsinām //
meaning:
होमो मूलफलाशित्वं स्वाध्यायस्तप एव च /
संविभागो यथान्यायं धर्मो ऽयं वनवासिनाम् //
text_mt: Offering oblations, eating roots and fruits, self-study, austerity, / and sharing [food] according to rule—this is the duty of forest-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣāśanaṃ ca maunitvaṃ tapo dhyānaṃ viśeṣataḥ /
samyagjñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ dharmo 'yaṃ bhikṣuke mataḥ //
meaning:
भैक्षाशनं च मौनित्वं तपो ध्यानं विशेषतः /
सम्यग्ज्ञानं च वैराग्यं धर्मो ऽयं भिक्षुके मतः //
text_mt: Eating begged food, silence, austerity, especially meditation, / correct knowledge, and detachment are considered the duty of the mendicant.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣācaryā ca śuśrūṣā guroḥ svādhyāya eva ca /
sandhyākarmāgnikāryaṃ ca dharmo 'yaṃ brahmacāriṇām //
meaning:
भिक्षाचर्या च शुश्रूषा गुरोः स्वाध्याय एव च /
सन्ध्याकर्माग्निकार्यं च धर्मो ऽयं ब्रह्मचारिणाम् //
text_mt: Begging for food, service to the teacher, self-study, / the twilight rituals, and tending the sacred fire are this duty of celibate students.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārivanasthānāṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ /
sādhāraṇaṃ brahmacaryaṃ provāca kamalodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारिवनस्थानां भिक्षुकाणां द्विजोत्तमाः /
साधारणं ब्रह्मचर्यं प्रोवाच कमलोद्भवः //
text_mt: For celibate students, forest-dwellers, and mendicants, O best of twice-born, / the lotus-born [Brahmā] taught common celibacy.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtukālābhigāmitvaṃ svadāreṣu na cānyataḥ /
parvavarjaṃ gṛhasthasya brahmacaryamudāhṛtam //
meaning:
ऋतुकालाभिगामित्वं स्वदारेषु न चान्यतः /
पर्ववर्जं गृहस्थस्य ब्रह्मचर्यमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Approaching one's own wife during the fertile period and nowhere else, / except on sacred days, is declared to be the celibacy of the householder.

sanskrit_iast:
āgarbhasaṃbhavādādyāt kāryaṃ tenāpramādataḥ /
akurvāṇastu viprendrā bhrūṇahā tu prajāyate //
meaning:
आगर्भसंभवादाद्यात् कार्यं तेनाप्रमादतः /
अकुर्वाणस्तु विप्रेन्द्रा भ्रूणहा तु प्रजायते //
text_mt: Until the initial conception occurs, he must perform this without negligence; / for by not doing so, O foremost of brahmins, he becomes a slayer of the fetus.

sanskrit_iast:
vedābhyāso 'nvahaṃ śaktyā śrāddhaṃ cātithipūjanam /
gṛhasthasya paro dharmo devatābhyarcanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वेदाभ्यासो ऽन्वहं शक्त्या श्राद्धं चातिथिपूजनम् /
गृहस्थस्य परो धर्मो देवताभ्यर्चनं तथा //
text_mt: Daily study of the Veda to the best of one's ability, ancestral offering rites, honoring guests, / and worship of the deities is the supreme duty of the householder.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivāhmamagnimindhīta sāyaṃ prātaryathāvidhi /
deśāntaragato vātha mṛtapatnīka eva vā //
meaning:
वैवाह्ममग्निमिन्धीत सायं प्रातर्यथाविधि /
देशान्तरगतो वाथ मृतपत्नीक एव वा //
text_mt: He should kindle the marital fire in the evening and morning according to rule, / even if gone to another region or if his wife has died.

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ tu gṛhastho yonirucyate /
anye tamupajīvanti tasmācchreyān gṛhāśramī //
meaning:
त्रयाणामाश्रमाणां तु गृहस्थो योनिरुच्यते /
अन्ये तमुपजीवन्ति तस्माच्छ्रेयान् गृहाश्रमी //
text_mt: The householder is indeed declared to be the source of the three stages of life; / the others depend on him; therefore the householder is the most excellent.

sanskrit_iast:
aikāśramyaṃ gṛhasthasya trayāṇāṃ śrutidarśanāt /
tasmād gārhasthyamevaikaṃ vijñeyaṃ dharmasādhanam //
meaning:
ऐकाश्रम्यं गृहस्थस्य त्रयाणां श्रुतिदर्शनात् /
तस्माद् गार्हस्थ्यमेवैकं विज्ञेयं धर्मसाधनम् //
text_mt: The householder is the single essential stage of life, because the [other] three are seen in the Śruti; / therefore the state of householder alone is to be known as the sole instrument of duty.

sanskrit_iast:
parityajedarthakāmau yau syātāṃ dharmavarjitau /
sarvalokaviruddhaṃ ca dharmamapyācarenna tu //
meaning:
परित्यजेदर्थकामौ यौ स्यातां धर्मवर्जितौ /
सर्वलोकविरुद्धं च धर्ममप्याचरेन्न तु //
text_mt: One should abandon wealth and desire which are devoid of duty; / and one must not practice even duty if it is opposed to all the world.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāt saṃjāyate hyartho dharmāt kāmo 'bhijāyate /
dharma evāpavargāya tasmād dharmaṃ samāśrayet //
meaning:
धर्मात् संजायते ह्यर्थो धर्मात् कामो ऽभिजायते /
धर्म एवापवर्गाय तस्माद् धर्मं समाश्रयेत् //
text_mt: For from duty wealth arises; from duty desire is born; / duty alone leads to final liberation; therefore one should resort to duty.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca trivargastriguṇo mataḥ /
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti tasmāddharmaṃ samāśrayet //
meaning:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च त्रिवर्गस्त्रिगुणो मतः /
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति तस्माद्धर्मं समाश्रयेत् //
text_mt: Duty, wealth, and desire are considered the group of three, possessing the three qualities: / goodness, passion, and darkness; therefore one should resort to duty.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ /
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः /
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः //
text_mt:
Those established in sattva go upward; those characterized by rajas stay in the middle;
those situated in the functioning of the lowest quality, characterized by tamas, go downward.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmin dharmasamāyuktāvarthakāmau vyavasthitau /
iha loke sukhī bhūtvā pretyānantyāya kalpate //
meaning:
यस्मिन् धर्मसमायुक्तावर्थकामौ व्यवस्थितौ /
इह लोके सुखी भूत्वा प्रेत्यानन्त्याय कल्पते //
text_mt:
In whom wealth and desire are properly established in union with dharma,
he becomes happy in this world and is fitted for infinity after death.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāt saṃjāyate mokṣo hyarthāt kāmo 'bhijāyate /
evaṃ sādhanasādhyatvaṃ cāturvidhye pradarśitam //
meaning:
धर्मात् संजायते मोक्षो ह्यर्थात् कामो ऽभिजायते /
एवं साधनसाध्यत्वं चातुर्विध्ये प्रदर्शितम् //
text_mt:
From dharma arises liberation, and from wealth desire is born;
thus the relation of means and goal has been shown in the fourfold group.

sanskrit_iast:
ya evaṃ veda dharmārthakāmamokṣasya mānavaḥ /
māhātmyaṃ cānutiṣṭheta sa cānantyāya kalpate //
meaning:
य एवं वेद धर्मार्थकाममोक्षस्य मानवः /
माहात्म्यं चानुतिष्ठेत स चानन्त्याय कल्पते //
text_mt:
Whatever man knows thus the greatness of dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation,
and carries it out, is fitted for infinity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca tyaktvā dharmaṃ samāśrayet /
dharmāt saṃjāyate sarvamityāhurbrahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादर्थं च कामं च त्यक्त्वा धर्मं समाश्रयेत् /
धर्मात् संजायते सर्वमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt:
Therefore, having abandoned wealth and desire, one should take refuge in dharma;
from dharma everything arises—so say the teachers of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmeṇa dhāryate sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam /
anādinidhanā śaktiḥ saiṣā brāhmī dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मेण धार्यते सर्वं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
अनादिनिधना शक्तिः सैषा ब्राह्मी द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
By dharma the entire world, both moving and unmoving, is sustained;
this is that beginningless and endless power of Brahmā, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā prāpyate dharmo jñānena ca na saṃśayaḥ /
tasmājjñānena sahitaṃ karmayogaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
कर्मणा प्राप्यते धर्मो ज्ञानेन च न संशयः /
तस्माज्ज्ञानेन सहितं कर्मयोगं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
By action dharma is attained, and by knowledge, without a doubt;
therefore one should practice the yoga of action accompanied by knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam /
jñānapūrvaṃ nivṛttaṃ syāt pravṛttaṃ yadato 'nyathā //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तं च निवृत्तं च द्विविधं कर्म वैदिकम् /
ज्ञानपूर्वं निवृत्तं स्यात् प्रवृत्तं यदतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt:
Vedic action is of two kinds: directed toward engagement and directed toward disengagement.
Action preceded by knowledge is disengagement; that which is otherwise is engagement.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttaṃ sevamānastu yāti tat paramaṃ padam /
tasmānnivṛttaṃ saṃsevyamanyathā saṃsaret punaḥ //
meaning:
निवृत्तं सेवमानस्तु याति तत् परमं पदम् /
तस्मान्निवृत्तं संसेव्यमन्यथा संसरेत् पुनः //
text_mt:
Practicing disengagement, one goes to that supreme abode;
therefore disengagement should be cultivated, otherwise one transmigrates again.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā damo dayā dānamalobhastyāga eva ca /
ārjavaṃ cānasūyā ca tīrthānusaraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
क्षमा दमो दया दानमलोभस्त्याग एव च /
आर्जवं चानसूया च तीर्थानुसरणं तथा //
text_mt:
Patience, self-control, compassion, generosity, freedom from greed, renunciation,
straightforwardness, freedom from envy, and visiting sacred pilgrimage places,

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ santoṣa āstikyaṃ śraddhā cendriyanigrahaḥ /
devatābhyarcanaṃ pūjā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सत्यं सन्तोष आस्तिक्यं श्रद्धा चेन्द्रियनिग्रहः /
देवताभ्यर्चनं पूजा ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः //
text_mt:
Truthfulness, contentment, faith in the sacred, trust, restraint of the senses,
and worship of deities, especially the honoring of brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
āhiṃsā priyavāditvamapaiśunyamakalkatā /
sāmāsikamimaṃ dharmaṃ cāturvarṇye 'bravīnmanuḥ //
meaning:
आहिंसा प्रियवादित्वमपैशुन्यमकल्कता /
सामासिकमिमं धर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्ये ऽब्रवीन्मनुः //
text_mt:
Non-violence, speaking kindly, absence of slander, absence of deceit—
this brief summary of dharma Manu declared for the four classes.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ kriyāvatām /
sthānamaindraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinām //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं ब्राह्मणानां स्मृतं स्थानं क्रियावताम् /
स्थानमैन्द्रं क्षत्रियाणां संग्रामेष्वपलायिनाम् //
text_mt:
The realm of Prajāpati is remembered as the destination for ritual-practicing brāhmaṇas;
the realm of Indra for kṣatriyas who do not flee in battles;

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyānāṃ mārutaṃ sthānaṃ svadharmamanuvartatām /
gāndharvaṃ śūdrajātīnāṃ paricāreṇa vartatām //
meaning:
वैश्यानां मारुतं स्थानं स्वधर्ममनुवर्तताम् /
गान्धर्वं शूद्रजातीनां परिचारेण वर्तताम् //
text_mt:
The realm of the wind-gods for vaiśyas who adhere to their own duty;
and the realm of the Gandharvas for śūdras who abide in service.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāśītisahastrāṇāmṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām /
smṛtaṃ teṣāṃ tu yatsthānaṃ tadeva guruvāsinām //
meaning:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्त्राणामृषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् /
स्मृतं तेषां तु यत्स्थानं तदेव गुरुवासिनाम् //
text_mt:
The abode remembered for the eighty-eight thousand sages with drawn-up semen,
that very same is the abode for those who dwell with their teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣoṇāṃ tu yatsthānaṃ smṛtaṃ tad vai vanaukasām /
prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ sthānamuktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā //
meaning:
सप्तर्षोणां तु यत्स्थानं स्मृतं तद् वै वनौकसाम् /
प्राजापत्यं गृहस्थानां स्थानमुक्तं स्वयंभुवा //
text_mt:
The abode remembered for the seven sages is indeed for forest-dwellers;
the realm of Prajāpati was declared by the Self-born for householders.

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ yatacittānāṃ nyāsināmūrdhvaretasām /
hairaṇyagarbhaṃ tat sthānaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ //
meaning:
यतीनां यतचित्तानां न्यासिनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् /
हैरण्यगर्भं तत् स्थानं यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः //
text_mt:
For ascetics of restrained mind, renunciants with drawn-up semen,
there is that realm of Hiraṇyagarbha from which one does not return again.

sanskrit_iast:
yogināmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ vyomākhyaṃ paramākṣaram /
ānandamaiśvaraṃ dhāma sā kāṣṭhā sā parāgatiḥ //
meaning:
योगिनाममृतं स्थानं व्योमाख्यं परमाक्षरम् /
आनन्दमैश्वरं धाम सा काष्ठा सा परागतिः //
text_mt:
For yogins, the immortal abode is called the void, the supreme imperishable,
the bliss-filled sovereign realm—that is the highest state, that is the supreme path.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaca ūcuḥ
bhagavan devatārighna hiraṇyākṣaniṣūdana /
catvāro hyāśramāḥ proktā yogināmeka ucyate //
meaning:
ऋषच ऊचुः
भगवन् देवतारिघ्न हिरण्याक्षनिषूदन /
चत्वारो ह्याश्रमाः प्रोक्ता योगिनामेक उच्यते //
text_mt:
The sages said:
O Lord, slayer of the enemies of the gods, slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa!
Four stages of life have been taught, but only one is mentioned for yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma ūvāca
sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya samādhimacalaṃ śritaḥ /
ya āste niścalo yogī sa saṃnyāsī na pañcamaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म ऊवाच
सर्वकर्माणि संन्यस्य समाधिमचलं श्रितः /
य आस्ते निश्चलो योगी स संन्यासी न पञ्चमः //
text_mt:
The glorious Kūrma said:
Having renounced all actions, established in unshakeable absorption,
the motionless yogin who abides [thus] is a renunciant, not a fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ tu dvaividhyaṃ śrutadarśitam /
brahmacāryupakurvāṇo naiṣṭhiko brahmatatparaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषामाश्रमाणां तु द्वैविध्यं श्रुतदर्शितम् /
ब्रह्मचार्युपकुर्वाणो नैष्ठिको ब्रह्मतत्परः //
text_mt:
A twofold division for all stages of life is shown by the Veda:
the student who provides service, and the lifelong student devoted to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'dhītyavidhivadvedān gṛhasthāśramamāvrajet /
upakurvāṇako jñeyo naiṣṭhiko maraṇāntikaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽधीत्यविधिवद्वेदान् गृहस्थाश्रममाव्रजेत् /
उपकुर्वाणको ज्ञेयो नैष्ठिको मरणान्तिकः //
text_mt:
He who, having studied the Vedas according to rule, enters the householder stage
is to be known as providing service; the lifelong student continues until death.

sanskrit_iast:
udāsīnaḥ sādhakaśca gṛhastho dvividho bhavet /
kuṭumbabharaṇe yattaḥ sādhako 'sau gṛhī bhavet //
meaning:
उदासीनः साधकश्च गृहस्थो द्विविधो भवेत् /
कुटुम्बभरणे यत्तः साधको ऽसौ गृही भवेत् //
text_mt:
The householder is of two kinds: the indifferent and the striving.
Intent on sustaining his family, the householder is a striving one.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇānitrīṇyapākṛtyatyaktvā bhāryādhanādikam /
ekākī yastu vicaredudāsīnaḥ sa maukṣikaḥ //
meaning:
ऋणानित्रीण्यपाकृत्यत्यक्त्वा भार्याधनादिकम् /
एकाकी यस्तु विचरेदुदासीनः स मौक्षिकः //
text_mt:
Having discharged the three debts, having abandoned wife, wealth, and the rest,
he who wanders alone, indifferent, is focused on liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tapastapyati yo 'raṇye yajed devān juhoti ca /
svādhyāye caiva nirato vanasthastāpaso mataḥ //
meaning:
तपस्तप्यति यो ऽरण्ये यजेद् देवान् जुहोति च /
स्वाध्याये चैव निरतो वनस्थस्तापसो मतः //
text_mt:
He who practices austerity in the forest, sacrifices to the gods, offers oblations,
and is devoted to sacred recitation, is considered an ascetic forest-dweller.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā karṣito 'tyarthaṃ yastu dhyānaparo bhavet /
sāṃnyāsikaḥ sa vijñeyo vānaprasthāśrame sthitaḥ //
meaning:
तपसा कर्षितो ऽत्यर्थं यस्तु ध्यानपरो भवेत् /
सांन्यासिकः स विज्ञेयो वानप्रस्थाश्रमे स्थितः //
text_mt:
He who, greatly emaciated by austerity, becomes devoted to meditation
is to be known as a renunciant situated in the forest-dweller stage of life.

sanskrit_iast:
yogābhyāsarato nityamārurukṣurjitendriyaḥ /
jñānāya vartate bhikṣuḥ procyate pārameṣṭhikaḥ //
meaning:
योगाभ्यासरतो नित्यमारुरुक्षुर्जितेन्द्रियः /
ज्ञानाय वर्तते भिक्षुः प्रोच्यते पारमेष्ठिकः //
text_mt:
Constantly devoted to the practice of yoga, desiring to ascend, with senses conquered,
the mendicant who exists for knowledge is proclaimed to be of the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvātmaratireva syānnityatṛpto mahāmuniḥ /
samyag darśanasaṃpannaḥ sa yogī bhikṣurucyate //
meaning:
यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यान्नित्यतृप्तो महामुनिः /
सम्यग् दर्शनसंपन्नः स योगी भिक्षुरुच्यते //
text_mt:
He who delights only in the Self, eternally contented, a great sage,
endowed with correct vision—that yogin is called a mendicant.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānasaṃnyāsinaḥ kecid vedasaṃnyāsino 'pare /
karmasanyāsinaḥ kecit trividhāḥ parāmeṣṭhikāḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानसंन्यासिनः केचिद् वेदसंन्यासिनो ऽपरे /
कर्मसन्यासिनः केचित् त्रिविधाः परामेष्ठिकाः //
text_mt:
Some are renunciants of knowledge, others are renunciants of the Veda,
and some are renunciants of action; threefold are those of the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yogī ca trividho jñeyo bhautikaḥ sāṃkhya eva ca /
tṛtīyotyāśramī proktī yogamuttamamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
योगी च त्रिविधो ज्ञेयो भौतिकः सांख्य एव च /
तृतीयोत्याश्रमी प्रोक्ती योगमुत्तममास्थितः //
text_mt:
And the yogin is to be known as threefold: the material, the reflective,
and the third is called transcendent of the stages of life, established in supreme yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamā bhāvanā pūrve sāṃkhye tvakṣarabhāvanā /
tṛtīye cāntimā proktā bhāvanā pārameśvarī //
meaning:
प्रथमा भावना पूर्वे सांख्ये त्वक्षरभावना /
तृतीये चान्तिमा प्रोक्ता भावना पारमेश्वरी //
text_mt:
The first contemplation is in the former, but in the reflective [stage] there is contemplation on the imperishable;
and in the third, the final contemplation on the Supreme Lord is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādetad vijānīdhvamāśramāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam /
sarveṣu vedaśāstreṣu pañcamo nopapadyate //
meaning:
तस्मादेतद् विजानीध्वमाश्रमाणां चतुष्टयम् /
सर्वेषु वेदशास्त्रेषु पञ्चमो नोपपद्यते //
text_mt:
Therefore know this: there is a tetrad of the stages of life;
in all the Vedic scriptures a fifth is not found.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ varṇāśramān sṛṣṭvā devadevo nirañjanaḥ /
dakṣādīn prāha viśvātmā sṛjadhvaṃ vividhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
एवं वर्णाश्रमान् सृष्ट्वा देवदेवो निरञ्जनः /
दक्षादीन् प्राह विश्वात्मा सृजध्वं विविधाः प्रजाः //
