text_mt:
Having thus created the classes and stages of life, the spotless God of gods,
the Self of the universe, said to Dakṣa and the others: “Generate diverse creatures.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo vacanāt putrā dakṣādyā munisattamāḥ /
asṛjanta prajāḥ sarvā devamānuṣapūrvikāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो वचनात् पुत्रा दक्षाद्या मुनिसत्तमाः /
असृजन्त प्रजाः सर्वा देवमानुषपूर्विकाः //
text_mt:
At the command of Brahmā, the sons beginning with Dakṣa, best of sages,
created all offspring, beginning with gods and human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa bhagavān brahmā straṣṭvatve sa vyavasthitaḥ /
ahaṃ vai pālayāmīdaṃ saṃhariṣyati śūlabhṛt //
meaning:
इत्येष भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्त्रष्ट्वत्वे स व्यवस्थितः /
अहं वै पालयामीदं संहरिष्यति शूलभृत् //
text_mt:
Thus this Lord Brahmā is established in the status of creator;
I indeed protect this [world], and the trident-bearer will withdraw it.

sanskrit_iast:
tistrastu mūrtayaḥ proktā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
rajaḥ sattvatamoyogāt parasya paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तिस्त्रस्तु मूर्तयः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः /
रजः सत्त्वतमोयोगात् परस्य परमात्मनः //
text_mt:
The three forms—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara—are proclaimed
through the conjunction of rajas, sattva, and tamas with the higher Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
anoyanyamanuraktāste hyanyonyamupajīvinaḥ /
anyonyaṃ praṇatāścaiva līlayā parameśvarāḥ //
meaning:
अनोयन्यमनुरक्तास्ते ह्यन्योन्यमुपजीविनः /
अन्योन्यं प्रणताश्चैव लीलया परमेश्वराः //
text_mt:
They are devoted to one another, dependent on one another,
and bowed down to one another in divine play, the supreme lords.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva tathaivākṣarabhāvanā /
tistrastu bhāvanā rudre vartante satataṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव तथैवाक्षरभावना /
तिस्त्रस्तु भावना रुद्रे वर्तन्ते सततं द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Pertaining to Brahmā, pertaining to Maheśvara, and likewise contemplation on the imperishable—
these three contemplations abide continually in Rudra, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pravartate mayyajastramādyā cākṣarabhāvanā /
dvitīyā brahmaṇaḥ proktā devasyākṣarabhāvanā //
meaning:
प्रवर्तते मय्यजस्त्रमाद्या चाक्षरभावना /
द्वितीया ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्ता देवस्याक्षरभावना //
text_mt:
The primary contemplation on the imperishable proceeds incessantly in me;
the second contemplation on the imperishable is declared to belong to God Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ caiva mahādevo na bhinnau paramārthataḥ /
vibhajyasvecchayātmānaṃ so 'nyaryāmīśvaraḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
अहं चैव महादेवो न भिन्नौ परमार्थतः /
विभज्यस्वेच्छयात्मानं सो ऽन्यर्यामीश्वरः स्थितः //
text_mt:
I and Mahādeva are not distinct in ultimate truth;
having divided himself by his own will, he abides as the inner ruler and lord.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyamakhilaṃ straṣṭuṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
puruṣaḥ parato 'vyaktād brahmatvaṃ samupāgamat //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं स्त्रष्टुं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
पुरुषः परतो ऽव्यक्ताद् ब्रह्मत्वं समुपागमत् //
text_mt:
To create the entire triple world, along with gods, asuras, and humans,
the Spirit beyond the unmanifest attained the status of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād brahmā mahādevo viṣṇurviśveśvaraḥ paraḥ /
ekasyaiva smṛtāstistrastanūḥ kāryavaśāt prabhoḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद् ब्रह्मा महादेवो विष्णुर्विश्वेश्वरः परः /
एकस्यैव स्मृतास्तिस्त्रस्तनूः कार्यवशात् प्रभोः //
text_mt:
Therefore Brahmā, Mahādeva, and Viṣṇu, the supreme Lord of the Universe,
are remembered as the three forms of the one Lord alone, by force of cosmic purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vandyāḥ pūjyāḥ prayatnataḥ /
yadīcchedacirāt sthānaṃ yattanmokṣākhyamavyayam //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वन्द्याः पूज्याः प्रयत्नतः /
यदीच्छेदचिरात् स्थानं यत्तन्मोक्षाख्यमव्ययम् //
text_mt:
Therefore with all effort they are to be saluted, to be worshipped with zeal,
if one desires that imperishable abode which is called liberation without delay.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramaprayuktena dharmeṇa prītisaṃyutaḥ /
pūjayed bhāvayuktena yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमप्रयुक्तेन धर्मेण प्रीतिसंयुतः /
पूजयेद् भावयुक्तेन यावज्जीवं प्रतिज्ञया //
text_mt:
With dharma enjoined by class and stage of life, accompanied by love,
one should worship with devotion by a lifelong vow.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ tu prokto 'yaṃ vidhivaddvijāḥ /
āśramo vaiṣṇavo brāhmo harāśrama iti trayaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्णामाश्रमाणां तु प्रोक्तो ऽयं विधिवद्द्विजाः /
आश्रमो वैष्णवो ब्राह्मो हराश्रम इति त्रयः //
text_mt:
Of the four stages of life, this has been declared according to rule, O twice-born:
the stage of Viṣṇu, the stage of Brahmā, and the stage of Hara—these are the three.

sanskrit_iast:
talliṅgadhārī satataṃ tadbhaktajanavatsalaḥ /
dhyāyedathārcayedetān brahmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तल्लिङ्गधारी सततं तद्भक्तजनवत्सलः /
ध्यायेदथार्चयेदेतान् ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणः //
text_mt:
Bearing their distinctive emblem constantly, loving toward their devotees,
one should meditate on and worship them, dedicated to the knowledge of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva bhaktānāṃ śaṃbhorliṅgamanuttamam /
sitena bhasmanā kāryaṃ lalāṭe tu tripuṇḍrakam //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव भक्तानां शंभोर्लिङ्गमनुत्तमम् /
सितेन भस्मना कार्यं ललाटे तु त्रिपुण्ड्रकम् //
text_mt: For all devotees of Śambhu, the unsurpassed liṅga [is prescribed]; / on the forehead, moreover, a tripuṇḍraka should be made with white ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ prapannaḥ paramaṃ padam /
dhārayet sarvadā śūlaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāribhiḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु नारायणं देवं प्रपन्नः परमं पदम् /
धारयेत् सर्वदा शूलं ललाटे गन्धवारिभिः //
text_mt: He, however, who has taken refuge in god Nārāyaṇa, the supreme state, / should always bear a trident [mark] on his forehead with fragrant waters.

sanskrit_iast:
prapannā ye jagadbījaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam /
teṣāṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ tu sarvadā //
meaning:
प्रपन्ना ये जगद्बीजं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् /
तेषां ललाटे तिलकं धारणीयं तु सर्वदा //
text_mt: Those who have taken refuge in Brahmā Parameṣṭhin, the seed of the universe— / on their foreheads a tilaka is always to be worn.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sāvanādirbhūtādiḥ kālātmāsau dhṛto bhavet /
uparyadho bhāvayogāt tripuṇḍrasya tu dhāraṇāt //
meaning:
यो ऽसावनादिर्भूतादिः कालात्मासौ धृतो भवेत् /
उपर्यधो भावयोगात् त्रिपुण्ड्रस्य तु धारणात् //
text_mt: He who is beginningless, the source of beings, whose self is time—he is borne / because of the union of upper and lower conditions, through wearing the tripuṇḍra.

sanskrit_iast:
yattat pradhānaṃ triguṇaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam /
dhṛtaṃ triśūladharaṇād bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यत्तत् प्रधानं त्रिगुणं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकम् /
धृतं त्रिशूलधरणाद् भवत्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: That which is the primary matter of three qualities, composed of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / is indeed borne through wearing the trident; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmatejomayaṃ śuklaṃ yadetan maṇḍalaṃ raveḥ /
bhavatyeva dhṛtaṃ sthānamaiśvaraṃ tilake kṛte //
meaning:
ब्रह्मतेजोमयं शुक्लं यदेतन् मण्डलं रवेः /
भवत्येव धृतं स्थानमैश्वरं तिलके कृते //
text_mt: This white orb of the sun, which consists of the splendor of Brahman— / that sovereign abode is indeed borne when the tilaka is made.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt kāryaṃ triśūlāṅkaṃ tathā ca tilakaṃ śubham /
triyāyuṣaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ trayāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam //
meaning:
तस्मात् कार्यं त्रिशूलाङ्कं तथा च तिलकं शुभम् /
त्रियायुषं च भक्तानां त्रयाणां विधिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Therefore, the trident mark, the auspicious tilaka, / and the triyāyuṣa [mark] should be made according to rule for the three [classes of] devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
yajeta juhuyādagnau japed dadyājjitendriyaḥ /
śānto dānto jitakrodho varṇāśramavidhānavit //
meaning:
यजेत जुहुयादग्नौ जपेद् दद्याज्जितेन्द्रियः /
शान्तो दान्तो जितक्रोधो वर्णाश्रमविधानवित् //
text_mt: Subduing his senses, he should sacrifice, offer into fire, chant prayers, and give gifts, / tranquil, self-controlled, free from anger, knowing the rules of social classes and life-stages.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paricared devān yāvajjīvaṃ samāhitaḥ /
teṣāṃ saṃsthānamacalaṃ so 'cirādadhigacchati //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं परिचरेद् देवान् यावज्जीवं समाहितः /
तेषां संस्थानमचलं सो ऽचिरादधिगच्छति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Attentive, he should thus attend upon the gods as long as he lives; / he soon attains their unshakeable abode.

Thus ends the second chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the venerable Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
varṇā bhagavatoddiṣṭāścatvāro 'pyāśramāstathā /
idānīṃ kramamasmākamāśramāṇāṃ vada prabho //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
वर्णा भगवतोद्दिष्टाश्चत्वारो ऽप्याश्रमास्तथा /
इदानीं क्रममस्माकमाश्रमाणां वद प्रभो //
title: tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / The social classes have been explained by the Lord, and likewise the four life-stages. / Now tell us, O Lord, the orderly sequence of the life-stages.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā /
krameṇaivāśramāḥ proktāḥ kāraṇādanyathā bhavet //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थो यतिस्तथा /
क्रमेणैवाश्रमाः प्रोक्ताः कारणादन्यथा भवेत् //
text_mt: The venerable Tortoise said: / The student of the Veda, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the ascetic— / the life-stages are taught in this precise order, [though] it may be otherwise through a [special] cause.

sanskrit_iast:
utpannajñānavijñāno vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ /
pravrajed brahmacaryāt tu yadicchet paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
उत्पन्नज्ञानविज्ञानो वैराग्यं परमं गतः /
प्रव्रजेद् ब्रह्मचर्यात् तु यदिच्छेत् परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: One in whom knowledge and discernment have arisen, who has attained supreme detachment, / may renounce directly from studentship, if he desires the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
dārānāhṛtya vidhivadanyathā vividhairmakhaiḥ /
yajedutpādayet putrān virakto yadi saṃnyaset //
meaning:
दारानाहृत्य विधिवदन्यथा विविधैर्मखैः /
यजेदुत्पादयेत् पुत्रान् विरक्तो यदि संन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Otherwise, taking a wife according to rule, he should sacrifice / with various sacrifices, beget sons, [and] renounce if he becomes detached.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭvā vidhivad yajñairanutpādya tathātmajam /
nagārhasthyaṃ gṛhītyaktvā saṃnyased buddhimān dvijaḥ //
meaning:
अनिष्ट्वा विधिवद् यज्ञैरनुत्पाद्य तथात्मजम् /
नगार्हस्थ्यं गृहीत्यक्त्वा संन्यसेद् बुद्धिमान् द्विजः //
text_mt: Without sacrificing according to rule with sacrifices and without begetting a son, / an intelligent twice-born householder should not renounce, abandoning householdership.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vairāgyavegena sthātuṃ notsahate gṛhe /
tatraiva saṃnyased vidvānaniṣṭvāpi dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
अथ वैराग्यवेगेन स्थातुं नोत्सहते गृहे /
तत्रैव संन्यसेद् विद्वाननिष्ट्वापि द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: If, however, through the force of detachment he has no enthusiasm to remain in the house, / the wise twice-born man may renounce right there, even without having sacrificed.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā vividhairyajñairiṣṭvā vanamathākṣayet /
tapastaptvā tapoyogād viraktaḥ saṃnyased yadi //
meaning:
अन्यथा विविधैर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा वनमथाक्षयेत् /
तपस्तप्त्वा तपोयोगाद् विरक्तः संन्यसेद् यदि //
text_mt: Otherwise, having sacrificed with various sacrifices, he should then dwell in the forest; / having performed austerity, if he becomes detached through the practice of austerity, he may renounce.

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā na gṛhaṃ praviśet punaḥ /
na saṃnyāsī vanaṃ cātha brahmācaryaṃ na sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गत्वा न गृहं प्रविशेत् पुनः /
न संन्यासी वनं चाथ ब्रह्माचर्यं न साधकः //
text_mt: Having entered the life-stage of a forest-dweller, he should not enter the household again; / nor the renunciant the forest, nor the practitioner [return to] studentship.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭimāgneyīmathavā dvijaḥ /
pravrajeta gṛhī vidvān vanād vā śruticodanāt //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यां निरूप्येष्टिमाग्नेयीमथवा द्विजः /
प्रव्रजेत गृही विद्वान् वनाद् वा श्रुतिचोदनात् //
text_mt: Having performed the Prājāpatya sacrifice, or the Āgneya [sacrifice], a wise twice-born man / may renounce from the household, or from the forest, according to Vedic injunction.

sanskrit_iast:
prakartumasamartho 'pi juhotiyajatikriyāḥ /
andhaḥ paṅgurdaridro vā viraktaḥ saṃnyased dvijaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकर्तुमसमर्थो ऽपि जुहोतियजतिक्रियाः /
अन्धः पङ्गुर्दरिद्रो वा विरक्तः संन्यसेद् द्विजः //
text_mt: A twice-born man, even if unable to perform / the rites of offering and sacrificing, whether blind, lame, or poor, may renounce if he is detached.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva vairāgyaṃ saṃnyāsāya vidhīyate /
patatyevāvirakto yaḥ saṃnyāsaṃ kartumicchati //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव वैराग्यं संन्यासाय विधीयते /
पतत्येवाविरक्तो यः संन्यासं कर्तुमिच्छति //
text_mt: For all [persons], detachment alone is prescribed for renunciation; / he who, lacking detachment, wishes to renounce certainly falls.

sanskrit_iast:
ekasminnathavā samyag vartetāmaraṇaṃ dvijaḥ /
śraddhāvanāśrame yuktaḥ so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate //
meaning:
एकस्मिन्नथवा सम्यग् वर्तेतामरणं द्विजः /
श्रद्धावनाश्रमे युक्तः सो ऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते //
text_mt: Or a twice-born man may properly abide in a single [life-stage] until death; / endowed with faith and intent upon his life-stage, he is fit for immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyāgatadhanaḥ śānto brahmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ /
svadharmapālako nityaṃ so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate //
meaning:
न्यायागतधनः शान्तो ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणः /
स्वधर्मपालको नित्यं सो ऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते //
text_mt: Whose wealth is acquired lawfully, tranquil, devoted to the knowledge of Brahman, / ever guarding his own duty, he is fit for immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyādhāya kramāṇi niḥsaṅgaḥ kāmavarjitaḥ /
prasannenaiva manasā kurvāṇo yāti tatpadam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय क्रमाणि निःसङ्गः कामवर्जितः /
प्रसन्नेनैव मनसा कुर्वाणो याति तत्पदम् //
text_mt: Placing his actions in Brahman, unattached, free from desire, / acting with a serene mind, he goes to that abode.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā dīyate deyaṃ brahmaṇe saṃpradīyate /
brahmaiva dīyate ceti brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा दीयते देयं ब्रह्मणे संप्रदीयते /
ब्रह्मैव दीयते चेति ब्रह्मार्पणमिदं परम् //
text_mt: "What is given is given by Brahman; it is offered to Brahman; / and it is Brahman itself that is given"—this is the supreme dedication to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ kartā sarvametad brahmaiva kurute tathā /
etad brahmārpaṇaṃ proktamṛṣibhiḥ tattvadarśibhiḥ //
meaning:
नाहं कर्ता सर्वमेतद् ब्रह्मैव कुरुते तथा /
एतद् ब्रह्मार्पणं प्रोक्तमृषिभिः तत्त्वदर्शिभिः //
text_mt: "I am not the doer; Brahman alone does all this"— / this has been declared as dedication to Brahman by the seers who see truth.

sanskrit_iast:
prīṇātu bhagavānīśaḥ karmaṇānena śāśvataḥ /
karoti satataṃ buddhyā brahmārpaṇamidaṃ param //
meaning:
प्रीणातु भगवानीशः कर्मणानेन शाश्वतः /
करोति सततं बुद्ध्या ब्रह्मार्पणमिदं परम् //
text_mt: "May the eternal, divine Lord be pleased by this action"— / [he who] constantly does [action] with this intellect [performs] this supreme dedication to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā phalānāṃ saṃnyāsaṃ prakuryāt parameśvare /
karmaṇāmetadapyāhuḥ brahmārpaṇamanuttamam //
meaning:
यद्वा फलानां संन्यासं प्रकुर्यात् परमेश्वरे /
कर्मणामेतदप्याहुः ब्रह्मार्पणमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Or, if he makes the renunciation of the fruits of actions / to the Supreme Lord, this too they call the unsurpassed dedication to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ saṅgavarjitam /
kriyate viduṣā karma tadbhavedapi mokṣadam //
meaning:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं सङ्गवर्जितम् /
क्रियते विदुषा कर्म तद्भवेदपि मोक्षदम् //
text_mt: Whatever obligatory action is done simply because it is duty, free from attachment, / by a wise person, that action leads to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā yadi karmāṇi kuryānnityamapi dvijaḥ /
akṛtvā phalasaṃnyāsaṃ badhyate tatphalena tu //
meaning:
अन्यथा यदि कर्माणि कुर्यान्नित्यमपि द्विजः /
अकृत्वा फलसंन्यासं बध्यते तत्फलेन तु //
text_mt: Otherwise, even if a twice-born man performs actions constantly, / without renouncing their fruit, he is bound by that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tyaktvā karmāśritaṃ phalam /
avidvānapi kurvota karmāpnotyacirāt padam //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन त्यक्त्वा कर्माश्रितं फलम् /
अविद्वानपि कुर्वोत कर्माप्नोत्यचिरात् पदम् //
text_mt: Therefore, having abandoned the fruit resting on actions with every effort, / even an unwise person, performing action, soon attains the state.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā kṣīyate pāpamaihikaṃ paurvikaṃ tathā /
manaḥ prasādamanveti brahma vijñāyate tataḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा क्षीयते पापमैहिकं पौर्विकं तथा /
मनः प्रसादमन्वेति ब्रह्म विज्ञायते ततः //
text_mt: By action, sin belonging to this world and to former [lives] is destroyed; / the mind attains serenity; from that, Brahman is realized.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā sahitājjñānāt samyag yogo 'bijāyate /
jñānaṃ ca karmasahitaṃ jāyate doṣavarjitam //
meaning:
कर्मणा सहिताज्ज्ञानात् सम्यग् योगो ऽबिजायते /
ज्ञानं च कर्मसहितं जायते दोषवर्जितम् //
text_mt: From knowledge accompanied by action, proper yoga is born; / and knowledge accompanied by action becomes free from fault.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tatra tatrāśrame rataḥ /
karmāṇīśvaratuṣṭyarthaṃ kuryānnaiṣkarmyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र तत्राश्रमे रतः /
कर्माणीश्वरतुष्ट्यर्थं कुर्यान्नैष्कर्म्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Therefore, devoted to his respective life-stage with every effort, / one should perform actions for the satisfaction of the Lord; [thus] he attains actionlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya paramaṃ jñānaṃ naiṣkarmyaṃ tatprasādataḥ /
ekākī nirmamaḥ śānto jīvanneva vimucyate //
meaning:
संप्राप्य परमं ज्ञानं नैष्कर्म्यं तत्प्रसादतः /
एकाकी निर्ममः शान्तो जीवन्नेव विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having attained supreme knowledge and actionlessness through His grace, / solitary, free from mineness, tranquil, he is liberated even while living.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣate paramātmānaṃ paraṃ brahma maheśvaram /
nityānandaṃ nirābhāsaṃ tasminneva layaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
वीक्षते परमात्मानं परं ब्रह्म महेश्वरम् /
नित्यानन्दं निराभासं तस्मिन्नेव लयं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He sees the Supreme Self, the supreme Brahman, Maheśvara, / eternal bliss, free from appearance; in Him alone he dissolves.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt seveta satataṃ karmayogaṃ prasannadhīḥ /
tṛptaye parameśasya tat padaṃ yāti śāśvatam //
meaning:
तस्मात् सेवेत सततं कर्मयोगं प्रसन्नधीः /
तृप्तये परमेशस्य तत् पदं याति शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: Therefore, with a serene mind, one should constantly cultivate the yoga of action / for the gratification of the Supreme Lord; he goes to that eternal abode.

sanskrit_iast:
etad vaḥ sathitaṃ sarvaṃ cāturāśramyamuttamam /
na hyetat samatikramya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतद् वः सथितं सर्वं चातुराश्रम्यमुत्तमम् /
न ह्येतत् समतिक्रम्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे तृतीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
All this system of four life-stages has been declared to you as the highest; / no mortal who transgresses this finds perfection.

Thus ends the third chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the venerable Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrutvā'śramavidhiṃ kṛtsanamṛṣayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ /
namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ punarvacanamabruvan //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रुत्वाऽश्रमविधिं कृत्सनमृषयो हृष्टमानसाः /
नमस्कृत्य हृषीकेशं पुनर्वचनमब्रुवन् //
title: caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard the complete rule of the life-stages, the sages, delighted in mind, / bowed to Hṛṣīkeśa and spoke these words once again:

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
bhāṣitaṃ bhavatā sarvaṃ cāturāśramyamuttamam /
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmo yathā saṃbhavate jagat //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
भाषितं भवता सर्वं चातुराश्रम्यमुत्तमम् /
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामो यथा संभवते जगत् //
text_mt: The sages said: / You have explained the entire excellent system of four life-stages; / now we wish to hear how the universe comes into being.

sanskrit_iast:
kutaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ kasmiṃśca layameṣyati /
niyantā kaśca sarveṣāṃ vadasva puruṣottama //
meaning:
कुतः सर्वमिदं जातं कस्मिंश्च लयमेष्यति /
नियन्ता कश्च सर्वेषां वदस्व पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: Whence is all this born, and into what will it dissolve? / And who is the ruler of all? Tell us, O Supreme Spirit!

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyamṛṣīṇāṃ kūrmarūpadhṛk /
prāha gambhīrayā vācā bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यमृषीणां कूर्मरूपधृक् /
प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययौ //
text_mt: Hearing the words of the sages, Nārāyaṇa, bearing the form of a tortoise, / spoke with a deep voice the origin and dissolution of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
maheśvaraḥ paro 'vyaktaścaturvyūhaḥ sanātanaḥ /
anantaścāprameyaśca niyantā viśvatomukhaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
महेश्वरः परो ऽव्यक्तश्चतुर्व्यूहः सनातनः /
अनन्तश्चाप्रमेयश्च नियन्ता विश्वतोमुखः //
text_mt: The venerable Tortoise said: / The Great Lord is supreme, unmanifest, possessing fourfold manifestation, eternal, / infinite, immeasurable, the ruler, facing in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam /
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiśceti yadāhustattvacintakāḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् /
प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चेति यदाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः //
text_mt: The unmanifest cause which is eternal, composed of being and non-being, / which the investigators of reality call pradhāna and primordial matter,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhavarṇarasairhenaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam /
ajaraṃ dhruvamakṣayyaṃ nityaṃ svātmanyavasthitam //
meaning:
गन्धवर्णरसैर्हेनं शब्दस्पर्शविवर्जितम् /
अजरं ध्रुवमक्षय्यं नित्यं स्वात्मन्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt: destitute of smell, color, and taste, devoid of sound and touch, / ageless, firm, imperishable, eternal, abiding in its own nature,

sanskrit_iast:
jagadyonirmahābhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam /
vigrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmanādhiṣṭhitaṃ mahat //
meaning:
जगद्योनिर्महाभूतं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
विग्रहः सर्वभूतानामात्मनाधिष्ठितं महत् //
text_mt: the womb of the universe, the great element, the eternal supreme Brahman, / the bodily form of all beings, great, presided over by the Self—

sanskrit_iast:
anādyantamajaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇaṃ prabhavāpyayam /
asāṃpratamavijñeyaṃ brahmāgre samavartata //
meaning:
अनाद्यन्तमजं सूक्ष्मं त्रिगुणं प्रभवाप्ययम् /
असांप्रतमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत //
text_mt: Without beginning or end, unborn, subtle, composed of the three qualities, the source of origin and dissolution, / without present manifestation, unknowable, Brahman existed in the beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇasāmye tadā tasmin puruṣe cātmani sthite /
prākṛtaḥ pralayo jñeyo yāvad viśvasamudbhavaḥ //
meaning:
गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन् पुरुषे चात्मनि स्थिते /
प्राकृतः प्रलयो ज्ञेयो यावद् विश्वसमुद्भवः //
text_mt: When the qualities were in equilibrium, and Puruṣa was stationed in the Self, / that is known as the elemental dissolution, until the arising of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī rātririyaṃ proktā ahaḥ sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā /
aharna vidyate tasya na rātrirhyupacārataḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी रात्रिरियं प्रोक्ता अहः सृष्टिरुदाहृता /
अहर्न विद्यते तस्य न रात्रिर्ह्युपचारतः //
text_mt: This is declared to be the night of Brahmā; creation is called his day. / Yet for him there is no day and no night, except by conventional designation.

sanskrit_iast:
niśānte pratibuddho 'sau jagadādiranādimān /
sarvabhūtamayo 'vyakto hyantaryāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
निशान्ते प्रतिबुद्धो ऽसौ जगदादिरनादिमान् /
सर्वभूतमयो ऽव्यक्तो ह्यन्तर्यामीश्वरः परः //
text_mt: At the end of the night, he awoke—the origin of the world, having no beginning, / consisting of all beings, the unmanifest, the inner ruler, the supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva praviśyāśu maheśvaraḥ /
kṣobhayāmāsa yogena pareṇa parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव प्रविश्याशु महेश्वरः /
क्षोभयामास योगेन परेण परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Entering both primordial matter and Puruṣa swiftly, the great Lord, / the supreme Lord, agitated them through highest yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mado narastrīṇāṃ yathā vā mādhavo 'nilaḥ /
anupraviṣṭaḥ kṣobhāya tathāsau yogamūrtimān //
meaning:
यथा मदो नरस्त्रीणां यथा वा माधवो ऽनिलः /
अनुप्रविष्टः क्षोभाय तथासौ योगमूर्तिमान् //
text_mt: Just as passion enters men and women, or as the spring breeze [stirs desire] / upon entering, to bring about agitation, so did he, embodied in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva kṣobhako viprāḥ kṣobhyaśca parameśvaraḥ /
sa saṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ pradhānatve 'pi ca sthitaḥ //
meaning:
स एव क्षोभको विप्राः क्षोभ्यश्च परमेश्वरः /
स संकोचविकासाभ्यां प्रधानत्वे ऽपि च स्थितः //
text_mt: He alone is the agitator, O Brahmins, and the supreme Lord is also the agitated. / Through contraction and expansion, he abides even in the state of primordial matter.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānāt kṣobhyamāṇācca tathā puṃsaḥ purātanāt /
prādurāsīnmahad bījaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam //
meaning:
प्रधानात् क्षोभ्यमाणाच्च तथा पुंसः पुरातनात् /
प्रादुरासीन्महद् बीजं प्रधानपुरुषात्मकम् //
text_mt: From primordial matter being agitated, and likewise from the ancient Puruṣa, / there manifested the seed, the Intellect, whose nature is primordial matter and Puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānātmā matirbrahmā prabuddhiḥ khyātirīśvaraḥ /
prajñādhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃvidetasmāditi tat smṛtam //
meaning:
महानात्मा मतिर्ब्रह्मा प्रबुद्धिः ख्यातिरीश्वरः /
प्रज्ञाधृतिः स्मृतिः संविदेतस्मादिति तत् स्मृतम् //
text_mt: It is remembered as Mahat, Ātman, Mati, Brahmā, Prabuddhi, Khyāti, Īśvara, / Prajñā, Dhṛti, Smṛti, and Saṃvid, because of these [functions].

sanskrit_iast:
vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiścaiva tāmasaḥ /
trividho 'yamahaṅkāro mahataḥ saṃbabhūva ha //
meaning:
वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चैव तामसः /
त्रिविधो ऽयमहङ्कारो महतः संबभूव ह //
text_mt: Vaikārika (sāttvika), taijasa (rājasika), and bhūtādi (tāmasika)— / this threefold ego arose from the Intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkāro 'bimānaśca kartā mantā ca sa smṛtaḥ /
ātmā ca pudgalo jīvo yataḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
अहङ्कारो ऽबिमानश्च कर्ता मन्ता च स स्मृतः /
आत्मा च पुद्गलो जीवो यतः सर्वाः प्रवृत्तयः //
text_mt: It is recalled as ego, self-conceit, the agent, and the thinker, / and the self, the individual, the living soul from which all activities proceed.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhūtānyahaṅkārāt tanmātrāṇi ca jajñire /
indriyāṇi tathā devāḥ sarvaṃ tasyātmajaṃ jagat //
meaning:
पञ्चभूतान्यहङ्कारात् तन्मात्राणि च जज्ञिरे /
इन्द्रियाणि तथा देवाः सर्वं तस्यात्मजं जगत् //
text_mt: From the ego were born the five gross elements and subtle elements; / likewise the sense faculties and the deities—the whole world is its offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
manastvavyaktajaṃ proktaṃ vikāraḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
yenāsau jāyate kartā bhūtādīṃścānupaśyati //
meaning:
मनस्त्वव्यक्तजं प्रोक्तं विकारः प्रथमः स्मृतः /
येनासौ जायते कर्ता भूतादींश्चानुपश्यति //
text_mt: Mind, however, is said to be born of the unmanifest; it is remembered as the first modification, / by which one becomes an agent and perceives the origin of elements and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikārikādahaṅkārāt sargo vaikāriko 'bhavat /
taijasānīndriyāṇi syurdevā vaikārikā daśa //
meaning:
वैकारिकादहङ्कारात् सर्गो वैकारिको ऽभवत् /
तैजसानीन्द्रियाणि स्युर्देवा वैकारिका दश //
text_mt: From the vaikārika ego arose the vaikārika creation: / the ten deities are vaikārika, while the senses are taijasa.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśaṃ manastatra svaguṇenobhayātmakam /
bhūtatanmātrasargo 'yaṃ bhūtāderabhavan prajāḥ //
meaning:
एकादशं मनस्तत्र स्वगुणेनोभयात्मकम् /
भूततन्मात्रसर्गो ऽयं भूतादेरभवन् प्रजाः //
text_mt: The eleventh among them is the mind, dual in nature by its own quality. / This creation of subtle and gross elements arose from the bhūtādi, O creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādistu vikurvāṇaḥ śabdamātraṃ sasarja ha /
ākāśaṃ śuṣiraṃ tasmādutpannaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
भूतादिस्तु विकुर्वाणः शब्दमात्रं ससर्ज ह /
आकाशं शुषिरं तस्मादुत्पन्नं शब्दलक्षणम् //
text_mt: Undergoing transformation, the bhūtādi produced the subtle element of sound. / From that arose space, hollow and characterized by sound.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśastu vikurvāṇaḥ sparśamātraṃ sasarja ha /
vāyurutpadyate tasmāt tasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ //
meaning:
आकाशस्तु विकुर्वाणः स्पर्शमात्रं ससर्ज ह /
वायुरुत्पद्यते तस्मात् तस्य स्पर्शो गुणो मतः //
text_mt: Undergoing transformation, space produced the subtle element of touch. / From that arises wind, whose quality is considered to be touch.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuścāpi vikurvāṇo rūpamātraṃ sasarja ha /
jyotirutpadyate vāyostadrūpaguṇamucyate //
meaning:
वायुश्चापि विकुर्वाणो रूपमात्रं ससर्ज ह /
ज्योतिरुत्पद्यते वायोस्तद्रूपगुणमुच्यते //
text_mt: Undergoing transformation, wind also produced the subtle element of form. / Light arises from wind, and it is said to have the quality of form.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiścāpi vikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarja ha /
saṃbhavanti tato 'mbhāṃsi rasādhārāṇi tāni tu //
meaning:
ज्योतिश्चापि विकुर्वाणं रसमात्रं ससर्ज ह /
संभवन्ति ततो ऽम्भांसि रसाधाराणि तानि तु //
text_mt: Undergoing transformation, light also produced the subtle element of taste. / From that arise the waters, which are indeed the receptacles of taste.

sanskrit_iast:
āpaścāpi vikurvantyo gandhamātraṃ sasarjire /
saṃghāto jāyate tasmāt tasya gandho guṇo mataḥ //
meaning:
आपश्चापि विकुर्वन्त्यो गन्धमात्रं ससर्जिरे /
संघातो जायते तस्मात् तस्य गन्धो गुणो मतः //
text_mt: Undergoing transformation, the waters also produced the subtle element of smell. / From that is born the solid mass (earth), whose quality is considered to be smell.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ yat sparśamātraṃ samāvṛṇot /
dviguṇastu tato vāyuḥ śabdasparśātmako 'bhavat //
meaning:
आकाशं शब्दमात्रं यत् स्पर्शमात्रं समावृणोत् /
द्विगुणस्तु ततो वायुः शब्दस्पर्शात्मको ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Space, which is the subtle element of sound, enveloped the subtle element of touch; / therefore wind had two qualities, possessing the nature of sound and touch.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ tathaivāviśataḥ śabdasparśau guṇāvubhau /
triguṇaḥ syāt tato vahniḥ sa śabdasparśarūpavān //
meaning:
रूपं तथैवाविशतः शब्दस्पर्शौ गुणावुभौ /
त्रिगुणः स्यात् ततो वह्निः स शब्दस्पर्शरूपवान् //
text_mt: Likewise, the two qualities of sound and touch entered form; / therefore fire had three qualities, possessing sound, touch, and form.

sanskrit_iast:
śabda sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasamātraṃ samāviśan /
tasmāccaturguṇā āpo vijñeyāstu rasātmikāḥ //
meaning:
शब्द स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसमात्रं समाविशन् /
तस्माच्चतुर्गुणा आपो विज्ञेयास्तु रसात्मिकाः //
text_mt: Sound, touch, and form entered the subtle element of taste; / therefore the waters, possessing the nature of taste, are to be known as having four qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaṃ samāviśan /
tasamāt pañcaguṇā bhūmiḥ sthūlā bhūteṣu śabdyate //
meaning:
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धं समाविशन् /
तसमात् पञ्चगुणा भूमिः स्थूला भूतेषु शब्द्यते //
text_mt: Sound, touch, form, and taste entered smell; / therefore earth, having five qualities, is designated as gross among the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntā ghorāśca mūḍhāśca viśeṣāstena te smṛtāḥ /
parasparānupraveśād dhārayanti parasparam //
meaning:
शान्ता घोराश्च मूढाश्च विशेषास्तेन ते स्मृताः /
परस्परानुप्रवेशाद् धारयन्ति परस्परम् //
text_mt: They are remembered as specific forms, being peaceful, terrible, and deluding; / through entering into one another, they support each other.

sanskrit_iast:
ete sapta mahātmāno hyanyonyasya samāśrayāt /
nāśaknuvan prajāḥ straṣṭumasamāgamya kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
एते सप्त महात्मानो ह्यन्योन्यस्य समाश्रयात् /
नाशक्नुवन् प्रजाः स्त्रष्टुमसमागम्य कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: These seven great principles, by resorting to one another, / were not able to produce creatures without completely coming together.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣādhiṣṭhitātvācca avyaktānugraheṇa ca /
mahādādayo viśeṣāntā hmaṇḍamutpādayanti te //
meaning:
पुरुषाधिष्ठितात्वाच्च अव्यक्तानुग्रहेण च /
महादादयो विशेषान्ता ह्मण्डमुत्पादयन्ति ते //
text_mt: Presided over by Puruṣa and through the favor of the unmanifest, / they, beginning with Mahat and ending with the specific forms, produce the egg.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālasamutpannaṃ jalabudbudavacca tat /
viśeṣebhyo 'ṇḍamabhavad bṛhat tadudakeśayam //
meaning:
एककालसमुत्पन्नं जलबुद्बुदवच्च तत् /
विशेषेभ्यो ऽण्डमभवद् बृहत् तदुदकेशयम् //
text_mt: Produced in a single moment like a water bubble, / that vast egg arose from the specific forms, lying upon the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin kāryasya karaṇaṃ saṃsiddhiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
prākṛte 'ṇḍe vivṛttaḥ sa kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन् कार्यस्य करणं संसिद्धिः परमेष्ठिनः /
प्राकृते ऽण्डे विवृत्तः स क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः //
text_mt: In it took place the agency of the work, the complete accomplishment of Parameṣṭhin; / turned within the elemental egg, the knower of the field was called Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate /
ādikartā sa bhūtānāṃ brahmāgre samavartata //
meaning:
स वै शरीरी प्रथमः स वै पुरुष उच्यते /
आदिकर्ता स भूतानां ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत //
text_mt: He indeed is the first embodied being; he indeed is called Puruṣa; / the primal maker of beings, Brahmā, came into existence in the beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ haṃsaṃ pradhānāt parataḥ sthitam /
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ kapilaṃ chandomūrti sanātanam //
meaning:
यमाहुः पुरुषं हंसं प्रधानात् परतः स्थितम् /
हिरण्यगर्भं कपिलं छन्दोमूर्ति सनातनम् //
text_mt: Him they call Puruṣa, the swan, standing beyond primordial matter, / Hiraṇyagarbha, Kapila, the embodiment of Vedic meters, the eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
merurulbamabhūt tasya jarāyuścāpi parvatāḥ /
garbhodakaṃ samudrāśca tasyāsan paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
मेरुरुल्बमभूत् तस्य जरायुश्चापि पर्वताः /
गर्भोदकं समुद्राश्च तस्यासन् परमात्मनः //
text_mt: Meru became his inner membrane, and the mountains his chorion; / the oceans were the embryonic waters of that supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnaṇḍe 'bhavad viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā //
meaning:
तस्मिन्नण्डे ऽभवद् विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना //
text_mt: In that egg arose the universe, with gods, asuras, and humans, / the moon and the sun along with the constellations, planets, and the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhirdaśaguṇābhiśca bāhyato 'ṇḍaṃ samāvṛtam /
āpo daśaguṇenaiva tejasā bāhyato vṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अद्भिर्दशगुणाभिश्च बाह्यतो ऽण्डं समावृतम् /
आपो दशगुणेनैव तेजसा बाह्यतो वृताः //
text_mt: The egg is enveloped from the outside by waters ten times greater; / the waters are enveloped on the outside by fire ten times greater.

sanskrit_iast:
tejo daśaguṇenaiva bāhyato vāyunāvṛtam /
ākāśenāvṛto vāyuḥ khaṃ tu bhūtādināvṛtam //
meaning:
तेजो दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतो वायुनावृतम् /
आकाशेनावृतो वायुः खं तु भूतादिनावृतम् //
text_mt: Fire is enveloped on the outside by wind ten times greater; / wind is enveloped by space, and space by the origin of elements (bhūtādi).

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādirmahatā tadvadavyaktenāvṛto mahān /
ete lokā mahātmanaḥ sarvatattvābhimāninaḥ //
meaning:
भूतादिर्महता तद्वदव्यक्तेनावृतो महान् /
एते लोका महात्मनः सर्वतत्त्वाभिमानिनः //
text_mt: Bhūtādi is likewise enveloped by Mahat, and Mahat is enveloped by the unmanifest. / These are the worlds of the great Self, who identifies with all the principles.

sanskrit_iast:
vasanti tatra puruṣāstadātmāno vyavasthitāḥ /
īśvarā yogadharmāṇo ye cānye tattvacintakāḥ //
meaning:
वसन्ति तत्र पुरुषास्तदात्मानो व्यवस्थिताः /
ईश्वरा योगधर्माणो ये चान्ये तत्त्वचिन्तकाः //
text_mt: Beings abide there, established in that nature, / lords possessing the nature of yoga, and other contemplators of the principles,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñāḥ śāntarajaso nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ /
etairāvaraṇairaṇḍaṃ saptabhiḥ prākṛtairvṛtam //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञाः शान्तरजसो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः /
एतैरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिः प्राकृतैर्वृतम् //
text_mt: all-knowing, whose passion has been pacified, ever of joyful mind. / By these seven elemental coverings the egg is enveloped.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvacchakyate vaktuṃ māyaiṣā gahanā dvijāḥ /
etat prādhānikaṃ kāryaṃ yanmayā bījamīritam /
prajāpateḥ parā mūrtiritīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
एतावच्छक्यते वक्तुं मायैषा गहना द्विजाः /
एतत् प्राधानिकं कार्यं यन्मया बीजमीरितम् /
प्रजापतेः परा मूर्तिरितीयं वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Only this much can be spoken; this illusory power is unfathomable, O twice-born! / This product of primordial matter, which I have called the seed, / is the supreme form of Prajāpati—such is the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍametat sakalaṃ saptalokatalānvitam /
dvitīyaṃ tasya devasya śarīraṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डमेतत् सकलं सप्तलोकतलान्वितम् /
द्वितीयं तस्य देवस्य शरीरं परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: This entire Brahmic egg, endowed with seven lower realms, / is the second body of that divine Lord, Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān brahmā vai kanakāṇḍajaḥ /
tṛtīyaṃ bhagavadrūpaṃ prāhurvedārthavedinaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् ब्रह्मा वै कनकाण्डजः /
तृतीयं भगवद्रूपं प्राहुर्वेदार्थवेदिनः //
text_mt: The blessed Hiraṇyagarbha, Brahmā born from the golden egg, / is said to be the third form of the Lord by knowers of the meaning of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
rajoguṇamayaṃ cānyad rūpaṃ tasyaiva dhīmataḥ /
caturmukhaḥ sa bhagavān jagatsṛṣṭau pravartate //
meaning:
रजोगुणमयं चान्यद् रूपं तस्यैव धीमतः /
चतुर्मुखः स भगवान् जगत्सृष्टौ प्रवर्तते //
text_mt: Another form of that wise one consists of the quality of passion; / the four-faced Lord proceeds with the creation of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭaṃ ca pāti sakalaṃ viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ /
sattvaṃ guṇamupāśritya viṣṇurviśveśvaraḥ svayam //
meaning:
सृष्टं च पाति सकलं विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः /
सत्त्वं गुणमुपाश्रित्य विष्णुर्विश्वेश्वरः स्वयम् //
text_mt: And the Self of all, facing everywhere, protects everything that has been created; / resorting to the quality of goodness, Viṣṇu is himself the Lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
antakāle svayaṃ devaḥ sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ /
tamoguṇaṃ samāśritya rudraḥ saṃharate jagat //
meaning:
अन्तकाले स्वयं देवः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः /
तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य रुद्रः संहरते जगत् //
text_mt: At the time of dissolution, the God himself, the Self of all, the supreme Lord, / resorting to the quality of darkness as Rudra, destroys the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
eko 'pi sanmahādevastridhāsau samavasthitaḥ /
sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ /
ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ //
meaning:
एको ऽपि सन्महादेवस्त्रिधासौ समवस्थितः /
सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निर्गुणो ऽपि निरञ्जनः /
एकधा स द्विधा चैव त्रिधा च बहुधा पुनः //
text_mt: Though being one, Mahādeva is situated in three ways / through the qualities of creation, preservation, and dissolution, though devoid of qualities and untainted— / once, twice, thrice, and again in manifold ways.

sanskrit_iast:
yogeśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca /
nānākṛtikriyārūpanāmavanti svalīlayā //
meaning:
योगेश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोति च /
नानाकृतिक्रियारूपनामवन्ति स्वलीलया //
text_mt: The Lord of yoga creates and dissolves bodies / possessing various forms, actions, appearances, and names, through his own divine play.

sanskrit_iast:
hitāya caiva bhaktānāṃ sa eva grasate punaḥ /
tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ traikālye saṃpravartate /
sṛjate grasate caiva vīkṣate ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
हिताय चैव भक्तानां स एव ग्रसते पुनः /
त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं त्रैकाल्ये संप्रवर्तते /
सृजते ग्रसते चैव वीक्षते च विशेषतः //
text_mt: And for the benefit of his devotees, he himself swallows [all] again. / Having divided himself into three, he acts in the three periods of time; / he creates, he swallows, and he especially oversees.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt sṛṣṭvānugṛhṇāti grasate ca punaḥ prajāḥ /
guṇātmakatvāt traikālye tasmādekaḥ sa ucyate //
meaning:
यस्मात् सृष्ट्वानुगृह्णाति ग्रसते च पुनः प्रजाः /
गुणात्मकत्वात् त्रैकाल्ये तस्मादेकः स उच्यते //
text_mt: Because having created he favours and again swallows the creatures / through being composed of the qualities across the three times, therefore he is said to be one.

sanskrit_iast:
agre hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sa prādurbhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ /
āditvādādidevo 'sau ajātatvādajaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अग्रे हिरण्यगर्भः स प्रादुर्भूतः सनातनः /
आदित्वादादिदेवो ऽसौ अजातत्वादजः स्मृतः //
text_mt: In the beginning, he, the eternal Hiraṇyagarbha, became manifest. / Because he is the beginning, he is the primeval god; because he is unborn, he is remembered as Aja.

sanskrit_iast:
pātiyasmāt prajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatiriti smṛtaḥ /
deveṣu ca mahādevo māhadeva iti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पातियस्मात् प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिरिति स्मृतः /
देवेषु च महादेवो माहदेव इति स्मृतः //
text_mt: Because he protects all creatures, he is remembered as Prajāpati; / and among the gods he is the great god, remembered as Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhattvācca smṛto brahmā paratvāt parameśvaraḥ /
vaśitvādapyavaśyatvādīśvaraḥ paribhāṣitaḥ //
meaning:
बृहत्त्वाच्च स्मृतो ब्रह्मा परत्वात् परमेश्वरः /
वशित्वादप्यवश्यत्वादीश्वरः परिभाषितः //
text_mt: Because of his greatness he is remembered as Brahmā; because of his supremacy, the Supreme Lord; / and because he controls and is not controlled, he is defined as Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiḥ sarvatragatvena hariḥ sarvaharo yataḥ /
anutpādācca pūrvatvāt svayaṃbhūriti sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिः सर्वत्रगत्वेन हरिः सर्वहरो यतः /
अनुत्पादाच्च पूर्वत्वात् स्वयंभूरिति स स्मृतः //
text_mt: He is the Ṛṣi through his omnipresence; Hari because he takes away everything; / and because of having no origin and being prior, he is remembered as the Self-born.

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāmayano yasmāt tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
haraḥ saṃsāraharaṇād vibhutvād viṣṇurucyate //
meaning:
नराणामयनो यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः /
हरः संसारहरणाद् विभुत्वाद् विष्णुरुच्यते //
text_mt: Because he is the resting place of humans, by that he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa; / he is Hara because he takes away transmigratory existence; because of all-pervasiveness he is called Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavān sarvavijñānādavanādomiti smṛtaḥ /
sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānāt sarvaḥ sarvamayo yataḥ //
meaning:
भगवान् सर्वविज्ञानादवनादोमिति स्मृतः /
सर्वज्ञः सर्वविज्ञानात् सर्वः सर्वमयो यतः //
text_mt: He is Bhagavān through all-knowledge, and he is remembered as Om because of protecting; / he is the Omniscient from knowing all; he is Sarva because he consists of all.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ sa nirmalo yasmād vibhuḥ sarvagato yataḥ /
tāraṇāt sarvaduḥ khānāṃ tārakaḥ parigīyate //
meaning:
शिवः स निर्मलो यस्माद् विभुः सर्वगतो यतः /
तारणात् सर्वदुः खानां तारकः परिगीयते //
text_mt: He is Śiva because he is spotless; Vibhu because he is omnipresent; / because of carrying across all sorrows, he is proclaimed as the Savior.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat /
anekabhedabhinnastu krīḍate parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं जगत् /
अनेकभेदभिन्नस्तु क्रीडते परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: What is the use of saying much here? The entire world consists of Brahman, / and differentiated into manifold distinctions, the Supreme Lord plays.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ saṃkṣepāt kathito mayā /
abuddhipūrvako viprā brāhmīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ nibodhata //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvaṃvibhāge caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः संक्षेपात् कथितो मया /
अबुद्धिपूर्वको विप्रा ब्राह्मीं सृष्टिं निबोधत //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वंविभागे चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this elemental primary creation has been told by me in brief, / [which was] preceded by no conscious design, O brāhmaṇas; learn [now] of the creation pertaining to Brahmā.

Thus ends the fourth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
svayaṃbhuvo vivṛttasya kālasaṃkhyā dvijottamāḥ /
na śakyate samākhyātuṃ bahuvarṣairapi svayam //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
स्वयंभुवो विवृत्तस्य कालसंख्या द्विजोत्तमाः /
न शक्यते समाख्यातुं बहुवर्षैरपि स्वयम् //
title: pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The holy Kūrma said:
The reckoning of time of the Self-born who has evolved, O best of the twice-born, / cannot be fully described in person even through many years.

sanskrit_iast:
kālasaṃkhyā samāsena parārdhadvayakalpitā /
sa eva syāt paraḥ kālaḥ tadante pratisṛjyate //
meaning:
कालसंख्या समासेन परार्धद्वयकल्पिता /
स एव स्यात् परः कालः तदन्ते प्रतिसृज्यते //
text_mt: In brief, the reckoning of time is conceived as two parārdhas; / that indeed would be the supreme time, at the end of which [the universe] is recreated.

sanskrit_iast:
nijena tasya mānena āyurvarṣaśataṃ smṛtam /
tat parākhyaṃ tadardhaṃ ca parārdhamabhidīyate //
meaning:
निजेन तस्य मानेन आयुर्वर्षशतं स्मृतम् /
तत् पराख्यं तदर्धं च परार्धमभिदीयते //
text_mt: By his own measure, his lifespan is remembered as one hundred years; / that is termed a para, and its half is called a parārdha.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhā pañcadaśa khyātā nimeṣā dvijasattamāḥ /
kāṣṭhāstriṃśat kalā triṃśat kalā mauhūrtikī gatiḥ //
meaning:
काष्ठा पञ्चदश ख्याता निमेषा द्विजसत्तमाः /
काष्ठास्त्रिंशत् कला त्रिंशत् कला मौहूर्तिकी गतिः //
text_mt: Fifteen nimeṣas are known as a kāṣṭhā, O best of the twice-born; / thirty kāṣṭhās are a kalā; thirty kalās are the duration of a muhūrta.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatsaṃkhyairahorātraṃ muhūrtairmānuṣaṃ smṛtam /
ahorātrāṇi tāvanti māsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ //
meaning:
तावत्संख्यैरहोरात्रं मुहूर्तैर्मानुषं स्मृतम् /
अहोरात्राणि तावन्ति मासः पक्षद्वयात्मकः //
text_mt: A human day-and-night is remembered as consisting of that number of muhūrtas; / that many days-and-nights are a month, consisting of two fortnights.

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ ṣaḍbhirayanaṃ varṣaṃ dve 'yane dakṣiṇottare /
ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātrirdevānāmuttaraṃ dinam //
meaning:
तैः षड्भिरयनं वर्षं द्वे ऽयने दक्षिणोत्तरे /
अयनं दक्षिणं रात्रिर्देवानामुत्तरं दिनम् //
text_mt: Six of those are a half-year; a year consists of two half-years, southern and northern; / the southern half-year is the night of the gods, the northern [is their] day.

sanskrit_iast:
divyairvarṣasahastraistu kṛtatretādisaṃjñitam /
caturyugaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ tadvibhāgaṃ nibodhata //
meaning:
दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु कृतत्रेतादिसंज्ञितम् /
चतुर्युगं द्वादशभिः तद्विभागं निबोधत //
text_mt: A cycle of four yugas named Kṛta, Tretā, and so on, consists of twelve / divine thousand years; learn its division:

sanskrit_iast:
catvāryāhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam /
tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca kṛtasya tu //
meaning:
चत्वार्याहुः सहस्त्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् /
तस्य तावच्छती सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च कृतस्य तु //
text_mt: They say that Kṛtayuga consists of four thousand years; / its dawn is of as many hundreds, and the twilight of the Kṛta is the same.

sanskrit_iast:
triśatī dviśatī sandhyā tathā caikaśatī kramāt /
aṃśakaṃ ṣaṭśataṃ tasmāt kṛsandhyāṃśakaṃ vinā //
meaning:
त्रिशती द्विशती सन्ध्या तथा चैकशती क्रमात् /
अंशकं षट्शतं तस्मात् कृसन्ध्यांशकं विना //
text_mt: The dawns are respectively three hundred, two hundred, and one hundred; / the twilights are six hundred in all, excluding the dawn and twilight of the Kṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
tridvyekasāhastramato vinā sandhyāṃśakena tu /
tretādvāparatiṣyāṇāṃ kālajñāne prakīrtitam //
meaning:
त्रिद्व्येकसाहस्त्रमतो विना सन्ध्यांशकेन तु /
त्रेताद्वापरतिष्याणां कालज्ञाने प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: Hence, without the dawn and twilight, [the duration] is proclaimed as three, two, and one thousand [years] / in the knowledge of the time of the Tretā, Dvāpara, and Tiṣya [yugas].

sanskrit_iast:
etad dvādaśasāhastraṃ sādhikaṃ parikalpitam /
tadekasaptatiguṇaṃ manorantaramucyate //
meaning:
एतद् द्वादशसाहस्त्रं साधिकं परिकल्पितम् /
तदेकसप्ततिगुणं मनोरन्तरमुच्यते //
text_mt: This [total] is conceived as twelve thousand along with the additions; / multiplied by seventy-one, that is called the interval of a Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo divase viprā manavaḥ syuścaturdaśa /
svāyaṃbhuvādayaḥ sarve tataḥ sāvarṇikādayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे विप्रा मनवः स्युश्चतुर्दश /
स्वायंभुवादयः सर्वे ततः सावर्णिकादयः //
text_mt: In a day of Brahmā, O brāhmaṇas, there are fourteen Manus: / all [those] beginning with Svāyambhuva, and then those beginning with Sāvarṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā /
pūrṇaṃ yugasahastraṃ vai paripālyā nareśvaraiḥ //
meaning:
तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता /
पूर्णं युगसहस्त्रं वै परिपाल्या नरेश्वरैः //
text_mt: By them, rulers of men, this entire earth with its seven islands and its mountains / must be protected for a full thousand yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai /
vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaṃ kalpena caiva hi //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै /
व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पं कल्पेन चैव हि //
text_mt: Indeed, by one cosmic era of a Manu all the eras are explained, / without doubt, and by one kalpa, [every] kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmamekamahaḥ kalpastāvatī rātririṣyate /
caturyugasahastraṃ tu kalpamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्ममेकमहः कल्पस्तावती रात्रिरिष्यते /
चतुर्युगसहस्त्रं तु कल्पमाहुर्मनीषिणः //
text_mt: One day of Brahmā is a kalpa; his night is held to be of equal length; / the wise say that a kalpa is a thousand cycles of four yugas.

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi kalpaśatāni syuḥ tathā ṣaṣṭirdvijottamāḥ /
brahmaṇaḥ kathitaṃ varṣaṃ parākhyaṃ tacchataṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
त्रीणि कल्पशतानि स्युः तथा षष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः /
ब्रह्मणः कथितं वर्षं पराख्यं तच्छतं विदुः //
text_mt: Three hundred and sixty kalpas, O best of the twice-born, / are called a year of Brahmā; a hundred of them they know as a para.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyānte sarvatattvānāṃ svahetau prakṛtau layaḥ /
tenāyaṃ procyate sadbhiḥ prākṛtaḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ //
meaning:
तस्यान्ते सर्वतत्त्वानां स्वहेतौ प्रकृतौ लयः /
तेनायं प्रोच्यते सद्भिः प्राकृतः प्रतिसंचरः //
text_mt: At its end is the dissolution of all principles into their cause, primordial matter; / therefore this is called the elemental dissolution by the good.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmanārāyaṇeśānāṃ trayāṇāṃ prakṛtau layaḥ /
procyate kālayogena punareva ca saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मनारायणेशानां त्रयाणां प्रकृतौ लयः /
प्रोच्यते कालयोगेन पुनरेव च संभवः //
text_mt: The dissolution of the three—Brahmā, Nārāyaṇa, and Īśāna—into primordial matter / is taught to occur through the agency of time, as is their reappearance.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ brahmā ca bhūtāni vāsudevo 'pi śaṅkaraḥ /
kālenaiva tu sṛjyante sa eva grasate punaḥ //
meaning:
एवं ब्रह्मा च भूतानि वासुदेवो ऽपि शङ्करः /
कालेनैव तु सृज्यन्ते स एव ग्रसते पुनः //
text_mt: Thus Brahmā and the beings, Vāsudeva as well as Śaṅkara, / are created only by time, and he alone swallows them again.

sanskrit_iast:
anādireṣa bhagavān kālo 'nanto 'jaro 'maraḥ /
sarvagatvāt svatantratvāt sarvātmāsau maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अनादिरेष भगवान् कालो ऽनन्तो ऽजरो ऽमरः /
सर्वगत्वात् स्वतन्त्रत्वात् सर्वात्मासौ महेश्वरः //
text_mt: This Lord Time is beginningless, endless, ageless, and immortal; / because of omnipresence and independence, he is the universal Self, the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇo bahavo rudrā hyanye nārāyaṇādayaḥ /
eko hi bhagavānīśaḥ kālaḥ kaviriti śruti //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणो बहवो रुद्रा ह्यन्ये नारायणादयः /
एको हि भगवानीशः कालः कविरिति श्रुति //
text_mt: There are many Brahmās and Rudras, and other Nārāyaṇas and the rest; / indeed the one Lord is Īśa, Time, the Seer, according to scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
ekamatra vyatītaṃ tu parārdhaṃ brahmaṇo dvijāḥ /
sāṃprataṃ vartate tadvat tasya kalpo 'yamaṣṭamaḥ //
meaning:
एकमत्र व्यतीतं तु परार्धं ब्रह्मणो द्विजाः /
सांप्रतं वर्तते तद्वत् तस्य कल्पो ऽयमष्टमः //
text_mt: Here one parārdha of Brahmā has passed, O twice-born; / presently, likewise, this eighth kalpa of his is running.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'tītaḥ saptamaḥ kalpaḥ pādma ityucyate budhaiḥ /
vārāho vartate kalpaḥ tasya vakṣyāmi vistaram //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यो ऽतीतः सप्तमः कल्पः पाद्म इत्युच्यते बुधैः /
वाराहो वर्तते कल्पः तस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The seventh kalpa that has passed is called Pādma by the wise; / the Vārāha kalpa is now underway; I shall describe it in detail.

Thus ends the fifth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
āsīdekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam /
śāntavātādikaṃ sarvaṃ na prajñāyata kiñcana //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
आसीदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम् /
शान्तवातादिकं सर्वं न प्रज्ञायत किञ्चन //
title: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The holy Kūrma said:
There was a single terrifying ocean, undivided and filled with darkness; / everything such as wind was stilled; nothing was discernible.

sanskrit_iast:
ekārṇave tadā tasmin naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame /
tadā samabhavad brahmā sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt //
meaning:
एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन् नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे /
तदा समभवद् ब्रह्मा सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात् //
text_mt: Then, when the moving and unmoving had perished in that single ocean, / there arose Brahmā, thousand-eyed and thousand-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
sahastraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇastvatīndriyaḥ /
brahmā nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā //
meaning:
सहस्त्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णस्त्वतीन्द्रियः /
ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा //
text_mt: the thousand-headed Spirit, gold-colored and beyond the senses; / then Brahmā, named Nārāyaṇa, slept upon the water.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ codāharantyatra ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati /
brahmasvarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam //
meaning:
इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति /
ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणं देवं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम् //
text_mt: And in this regard they cite this verse concerning Nārāyaṇa, / the god whose nature is Brahman, the origin and dissolution of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
āpo nārā iti proktā nāmnā pūrvamiti śrutiḥ /
ayanaṃ tasya tā yasmāt tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता नाम्ना पूर्वमिति श्रुतिः /
अयनं तस्य ता यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः //
text_mt: "Waters were previously called nārāḥ by name," so says the revelation; / "because they were his resting place, he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa."

sanskrit_iast:
tulyaṃ yugasahastrasya naiśaṃ kālamupāsya saḥ /
śarvaryante prakurute brahmatvaṃ sargakāraṇāt //
meaning:
तुल्यं युगसहस्त्रस्य नैशं कालमुपास्य सः /
शर्वर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वं सर्गकारणात् //
text_mt: Having spent a nocturnal period equal to a thousand yugas, / at the end of the night he assumed the state of Brahmā for the sake of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargatāṃ mahīm /
anumānāt taduddhāraṃ kartukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिन् विज्ञायान्तर्गतां महीम् /
अनुमानात् तदुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Then, knowing by inference that the earth was submerged in that water, / Prajāpati, desiring to lift it up,

sanskrit_iast:
jalakrīḍāsu ruciraṃ vārāhaṃ rupamāsthitaḥ /
adhṛṣyaṃ manasāpyanyairvāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
जलक्रीडासु रुचिरं वाराहं रुपमास्थितः /
अधृष्यं मनसाप्यन्यैर्वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: assumed the form of a boar, delighting in aquatic sports, / unassailable even in thought by others, made of sacred speech, named Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviśya ca rasātalam /
daṃṣṭrayābhyujjahāraināmātmādhāro dharādharaḥ //
meaning:
पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविश्य च रसातलम् /
दंष्ट्रयाभ्युज्जहारैनामात्माधारो धराधरः //
text_mt: And having entered the netherworld to uplift the earth, / the bearer of the earth, who is his own support, raised her up with his tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā daṃṣṭrāgravinyastāṃ pṛthivīṃ prathitapauruṣam /
astuvañjanalokasthāḥ siddhā brahmarṣayo harim //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा दंष्ट्राग्रविन्यस्तां पृथिवीं प्रथितपौरुषम् /
अस्तुवञ्जनलोकस्थाः सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो हरिम् //
text_mt: Seeing the earth placed on the tip of his tusk, and his renowned prowess, / the perfected beings and brāhmaṇa seers abiding in Janaloka praised Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
namaste devadevāya brahmaṇe parameṣṭhine /
puruṣāya purāṇāya śāśvatāya jayāya ca //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
नमस्ते देवदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमेष्ठिने /
पुरुषाय पुराणाय शाश्वताय जयाय च //
text_mt:
The seers said:
Salutations to you, the God of gods, to Brahmā Parameṣṭhin, / to the ancient, eternal Spirit, and to Victory!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ svayaṃbhuve tubhyaṃ straṣṭre sarvārthavedine /
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya vedhase paramātmane //
meaning:
नमः स्वयंभुवे तुभ्यं स्त्रष्ट्रे सर्वार्थवेदिने /
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय वेधसे परमात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to you, the self-born, the creator, knower of all things; / homage to Hiraṇyagarbha, the ordainer, the supreme Self!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vāsudevāya viṣṇave viśvayonaye /
nārāyaṇāya devāya devānāṃ hitakāriṇe //
meaning:
नमस्ते वासुदेवाय विष्णवे विश्वयोनये /
नारायणाय देवाय देवानां हितकारिणे //
text_mt: Homage to you, Vāsudeva, Viṣṇu, source of the universe, / to Nārāyaṇa, the god who works the welfare of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te caturvaktre śārṅgacakrāsidhāriṇe /
sarvabhūtātmabhūtāya kūṭasthāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते चतुर्वक्त्रे शार्ङ्गचक्रासिधारिणे /
सर्वभूतात्मभूताय कूटस्थाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage be to you, four-faced one, bearer of bow, discus, and sword! / To the inner self of all beings, to the immutable, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
namo vedarahasyāya namaste vedayonaye /
namo buddhāya śuddhāya namaste jñānarūpiṇe //
meaning:
नमो वेदरहस्याय नमस्ते वेदयोनये /
नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपिणे //
text_mt: Homage to the secret of the Vedas! Homage to you, source of the Vedas! / Homage to the awakened, the pure! Homage to you whose form is knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stvānandarūpāya sākṣiṇe jagatāṃ namaḥ /
anantāyāprameyāya kāryāya karaṇāya ca //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्त्वानन्दरूपाय साक्षिणे जगतां नमः /
अनन्तायाप्रमेयाय कार्याय करणाय च //
text_mt: Homage be to the one whose form is bliss, homage to the witness of the worlds, / to the infinite, the immeasurable, the effect and the cause!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste pañcabūtāya pañcabhūtātmane namaḥ /
namo mūlaprakṛtaye māyārūpāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते पञ्चबूताय पञ्चभूतात्मने नमः /
नमो मूलप्रकृतये मायारूपाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Homage to you who are the five elements, homage to the soul of the five elements! / Homage to primordial matter, homage to you whose form is illusory creative power!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te varāhāya namaste matsyarūpiṇe /
namo yogādhigamyāya namaḥ sakarṣaṇāya te //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते वराहाय नमस्ते मत्स्यरूपिणे /
नमो योगाधिगम्याय नमः सकर्षणाय ते //
text_mt: Homage be to you, the Boar! Homage to you who take the form of a fish! / Homage to the one attained through yoga! Homage to you, Saṅkarṣaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ tridhāmne divyatejase /
namaḥ siddhāya pūjyāya guṇatrayavibhāvine //
meaning:
नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं त्रिधाम्ने दिव्यतेजसे /
नमः सिद्धाय पूज्याय गुणत्रयविभाविने //
text_mt: Homage to you who have three forms, of three abodes, possessing divine splendor! / Homage to the perfected, the worshipful, the manifester of the three qualities!

sanskrit_iast:
tamo 'stvādityavarṇāya namaste padmayonaye /
namo 'mūrtāya mūrtāya mādhavāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
तमो ऽस्त्वादित्यवर्णाय नमस्ते पद्मयोनये /
नमो ऽमूर्ताय मूर्ताय माधवाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage be to the sun-colored one! Homage to you born from the lotus! / Homage to the formless, the embodied, to Mādhava, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvayyeva layameṣyati /
pālayaitajjagat sarvaṃ trātā tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ gati //
meaning:
त्वयैव सृष्टमखिलं त्वय्येव लयमेष्यति /
पालयैतज्जगत् सर्वं त्राता त्वं शरणं गति //
text_mt: By you alone the whole universe was created, in you alone it will dissolve. / Protect this entire world! You are the savior, the refuge, the path!

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sanakādyairabhiṣṭutaḥ /
prasādamakarot teṣāṃ varāhavapurīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं स भगवान् विष्णुः सनकाद्यैरभिष्टुतः /
प्रसादमकरोत् तेषां वराहवपुरीश्वरः //
text_mt: Thus praised by Sanaka and the others, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, / the sovereign who possessed the body of a boar, granted them favor.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃsthānamānīya pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ /
mumoca rūpaṃ manasā dhārayitvā prijāpatiḥ //
meaning:
ततः संस्थानमानीय पृथिवीं पृथिवीपतिः /
मुमोच रूपं मनसा धारयित्वा प्रिजापतिः //
text_mt: Then, having restored the earth to its proper place, the lord of the earth, / the lord of creatures, relinquishing that form, held [it] in his mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari jalaughasya mahatī nauriva sthitā /
vitatatvācca dehasya na mahī yāti saṃplavam //
meaning:
तस्योपरि जलौघस्य महती नौरिव स्थिता /
विततत्वाच्च देहस्य न मही याति संप्लवम् //
text_mt: It rested upon that flood of water like a great boat, / and because of the vastness of its body, the earth did not sink.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ tu samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinod girīn /
prāksargadagdhānakhilāṃstataḥ sarge 'dadhanmanaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭasāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पृथिवीं तु समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद् गिरीन् /
प्राक्सर्गदग्धानखिलांस्ततः सर्गे ऽदधन्मनः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षटसाहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षष्ठो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having leveled the earth, he piled up the mountains on the earth / that were entirely burned up in the previous creation; then he turned his mind to creation.

Thus ends the sixth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
sṛṣṭiṃ cintayatastasya kalpādiṣu yathā purā /
abuddhipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ prādurbhūtastamomayaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
सृष्टिं चिन्तयतस्तस्य कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा /
अबुद्धिपूर्वकः सर्गः प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः //
title: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The glorious Kūrma said: / As he contemplated creation at the beginning of the kalpa, as in the past, / an unconscious primary creation consisting of darkness manifested.

sanskrit_iast:
tamo moho mahāmohastāmistraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ /
avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्त्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः /
अविद्या पञ्चपर्वैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः //
text_mt: Darkness, delusion, great delusion, gloom, and that known as blinding gloom: / this five-jointed nescience manifested from that great soul.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyataḥ so 'bhimāninaḥ /
saṃvṛtastamasā caiva bījakambhuvanāvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चधावस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतः सो ऽभिमानिनः /
संवृतस्तमसा चैव बीजकम्भुवनावृतः //
text_mt: A fivefold primary creation stood forth while the self-conscious one was meditating, / enfolded in darkness and wrapped like a sheath around the seed.

sanskrit_iast:
varhirantaścāprakāśaḥ stabdho niḥ saṃjña eva ca /
mukyā nagā iti proktā mukhyasargastu sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
वर्हिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशः स्तब्धो निः संज्ञ एव च /
मुक्या नगा इति प्रोक्ता मुख्यसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः //
text_mt: Without light outside or inside, motionless, and indeed unconscious; / they are called trees, the foremost: that is known as the primary creation of the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvāsādhakaṃ sargamamanyadaparaṃ prabhuḥ /
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargastiryakstroto 'bhyavartata //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वासाधकं सर्गममन्यदपरं प्रभुः /
तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गस्तिर्यक्स्त्रोतो ऽभ्यवर्तत //
text_mt: Seeing that creation incapable of [his] purpose, the lord considered another. / While he was meditating, the creation whose current is horizontal came forth.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt tiryak pravṛttaḥ sa tiryakstrotastataḥ smṛtaḥ /
paśvādayaste vikhyātā utpathagrāhiṇo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मात् तिर्यक् प्रवृत्तः स तिर्यक्स्त्रोतस्ततः स्मृतः /
पश्वादयस्ते विख्याता उत्पथग्राहिणो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Because it moves horizontally, it is therefore called the horizontal-current [creation]. / They are known as beasts and the like, straying from the right path, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
tamapyasādhakaṃ jñātvā sargamanyaṃ sasarja ha /
ūrdhvastrota iti prokto devasargastu sāttvikaḥ //
meaning:
तमप्यसाधकं ज्ञात्वा सर्गमन्यं ससर्ज ह /
ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोत इति प्रोक्तो देवसर्गस्तु सात्त्विकः //
text_mt: Knowing that [creation] too to be incapable of [his] purpose, he emitted another creation. / It is called the upward-current [creation], the divine creation consisting of purity.

sanskrit_iast:
te sukhapratibahulā bahirantaśca nāvṛtāḥ /
prakāśā bahirantaśca svabhāvād devasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
ते सुखप्रतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च नावृताः /
प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च स्वभावाद् देवसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: They abound in joy, are unobstructed outside and inside, / shining outside and inside, and are termed gods by their nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bidhāyāyatastasya satyābhidhyāyinastadā /
prādurāsīt tadāvyaktādarvākstrotastu sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽबिधायायतस्तस्य सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा /
प्रादुरासीत् तदाव्यक्तादर्वाक्स्त्रोतस्तु साधकः //
text_mt: Then, as he who meditates on truth was meditating, / there manifested from the unmanifest the downward-current [creation], which accomplishes [his purpose].

sanskrit_iast:
te ca prakāśabahulāstamodriktā rajodhikāḥ /
duḥ khotkaṭāḥ sattvayutā manuṣyāḥ parikīrtitā //
meaning:
ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमोद्रिक्ता रजोधिकाः /
दुः खोत्कटाः सत्त्वयुता मनुष्याः परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: They have much illumination, an excess of darkness, an abundance of passion, / an intensity of suffering, and are endowed with purity: they are proclaimed as humans.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāparaṃ sargamamanyad bhagavānajaḥ /
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ sargo bhūtādiko 'bhavat //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा चापरं सर्गममन्यद् भगवानजः /
तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गं सर्गो भूतादिको ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Seeing that, the unborn Lord considered another creation. / While he was meditating upon creation, the creation of spirits and the rest came into being.

sanskrit_iast:
te 'parigrāhiṇaḥ sarve saṃvibhāgaratāḥ punaḥ /
khādanāścāpyaśīlāśca bhūtādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
ityete pañca kathitāḥ sargā vai dvijapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
ते ऽपरिग्राहिणः सर्वे संविभागरताः पुनः /
खादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च भूताद्याः परिकीर्तिताः /
इत्येते पञ्च कथिताः सर्गा वै द्विजपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: They are all non-possessive, but engaged in distribution, / devouring and undisciplined; they are proclaimed as spirits and the rest. / Thus these five creations have been spoken of, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ /
tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargo hi sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः /
तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गो हि स स्मृतः //
text_mt: The first creation should be known as that of the intellect, of Brahmā; / the second is that of the subtle elements, remembered indeed as the creation of the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ /
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ saṃbhūto 'buddhipūrvakaḥ //
meaning:
वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः /
इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः संभूतो ऽबुद्धिपूर्वकः //
text_mt: The third is the modified creation, remembered as the creation of the senses. / This is the elemental creation that came to be without prior thought.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyasargaścaturthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ /
tiryakstrotastu yaḥ proktastiryagyonyaḥ sa pañcamaḥ //
meaning:
मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः /
तिर्यक्स्त्रोतस्तु यः प्रोक्तस्तिर्यग्योन्यः स पञ्चमः //
text_mt: The fourth is the primary creation of the foremost, and the foremost are remembered as immovable things. / The one called the horizontal current, consisting of the animal wombs, is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
tathordhvastrotasāṃ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ /
tator'vākstrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ //
meaning:
तथोर्ध्वस्त्रोतसां षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः /
ततोर्ऽवाक्स्त्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः //
text_mt: Likewise the sixth is of those with upward currents, remembered as the divine creation. / Then the creation of those with downward currents is the seventh, and that is the human.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamo bhautikaḥ sargo bhūtādīnāṃ prakīrtitaḥ /
navamaścaiva kaumāraḥ prākṛtā vaikṛtāstvime //
meaning:
अष्टमो भौतिकः सर्गो भूतादीनां प्रकीर्तितः /
नवमश्चैव कौमारः प्राकृता वैकृतास्त्विमे //
text_mt: The eighth is proclaimed as the physical creation of spirits and the rest, / and the ninth is the creation of the Kumāras. These are the elemental and secondary [creations].

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtāstu trayaḥ pūrve sargāste 'buddhipūrvakāḥ /
buddhipūrvaṃ pravartante mukhyādyā munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः पूर्वे सर्गास्ते ऽबुद्धिपूर्वकाः /
बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्तन्ते मुख्याद्या मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: The first three are elemental creations; they are produced without prior thought. / Those starting with the foremost proceed with prior thought, O best of sages!

sanskrit_iast:
agre sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān /
sanakaṃ sanātanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca sanandanam /
ṛbhuṃ sanātkumāraṃ ca pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् /
सनकं सनातनं चैव तथैव च सनन्दनम् /
ऋभुं सनात्कुमारं च पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: At first Brahmā, the lord of creatures, emitted mind-born [sons] equal to himself: / Sanaka, Sanātana, and likewise Sanandana, / Ṛbhu, and Sanatkumāra, at the very beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaite yogino viprāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ /
īśvarāsaktamanaso na sṛṣṭau dadhire matim //
meaning:
पञ्चैते योगिनो विप्राः परं वैराग्यमास्थिताः /
ईश्वरासक्तमनसो न सृष्टौ दधिरे मतिम् //
text_mt: These five yogins, O twice-born, having attained supreme detachment, / their minds devoted to the Lord, set not their intention upon creation.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau prajāpatiḥ /
mumoha māyayā sadyo māyinaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ प्रजापतिः /
मुमोह मायया सद्यो मायिनः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: When they were thus indifferent to the creation of the worlds, the lord of creatures / was instantly bewildered by the illusory creative power of the supreme illusionist.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ bodhayāmāsa sutaṃ jaganmāyo mahāmuniḥ /
nārāyaṇo mahāyogī yogicittānurañjanaḥ //
meaning:
तं बोधयामास सुतं जगन्मायो महामुनिः /
नारायणो महायोगी योगिचित्तानुरञ्जनः //
text_mt: The great sage, whose illusory power is the world, awakened that son: / Nārāyaṇa, the great yogin who delights the minds of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
bodhitastena viśvātmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ /
sa tapyamāno bhagavān na kiñcit pratipadyata //
meaning:
बोधितस्तेन विश्वात्मा तताप परमं तपः /
स तप्यमानो भगवान् न किञ्चित् प्रतिपद्यत //
text_mt: Awakened by him, the soul of the universe performed supreme asceticism. / As he performed asceticism, the Lord did not attain anything.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dīrgheṇa kālena dukhāt krodho vyajāyata /
krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśru bindavaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुखात् क्रोधो व्यजायत /
क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रु बिन्दवः //
text_mt: Then after a long time, wrath was born from sorrow. / From the eyes of him overcome by wrath, teardrops fell.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrukuṭīkuṭilāt tasya lalāṭāt parameśvaraḥ /
samutpanno mahādevaḥ śaraṇyo nīlalohitaḥ //
meaning:
भ्रुकुटीकुटिलात् तस्य ललाटात् परमेश्वरः /
समुत्पन्नो महादेवः शरण्यो नीललोहितः //
text_mt: From his forehead, arched with a frown, the supreme lord / Mahādeva arose, the refuge, the blue-and-red one.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva bhagavānīśastejorāśiḥ sanātanaḥ /
yaṃ prapaśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ svātmasthaṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
स एव भगवानीशस्तेजोराशिः सनातनः /
यं प्रपश्यन्ति विद्वांसः स्वात्मस्थं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: He alone is the Lord, the master, an eternal mass of splendor, / the supreme lord whom the wise behold residing within their own soul.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ /
tāma bhagavān brahmā sṛjemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्कारं समनुस्मृत्य प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः /
ताम भगवान् ब्रह्मा सृजेमा विविधाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: Remembering the syllable Oṃ, bowing, with joined palms, / the blessed Brahmā [said] to him: 'Create these diverse creatures!'

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya bhagavān vākyaṃ śaṅkaro dharmavāhanaḥ /
svātmanā sadśān rudrān sasarja manasā śivaḥ /
kapardino nirātaṅkāṃstrinetrān nīlalohitān //
meaning:
निशम्य भगवान् वाक्यं शङ्करो धर्मवाहनः /
स्वात्मना सद्शान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः /
कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कांस्त्रिनेत्रान् नीललोहितान् //
text_mt: Hearing the words of the Blessed One, Śaṅkara, whose vehicle is righteousness, Śiva, / created with his mind Rudras equal to himself: / matted-haired, free from fear, three-eyed, and blue-and-red.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā janmamṛtyuyutāḥ prajāḥ /
sṛjeti so 'bravīdīśo nāhaṃ mṛtyujarānvitāḥ /
prajāḥ strakṣye jagannātha sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा जन्ममृत्युयुताः प्रजाः /
सृजेति सो ऽब्रवीदीशो नाहं मृत्युजरान्विताः /
प्रजाः स्त्रक्ष्ये जगन्नाथ सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: The blessed Brahmā said to him: 'Create creatures subject to birth and death!' / The Lord said to him: 'I will not create creatures / endowed with death and old age, O lord of the world! Create inauspicious creatures yourself!'

sanskrit_iast:
nivārya ca tadā rudraṃ sasarja kamalodbhavaḥ /
sthānābhimāninaḥ sarvān gadatastān nibodhata //
meaning:
निवार्य च तदा रुद्रं ससर्ज कमलोद्भवः /
स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वान् गदतस्तान् निबोधत //
text_mt: Having then checked Rudra, the lotus-born [Brahmā] created / all the deities presiding over places; hear of them as they are declared:

sanskrit_iast:
apo 'gnirantarikṣaṃ ca dyaurvāyuḥ pṛthivī tathā /
nadyaḥ samudrāḥ śailāśca vṛkṣā vīrudha eva ca //
meaning:
अपो ऽग्निरन्तरिक्षं च द्यौर्वायुः पृथिवी तथा /
नद्यः समुद्राः शैलाश्च वृक्षा वीरुध एव च //
text_mt: the waters, fire, and the atmosphere, heaven, wind, and likewise the earth, / rivers, oceans, and mountains, trees and climbing plants;

sanskrit_iast:
lavāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtā divasāḥ kṣapāḥ /
ardhamāsāśca māsāśca ayanābdayugādayaḥ //
meaning:
लवाः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः /
अर्धमासाश्च मासाश्च अयनाब्दयुगादयः //
text_mt: instants, measures of time, divisions of an hour, muhūrtas, days, nights, / half-months, and months, solstices, years, and yugas, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānābimāninaḥ sṛṣṭvā sādhakānasṛjat punaḥ /
marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum /
dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca dharmaṃ saṃkalpameva ca //
meaning:
स्थानाबिमानिनः सृष्ट्वा साधकानसृजत् पुनः /
मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् /
दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च धर्मं संकल्पमेव च //
text_mt: Having created the presiding deities of the cosmic places, he then created the practitioners: / Marīci, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Dakṣa, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Dharma, and Saṃkalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇād brahmāsṛjad dakṣaṃ cakṣuṣaśca marīcinam /
śiraso 'ṅgirasaṃ devo hṛdayād bhṛgumeva ca //
meaning:
प्राणाद् ब्रह्मासृजद् दक्षं चक्षुषश्च मरीचिनम् /
शिरसो ऽङ्गिरसं देवो हृदयाद् भृगुमेव च //
text_mt: From his out-breath Brahmā created Dakṣa, and Marīci from his eye; / the god created Aṅgiras from his head, and Bhṛgu from his heart,

sanskrit_iast:
śrotrābhyāmatrināmānaṃ dharmaṃ ca vyavasāyataḥ /
saṃkalpaṃ caiva saṃkalpāt sarvalokapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
श्रोत्राभ्यामत्रिनामानं धर्मं च व्यवसायतः /
संकल्पं चैव संकल्पात् सर्वलोकपितामहः //
text_mt: the one named Atri from his two ears, and Dharma from his resolve, / and Saṃkalpa from his volition, the Grandfather of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastyaṃ ca tathodānād vyanācca pulahaṃ munim /
apānāt kratumavyagraṃ samānācca vasiṣṭhakam //
meaning:
पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानाद् व्यनाच्च पुलहं मुनिम् /
अपानात् क्रतुमव्यग्रं समानाच्च वसिष्ठकम् //
text_mt: And likewise Pulastya from his upward breath, and the sage Pulaha from his pervasive breath, / unperturbed Kratu from his downward breath, and Vasiṣṭha from his equal breath.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ sādhakā gṛhamedhinaḥ /
āsthāya mānavaṃ rūpaṃ dharmastaiḥ saṃpravartitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येते ब्रह्मणा सृष्टाः साधका गृहमेधिनः /
आस्थाय मानवं रूपं धर्मस्तैः संप्रवर्तितः //
text_mt: Thus were these householder practitioners created by Brahmā; / assuming human form, dharma was set in motion by them.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devāsurapitṛn manuṣyāṃśca catuṣṭayam /
sisṛkṣurambhāṃsyetāni svamātmānamayūyujat //
meaning:
ततो देवासुरपितृन् मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम् /
सिसृक्षुरम्भांस्येतानि स्वमात्मानमयूयुजत् //
text_mt: Then, desiring to create the fourfold group of gods, asuras, ancestors, and humans, / he applied his own self to these waters.

sanskrit_iast:
yuktātmanastamomātrā udriktābhūt prajāpateḥ /
tato 'sya jaghanāt pūrvamasurā jajñire sutāḥ //
meaning:
युक्तात्मनस्तमोमात्रा उद्रिक्ताभूत् प्रजापतेः /
ततो ऽस्य जघनात् पूर्वमसुरा जज्ञिरे सुताः //
text_mt: As the Lord of Creatures concentrated himself, the measure of darkness predominated; / thereupon, from his loins the asuras were first born as his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
utsasarjāsurān sṛṣṭvā tāṃ tanuṃ puruṣottamaḥ /
sā cotsṛṣṭā tanustena sadyo rātrirajāyata /
sā tamobahulā yasmāt prajāstasyāṃsvapantyataḥ //
meaning:
उत्ससर्जासुरान् सृष्ट्वा तां तनुं पुरुषोत्तमः /
सा चोत्सृष्टा तनुस्तेन सद्यो रात्रिरजायत /
सा तमोबहुला यस्मात् प्रजास्तस्यांस्वपन्त्यतः //
text_mt: Having created the asuras, the Supreme Spirit abandoned that body; / and that body, once abandoned by him, immediately became night; / because it abounds in darkness, therefore creatures sleep during it.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvamātratmikāṃ devastanumanyāmagṛhṇata /
tato 'sya mukhato devā dīvyataḥ saṃprajajñire //
meaning:
सत्त्वमात्रत्मिकां देवस्तनुमन्यामगृह्णत /
ततो ऽस्य मुखतो देवा दीव्यतः संप्रजज्ञिरे //
text_mt: The god assumed another body, consisting of the measure of purity; / then from his mouth, as he was sporting, the gods were born.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktā sāpi tanustena sattvaprāyamabhūd dinam /
tasmādaho dharmayuktā devatāḥ samupāsate //
meaning:
त्यक्ता सापि तनुस्तेन सत्त्वप्रायमभूद् दिनम् /
तस्मादहो धर्मयुक्ता देवताः समुपासते //
text_mt: That body too, abandoned by him, became day, which is predominated by purity; / therefore, endowed with righteousness, the gods attend upon the day.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvamātrātmikāmeva tato 'nyāṃ jagṛhe tanum /
pitṛvanmanyamānasya pitaraḥ saṃprajajñire //
meaning:
सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततो ऽन्यां जगृहे तनुम् /
पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य पितरः संप्रजज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Then he assumed another body, likewise consisting of the measure of purity; / as he regarded himself like a father, the ancestors were born.

sanskrit_iast:
utsasarja pitṛn sṛṣṭvā tatastāmapi viśvasṛk /
sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyaḥ sandhyā vyajāyata //
meaning:
उत्ससर्ज पितृन् सृष्ट्वा ततस्तामपि विश्वसृक् /
सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन सद्यः सन्ध्या व्यजायत //
text_mt: Then, having created the ancestors, the creator of the universe abandoned that [body] as well; / cast off by him, that body immediately became twilight.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādahardevatānāṃ rātriḥ syād devavidviṣām /
tayormadhye pitṝṇāṃ tu mūrtiḥ sandhyā garīyasī //
meaning:
तस्मादहर्देवतानां रात्रिः स्याद् देवविद्विषाम् /
तयोर्मध्ये पितॄणां तु मूर्तिः सन्ध्या गरीयसी //
text_mt: Therefore day belongs to the gods, and night belongs to the enemies of the gods; / between the two, however, the twilight is the revered form of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād devāsurāḥ sarve manavo mānavāstathā /
upāsate tadā yuktā rātryahnormadhyamāṃ tanum //
meaning:
तस्माद् देवासुराः सर्वे मनवो मानवास्तथा /
उपासते तदा युक्ता रात्र्यह्नोर्मध्यमां तनुम् //
text_mt: Therefore all the gods, asuras, manus, and humans, / concentrated at that time, revere that middle form between night and day.

sanskrit_iast:
rajomātrātmikāṃ brahmā tanumanyāmagṛhṇata /
tato 'sya jajñire putrā manuṣyā rajasāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
रजोमात्रात्मिकां ब्रह्मा तनुमन्यामगृह्णत /
ततो ऽस्य जज्ञिरे पुत्रा मनुष्या रजसावृताः //
text_mt: Brahmā assumed another body consisting of the measure of passion; / then from him were born human beings as sons, enveloped in passion.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmapyāśu sa tatyāja tanuṃ sadyaḥ prajāpatiḥ /
jyotstrā sā cābhavadviprāḥ prāksandhyā yābidhīyate //
meaning:
तामप्याशु स तत्याज तनुं सद्यः प्रजापतिः /
ज्योत्स्त्रा सा चाभवद्विप्राः प्राक्सन्ध्या याबिधीयते //
text_mt: The Lord of Creatures quickly cast off that body too; / and it, O Brahmins, became the moonlight, which is known as the dawn twilight.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā saṃprāpya dvijapuṅgavāḥ /
mūrti tamorajaḥ prāyāṃ punarevābhyayūyujat //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा संप्राप्य द्विजपुङ्गवाः /
मूर्ति तमोरजः प्रायां पुनरेवाभ्ययूयुजत् //
