text_mt: Then the blessed Brahmā, having assumed, O best of the twice-born, / a form predominated by darkness and passion, applied himself once again.

sanskrit_iast:
andhakāre kṣudhāviṣṭā rākṣasāstasya jajñire /
putrāstamorajaḥ prāyā balinaste niśācarāḥ //
meaning:
अन्धकारे क्षुधाविष्टा राक्षसास्तस्य जज्ञिरे /
पुत्रास्तमोरजः प्राया बलिनस्ते निशाचराः //
text_mt: In the darkness, rākṣasas overcome with hunger were born to him; / those sons, nocturnal wanderers, were predominated by darkness and passion, full of strength.

sanskrit_iast:
sarpā yakṣāstathā būtā gandharvāḥ saṃprajajñire /
rajastamobhyāmāviṣṭāṃstato 'nyānasṛjat prabhuḥ //
meaning:
सर्पा यक्षास्तथा बूता गन्धर्वाः संप्रजज्ञिरे /
रजस्तमोभ्यामाविष्टांस्ततो ऽन्यानसृजत् प्रभुः //
text_mt: Snakes, yakṣas, and bhūtas, and gandharvas were born; / then the Lord created others, filled with passion and darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
vayāṃsi vayasaḥ sṛṣṭvā avayo vakṣaso 'sṛjat /
mukhato 'jān sasarjānyān udarādgāścanirmame //
meaning:
वयांसि वयसः सृष्ट्वा अवयो वक्षसो ऽसृजत् /
मुखतो ऽजान् ससर्जान्यान् उदराद्गाश्चनिर्ममे //
text_mt: Having created birds from his prime of youth, he created sheep from his chest; / he generated goats from his mouth, and fashioned cows from his belly.

sanskrit_iast:
padbhyāñcāśvān samātaṅgān rāsabhān gavayān mṛgān /
uṣṭrānaśvatarāṃścaiva nyaṅkūnanyāṃśva jātayaḥ /
aupadhyaḥ phalamūlinyo romabhyastasya jajñire //
meaning:
पद्भ्याञ्चाश्वान् समातङ्गान् रासभान् गवयान् मृगान् /
उष्ट्रानश्वतरांश्चैव न्यङ्कूनन्यांश्व जातयः /
औपध्यः फलमूलिन्यो रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: And from his feet [he created] horses along with elephants, donkeys, gavayas, deer, / camels, mules, antelopes, and other species; / and medicinal plants bearing fruits and roots were born from his body hair.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatraṃ ca ṛcaṃ caiva trivṛtsāma rathantaram /
agniṣṭomaṃ ca yajñānāṃ nirmame prathamānmukhāt //
meaning:
गायत्रं च ऋचं चैव त्रिवृत्साम रथन्तरम् /
अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् //
text_mt: And the Gāyatrī metre, the Ṛgveda, the Trivṛt stoma, the Rathantara sāman, / and the Agniṣṭoma among sacrifices he fashioned from his first mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
yajūṃṣi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ stomaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tathā /
bṛhatsāma tathokthaṃ ca dakṣiṇādasṛjanmukhāt //
meaning:
यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पञ्चदशं तथा /
बृहत्साम तथोक्थं च दक्षिणादसृजन्मुखात् //
text_mt: The Yajurveda, the Traiṣṭubha metre, the Pañcadaśa stoma, / the Bṛhat sāman, and the Uktha he created from his southern mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmāni jāgataṃ chandastomaṃ saptadaśaṃ tathā /
vairūpamatirātraṃ ca paścimādasṛjanmukhāt //
meaning:
सामानि जागतं छन्दस्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा /
वैरूपमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमादसृजन्मुखात् //
text_mt: The Sāmaveda, the Jāgatī metre, the Saptadaśa stoma, / the Vairūpa sāman, and the Atirātra sacrifice he created from his western mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviśamatharvāṇamāptoryāmāṇameva ca /
anuṣṭubhaṃ savairājamuttarādasṛjanmukhāt //
meaning:
एकविशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामाणमेव च /
अनुष्टुभं सवैराजमुत्तरादसृजन्मुखात् //
text_mt: The Ekaviṃśa stoma, the Atharvaveda, the Āptoryāma sacrifice, / and the Anuṣṭubh metre with the Vairāja sāman he created from his northern mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire /
brahmaṇo hi prajāsargaṃ sṛjatastu prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे /
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रजासर्गं सृजतस्तु प्रजापतेः //
text_mt: High and low creatures were born from his limbs, / indeed of Brahmā, the Lord of Creatures, as he was generating the creation of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭvā catuṣṭayaṃ sargaṃ devarṣipitṛmānuṣam /
tato 'sṛjacca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca //
meaning:
सृष्ट्वा चतुष्टयं सर्गं देवर्षिपितृमानुषम् /
ततो ऽसृजच्च भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च //
text_mt: Having created the fourfold creation of gods, sages, ancestors, and humans, / he then created immovable and moving creatures:

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣān piśācān gandharvāṃstathaivāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ /
narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥ puśumṛgoragān /
avyayaṃ ca vyayaṃ caiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
यक्षान् पिशाचान् गन्धर्वांस्तथैवाप्सरसः शुभाः /
नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयः पुशुमृगोरगान् /
अव्ययं च व्ययं चैव द्वयं स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: yakṣas, piśācas, gandharvas, and likewise auspicious apsarases, / humans, kinnaras, rākṣasas, birds, cattle, wild beasts, and serpents, / both the imperishable and the perishable, the twofold immovable and moving.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ ye yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭau pratipedire /
tānyeva te prapadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां ये यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्टौ प्रतिपेदिरे /
तान्येव ते प्रपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Whatever actions they took upon themselves in the former creation, / those very actions they obtain as they are created again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃstrāhiṃstre mṛdukrūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte /
tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāt tat tasya rocate //
meaning:
हिंस्त्राहिंस्त्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते /
तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात् तत् तस्य रोचते //
text_mt: Harmful or harmless, gentle or cruel, righteous or unrighteous, true or false— / conditioned by those [dispositions], they obtain them; therefore that appeals to each.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrtiṣu /
viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vidadhāt svayam //
meaning:
महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मूर्तिषु /
विनियोगं च भूतानां धातैव विदधात् स्वयम् //
text_mt: The diversity among the great elements, the objects of the senses, and embodied forms, / and the allocation of creatures, the Ordainer himself established.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmarūpaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ kṛtyānāṃ ca prapañcanam /
vedaśabdebhya evādau nirmame sa maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
नामरूपं च भूतानां कृत्यानां च प्रपञ्चनम् /
वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ निर्ममे स महेश्वरः //
text_mt: The names and forms of beings and the elaboration of duties / that Great Lord fashioned in the beginning from the words of the Veda alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣāṇi caiva nāmāni yāśca vedeṣu dṛṣṭayaḥ /
śarvaryante prasūtānāṃ tānyevaibhyo dadātyajaḥ //
meaning:
आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च वेदेषु दृष्टयः /
शर्वर्यन्ते प्रसूतानां तान्येवैभ्यो ददात्यजः //
text_mt: The names belonging to the ṛṣis, and the visions that are in the Vedas, / those very ones the Unborn One assigns to those born at the end of the night [of Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
yathartāvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye /
dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये /
दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Just as the diverse marks of the seasons appear in their recurring cycle / as those very same ones, so do the states of existence at the start of the yugas.

Thus ends the seventh chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
evaṃ bhūtāni sṛṣṭāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca /
yadā cāsya prajāḥ sṛṣṭā na vyavardhanta dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
एवं भूतानि सृष्टानि स्थावराणि चराणि च /
यदा चास्य प्रजाः सृष्टा न व्यवर्धन्त धीमतः //
title: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The glorious Tortoise said: / When the immovable and moving creatures had thus been created, / and when the creatures created by him, the wise one, did not multiply,

sanskrit_iast:
tamomātrāvṛto brahmā tadāśocata duḥ khitaḥ /
tataḥ sa vidadhe buddhimarthaniścayagāminīm //
meaning:
तमोमात्रावृतो ब्रह्मा तदाशोचत दुः खितः /
ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगामिनीम् //
text_mt: then Brahmā, enveloped in the measure of darkness, grieved, full of sorrow; / thereupon he formulated an intellect that goes to the ascertainment of the matter.

sanskrit_iast:
athātmani samadrākṣīt tamomātrāṃ niyāmikām /
rajaḥ sattvaṃ ca saṃvṛtya vartamānāṃ svadharmataḥ //
meaning:
अथात्मनि समद्राक्षीत् तमोमात्रां नियामिकाम् /
रजः सत्त्वं च संवृत्य वर्तमानां स्वधर्मतः //
text_mt: Then in himself he perceived the measure of darkness as the regulating factor, / which, having shrouded passion and purity, was operating according to its own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tamastad vyanudat paścāt rajaḥ sattvena saṃyutaḥ /
tat tamaḥ pratinunnaṃ vai mithunaṃ samajāyata //
meaning:
तमस्तद् व्यनुदत् पश्चात् रजः सत्त्वेन संयुतः /
तत् तमः प्रतिनुन्नं वै मिथुनं समजायत //
text_mt: He subsequently cast off that darkness, joined with passion and purity; / that darkness, indeed, when cast away, became a pair:

sanskrit_iast:
adharmācaraṇo viprā hiṃsā cāśubhalakṣaṇā /
svāṃ tanuṃ sa tato brahmā tāmapohata bhāsvarām //
meaning:
अधर्माचरणो विप्रा हिंसा चाशुभलक्षणा /
स्वां तनुं स ततो ब्रह्मा तामपोहत भास्वराम् //
text_mt: the practice of unrighteousness, O Brahmins, and violence of inauspicious marks; / then Brahmā set aside that radiant body of his.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhākarot punardehamardhena puruṣo 'bhavat /
ardhena nārī puruṣo virājamasṛjat prabhuḥ //
meaning:
द्विधाकरोत् पुनर्देहमर्धेन पुरुषो ऽभवत् /
अर्धेन नारी पुरुषो विराजमसृजत् प्रभुः //
text_mt: He made his body into two parts: with one half he became a male, / and with the other half a female; as the male, the Lord created Virāj,

sanskrit_iast:
nārīṃ ca śatarūpākhyāṃ yoginīṃ sasṛje śubhām /
sā divaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva mahamnā vyāpya saṃsthitā //
meaning:
नारीं च शतरूपाख्यां योगिनीं ससृजे शुभाम् /
सा दिवं पृथिवीं चैव महम्ना व्याप्य संस्थिता //
text_mt: and the female named Śatarūpā he created as an auspicious yoginī; / she remained pervading heaven and earth with her greatness,

sanskrit_iast:
yogaiśvaryabalopetā jñānavijñānasaṃyutā /
yo 'bhavat puruṣāt putro virāḍavyaktajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
योगैश्वर्यबलोपेता ज्ञानविज्ञानसंयुता /
यो ऽभवत् पुरुषात् पुत्रो विराडव्यक्तजन्मनः //
text_mt: endowed with the strength of yogic sovereignty, united with knowledge and discrimination. / The son who came to be from that male was Virāj, born of the unmanifest;

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvo manurdevaḥ so 'bhavat puruṣo muniḥ /
sā devī śatarūpākhyā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवो मनुर्देवः सो ऽभवत् पुरुषो मुनिः /
सा देवी शतरूपाख्या तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् //
text_mt: he, the divine sage, became the male Svāyambhuva Manu; / that goddess named Śatarūpā, having performed austerities very difficult to practice,

sanskrit_iast:
bhartāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ manumevānupadyata /
tasmācca śatarūpā sā putradvayamasūyata //
meaning:
भर्तारं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं मनुमेवानुपद्यत /
तस्माच्च शतरूपा सा पुत्रद्वयमसूयत //
text_mt: obtained as her husband Manu, the son of Brahmā; / and from him that Śatarūpā bore two sons,

sanskrit_iast:
priyavratottānapādau kanyādvayamanuttamam /
tayoḥ prasūtiṃ dakṣāya manuḥ kanyāṃ dadau punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ कन्याद्वयमनुत्तमम् /
तयोः प्रसूतिं दक्षाय मनुः कन्यां ददौ पुनः //
text_mt: Priyavrata and Uttānapāda, and two unsurpassed daughters; / of the two [daughters], Manu gave Prasūti to Dakṣa as wife.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatirathākūtiṃ mānaso jagṛhe ruciḥ /
ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe mānasasya ruceḥ śubham /
yajñaśca dakṣiṇā caiva yābhyāṃ saṃvardhitaṃ jagat //
meaning:
प्रजापतिरथाकूतिं मानसो जगृहे रुचिः /
आकूत्यां मिथुनं जज्ञे मानसस्य रुचेः शुभम् /
यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव याभ्यां संवर्धितं जगत् //
text_mt: Then Ruci, the mental son [of Brahmā], the lord of creatures, took Ākūti [in marriage]. / From Ākūti was born an auspicious pair to the mental son Ruci: / Yajña and Dakṣiṇā, by whom the world was made to thrive.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasya dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu putrā dvādaśa jajñire /
yāmā iti samākyatā devāḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare //
meaning:
यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां तु पुत्रा द्वादश जज्ञिरे /
यामा इति समाक्यता देवाः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे //
text_mt: And to Yajña from Dakṣiṇā twelve sons were born, / renowned as the Yāma gods in the era of Svāyambhuva [Manu].

sanskrit_iast:
prasūtyāṃ ca tathā dakṣaścatastro viṃśatiṃ tathā /
sasarja kanyā nāmāni tāsāṃ samyam nibodhata //
meaning:
प्रसूत्यां च तथा दक्षश्चतस्त्रो विंशतिं तथा /
ससर्ज कन्या नामानि तासां सम्यम् निबोधत //
text_mt: And likewise, Dakṣa engendered twenty-four daughters / upon Prasūti; hear their names in full:

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā /
buddhirlajjāvapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī //
meaning:
श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्मेधा क्रिया तथा /
बुद्धिर्लज्जावपुः शान्तिः सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी //
text_mt: Śraddhā, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Tuṣṭi, Puṣṭi, Medhā, and Kriyā; / Buddhi, Lajjā, Vapuḥ, Śānti, Siddhi, and Kīrti as the thirteenth.

sanskrit_iast:
patnyarthaṃ pratijagrāha dharmo dākṣāyaṇīḥ śubhāḥ /
tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīyasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ //
meaning:
पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः शुभाः /
ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः //
text_mt: Dharma took these auspicious daughters of Dakṣa as his wives. / Remaining from them were eleven younger, beautiful-eyed daughters:

sanskrit_iast:
khyātiḥ satyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā /
saṃtatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā //
meaning:
ख्यातिः सत्यथ संभूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा /
संततिश्चानसूया च ऊर्जा स्वाहा स्वधा तथा //
text_mt: Khyāti, Satī, and then Saṃbhūti, Smṛti, Prīti, and Kṣamā, / Saṃtati and Anasūyā, Ūrjā, Svāhā, and Svadhā.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgurbhavo marīciśca tathā caivāṅgirā muniḥ /
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kratuḥ paramadharmavit //
meaning:
भृगुर्भवो मरीचिश्च तथा चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः /
पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुः परमधर्मवित् //
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Bhava, Marīci, and the sage Aṅgiras, / Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu, the supreme knower of duty,

sanskrit_iast:
atrirvasiṣṭho vahniśca pitaraśca yathākramam /
khyātyādyā jagṛhuḥ kanyā munayo munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
अत्रिर्वसिष्ठो वह्निश्च पितरश्च यथाक्रमम् /
ख्यात्याद्या जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Vahni, and the ancestors in proper order— / these sages, best of sages, took the daughters beginning with Khyāti.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhāyā ātmajaḥ kāmo darpo lakṣmīsutaḥ smṛtaḥ /
dhṛtyāstu niyamaḥ putrastuṣṭyāḥ saṃtoṣa ucyate //
meaning:
श्रद्धाया आत्मजः कामो दर्पो लक्ष्मीसुतः स्मृतः /
धृत्यास्तु नियमः पुत्रस्तुष्ट्याः संतोष उच्यते //
text_mt: Kāma was the son of Śraddhā; Darpa is remembered as the son of Lakṣmī; / Niyama was the son of Dhṛti; Saṃtoṣa is declared [the son] of Tuṣṭi;

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭyā lābhaḥ sutaścāpi medhāputraḥ śrutastathā /
kriyāyāścābhavat putro daṇḍaḥ samaya eva ca //
meaning:
पुष्ट्या लाभः सुतश्चापि मेधापुत्रः श्रुतस्तथा /
क्रियायाश्चाभवत् पुत्रो दण्डः समय एव च //
text_mt: Lābha was the son of Puṣṭi; likewise Śruta was the son of Medhā; / and of Kriyā was born a son, Daṇḍa, and also Samaya;

sanskrit_iast:
buddhyā bodhaḥ sutastadvadapramādo vyajāyata /
lajjāyā vinayaḥ putro vapuṣo vyavasāyakaḥ //
meaning:
बुद्ध्या बोधः सुतस्तद्वदप्रमादो व्यजायत /
लज्जाया विनयः पुत्रो वपुषो व्यवसायकः //
text_mt: of Buddhi was born Bodha as a son, and likewise Apramāda; / Vinaya was the son of Lajjā; Vyavasāya of Vapus;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemaḥ śāntisutaścāpi sukhaṃ siddhirajāyata /
yaśaḥ kīrtisutastadvadityete dharmasūnavaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेमः शान्तिसुतश्चापि सुखं सिद्धिरजायत /
यशः कीर्तिसुतस्तद्वदित्येते धर्मसूनवः //
text_mt: Kṣema was the son of Śānti; and Sukha was born to Siddhi; / likewise Yaśas was the son of Kīrti: these are the sons of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmasya harṣaḥ putro 'bhūd devānando vyajāyata /
ityeṣa vai sukhodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya kīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
कामस्य हर्षः पुत्रो ऽभूद् देवानन्दो व्यजायत /
इत्येष वै सुखोदर्कः सर्गो धर्मस्य कीर्तितः //
text_mt: Harṣa was the son of Kāma; from him was born Devānanda. / Thus this creation of Dharma, having happiness as its outcome, has been recounted.

sanskrit_iast:
jajñe hiṃsā tvadharmād vai nikṛtiṃ cānṛtaṃ sutam /
nikṛtyanṛtayorjajñe bhayaṃ naraka eva ca //
meaning:
जज्ञे हिंसा त्वधर्माद् वै निकृतिं चानृतं सुतम् /
निकृत्यनृतयोर्जज्ञे भयं नरक एव च //
text_mt: From Adharma indeed, Hiṃsā bore Nikṛti and a son, Anṛta. / From Nikṛti and Anṛta were born Bhaya and Naraka;

sanskrit_iast:
māyā ca vedanā caiva mithunaṃ tvidametayoḥ /
bhayājjajñe 'tha vai māyā mṛtyuṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam //
meaning:
माया च वेदना चैव मिथुनं त्विदमेतयोः /
भयाज्जज्ञे ऽथ वै माया मृत्युं भूतापहारिणम् //
text_mt: and Māyā and Vedanā—this was the pair of these two. / Then from Bhaya, Māyā indeed bore Mṛtyu, the taker of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
vedanā ca sutaṃ cāpi duḥ khaṃ jajñe 'tha rauravāt /
mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire //
meaning:
वेदना च सुतं चापि दुः खं जज्ञे ऽथ रौरवात् /
मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णाक्रोधाश्च जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: And Vedanā bore a son, Duḥkha, from Raurava. / From Mṛtyu were born Vyādhi, Jarā, Śoka, Tṛṣṇā, and Krodha.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥ khottarāḥ smṛtā hyete sarve cādharmalakṣaṇāḥ /
naiṣāṃ bhāryāsti putro vā sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ //
meaning:
दुः खोत्तराः स्मृता ह्येते सर्वे चाधर्मलक्षणाः /
नैषां भार्यास्ति पुत्रो वा सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः //
text_mt: These are remembered as having suffering as their outcome, and all have the character of unrighteousness. / They have neither wife nor son; indeed, all of them have drawn up their semen.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa tāmasaḥ sargo jajñe dharmaniyāmakaḥ /
saṃkṣepeṇa mayā proktā visṛṣṭirmunipuṅgavā //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge 'ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः /
संक्षेपेण मया प्रोक्ता विसृष्टिर्मुनिपुङ्गवा //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे ऽष्टमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this dark creation was born as a restrainer through righteousness. / The secondary creation has been spoken by me in brief, O best of sages.

Thus ends the eighth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ /
praṇamya varadaṃ viṣṇuṃ papracchuḥ saṃśayānvitā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं नारदाद्या महर्षयः /
प्रणम्य वरदं विष्णुं पप्रच्छुः संशयान्विता //
title: navamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this speech, the great sages headed by Nārada, / having bowed to Viṣṇu the grantor of boons, asked, filled with doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathito bhavatā sargo mukhyādīnāṃ janārdana /
idānīṃ saṃśayaṃ cemamasmākaṃ chettumarhasi //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथितो भवता सर्गो मुख्यादीनां जनार्दन /
इदानीं संशयं चेममस्माकं छेत्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: The sages said: / The creation beginning with the primary has been related by you, O Janārdana. / Now you ought to dispel this doubt of ours:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ pūrvajo 'pi pinākadhṛk /
putratvamagacchaṃbhurbrahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
कथं स भगवानीशः पूर्वजो ऽपि पिनाकधृक् /
पुत्रत्वमगच्छंभुर्ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः //
text_mt: How did that blessed Lord, the wielder of the Pināka, although firstborn, / Śambhu, come to be the son of Brahmā, whose birth is from the unmanifest?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ ca bhagavāñjajñe brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
aṇḍajo jagatāmīśastanno vaktumihārhasi //
meaning:
कथं च भगवाञ्जज्ञे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
अण्डजो जगतामीशस्तन्नो वक्तुमिहार्हसि //
text_mt: And how was the blessed lord Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / the egg-born lord of the worlds, born? You ought to tell us that here.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ /
putratvaṃ brahmaṇastasya padmayonitvameva ca //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे शङ्करस्यामितौजसः /
पुत्रत्वं ब्रह्मणस्तस्य पद्मयोनित्वमेव च //
text_mt: The holy Kūrma said: / Hear, O all sages, about the immeasurably powerful Śaṅkara / becoming the son of that Brahmā, and his being born from a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
atītakalpāvasāne tamobhūtaṃ jagat trayam /
āsīdekārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ na devādyā na carṣayaḥ //
meaning:
अतीतकल्पावसाने तमोभूतं जगत् त्रयम् /
आसीदेकार्णवं सर्वं न देवाद्या न चर्षयः //
text_mt: At the close of the past cosmic age, the threefold world became darkness; / all was a single ocean; there were neither gods nor sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nārāyaṇo devo nirjane nirupaplave /
āśritya śeṣaśayanaṃ suṣvāpa puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र नारायणो देवो निर्जने निरुपप्लवे /
आश्रित्य शेषशयनं सुष्वाप पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: There the divine Nārāyaṇa, the Supreme Spirit, / resting upon the couch of Śeṣa, fell asleep in that desolate, affliction-free place,

sanskrit_iast:
sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvā sa sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt /
sahastrabāhuḥ sarvajñaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
सहस्त्रशीर्षा भूत्वा स सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात् /
सहस्त्रबाहुः सर्वज्ञश्चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः //
text_mt: having become thousand-headed, thousand-eyed, thousand-footed, / thousand-armed, omniscient, meditated upon by the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
pītavāsā viśālākṣo nīlajimūtasannibhaḥ /
mahāvibhūtiryogātmā yogināṃ hṛdayālayaḥ //
meaning:
पीतवासा विशालाक्षो नीलजिमूतसन्निभः /
महाविभूतिर्योगात्मा योगिनां हृदयालयः //
text_mt: clad in yellow garments, large-eyed, resembling a dark raincloud, / possessed of great sovereign power, consisting of yoga, the dwelling within the heart of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācit tasya suptasya līlārthaṃ divyamadbhutam /
trailokyasāraṃ vimalaṃ nābhyāṃ paṅkajamudvabhau //
meaning:
कदाचित् तस्य सुप्तस्य लीलार्थं दिव्यमद्भुतम् /
त्रैलोक्यसारं विमलं नाभ्यां पङ्कजमुद्वभौ //
text_mt: Once, as he was sleeping, for the sake of sport, a celestial, wondrous, / spotless lotus arose from his navel, containing the essence of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham /
divyagandhamayaṃ puṇyaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam //
meaning:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् /
दिव्यगन्धमयं पुण्यं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम् //
text_mt: spanning a hundred yojanas, radiant like the morning sun, / filled with celestial fragrance, sacred, endowed with pericarp and filaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ vartamānasya śārṅgiṇaḥ /
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāṃstaṃ deśamupacakrame //
meaning:
तस्यैवं सुचिरं कालं वर्तमानस्य शार्ङ्गिणः /
हिरण्यगर्भो भगवांस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे //
text_mt: While the wielder of the Śārṅga bow was thus remaining for a very long time, / the blessed lord Hiraṇyagarbha approached that place.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taṃ kareṇa viśvātmā samutthāpya sanātanam /
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ māyayā tasya mohitaḥ //
meaning:
स तं करेण विश्वात्मा समुत्थाप्य सनातनम् /
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं मायया तस्य मोहितः //
text_mt: He, the soul of all, awakening that eternal one with his hand, / spoke sweet words, deluded by his illusory creative power:

sanskrit_iast:
asminnekārṇave ghore nirjane tamasāvṛte /
ekākī ko bhavāñchete brūhi me puruṣarṣabha //
meaning:
अस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे निर्जने तमसावृते /
एकाकी को भवाञ्छेते ब्रूहि मे पुरुषर्षभ //
text_mt: “In this terrible, solitary single ocean shrouded in darkness, / who are you who lie alone? Tell me, O bull among men!”

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vihasya garuḍadhvajaḥ /
uvāca devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विहस्य गरुडध्वजः /
उवाच देवं ब्रह्माणं मेघगम्भीरनिः स्वनः //
text_mt: Hearing his words, the god whose banner is Garuḍa smiled / and spoke to the god Brahmā with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayam /
mahāyogeśvaraṃ māṃ tvaṃ jānīhi puruṣottamam //
meaning:
भो भो नारायणं देवं लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययम् /
महायोगेश्वरं मां त्वं जानीहि पुरुषोत्तमम् //
text_mt: “O, know me to be the divine Nārāyaṇa, the source and dissolution of the worlds, / the great lord of yoga, the Supreme Spirit!

sanskrit_iast:
mayi paśya jagat kṛtsnaṃ tvāṃ ca lokapitāmaham /
saparvatamahādvīpaṃ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtam //
meaning:
मयि पश्य जगत् कृत्स्नं त्वां च लोकपितामहम् /
सपर्वतमहाद्वीपं समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृतम् //
text_mt: Behold in me the entire world and yourself, the grandfather of the worlds, / along with mountains and great continents, surrounded by the seven oceans!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamābhāṣya viścātmā provāca puruṣaṃ hariḥ /
jānannapi mahāyogī ko bhavāniti vedhasam //
meaning:
एवमाभाष्य विश्चात्मा प्रोवाच पुरुषं हरिः /
जानन्नपि महायोगी को भवानिति वेधसम् //
text_mt: Having addressed him thus, Hari, the soul of all, the great yogin, / although knowing, said to the creator, the Puruṣa: “Who are you?”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahasya bhagavān brahmā vedanidhiḥ prabhuḥ /
pratyuvācāmbujābhākṣaṃ sasmitaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā //
meaning:
ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदनिधिः प्रभुः /
प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजाभाक्षं सस्मितं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा //
text_mt: Then, laughing, the blessed lord Brahmā, the treasure of the Vedas, the sovereign, / replied to the lotus-eyed one with a smile and in polished speech:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ /
mayyeva saṃsthitaṃ viśvaṃ brahmāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ //
meaning:
अहं धाता विधाता च स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः /
मय्येव संस्थितं विश्वं ब्रह्माहं विश्वतोमुखः //
text_mt: “I am the creator and the disposer, the self-existent great-grandfather; / in me alone is the universe situated; I am Brahmā, facing in every direction.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vācaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ /
anujñāpyātha yogena praviṣṭo brahmaṇastanum //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाचं स भगवान् विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः /
अनुज्ञाप्याथ योगेन प्रविष्टो ब्रह्मणस्तनुम् //
text_mt: Hearing his speech, that blessed lord Viṣṇu of true prowess, / having asked permission, then entered the body of Brahmā by means of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tralokyametat sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam /
udare tasya devasya dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ //
meaning:
त्रलोक्यमेतत् सकलं सदेवासुरमानुषम् /
उदरे तस्य देवस्य दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागतः //
text_mt: Having seen in the belly of that god this entire threefold world / together with gods, asuras, and mortals, he came to astonishment.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāsya vaktrānniṣkramya pannagendraniketanaḥ /
ajātaśatrurbhagavān pitāmahamathābravīt //
meaning:
तदास्य वक्त्रान्निष्क्रम्य पन्नगेन्द्रनिकेतनः /
अजातशत्रुर्भगवान् पितामहमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then coming out from his mouth, the blessed one whose dwelling is the king of serpents, / who has no enemy born, spoke to the grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānapyevamevādya śāśvataṃ hi mamoharam /
praviśya lokān paśyaitān vicitrān puruṣarṣabha //
meaning:
भवानप्येवमेवाद्य शाश्वतं हि ममोहरम् /
प्रविश्य लोकान् पश्यैतान् विचित्रान् पुरुषर्षभ //
text_mt: “You too, in just the same way, enter this eternal belly of mine today / and behold these wondrous worlds, O bull among men!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahlādanīṃ vāṇī śrutvā tasyābhinandya ca /
śrīpaterudaraṃ bhūyaḥ praviveśa kuśadhvajaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रह्लादनीं वाणी श्रुत्वा तस्याभिनन्द्य च /
श्रीपतेरुदरं भूयः प्रविवेश कुशध्वजः //
text_mt: Then, having heard and welcomed his gladdening speech, / he whose banner is kuśa grass entered again the belly of the lord of Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
tāneva lokān garbhasthānapaśyat satyavikramaḥ /
paryaṭitvā tu devasya dadṛśe 'ntaṃ na vai hareḥ //
meaning:
तानेव लोकान् गर्भस्थानपश्यत् सत्यविक्रमः /
पर्यटित्वा तु देवस्य ददृशे ऽन्तं न वै हरेः //
text_mt: He of true valor beheld those very same worlds situated within the womb; / but having wandered through, he saw no end to the god Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni mahātmanā /
janārdanena brahmāsau nābhyāṃ dvāramavindata //
meaning:
ततो द्वाराणि सर्वाणि पिहितानि महात्मना /
जनार्दनेन ब्रह्मासौ नाभ्यां द्वारमविन्दत //
text_mt: Then all the openings were closed by the great-souled / Janārdana; that Brahmā found an opening in his navel.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yogabalenāsau praviśya kanakāṇḍajaḥ /
ujjahārātmano rūpaṃ puṣkarāccaturānanaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र योगबलेनासौ प्रविश्य कनकाण्डजः /
उज्जहारात्मनो रूपं पुष्कराच्चतुराननः //
text_mt:
Entering there by the power of yoga, he who was born of the golden egg,
the four-faced one, brought forth his form from the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
virarājāravindasthaḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ /
brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān jagadyoniḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
विरराजारविन्दस्थः पद्मगर्भसमद्युतिः /
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् जगद्योनिः पितामहः //
text_mt:
Seated upon the lotus, radiant as the interior of a lotus,
shone the lord Brahmā, the self-existent, the source of the universe, the grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
samanyamāno viśveśamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam /
provāca puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ meghagambhīrayā girā //
meaning:
समन्यमानो विश्वेशमात्मानं परमं पदम् /
प्रोवाच पुरुषं विष्णुं मेघगम्भीरया गिरा //
text_mt:
Considering himself to be the lord of all and the supreme abode,
he spoke to the person Viṣṇu in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatedānīmātmano jayakāṅkṣayā /
eko 'haṃ prabalo nānyo māṃ vai ko 'bibhaviṣyati //
meaning:
किं कृतं भवतेदानीमात्मनो जयकाङ्क्षया /
एको ऽहं प्रबलो नान्यो मां वै को ऽबिभविष्यति //
text_mt:
"What is this done by you now, desiring victory for yourself?
I alone am powerful, no one else; indeed, who shall overcome me?"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyaṃ brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ /
sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यं ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः /
सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं बभाषे मधुरं हरिः //
text_mt:
Hearing the words of Brahmā, the arranger of the worlds,
Nārāyaṇa, Hari, spoke this sweet speech preceded by conciliation:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavān dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ /
na mātsaryābhiyogena dvārāṇi pihitāni me //
meaning:
भवान् धाता विधाता च स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः /
न मात्सर्याभियोगेन द्वाराणि पिहितानि मे //
text_mt:
"You are the creator and ordainer, the self-existent great-grandfather;
my gates were not shut out of any resort to rivalry.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu līlārthamevaitanna tvāṃ bādhitumicchayā /
ko hi bādhitumanvicched devadevaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
किन्तु लीलार्थमेवैतन्न त्वां बाधितुमिच्छया /
को हि बाधितुमन्विच्छेद् देवदेवं पितामहम् //
text_mt:
Rather, this was only for the sake of sport, not with a desire to obstruct you;
for who would seek to obstruct the god of gods, the grandfather?

sanskrit_iast:
na te 'nyathāvagantavyaṃ mānyo me sarvathā bhavān /
sarvamanvaya kalyāṇaṃ yanmayāpahṛtaṃ tava //
meaning:
न ते ऽन्यथावगन्तव्यं मान्यो मे सर्वथा भवान् /
सर्वमन्वय कल्याणं यन्मयापहृतं तव //
text_mt:
You must not understand it otherwise; you are to be honored by me in every way.
Accept all well-being, whatever was taken from you by me.

sanskrit_iast:
asmācca kāraṇād brahman putro bhavatu me bhavān /
padmayoniriti khyāto matpriyārthaṃ jaganmaya //
meaning:
अस्माच्च कारणाद् ब्रह्मन् पुत्रो भवतु मे भवान् /
पद्मयोनिरिति ख्यातो मत्प्रियार्थं जगन्मय //
text_mt:
And for this reason, O Brahman, become my son,
famed as the lotus-born, for the sake of my pleasure, O you who embody the universe!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān devo varaṃ dattvā kirīṭine /
praharṣamatulaṃ gatvā punarviṣṇumabhāṣata //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् देवो वरं दत्त्वा किरीटिने /
प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा पुनर्विष्णुमभाषत //
text_mt:
Then that lord, the god, having granted a boon to the diadem-wearer,
and having experienced incomparable joy, spoke again to Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavān sarvātmako 'nantaḥ sarveṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ /
sarvabhūtāntarātmā vai paraṃ bahma sanātanam //
meaning:
भवान् सर्वात्मको ऽनन्तः सर्वेषां परमेश्वरः /
सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा वै परं बह्म सनातनम् //
text_mt:
"You are the self of all, infinite, the supreme lord of all,
the inner self of all beings, indeed the eternal supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ vai sarvalokānāmātmā lokamaheśvaraḥ /
manmayaṃ sarvamevedaṃ brahmāhaṃ puruṣaḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
अहं वै सर्वलोकानामात्मा लोकमहेश्वरः /
मन्मयं सर्वमेवेदं ब्रह्माहं पुरुषः परः //
text_mt:
I indeed am the self of all worlds, the great lord of the world;
all this is composed of me alone; I am Brahmā, the supreme person.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ /
ekā mūrtirdvidhā bhinnā nārāyaṇapitāmahau //
meaning:
नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः /
एका मूर्तिर्द्विधा भिन्ना नारायणपितामहौ //
text_mt:
For other than us two, there exists no supreme lord of the worlds;
one form is divided into two as Nārāyaṇa and the grandfather."

sanskrit_iast:
tenaivamukto brahmāṇaṃ vāsudevo 'bravīdidam /
iyaṃ pratijñā bhavato vināśāya bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तेनैवमुक्तो ब्रह्माणं वासुदेवो ऽब्रवीदिदम् /
इयं प्रतिज्ञा भवतो विनाशाय भविष्यति //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by him, Vāsudeva said this to Brahmā:
"This declaration of yours will lead to your destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam /
pradhānapuruṣeśānaṃ vedāhaṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
किं न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम् /
प्रधानपुरुषेशानं वेदाहं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Do you not see the lord of yoga, the imperishable master of Brahman,
the ruler of primordial matter and spirit? I know the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ na paśyanti yogīndrāḥ sāṃkhyā api maheśvaram /
anādinidhanaṃ brahma tameva śaraṇaṃ vraja //
meaning:
यं न पश्यन्ति योगीन्द्राः सांख्या अपि महेश्वरम् /
अनादिनिधनं ब्रह्म तमेव शरणं व्रज //
text_mt:
Whom even the chiefs of yogins and the Sāṃkhyas do not see, the great lord,
the Brahman without beginning or end—go to him alone for refuge!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kruddho 'mbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā provāca keśavam /
bhavān na nūnamātmānaṃ vetti tat paramakṣaram //
meaning:
ततः क्रुद्धो ऽम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच केशवम् /
भवान् न नूनमात्मानं वेत्ति तत् परमक्षरम् //
text_mt:
Then Brahmā, angered, spoke to lotus-eyed Keśava:
"Surely you do not know yourself, that supreme imperishable [reality],

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmekamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam /
nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं जगतामेकमात्मानं परमं पदम् /
नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः //
text_mt:
Brahmā, the single self of the worlds, the supreme abode;
for other than us two, there exists no supreme lord of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtyajya nidrāṃ vipulāṃ svamātmānaṃ vilokaya /
tasya tat krodhajaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurabhāṣata //
meaning:
संत्यज्य निद्रां विपुलां स्वमात्मानं विलोकय /
तस्य तत् क्रोधजं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विष्णुरभाषत //
text_mt:
Abandoning this immense sleep, behold your own self!"
Hearing that speech of his born of anger, Viṣṇu spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇa parivādaṃ mahātmanaḥ /
na me 'styaviditaṃ brahman nānyathāhaṃ vadāmite //
meaning:
मा मैवं वद कल्याण परिवादं महात्मनः /
न मे ऽस्त्यविदितं ब्रह्मन् नान्यथाहं वदामिते //
text_mt:
"Do not, do not speak thus, O auspicious one, slander of that great soul!
There is nothing unknown to me, O Brahman; I do not speak falsely to you.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu mohayati brahman bhavantaṃ pārameśvarī /
māyāśeṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ heturātmasamudbhāvā //
meaning:
किन्तु मोहयति ब्रह्मन् भवन्तं पारमेश्वरी /
मायाशेषविशेषाणां हेतुरात्मसमुद्भावा //
text_mt:
Rather, O Brahman, the supreme lord's illusory creative power bewilders you—
sprung from himself, the cause of all particular distinctions."

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā bhagavān viṣṇustūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha /
jñātvā tat paramaṃ tattvaṃ svamātmānaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विष्णुस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह /
ज्ञात्वा तत् परमं तत्त्वं स्वमात्मानं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Having spoken this much, the lord Viṣṇu became silent,
knowing that supreme reality, his own self, the great lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kuto 'pyaparimeyātmā bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ /
prasādaṃ brahmaṇe kartuṃ prādurāsīt tato haraḥ //
meaning:
कुतो ऽप्यपरिमेयात्मा भूतानां परमेश्वरः /
प्रसादं ब्रह्मणे कर्तुं प्रादुरासीत् ततो हरः //
text_mt:
Then, from somewhere, Hara, of immeasurable soul, the supreme lord of beings,
manifested in order to bestow grace upon Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭanayano 'nanto jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ /
triśūlapāṇirbhagavāṃstejasāṃ paramo nidhiḥ //
meaning:
ललाटनयनो ऽनन्तो जटामण्डलमण्डितः /
त्रिशूलपाणिर्भगवांस्तेजसां परमो निधिः //
text_mt:
Having an eye on his forehead, infinite, adorned with a mass of matted hair,
holding a trident in hand, the lord, the supreme treasury of splendors,

sanskrit_iast:
divyāṃ viśālāṃ grathitāṃ grahaiḥ sārkendutārakaiḥ /
mālāmatyadbhutākārāṃ dhārayan pādalambinīm //
meaning:
दिव्यां विशालां ग्रथितां ग्रहैः सार्केन्दुतारकैः /
मालामत्यद्भुताकारां धारयन् पादलम्बिनीम् //
text_mt:
Wearing a divine, vast garland of wondrous form hanging down to his feet,
strung with the planets together with the sun, moon, and stars.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamīśānaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
mohito māyayātyarthaṃ pītavāsasamabvīt //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवमीशानं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
मोहितो माययात्यर्थं पीतवाससमब्वीत् //
text_mt:
Seeing that god, the ruler, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds,
extremely bewildered by illusory creative power, spoke to the one clad in yellow:

sanskrit_iast:
ka eṣa puruṣo 'nantaḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ /
tejorāśirameyātmā samāyāti janārdana //
meaning:
क एष पुरुषो ऽनन्तः शूलपाणिस्त्रिलोचनः /
तेजोराशिरमेयात्मा समायाति जनार्दन //
text_mt:
"Who is this person, infinite, trident-handed, three-eyed,
a mass of splendor, of immeasurable soul, who is approaching, O Janārdana?"

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurdānavamardanaḥ /
apaśyadīśvaraṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ vimale 'mbhasi //
meaning:
तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विष्णुर्दानवमर्दनः /
अपश्यदीश्वरं देवं ज्वलन्तं विमले ऽम्भसि //
text_mt:
Hearing those words of his, Viṣṇu, crusher of the demons,
saw the god, the lord, blazing in the pure water.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā tatparamaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ brahmabhāvanam /
provācotthāya bhagavān devadevaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा तत्परमं भावमैश्वरं ब्रह्मभावनम् /
प्रोवाचोत्थाय भगवान् देवदेवं पितामहम् //
text_mt:
Knowing that supreme state belonging to the lord, productive of Brahman,
the lord, rising up, spoke to the god of gods, the grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ /
anādinidhano 'cintyo lokānāmīśvaro mahān //
meaning:
अयं देवो महादेवः स्वयञ्ज्योतिः सनातनः /
अनादिनिधनो ऽचिन्त्यो लोकानामीश्वरो महान् //
text_mt:
"This god is Mahādeva, self-luminous, eternal,
without beginning or end, inconceivable, the great lord of the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaraḥ śaṃbhurīśānaḥ sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ /
bhūtānāmadhipo yogī maheśo vimalaḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्करः शंभुरीशानः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः /
भूतानामधिपो योगी महेशो विमलः शिवः //
text_mt:
Śaṅkara, Śambhu, Īśāna, the self of all, the supreme lord,
the sovereign of beings, the yogin, Maheśa, the spotless Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ /
yaṃ prapaśyanti yatayo brahmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ //
meaning:
एष धाता विधाता च प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः /
यं प्रपश्यन्ति यतयो ब्रह्मभावेन भाविताः //
text_mt:
He is the creator and ordainer, the ruler of primordial matter and spirit,
whom ascetics perceive when imbued with the state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjatyeṣa jagat kṛtsnaṃ pāti saṃharate tathā /
kālo bhūtvā mahādevaḥ kevalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
सृजत्येष जगत् कृत्स्नं पाति संहरते तथा /
कालो भूत्वा महादेवः केवलो निष्कलः शिवः //
text_mt:
He creates the entire universe, protects [it], and likewise withdraws [it],
becoming Time, Mahādeva, the solitary, partless Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe pūrvaṃ bhavantaṃ yaḥ sanātanaḥ /
vedāṃśca pradadau tubhyaṃ so 'yamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं विदधे पूर्वं भवन्तं यः सनातनः /
वेदांश्च प्रददौ तुभ्यं सो ऽयमायाति शङ्करः //
text_mt:
He who, eternal, created you as Brahmā in the beginning
and gave the Vedas to you, that Śaṅkara is this one who approaches.

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva cāparāṃ mūrti viśvayoniṃ sanātanīm /
vāsudevābhidhānāṃ māmavehi prapitāmaha //
meaning:
अस्यैव चापरां मूर्ति विश्वयोनिं सनातनीम् /
वासुदेवाभिधानां मामवेहि प्रपितामह //
text_mt:
And know me, who bear the name Vāsudeva,
to be another eternal form of his, the womb of the universe, O great-grandfather!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam /
divyaṃ bhavatu te cakṣuryena drakṣyasi tatparam //
meaning:
किं न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम् /
दिव्यं भवतु ते चक्षुर्येन द्रक्ष्यसि तत्परम् //
text_mt:
Do you not see the lord of yoga, the imperishable master of Brahman?
May you have a divine eye, by which you will behold that supreme [reality]."

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvā śaivaṃ tadā cakṣurviṣṇorlokapitāmahaḥ /
bubudhe parameśānaṃ purataḥ samavasthitam //
meaning:
लब्ध्वा शैवं तदा चक्षुर्विष्णोर्लोकपितामहः /
बुबुधे परमेशानं पुरतः समवस्थितम् //
text_mt:
Having then received that divine eye of Śiva from Viṣṇu, the grandfather of the worlds
perceived the supreme sovereign standing before him.

sanskrit_iast:
sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānamaiśvaraṃ prapitāmahaḥ /
prapede śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tameva pitaraṃ śivam //
meaning:
स लब्ध्वा परमं ज्ञानमैश्वरं प्रपितामहः /
प्रपेदे शरणं देवं तमेव पितरं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Having obtained supreme knowledge pertaining to the lord, the great-grandfather
went for refuge to that very god, his father Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā /
atharvaśirasā devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्कारं समनुस्मृत्य संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना /
अथर्वशिरसा देवं तुष्टाव च कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt:
Remembering the sacred syllable Om, steadying himself by himself,
he praised the god with the Atharvaśiras, his hands folded in reverence.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstutastena bhagavān brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ /
avāpa paramāṃ prītiṃ vyājahāra smayanniva //
meaning:
संस्तुतस्तेन भगवान् ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरः /
अवाप परमां प्रीतिं व्याजहार स्मयन्निव //
text_mt:
Praised thus by that Brahmā, the lord, the supreme lord,
attained supreme pleasure and spoke as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
matsamastvaṃ na saṃdeho madbhaktaśca yato bhavān /
mayaivotpāditaḥ pūrvaṃ lokasṛṣṭyarthamavyayam //
meaning:
मत्समस्त्वं न संदेहो मद्भक्तश्च यतो भवान् /
मयैवोत्पादितः पूर्वं लोकसृष्ट्यर्थमव्ययम् //
text_mt:
"You are equal to me, there is no doubt, and since you are devoted to me,
you were produced by me alone previously for the sake of the imperishable creation of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamātmā hyādipuruṣo mama dehasamudbhavaḥ /
varaṃ varaya viśvātman varado 'haṃ tavānagha //
meaning:
त्वमात्मा ह्यादिपुरुषो मम देहसमुद्भवः /
वरं वरय विश्वात्मन् वरदो ऽहं तवानघ //
text_mt:
You indeed are the self, the primeval person, born from my body;
choose a boon, O universal self! I am the giver of boons to you, O sinless one."

sanskrit_iast:
sa devadevavacanaṃ niśamya kamalodbhavaḥ /
nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ praṇamyāha vṛṣadhvajam //
meaning:
स देवदेववचनं निशम्य कमलोद्भवः /
निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं पुरुषं प्रणम्याह वृषध्वजम् //
text_mt:
Hearing the words of the god of gods, the lotus-born one,
having looked at the person Viṣṇu, bowed and spoke to the bull-bannered one:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mahādevāmbikāpate /
tvāmeva putramicchāmi tvayā vā sadṛśaṃ satam //
meaning:
भगवन् भूतभव्येश महादेवाम्बिकापते /
त्वामेव पुत्रमिच्छामि त्वया वा सदृशं सतम् //
text_mt:
"O Lord, ruler of past and future, Mahādeva, consort of Ambikā,
I desire you alone as a son, or one who is always equal to you.

sanskrit_iast:
mohito 'smi mahādeva māyayā sūkṣmayā tvayā /
na jāne paramaṃ bhāvaṃ yāthātathyena te śiva //
meaning:
मोहितो ऽस्मि महादेव मायया सूक्ष्मया त्वया /
न जाने परमं भावं याथातथ्येन ते शिव //
text_mt:
I have been bewildered, O Mahādeva, by your subtle illusory creative power;
I do not know your supreme state in truth, O Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva deva bhaktānāṃ bhrātā mātā pitā suhṛt /
prasīda tava pādābjaṃ namāmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
त्वमेव देव भक्तानां भ्राता माता पिता सुहृत् /
प्रसीद तव पादाब्जं नमामि शरणं गतः //
text_mt:
You alone, O god, are brother, mother, father, and friend to devotees;
be gracious! I bow to your lotus feet, having approached for refuge."

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jagannātho vṛṣadhvajaḥ /
vyājahāra tadā putraṃ samālokya janārdanam //
meaning:
स तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा जगन्नाथो वृषध्वजः /
व्याजहार तदा पुत्रं समालोक्य जनार्दनम् //
text_mt:
Hearing his words, the bull-bannered lord of the world,
looking upon Janārdana, then spoke to his son:

sanskrit_iast:
yadarthitaṃ bhagavatā tat kariṣyāmi putraka /
vijñānamaiśvaraṃ divyamutpatsyati tavānagha //
meaning:
यदर्थितं भगवता तत् करिष्यामि पुत्रक /
विज्ञानमैश्वरं दिव्यमुत्पत्स्यति तवानघ //
text_mt:
"What has been requested by the lord, that I shall do, my son;
divine knowledge of the lord will arise in you, O sinless one."

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva sarvabhūtānāmādikartā niyojitaḥ /
tathā kuruṣva deveśa mayā lokapitāmaha //
meaning:
त्वमेव सर्वभूतानामादिकर्ता नियोजितः /
तथा कुरुष्व देवेश मया लोकपितामह //
text_mt: “You alone are appointed as the primordial maker of all living beings; / act accordingly, O lord of the gods, grandfather of the worlds, through me.”

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa nārāyaṇo 'nanto mamaiva paramā tanuḥ /
bhaviṣyati taveśāno yogakṣemavaho hariḥ //
meaning:
एष नारायणो ऽनन्तो ममैव परमा तनुः /
भविष्यति तवेशानो योगक्षेमवहो हरिः //
text_mt: This Nārāyaṇa, the infinite, is my own supreme body; / Hari will be your master, providing what is needed and preserving what is acquired.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyāhṛtya hastābhyāṃ prītātmā parameśvaraḥ /
saṃspṛśya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ hariṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
एवं व्याहृत्य हस्ताभ्यां प्रीतात्मा परमेश्वरः /
संस्पृश्य देवं ब्रह्माणं हरिं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Supreme Lord, pleased in spirit, / touched the god Brahmā with both hands and spoke a word to Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣṭo 'smi sarvathāhante bhaktyā tava jaganmaya /
varaṃ vṛṇīṣvaṃ nahyāvāṃ vibhinnau paramārthataḥ //
meaning:
तृष्टो ऽस्मि सर्वथाहन्ते भक्त्या तव जगन्मय /
वरं वृणीष्वं नह्यावां विभिन्नौ परमार्थतः //
text_mt: "I am entirely pleased with you, with your devotion, O you whose nature is the universe! / Choose a boon; for we two are not different in absolute reality."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvātha devavacanaṃ viṣṇurviśvajaganmayaḥ /
prāha prasannayā vācā samālokya caturmukham //
meaning:
श्रुत्वाथ देववचनं विष्णुर्विश्वजगन्मयः /
प्राह प्रसन्नया वाचा समालोक्य चतुर्मुखम् //
text_mt: Then, hearing the god's word, Viṣṇu, whose nature is the universal world, / looking at the four-faced [Brahmā], said with a pleased voice:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva varaḥ śloghyo yadahaṃ parameśvaram /
paśyāmi paramātmānaṃ bhaktirbhavatu me tvayi //
meaning:
एष एव वरः श्लोघ्यो यदहं परमेश्वरम् /
पश्यामि परमात्मानं भक्तिर्भवतु मे त्वयि //
text_mt: "This indeed is the praiseworthy boon: that I behold the Supreme Lord, / the supreme self; let me have devotion to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ punarviṣṇumabhāṣata /
bhavān sarvasya kāryasya kartāha'madhidaivatam //
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवः पुनर्विष्णुमभाषत /
भवान् सर्वस्य कार्यस्य कर्ताहऽमधिदैवतम् //
text_mt: Saying "So be it!", Mahādeva spoke again to Viṣṇu: / "You are the maker of every effect, and I am the presiding deity.

sanskrit_iast:
manmayaṃ tvanmayaṃ caiva sarvametanna saṃśayaḥ /
bhavān somastvahaṃ sūryo bhavān rātrirahaṃ dinam //
meaning:
मन्मयं त्वन्मयं चैव सर्वमेतन्न संशयः /
भवान् सोमस्त्वहं सूर्यो भवान् रात्रिरहं दिनम् //
text_mt: All this consists of me and consists of you, no doubt; / you are Soma and I am Sūrya, you are night and I am day.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavān prakṛtiravyaktamahaṃ puruṣa eva ca /
bhavān jñānamahaṃ jñātā bhavān māyāhamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
भवान् प्रकृतिरव्यक्तमहं पुरुष एव च /
भवान् ज्ञानमहं ज्ञाता भवान् मायाहमीश्वरः //
text_mt: You are unmanifest primordial matter and I am the spirit; / you are knowledge and I am the knower, you are illusory creative power and I am the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavān vidyātmikā śaktiḥ śaktimānahamīśvaraḥ /
yo 'haṃ suniṣkalo devaḥ so 'pi nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
भवान् विद्यात्मिका शक्तिः शक्तिमानहमीश्वरः /
यो ऽहं सुनिष्कलो देवः सो ऽपि नारायणः परः //
text_mt: You are the power whose nature is wisdom, and I am the Lord possessing power; / that which I, the god entirely without parts, am, is also the supreme Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ekībhāvena paśyanti yogino brahmavādinaḥ /
tvāmanāśritya viśvātman na yogī māmupaiṣyati /
pālayaitajjagat kṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam //
meaning:
एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति योगिनो ब्रह्मवादिनः /
त्वामनाश्रित्य विश्वात्मन् न योगी मामुपैष्यति /
पालयैतज्जगत् कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् //
text_mt: Yogins who proclaim Brahman see us as one; / without resorting to you, O soul of the universe, no yogin will attain me. / Protect this entire world, along with gods, asuras, and mortals."

sanskrit_iast:
itīdamuktvā bhagavānanādiḥ
svamāyayā mohitabhūtabhedaḥ /
jagāma janmardhivināśahīnaṃ
dhāmaikamavyaktamanantaśaktiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इतीदमुक्त्वा भगवाननादिः
स्वमायया मोहितभूतभेदः /
जगाम जन्मर्धिविनाशहीनं
धामैकमव्यक्तमनन्तशक्तिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे नवमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken this, the beginningless Lord, / who bewilders the diverse beings through his illusory creative power, / went to that single, unmanifest abode, free of birth, growth, and destruction, / he of infinite power.

Thus ends the ninth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
gate maheśvare deve svādhivāsaṃ pitāmahaḥ /
tadeva sumahat padmaṃ bheje nābhisamutthitam //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
गते महेश्वरे देवे स्वाधिवासं पितामहः /
तदेव सुमहत् पद्मं भेजे नाभिसमुत्थितम् //
text_mt: The holy Kūrma said: / When the god Maheśvara had departed to his own abode, the Grandfather / took recourse to that very immense lotus risen from the navel.

sanskrit_iast:
atha dīrgheṇa kālena tatrāpratimapauruṣau /
mahāsurau samāyātau bhrātarau madhukaiṭabhau //
meaning:
अथ दीर्घेण कालेन तत्राप्रतिमपौरुषौ /
महासुरौ समायातौ भ्रातरौ मधुकैटभौ //
text_mt: Then after a long time, two great asuras of incomparable valor, / the brothers Madhu and Kaiṭabha, arrived there,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhena mahatāviṣṭau mahāparvatavigrahau /
karṇāntarasamudbhūtau devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ //
meaning:
क्रोधेन महताविष्टौ महापर्वतविग्रहौ /
कर्णान्तरसमुद्भूतौ देवदेवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः //
text_mt: possessed of great wrath, with bodies like great mountains, / born from the ear-cavity of the bow-wielding god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvāgatau samīkṣyāha nārāyaṇamajo vibhuḥ /
trailokyakaṇṭakāvetāvasurau hantumarhasi //
meaning:
तावागतौ समीक्ष्याह नारायणमजो विभुः /
त्रैलोक्यकण्टकावेतावसुरौ हन्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Beholding those two arrived, the unborn, all-pervading [Brahmā] said to Nārāyaṇa: / "You ought to slay these two asuras, thorns to the three worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ /
ājñāpayāmāsa tayorvadhārthaṃ puruṣāvubhau //
meaning:
तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः /
आज्ञापयामास तयोर्वधार्थं पुरुषावुभौ //
text_mt: Hearing that word of his, the Lord Hari Nārāyaṇa / commanded two men for the destruction of the two.

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayā mahadyuddhaṃ tayostābhyāmabhūd dvijāḥ /
vyanayat kaiṭabhaṃ viṣṇurjiṣṇuśca vyanayanmadhum //
meaning:
तदाज्ञया महद्युद्धं तयोस्ताभ्यामभूद् द्विजाः /
व्यनयत् कैटभं विष्णुर्जिष्णुश्च व्यनयन्मधुम् //
text_mt: By his command, a great battle took place between the two pairs, O twice-born; / Viṣṇu destroyed Kaiṭabha, and Jiṣṇu destroyed Madhu.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ padmāsanāsīnaṃ jagannāthaṃ pitāmaham /
babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ snehāviṣṭamanā hariḥ //
meaning:
ततः पद्मासनासीनं जगन्नाथं पितामहम् /
बभाषे मधुरं वाक्यं स्नेहाविष्टमना हरिः //
text_mt: Then, with his mind filled with affection, Hari spoke sweet words / to the Grandfather, the lord of the world seated on the lotus-seat:

sanskrit_iast:
asmānmayocyamānastvaṃ padmādavatara prabho /
nāhaṃ bhavantaṃ śaknomi voḍhuṃ tejāmayaṃ gurum //
meaning:
अस्मान्मयोच्यमानस्त्वं पद्मादवतर प्रभो /
नाहं भवन्तं शक्नोमि वोढुं तेजामयं गुरुम् //
text_mt: "Addressed by me, descend from this lotus, O Lord! / I am unable to bear you, heavy and made of splendor."

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'vatīrya viśvātmā dehamāviśya cakriṇaḥ /
avāca vaiṣṇavīṃ nidrāmekībhūyātha viṣṇunā //
meaning:
ततो ऽवतीर्य विश्वात्मा देहमाविश्य चक्रिणः /
अवाच वैष्णवीं निद्रामेकीभूयाथ विष्णुना //
text_mt: Then, descending, the soul of the universe, entering the body of the discus-bearer, / entered Vaiṣṇavī sleep, having become united with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
sahastraśīrṣanayanaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ /
brahmā nārāyaṇākhyo 'sau suṣvāpa salile tadā //
meaning:
सहस्त्रशीर्षनयनः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः /
ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यो ऽसौ सुष्वाप सलिले तदा //
text_mt: With a thousand heads and eyes, holding conch, discus, and mace, / that Brahmā, named Nārāyaṇa, then slept upon the water.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'nubhūya ciraṃ kālamānandaṃ paramātmanaḥ /
anādyanantamadvaitaṃ svātmānaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
सो ऽनुभूय चिरं कालमानन्दं परमात्मनः /
अनाद्यनन्तमद्वैतं स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: Experiencing for a long time the bliss of the supreme self, / beginningless, endless, non-dual, his own self termed Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhāte yogātmā bhūtvā devaścaturmukhaḥ /
sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रभाते योगात्मा भूत्वा देवश्चतुर्मुखः /
ससर्ज सृष्टिं तद्रूपां वैष्णवं भावमाश्रितः //
text_mt: then at dawn, having become yogic in soul, the four-faced god, / adopting the Vaiṣṇava state, emitted creation corresponding to that form.

sanskrit_iast:
purastādasṛjad devaḥ sanandaṃ sanakaṃ tathā /
ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca purvajaṃ taṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
पुरस्तादसृजद् देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा /
ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च पुर्वजं तं सनातनम् //
text_mt: First the god created Sananda, as well as Sanaka, / Ṛbhu, and Sanatkumāra, that first-born eternal one.

sanskrit_iast:
te dvandvamohanirmuktāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ /
viditvā paramaṃ bhāvaṃ na sṛṣṭau dadhire matim //
meaning:
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ताः परं वैराग्यमास्थिताः /
विदित्वा परमं भावं न सृष्टौ दधिरे मतिम् //
text_mt: Freed from the delusion of dualities, settled in supreme dispassion, / having known the supreme state, they did not direct their minds toward creation.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau pitāmahaḥ /
babhūva naṣṭacetā vai māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ पितामहः /
बभूव नष्टचेता वै मायया परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: When they were thus indifferent to the creation of the worlds, the Grandfather / indeed became bewildered in mind through the illusory creative power of the Supreme Being.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ purāṇapuruṣo jaganmūrtirjanārdanaḥ /
vyājahārātmanaḥ putraṃ mohanāśāya padmajam //
meaning:
ततः पुराणपुरुषो जगन्मूर्तिर्जनार्दनः /
व्याजहारात्मनः पुत्रं मोहनाशाय पद्मजम् //
text_mt: Then the ancient Spirit, Janārdana, whose form is the world, / spoke to his son, the lotus-born, for the destruction of his delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuruvāca
kaccinna vismṛto devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ sanātanaḥ /
yaduktavānātmano 'sau putratve tava śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुरुवाच
कच्चिन्न विस्मृतो देवः शूलपाणिः सनातनः /
यदुक्तवानात्मनो ऽसौ पुत्रत्वे तव शङ्करः //
text_mt: Viṣṇu said: / "Has the eternal god, bearer of the spear in hand, not been remembered, / that which Śaṅkara said concerning his becoming your son?"

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya saṃjñāṃ govindāt padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ /
prajāḥ straṣṭumanāstepe tapaḥ paramaduścaram //
meaning:
अवाप्य संज्ञां गोविन्दात् पद्मयोनिः पितामहः /
प्रजाः स्त्रष्टुमनास्तेपे तपः परमदुश्चरम् //
text_mt: Having regained consciousness from Govinda, the Grandfather, born of the lotus, / desirous of creating creatures, performed extremely arduous asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiñcit samavartata /
tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥ khāt krodho 'bhyajāyata //
meaning:
तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किञ्चित् समवर्तत /
ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुः खात् क्रोधो ऽभ्यजायत //
text_mt: As he was performing asceticism in this manner, nothing occurred; / then, after a long time, out of distress, wrath arose [in him].

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ /
tatastebhyo 'śrubindubhyo bhūtāḥ pretāstathābhavan //
meaning:
क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः /
ततस्तेभ्यो ऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो भूताः प्रेतास्तथाभवन् //
text_mt: From the eyes of [Brahmā] possessed of wrath, tear-drops fell; / then from those tear-drops, ghosts and spirits came to be.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṃstānaśrujān dṛṣṭvā brahmātmānamanindana /
jahau prāṇāṃśca bhagavān krodhāviṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वांस्तानश्रुजान् दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दन /
जहौ प्राणांश्च भगवान् क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Seeing all those born of tears, Brahmā blamed himself, / and the Lord Prajāpati, possessed of wrath, gave up his life-breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prāṇamayo rudraḥ prādurasīt prabhīrmukhāt /
sahastrādityasaṃkāśo yugāntadahanopamaḥ //
meaning:
तदा प्राणमयो रुद्रः प्रादुरसीत् प्रभीर्मुखात् /
सहस्त्रादित्यसंकाशो युगान्तदहनोपमः //
text_mt: Then the radiant Rudra, consisting of the life-breath, manifested from his mouth, / resembling a thousand suns, like the fire at the end of the cosmic age.

sanskrit_iast:
ruroda susvaraṃ ghoraṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ /
rodamānaṃ tato brahmā mā rodīrityabhāṣata /
rodanād rudra ityevaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
रुरोद सुस्वरं घोरं देवदेवः स्वयं शिवः /
रोदमानं ततो ब्रह्मा मा रोदीरित्यभाषत /
रोदनाद् रुद्र इत्येवं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: The god of gods, Śiva himself, cried with a loud, terrible sound; / to the crying one, Brahmā then said: "Do not cry! / Because of crying (rodana), you will attain fame in the world as Rudra."

sanskrit_iast:
anyāni sapta nāmāni patnīḥ putrāṃścaśāśvatān /
sthānāni caiṣāmaṣṭānāṃ dadau lokapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यानि सप्त नामानि पत्नीः पुत्रांश्चशाश्वतान् /
स्थानानि चैषामष्टानां ददौ लोकपितामहः //
text_mt: The Grandfather of the world assigned [him] seven other names, / wives, eternal sons, and the seats of these eight.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaḥ śarvastatheśānaḥ paśūnāṃ patireva ca /
bhīmaścogro mahādevastāni nāmāni sapta vai //
meaning:
भवः शर्वस्तथेशानः पशूनां पतिरेव च /
भीमश्चोग्रो महादेवस्तानि नामानि सप्त वै //
text_mt: Bhava, Śarva, likewise Īśāna, and the Lord of Cattle (Paśupati), / Bhīma, and Ugra, [and] Mahādeva—these indeed are the seven names.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryo jalaṃ mahī vahnirvāyurākāśameva ca /
dīkṣito brāhmaṇaścandra ityetā aṣṭamūrtayaḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यो जलं मही वह्निर्वायुराकाशमेव च /
दीक्षितो ब्राह्मणश्चन्द्र इत्येता अष्टमूर्तयः //
text_mt: The sun, water, the earth, fire, air, and ether, / the initiated priest, and the moon—thus are the eight forms.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāneṣveteṣu ye rudraṃ dhyāyanti praṇamanti ca /
teṣāmaṣṭatanurdevo dadāti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
स्थानेष्वेतेषु ये रुद्रं ध्यायन्ति प्रणमन्ति च /
तेषामष्टतनुर्देवो ददाति परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Those who meditate on Rudra and bow down to him in these seats— / to them the god of eight forms gives the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarcalā tathaivomā vikeśī ca tathā śivā /
svāhā diśaśca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ceti patnayaḥ //
meaning:
सुवर्चला तथैवोमा विकेशी च तथा शिवा /
स्वाहा दिशश्च दीक्षा च रोहिणी चेति पत्नयः //
text_mt: Suvarcalā, likewise Umā, Vikeśī, and Śivā, / Svāhā, the directions, Dīkṣā, and Rohiṇī—these are the wives.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścarastathā śukro lohitāṅgo manojavaḥ /
skandaḥ sargo 'tha santāno budhaścaiṣāṃ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरस्तथा शुक्रो लोहिताङ्गो मनोजवः /
स्कन्दः सर्गो ऽथ सन्तानो बुधश्चैषां सुताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Śanaiścara, likewise Śukra, Lohitāṅga, Manojava, / Skanda, Sarga, Santāna, and Budha are recalled as their sons.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃprakāro bhagavān devadevo maheśvaraḥ /
prajādharmaṃ ca kāma ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
एवंप्रकारो भगवान् देवदेवो महेश्वरः /
प्रजाधर्मं च काम च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमाश्रितः //
text_mt: Of such nature, the Lord, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / abandoning the duty of procreation and desire, resorted to dispassion,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyādhya cātmānamaiśvaraṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ /
pītvā tadakṣaraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ paramāmṛtam //
meaning:
आत्मन्याध्य चात्मानमैश्वरं भावमास्थितः /
पीत्वा तदक्षरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं परमामृतम् //
text_mt: establishing the self in the self and adopting the sovereign state, / having drunk that imperishable Brahman, the eternal supreme nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāḥ sṛjeti cādiṣṭo brahmaṇā nīlalohitaḥ /
svātmanā sadṛśān rudrān sasarja manasā śivaḥ //
meaning:
प्रजाः सृजेति चादिष्टो ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः /
स्वात्मना सदृशान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः //
text_mt: Instructed by Brahmā, "Create creatures!", Nīlalohita, / Śiva, created with his mind Rudras equal to himself:

sanskrit_iast:
kapardino nirātaṅkān nīlakaṇṭhān pinākinaḥ /
triśūlahastānṛṣṭighnān mahānandāṃstrilocanān //
meaning:
कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कान् नीलकण्ठान् पिनाकिनः /
त्रिशूलहस्तानृष्टिघ्नान् महानन्दांस्त्रिलोचनान् //
text_mt: bearing matted hair, free from fear, blue-throated, wielding bows, / with tridents in hand, striking with spears, of great joy, three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
jarāmaraṇanirmuktān mahāvṛṣabhavāhanān /
vītarāgāṃśca sarvajñān koṭikoṭiśatān prabhuḥ //
meaning:
जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् महावृषभवाहनान् /
वीतरागांश्च सर्वज्ञान् कोटिकोटिशतान् प्रभुः //
text_mt: freed from old age and death, riding on great bulls, / free of passion, and omniscient—hundreds of millions upon millions [did] the Lord [create].

sanskrit_iast:
tān dṛṣṭvā vividhān rudrāna nirmalān nīlalohitān /
jarāmaraṇanirmuktān vyājaharā haraṃ guruḥ //
meaning:
तान् दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान निर्मलान् नीललोहितान् /
जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् व्याजहरा हरं गुरुः //
text_mt: Seeing those diverse Rudras, spotless, blue-and-red, / and free from old age and death, the Teacher spoke to Hara:

sanskrit_iast:
mā strākṣīrīdṛśīrdeva prajā mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ /
anyāḥ sṛjasva bhūteśa janmamṛtyusamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
मा स्त्राक्षीरीदृशीर्देव प्रजा मृत्युविवर्जिताः /
अन्याः सृजस्व भूतेश जन्ममृत्युसमन्विताः //
text_mt: “O God, do not create such beings devoid of death! / Create others, Lord of beings, endowed with birth and death!”

sanskrit_iast:
tatastamāha bhagavān kaparde kāmaśāsanaḥ /
nāsti me tādṛśaḥ sargaḥ sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तमाह भगवान् कपर्दे कामशासनः /
नास्ति मे तादृशः सर्गः सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: Then the Blessed Lord of matted hair, the punisher of Kāma, said to him: / “Such a creation is not mine. You create the inauspicious subjects!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti devo 'sau na prasūte 'śubhāḥ prajāḥ /
svātmajaireva tai rudrairnivṛttātmā hyatiṣṭhata /
sthāṇutvaṃ tena tasyāsīd devadevasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति देवो ऽसौ न प्रसूते ऽशुभाः प्रजाः /
स्वात्मजैरेव तै रुद्रैर्निवृत्तात्मा ह्यतिष्ठत /
स्थाणुत्वं तेन तस्यासीद् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt: From that time forth, that God produced no inauspicious beings; / with those Rudras who were his own sons, he remained withdrawn within himself. / Therefore arose the condition of being Sthāṇu (the Motionless) for that God of gods bearing the trident.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ /
straṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbodho hyadhiṣṭhātṛtvameva ca //
meaning:
ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं तपः सत्यं क्षमा धृतिः /
स्त्रष्टृत्वमात्मसंबोधो ह्यधिष्ठातृत्वमेव च //
text_mt: Knowledge, dispassion, sovereignty, asceticism, truth, forbearance, steadfastness, / creative power, self-awareness, and overlordship indeed—

sanskrit_iast:
avyayāni daśaitāni nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti śaṅkare /
sa eva śaṅkaraḥ sākṣāt pinākī parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अव्ययानि दशैतानि नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति शङ्करे /
स एव शङ्करः साक्षात् पिनाकी परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: these ten imperishable qualities constantly reside in Śaṅkara. / He is indeed Śaṅkara directly, the wielder of the Pināka, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā vīkṣya devaṃ trilocanam /
sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ prītivisphārilocanaḥ //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा वीक्ष्य देवं त्रिलोचनम् /
सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैः प्रीतिविस्फारिलोचनः //
text_mt: Then the Blessed Lord Brahmā, beholding the three-eyed God / together with his own mind-born sons, his eyes expanding with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā parataraṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā /
tuṣṭāva jagatāmekaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा परतरं भावमैश्वरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा /
तुष्टाव जगतामेकं कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम् //
text_mt: having recognized with the eye of knowledge the higher divine nature, / praised the sole [Lord] of the worlds, placing his folded hands upon his head.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
namaste 'stu mahādeva namaste parameśvara /
namaḥ śivāya devāya namaste brahmarūpiṇe //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
नमस्ते ऽस्तु महादेव नमस्ते परमेश्वर /
नमः शिवाय देवाय नमस्ते ब्रह्मरूपिणे //
text_mt:
Brahmā said:
“Salutations to you, Mahādeva! Salutations to you, Supreme Lord! / Salutations to Śiva the God; salutations to you who have the form of Brahman!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te maheśāya namaḥ śāntāya hetave /
pradhānapuruṣeśāya yogādhipataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते महेशाय नमः शान्ताय हेतवे /
प्रधानपुरुषेशाय योगाधिपतये नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to you, the Great Lord! Salutations to the peaceful Cause! / Salutations to the Lord of Pradhāna and Puruṣa, to the Master of Yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kālāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya śūline /
namaḥ pinākahastāya trinetrāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः कालाय रुद्राय महाग्रासाय शूलिने /
नमः पिनाकहस्ताय त्रिनेत्राय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to Time, to Rudra, to the great Devourer, to the bearer of the trident! / Salutations to the one with the Pināka in hand, to the three-eyed one, salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ brahmaṇo janakāya te /
brahmavidyādhipataye brahmavidyāpradāyine //
meaning:
नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणो जनकाय ते /
ब्रह्मविद्याधिपतये ब्रह्मविद्याप्रदायिने //
text_mt: Salutations to you of three forms, to you the progenitor of Brahmā, / to the Lord of the knowledge of Brahman, to the giver of the knowledge of Brahman!

sanskrit_iast:
namo vedarahasyāya kālakālāya te namaḥ /
vedāntasārasārāya namo vedātmamūrtaye //
meaning:
नमो वेदरहस्याय कालकालाय ते नमः /
वेदान्तसारसाराय नमो वेदात्ममूर्तये //
text_mt: Salutations to the secret of the Vedas! Salutations to you, the Death of Death! / Salutations to the essence of the essence of the Vedānta, to the embodiment of the soul of the Vedas!

sanskrit_iast:
namo buddhāya śuddhāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ /
prahīṇaśokairvividhairbhūtaiḥ varivṛtāya te //
meaning:
नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः /
प्रहीणशोकैर्विविधैर्भूतैः वरिवृताय ते //
text_mt: Salutations to the enlightened one, to the pure one, salutations to the Guru of yogins, / to you who are surrounded by diverse beings whose sorrow has vanished!

sanskrit_iast:
namo brahmaṇyadevāya brahmādhipataye namaḥ /
triyambakāya devāya namaste parameṣṭhine //
meaning:
नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः /
त्रियम्बकाय देवाय नमस्ते परमेष्ठिने //
text_mt: Salutations to the deity devoted to Brahman, salutations to the Overlord of Brahmā! / Salutations to the three-eyed God; salutations to you, the Supreme Being!

sanskrit_iast:
namo digvāsase tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāyā daṇḍine /
anādimalahīnāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो दिग्वाससे तुभ्यं नमो मुण्डाया दण्डिने /
अनादिमलहीनाय ज्ञानगम्याय ते नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to you who are clad in the directions! Salutations to the shaven-headed one, to the staff-bearer! / Salutations to you who are free from beginningless impurity, attainable through knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namastārāya tīrthāya namo yogardhihetave /
namo dharmādhigamyāya yogagamyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ताराय तीर्थाय नमो योगर्धिहेतवे /
नमो धर्माधिगम्याय योगगम्याय ते नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to the Savior, to the ford of deliverance! Salutations to the cause of the prosperity of yoga! / Salutations to the one reached through virtue, to the one reached through yoga, salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste niṣprapañcāya nirābhāsāya te namaḥ /
brahmaṇe viśvarūpāya namaste paramātmane //
meaning:
नमस्ते निष्प्रपञ्चाय निराभासाय ते नमः /
ब्रह्मणे विश्वरूपाय नमस्ते परमात्मने //
text_mt: Salutations to you devoid of phenomenal manifestation, salutations to you free from appearance! / Salutations to Brahman, who has the universe as his form; salutations to you, the Supreme Self!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvayyeva sakalaṃ sthitam /
tvayā saṃhriyate viśvaṃ pradhānādyaṃ jaganmaya //
meaning:
त्वयैव सृष्टमखिलं त्वय्येव सकलं स्थितम् /
त्वया संह्रियते विश्वं प्रधानाद्यं जगन्मय //
text_mt: By you alone all this was created; in you alone everything rests; / by you the universe beginning with Pradhāna is withdrawn, O you who consist of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamīśvaro mahādevaḥ paraṃ brahma maheśvaraḥ /
parameṣṭhī śivaḥ śāntaḥ puruṣo niṣkalo haraḥ //
meaning:
त्वमीश्वरो महादेवः परं ब्रह्म महेश्वरः /
परमेष्ठी शिवः शान्तः पुरुषो निष्कलो हरः //
text_mt: You are the Lord, Mahādeva, the Supreme Brahman, the Great Lord, / the Supreme Being, Śiva, the Peaceful, the Puruṣa, the partless Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistvaṃ kālaḥ parameśvaraḥ /
tvameva puruṣo 'nantaḥ pradhānaṃ prakṛtistathā //
meaning:
त्वमक्षरं परं ज्योतिस्त्वं कालः परमेश्वरः /
त्वमेव पुरुषो ऽनन्तः प्रधानं प्रकृतिस्तथा //
text_mt: You are the imperishable supreme light; you are Time, the Supreme Lord; / you alone are the infinite Puruṣa, as well as Pradhāna and primordial matter.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyurvyomāhaṅkāra eva ca /
yasya rūpaṃ namasyāmi bhavantaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
भूमिरापो ऽनलो वायुर्व्योमाहङ्कार एव च /
यस्य रूपं नमस्यामि भवन्तं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: Earth, water, fire, wind, ether, and egoity— / he whose form [these are], you who are designated as Brahman, I revere.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya dyaurabhavanmūrdhā pādau pṛthvī diśo bhujāḥ /
ākāśamudaraṃ tasmai virāje praṇamāmyaham //
meaning:
यस्य द्यौरभवन्मूर्धा पादौ पृथ्वी दिशो भुजाः /
आकाशमुदरं तस्मै विराजे प्रणमाम्यहम् //
text_mt: He whose head the sky became, whose feet the earth, whose arms the directions, / and whose belly the atmosphere—to that Cosmic Sovereign I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtāpayati yo viśvaṃ svabhābhirbhāsayan diśaḥ /
brahmatejomayaṃ nityaṃ tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
संतापयति यो विश्वं स्वभाभिर्भासयन् दिशः /
ब्रह्मतेजोमयं नित्यं तस्मै सूर्यात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who scorches the universe, illumining the directions with his rays, / eternally consisting of the splendor of Brahman—salutations to him in the form of the sun!

sanskrit_iast:
havyaṃ vahati yo nityaṃ raudrī tejomayo tanuḥ /
kavyaṃ pitṛgaṇānāṃ ca tasmai vahnyātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
हव्यं वहति यो नित्यं रौद्री तेजोमयो तनुः /
कव्यं पितृगणानां च तस्मै वह्न्यात्मने नमः //
text_mt: The fiery body of Rudra which continually conveys the sacrificial oblation, / and the ancestral offering to the hosts of ancestors—salutations to him in the form of fire!

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyati yo nityaṃ svadhāmnā sakalaṃ jagat /
pīyate devatāsaṅghaistasmai somātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
आप्यायति यो नित्यं स्वधाम्ना सकलं जगत् /
पीयते देवतासङ्घैस्तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who continually gladdens the entire world with his light, / and is drunk by the hosts of deities—salutations to him in the form of the moon!

sanskrit_iast:
vibhartyaśeṣabhūtāni yo 'ntaścarati sarvadā /
śaktirmāheścarī tubhyaṃ tasmai vāyvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
विभर्त्यशेषभूतानि यो ऽन्तश्चरति सर्वदा /
शक्तिर्माहेश्चरी तुभ्यं तस्मै वाय्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt: The power belonging to Maheśvara that sustains all beings, / which moves within at all times—salutations to you in the form of the wind!

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ yaḥ svakarmānurūpataḥ /
svātmanyavasthitastasmai caturvaktrātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
सृजत्यशेषमेवेदं यः स्वकर्मानुरूपतः /
स्वात्मन्यवस्थितस्तस्मै चतुर्वक्त्रात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who creates this entire [universe] according to each one's past actions, / residing in his own Self—salutations to him in the form of the four-faced [Brahmā]!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śeṣaśayane śete viśvamāvṛtya māyayā /
svātmānubhūtiyogena tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
यः शेषशयने शेते विश्वमावृत्य मायया /
स्वात्मानुभूतियोगेन तस्मै विश्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who lies on the serpent Śeṣa as his bed, having pervaded the universe by his illusory creative power / through the yoga of direct experience of his own Self—salutations to him in the form of Viśva!

sanskrit_iast:
vibharti śirasā nityaṃ dvisaptabhuvanātmakam /
brahmāṇḍaṃ yo 'khilādhārastasmai śeṣātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
विभर्ति शिरसा नित्यं द्विसप्तभुवनात्मकम् /
ब्रह्माण्डं यो ऽखिलाधारस्तस्मै शेषात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who, being the support of all, constantly bears with his head / the cosmic egg consisting of the fourteen worlds—salutations to him in the form of Śeṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ parānte parānandaṃ pītvā divyaikasākṣikam /
nṛtyatyanantamahimā tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
यः परान्ते परानन्दं पीत्वा दिव्यैकसाक्षिकम् /
नृत्यत्यनन्तमहिमा तस्मै रुद्रात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He who, having drunk supreme bliss at the end of the cosmic age, with only divine witnesses, / dances, of infinite greatness—salutations to him in the form of Rudra!

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'ntarā sarvabhūtānāṃ niyantā tiṣṭhatīśvaraḥ /
taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ devaṃ namasye bhavatastanum //
meaning:
यो ऽन्तरा सर्वभूतानां नियन्ता तिष्ठतीश्वरः /
तं सर्वसाक्षिणं देवं नमस्ये भवतस्तनुम् //
text_mt: He who dwells within all beings as the inner controller, the Lord— / to that God who is the witness of all, to your body, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ vinindrā jitaśvāsāḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ samadarśinaḥ /
jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
यं विनिन्द्रा जितश्वासाः संतुष्टाः समदर्शिनः /
ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास्तस्मै योगात्मने नमः //
text_mt: He whom the sleepless, those who have conquered the breath, the contented, those of equal vision, / behold as light while practicing yoga—salutations to him who is the embodiment of yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
yayā saṃtarate māyāṃ yogī saṃkṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ /
apārataraparyantāṃ tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
यया संतरते मायां योगी संक्षीणकल्मषः /
अपारतरपर्यन्तां तस्मै विद्यात्मने नमः //
text_mt: That by which the yogin whose stains are destroyed crosses over the illusory creative power / which is boundless—salutations to him in the form of knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
yasya bhāsā vibhātīdamadvayaṃ tamasaḥ param /
prapadye tat paraṃ tattvaṃ tadrūpaṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
यस्य भासा विभातीदमद्वयं तमसः परम् /
प्रपद्ये तत् परं तत्त्वं तद्रूपं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: By whose radiance this non-dual reality beyond darkness shines forth, / to that supreme reality, to that form, the Supreme Lord, I take refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
nityānandaṃ nirādhāraṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ śivam /
prapadye paramātmānaṃ bhavantaṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
नित्यानन्दं निराधारं निष्कलं परमं शिवम् /
प्रपद्ये परमात्मानं भवन्तं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: In the eternal bliss, the supportless, the partless, the supreme Śiva, / in you, the Supreme Self, the Supreme Lord, I take refuge.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ brahmā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ /
prāñjaliḥ praṇatastasthau gṛṇan brahma sanātanam //
meaning:
एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं ब्रह्मा तद्भावभावितः /
प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतस्तस्थौ गृणन् ब्रह्म सनातनम् //
text_mt: Having thus praised Mahādeva, Brahmā, absorbed in contemplation of him, / stood with folded hands, bowed low, chanting the eternal Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasmai mahādevo divyaṃ yogamanuttamam /
aiśvaryaṃ brahmasadbhāvaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca dadau haraḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तस्मै महादेवो दिव्यं योगमनुत्तमम् /
ऐश्वर्यं ब्रह्मसद्भावं वैराग्यं च ददौ हरः //
text_mt: Then to him Mahādeva, Hara, gave divine, unsurpassable yoga, / sovereignty, realization of the nature of Brahman, and dispassion.

sanskrit_iast:
karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇatārtihā /
vyājaharā svayaṃ devaḥ so 'nugṛhya pitāmaham //
meaning:
कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतार्तिहा /
व्याजहरा स्वयं देवः सो ऽनुगृह्य पितामहम् //
text_mt: Touching him with both most auspicious hands, the dispeller of the distress of the bowed / spoke himself, the God, showing grace to the Grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
yattvayābhyarthitaṃ brahman putratve bhavato mama /
kṛtaṃ mayā tat sakalaṃ sṛjasva vividhaṃ jagat //
meaning:
यत्त्वयाभ्यर्थितं ब्रह्मन् पुत्रत्वे भवतो मम /
कृतं मया तत् सकलं सृजस्व विविधं जगत् //
text_mt: “That which was requested by you, O Brahmā, regarding my becoming your son, / all that has been done by me; create the manifold world!

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ brahman brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā /
sargarakṣālayaguṇairniṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधा भिन्नो ऽस्म्यहं ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया /
सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निष्कलः परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: I am divided threefold, O Brahmā, under the names of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara, / by the qualities of creation, preservation, and dissolution, though I am the partless Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ mamāgrajaḥ putraḥ sṛṣṭihetorvinirmitaḥ /
mamaiva dakṣiṇādaṅgād vāmāṅgāt puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
स त्वं ममाग्रजः पुत्रः सृष्टिहेतोर्विनिर्मितः /
ममैव दक्षिणादङ्गाद् वामाङ्गात् पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: You are my eldest son, produced for the sake of creation / from my very right side, and the Supreme Spirit from my left side.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devādidevasya śaṃbhorhṛdayadeśataḥ /
saṃbabhūvātha rudro 'sāvahaṃ tasyāparā tanuḥ //
meaning:
तस्य देवादिदेवस्य शंभोर्हृदयदेशतः /
संबभूवाथ रुद्रो ऽसावहं तस्यापरा तनुः //
text_mt: From the region of the heart of that primeval God of gods, Sambhu, / this Rudra arose; I am his other embodiment.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivā brahman sargasthityantahetavaḥ /
vibhajyātmānameko 'pi svecchayā śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवा ब्रह्मन् सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवः /
विभज्यात्मानमेको ऽपि स्वेच्छया शङ्करः स्थितः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, O Brahmā, are the causes of creation, preservation, and dissolution; / though one, Śaṅkara remains divided by his own will.

sanskrit_iast:
tathānyāni ca rūpāṇi mama māyākṛtāni tu /
nirūpaḥ kevalaḥ svaccho mahādevaḥ svabhāvataḥ //
meaning:
तथान्यानि च रूपाणि मम मायाकृतानि तु /
निरूपः केवलः स्वच्छो महादेवः स्वभावतः //
text_mt: So too, my other forms are fashioned through illusory creative power; / by his own essential nature, Mahādeva is formless, solitary, and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhyaḥ parataro devastrimūrtiḥ paramā tanuḥ /
māheśvarī trinayanā yogināṃ śāntidā sadā //
meaning:
एभ्यः परतरो देवस्त्रिमूर्तिः परमा तनुः /
माहेश्वरी त्रिनयना योगिनां शान्तिदा सदा //
text_mt: Higher than these is the divine, three-formed, supreme body, / belonging to Maheśvara, three-eyed, which ever grants peace to yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā eva parāṃ mūrti māmavehi pitāmaha /
śāśvataiśvaryavijñānatejoyogasamanvitām //
meaning:
तस्या एव परां मूर्ति मामवेहि पितामह /
शाश्वतैश्वर्यविज्ञानतेजोयोगसमन्विताम् //
text_mt: Know me, O Grandfather, to be that very supreme form / endowed with eternal sovereignty, profound knowledge, splendor, and yoga.”

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ grasāmi sakalamadhiṣṭhāya tamoguṇam /
kālo bhūtvā na tamasā māmanyo 'bhibhaviṣyati //
meaning:
सो ऽहं ग्रसामि सकलमधिष्ठाय तमोगुणम् /
कालो भूत्वा न तमसा मामन्यो ऽभिभविष्यति //
text_mt: I myself, presiding over the quality of darkness, swallow everything; / having become Time, no other shall overpower me with darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā yadā hi māṃ nityaṃ vicintayasi padmaja /
tadā tadā me sānnidhyaṃ bhaviṣyati tavānagha //
meaning:
यदा यदा हि मां नित्यं विचिन्तयसि पद्मज /
तदा तदा मे सान्निध्यं भविष्यति तवानघ //
text_mt: Whenever you constantly meditate on me, O lotus-born one, / then my presence will be before you, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā brahmāṇaṃ so 'bhivandya guruṃ haraḥ /
sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणं सो ऽभिवन्द्य गुरुं हरः /
सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैः क्षणादन्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Brahmā and having saluted his guru, Hara, / together with the mind-born sons, vanished in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi yogaṃ samāsthāya sasarja vividhaṃ jagat /
nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavān yathāpūrvaṃ prijāpatiḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि योगं समास्थाय ससर्ज विविधं जगत् /
नारायणाख्यो भगवान् यथापूर्वं प्रिजापतिः //
text_mt: He too, having resorted to yoga, created the manifold universe / as before, the Lord Prajāpati named Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum /
dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā //
meaning:
मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् /
दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद् योगविद्यया //
text_mt: By the wisdom of yoga, he created Marīci, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, / Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dakṣa, Atri, and Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ /
sarve te brahmaṇā tulyāḥ sādhakā brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः /
सर्वे ते ब्रह्मणा तुल्याः साधका ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: These are ascertained in the Purāṇa as the nine Brahmās; / all of them are equal to Brahmā, spiritual strivers, speakers on Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharmaṃ ca yugadharmāṃśca śāśvatān /
sthānābhimāninaḥ sarvān yathā te kathitaṃ purā //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge deśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
संकल्पं चैव धर्मं च युगधर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् /
स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वान् यथा ते कथितं पुरा //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे देशमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
