text_mt: Seeing Mahādeva, the Goddess, her eyes widened with joy, / bowed with her head at the feet of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedya vijayaṃ tasmai śaṅkarāyātha śaṅkarī /
bhairavo viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ praṇataḥ pārśvago 'vadat //
meaning:
निवेद्य विजयं तस्मै शङ्करायाथ शङ्करी /
भैरवो विष्णुमाहात्म्यं प्रणतः पार्श्वगो ऽवदत् //
text_mt: Then Śaṅkarī reported victory to that Śaṅkara; / bowing and standing beside him, Bhairava spoke of Viṣṇu's majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tadvijayaṃ śaṃbhurvikramaṃ keśavasya ca /
samāste bhagavānīśo devyā saha varāsane //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तद्विजयं शंभुर्विक्रमं केशवस्य च /
समास्ते भगवानीशो देव्या सह वरासने //
text_mt: Hearing of that victory and the valor of Keśava, / the lord Īśa sat together with the Goddess on an excellent throne.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ /
ājagmurmandaraṃ druṣṭaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam //
meaning:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखा द्विजाः /
आजग्मुर्मन्दरं द्रुष्टं देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: Then all the hosts of gods and the twice-born led by Marīci / came to Mount Mandara to behold the three-eyed god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yena tad vijitaṃ pūrvaṃ devīnāṃ śatamuttamam /
samāgataṃ daityasainyamīśdarśanavāñchayā //
meaning:
येन तद् विजितं पूर्वं देवीनां शतमुत्तमम् /
समागतं दैत्यसैन्यमीश्दर्शनवाञ्छया //
text_mt: By whom that excellent hundred goddesses had previously conquered / the gathered Daitya army, desiring the sight of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā varāsanāsīnaṃ devyā candravibhūṣaṇam /
praṇemurādarād devyo gāyanti smātilālasāḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा वरासनासीनं देव्या चन्द्रविभूषणम् /
प्रणेमुरादराद् देव्यो गायन्ति स्मातिलालसाः //
text_mt: Seeing him adorned with the moon seated with the Goddess on an excellent throne, / the goddesses bowed with respect and, filled with intense longing, sang.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇemurgirijāṃ devīṃ vāmapārśve pinākinaḥ /
devāsanagataṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam //
meaning:
प्रणेमुर्गिरिजां देवीं वामपार्श्वे पिनाकिनः /
देवासनगतं देवं नारायणमनामयम् //
text_mt: They bowed to the goddess Girijā on the left side of the wielder of the Pināka, / and to the divine, flawless Nārāyaṇa seated on the divine throne.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā siṃhāsanāsīnaṃ devyā nārāyaṇena ca /
praṇamya devamīśānaṃ pṛṣṭavatyo varāṅganāḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सिंहासनासीनं देव्या नारायणेन च /
प्रणम्य देवमीशानं पृष्टवत्यो वराङ्गनाः //
text_mt: Seeing [Īśāna] seated on the lion-throne with the Goddess and Nārāyaṇa, / the excellent women bowed to the divine Īśāna and asked:

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā ūcuḥ
kastvaṃ vibhrājase kāntyā keyaṃ bālaraviprabhā /
ko 'nvayaṃ bhti vapuṣā paṅkajāyatalocanaḥ //
meaning:
कन्या ऊचुः
कस्त्वं विभ्राजसे कान्त्या केयं बालरविप्रभा /
को ऽन्वयं भ्ति वपुषा पङ्कजायतलोचनः //
text_mt: The maidens said: / "Who are you that shine with splendor? Who is this woman radiant as the morning sun? / And who is this one who shines with his body, possessing eyes long as lotuses?"

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya tāsāṃ vacanaṃ vṛṣendravaravāhanaḥ /
vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtādhipatiravyayaḥ //
meaning:
निशम्य तासां वचनं वृषेन्द्रवरवाहनः /
व्याजहार महायोगी भूताधिपतिरव्ययः //
text_mt: Hearing their words, he whose mount is the best of bulls, / the great yogin, the imperishable lord of beings, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo gaurī jaganmātā sanātanī /
vibhajya saṃsthito devaḥ svātmānaṃ bahudheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अहं नारायणो गौरी जगन्माता सनातनी /
विभज्य संस्थितो देवः स्वात्मानं बहुधेश्वरः //
text_mt: "I, Nārāyaṇa, and Gaurī, the eternal mother of the world— / having divided his own self manifold, the divine Lord abides.

sanskrit_iast:
na me viduḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ devādyā na maharṣayaḥ /
eko 'yaṃ veda viśvātmā bhavānī viṣṇureva ca //
meaning:
न मे विदुः परं तत्त्वं देवाद्या न महर्षयः /
एको ऽयं वेद विश्वात्मा भवानी विष्णुरेव च //
text_mt: Neither the gods and others nor the great sages know my supreme truth; / only this one who is the self of the universe, Bhavānī, and Viṣṇu knows it.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ hi niṣkriyaḥ śāntaḥ kevalo niṣparigrahaḥ /
māmeva keśavaṃ devamāhurdevīmathāmbikām //
meaning:
अहं हि निष्क्रियः शान्तः केवलो निष्परिग्रहः /
मामेव केशवं देवमाहुर्देवीमथाम्बिकाम् //
text_mt: For I am actionless, tranquil, solitary, and free from possessions; / me alone they call the divine Keśava, and also the Goddess Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryameva ca /
kartā kārayitā viṣṇurbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ //
meaning:
एष धाता विधाता च कारणं कार्यमेव च /
कर्ता कारयिता विष्णुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः //
text_mt: He is the creator and the ordainer, the cause and the effect, / the doer and the instigator—Viṣṇu, who bestows the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktā pumānaprameyaḥ saṃhartā kālarūpadhṛk /
straṣṭā pātā vāsudevo viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ //
meaning:
भोक्ता पुमानप्रमेयः संहर्ता कालरूपधृक् /
स्त्रष्टा पाता वासुदेवो विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः //
text_mt: He is the experiencer, the immeasurable Spirit, the destroyer bearing the form of Time, / the creator, the protector, Vāsudeva, the self of the universe, facing in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṭastho hyakṣaro vyāpī yogī nārāyaṇaḥ svayam /
tārakaḥ puruṣo hyātmā kevalaṃ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
कृटस्थो ह्यक्षरो व्यापी योगी नारायणः स्वयम् /
तारकः पुरुषो ह्यात्मा केवलं परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Indeed, unchanging, imperishable, and all-pervading, the yogin is Nārāyaṇa himself; / the deliverer, the Spirit, the self, the absolute supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
saiṣā māheśvarī gaurī mama śaktirnirañjanā /
sāntā satyā sadānandā paraṃ padamiti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
सैषा माहेश्वरी गौरी मम शक्तिर्निरञ्जना /
सान्ता सत्या सदानन्दा परं पदमिति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: This very Gaurī, the great sovereign goddess, is my taintless power; / she is peaceful, true, eternal bliss, the supreme state—thus says the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ sarvamidaṃ jātamatraiva layameṣyati /
eṣaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gatīnāmuttamā gatiḥ //
meaning:
अस्याः सर्वमिदं जातमत्रैव लयमेष्यति /
एषैव सर्वभूतानां गतीनामुत्तमा गतिः //
text_mt: From her all this was born, and right here it will dissolve; / she alone is the supreme refuge among all paths for all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tayāhaṃ saṃgato devyā kevalo niṣkalaḥ paraḥ /
paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ yastad veda sa mucyate //
meaning:
तयाहं संगतो देव्या केवलो निष्कलः परः /
पश्याम्यशेषमेवेदं यस्तद् वेद स मुच्यते //
text_mt: United with that Goddess, I, solitary, partless, and supreme, / behold this entire universe; he who knows this is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanādimadvaitaṃ viṣṇumātmānamīśvaram /
ekameva vijānīdhvaṃ tato yāsyatha nirvṛtim //
meaning:
तस्मादनादिमद्वैतं विष्णुमात्मानमीश्वरम् /
एकमेव विजानीध्वं ततो यास्यथ निर्वृतिम् //
text_mt: Therefore know Viṣṇu, the self, the Lord, to be beginningless, / non-dual, and one alone; then you will attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
manyante viṣṇumavyaktamātmānaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ /
ye bhinnadṛṣṭyāpīśānaṃ pūjayanto na me priyāḥ //
meaning:
मन्यन्ते विष्णुमव्यक्तमात्मानं श्रद्धयान्विताः /
ये भिन्नदृष्ट्यापीशानं पूजयन्तो न मे प्रियाः //
text_mt: Those endowed with faith who consider Viṣṇu the unmanifest Self / but worship Īśāna with a vision of distinction are not dear to me.

sanskrit_iast:
dviṣanti ye jagatsūtiṃ mohitā rauravādiṣu /
pacyamānā na mucyante kalpakoṭiśatairapi //
meaning:
द्विषन्ति ये जगत्सूतिं मोहिता रौरवादिषु /
पच्यमाना न मुच्यन्ते कल्पकोटिशतैरपि //
text_mt: Those who hate the origin of the world, deluded, / are cooked in the Raurava and other hells and are not freed even after hundreds of millions of cosmic ages.

sanskrit_iast:
tasamādaśeṣabhūtānāṃ rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ /
yathāvadiha vijñāya dhyeyaḥ sarvāpadi prabhuḥ //
meaning:
तसमादशेषभूतानां रक्षको विष्णुरव्ययः /
यथावदिह विज्ञाय ध्येयः सर्वापदि प्रभुः //
text_mt: Therefore, knowing properly that the imperishable Viṣṇu is the protector / of all beings, the Lord is to be meditated upon in every misfortune."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ devyaḥ sarvagaṇeśvarāḥ /
nemurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यं देव्यः सर्वगणेश्वराः /
नेमुर्नारायणं देवं देवीं च हिमशैलजाम् //
text_mt: Hearing the word of the Lord, the goddesses and all the leaders of the Gaṇas / bowed to the divine Nārāyaṇa and to the goddess born of the snowy mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
prārthayāmāsurīśāne bhaktiṃ bhaktajanapriye /
bhavānīpādayugale nārāyaṇapadāmbuje //
meaning:
प्रार्थयामासुरीशाने भक्तिं भक्तजनप्रिये /
भवानीपादयुगले नारायणपदाम्बुजे //
text_mt: They prayed for devotion to Īśāna, dear to devoted people, / at the pair of feet of Bhavānī and the lotus feet of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ gaṇeśā mātaro 'pi ca /
na paśyanti jagatsūtiṃ tadbhutamivābhavat //
meaning:
ततो नारायणं देवं गणेशा मातरो ऽपि च /
न पश्यन्ति जगत्सूतिं तद्भुतमिवाभवत् //
text_mt: Then the leaders of the Gaṇas and the mothers no longer saw / the divine Nārāyaṇa, the origin of the world; it was like a wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare mahādaityo hyandhako manmathārditaḥ /
mohito girijāṃ devīmāhartuṃ girimāyayau //
meaning:
तदन्तरे महादैत्यो ह्यन्धको मन्मथार्दितः /
मोहितो गिरिजां देवीमाहर्तुं गिरिमाययौ //
text_mt: In the meantime, the great Daitya Andhaka, tormented by love / and deluded, came to the mountain to abduct the goddess Girijā.

sanskrit_iast:
athānantavapuḥ śrīmān yogī nārāyaṇo 'malaḥ /
tatraivāvirabhūd daityairyuddhāya puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
अथानन्तवपुः श्रीमान् योगी नारायणो ऽमलः /
तत्रैवाविरभूद् दैत्यैर्युद्धाय पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: Then the glorious, pure yogin Nārāyaṇa, of infinite forms, / the Supreme Spirit, appeared right there to fight the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātha pārśve bhagavantamīśo
yuddhāya viṣṇuṃ gaṇadevamukhyaiḥ /
śilādaputreṇa ca mātṛkābhiḥ
sa kālarudro 'bhijagāma devaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वाथ पार्श्वे भगवन्तमीशो
युद्धाय विष्णुं गणदेवमुख्यैः /
शिलादपुत्रेण च मातृकाभिः
स कालरुद्रो ऽभिजगाम देवः //
text_mt: Having then placed the divine Viṣṇu at his side, the Lord, / that divine Kalarudra, went forth to battle with the chiefs of the Gaṇas and gods, / with the son of Śilāda, and with the mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlamādāya kṛśānukalpaṃ
sa devadevaḥ prayayau purastāt /
tamanvayuste gaṇarājavaryā
jagāma devo 'pi sahastrabāhuḥ //
meaning:
त्रिशूलमादाय कृशानुकल्पं
स देवदेवः प्रययौ पुरस्तात् /
तमन्वयुस्ते गणराजवर्या
जगाम देवो ऽपि सहस्त्रबाहुः //
text_mt: Taking a trident resembling fire, / that god of gods set forth in front; / those best of the lords of the Gaṇas followed him, / and the thousand-armed god also went forth.

sanskrit_iast:
rarāja madhye bhagavān surāṇāṃ
vivāhano vāridavarṇavarṇaḥ /
tadā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍha-
strilokadṛṣṭirbhagavānivārkaḥ //
meaning:
रराज मध्ये भगवान् सुराणां
विवाहनो वारिदवर्णवर्णः /
तदा सुमेरोः शिखराधिरूढ-
स्त्रिलोकदृष्टिर्भगवानिवार्कः //
text_mt: The Lord shone in the midst of the gods, / having no vehicle, possessing the color of a cloud, / then like the divine sun mounted on the peak of Sumeru, / beholding the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatyanādirbhagavānameyo
haraḥ sahastrākṛtirāvirāsīt /
triśūlapāṇirgagane sughoṣaḥ
papāta devopari puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ //
meaning:
जगत्यनादिर्भगवानमेयो
हरः सहस्त्राकृतिराविरासीत् /
त्रिशूलपाणिर्गगने सुघोषः
पपात देवोपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः //
text_mt: In the world, the beginningless, immeasurable Lord / Hara appeared with a thousand forms; / with trident in hand, he roared loudly in the sky, / and a shower of flowers fell upon the god.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgataṃ vīkṣya gaṇeśarājaṃ
samāvṛtaṃ devaripurgaṇeśaiḥ /
yuyodha śakreṇa samātṛkābhi-
r gaṇairaśeṣairamapapradhānaiḥ //
meaning:
समागतं वीक्ष्य गणेशराजं
समावृतं देवरिपुर्गणेशैः /
युयोध शक्रेण समातृकाभि-
र् गणैरशेषैरमपप्रधानैः //
text_mt: Seeing the king of the Gaṇa leaders arrived, / surrounded by the Gaṇa chiefs, the enemy of the gods / fought with Śakra, with the mothers, / and with all the Gaṇas having the immortals as their leaders.

sanskrit_iast:
vijitya sarvānapi bāhuvīryāt
sa saṃyuge śaṃbhumanantadhāma /
samāyayau yatra sa kālarudro
vimānamāruhya vihīnasattvaḥ //
meaning:
विजित्य सर्वानपि बाहुवीर्यात्
स संयुगे शंभुमनन्तधाम /
समाययौ यत्र स कालरुद्रो
विमानमारुह्य विहीनसत्त्वः //
text_mt: Having conquered them all through the might of his arms / in battle, he, deprived of courage, / mounted a celestial vehicle and approached Śambhu of infinite splendor / where that Kalarudra stood.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ samayāntaṃ bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ /
vyājahāra mahādevaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वान्धकं समयान्तं भगवान् गरुडध्वजः /
व्याजहार महादेवं भैरवं भूतिभूषणम् //
text_mt: Seeing Andhaka approaching, the Lord whose banner is Garuḍa / addressed Mahādeva, the Bhairava adorned with holy ash:

sanskrit_iast:
hantumarhasi daityeśamandhakaṃ lokakaṇṭakam /
tvāmṛte bhagavān śakto hantā nānyo 'sya vidyate //
meaning:
हन्तुमर्हसि दैत्येशमन्धकं लोककण्टकम् /
त्वामृते भगवान् शक्तो हन्ता नान्यो ऽस्य विद्यते //
text_mt: "You ought to slay the lord of Daityas, Andhaka, the thorn of the world; / other than you, there is no other slayer capable of [killing] him, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hartā sarvalokānāṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ /
stūyate vividhairmantrarvedavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
त्वं हर्ता सर्वलोकानां कालात्मा ह्यैश्वरी तनुः /
स्तूयते विविधैर्मन्त्रर्वेदविद्भिर्विचक्षणैः //
text_mt: You are the destroyer of all worlds, the soul of Time, the sovereign body / praised with various mantras by wise knowers of the Vedas."

sanskrit_iast:
sa vāsudevasya vaco niśamya bhagavān haraḥ /
nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ hanane daityandrasya matiṃ dadhau //
meaning:
स वासुदेवस्य वचो निशम्य भगवान् हरः /
निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं हनने दैत्यन्द्रस्य मतिं दधौ //
text_mt: Hearing the word of Vāsudeva and looking at Viṣṇu, / the divine Hara set his mind on slaying the lord of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma devatānīkaṃ gaṇānāṃ harṣamuttamam /
stuvanti bhairavaṃ devamantarikṣacarā janāḥ //
meaning:
जगाम देवतानीकं गणानां हर्षमुत्तमम् /
स्तुवन्ति भैरवं देवमन्तरिक्षचरा जनाः //
text_mt: The army of gods went forth, and supreme joy arose among the hosts; / beings roaming the atmosphere praised the terrifying god Bhairava:

sanskrit_iast:
jayānanta mahādeva kālamūrte sanātana /
tvamagniḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
जयानन्त महादेव कालमूर्ते सनातन /
त्वमग्निः सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरसि नित्यशः //
text_mt: "Victory, O infinite one, O Mahādeva, whose form is time, O eternal one! / You, the fire within all living beings, move constantly.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ yatrajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ dhātā hariravyayaḥ /
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ dhāma paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
त्वं यत्रज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वं धाता हरिरव्ययः /
त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं महादेवस्त्वं धाम परमं पदम् //
text_mt: You know the sacrifice; you are the vaṣaṭ-call; you are the creator, Hari the imperishable; / you are Brahmā; you are Mahādeva; you are the supreme abode, the highest state.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāramūrtiryogātmā trayīnetrastrilocanaḥ /
mahāvibhūtirdeveśo jayāśeṣajagatpate //
meaning:
ओङ्कारमूर्तिर्योगात्मा त्रयीनेत्रस्त्रिलोचनः /
महाविभूतिर्देवेशो जयाशेषजगत्पते //
text_mt: Your form is the syllable Oṃ; your self is yoga; your eyes are the three Vedas; you are three-eyed; / of great majesty, lord of the gods: victory to you, O lord of the entire universe!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālāgnirudro 'sau gṛhītvāndhakamīśvaraḥ /
triśūlāgreṣu vinyasya prananarta satāṃ gatiḥ //
meaning:
ततः कालाग्निरुद्रो ऽसौ गृहीत्वान्धकमीश्वरः /
त्रिशूलाग्रेषु विन्यस्य प्रननर्त सतां गतिः //
text_mt: Then that lord, Kālāgnirudra, seized Andhaka, / fixed him upon the tips of his trident, and, the refuge of the virtuous, danced.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ devagaṇāḥ śūlaprotaṃ pitāmahaḥ /
praṇemurīśvaraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ bhavamocakam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वान्धकं देवगणाः शूलप्रोतं पितामहः /
प्रणेमुरीश्वरं देवं भैरवं भवमोचकम् //
text_mt: Seeing Andhaka pierced upon the trident, the hosts of gods and the Grandfather / bowed to the divine lord, Bhairava, the releaser from worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
astuvan munayaḥ siddhā jagurgandharvikiṃnarāḥ /
antarikṣe 'psaraḥ saṅghā nṛtyantisma manoramāḥ //
meaning:
अस्तुवन् मुनयः सिद्धा जगुर्गन्धर्विकिंनराः /
अन्तरिक्षे ऽप्सरः सङ्घा नृत्यन्तिस्म मनोरमाः //
text_mt: The sages and Siddhas praised him; Gandharvas and Kiṃnaras sang; / delightful throngs of Apsarases danced in the atmosphere.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpito 'thaśūlāgre so 'ndhako dagdhakilbiṣaḥ /
utpannākhilavijñānastuṣṭāva parameśvaram //
meaning:
संस्थापितो ऽथशूलाग्रे सो ऽन्धको दग्धकिल्बिषः /
उत्पन्नाखिलविज्ञानस्तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Placed thus upon the trident’s tip, his sins burnt away, / all knowledge arose within Andhaka, and he praised the Supreme Lord:

sanskrit_iast:
andhaka uvāca
namāmi mūrdhnā bhagavantamekaṃ
samāhitā yaṃ vidurīśatattvam /
purātanaṃ puṇyamanantarūpaṃ
kālaṃ kaviṃ yogaviyogahetum //
meaning:
अन्धक उवाच
नमामि मूर्ध्ना भगवन्तमेकं
समाहिता यं विदुरीशतत्त्वम् /
पुरातनं पुण्यमनन्तरूपं
कालं कविं योगवियोगहेतुम् //
text_mt: Andhaka said: / "I bow my head to the one Lord / whom the concentrated know as the truth of the Sovereign, / the ancient, the holy, of infinite form, / Time, the sage, the cause of union and disunion;

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ
hutāśavaktraṃ jvalanārkarūpam /
sahastrapādākṣiśirobhiyuktaṃ
bhavantamekaṃ praṇamāmi rudram //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालं दिवि नृत्यमानं
हुताशवक्त्रं ज्वलनार्करूपम् /
सहस्त्रपादाक्षिशिरोभियुक्तं
भवन्तमेकं प्रणमामि रुद्रम् //
text_mt: fearsome with fangs, dancing in the sky, / whose face is fire, having the form of flame and sun, / endowed with a thousand feet, eyes, and heads: / to you alone, Rudra, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
jayādidevāmarapūjitāṅghre
vibhāgahīnāmalatattvarūpa /
tvamagnireko bahudhābhipūjyase
vāyvādibhedairakhilātmarūpa //
meaning:
जयादिदेवामरपूजिताङ्घ्रे
विभागहीनामलतत्त्वरूप /
त्वमग्निरेको बहुधाभिपूज्यसे
वाय्वादिभेदैरखिलात्मरूप //
text_mt: Victory, O primal god whose feet are worshipped by the immortals, / whose form is the pure truth without divisions! / You, the single fire, are worshipped in manifold ways / through the divisions of wind and the rest, whose form is the Self of all.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇam
ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt /
tvaṃ paśyasīdaṃ paripāsyajastraṃ
tvamantako yogigaṇābhijuṣṭaḥ //
meaning:
त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं पुराणम्
आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् /
त्वं पश्यसीदं परिपास्यजस्त्रं
त्वमन्तको योगिगणाभिजुष्टः //
text_mt: They declare you alone to be the ancient Spirit, / sun-colored, beyond darkness; / you behold this [universe] and protect it unceasingly; / you are the end-maker, frequented by hosts of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
eko 'ntarātmā bahudhā niviṣṭo
deheṣu dehādiviśeṣahīnaḥ /
tvamātmaśabdaṃ paramātmatattvaṃ
bhavantamāhuḥ śivameva kecit //
meaning:
एको ऽन्तरात्मा बहुधा निविष्टो
देहेषु देहादिविशेषहीनः /
त्वमात्मशब्दं परमात्मतत्त्वं
भवन्तमाहुः शिवमेव केचित् //
text_mt: The one inner Self, entered manifoldly / into bodies, devoid of the distinctions of body and the rest; / you are denoted by the word 'Self', the truth of the supreme Self— / some call you Śiva alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pavitra-
mānandarūpaṃ praṇavābhidhānam /
tvamīśvaro vedapadeṣu siddhaḥ
svayaṃ prabho 'śeṣaviśeṣahīnaḥ //
meaning:
त्वमक्षरं ब्रह्म परं पवित्र-
मानन्दरूपं प्रणवाभिधानम् /
त्वमीश्वरो वेदपदेषु सिद्धः
स्वयं प्रभो ऽशेषविशेषहीनः //
text_mt: You are the imperishable Brahman, supreme, pure, / whose form is bliss, whose name is the Praṇava; / you are the Lord established in the words of the Veda, / yourself, O sovereign, free from all distinctions.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamindrarūpo varuṇāgnirūpo
haṃsaḥ prāṇo mṛtyurantāsi yajñaḥ /
prajāpatirbhagavānekarudro
nīlagrīvaḥ stūyase vedavidbhiḥ //
meaning:
त्वमिन्द्ररूपो वरुणाग्निरूपो
हंसः प्राणो मृत्युरन्तासि यज्ञः /
प्रजापतिर्भगवानेकरुद्रो
नीलग्रीवः स्तूयसे वेदविद्भिः //
text_mt: You have the form of Indra, the form of Varuṇa and Agni; / you are the Haṃsa, the life-breath, death, the end, and the sacrifice; / you are Prajāpati, the Lord, the one Rudra; / blue-throated, you are praised by the knowers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇastvaṃ jagatāmathādiḥ
pitāmahastvaṃ prapitāmahaśca /
vedāntaguhyopaniṣatsu gītaḥ
sadāśivastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si //
meaning:
नारायणस्त्वं जगतामथादिः
पितामहस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च /
वेदान्तगुह्योपनिषत्सु गीतः
सदाशिवस्त्वं परमेश्वरो ऽसि //
text_mt: You are Nārāyaṇa, and the origin of the worlds; / you are the Grandfather, and the Great-Grandfather; / you are sung in the secret Upaniṣads of the Vedānta; / you are Sadāśiva, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ parastāt tamasaḥ parasmai
parātmane pañcapadāntarāya /
triśaktyatītāya nirañjanāya
sahastraśaktyāsanasaṃsthitāya //
meaning:
नमः परस्तात् तमसः परस्मै
परात्मने पञ्चपदान्तराय /
त्रिशक्त्यतीताय निरञ्जनाय
सहस्त्रशक्त्यासनसंस्थिताय //
text_mt: Homage to the supreme beyond darkness, / the supreme Self within the five states, / transcendent over the three powers, taintless, / seated on the throne of a thousand powers!

sanskrit_iast:
trimūrtaye 'nandapadātmamūrte
jagannivāsāya jaganmayāya /
namo lalāṭārpitalocanāya
namo janānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitāya //
meaning:
त्रिमूर्तये ऽनन्दपदात्ममूर्ते
जगन्निवासाय जगन्मयाय /
नमो ललाटार्पितलोचनाय
नमो जनानां हृदि संस्थिताय //
text_mt: To the three-formed, whose form is the state of bliss, / the dwelling of the universe, consisting of the universe; / homage to him whose eye is placed upon his forehead; / homage to him who is seated in the heart of people!

sanskrit_iast:
phaṇīndrahārāya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ
munīndrasiddhārcitapādayugma /
aiśvaryadharmāsanasaṃsthitāya
namaḥ parāntāya bhavodbhavāya //
meaning:
फणीन्द्रहाराय नमो ऽस्तु तुभ्यं
मुनीन्द्रसिद्धार्चितपादयुग्म /
ऐश्वर्यधर्मासनसंस्थिताय
नमः परान्ताय भवोद्भवाय //
text_mt: Homage to you whose necklace is the king of serpents, / whose pair of feet is worshipped by chiefs of sages and Siddhas, / who are seated on the throne of sovereignty and righteousness; / homage to the ultimate end, the source of existence!

sanskrit_iast:
sahastracandrārkavilocanāya
namo 'stu te soma sumadhyamāya /
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyabāho
namo 'mbikāyāḥ pataye mṛḍāya //
meaning:
सहस्त्रचन्द्रार्कविलोचनाय
नमो ऽस्तु ते सोम सुमध्यमाय /
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यबाहो
नमो ऽम्बिकायाः पतये मृडाय //
text_mt: Homage to you, Soma, whose eyes are a thousand moons and suns, / of slender waist; / homage to you, O god with golden arms; / homage to the husband of Ambikā, the merciful one!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'tiguhyāya guhāntarāya
vedāntavijñānasuniścitāya /
trikālahīnāmaladhāmadhāmne
namo maheśāya namaḥ śivāya //
meaning:
नमो ऽतिगुह्याय गुहान्तराय
वेदान्तविज्ञानसुनिश्चिताय /
त्रिकालहीनामलधामधाम्ने
नमो महेशाय नमः शिवाय //
text_mt: Homage to the deeply secret, within the cave [of the heart], / well-ascertained by the knowledge of Vedānta, / whose abode is the pure light free from the three times; / homage to Maheśa, homage to Śiva!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavān śūlāgrādavaropya tam /
tuṣṭaḥ provāca hastābhyāṃ spṛṣṭvātha parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एवं स्तुवन्तं भगवान् शूलाग्रादवरोप्य तम् /
तुष्टः प्रोवाच हस्ताभ्यां स्पृष्ट्वाथ परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: When he praised him thus, the Lord took him down from the trident's tip; / pleased, the Supreme Lord touched him with both hands and said:

sanskrit_iast:
prīto 'haṃ sarvathā daitya stavenānena sāṃpratam /
saṃprāpya gāṇapatyaṃ me sannidhāne vasāmaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रीतो ऽहं सर्वथा दैत्य स्तवेनानेन सांप्रतम् /
संप्राप्य गाणपत्यं मे सन्निधाने वसामरः //
text_mt: "I am completely pleased now with this hymn, O Daitya; / having attained the status of a leader of my hosts, dwell near me as an immortal,

sanskrit_iast:
arogaśchinnasaṃdeho devairapi supūjitaḥ /
nandīśvarasyānucaraḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
अरोगश्छिन्नसंदेहो देवैरपि सुपूजितः /
नन्दीश्वरस्यानुचरः सर्वदुः खविवर्जितः //
text_mt: free from sickness, with doubts severed, well worshipped even by the gods, / an attendant of Nandīśvara, rid of all sorrow."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyāhṛtamātre tu devadevena devatāḥ /
gaṇeśvarā mahādevamandhakaṃ devasannidhau //
meaning:
एवं व्याहृतमात्रे तु देवदेवेन देवताः /
गणेश्वरा महादेवमन्धकं देवसन्निधौ //
text_mt: No sooner had this been uttered by the god of gods, than the deities / and the lords of the hosts [looked upon] Mahādeva and Andhaka in the god's presence—

sanskrit_iast:
sahastrasūryasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candracihnitam /
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ jaṭāmauliṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram //
meaning:
सहस्त्रसूर्यसंकाशं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रचिह्नितम् /
नीलकण्ठं जटामौलिं शूलासक्तमहाकरम् //
text_mt: resembling a thousand suns, three-eyed, marked by the moon, / blue-throated, with matted hair as a crown, his great hand holding a trident.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tuṣṭuvurdaityamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ /
uvāca bhagavān viṣṇurdevadevaṃ smayanniva //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं तुष्टुवुर्दैत्यमाश्चर्यं परमं गताः /
उवाच भगवान् विष्णुर्देवदेवं स्मयन्निव //
text_mt: Seeing that Daitya, they praised him, filled with supreme wonder; / the lord Viṣṇu spoke to the god of gods, as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne tava mahādeva prabhāvaḥ puruṣo mahān /
nekṣate 'jñānajān doṣān gṛhṇāti ca guṇānapi //
meaning:
स्थाने तव महादेव प्रभावः पुरुषो महान् /
नेक्षते ऽज्ञानजान् दोषान् गृह्णाति च गुणानपि //
text_mt: "Fitting is your majesty, O Mahādeva: the Great Spirit / looks not upon faults born of ignorance, but takes even good qualities."

sanskrit_iast:
itīrito 'tha bhairavo gaṇeśadevapuṅgavaiḥ /
sakeśavaḥ sahāndhako jagāma śaṅkarāntikam //
meaning:
इतीरितो ऽथ भैरवो गणेशदेवपुङ्गवैः /
सकेशवः सहान्धको जगाम शङ्करान्तिकम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the lords of the hosts and the foremost gods, Bhairava, / accompanied by Keśava and by Andhaka, went into the presence of Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya devamāgataṃ saśaṅkaraḥ sahāndhakam /
samādhavaṃ samātṛkaṃ jagāma nirvṛtiṃ haraḥ //
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य देवमागतं सशङ्करः सहान्धकम् /
समाधवं समातृकं जगाम निर्वृतिं हरः //
text_mt: Beholding the god arrived, together with Śaṅkara and Andhaka, / with Mādhava and with the Mothers, Hara experienced delight.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya pāṇineśvaro hiraṇyalocanātmajam /
jagāma yatra śailajā vimānamīśavallabhā //
meaning:
प्रगृह्य पाणिनेश्वरो हिरण्यलोचनात्मजम् /
जगाम यत्र शैलजा विमानमीशवल्लभा //
text_mt: Taking the son of Hiraṇyākṣa by the hand, the Lord / went to the aerial chariot where the Daughter of the Mountain, beloved of the Lord, was.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya sā samāgataṃ bhavaṃ bhavārtihāriṇam /
avāpa sāndhakaṃ sukhaṃ prasādamandhakaṃ prati //
meaning:
विलोक्य सा समागतं भवं भवार्तिहारिणम् /
अवाप सान्धकं सुखं प्रसादमन्धकं प्रति //
text_mt: Seeing Bhava, who removes the distress of worldly existence, arrived with Andhaka, / she felt joy and favor toward Andhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
athāndhako maheśvarīṃ dadarśa devapārśvagām /
papāta daṇḍavatkṣitau nanāma pādapadmayoḥ //
meaning:
अथान्धको महेश्वरीं ददर्श देवपार्श्वगाम् /
पपात दण्डवत्क्षितौ ननाम पादपद्मयोः //
text_mt: Then Andhaka beheld the Great Goddess standing at the god's side; / he fell to the ground like a staff and bowed to her lotus feet:

sanskrit_iast:
namāmi devavallabhāmanādimadrijāmimām /
yataḥ pradhānapūruṣau nihanti yākhilaṃ jagat //
meaning:
नमामि देववल्लभामनादिमद्रिजामिमाम् /
यतः प्रधानपूरुषौ निहन्ति याखिलं जगत् //
text_mt: "I bow to this beloved of the god, the beginningless Daughter of the Mountain, / from whom are primordial matter and the Spirit, who destroys the entire universe;

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāti yā śivāsane śivena sākamavyayā /
hiraṇmaye 'tinirmale namāmi tāmimāmajām //
meaning:
विभाति या शिवासने शिवेन साकमव्यया /
हिरण्मये ऽतिनिर्मले नमामि तामिमामजाम् //
text_mt: who shines on the seat of Śiva together with Śiva, the imperishable one, / upon the golden, exceedingly pure [throne]—to that unborn one I bow;

sanskrit_iast:
yadantarākhilaṃ jagajjaganti yānti saṃkṣayam /
namāmi yatra tāmumāmaśeṣabedavarjitām //
meaning:
यदन्तराखिलं जगज्जगन्ति यान्ति संक्षयम् /
नमामि यत्र तामुमामशेषबेदवर्जिताम् //
text_mt: within whom is the entire universe, and in whom the worlds go to dissolution; / to that Umā, free of all divisions, I bow;

sanskrit_iast:
na jāyate nahīyate na vardhate ca tāmumām /
namāmi yā guṇātigā girīśaputrikāmimām //
meaning:
न जायते नहीयते न वर्धते च तामुमाम् /
नमामि या गुणातिगा गिरीशपुत्रिकामिमाम् //
text_mt: who is not born, does not diminish, and does not increase—to that Umā / who transcends the qualities, the daughter of the Mountain-Lord, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamasva devi śailaje kṛtaṃ mayā vimāhataḥ /
surāsurairyadarcitaṃ namāmi te padāmbujam //
meaning:
क्षमस्व देवि शैलजे कृतं मया विमाहतः /
सुरासुरैर्यदर्चितं नमामि ते पदाम्बुजम् //
text_mt: Pardon, O goddess, Daughter of the Mountain, what was done by me in delusion; / I bow to your lotus foot, which is worshipped by gods and Asuras."

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bhagavatī gaurī bhaktinamreṇa pārvatī /
saṃstutā daityapatinā putratve jagṛhe 'ndhakam //
meaning:
इत्थं भगवती गौरी भक्तिनम्रेण पार्वती /
संस्तुता दैत्यपतिना पुत्रत्वे जगृहे ऽन्धकम् //
text_mt: Praised in this way by the lord of the Daityas bowed in devotion, / the divine Gaurī, Pārvatī, accepted Andhaka as a son.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhairavo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ /
jagāmānujñayā śaṃbhoḥ pātālaṃ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ततः स मातृभिः सार्धं भैरवो रुद्रसंभवः /
जगामानुज्ञया शंभोः पातालं परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Then that Bhairava, born of Rudra, the supreme lord, / went together with the Mothers to the netherworld by the permission of Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sā tāmasī viṣṇormūrtiḥ saṃhārakārikā /
samāste hariravyakto nṛsiṃhākṛtirīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यत्र सा तामसी विष्णोर्मूर्तिः संहारकारिका /
समास्ते हरिरव्यक्तो नृसिंहाकृतिरीश्वरः //
text_mt: where that dark form of Viṣṇu that causes dissolution, / the unmanifest Hari, the Lord in the form of a man-lion, resides.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'nantākṛtiḥ śaṃbhuḥ śeṣeṇāpi supūjitaḥ /
kālāgnirudro bhagavān yuyojātmānamātmani //
meaning:
ततो ऽनन्ताकृतिः शंभुः शेषेणापि सुपूजितः /
कालाग्निरुद्रो भगवान् युयोजात्मानमात्मनि //
text_mt: Then Śambhu, of infinite form, well worshipped even by Śeṣa, / the divine Kālāgnirudra, united himself within the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
yuñjatastasya devasya sarvā evātha mātaraḥ /
bubhukṣitā mahādevaṃ praṇamyāhustriśūlinam //
meaning:
युञ्जतस्तस्य देवस्य सर्वा एवाथ मातरः /
बुभुक्षिता महादेवं प्रणम्याहुस्त्रिशूलिनम् //
text_mt: As that god was uniting [himself], all the Mothers, / being hungry, bowed to Mahādeva, the trident-bearer, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
mātara ūcuḥ
bubhukṣitā mahādeva anujñā dīyatāṃ tvayā /
trailokyaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmo nānyathā tṛptirastinaḥ //
meaning:
मातर ऊचुः
बुभुक्षिता महादेव अनुज्ञा दीयतां त्वया /
त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयिष्यामो नान्यथा तृप्तिरस्तिनः //
text_mt: The Mothers said: / "We are hungry, O Mahādeva; let permission be given by you: / we will consume the three worlds; otherwise we have no satisfaction."

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ mātaro viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥ /
bhakṣayāñcakrire sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मातरो विष्णुसंभवाः /
भक्षयाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् //
text_mt:
Having spoken these words, the Mothers born from Viṣṇu
consumed the entire triple world, with its moving and unmoving beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhairavo devo nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ harim /
dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṣaṇātprādurabhūddhariḥ //
meaning:
ततः स भैरवो देवो नृसिंहवपुषं हरिम् /
दध्यौ नारायणं देवं क्षणात्प्रादुरभूद्धरिः //
text_mt:
Then that god Bhairava meditated upon Hari in the form of a man-lion,
the god Nārāyaṇa; in an instant Hari appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāpayāmāsa ca taṃ bhakṣayantīha mātaraḥ /
nivārayāśu trailokyaṃ tvadīyā bhagavanniti //
meaning:
विज्ञापयामास च तं भक्षयन्तीह मातरः /
निवारयाशु त्रैलोक्यं त्वदीया भगवन्निति //
text_mt:
And he addressed him: 'Here the Mothers are devouring [everything];
swiftly restrain them from the triple world, O Lord, for they are yours!'

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmṛtā viṣṇunā devyo nṛsiṃhavapuṣā punaḥ /
upatasthurmahādevaṃ narasiṃhākṛtiṃ ca tam //
meaning:
संस्मृता विष्णुना देव्यो नृसिंहवपुषा पुनः /
उपतस्थुर्महादेवं नरसिंहाकृतिं च तम् //
text_mt:
Remembered by Viṣṇu in the form of a man-lion, the goddesses again
approached Mahādeva and him who had the form of a man-lion.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya sannidhiṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvāḥ saṃhārakārikāḥ /
pradaduḥ śaṃbhave śaktiṃ bhairavāyātitejase //
meaning:
संप्राप्य सन्निधिं विष्णोः सर्वाः संहारकारिकाः /
प्रददुः शंभवे शक्तिं भैरवायातितेजसे //
text_mt:
Attaining the presence of Viṣṇu, all those who bring about dissolution
offered their power to Śambhu, the exceedingly radiant Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyaṃstā jagatsūtiṃ nṛsiṃhamatha bhairavam /
kṣaṇādekatvamāpannaṃ śeṣāhiṃ cāpi mātaraḥ //
meaning:
अपश्यंस्ता जगत्सूतिं नृसिंहमथ भैरवम् /
क्षणादेकत्वमापन्नं शेषाहिं चापि मातरः //
text_mt:
Then the Mothers beheld the source of the world, the man-lion and Bhairava,
and the serpent Śeṣa as well, united in oneness in a single instant.

sanskrit_iast:
vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśo ye bhaktāḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ /
ye ca māṃ saṃsmarantīha pālanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
व्याजहार हृषीकेशो ये भक्ताः शूलपाणिनः /
ये च मां संस्मरन्तीह पालनीयाः प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt:
Hṛṣīkeśa declared: 'Those who are devotees of the trident-bearer,
and those who remember me here, are to be protected with every effort.

sanskrit_iast:
mamaiva mūrtiratulā sarvasaṃhārakārikā /
maheśvarāṃśasaṃbhūtā bhuktimuktipradā tviyam //
meaning:
ममैव मूर्तिरतुला सर्वसंहारकारिका /
महेश्वरांशसंभूता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा त्वियम् //
text_mt:
This matchless form of mine is the cause of universal destruction;
born of a portion of Maheśvara, it grants both enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ananto bhagavān kālo dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu /
tāmasī rājasī mūrtirdevadevaścaturmukhaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तो भगवान् कालो द्विधावस्था ममैव तु /
तामसी राजसी मूर्तिर्देवदेवश्चतुर्मुखः //
text_mt:
Endless Lord Time is an twofold state of mine:
the form endowed with darkness, and the form endowed with passion, the god of gods, the four-faced one.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'yaṃ devo durādharṣaḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ /
bhakṣayiṣyati kalpānte rudrātmā nikhilaṃ jagat //
meaning:
सो ऽयं देवो दुराधर्षः कालो लोकप्रकालनः /
भक्षयिष्यति कल्पान्ते रुद्रात्मा निखिलं जगत् //
text_mt:
This invincible god, Time, the driver of the worlds,
whose self is Rudra, will consume the entire world at the end of the cosmic age.

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā vimohikā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā /
sattvodriktājagat kṛtsnaṃ saṃsthāpayati nityadā //
meaning:
या सा विमोहिका मूर्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया /
सत्त्वोद्रिक्ताजगत् कृत्स्नं संस्थापयति नित्यदा //
text_mt:
That deluding form of mine named Nārāyaṇa,
abounding in goodness, perpetually establishes the whole world.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi viṣṇuḥ paraṃ brahma paramātmā parā gatiḥ /
mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sadānandeti kathyate //
meaning:
स हि विष्णुः परं ब्रह्म परमात्मा परा गतिः /
मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सदानन्देति कथ्यते //
text_mt:
For he is Viṣṇu, the supreme Brahman, the Supreme Self, the ultimate goal;
he is called the unmanifest primordial matter, eternal bliss.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ bodhitā devyo viṣṇunā viśvamātaraḥ /
prapedire mahādevaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ harim //
meaning:
इत्येवं बोधिता देव्यो विष्णुना विश्वमातरः /
प्रपेदिरे महादेवं तमेव शरणं हरिम् //
text_mt:
Instructed thus by Viṣṇu, the goddesses, Mothers of the universe,
took refuge in Mahādeva, and in that very Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayāndhakanibarhaṇam /
māhātmyaṃ devadevasya bhairavasyāmitaujasaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं मयान्धकनिबर्हणम् /
माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य भैरवस्यामितौजसः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
All this has been related to you by me: the destruction of Andhaka
and the majesty of the god of gods, Bhairava of boundless radiance.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
andake nigṛhīte vai prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ /
virocano nāma suto babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
अन्दके निगृहीते वै प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः /
विरोचनो नाम सुतो बभूव नृपतिः पुरा //
text_mt:
The holy Tortoise said:
When Andhaka was subdued, indeed, a son named Virocana
became king of the noble-souled Prahlāda of old.

sanskrit_iast:
devāñjitvā sadevendrāna bahūn varṣān mahāsuraḥ /
pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram //
meaning:
देवाञ्जित्वा सदेवेन्द्रान बहून् वर्षान् महासुरः /
पालयामास धर्मेण त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् //
text_mt:
Having conquered the gods along with the lords of the gods, the great Asura
ruled the triple world, with its moving and unmoving beings, righteously for many years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadācid viṣṇucoditaḥ /
sanatkumāro bhagavān puraṃ prāpa mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कदाचिद् विष्णुचोदितः /
सनत्कुमारो भगवान् पुरं प्राप महामुनिः //
text_mt:
While he was living in this manner, once, impelled by Viṣṇu,
the venerable Sanatkumāra, the great sage, arrived at his city.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā sihāsanagato brahmaputraṃ mahāsuraḥ /
nanāmotthāya śirasā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सिहासनगतो ब्रह्मपुत्रं महासुरः /
ननामोत्थाय शिरसा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Seeing the son of Brahmā while seated on his throne, the great Asura
rose, bowed with his head, and, with folded hands, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi saṃprāpto me purātanaḥ /
yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān yato 'sau brahmavit svayam //
meaning:
धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि संप्राप्तो मे पुरातनः /
योगीश्वरो ऽद्य भगवान् यतो ऽसौ ब्रह्मवित् स्वयम् //
text_mt:
'I am blessed, I am favored; the ancient master of yoga,
the venerable one, has arrived at my [city] today, since he himself knows Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthamāgato brahman svayaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
brūhi me brahmaṇaḥ putra kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyaham //
meaning:
किमर्थमागतो ब्रह्मन् स्वयं देवः पितामहः /
ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मणः पुत्र किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम् //
text_mt:
For what reason have you come, O Brahman? Grandfather, the god himself!
Tell me, son of Brahmā, what service may I perform?'

sanskrit_iast:
so 'bravīd bhagavān devo dharmayuktaṃ mahāsuram /
draṣṭumabhyāgato 'haṃ vai bhavantaṃ bhāgyavānasi //
meaning:
सो ऽब्रवीद् भगवान् देवो धर्मयुक्तं महासुरम् /
द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो ऽहं वै भवन्तं भाग्यवानसि //
text_mt:
The venerable god said to the righteous great Asura:
'I have indeed come to see you; you are fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
sudurlabhā nītireṣā daityānāṃ daityasattama /
triloke dhārmiko nūnaṃ tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate //
meaning:
सुदुर्लभा नीतिरेषा दैत्यानां दैत्यसत्तम /
त्रिलोके धार्मिको नूनं त्वादृशो ऽन्यो न विद्यते //
text_mt:
Such conduct among Daityas is exceedingly rare, O best of Daityas!
Surely no other righteous person like you exists in the three worlds.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto 'surarājastaṃ punaḥ prāha mahāmunim /
dharmāṇāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ brūhi me brahmavittama //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो ऽसुरराजस्तं पुनः प्राह महामुनिम् /
धर्माणां परमं धर्मं ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मवित्तम //
text_mt:
Addressed thus, the king of Asuras spoke again to that great sage:
'Tell me the supreme duty among duties, O best of knowers of Brahman!'

sanskrit_iast:
so 'bravīd bhagavān yogī daityendrāya mahātmane /
sarvaguhyatamaṃ dharmamātmajñānamanuttamam //
meaning:
सो ऽब्रवीद् भगवान् योगी दैत्येन्द्राय महात्मने /
सर्वगुह्यतमं धर्ममात्मज्ञानमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
The venerable yogin declared to the noble-souled lord of Daityas
the most secret duty of all: unsurpassable knowledge of the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānaṃ dattvā ca gurudakṣiṇām /
nidhāya putre tadrājyaṃ yogābhyāsarato 'bhavat //
meaning:
स लब्ध्वा परमं ज्ञानं दत्त्वा च गुरुदक्षिणाम् /
निधाय पुत्रे तद्राज्यं योगाभ्यासरतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
Having obtained supreme knowledge and given a fee to the guru,
he placed that kingdom upon his son and became devoted to the practice of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasya putro matimān balirnāma mahāsuraḥ /
brahmaṇyo dhārmiko 'tyarthaṃ vijigye 'tha purandaram //
meaning:
स तस्य पुत्रो मतिमान् बलिर्नाम महासुरः /
ब्रह्मण्यो धार्मिको ऽत्यर्थं विजिग्ये ऽथ पुरन्दरम् //
text_mt:
That son of his, the intelligent great Asura named Bali,
devoted to Brahmins and exceedingly righteous, then conquered Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tena mahad yuddhaṃ śakraḥ sarvāmarairvṛtaḥ /
jagāma nirjito viṣṇuṃ devaṃ śaraṇamacyutam //
meaning:
कृत्वा तेन महद् युद्धं शक्रः सर्वामरैर्वृतः /
जगाम निर्जितो विष्णुं देवं शरणमच्युतम् //
text_mt:
Having fought a great battle with him, Śakra, surrounded by all the immortals,
was defeated and went for refuge to the god Viṣṇu, Acyuta.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare 'ditirdevī devamātā suduḥ khitā /
daityendrāṇāṃ vadhārthāya putro me syāditi svayam //
meaning:
तदन्तरे ऽदितिर्देवी देवमाता सुदुः खिता /
दैत्येन्द्राणां वधार्थाय पुत्रो मे स्यादिति स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Meanwhile the goddess Aditi, mother of the gods, deeply grieved,
[wished] herself: 'May I have a son for the slaying of the Daitya lords.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatāpa sumahad ghoraṃ taporāśistapaḥ param /
prapannā viṣṇumavyaktaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ harim //
meaning:
तताप सुमहद् घोरं तपोराशिस्तपः परम् /
प्रपन्ना विष्णुमव्यक्तं शरण्यं शरणं हरिम् //
text_mt:
A heap of ascetic power, she performed very great and dreadful, supreme austerity,
taking refuge in the unmanifest Viṣṇu, Hari, who offers shelter.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā hṛtpadmakiñjalke niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam /
vāsudevamanādyantamānandaṃ vyoma kevalam //
meaning:
कृत्वा हृत्पद्मकिञ्जल्के निष्कलं परमं पदम् /
वासुदेवमनाद्यन्तमानन्दं व्योम केवलम् //
text_mt:
Placing in the filaments of the heart-lotus the partless supreme abode,
Vāsudeva, without beginning or end, bliss, pure ether, [she meditated].

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ /
āvirbabhūva yogātmā devamātuḥ puro hariḥ //
meaning:
प्रसन्नो भगवान् विष्णुः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः /
आविर्बभूव योगात्मा देवमातुः पुरो हरिः //
text_mt:
Pleased, the venerable Viṣṇu, wielder of the conch, discus, and mace,
Hari, the self of yoga, appeared before the mother of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ viṣṇumaditirbhaktisaṃyutā /
mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ toṣayāmāsa keśavam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा समागतं विष्णुमदितिर्भक्तिसंयुता /
मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं तोषयामास केशवम् //
text_mt:
Seeing that Viṣṇu had arrived, Aditi, full of devotion,
considered herself fulfilled and propitiated Keśava:

sanskrit_iast:
aditiruvāca
jayāśeṣaduḥ khaughanāśaikaheto
jayānantamāhātmyayogābhiyukta /
jayānādimadhyāntavijñānamūrte
jayāśeṣakalpāmalānandarūpa //
meaning:
अदितिरुवाच
जयाशेषदुः खौघनाशैकहेतो
जयानन्तमाहात्म्ययोगाभियुक्त /
जयानादिमध्यान्तविज्ञानमूर्ते
जयाशेषकल्पामलानन्दरूप //
text_mt:
Aditi said:
'Victory to the sole cause of the destruction of the entire flood of sorrow!
Victory to the one intent on the yoga of endless majesty!
Victory to the form of consciousness without beginning, middle, or end!
Victory to the form of pure bliss through all cosmic ages!

sanskrit_iast:
namo viṣṇave kālarūpāya tubhyaṃ
namo nārasiṃhāya śeṣāya tubhyam /
namaḥ kālarudrāya saṃhārakartre
namo vāsudevāya tubhyaṃ namaste //
meaning:
नमो विष्णवे कालरूपाय तुभ्यं
नमो नारसिंहाय शेषाय तुभ्यम् /
नमः कालरुद्राय संहारकर्त्रे
नमो वासुदेवाय तुभ्यं नमस्ते //
text_mt:
Homage to you, Viṣṇu, whose form is Time!
Homage to you, the Man-Lion, Śeṣa!
Homage to Kāla-Rudra, the maker of dissolution!
Homage to Vāsudeva! Homage, homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namo viśvamāyāvidhānāya tubhyaṃ
namo yogagamyāya satyāya tubhyam /
namo dharmavijñānaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ
namaste varāhāya bhūyo namaste //
meaning:
नमो विश्वमायाविधानाय तुभ्यं
नमो योगगम्याय सत्याय तुभ्यम् /
नमो धर्मविज्ञाननिष्ठाय तुभ्यं
नमस्ते वराहाय भूयो नमस्ते //
text_mt:
Homage to you, the arranger of the world's illusory creative power!
Homage to you, reachable by yoga, who are truth!
Homage to you, intent on duty and wisdom!
Homage to you, the Boar! Repeated homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sahastrārkacandrābhamūrte
namo vedavijñānadharmābhigamya /
namo devadevādidevādideva
prabho viśvayone 'tha bhūyo namaste //
meaning:
नमस्ते सहस्त्रार्कचन्द्राभमूर्ते
नमो वेदविज्ञानधर्माभिगम्य /
नमो देवदेवादिदेवादिदेव
प्रभो विश्वयोने ऽथ भूयो नमस्ते //
text_mt:
Homage to you, whose form has the radiance of a thousand suns and moons!
Homage to the one reachable through Vedic wisdom and duty!
Homage to the god of gods, the primordial god, the first of all gods!
O Lord, source of the universe, repeated homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śaṃbhave satyaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ
namo hetave viśvarūpāya tubhyam /
namo yogapīṭhāntarasthāya tubhyaṃ
śivāyaikarūpāya bhūyo namaste //
meaning:
नमः शंभवे सत्यनिष्ठाय तुभ्यं
नमो हेतवे विश्वरूपाय तुभ्यम् /
नमो योगपीठान्तरस्थाय तुभ्यं
शिवायैकरूपाय भूयो नमस्ते //
text_mt:
Homage to you, Śambhu, grounded in truth!
Homage to you, the cause, whose form is the universe!
Homage to you, dwelling within the seat of yoga!
To Śiva of unitary form, repeated homage to you!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo devamātrā jaganmayaḥ /
toṣitaśchandayāmāsa vareṇa prahasanniva //
meaning:
एवं स भगवान् कृष्णो देवमात्रा जगन्मयः /
तोषितश्छन्दयामास वरेण प्रहसन्निव //
text_mt:
Thus propitiated by the mother of the gods, the venerable Kṛṣṇa,
embodying the universe, invited her [to ask] for a boon, as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau sā vabre varamuttamam /
tvāmeva putraṃ devānāṃ hitāya varaye varam //
meaning:
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ सा वब्रे वरमुत्तमम् /
त्वामेव पुत्रं देवानां हिताय वरये वरम् //
text_mt:
Bowing with her head to the ground, she chose the supreme boon:
'I choose the boon of yourself as my son for the welfare of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathāstvityāha bhagavān prapannajanavatsalaḥ /
dattvā varānaprameyastatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् प्रपन्नजनवत्सलः /
दत्त्वा वरानप्रमेयस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
'Let it be so,' said the venerable one, compassionate to those who seek refuge.
Having granted the boons, the immeasurable one vanished on that very spot.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bahutithe kāle bhagavantaṃ janārdanam /
dadhāra garbhaṃ devānāṃ mātā nārāyaṇaṃ svayam //
meaning:
ततो बहुतिथे काले भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् /
दधार गर्भं देवानां माता नारायणं स्वयम् //
text_mt:
Then, after a long time, the mother of the gods
herself bore the embryo, the venerable Janārdana, Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
samāviṣṭe hṛṣīkeśe devamāturathodaram /
utpātā jajñire ghorā balervairocaneḥ pure //
meaning:
समाविष्टे हृषीकेशे देवमातुरथोदरम् /
उत्पाता जज्ञिरे घोरा बलेर्वैरोचनेः पुरे //
text_mt:
When Hṛṣīkeśa had entered the womb of the mother of the gods,
dreadful omens arose in the city of Bali, son of Virocana.

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya sarvānutpātān daityendro bhayavihvalaḥ /
prahlādamasuraṃ vṛddhaṃ praṇamyāha pitāmaham //
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य सर्वानुत्पातान् दैत्येन्द्रो भयविह्वलः /
प्रह्लादमसुरं वृद्धं प्रणम्याह पितामहम् //
text_mt:
Observing all the portents, the lord of Daityas, agitated with fear,
bowed to the aged Asura Prahlāda, his grandfather, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
baliruvāca
pitāmaha mahāprājña jāyante 'smatpure 'dhunā /
kimutpātā bhavet kāryamasmākaṃ kiṃnimittakāḥ //
meaning:
बलिरुवाच
पितामह महाप्राज्ञ जायन्ते ऽस्मत्पुरे ऽधुना /
किमुत्पाता भवेत् कार्यमस्माकं किंनिमित्तकाः //
text_mt:
Bali said:
'Grandfather, of great wisdom, why are portents arising
in our city now? What might be [their] effect for us, and what is their cause?'

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya tasya vacanaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāsuraḥ /
namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśamidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
निशम्य तस्य वचनं चिरं ध्यात्वा महासुरः /
नमस्कृत्य हृषीकेशमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Hearing his words, the great Asura meditated for a long time;
bowing to Hṛṣīkeśa, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
prahlāda uvāca
yo yajñairijyate viṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṃ jagat /
dadhārāsuranāśārthaṃ mātā taṃ tridivaukasām //
meaning:
प्रह्लाद उवाच
यो यज्ञैरिज्यते विष्णुर्यस्य सर्वमिदं जगत् /
दधारासुरनाशार्थं माता तं त्रिदिवौकसाम् //
text_mt:
Prahlāda said:
Viṣṇu, who is worshipped with sacrifices, to whom belongs this entire universe—
for the destruction of the asuras, the mother of the dwellers of heaven bore him.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādabhinnaṃ sakalaṃ bhidyate yo 'khilādapi /
sa vāsudevo devānāṃ māturdehaṃ samāviśat //
meaning:
यस्मादभिन्नं सकलं भिद्यते यो ऽखिलादपि /
स वासुदेवो देवानां मातुर्देहं समाविशत् //
text_mt:
He from whom everything is not distinct, and who is distinct even from all,
that Vāsudeva entered the body of the mother of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya devā jānanti svarūpaṃ paramārthataḥ /
sa viṣṇuraditerdehaṃ svecchayādya samāviśat //
meaning:
न यस्य देवा जानन्ति स्वरूपं परमार्थतः /
स विष्णुरदितेर्देहं स्वेच्छयाद्य समाविशत् //
text_mt:
He whose essential nature the gods do not know in the highest truth,
that Viṣṇu has today entered the body of Aditi of his own will.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmād bhavanti bhūtāni yatra saṃyānti saṃkṣayam /
so 'vatīrṇo mahāyogī purāṇapuruṣo hariḥ //
meaning:
यस्माद् भवन्ति भूतानि यत्र संयान्ति संक्षयम् /
सो ऽवतीर्णो महायोगी पुराणपुरुषो हरिः //
text_mt:
He from whom beings arise, and into whom they go to destruction,
that Hari, the great yogin, the ancient spirit, has descended.

sanskrit_iast:
na yatra vidyate nāmajātyādiparikalpanā /
sattāmātrātmarūpo 'sau viṣṇuraṃśena jāyate //
meaning:
न यत्र विद्यते नामजात्यादिपरिकल्पना /
सत्तामात्रात्मरूपो ऽसौ विष्णुरंशेन जायते //
text_mt:
In whom there is no conception of name, genus, or the like,
he, whose nature is pure existence, Viṣṇu, is born through a portion [of himself].

sanskrit_iast:
yasya sā jagatāṃ mātā śaktistaddharmadhāriṇī /
māyā bhagavatī lakṣmīḥ so 'vatīrṇo janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य सा जगतां माता शक्तिस्तद्धर्मधारिणी /
माया भगवती लक्ष्मीः सो ऽवतीर्णो जनार्दनः //
text_mt:
He whose power is that mother of the worlds, upholding his divine nature,
the illusory creative power, the blessed Lakṣmī—that Janārdana has descended.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya sā tāmasī mūrtiḥ śaṅkaro rājasī tanuḥ /
brahmā saṃjāyate viṣṇuraṃśenaikena sattvabhṛt //
meaning:
यस्य सा तामसी मूर्तिः शङ्करो राजसी तनुः /
ब्रह्मा संजायते विष्णुरंशेनैकेन सत्त्वभृत् //
text_mt:
He whose form of darkness is Śaṅkara, whose form of passion is Brahmā,
Viṣṇu is born through one portion, bearing goodness.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vicintya govindaṃ bhaktinamreṇa cetasā /
tameva gaccha śaraṇaṃ tato yāsyasi nirvṛtim //
meaning:
इत्थं विचिन्त्य गोविन्दं भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा /
तमेव गच्छ शरणं ततो यास्यसि निर्वृतिम् //
text_mt:
Having thus reflected upon Govinda with a mind bowed in devotion,
go to him alone for refuge; then you shall attain supreme peace.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahlādavacanād balirvairocanirharim /
jagāma śaraṇaṃ viśvaṃ pālayāmāsa dharmataḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रह्लादवचनाद् बलिर्वैरोचनिर्हरिम् /
जगाम शरणं विश्वं पालयामास धर्मतः //
text_mt:
Then, at the word of Prahlāda, Bali, the son of Virocana, went to Hari for refuge,
and protected the universe in accordance with righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle prāpte mahāviṣṇuṃ devānāṃ harṣavardhanam /
asūta kaśyapāccainaṃ devamātāditiḥ svayam //
meaning:
काले प्राप्ते महाविष्णुं देवानां हर्षवर्धनम् /
असूत कश्यपाच्चैनं देवमातादितिः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
When the time arrived, Aditi herself, mother of the gods, gave birth
to Mahāviṣṇu from Kaśyapa, increasing the joy of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam /
nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजं विशालाक्षं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् /
नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम् //
text_mt:
Four-armed, large-eyed, his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa,
resembling a dark-blue cloud, radiant, enveloped in splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
upatasthuḥ surāḥ sarve siddhāḥ sādhyāśca cāraṇāḥ /
upendramindrapramukhā brahmā carṣigamairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपतस्थुः सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाः साध्याश्च चारणाः /
उपेन्द्रमिन्द्रप्रमुखा ब्रह्मा चर्षिगमैर्वृतः //
text_mt:
All the gods, siddhas, sādhyas, and cāraṇas approached him,
Upendra, led by Indra, and Brahmā surrounded by hosts of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtopanayano vedānadhyaiṣṭa bhagavān hariḥ /
samācāraṃ bharadvājāt trilokāya pradarśayan //
meaning:
कृतोपनयनो वेदानध्यैष्ट भगवान् हरिः /
समाचारं भरद्वाजात् त्रिलोकाय प्रदर्शयन् //
text_mt:
Having received the sacred thread ceremony, the blessed Lord Hari studied the Vedas,
learning proper conduct from Bharadvāja to display it to the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi laukikaṃ mārgaṃ pradarśayati sa prabhuḥ /
sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate //
meaning:
एवं हि लौकिकं मार्गं प्रदर्शयति स प्रभुः /
स यत् प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते //
text_mt:
For in this way that Lord displays the worldly path;
whatever standard he sets, the world follows.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena matimān balirvairocaniḥ svayam /
yajñairyajñeśvaraṃ viṣṇumarcayāmāsa sarvagam //
meaning:
ततः कालेन मतिमान् बलिर्वैरोचनिः स्वयम् /
यज्ञैर्यज्ञेश्वरं विष्णुमर्चयामास सर्वगम् //
text_mt:
Then, in the course of time, the wise Bali, the son of Virocana, himself
worshipped Viṣṇu, the all-pervading lord of sacrifice, with sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān pūjayāmāsa dattvā bahutaraṃ dhanam /
brahmarṣayaḥ samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयामास दत्त्वा बहुतरं धनम् /
ब्रह्मर्षयः समाजग्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः //
text_mt:
He honored the brahmins by giving abundant wealth;
and the brahmin seers came to the sacrificial enclosure of that great-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāya viṣṇurbhagavān bharadvājapracoditaḥ /
āsthāya vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ yajñadeśamathāgamat //
meaning:
विज्ञाय विष्णुर्भगवान् भरद्वाजप्रचोदितः /
आस्थाय वामनं रूपं यज्ञदेशमथागमत् //
text_mt:
Knowing [this], the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, urged by Bharadvāja,
assumed the form of a dwarf and went to the place of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinopavītāṅga āṣāḍhena virājitaḥ /
brāhmaṇo jaṭilo vedānudgiran bhasmamaṇḍitaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनोपवीताङ्ग आषाढेन विराजितः /
ब्राह्मणो जटिलो वेदानुद्गिरन् भस्ममण्डितः //
text_mt:
His body wearing a black buckskin and a sacred thread, shining with a staff of palāśa wood,
a brahmin with matted hair, uttering the Vedas, adorned with sacred ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpyāsurarājasya samīpaṃ bhikṣuko hariḥ /
svapādairvimitaṃ deśamayācata baliṃ tribhiḥ //
meaning:
संप्राप्यासुरराजस्य समीपं भिक्षुको हरिः /
स्वपादैर्विमितं देशमयाचत बलिं त्रिभिः //
text_mt:
Having arrived near the king of the asuras, Hari as a beggar
begged Bali for ground measured by three of his own strides.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya caraṇau viṣṇorbalirbhāsamanvitaḥ /
ācāmayitvā bhṛṅgāramādāya svarṇanirmitam //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ विष्णोर्बलिर्भासमन्वितः /
आचामयित्वा भृङ्गारमादाय स्वर्णनिर्मितम् //
text_mt:
Having washed the feet of Viṣṇu, Bali, full of splendor,
made [him] sip water, and taking a pitcher made of gold,

sanskrit_iast:
dāsye tavedaṃ bhavate padatrayaṃ
prīṇātu devo hariravyayākṛtiḥ /
vicintya devasya karāgrapallave
nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ suśītalam //
meaning:
दास्ये तवेदं भवते पदत्रयं
प्रीणातु देवो हरिरव्ययाकृतिः /
विचिन्त्य देवस्य कराग्रपल्लवे
निपातयामास जलं सुशीतलम् //
text_mt:
“I will give to your honor these three strides of land;
may the god Hari, of imperishable form, be pleased.”
Having so resolved, onto the sprout-like fingertip of the god
he poured the cool water.

sanskrit_iast:
vicakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etā-
mathāntarikṣaṃ divamādidevaḥ /
vyapetarāgaṃ ditijeśvaraṃ taṃ
prakartukāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prapannam //
meaning:
विचक्रमे पृथिवीमेष एता-
मथान्तरिक्षं दिवमादिदेवः /
व्यपेतरागं दितिजेश्वरं तं
प्रकर्तुकामः शरणं प्रपन्नम् //
text_mt:
The primordial god strode over this earth,
and then the intermediate space and the sky,
desirous of purifying that lord of the sons of Diti
who had surrendered to him for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
ākramya lokatrayamīśapādaḥ
prājāpatyād brahmalokaṃ jagāma /
praṇemurādityasahastrakalpaṃ
ye tatra loke nivasanti siddhāḥ //
meaning:
आक्रम्य लोकत्रयमीशपादः
प्राजापत्याद् ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम /
प्रणेमुरादित्यसहस्त्रकल्पं
ये तत्र लोके निवसन्ति सिद्धाः //
text_mt:
Having traversed the three worlds, the foot of the Lord,
beyond the realm of Prajāpati, went to the world of Brahmā;
and those perfected ones residing in that world
bowed down to it, radiant like a thousand suns.

sanskrit_iast:
athopatasthe bhagavānanādiḥ
pitāmahāstoṣayāmāsa viṣṇum /
bhittvā tadaṇḍasya kapālamūrdhvaṃ
jagāma divyāvaraṇāni bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
अथोपतस्थे भगवाननादिः
पितामहास्तोषयामास विष्णुम् /
भित्त्वा तदण्डस्य कपालमूर्ध्वं
जगाम दिव्यावरणानि भूयः //
text_mt:
Then the blessed beginningless Grandfather [Brahmā] approached
and satisfied Viṣṇu;
and piercing the upper shell of the cosmic egg,
[the foot] went further through the divine coverings.

sanskrit_iast:
athāṇḍabhedānnipapāta śītalaṃ
mahājalaṃ tat puṇyakṛdbhiścajuṣṭam /
pravartate cāpi saridvarā tadā
gaṅgetyuktā brahmaṇā vyomasaṃsthā //
meaning:
अथाण्डभेदान्निपपात शीतलं
महाजलं तत् पुण्यकृद्भिश्चजुष्टम् /
प्रवर्तते चापि सरिद्वरा तदा
गङ्गेत्युक्ता ब्रह्मणा व्योमसंस्था //
text_mt:
Then from the cleavage of the egg fell cool,
great water, enjoyed by those who perform holy deeds;
and there flowed that excellent celestial river,
called the Gaṅgā by Brahmā, residing in the firmament.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā mahāntaṃ prakṛtiṃ pradhānaṃ
brahmāṇamekaṃ puruṣaṃ svabījam /
atiṣṭhadīśasya padaṃ tadavyayaṃ
dṛṣṭvā devāstatra tatra stuvanti //
meaning:
गत्वा महान्तं प्रकृतिं प्रधानं
ब्रह्माणमेकं पुरुषं स्वबीजम् /
अतिष्ठदीशस्य पदं तदव्ययं
दृष्ट्वा देवास्तत्र तत्र स्तुवन्ति //
text_mt:
Having reached the cosmic intellect, primordial matter, the unmanifest,
the one Brahmā, the Puruṣa, its own seed,
that imperishable foot of the Lord stood firm;
having seen it, the gods everywhere praised it.

sanskrit_iast:
ālokya taṃ puruṣaṃ viśvakāyaṃ
mahān balirbhaktiyogena viṣṇum /
nanāma nārāyaṇamekamavyayaṃ
svacetasā yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ //
meaning:
आलोक्य तं पुरुषं विश्वकायं
महान् बलिर्भक्तियोगेन विष्णुम् /
ननाम नारायणमेकमव्ययं
स्वचेतसा यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः //
text_mt:
Beholding that spirit whose body is the universe, Viṣṇu,
the great Bali, through the discipline of devotion,
bowed down to the one imperishable Nārāyaṇa,
whom the gods revere in their own hearts.

sanskrit_iast:
tamabravīd bhagavānādikartā
bhūtvā punarvāmano vāsudevaḥ /
mamaiva daityādhipate 'dhunedaṃ
lokatrayaṃ bhavatā bhāvadattam //
meaning:
तमब्रवीद् भगवानादिकर्ता
भूत्वा पुनर्वामनो वासुदेवः /
ममैव दैत्याधिपते ऽधुनेदं
लोकत्रयं भवता भावदत्तम् //
text_mt:
The blessed creator of all, Vāsudeva,
having become the dwarf again, spoke to him:
“O sovereign of the daityas, now these three worlds are mine,
given by your honor with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya mūrdhnā punareva daityo
nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ karāgre /
dāsye tavātmānamanantadhāmne
trivikramāyāmitavikramāya //
meaning:
प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पुनरेव दैत्यो
निपातयामास जलं कराग्रे /
दास्ये तवात्मानमनन्तधाम्ने
त्रिविक्रमायामितविक्रमाय //
text_mt:
Bowing his head, once again the daitya
poured water onto the tips of his fingers:
“I give my own self to you, whose abode is infinite,
to Trivikrama of boundless stride.”

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya sūnorapi saṃpradattaṃ
prahlādasūnoratha śaṅkhapāṇiḥ /
jagāda daityaṃ jagadantarātmā
pātālamūlaṃ praviśeti bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
प्रगृह्य सूनोरपि संप्रदत्तं
प्रह्लादसूनोरथ शङ्खपाणिः /
जगाद दैत्यं जगदन्तरात्मा
पातालमूलं प्रविशेति भूयः //
text_mt:
Accepting what was offered even by the son of Prahlāda’s son,
the shell-handed inner self of the universe
spoke again to the daitya:
“Enter the root of the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
samāsyatāṃ bhavatā tatra nityaṃ
bhuktvā bhogān devatānāmalabhyān /
dhyāyasva māṃ satataṃ bhaktiyogāt
pravekṣyase kalpadāhe punarmām //
meaning:
समास्यतां भवता तत्र नित्यं
भुक्त्वा भोगान् देवतानामलभ्यान् /
ध्यायस्व मां सततं भक्तियोगात्
प्रवेक्ष्यसे कल्पदाहे पुनर्माम् //

sanskrit_iast:
uktvaivaṃ daityasiṃhaṃ taṃ viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ /
purandarāya trailokyaṃ dadau viṣṇururukramaḥ //
meaning:
उक्त्वैवं दैत्यसिंहं तं विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः /
पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं ददौ विष्णुरुरुक्रमः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to that lion among the daityas, Viṣṇu of true valor,
Viṣṇu of wide strides gave the three worlds to Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstuvanti mahāyogaṃ siddhā devarṣikinnarāḥ /
brahmā śakro 'tha bhagavān rudrādityamarudgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
संस्तुवन्ति महायोगं सिद्धा देवर्षिकिन्नराः /
ब्रह्मा शक्रो ऽथ भगवान् रुद्रादित्यमरुद्गणाः //
text_mt:
The siddhas, divine seers, and kinnaras praised the great yogic power,
as did Brahmā, Indra, and the blessed Rudras, Ādityas, and Marut hosts.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvaitadadbhutaṃ karma viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk /
paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
कृत्वैतदद्भुतं कर्म विष्णुर्वामनरूपधृक् /
पश्यतामेव सर्वेषां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
Having performed this miraculous deed, Viṣṇu, who assumed the dwarf form,
vanished right there while all were looking on.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi daityavaraḥ śrīmān pātālaṃ prāpa coditaḥ /
prahlādenāsuravarairviṣṇunā viṣṇutatparaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि दैत्यवरः श्रीमान् पातालं प्राप चोदितः /
प्रह्लादेनासुरवरैर्विष्णुना विष्णुतत्परः //
text_mt:
That illustrious best of daityas too, devoted to Viṣṇu, went to the netherworld,
impelled by Prahlāda, the best of the asuras, and by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛcchad viṣṇumāhātmayaṃ bhaktiyogamanuttamam /
pūjāvidhānaṃ prahlādaṃ tadāhāsau cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
अपृच्छद् विष्णुमाहात्मयं भक्तियोगमनुत्तमम् /
पूजाविधानं प्रह्लादं तदाहासौ चकार सः //
text_mt:
He asked Prahlāda about the majesty of Viṣṇu,
the unsurpassed discipline of devotion, and the procedure of worship; and whatever he said, Bali performed.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rathacaraṇāsiśaṅkhapāṇiṃ
sarasijolacanamīśamaprameyam /
śaraṇamupapayau sa bhāvayogāt
praṇatagatiṃ praṇidhāya karmayogam //
meaning:
अथ रथचरणासिशङ्खपाणिं
सरसिजोलचनमीशमप्रमेयम् /
शरणमुपपयौ स भावयोगात्
प्रणतगतिं प्रणिधाय कर्मयोगम् //
text_mt:
Then, dedicating his yoga of action to him who is the refuge of the bowed,
he approached for refuge with devotional concentration
that immeasurable Lord, who holds the discus, sword, and conch in his hands,
and whose eyes resemble lotuses.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vaḥ kathito viprā vāmanasya parākramaḥ /
sa devakāryāṇi sadā karoti puruṣottamaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāya
meaning:
एष वः कथितो विप्रा वामनस्य पराक्रमः /
स देवकार्याणि सदा करोति पुरुषोत्तमः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षोडशो ऽध्याय

sanskrit_iast:
baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīnmahābalaparākramam /
teṣāṃ pradhāno dyutimān bāṇo nāma mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीन्महाबलपराक्रमम् /
तेषां प्रधानो द्युतिमान् बाणो नाम महाबलः //
text_mt:
Bali indeed had a hundred sons of great strength and valor;
the foremost among them was the radiant one named Bāṇa, of great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'tīva śaṅkare bhakto rājā rājyamapālayat /
trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya bādhayāmāsa vāsavam //
meaning:
सो ऽतीव शङ्करे भक्तो राजा राज्यमपालयत् /
त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय बाधयामास वासवम् //
text_mt:
Exceedingly devoted to Śaṅkara, he ruled the kingdom as king;
bringing the three worlds under his control, he harassed Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śakrādayo devā gatvocuḥ kṛttivāsasam /
tvadīyo bādhate hyasmān bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ //
meaning:
ततः शक्रादयो देवा गत्वोचुः कृत्तिवाससम् /
त्वदीयो बाधते ह्यस्मान् बाणो नाम महासुरः //
text_mt:
Then the gods, led by Indra, went and said to the one clad in an animal skin [Śiva]:
“A great asura named Bāṇa, who is your own devotee, harasses us.”

sanskrit_iast:
vyāhṛto daivadaiḥ sarvairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ /
dadāha bāṇasya puraṃ śareṇaikena līlayā //
meaning:
व्याहृतो दैवदैः सर्वैर्देवदेवो महेश्वरः /
ददाह बाणस्य पुरं शरेणैकेन लीलया //
text_mt:
Addressed by all the gods, the god of gods, Maheśvara,
burned the city of Bāṇa sportively with a single arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
dahyamāne pure tasmin bāṇo rudraṃ triśūlinam /
yayau śaraṇamīśānaṃ gopatiṃ nīlalohitam //
meaning:
दह्यमाने पुरे तस्मिन् बाणो रुद्रं त्रिशूलिनम् /
ययौ शरणमीशानं गोपतिं नीललोहितम् //
text_mt:
While that city was burning, Bāṇa sought refuge
with Rudra who holds the trident, Īśāna, the lord of cattle, Nīlalohita.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhanyādhāya talliṅgaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ bhītavarjitaḥ /
nirgatya tu purāt tasmāt tuṣṭāva parameśvaram //
meaning:
मूर्धन्याधाय तल्लिङ्गं शांभवं भीतवर्जितः /
निर्गत्य तु पुरात् तस्मात् तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Placing that liṅga of Śambhu upon his head, freed from fear, / he came forth from that city and praised the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstuto bhagavānīśaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ /
gāṇapatyena bāṇaṃ taṃ yojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ //
meaning:
संस्तुतो भगवानीशः शङ्करो नीललोहितः /
गाणपत्येन बाणं तं योजयामास भावतः //
text_mt: Praised in this way, the blessed lord Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, / lovingly appointed that Bāṇa to the leadership of his attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
athābhavan danoḥ putrāstārādyā hyatibhīṣaṇāḥ /
tārastathā śambaraśca kapilaḥ śaṅkarastathā /
svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अथाभवन् दनोः पुत्रास्ताराद्या ह्यतिभीषणाः /
तारस्तथा शम्बरश्च कपिलः शङ्करस्तथा /
स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Now there were sons of Danu, beginning with Tāra, exceedingly terrifying: / Tāra, Śambara, Kapila, Śaṅkara, / Svarbhānu, and Vṛṣaparvan are recorded as the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
surasāyāḥ sahastraṃ tu sarpāṇāmabhavad dvijāḥ /
anekaśirasāṃ tadvat khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
सुरसायाः सहस्त्रं तु सर्पाणामभवद् द्विजाः /
अनेकशिरसां तद्वत् खेचराणां महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: From Surasā came a thousand snakes, O twice-born ones, / having many heads, moving through the sky, and great-souled.

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭā janayāmāsa gandharvāṇāṃ sahastrakam /
anantādyā mahānāgāḥ kādraveyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अरिष्टा जनयामास गन्धर्वाणां सहस्त्रकम् /
अनन्ताद्या महानागाः काद्रवेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Ariṣṭā brought forth a thousand Gandharvas; / the great serpents, beginning with Ananta, are proclaimed as Kadrū's offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrā ca janayāmāsa ṣaṭ kanyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ /
śukīṃ śyenīṃ ca bhāsīṃ ca sugrīvāṅgṛdhrikāṃ śucim //
meaning:
ताम्रा च जनयामास षट् कन्या द्विजपुङ्गवाः /
शुकीं श्येनीं च भासीं च सुग्रीवाङ्गृध्रिकां शुचिम् //
text_mt: And Tāmrā brought forth six daughters, O best of the twice-born: / Śukī, Śyenī, Bhāsī, Sugrīvā, Gṛdhrikā, and Śuci.

sanskrit_iast:
gāstathā janayāmāsa surabhirmahiṣīstathā /
irā vṛkṣalatāvallīstṛṇajātīśca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
गास्तथा जनयामास सुरभिर्महिषीस्तथा /
इरा वृक्षलतावल्लीस्तृणजातीश्च सर्वशः //
text_mt: Surabhi brought forth cows and likewise buffaloes; / Irā [brought forth] trees, creepers, shrubs, and all kinds of grasses.

sanskrit_iast:
khasā vai yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā /
rakṣogaṇaṃ krodhavaśā janayāmāsa sattamāḥ //
meaning:
खसा वै यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा /
रक्षोगणं क्रोधवशा जनयामास सत्तमाः //
text_mt: Khasā indeed [brought forth] Yakṣas and Rakṣases, Muni the Apsarases, / and Krodhavaśā brought forth the host of Rakṣases, O virtuous ones.

sanskrit_iast:
vinatāyāśca putrau dvau prakhyātau garuḍāruṇau /
tayośca garuḍo dhīmān tapastaptvā suduścaram /
prasādācchūnilaḥ prāpto vāhanatvaṃ hareḥ svayam //
meaning:
विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वौ प्रख्यातौ गरुडारुणौ /
तयोश्च गरुडो धीमान् तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् /
प्रसादाच्छूनिलः प्राप्तो वाहनत्वं हरेः स्वयम् //
text_mt: And Vinatā had two sons, famous as Garuḍa and Aruṇa; / between them, wise Garuḍa, having performed severe austerities, / attained the role of being the mount of Hari himself by the grace of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya tapasā rudraṃ mahdevaṃ tathāruṇaḥ /
sārathye kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ prītenārkasya śaṃbhunā //
meaning:
आराध्य तपसा रुद्रं मह्देवं तथारुणः /
सारथ्ये कल्पितः पूर्वं प्रीतेनार्कस्य शंभुना //
text_mt: Having worshipped Rudra, Mahādeva, through ascetic penance, Aruṇa / was previously appointed as the Sun's charioteer by pleased Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāḥ sthāṇujaṅgamāḥ /
vaivasvate 'nte hyasmiñchṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ //
meaning:
एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तिताः स्थाणुजङ्गमाः /
वैवस्वते ऽन्ते ह्यस्मिञ्छृण्वतां पापनाशनाः //
text_mt: These descendants of Kaśyapa, immovable and moving, / have been narrated in this Vaivasvata cosmic era; they destroy the sins of those who hear [them].

sanskrit_iast:
saptaviṃśat sutāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyaśca suvratāḥ /
ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
सप्तविंशत् सुताः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्यश्च सुव्रताः /
अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश //
text_mt: Twenty-seven daughters are spoken of, the virtuous wives of Soma; / and sixteen offspring of the wives of Ariṣṭanemi here.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuputrasya viduṣaścatastro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ /
tadvadaṅgirasaḥ putrā ṛṣayo brahmasatkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्त्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः /
तद्वदङ्गिरसः पुत्रा ऋषयो ब्रह्मसत्कृताः //
text_mt: Four lightnings are recorded as [the daughters] of the wise Bahuputra; / likewise, the sons of Aṅgiras were sages honored by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāśvasya tu devarṣerdevapraharaṇāḥ sutāḥ /
ete yugasahastrānte jāyante punareva hi /
manvantareṣu niyataṃ tulyaiḥ kāryaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
कुशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षेर्देवप्रहरणाः सुताः /
एते युगसहस्त्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनरेव हि /
मन्वन्तरेषु नियतं तुल्यैः कार्यैः स्वनामभिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The divine sage Kuśāśva had divine weapons as his sons; / these indeed are born again at the end of a thousand yugas / in the cosmic eras of Manus with fixed tasks and matching names.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etānutpādya putrāṃstu prajāsaṃtānakāraṇāt /
kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra sumahat tapaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासंतानकारणात् /
कश्यपो गोत्रकामस्तु चचार सुमहत् तपः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having fathered these sons for the sake of continuing the progeny, / Kaśyapa, desiring a clan, performed great ascetic penance.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya vai tapato 'tyarthaṃ prādurbhūtau sutāvimau /
vatsaraścāsitaścaiva tāvubhau brahmavādinau //
meaning:
तस्य वै तपतो ऽत्यर्थं प्रादुर्भूतौ सुताविमौ /
वत्सरश्चासितश्चैव तावुभौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ //
text_mt: As he was performing penance intensely, these two sons appeared: / Vatsara and Asita, both expositors of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsarānnaidhruvo jajñe raibhyaśca sumahāyaśāḥ /
raibhyasya jajñire raibhyāḥ putrā dyutimatāṃ varāḥ //
meaning:
वत्सरान्नैध्रुवो जज्ञे रैभ्यश्च सुमहायशाः /
रैभ्यस्य जज्ञिरे रैभ्याः पुत्रा द्युतिमतां वराः //
text_mt: From Vatsara was born Naidhruva, and the highly renowned Raibhya; / from Raibhya were born the Raibhyas, foremost among radiant men.

sanskrit_iast:
cyavanasya sutā patnī naidhruvasya mahātmanaḥ /
sumedhā janayāmāsa putrān vai kuṇḍapāyinaḥ //
meaning:
च्यवनस्य सुता पत्नी नैध्रुवस्य महात्मनः /
सुमेधा जनयामास पुत्रान् वै कुण्डपायिनः //
text_mt: The wife of the great-souled Naidhruva was the daughter of Cyavana; / Sumedhā gave birth to sons, the Kuṇḍapāyins.

sanskrit_iast:
asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samapadyata /
nāmnā vai devalaḥ putro yogācāryo mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
असितस्यैकपर्णायां ब्रह्मिष्ठः समपद्यत /
नाम्ना वै देवलः पुत्रो योगाचार्यो महातपाः //
text_mt: By Ekaparṇā, Asita had a son deeply devoted to Brahman, / Devala by name, a master of yoga and a great ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṇḍilyānāṃ paraḥ śrīmān sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ /
prasādāt pārvatīśasya yogamuttamamāptavān //
meaning:
शाण्डिल्यानां परः श्रीमान् सर्वतत्त्वार्थवित् सुधीः /
प्रसादात् पार्वतीशस्य योगमुत्तममाप्तवान् //
text_mt: He was supreme among the Śāṇḍilyas, glorious, knowledgeable in the truths of all principles, and wise; / by the grace of Pārvatī's lord, he attained supreme yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṇḍilyā naidhru vāraibhyāstrayaḥ pakṣāstu kāśyapāḥ /
naraprakṛtayo viprāḥ pulastyasya vadāmi vaḥ //
meaning:
शाण्डिल्या नैध्रु वारैभ्यास्त्रयः पक्षास्तु काश्यपाः /
नरप्रकृतयो विप्राः पुलस्त्यस्य वदामि वः //
text_mt: The Śāṇḍilyas, the Naidhruvas, and the Raibhyas are three divisions belonging to Kaśyapa, / being of human nature, O twice-born ones. I shall tell you of Pulastya's [lineage].

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇabindoḥ sutā viprā nāmnā tvilavilā smṛtā /
pulastyāya sa rājarṣistāṃ kanyāṃ pratyapādayat //
meaning:
तृणबिन्दोः सुता विप्रा नाम्ना त्विलविला स्मृता /
पुलस्त्याय स राजर्षिस्तां कन्यां प्रत्यपादयत् //
text_mt: The daughter of Tṛṇabindu, O twice-born ones, was known by name as Ilavilā; / that royal sage bestowed that maiden upon Pulastya.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣistvailavilistasyāṃ viśravāḥ samapadyata /
tasya patnyaścatastrastu paulastyakulavardhikāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिस्त्वैलविलिस्तस्यां विश्रवाः समपद्यत /
तस्य पत्न्यश्चतस्त्रस्तु पौलस्त्यकुलवर्धिकाः //
text_mt: In her was born the sage Viśravas, son of Ilavilā; / he had four wives who increased the family of Pulastya:

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpotkaṭā ca rākā ca kaikasī devavarṇinī /
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāstāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पोत्कटा च राका च कैकसी देववर्णिनी /
रूपलावण्यसंपन्नास्तासां वै शृणुत प्रजाः //
text_mt: Puṣpotkaṭā, Rākā, Kaikasī, and Devavarṇinī, / endowed with beauty and charm. Hear now of their offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasya suṣuve devarūpiṇī /
kaikasī janayat putraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठं वैश्रवणं तस्य सुषुवे देवरूपिणी /
कैकसी जनयत् पुत्रं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् //
text_mt: To him, Devavarṇinī bore his eldest son, Vaiśravaṇa; / Kaikasī gave birth to a son, Rāvaṇa, the lord of the Rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam /
puṣpotkaṭā vyajanayat putrān viśravasaḥ śubhān //
meaning:
कुम्भकर्णं शूर्पणखां तथैव च विभीषणम् /
पुष्पोत्कटा व्यजनयत् पुत्रान् विश्रवसः शुभान् //
text_mt: and Kumbhakarṇa, Śūrpaṇakhā, and likewise Vibhīṣaṇa. / Puṣpotkaṭā brought forth splendid sons to Viśravas:

sanskrit_iast:
mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā /
kumbhīnasīṃ tathā kanyāṃ rākāyāṃ śṛṇuta prajāḥ //
meaning:
महोदरं प्रहस्तं च महापार्श्वं खरं तथा /
कुम्भीनसीं तथा कन्यां राकायां शृणुत प्रजाः //
text_mt: Mahodara, Prahasta, Mahāpārśva, and Khara, / and a daughter, Kumbhīnasī. Hear now of the offspring born of Rākā:

sanskrit_iast:
triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvo mahābalaḥ /
ityete krūrakarmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā daśa /
sarve tapobalotkṛṣṭā rudrabhaktāḥ subhīṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चैव विद्युज्जिह्वो महाबलः /
इत्येते क्रूरकर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षसा दश /
सर्वे तपोबलोत्कृष्टा रुद्रभक्ताः सुभीषणाः //
text_mt: Triśiras, Dūṣaṇa, and Vidyujjihva of great strength; / these were the ten fierce Rākṣasas of Pulastya's lineage, / all distinguished by the power of penance, devotees of Rudra, and exceedingly terrifying.

sanskrit_iast:
pulahasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyālāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ /
bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ sarpāśca śūkarā hastinastathā //
meaning:
पुलहस्य मृगाः पुत्राः सर्वे व्यालाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः /
भूताः पिशाचाः सर्पाश्च शूकरा हस्तिनस्तथा //
text_mt: The sons of Pulaha were wild animals, all fanged beasts of prey, / spirits, Piśācas, serpents, boars, and elephants.

sanskrit_iast:
anapatyaḥ kratustasmin smṛto vaivasvate 'ntare /
marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ svayameva prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
अनपत्यः क्रतुस्तस्मिन् स्मृतो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे /
मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः स्वयमेव प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Kratu is recorded as having been childless in that Vaivasvata cosmic era; / Marīci's son was Kaśyapa, the Prajāpati himself.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgorapyabhavacchukro daityācāryo mahātapāḥ /
svādhyāyayoganirato harabhakto mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
भृगोरप्यभवच्छुक्रो दैत्याचार्यो महातपाः /
स्वाध्याययोगनिरतो हरभक्तो महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: From Bhṛgu was born Śukra, the teacher of the Daityas, a great ascetic / devoted to the study of the Vedas and yoga, a devotee of Hara, and of great brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
atreḥ patnyo 'bhavan bahvyaḥ sodaryāstāḥ pativratāḥ /
kṛśāśvasya tu viprendrā ghṛtācyāmiti me śrutam //
meaning:
अत्रेः पत्न्यो ऽभवन् बह्व्यः सोदर्यास्ताः पतिव्रताः /
कृशाश्वस्य तु विप्रेन्द्रा घृताच्यामिति मे श्रुतम् //
text_mt: Atri had many wives who were devoted sisters, / the daughters of Kṛśāśva by Ghṛtācī, O foremost of twice-born ones, so have I heard.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāsu janayāmāsa svastyātreyān mahaujasaḥ /
vedavedāṅganiratāṃstapasā hatakilbiṣān //
meaning:
स तासु जनयामास स्वस्त्यात्रेयान् महौजसः /
वेदवेदाङ्गनिरतांस्तपसा हतकिल्बिषान् //
text_mt: In them he fathered the Svastyātreyas, of great power, / devoted to the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences, their sins destroyed by penance.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradastu vasiṣṭhāya dadau devīmarundhatīm /
ūrdhvaretāstatra muniḥ śāpād dakṣasya nāradaḥ //
meaning:
नारदस्तु वसिष्ठाय ददौ देवीमरुन्धतीम् /
ऊर्ध्वरेतास्तत्र मुनिः शापाद् दक्षस्य नारदः //
text_mt: Nārada gave the noble Arundhatī to Vasiṣṭha; / the sage Nārada lived there as a celibate due to a curse from Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
haryaśveṣu tu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya tu /
śaśāpa nāradaṃ dakṣaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ //
meaning:
हर्यश्वेषु तु नष्टेषु मायया नारदस्य तु /
शशाप नारदं दक्षः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः //
text_mt: When the Haryaśvas had perished through the illusory art of Nārada, / Dakṣa, his eyes blood-red with anger, cursed Nārada:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānmama sutāḥ sarve bhavato māyayā dvija /
kṣayaṃ nītāstvaśeṣeṇa nirapatyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
यस्मान्मम सुताः सर्वे भवतो मायया द्विज /
क्षयं नीतास्त्वशेषेण निरपत्यो भविष्यति //
text_mt: ‘Since all my sons have been brought entirely to destruction / through your illusory art, O twice-born, you shall be without offspring.’

sanskrit_iast:
arundhatyāṃ vasiṣṭhastu śaktimutpādayat sutam /
śakteḥ parāśaraḥ śrīmān sarvajñastapatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
अरुन्धत्यां वसिष्ठस्तु शक्तिमुत्पादयत् सुतम् /
शक्तेः पराशरः श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञस्तपतां वरः //
text_mt: In Arundhatī, Vasiṣṭha fathered a son, Śakti; / from Śakti came the glorious Parāśara, omniscient, best among ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya devadeveśamīśānaṃ tripurāntakam /
lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ kṛṣṇādvaipāyanaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
आराध्य देवदेवेशमीशानं त्रिपुरान्तकम् /
लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं कृष्णाद्वैपायनं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the lord of gods, Īśāna, the destroyer of the three cities, / he obtained an incomparable son, the lord Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaipāyanācchrako jajñe bhagavāneva śaṅkaraḥ /
aṃśāṃśenāvatīryorvyāṃ svaṃ prāpa paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
द्वैपायनाच्छ्रको जज्ञे भगवानेव शङ्करः /
अंशांशेनावतीर्योर्व्यां स्वं प्राप परमं पदम् //
text_mt: From Dvaipāyana was born Śuka, none other than the blessed lord Śaṅkara, / who, having descended to earth with a portion of his portion, attained his own supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
śukasyāpyabhavan putrāḥ pañcātyantatapasvinaḥ /
bhūriśravāḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇo gauraśca pañcamaḥ /
kanyā kīrtimatī caiva yogamātā dhṛtavratā //
meaning:
शुकस्याप्यभवन् पुत्राः पञ्चात्यन्ततपस्विनः /
भूरिश्रवाः प्रभुः शंभुः कृष्णो गौरश्च पञ्चमः /
कन्या कीर्तिमती चैव योगमाता धृतव्रता //
text_mt: Śuka also had five sons of great penance: / Bhūriśravas, Prabhu, Śambhu, Kṛṣṇa, and Gaura as the fifth, / and a daughter, Kīrtimatī, mother of yoga and keeper of vows.

sanskrit_iast:
ete 'tra vaṃśyāḥ kathitā brāhmaṇā brahmavādinām /
ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhadhvaṃ kaśyapādrājasaṃtatim //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एते ऽत्र वंश्याः कथिता ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मवादिनाम् /
अत ऊर्ध्वं निबोधध्वं कश्यपाद्राजसंततिम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
These descendants of the expositors of the Veda, all Brāhmaṇas, have been recounted here; / henceforth, learn of the royal lineage sprung from Kaśyapa.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
aditiḥ suṣuve putramādityaṃ kaśyapāt prabhum /
tasyādityasya caivasīd bhāryāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam /
saṃjñā rājñī prabhā chāyā putrāṃstāsāṃ nibodhata //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अदितिः सुषुवे पुत्रमादित्यं कश्यपात् प्रभुम् /
तस्यादित्यस्य चैवसीद् भार्याणां तु चतुष्टयम् /
संज्ञा राज्ञी प्रभा छाया पुत्रांस्तासां निबोधत //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Aditi bore to Kaśyapa a powerful son, the Sun; / and that Sun had four wives: / Saṃjñā, Rājñī, Prabhā, and Chāyā. Learn of their sons.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjñā tvāṣṭrī ca suṣuve sūryānmanumanuttamam /
yamaṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva rājñī raivatameva ca //
meaning:
संज्ञा त्वाष्ट्री च सुषुवे सूर्यान्मनुमनुत्तमम् /
यमं च यमुनां चैव राज्ञी रैवतमेव च //
text_mt: And Saṃjñā, daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ, bore to the sun the peerless Manu, / and Yama, and Yamunā; and Rājñī bore Raivata;

sanskrit_iast:
prabhā prabhātamādityācchāyā sāvarṇamātmajam /
śaniṃ ca tapatīṃ caiva viṣṭiṃ caiva yathākramam //
meaning:
प्रभा प्रभातमादित्याच्छाया सावर्णमात्मजम् /
