शनिं च तपतीं चैव विष्टिं चैव यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Prabhā [bore] Prabhāta to the sun; Chāyā bore her son Sāvarṇa, / and Śani, and Tapatī, and Viṣṭi in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
manostu prathamasyāsan nava putrāstu saṃyamāḥ /
ikṣvākurnabhagaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca //
meaning:
मनोस्तु प्रथमस्यासन् नव पुत्रास्तु संयमाः /
इक्ष्वाकुर्नभगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च //
text_mt: To the first Manu there were nine self-controlled sons: / Ikṣvāku and Nabhaga, Dhṛṣṭa and Śaryāti,

sanskrit_iast:
nariṣyantaśca nābhāgo hyariṣṭaḥ kāruṣakastathā /
pṛṣadhraśca mahātejā navaite śakrasannibhāḥ //
meaning:
नरिष्यन्तश्च नाभागो ह्यरिष्टः कारुषकस्तथा /
पृषध्रश्च महातेजा नवैते शक्रसन्निभाः //
text_mt: and Nariṣyanta, and Nābhāga, and Ariṣṭa, and Kāruṣaka, / and Pṛṣadhra of great splendour; these nine were like Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
ilā jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca somavaṃśavivṛddhaye /
budhasya gatvā bhavanaṃ somaputreṇa saṃgatā //
meaning:
इला ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा च सोमवंशविवृद्धये /
बुधस्य गत्वा भवनं सोमपुत्रेण संगता //
text_mt: Ilā was the eldest and most excellent. For the increase of the Lunar dynasty, / she went to the abode of Budha and united with the son of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
asūta saumyajaṃ devī purūravasamuttamam /
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikartāraṃ budhāditi hi naḥ śrutam //
meaning:
असूत सौम्यजं देवी पुरूरवसमुत्तमम् /
पितॄणां तृप्तिकर्तारं बुधादिति हि नः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: The goddess bore to Budha the excellent Purūravas, born of the son of Soma, / who brought gratification to the ancestors; so indeed have we heard.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya puṃstvamamalaṃ sudyumna iti viśrutaḥ /
ilā putratrayaṃ lebhe punaḥ strītvamavindata //
meaning:
संप्राप्य पुंस्त्वममलं सुद्युम्न इति विश्रुतः /
इला पुत्रत्रयं लेभे पुनः स्त्रीत्वमविन्दत //
text_mt: Having attained pure manhood, renowned as Sudyumna, / [and having] fathered three sons, Ilā obtained womanhood once again:

sanskrit_iast:
utkalaśca gayaścaiva vinatāśvastathaiva ca /
sarve te 'pratimaprakhyāḥ prapannāḥ kamalodbhavam //
meaning:
उत्कलश्च गयश्चैव विनताश्वस्तथैव च /
सर्वे ते ऽप्रतिमप्रख्याः प्रपन्नाः कमलोद्भवम् //
text_mt: Utkala, Gaya, and Vinatāśva; / all of them, renowned as matchless, took refuge in the lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣvākoścābhavad vīro vikukṣirnāma pārthivaḥ /
jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāpi daśa pañca ca tatsutāḥ //
meaning:
इक्ष्वाकोश्चाभवद् वीरो विकुक्षिर्नाम पार्थिवः /
ज्येष्ठः पुत्रशतस्यापि दश पञ्च च तत्सुताः //
text_mt: And to Ikṣvāku was born a heroic king named Vikukṣi, / the eldest even of a hundred sons; and his sons were fifteen.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāñjyeṣṭhaḥ kakutstho 'bhūt kākutstho hi suyodhanaḥ /
suyodhanāt pṛthuḥ śrīmān viśvakaśca pṛthoḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
तेषाञ्ज्येष्ठः ककुत्स्थो ऽभूत् काकुत्स्थो हि सुयोधनः /
सुयोधनात् पृथुः श्रीमान् विश्वकश्च पृथोः सुतः //
text_mt: The eldest among them was Kakutstha; the descendant of Kakutstha was Suyodhana; / from Suyodhana came glorious Pṛthu, and Viśvaka was the son of Pṛthu;

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakādārdrako dhīmān yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ /
sa gokarṇamanuprāpya yuvanāśvaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
विश्वकादार्द्रको धीमान् युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः /
स गोकर्णमनुप्राप्य युवनाश्वः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: from Viśvaka came wise Ārdraka, and Yuvanāśva was his son. / That majestic Yuvanāśva, having reached Gokarṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tu gautamaṃ vipraṃ tapantamanalaprabham /
praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau putrakāmo mahīpatiḥ /
apṛcchat karmaṇā kena dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तु गौतमं विप्रं तपन्तमनलप्रभम् /
प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ पुत्रकामो महीपतिः /
अपृच्छत् कर्मणा केन धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम् //
text_mt: and having seen the brāhmaṇa Gautama blazing with the lustre of fire, / bowed down like a staff upon the ground, desirous of a son, the lord of the earth, / and asked by what action he might obtain a righteous son.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
ārādhya pūrvapuruṣaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam /
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
आराध्य पूर्वपुरुषं नारायणमनामयम् /
अनादिनिधनं देवं धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम् //
text_mt: Gautama said: / By worshipping the Primal Spirit, Nārāyaṇa free from affliction, / the god without beginning or end, one may obtain a righteous son.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya putraḥ svayaṃ brahmā pautraḥ syānnīlalohitaḥ /
tamādikṛṣṇamīśānamārādhyāpnoti satsutam //
meaning:
यस्य पुत्रः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पौत्रः स्यान्नीललोहितः /
तमादिकृष्णमीशानमाराध्याप्नोति सत्सुतम् //
text_mt: He whose son is Brahmā himself, and whose grandson is Nīlalohita— / by worshipping him, the primal Kṛṣṇa, the Lord, one obtains a good son.

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya bhagavān brahmā prabhāvaṃ vetti tattvataḥ /
tamārādhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ prāpnuyāddhārmikaṃ sutam //
meaning:
न यस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रभावं वेत्ति तत्त्वतः /
तमाराध्य हृषीकेशं प्राप्नुयाद्धार्मिकं सुतम् //
text_mt: He whose majesty the blessed Brahmā does not know in its true nature— / by worshipping that Hṛṣīkeśa, one may obtain a righteous son.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gautamavacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ /
ārādhayanmahāyogaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
स गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा युवनाश्वो महीपतिः /
आराधयन्महायोगं वासुदेवं सनातनम् //
text_mt: Hearing that speech of Gautama, King Yuvanāśva / worshipped Vāsudeva, the eternal master of great yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro 'bhavad vīraḥ śrāvastiriti viśrutaḥ /
nirmitā yena śrāvastirgauḍadeśe mahāpurī //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वीरः श्रावस्तिरिति विश्रुतः /
निर्मिता येन श्रावस्तिर्गौडदेशे महापुरी //
text_mt: His son was the hero renowned as Śrāvasti, / by whom the great city Śrāvastī was built in the Gauḍa country.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca bṛhadaśvo 'bhūt tasmāt kuvalayāśvakaḥ /
dhundhumāratvamagamad dhundhuṃ hatvā mahāsuram //
meaning:
तस्माच्च बृहदश्वो ऽभूत् तस्मात् कुवलयाश्वकः /
धुन्धुमारत्वमगमद् धुन्धुं हत्वा महासुरम् //
text_mt: And from him came Bṛhadaśva; from him came Kuvalayāśva; / he attained the status of Dhundhumāra after slaying the great asura Dhundhu.

sanskrit_iast:
dhundhumārasya tanayāstrayaḥ proktā dvijottamāḥ /
dṛḍhāśvaścaiva daṇḍāśvaḥ kapilāśvastathaiva ca //
meaning:
धुन्धुमारस्य तनयास्त्रयः प्रोक्ता द्विजोत्तमाः /
दृढाश्वश्चैव दण्डाश्वः कपिलाश्वस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Three sons of Dhundhumāra are proclaimed, O best of the twice-born: / Dṛḍhāśva, Daṇḍāśva, and Kapilāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhāśvasya pramodastu haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ /
haryaśvasya nikumbhastu nikumbhāt saṃhatāśvakaḥ //
meaning:
दृढाश्वस्य प्रमोदस्तु हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः /
हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भस्तु निकुम्भात् संहताश्वकः //
text_mt: The son of Dṛḍhāśva was Pramoda, and Haryaśva was his son; / the son of Haryaśva was Nikumbha, and from Nikumbha came Saṃhatāśva;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśāśvaśca raṇāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasya vai sutau /
yuvanāśvo raṇāśvasya śakratulyabalo yudhi //
meaning:
कृशाश्वश्च रणाश्वश्च संहताश्वस्य वै सुतौ /
युवनाश्वो रणाश्वस्य शक्रतुल्यबलो युधि //
text_mt: Kṛśāśva and Raṇāśva were indeed the two sons of Saṃhatāśva; / the son of Raṇāśva was Yuvanāśva, equal in strength to Indra in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā tu vāruṇīmiṣṭimṛṣīṇāṃ vai prasādataḥ /
lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ viṣṇubhaktamanuttamam /
māndhātāraṃ mahāprājñaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam //
meaning:
कृत्वा तु वारुणीमिष्टिमृषीणां वै प्रसादतः /
लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं विष्णुभक्तमनुत्तमम् /
मान्धातारं महाप्राज्ञं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् //
text_mt: Having performed a sacrifice to Varuṇa, through the grace of the sages, / he obtained a matchless son, an unsurpassed devotee of Viṣṇu, / Māndhātṛ, of great wisdom, the foremost of all bearers of weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
māndhātuḥ purukutso 'bhūdambarīṣaśca vīryavān /
mucukundaśca puṇyātmā sarve śakrasamā yudhi //
meaning:
मान्धातुः पुरुकुत्सो ऽभूदम्बरीषश्च वीर्यवान् /
मुचुकुन्दश्च पुण्यात्मा सर्वे शक्रसमा युधि //
text_mt: To Māndhātṛ were born Purukutsa, and powerful Ambarīṣa, / and the virtuous-souled Mucukunda; all were equal to Indra in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
ambarīṣasya dāyādo yuvanāśvo 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ /
harito yuvanāśvasya hāritastatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
अम्बरीषस्य दायादो युवनाश्वो ऽपरः स्मृतः /
हरितो युवनाश्वस्य हारितस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: The heir of Ambarīṣa is remembered as another Yuvanāśva; / the son of Yuvanāśva was Harita, and his son was Hārita.

sanskrit_iast:
purukutsasya dāyādastrasadasyurmahāyaśāḥ /
narmadāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃbhūtistatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
पुरुकुत्सस्य दायादस्त्रसदस्युर्महायशाः /
नर्मदायां समुत्पन्नः संभूतिस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: The heir of Purukutsa was the illustrious Trasadasyu, / born of Narmadā; Saṃbhūti was his son;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuvṛddhaḥ sutastasya tvanaraṇyo 'bhavat paraḥ /
bṛhadaśavo 'naraṇyasya haryaśvastatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
विष्णुवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य त्वनरण्यो ऽभवत् परः /
बृहदशवो ऽनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Viṣṇuvṛddha was his son, and another was Anaraṇya; / the son of Anaraṇya was Bṛhadaśva, and Haryaśva was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'tīva dhārmiko rājā kardamasya prajāpateḥ /
prasādāddhārmikaṃ putraṃ lebhe sūryaparāyaṇam //
meaning:
सो ऽतीव धार्मिको राजा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः /
प्रसादाद्धार्मिकं पुत्रं लेभे सूर्यपरायणम् //
text_mt: That exceedingly righteous king, through the grace / of the Prajāpati Kardama, obtained a righteous son devoted to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu sūryaṃ samabhyarcya rājā vasumanāḥ śubham /
lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ tridhanvānamarindamam //
meaning:
स तु सूर्यं समभ्यर्च्य राजा वसुमनाः शुभम् /
लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं त्रिधन्वानमरिन्दमम् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the auspicious sun, King Vasumanas / obtained an incomparable son, Tridhanvan, subduer of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
ayajaccāśvamedhena śatrūn jitvā dvijottamāḥ /
svādhyāyavān dānaśīlastitikṣurdharmatatparaḥ //
meaning:
अयजच्चाश्वमेधेन शत्रून् जित्वा द्विजोत्तमाः /
स्वाध्यायवान् दानशीलस्तितिक्षुर्धर्मतत्परः //
text_mt: He sacrificed with the horse sacrifice, having conquered his enemies, O best of the twice-born; / he was devoted to Vedic study, generous, forbearing, and intent upon righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayastu samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ /
vasiṣṭhakaśyapamukhā devāścendrapurogamāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषयस्तु समाजग्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः /
वसिष्ठकश्यपमुखा देवाश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: The sages assembled at the sacrificial enclosure of that great-souled one, / headed by Vasiṣṭha and Kaśyapa, and the gods headed by Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tān praṇamya mahārājaḥ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ /
samāpya vidhivad yajñaṃ vasiṣṭhādīn dvijottamān //
meaning:
तान् प्रणम्य महाराजः पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः /
समाप्य विधिवद् यज्ञं वसिष्ठादीन् द्विजोत्तमान् //
text_mt: Having bowed to them, the great king, filled with humility, / having duly concluded the sacrifice, questioned Vasiṣṭha and the other best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
vasumanā uvāca
kiṃsviccheyaskarataraṃ loke 'smin brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ /
yajñastapo vā saṃnyāso brūta me sarvavedinaḥ //
meaning:
वसुमना उवाच
किंस्विच्छेयस्करतरं लोके ऽस्मिन् ब्राह्मणर्षभाः /
यज्ञस्तपो वा संन्यासो ब्रूत मे सर्ववेदिनः //
text_mt: Vasumanas said: / What is more conducive to the highest good in this world, O bulls among brāhmaṇas— / sacrifice, austerity, or renunciation? Tell me, you who know all.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
adhītya vedān vidhivat putrānutpādya dharmataḥ /
iṣṭvā yajñeśvaraṃ yajñair gaccheda vanamathātmavān //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
अधीत्य वेदान् विधिवत् पुत्रानुत्पाद्य धर्मतः /
इष्ट्वा यज्ञेश्वरं यज्ञैर् गच्छेद वनमथात्मवान् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having studied the Vedas according to rule, having produced sons according to righteousness, / having worshipped the Lord of sacrifice with sacrifices, the self-controlled man may then go to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
pulastya uvāca
ārādhya tapasā devaṃ yoginaṃ parameṣṭhinam /
pravrajed vidhivad yajñairiṣṭvā pūrvaṃ surottamān //
meaning:
पुलस्त्य उवाच
आराध्य तपसा देवं योगिनं परमेष्ठिनम् /
प्रव्रजेद् विधिवद् यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा पूर्वं सुरोत्तमान् //
text_mt: Pulastya said: / Having worshipped through austerity the divine yogin, the Supreme Being, / one should go forth into homelessness according to rule, having first worshipped the foremost gods with sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
pulaha uvāca
yamāhurekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ parameśvaram /
tamārādhya sahastrāṃśuṃ tapasā mokṣamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
पुलह उवाच
यमाहुरेकं पुरुषं पुराणं परमेश्वरम् /
तमाराध्य सहस्त्रांशुं तपसा मोक्षमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Pulaha said: / He whom they call the one ancient Spirit, the Supreme Lord— / by worshipping that thousand-rayed one through austerity, one may attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
ajasya nābhāvadhyekamīśvareṇa samarpitam /
bījaṃ bhagavatā yena sa devastapasejyate //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
अजस्य नाभावध्येकमीश्वरेण समर्पितम् /
बीजं भगवता येन स देवस्तपसेज्यते //
text_mt: Jamadagni said: / In the navel of the Unborn, a single seed was deposited by the Lord, / by which blessed one [it was placed]—that god is worshipped through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitra uvāca
yo 'gniḥ sarvātmako 'nantaḥ svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ /
sa rudrastapasogreṇa pūjyate netarairmakhaiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वामित्र उवाच
यो ऽग्निः सर्वात्मको ऽनन्तः स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः /
स रुद्रस्तपसोग्रेण पूज्यते नेतरैर्मखैः //
text_mt: Viśvāmitra said: / The fire which consists of all, infinite, self-existent, facing in all directions— / that Rudra is worshipped through fierce austerity, not by other sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
bharadvāja uvāca
yo yajñairijyate devo jātavedāḥ sanātanaḥ /
sa sarvadaivatatanuḥ pūjyate tapaseśvaraḥ //
meaning:
भरद्वाज उवाच
यो यज्ञैरिज्यते देवो जातवेदाः सनातनः /
स सर्वदैवततनुः पूज्यते तपसेश्वरः //
text_mt: Bharadvāja said: / The god who is worshipped through sacrifices, the eternal knower of all beings, / he whose body is all the deities, the Lord, is worshipped through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
atriruvāca
yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ yasyāpatyaṃ prajāpatiḥ /
tapaḥ sumahadāsthāya pūjyate sa maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अत्रिरुवाच
यतः सर्वमिदं जातं यस्यापत्यं प्रजापतिः /
तपः सुमहदास्थाय पूज्यते स महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Atri said: / From whom all this arose, whose offspring is Prajāpati— / undertaking immense austerity, that Maheśvara is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
gautama uvāca
yataḥ pradhānapuruṣau yasya śaktimayaṃ jagat /
sa devadevastapasā pūjanīyaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
गौतम उवाच
यतः प्रधानपुरुषौ यस्य शक्तिमयं जगत् /
स देवदेवस्तपसा पूजनीयः सनातनः //
text_mt: Gautama said: / From whom primary matter and spirit arise, of whose power the universe consists— / that eternal God of gods is to be worshipped through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapa uvāca
sahastranayano devaḥ sākṣī sa tu prajāpatiḥ /
prasīdati mahāyogī pūjitastapasā paraḥ //
meaning:
कश्यप उवाच
सहस्त्रनयनो देवः साक्षी स तु प्रजापतिः /
प्रसीदति महायोगी पूजितस्तपसा परः //
text_mt: Kaśyapa said: / The thousand-eyed god, the witness, he who is Prajāpati, / the supreme great yogin, when worshipped through austerity, becomes pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
kraturuvāca
prāptādhyayanayajñas labdhaputrasya caiva hi /
nāntareṇa tapaḥ kaściddharmaḥ śāstreṣu dṛśyate //
meaning:
क्रतुरुवाच
प्राप्ताध्ययनयज्ञस् लब्धपुत्रस्य चैव हि /
नान्तरेण तपः कश्चिद्धर्मः शास्त्रेषु दृश्यते //
text_mt: Kratu said: / For one who has accomplished study and sacrifice and has obtained a son, / no duty is seen in the scriptures apart from austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
ityākarṇya sa rājarṣistān praṇamyātihṛṣṭadhīḥ /
visarjayitvā saṃpūjya tridhanvānamathābravīt //
meaning:
इत्याकर्ण्य स राजर्षिस्तान् प्रणम्यातिहृष्टधीः /
विसर्जयित्वा संपूज्य त्रिधन्वानमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing this, that royal sage bowed to them with an exceedingly joyful mind; / having worshipped and dismissed them, he then spoke to Tridhanvan:

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayiṣye tapasā devamekākṣarāhvayam /
prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ puruṣamādityāntarasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
आराधयिष्ये तपसा देवमेकाक्षराह्वयम् /
प्राणं बृहन्तं पुरुषमादित्यान्तरसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: I shall worship through austerity the god whose name is the single syllable, / the breath of life, the immense Spirit situated within the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ tu dharmarato nityaṃ pālayaitadatandritaḥ /
cāturvarṇyasamāyuktamaśeṣaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
त्वं तु धर्मरतो नित्यं पालयैतदतन्द्रितः /
चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्तमशेषं क्षितिमण्डलम् //
text_mt: "You, however, always devoted to righteousness, unflaggingly protect / this entire circle of the earth comprising the four classes."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa tadrājyaṃ nidhāyātmabhave nṛpaḥ /
jagāmāraṇyamanaghastapaścartumanuttamam //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स तद्राज्यं निधायात्मभवे नृपः /
जगामारण्यमनघस्तपश्चर्तुमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus and placed that kingdom upon his own son, the faultless king / went to the forest to perform unsurpassed asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
himavacchikhare ramye devadāruvane śubhe /
kandamūlaphalāhāro munyannairayajat surān //
meaning:
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये देवदारुवने शुभे /
कन्दमूलफलाहारो मुन्यन्नैरयजत् सुरान् //
text_mt: On a delightful peak of the Himālaya, in an auspicious cedar forest, / subsisting on roots, tubers, and fruits, he worshipped the gods with the food of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ taponirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ /
jajāpa manasā devīṃ sāvitrariṃ vedamātaram //
meaning:
संवत्सरशतं साग्रं तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषः /
जजाप मनसा देवीं सावित्ररिं वेदमातरम् //
text_mt: For over a full hundred years, his sins shaken off by asceticism, / he mentally recited the goddess Sāvitrī, the mother of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ japato devaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ parameśvaraḥ /
hiraṇyagarbho viśvātmā taṃ deśamagamat svayam //
meaning:
तस्यैवं जपतो देवः स्वयंभूः परमेश्वरः /
हिरण्यगर्भो विश्वात्मा तं देशमगमत् स्वयम् //
text_mt: While he was thus reciting, the self-existent god, the supreme lord, / Hiraṇyagarbha, the soul of all, went to that region in person.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ samāyāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvatomukham /
nanāma śirasā tasya pādayornāma kīrtayan //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा देवं समायान्तं ब्रह्माणं विश्वतोमुखम् /
ननाम शिरसा तस्य पादयोर्नाम कीर्तयन् //
text_mt: Seeing the god Brahmā, whose faces are everywhere, approaching, / he bowed his head at his feet, praising his name:

sanskrit_iast:
namo devādhidevāya brahmaṇe paramātmane /
hirṇyamūrtaye tubhyaṃ sahastrākṣāya vedhase //
meaning:
नमो देवाधिदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने /
हिर्ण्यमूर्तये तुभ्यं सहस्त्राक्षाय वेधसे //
text_mt: "Salutations to the supreme God of gods, to Brahman, the supreme soul, / to you whose form is golden, who are thousand-eyed, the creator!

sanskrit_iast:
namo dhātre vidhātre ca namo vedātmamūrtaye /
sāṃkhyayogādhigamyāya namaste jñānamūrtaye //
meaning:
नमो धात्रे विधात्रे च नमो वेदात्ममूर्तये /
सांख्ययोगाधिगम्याय नमस्ते ज्ञानमूर्तये //
text_mt: "Salutations to the supporter and the ordainer, salutations to the embodiment of the Vedas, / attainable through Sāṅkhya and Yoga, salutations to you whose form is knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ straṣṭre sarvārthavedine /
puruṣāya purāṇāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं स्त्रष्ट्रे सर्वार्थवेदिने /
पुरुषाय पुराणाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः //
text_mt: "Salutations to you of threefold form, the creator, knower of all aims, / to the ancient Puruṣa, salutations to the preceptor of yogins!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān viriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ /
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado 'smītyabhāṣata //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् विरिञ्चो विश्वभावनः /
वरं वरय भद्रं ते वरदो ऽस्मीत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Then, pleased, the blessed Viriñca, creator of the universe, / said: "Choose a boon, blessings to you, I am a grantor of boons."

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca
japeyaṃ devadeveśa gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram /
bhūyo varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tāvadāyurbhavenmama //
meaning:
राजोवाच
जपेयं देवदेवेश गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् /
भूयो वर्षशतं साग्रं तावदायुर्भवेन्मम //
text_mt:
The king said:
"O Lord of the gods of gods, may I recite the Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas, / for over another hundred years; may my lifespan be that long."

sanskrit_iast:
bāḍhamityāha viśvātmā samālokya narādhipam /
spṛṣṭvā karābhyāṃ suprītastatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
बाढमित्याह विश्वात्मा समालोक्य नराधिपम् /
स्पृष्ट्वा कराभ्यां सुप्रीतस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: "So be it," said the soul of all, looking upon the ruler of men; / well pleased, having touched him with both hands, he vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi labdhavaraḥ śrīmān jajāpātiprasannadhīḥ /
śāntastriṣavaṇasnāyī kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽपि लब्धवरः श्रीमान् जजापातिप्रसन्नधीः /
शान्तस्त्रिषवणस्नायी कन्दमूलफलाशनः //
text_mt: Having obtained the boon, the glorious [king], his mind exceedingly clear, / tranquil, bathing at the three junctures of the day, eating roots, tubers, and fruits, recited.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pūrṇe varṣaśate bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ /
prādurāsīnmahāyogī bhānormaṇḍalamadhyataḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पूर्णे वर्षशते भगवानुग्रदीधितिः /
प्रादुरासीन्महायोगी भानोर्मण्डलमध्यतः //
text_mt: When his hundred years were complete, the blessed one of fierce rays, / the great yogin, became manifest from the center of the sun's orb.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vedaviduṣaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ sanātanam /
svayaṃbhuvamanādyantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा वेदविदुषं मण्डलस्थं सनातनम् /
स्वयंभुवमनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्माणं विस्मयं गतः //
text_mt: Seeing that eternal one, who knows the Vedas, situated in the orb, / the self-existent, beginningless and endless Brahmā, he was filled with amazement.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva vaidikairmantraiḥ sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ /
kṣaṇādapaśyat puruṣaṃ tameva parameśvaram //
meaning:
तुष्टाव वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः सावित्र्या च विशेषतः /
क्षणादपश्यत् पुरुषं तमेव परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: He praised [him] with Vedic mantras and especially with the Sāvitrī; / in a moment he saw that very supreme lord as a Puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhaṃ jaṭāmaulimaṣṭahastaṃ trilocanam /
candrāvayavalakṣamāṇaṃ naranārītanuṃ haram //
meaning:
चतुर्मुखं जटामौलिमष्टहस्तं त्रिलोचनम् /
चन्द्रावयवलक्षमाणं नरनारीतनुं हरम् //
text_mt: four-faced, with a crown of matted locks, eight-armed, three-eyed, / bearing the crescent moon, Hara whose body is man and woman,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsayantaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ svaraśmibhiḥ /
raktāmbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyānulepanam //
meaning:
भासयन्तं जगत् कृत्स्नं नीलकण्ठं स्वरश्मिभिः /
रक्ताम्बरधरं रक्तं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम् //
text_mt: illuminating the entire universe with his rays, the blue-throated one, / wearing red garments, red, with red garlands and ointments.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāvabhāvito dṛṣṭvā sadbhāvena pareṇa hi /
nanāma śirasā rudraṃ sāvitryānena caiva hi //
meaning:
तद्भावभावितो दृष्ट्वा सद्भावेन परेण हि /
ननाम शिरसा रुद्रं सावित्र्यानेन चैव हि //
text_mt: Pervaded by devotion to him upon seeing him with supreme genuine faith, / he bowed his head to Rudra and recited this Sāvitrī:

sanskrit_iast:
namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine /
trayīmayāya rudrāya kālarūpāya hetave //
meaning:
नमस्ते नीलकण्ठाय भास्वते परमेष्ठिने /
त्रयीमयाय रुद्राय कालरूपाय हेतवे //
text_mt: "Salutations to you, the blue-throated one, the radiant Parameṣṭhin, / Rudra composed of the three Vedas, the cause whose form is Time."

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prāha mahādevo rājānaṃ prītamānasaḥ /
imāni me rahasyāni nāmāni śṛṇu cānagha //
meaning:
तदा प्राह महादेवो राजानं प्रीतमानसः /
इमानि मे रहस्यानि नामानि शृणु चानघ //
text_mt: Then Mahādeva, his mind pleased, said to the king: / "Hear these secret names of mine, O sinless one,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedeṣu gītāni saṃsāraśamanāni tu /
namaskuruṣva nṛpate ebhirmāṃ satataṃ śuciḥ //
meaning:
सर्ववेदेषु गीतानि संसारशमनानि तु /
नमस्कुरुष्व नृपते एभिर्मां सततं शुचिः //
text_mt: "praised in all the Vedas and bringing an end to worldly existence; / bow down to me constantly with these, O ruler of men, being pure.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāyaṃ śatarudrīyaṃ yajuṣāṃ sāramuddhṛtam /
japasvānanyacetasko mayyāsaktamanā nṛpa //
meaning:
अध्यायं शतरुद्रीयं यजुषां सारमुद्धृतम् /
जपस्वानन्यचेतस्को मय्यासक्तमना नृप //
text_mt: "The Śatarudrīya hymn, extracted as the essence of the Yajus formulas, / recite with a single-pointed mind, your heart attached to me, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī mitāhāro bhasmaniṣṭhaḥ samāhitaḥ /
japedāmaraṇād rudraṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी मिताहारो भस्मनिष्ठः समाहितः /
जपेदामरणाद् रुद्रं स याति परमं पदम् //
text_mt: "Chaste, eating moderately, dedicated to [wearing] sacred ashes, concentrated, / whoever recites the Rudra [hymn] until death goes to the supreme state."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavān rudro bhaktānugrahakāmyayā /
punaḥ saṃvatsaraśataṃ rājñe hyāyurakalpayat //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रो भक्तानुग्रहकाम्यया /
पुनः संवत्सरशतं राज्ञे ह्यायुरकल्पयत् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the blessed Rudra, wishing to show grace to his devotee, / granted the king a lifespan of another hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvāsmai tat paraṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ parameśvaraḥ /
kṣaṇādantardadhe rudrastadadbhutamivābhavat //
meaning:
दत्त्वास्मै तत् परं ज्ञानं वैराग्यं परमेश्वरः /
क्षणादन्तर्दधे रुद्रस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् //
text_mt: Having bestowed that supreme knowledge and detachment upon him, the supreme lord / Rudra vanished in an instant; that was indeed wondrous.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāpi tapasā rudraṃ jajāpānanyamānasaḥ /
bhasmacchannastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā śāntaḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
राजापि तपसा रुद्रं जजापानन्यमानसः /
भस्मच्छन्नस्त्रिषवणं स्नात्वा शान्तः समाहितः //
text_mt: The king too recited the Rudra [hymn] with asceticism, his mind on no other, / covered in ashes, having bathed at the three junctures of the day, tranquil, concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
japatastasya nṛpateḥ pūrṇe varṣaśate punaḥ /
yogapravṛttirabhavat kālāt kālātmakaṃ param //
meaning:
जपतस्तस्य नृपतेः पूर्णे वर्षशते पुनः /
योगप्रवृत्तिरभवत् कालात् कालात्मकं परम् //
text_mt: As that king was reciting, when another hundred years had passed, / an engagement in yoga arose from [his master of] time, the supreme one whose nature is Time.

sanskrit_iast:
viveśa tad vedasāraṃ sthānaṃ vai parameṣṭhinaḥ /
bhānoḥ sa maṇḍalaṃ śubhraṃ tato yāto maheśvaram //
meaning:
विवेश तद् वेदसारं स्थानं वै परमेष्ठिनः /
भानोः स मण्डलं शुभ्रं ततो यातो महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: He entered that abode of Parameṣṭhin, the essence of the Vedas, / the bright orb of the sun, and from there he went to Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi rājñaścaritamuttamam /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekonaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि राज्ञश्चरितमुत्तमम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकोनविशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever reads or hears the excellent conduct of this king, / freed from all sins, is honored in the world of Brahmā.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tridhanvā rājaputrastu dharmeṇāpālayanmahīm /
tasya putro 'bhavad vidvāṃstrayyāruṇa iti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
त्रिधन्वा राजपुत्रस्तु धर्मेणापालयन्महीम् /
तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुण इति स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
And the prince Tridhanvan ruled the earth with righteousness; / his son was the learned one known as Trayyāruṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro 'bhūnmahābalaḥ /
bhāryā satyadhanā nāma hariścandramajījanat //
meaning:
तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारो ऽभून्महाबलः /
भार्या सत्यधना नाम हरिश्चन्द्रमजीजनत् //
text_mt: His son was Satyavrata, exceedingly strong; / his wife, named Satyadhanā, gave birth to Hariścandra.

sanskrit_iast:
hariścandrasya putro 'bhūd rohito nāma vīryavān /
harito rohitasyātha dhundhustasya suto 'bhavat //
meaning:
हरिश्चन्द्रस्य पुत्रो ऽभूद् रोहितो नाम वीर्यवान् /
हरितो रोहितस्याथ धुन्धुस्तस्य सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: The son of Hariścandra was the valiant Rohita; / Rohita's son was Harita, and Dhundhu was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
vijayaśca sudevaśca dhundhuputrau babhūvatuḥ /
vijayasyābhavat putraḥ kāruko nāma vīryavān //
meaning:
विजयश्च सुदेवश्च धुन्धुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः /
विजयस्याभवत् पुत्रः कारुको नाम वीर्यवान् //
text_mt: Vijaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Dhundhu; / Vijaya's son was the valiant Kāruka.

sanskrit_iast:
kārukasya vṛkaḥ putrastasmād bāhurajāyata /
sagarastasya putrau'bhūd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
कारुकस्य वृकः पुत्रस्तस्माद् बाहुरजायत /
सगरस्तस्य पुत्रौऽभूद् राजा परमधार्मिकः //
text_mt: The son of Kāruka was Vṛka; from him Bāhu was born; / Sagara was his son, a most righteous king.

sanskrit_iast:
dve bhārye sagarasyāpi prabhā bhānumatī tathā /
tābhyāmārādhitaḥ prādādaurvāgnirvaramuttamam //
meaning:
द्वे भार्ये सगरस्यापि प्रभा भानुमती तथा /
ताभ्यामाराधितः प्रादादौर्वाग्निर्वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Sagara had two wives: Prabhā and Bhānumatī; / worshipped by both of them, the Aurva fire granted an excellent boon.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ bhānumatī putramagṛhṇādasamañjasam /
prabhā ṣaṣṭisahastraṃ tu putrāṇāṃ jagṛhe śubhā //
meaning:
एकं भानुमती पुत्रमगृह्णादसमञ्जसम् /
प्रभा षष्टिसहस्त्रं तु पुत्राणां जगृहे शुभा //
text_mt: Bhānumatī chose a single son, Asamañjas; / the auspicious Prabhā chose sixty thousand sons.

sanskrit_iast:
asamañsasya tanayo hyaṃśumān nāma pārthivaḥ /
tasya putro dilīpastu dilīpāt tu bhagīrathaḥ //
meaning:
असमञ्सस्य तनयो ह्यंशुमान् नाम पार्थिवः /
तस्य पुत्रो दिलीपस्तु दिलीपात् तु भगीरथः //
text_mt: The son of Asamañjas was the king named Aṃśumat; / his son was Dilīpa, and from Dilīpa [came] Bhagīratha,

sanskrit_iast:
yena bhāgīrathī gaṅgā tapaḥ kṛtvāvatāritā /
prasādād devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
येन भागीरथी गङ्गा तपः कृत्वावतारिता /
प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः //
text_mt: by whom, having performed asceticism, the river Bhāgīrathī Gaṅgā was brought down / through the grace of the wise Mahādeva, the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathasya tapasā devaḥ prītamanā haraḥ /
babhāra śirasā gaṅgāṃ somānte somabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
भगीरथस्य तपसा देवः प्रीतमना हरः /
बभार शिरसा गङ्गां सोमान्ते सोमभूषणः //
text_mt: Pleased in mind by Bhagīratha's asceticism, the god Hara, / adorned with the moon, bore Gaṅgā on his head at the edge of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīrathasutaścāpi śruto nāma babhūva ha /
nābhāgastasya dāyādaḥ sindhudvīpastato 'bhavat //
meaning:
भगीरथसुतश्चापि श्रुतो नाम बभूव ह /
नाभागस्तस्य दायादः सिन्धुद्वीपस्ततो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: And the son of Bhagīratha was named Śruta; / his heir was Nābhāga, and from him came Sindhudvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutāyuḥ sutastasya ṛtuparṇastu tatsutaḥ /
ṛtuparṇasya putro 'bhūt sudāso nāma dhārmikāḥ /
saudāsastasya tanayaḥ khyātaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ //
meaning:
अयुतायुः सुतस्तस्य ऋतुपर्णस्तु तत्सुतः /
ऋतुपर्णस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् सुदासो नाम धार्मिकाः /
सौदासस्तस्य तनयः ख्यातः कल्माषपादकः //
text_mt: Ayutāyus was his son, and Ṛtuparṇa was his son; / Ṛtuparṇa's son was the righteous Sudāsa; / Saudāsa was his son, famous as Kalmāṣapāda.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhastu mahātejāḥ kṣetre kalmāṣapādake /
aśmakaṃ janayāmasā tamikṣvākukuladhvajam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके /
अश्मकं जनयामसा तमिक्ष्वाकुकुलध्वजम् //
text_mt: And the exceedingly splendid Vasiṣṭha, in the field of Kalmāṣapāda, / begat Aśmaka, the banner of the Ikṣvāku lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
aśmakasyotkalāyāṃ tu nakulo nāma pārthivaḥ /
sa hi rāmabhayād rājā vanaṃ prāpa suduḥ khitaḥ //
meaning:
अश्मकस्योत्कलायां तु नकुलो नाम पार्थिवः /
स हि रामभयाद् राजा वनं प्राप सुदुः खितः //
text_mt: To Aśmaka, in Utkalā, was born the king named Nakula; / he, in terror of Rāma, went to the forest, deeply sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhrat sa nārīkavacaṃ tasmācchataratho 'bhavat /
tasmād bilibiliḥ śrīmānvṛddhaśarmācatatsutaḥ //
meaning:
विभ्रत् स नारीकवचं तस्माच्छतरथो ऽभवत् /
तस्माद् बिलिबिलिः श्रीमान्वृद्धशर्माचतत्सुतः //
text_mt: Wearing a woman's armor, from him was born Śataratha; / from him came the glorious Bilibili, and his son was Vṛddhaśarman.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād viśvasahastasmāt khaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ /
dīrghabāhuḥ sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata //
meaning:
तस्माद् विश्वसहस्तस्मात् खट्वाङ्ग इति विश्रुतः /
दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत //
text_mt: From him came Viśvasaha; from him came the celebrated Khaṭvāṅga; / Dīrghabāhu was his son, and from him Raghu was born.

sanskrit_iast:
raghorajaḥ samutpanno rājā daśarathastataḥ /
rāmo dāśarathirvoro dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ //
meaning:
रघोरजः समुत्पन्नो राजा दशरथस्ततः /
रामो दाशरथिर्वोरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः //
text_mt: From Raghu, Aja was born, and from him King Daśaratha; / [from him was born] Rāma, the valiant son of Daśaratha, knower of righteousness, renowned throughout the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalaḥ /
sarve śakrasamā yuddhe viṣṇuśaktisamanvitāḥ /
jajñe rāvaṇanāśārthaṃ viṣṇuraṃśena viśvakṛt //
meaning:
भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलः /
सर्वे शक्रसमा युद्धे विष्णुशक्तिसमन्विताः /
जज्ञे रावणनाशार्थं विष्णुरंशेन विश्वकृत् //
text_mt: And Bharata, Lakṣmaṇa, and the mighty Śatrughna— / all were equal to Indra in battle, endowed with the power of Viṣṇu. / Viṣṇu, the creator of all, took birth in a portion [of himself] to destroy Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya subhagā bhāryā janakasyātmajā śubhā /
sītā trilokavikhyātā śīlaudāryaguṇānvitā //
meaning:
रामस्य सुभगा भार्या जनकस्यात्मजा शुभा /
सीता त्रिलोकविख्याता शीलौदार्यगुणान्विता //
text_mt: Rāma's fortunate and auspicious wife was the daughter of Janaka, / renowned across the three worlds, endowed with good character and nobility.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā toṣitā devī janakena girīndrajā /
prāyacchajjānakīṃ sītāṃ rāmamevāśritā patim //
meaning:
तपसा तोषिता देवी जनकेन गिरीन्द्रजा /
प्रायच्छज्जानकीं सीतां राममेवाश्रिता पतिम् //
text_mt: Pleased by Janaka's ascetic penance, the goddess, the daughter of the king of mountains, / gave him Jānakī Sītā, who had taken refuge in Rāma alone as her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
prītaśca bhagavānīśastriśūlī nīlalohitaḥ /
pradadau śatrunāśārthaṃ janakāyādbhutaṃ dhanuḥ //
meaning:
प्रीतश्च भगवानीशस्त्रिशूली नीललोहितः /
प्रददौ शत्रुनाशार्थं जनकायाद्भुतं धनुः //
text_mt: And the pleased lord, the ruler bearing the trident, Nīlalohita, / gave a wondrous bow to Janaka for the destruction of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rājā janako vidvān dātukāmaḥ sutāmimām /
aghoṣayadamitraghno loke 'smin dvijapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
स राजा जनको विद्वान् दातुकामः सुतामिमाम् /
अघोषयदमित्रघ्नो लोके ऽस्मिन् द्विजपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Wishing to give away this daughter, that wise king Janaka, / the slayer of his foes, proclaimed in this world, O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ dhanuḥ samādātuṃ yaḥ śaknoti jagattraye /
devo vā dānavo vāpi sa sītāṃ labdhumarhati //
meaning:
इदं धनुः समादातुं यः शक्नोति जगत्त्रये /
देवो वा दानवो वापि स सीतां लब्धुमर्हति //
text_mt: “Whoever in the three worlds is able to lift this bow, / whether god or demon, he is worthy to obtain Sītā.”

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāya rāmo balavān janakasya gṛhaṃ prabhuḥ /
bhañjayāmāsa cādāya gatvāsau līlayaiva hi //
meaning:
विज्ञाय रामो बलवान् जनकस्य गृहं प्रभुः /
भञ्जयामास चादाय गत्वासौ लीलयैव हि //
text_mt: Having learned this, the powerful lord Rāma went to Janaka's house, / and taking it up, he broke it in mere sport.

sanskrit_iast:
udvavāha ca tāṃ kanyāṃ pārvatīmiva śaṅkaraḥ /
rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā senāmiva ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ //
meaning:
उद्ववाह च तां कन्यां पार्वतीमिव शङ्करः /
रामः परमधर्मात्मा सेनामिव च षण्मुखः //
text_mt: And Rāma, supreme in righteousness, married that maiden, / as Śaṅkara [married] Pārvatī, and as the six-faced god [married] Devasenā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bahutithe kāle rājā daśarathaḥ svayam /
rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumārabhat //
meaning:
ततो बहुतिथे काले राजा दशरथः स्वयम् /
रामं ज्येष्ठं सुतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमारभत् //
text_mt: Then, after a long time had passed, King Daśaratha himself / began preparations to make his eldest, heroic son Rāma king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyātha patnī subhagā kaikeyī cārubhāṣiṇī /
nivārayāmāsa patiṃ prāha saṃbhrāntamānasā //
meaning:
तस्याथ पत्नी सुभगा कैकेयी चारुभाषिणी /
निवारयामास पतिं प्राह संभ्रान्तमानसा //
text_mt: Then his fortunate wife Kaikeyī, of sweet speech, / prevented her husband, and, her mind agitated, said:

sanskrit_iast:
matsutaṃ bharataṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumarhasi /
pūrvameva varo yasmād datto me bhavatā yataḥ //
meaning:
मत्सुतं भरतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमर्हसि /
पूर्वमेव वरो यस्माद् दत्तो मे भवता यतः //
text_mt: “You ought to make my heroic son Bharata king, / because a boon was previously given to me by your majesty.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā duḥ khitamānasaḥ /
bāḍhamityabravīd vākyaṃ tathā rāmo 'pi dharmavit //
meaning:
स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दुः खितमानसः /
बाढमित्यब्रवीद् वाक्यं तथा रामो ऽपि धर्मवित् //
text_mt: Hearing her words, the king, his mind grieving, / said, “So be it,” and likewise Rāma, the knower of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyātha pituḥ pādau lakṣmaṇena sahācyutaḥ /
yayau vanaṃ sapatnīkaḥ kṛtvā samayamātmavān //
meaning:
प्रणम्याथ पितुः पादौ लक्ष्मणेन सहाच्युतः /
ययौ वनं सपत्नीकः कृत्वा समयमात्मवान् //
text_mt: Then, bowing at his father's feet, the steadfast, imperishable one, / keeping his promise, went to the forest with Lakṣmaṇa and his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarāṇāṃ catvāri daśa caiva mahābalaḥ /
uvāsa tatra matimān lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ //
meaning:
संवत्सराणां चत्वारि दश चैव महाबलः /
उवास तत्र मतिमान् लक्ष्मणेन सह प्रभुः //
text_mt: For ten and four years, / the mighty, wise lord dwelt there with Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācid vasato 'raṇye rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ /
parivrājakaveṣeṇa sītāṃ hṛtvā yayau purīm //
meaning:
कदाचिद् वसतो ऽरण्ये रावणो नाम राक्षसः /
परिव्राजकवेषेण सीतां हृत्वा ययौ पुरीम् //
text_mt: Once, as he was dwelling in the forest, a demon named Rāvaṇa / carried off Sītā in the guise of a wandering mendicant and went to his city.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇo rāmaḥ sītāmākulitendriyau /
duḥ khaśokābhisaṃtaptau babhūvaturarindamau //
meaning:
अदृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणो रामः सीतामाकुलितेन्द्रियौ /
दुः खशोकाभिसंतप्तौ बभूवतुररिन्दमौ //
text_mt: Not seeing Sītā, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, their senses bewildered, / were consumed by pain and grief, those subduers of foes.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kadācit kapinā sugrīveṇa dvijottamāḥ /
vānarāṇāmabhūt sakhyaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततः कदाचित् कपिना सुग्रीवेण द्विजोत्तमाः /
वानराणामभूत् सख्यं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः //
text_mt: Then, at some time, O best of the twice-born, friendship was forged / between Rāma of untiring deeds and the monkey Sugrīva, [leader] of the monkeys.

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvasyānugo vīro hanumān nma vānaraḥ /
vāyuputrau mahātejā rāmasyāsīt priyaḥ sadā //
meaning:
सुग्रीवस्यानुगो वीरो हनुमान् न्म वानरः /
वायुपुत्रौ महातेजा रामस्यासीत् प्रियः सदा //
text_mt: A follower of Sugrīva was the heroic monkey named Hanumān, / son of the wind, possessed of great splendor, who was ever dear to Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛtvā paramaṃ dhairyaṃ rāmāya kṛtaniścayaḥ /
ānayiṣyāmi tāṃ sītāmityuktvā vicacāra ha //
meaning:
स कृत्वा परमं धैर्यं रामाय कृतनिश्चयः /
आनयिष्यामि तां सीतामित्युक्त्वा विचचार ह //
text_mt: Summoning supreme resolve, firmly determined for Rāma's sake, / he wandered forth, saying, “I will bring back Sītā.”

sanskrit_iast:
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ sītādarśanatatparaḥ /
jagāma rāvaṇapurīṃ laṅkāṃ sāgarasaṃsthitām //
meaning:
महीं सागरपर्यन्तां सीतादर्शनतत्परः /
जगाम रावणपुरीं लङ्कां सागरसंस्थिताम् //
text_mt: Traversing the earth to the ocean's edge, intent on seeing Sītā, / he went to Rāvaṇa's city, Laṅkā, situated in the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrātha nirjane deśe vṛkṣmūle śucismitām /
apaśyadamalāṃ sītāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām //
meaning:
तत्राथ निर्जने देशे वृक्ष्मूले शुचिस्मिताम् /
अपश्यदमलां सीतां राक्षसीभिः समावृताम् //
text_mt: There, in a lonely place at the foot of a tree, he saw / the pure Sītā of bright smiles, surrounded by demonesses,

sanskrit_iast:
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇāṃ hṛdyāṃ saṃsmarantīmaninditām /
rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ cātmasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणां हृद्यां संस्मरन्तीमनिन्दिताम् /
राममिन्दीवरश्यामं लक्ष्मणं चात्मसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: her eyes filled with tears, charming and blameless, / remembering Rāma, dark as a blue lotus, and Lakṣmaṇa, dwelling in her heart.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayitvā cātmānaṃ sītāyai rahasi svayam /
asaṃśayāya pradadāvasyai rāmāṅgulīyakam //
meaning:
निवेदयित्वा चात्मानं सीतायै रहसि स्वयम् /
असंशयाय प्रददावस्यै रामाङ्गुलीयकम् //
text_mt: Having revealed himself to Sītā alone in secret, / he gave her Rāma's signet ring to dispel doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāṅgulīyakaṃ sītā patyuḥ paramaśobhanam /
mene samāgataṃ rāmaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वाङ्गुलीयकं सीता पत्युः परमशोभनम् /
मेने समागतं रामं प्रीतिविस्फारितेक्षणा //
text_mt: Seeing her husband's most splendid signet ring, Sītā, / her eyes wide with joy, felt that Rāma had arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
samāśvāsya tadā sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya cāntikam /
nayiṣye tvāṃ mahābāhuruktvā rāmaṃ yayau punaḥ //
meaning:
समाश्वास्य तदा सीतां दृष्ट्वा रामस्य चान्तिकम् /
नयिष्ये त्वां महाबाहुरुक्त्वा रामं ययौ पुनः //
text_mt: Having then consoled Sītā, and having seen her, the mighty-armed one said, / “I will bring Rāma to you,” and went back to Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayitvā rāmāya sītādarśanamātmavān /
tasthau rāmeṇa purato lakṣmaṇena ca pūjitaḥ //
meaning:
निवेदयित्वा रामाय सीतादर्शनमात्मवान् /
तस्थौ रामेण पुरतो लक्ष्मणेन च पूजितः //
text_mt: The self-restrained one, having reported the sight of Sītā to Rāma, / stood before him, honored by Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa rāmo balavān sārdhaṃ hanumatā svayam /
lakṣmaṇena ca yuddhāya buddhiṃ cakre hi rakṣasām //
meaning:
ततः स रामो बलवान् सार्धं हनुमता स्वयम् /
लक्ष्मणेन च युद्धाय बुद्धिं चक्रे हि रक्षसाम् //
text_mt: Then the mighty Rāma himself, along with Hanumān / and Lakṣmaṇa, set his mind on battle with the demons.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātha vānaraśatairlaṅkāmārgaṃ mahodadheḥ /
setuṃ paramadharmātmā rāvaṇaṃ hatavān prabhuḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वाथ वानरशतैर्लङ्कामार्गं महोदधेः /
सेतुं परमधर्मात्मा रावणं हतवान् प्रभुः //
text_mt: Then, having built a bridge over the ocean towards Laṅkā with hundreds of monkeys, / the lord of supreme righteousness slew Rāvaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnīkaṃ ca sasutaṃ sabhrātṛkamaridamaḥ /
ānayāmāsa tāṃ sītāṃ vāyuputrasahāyavān //
meaning:
सपत्नीकं च ससुतं सभ्रातृकमरिदमः /
आनयामास तां सीतां वायुपुत्रसहायवान् //
text_mt: along with his wives, sons, and brothers; and that subduer of foes, / aided by the son of the wind, brought back Sītā.

sanskrit_iast:
setumadhye mahādevamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam /
sthāpayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ //
meaning:
सेतुमध्ये महादेवमीशानं कृत्तिवाससम् /
स्थापयामास लिङ्गस्थं पूजयामास राघवः //
text_mt: In the middle of the bridge, the descendant of Raghu consecrated Mahādeva, / Īśāna, clothed in animal skins, present in a liṅga, and worshipped him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devo mahādevaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ /
pratyakṣameva bhagavān dattavān varamuttamam //
meaning:
तस्य देवो महादेवः पार्वत्या सह शङ्करः /
प्रत्यक्षमेव भगवान् दत्तवान् वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The blessed god Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, along with Pārvatī, / appeared visibly before him and granted him an excellent boon:

sanskrit_iast:
yat tvayā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ drakṣyantīha dvijātayaḥ /
mahāpātakasaṃyuktāsteṣāṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyatu //
meaning:
यत् त्वया स्थापितं लिङ्गं द्रक्ष्यन्तीह द्विजातयः /
महापातकसंयुक्तास्तेषां पापं विनश्यतु //
text_mt: “The twice-born who see the liṅga established by you here, / even if joined with great sins, may their sin be destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāni caiva pāpāni snātasyātra mahodadhau /
darśanādeva liṅgasalya nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यानि चैव पापानि स्नातस्यात्र महोदधौ /
दर्शनादेव लिङ्गसल्य नाशं यान्ति न संशयः //
text_mt: And for one who has bathed here in the great ocean, other sins too / go to destruction merely from the sight of the liṅga; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat sthāsyanti girayo yāvadeṣā ca medinī /
yāvat setuśca tāvacca sthāsyāmyatra tirohitaḥ //
meaning:
यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयो यावदेषा च मेदिनी /
यावत् सेतुश्च तावच्च स्थास्याम्यत्र तिरोहितः //
text_mt: As long as mountains shall stand, and as long as this earth, / and as long as the bridge remains, so long shall I remain hidden here.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyatyakṣyaṃ kṛtam /
smaraṇādeva liṅgasya dinapāpaṃ praṇaśyati //
meaning:
स्नानं दानं जपः श्राद्धं भविष्यत्यक्ष्यं कृतम् /
स्मरणादेव लिङ्गस्य दिनपापं प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: Bathing, giving, recitation, and ancestral offering rites performed [here] will be inexhaustible; / merely from remembering the liṅga, the sin of the day is destroyed.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ pariṣvajya tu rāghavam /
sanandī sagaṇo rudrastatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्छंभुः परिष्वज्य तु राघवम् /
सनन्दी सगणो रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Having spoken thus and embraced the descendant of Raghu, the blessed Śambhu, / Rudra, along with Nandī and his attendants, vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi pālayāmāsa rājyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ /
abhiṣikto mahātejā bharatena mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि पालयामास राज्यं धर्मपरायणः /
अभिषिक्तो महातेजा भरतेन महाबलः //
text_mt: Rāma also, devoted to righteousness, protected the kingdom, / consecrated by Bharata, possessed of great splendor and mighty power.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣāḍh brāhmaṇān sarvān pūjayāmasaceśvaram /
yajñena yajñahantāramaśvamedhena śaṅkaram //
meaning:
विशेषाढ् ब्राह्मणान् सर्वान् पूजयामसचेश्वरम् /
यज्ञेन यज्ञहन्तारमश्वमेधेन शङ्करम् //
text_mt: He especially honored all the brāhmaṇas and worshipped the Lord, / Śaṅkara, the destroyer of the sacrifice, with the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya tanayo jajñe kuśa ityabhiviśrutaḥ /
lavaśca sumahābhāgaḥ sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ //
meaning:
रामस्य तनयो जज्ञे कुश इत्यभिविश्रुतः /
लवश्च सुमहाभागः सर्वतत्त्वार्थवित् सुधीः //
text_mt: To Rāma was born a son renowned as Kuśa, / and the highly fortunate Lava, wise and knowing the true meaning of all things.

sanskrit_iast:
atithistu kuśājjajñe niṣadhastatsuto 'bhavat /
nalastu niṣadhasyābhūnnabhastamādajāyata //
meaning:
अतिथिस्तु कुशाज्जज्ञे निषधस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
नलस्तु निषधस्याभून्नभस्तमादजायत //
text_mt: From Kuśa, Atithi was born, and Niṣadha was his son; / Nala was born to Niṣadha, and from him Nabhas was born.

sanskrit_iast:
nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīkākhyaḥ kṣemadhanvā ca tatsutaḥ /
tasya putro 'bhavad vīro devānīkaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
नभसः पुण्डरीकाख्यः क्षेमधन्वा च तत्सुतः /
तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वीरो देवानीकः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: From Nabhas was born the one named Puṇḍarīka, and Kṣemadhanvan was his son; / his son was the heroic, glorious Devānīka.

sanskrit_iast:
ahīnagustasya suto sahasvāṃstatsuto 'bhavat /
tasmāccandrāvalokastu tārāpīḍastu tatsutaḥ //
meaning:
अहीनगुस्तस्य सुतो सहस्वांस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
तस्माच्चन्द्रावलोकस्तु तारापीडस्तु तत्सुतः //
text_mt: Ahīnagu was his son; Sahasvān was his son; / from him came Candrāvaloka, and Tārāpīḍa was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāpīḍāccandragirirbhānuvittastato 'bhavat /
śrutāyurabhavat tasmādete ikṣvākuvaṃśajāḥ /
sarve prādhānyataḥ proktāḥ samāsena dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
तारापीडाच्चन्द्रगिरिर्भानुवित्तस्ततो ऽभवत् /
श्रुतायुरभवत् तस्मादेते इक्ष्वाकुवंशजाः /
सर्वे प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ताः समासेन द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: From Tārāpīḍa came Candragiri, and then Bhānuvitta; / from him was born Śrutāyus. These are born of the Ikṣvāku lineage, / all proclaimed in summary according to their importance, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityamikṣvākorvaṃśamuttamam /
sarvapāpavinirmukto svargaloke mahīyate //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यमिक्ष्वाकोर्वंशमुत्तमम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे विशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever constantly listens to this excellent lineage of Ikṣvāku, / freed from all sins, is honored in the heavenly realm.

Thus ends the twentieth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
romaharṣaṇa uvāca
ailaḥ purūravāścātha rājā rājyamapālayat /
tasya putrā babhūvurhi ṣaḍindrasamatejasaḥ //
meaning:
रोमहर्षण उवाच
ऐलः पुरूरवाश्चाथ राजा राज्यमपालयत् /
तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि षडिन्द्रसमतेजसः //
text_mt: Romaharṣaṇa said: / And then King Purūravas, son of Ilā, ruled the kingdom; / his sons indeed were six, equal in splendor to Indra:

sanskrit_iast:
āyurmāyuramāvāyurviśvāyuścaiva vīryavān /
śatāyuśca śrutāyuśca divyāścaivorvaśīsutāḥ //
meaning:
आयुर्मायुरमावायुर्विश्वायुश्चैव वीर्यवान् /
शतायुश्च श्रुतायुश्च दिव्याश्चैवोर्वशीसुताः //
text_mt: Āyus, Māyus, Amāvāyu, and the valiant Viśvāyu, / Śatāyus, and Śrutāyus—divine sons of Urvaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣastanayā vīrāḥ pañcaivāsan mahaujasaḥ /
svarbhānutanayāyāṃ vai prabhāyāmiti naḥ śrutam //
meaning:
आयुषस्तनया वीराः पञ्चैवासन् महौजसः /
स्वर्भानुतनयायां वै प्रभायामिति नः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: The heroic sons of Āyus were five, of great power, / born of Prabhā, daughter of Svarbhānu; so it is heard by us.

sanskrit_iast:
nahuṣaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ /
nahuṣasya tu dāyādāḥ ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ //
meaning:
नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः /
नहुषस्य तु दायादाः षडिन्द्रोपमतेजसः //
text_mt: The first among them was Nahuṣa, who knew duty and was renowned throughout the world. / Nahuṣa had six heirs, whose splendour was equal to Indra's.

sanskrit_iast:
utpannāḥ pitṛkanyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ mahābalāḥ /
yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyātiḥ pañcako 'śvakaḥ //
meaning:
उत्पन्नाः पितृकन्यायां विरजायां महाबलाः /
यतिर्ययातिः संयातिरायातिः पञ्चको ऽश्वकः //
text_mt: They were born of the ancestor's daughter Virajā and possessed immense strength: / Yati, Yayāti, Saṃyāti, Āyāti, the fifth, and Aśvaka.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ yayātiḥ pañcānāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ /
devayānīmukhanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa saḥ /
śarmiṣṭhāmāsurīṃ caiva tanayāṃ vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां ययातिः पञ्चानां महाबलपराक्रमः /
देवयानीमुखनसः सुतां भार्यामवाप सः /
शर्मिष्ठामासुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः //
text_mt: Among those five, Yayāti was possessed of great strength and prowess. / He obtained Devayānī, daughter of Uśanas, as his wife, / and also the Asura maiden Śarmiṣṭhā, the daughter of Vṛṣaparvan.

sanskrit_iast:
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata /
druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā cāpyajījanat //
meaning:
यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत /
द्रुह्युं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा चाप्यजीजनत् //
text_mt: Devayānī gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu, / and Śarmiṣṭhā also brought forth Druhyu, Anu, and Pūru.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'bhyaṣiñcadatikramya jyeṣṭhaṃ yadumaninditam /
purumeva kanīyāsaṃ piturvacanapālakam //
meaning:
सो ऽभ्यषिञ्चदतिक्रम्य ज्येष्ठं यदुमनिन्दितम् /
पुरुमेव कनीयासं पितुर्वचनपालकम् //
text_mt: Passing over the eldest, the blameless Yadu, he consecrated / Pūru, the youngest, who had obeyed his father's command.

sanskrit_iast:
diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ putramādiśat /
dakṣiṇāparayo rājā yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat /
pratīcyāmuttārāyāṃ ca druhyuṃ cānumakalpayat //
meaning:
दिशि दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां तुर्वसुं पुत्रमादिशत् /
दक्षिणापरयो राजा यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत् /
प्रतीच्यामुत्तारायां च द्रुह्युं चानुमकल्पयत् //
text_mt: He assigned his son Turvasu to the south-eastern direction; / the king appointed the eldest, Yadu, over the south and west, / and designated Druhyu and Anu for the west and north.

sanskrit_iast:
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dharmataḥ paripālitā /
rājāpi dārasahito navaṃ prāpa mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा धर्मतः परिपालिता /
राजापि दारसहितो नवं प्राप महायशाः //
text_mt: By them this entire earth was protected righteously. / The king too, of great renown, accompanied by his wife, reached heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yadorapyabhavan putrāḥ pañca devasutopamāḥ /
sahastrajit tathājyeṣṭhaḥ kroṣaṭurnālo 'jitoraghuḥ //
meaning:
यदोरप्यभवन् पुत्राः पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः /
सहस्त्रजित् तथाज्येष्ठः क्रोषटुर्नालो ऽजितोरघुः //
text_mt: To Yadu also were born five sons equal to the sons of gods: / Sahasrajit, who was the eldest, then Kroṣṭu, Nīla, Ajita, and Raghu.

sanskrit_iast:
sahastrajitsutastadvacchatajinnāma pārthivaḥ /
sutāḥ śatajito 'pyāsaṃstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ //
meaning:
सहस्त्रजित्सुतस्तद्वच्छतजिन्नाम पार्थिवः /
सुताः शतजितो ऽप्यासंस्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः //
text_mt: Sahasrajit's son likewise was the king named Śatajit. / Śatajit had three sons who were exceedingly righteous:

sanskrit_iast:
haihayaśca hayaścaiva rājā veṇuhayaḥ paraḥ /
haihayasyābhavat putro dharma ityabhiviśrutaḥ //
meaning:
हैहयश्च हयश्चैव राजा वेणुहयः परः /
हैहयस्याभवत् पुत्रो धर्म इत्यभिविश्रुतः //
text_mt: Haihaya, Haya, and King Veṇuhaya, the other one. / Haihaya's son was well known as Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro 'bhavad viprā dharmanetraḥ pratāpavān /
dharmanetrasya kīrtistu saṃjitastatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् विप्रा धर्मनेत्रः प्रतापवान् /
धर्मनेत्रस्य कीर्तिस्तु संजितस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: His son, O Brahmins, was the powerful Dharmanetra; / the renowned son of Dharmanetra was Saṃjit.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣmān saṃjitasyābhūd bhadraśreṇyastadanvayaḥ /
bhadraśreṇyasya dāyādo durdamo nāma pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
महिष्मान् संजितस्याभूद् भद्रश्रेण्यस्तदन्वयः /
भद्रश्रेण्यस्य दायादो दुर्दमो नाम पार्थिवः //
text_mt: Mahiṣmān was the son of Saṃjit; Bhadraśreṇya was in his lineage; / Bhadraśreṇya's heir was the king named Durdama.

sanskrit_iast:
durdamasya suto dhīmān dhanako nāma vīryavān /
dhanakasya tu dāyādāścatvāro lokasammatāḥ //
meaning:
दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् धनको नाम वीर्यवान् /
धनकस्य तु दायादाश्चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः //
text_mt: Durdama's son was the wise and valorous Dhanaka. / Dhanaka had four heirs acclaimed by the world:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtāgniśca kṛtavarmā tathaiva ca /
kṛtaujāśca caturtho 'bhūt kārtavīryor'juno 'bhavat //
meaning:
कृतवीर्यः कृताग्निश्च कृतवर्मा तथैव च /
कृतौजाश्च चतुर्थो ऽभूत् कार्तवीर्योर्ऽजुनो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Kṛtavīrya, Kṛtāgni, Kṛtavarman, / and Kṛtaujas was the fourth. Kṛtavīrya's son was Arjuna.

sanskrit_iast:
sahastrabāhurdyutimān dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ /
tasya rāmo 'bhavanmṛtyurjāmadagnyo janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्त्रबाहुर्द्युतिमान् धनुर्वेदविदां वरः /
तस्य रामो ऽभवन्मृत्युर्जामदग्न्यो जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Possessed of a thousand arms, radiant, and foremost among knowers of the science of archery, / his death was Rāma Jāmadagnya, who is Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putraśatānyāsan pañca tatra mahārathāḥ /
kṛtāstrā balinaḥ śūrā dharmātmāno namasvinaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रशतान्यासन् पञ्च तत्र महारथाः /
कृतास्त्रा बलिनः शूरा धर्मात्मानो नमस्विनः //
text_mt: He had five hundred sons, great chariot-warriors, / skilled in weapons, mighty, heroic, righteous, and humble.

sanskrit_iast:
śūraśca śūrasenaśca dhṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca /
jayadhvajaśca balavān nārāyaṇaparo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
शूरश्च शूरसेनश्च धृष्णः कृष्णस्तथैव च /
जयध्वजश्च बलवान् नारायणपरो नृपः //
text_mt: Śūra, Śūrasena, Dhṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa, / and the mighty King Jayadhvaja, who was devoted to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrasenādayaḥ sarve catvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ /
rudrabhaktā mahātmānaḥ pūjayanti sma śaṅkaram //
meaning:
शूरसेनादयः सर्वे चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः /
रुद्रभक्ता महात्मानः पूजयन्ति स्म शङ्करम् //
text_mt: The other four, beginning with Śūrasena, famed for their splendour, / were high-minded devotees of Rudra and worshipped Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
jayadhvajastu matimān devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim /
jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ daivataṃ dharmatatparaḥ //
meaning:
जयध्वजस्तु मतिमान् देवं नारायणं हरिम् /
जगाम शरणं विष्णुं दैवतं धर्मतत्परः //
text_mt: The wise Jayadhvaja, intent on duty, went for refuge / to the god Nārāyaṇa Hari, to the deity Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tamūcuritare putrā nāyaṃ dharmastavānagha /
īśvarārādhanarataḥ pitāsmākamabhūditi //
meaning:
तमूचुरितरे पुत्रा नायं धर्मस्तवानघ /
ईश्वराराधनरतः पितास्माकमभूदिति //
text_mt: The other sons said to him: 'O sinless one, this is not your duty; / our father was devoted to the worship of Īśvara.'

sanskrit_iast:
tānabravīnmahātejā eṣa dharmaḥ paro mama /
viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtā rājāno yanmahītale //
meaning:
तानब्रवीन्महातेजा एष धर्मः परो मम /
विष्णोरंशेन संभूता राजानो यन्महीतले //
text_mt: He of great splendour said to them: 'This is my highest duty, / for kings on the face of the earth are born from a portion of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ pālayatāvaśyaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ /
pūjanīyo yato viṣṇuḥ pālako jagato hariḥ //
meaning:
राज्यं पालयतावश्यं भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः /
पूजनीयो यतो विष्णुः पालको जगतो हरिः //
text_mt: By one who protects a kingdom, the Lord, the Supreme Spirit, must surely be worshipped, / since Viṣṇu Hari is the protector of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ca svayaṃbhuvaḥ /
tistrastu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ //
meaning:
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी च स्वयंभुवः /
तिस्त्रस्तु मूर्तयः प्रोक्ताः सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतवः //
text_mt: Three forms of the Self-born are declared, / characterized by purity, passion, and darkness, being the causes of creation, preservation, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ saṃsthāpayati sarvadā /
sṛjed brahmā rajomūrtiḥ saṃharet tāmaso haraḥ //
meaning:
सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णुः संस्थापयति सर्वदा /
सृजेद् ब्रह्मा रजोमूर्तिः संहरेत् तामसो हरः //
text_mt: Lord Viṣṇu, whose essence is purity, always sustains [it]; / Brahmā, having passion as his form, creates; and Hara, composed of darkness, dissolves [it].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmahīpatīnāṃ tu rājyaṃ pālayatāmayam /
ārādhyo bhagavān viṣṇuḥ keśavaḥ keśimardanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्महीपतीनां तु राज्यं पालयतामयम् /
आराध्यो भगवान् विष्णुः केशवः केशिमर्दनः //
text_mt: Therefore, by kings who protect their kingdom, this Lord / Viṣṇu, Keśava, the slayer of Keśin, is to be worshipped.'

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya tasya vacanaṃ bhrātaro 'nye manasvinaḥ /
procuḥ saṃhārakṛd rudraḥ pūjanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ //
meaning:
निशम्य तस्य वचनं भ्रातरो ऽन्ये मनस्विनः /
प्रोचुः संहारकृद् रुद्रः पूजनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः //
text_mt: Hearing his words, the other high-minded brothers / said: 'Rudra, the author of dissolution, must be worshipped by seekers of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ hi bhagavān rudraḥ sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ śivaḥ /
tamoguṇaṃ samāśritya kalpānte saṃharet prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अयं हि भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वं जगदिदं शिवः /
तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य कल्पान्ते संहरेत् प्रभुः //
text_mt: For this Lord Rudra, Śiva, the master, / having resorted to the quality of darkness, dissolves this entire universe at the end of an aeon.

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā ghoratarā mūrtirasya tejāmayī parā /
saṃhared vidyayā sarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ śūlabhṛt tayā //
meaning:
या सा घोरतरा मूर्तिरस्य तेजामयी परा /
संहरेद् विद्यया सर्वं संसारं शूलभृत् तया //
text_mt: Through that supreme and fiercest form of his, full of splendour, / the trident-bearer, by means of knowledge, dissolves the whole worldly cycle.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastānabravīd rājā vicintyāsau jayadhvajaḥ /
sattvena mucyate jantuḥ sattvātmā bhagavān hariḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तानब्रवीद् राजा विचिन्त्यासौ जयध्वजः /
सत्त्वेन मुच्यते जन्तुः सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् हरिः //
text_mt: Then King Jayadhvaja, having reflected, said to them: / 'A creature is liberated through purity, and Lord Hari is the essence of purity.'

sanskrit_iast:
tamūcurbhrātaro rudraḥ sevitaḥ sāttvikairjanaiḥ /
mocayet sattvasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayeśaṃ tato haram //
meaning:
तमूचुर्भ्रातरो रुद्रः सेवितः सात्त्विकैर्जनैः /
मोचयेत् सत्त्वसंयुक्तः पूजयेशं ततो हरम् //
text_mt: The brothers said to him: 'Rudra, when served by pure people / and accompanied by purity, liberates. Therefore, worship the Lord, Hara.'

sanskrit_iast:
athābravīd rājaputraḥ prahasan vai jayadhvajaḥ /
svadharmo muktaye panthā nānyo munibhiraṣyate //
meaning:
अथाब्रवीद् राजपुत्रः प्रहसन् वै जयध्वजः /
स्वधर्मो मुक्तये पन्था नान्यो मुनिभिरष्यते //
text_mt: Then the prince Jayadhvaja, smiling, said: / 'One's own duty is the path to liberation; no other is sought by the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā ca vaiṣṇavī śaktirnṛpāṇāṃ devatā sadā /
ārādhanaṃ paro dharmo purāreramitaujasaḥ //
meaning:
तथा च वैष्णवी शक्तिर्नृपाणां देवता सदा /
आराधनं परो धर्मो पुरारेरमितौजसः //
text_mt: Moreover, the power of Viṣṇu is always the deity of kings; / yet worship of the foe of Tripura, who is of boundless splendour, is also a supreme duty.'

sanskrit_iast:
tamabravīd rājaputraḥ kṛṣṇo matimatāṃ varaḥ /
yadarjuno 'smajjanakaḥ svadharmaṃ kṛtavāniti //
meaning:
तमब्रवीद् राजपुत्रः कृष्णो मतिमतां वरः /
यदर्जुनो ऽस्मज्जनकः स्वधर्मं कृतवानिति //
text_mt: The prince Kṛṣṇa, foremost among the wise, said to him: / 'Since our father Arjuna followed his own duty, [so should we].'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vivāde vitate śūraseno 'bravīd vacaḥ /
pramāṇamṛṣayo hyatra brūyuste yat tathaiva tat //
meaning:
एवं विवादे वितते शूरसेनो ऽब्रवीद् वचः /
प्रमाणमृषयो ह्यत्र ब्रूयुस्ते यत् तथैव तत् //
text_mt: While the debate was thus prolonged, Śūrasena spoke these words: / 'The sages are the authority in this matter; whatever they say is truly so.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataste rājaśārdūlāḥ papracchurbrahmavādinaḥ /
gatvā sarve susaṃrabdhāḥ saptarṣoṇāṃ tadāśramam //
meaning:
ततस्ते राजशार्दूलाः पप्रच्छुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः /
गत्वा सर्वे सुसंरब्धाः सप्तर्षोणां तदाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Then those best of kings, all being very eager, went / to the hermitage of the seven sages and questioned the exponents of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
tānabruvaṃste munayo vasiṣṭhādyā yathārthataḥ /
yā yasyābhimatā puṃsaḥ sā hi tasyaiva devatā //
meaning:
तानब्रुवंस्ते मुनयो वसिष्ठाद्या यथार्थतः /
या यस्याभिमता पुंसः सा हि तस्यैव देवता //
text_mt: Those sages, Vasiṣṭha and the others, spoke truthfully to them: / 'Whichever deity is preferred by a person, that is indeed their deity.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu kāryaviśeṣeṇa pūjitāśceṣṭadā nṛṇām /
viśeṣāt sarvadā nāyaṃ niyamo hyanyathā nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
किन्तु कार्यविशेषेण पूजिताश्चेष्टदा नृणाम् /
विशेषात् सर्वदा नायं नियमो ह्यन्यथा नृपाः //
text_mt: However, when worshipped according to specific needs, they grant human desires; / this rule, O kings, is not otherwise, especially at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpāṇāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca purandaraḥ /
viprāṇāmagnirādityo brahmā caiva pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
नृपाणां दैवतं विष्णुस्तथैव च पुरन्दरः /
विप्राणामग्निरादित्यो ब्रह्मा चैव पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt: The deity of kings is Viṣṇu, and likewise Indra; / of Brahmins, Fire, the Sun, Brahmā, and the wielder of the Pināka.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇurdānavānāṃ triśūlabhṛt /
gandharvāṇāṃ tathā somo yakṣāṇāmapi kathyate //
meaning:
देवानां दैवतं विष्णुर्दानवानां त्रिशूलभृत् /
गन्धर्वाणां तथा सोमो यक्षाणामपि कथ्यते //
text_mt: The deity of the gods is Viṣṇu; of the Dānavas, the wielder of the trident; / of the Gandharvas and of the Yakṣas, Soma is declared to be such;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādharāṇāṃ vāgdevī sādhyānāṃ bhagavānraviḥ /
rakṣasāṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ kiṃnarāṇāṃ ca pārvatī //
meaning:
विद्याधराणां वाग्देवी साध्यानां भगवान्रविः /
रक्षसां शङ्करो रुद्रः किंनराणां च पार्वती //
text_mt: of the Vidyādharas, the Goddess of Speech; of the Sādhyas, the Lord Sun; / of the Rākṣasas, Śaṅkara Rudra; and of the Kinnaras, Pārvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ daivataṃ brahmā mahādevaśca śūlabhṛt /
manūnāṃ syādumā devī tathā viṣṇuḥ sabhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
ऋषीणां दैवतं ब्रह्मा महादेवश्च शूलभृत् /
मनूनां स्यादुमा देवी तथा विष्णुः सभास्करः //
text_mt: of the sages, the deity is Brahmā and Mahādeva, the trident-bearer; / of the Manus, it is the goddess Umā, as well as Viṣṇu along with the Sun;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthānāṃ ca sarve syurbrahmā vai brahmacāriṇām /
vaikhānasānāmarkaḥ syād yatīnāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्थानां च सर्वे स्युर्ब्रह्मा वै ब्रह्मचारिणाम् /
वैखानसानामर्कः स्याद् यतीनां च महेश्वरः //
text_mt: of householders, all of them; Brahmā for celibate students; / for the Vaikhānasa ascetics, the Sun; and for renunciants, Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtānāṃ bhagavān rudraḥ kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ vināyakaḥ /
sarveṣāṃ bhagavān brahmā devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
भूतानां भगवान् रुद्रः कूष्माण्डानां विनायकः /
सर्वेषां भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवदेवः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: of the spirits, Lord Rudra; of the Kūṣmāṇḍas, Vināyaka; / and of all beings, Lord Brahmā, the God of gods, the lord of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ bhagavān brahmā svayaṃ devo 'bhyabhāṣata /
tasmājjayadhvajo nūnaṃ viṣṇvārādhanamarhati //
meaning:
इत्येवं भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयं देवो ऽभ्यभाषत /
तस्माज्जयध्वजो नूनं विष्ण्वाराधनमर्हति //
text_mt: Thus the Lord Brahmā, the god himself, spoke. / Therefore, Jayadhvaja is indeed suited for the worship of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast:
tān praṇamyātha te jagmuḥ purīṃ paramaśobhanām /
pālayāñcakrire pṛthvīṃ jitvā sarvaripūn raṇe //
meaning:
तान् प्रणम्याथ ते जग्मुः पुरीं परमशोभनाम् /
पालयाञ्चक्रिरे पृथ्वीं जित्वा सर्वरिपून् रणे //
text_mt: Having bowed to them, they then went to their splendid city, / and having conquered all their enemies in battle, they protected the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kadācid viprendrā videho nāma dānavaḥ /
bhīṣaṇaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ purīṃ teṣāṃ samāyayau //
meaning:
ततः कदाचिद् विप्रेन्द्रा विदेहो नाम दानवः /
भीषणः सर्वसत्त्वानां पुरीं तेषां समाययौ //
text_mt: Then once, O foremost of Brahmins, a Dānava named Videha, / terrifying to all creatures, arrived at their city.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālo dīptātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ /
śūlamādāya sūryābhaṃ nādayan vai diśo daśa //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालो दीप्तात्मा युगान्तदहनोपमः /
शूलमादाय सूर्याभं नादयन् वै दिशो दश //
text_mt: With dreadful fangs, a blazing body, resembling the fire of universal destruction, / taking up a trident radiant as the sun, he made the ten directions resound.

sanskrit_iast:
tannādaśravaṇānmartyāstatra ye nivasanti te /
tatyajurjovitaṃ tvanye dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
तन्नादश्रवणान्मर्त्यास्तत्र ये निवसन्ति ते /
तत्यजुर्जोवितं त्वन्ये दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः //
text_mt: From hearing that roar, mortals who resided there / abandoned their lives, while others fled, overwhelmed with terror.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarve susaṃyattāḥ kārtavīryātmajāstadā /
yuyudhurdānavaṃ śaktigirikūṭāsimudgaraiḥ //
meaning:
ततः सर्वे सुसंयत्ताः कार्तवीर्यात्मजास्तदा /
युयुधुर्दानवं शक्तिगिरिकूटासिमुद्गरैः //
text_mt: Then all the sons of Kārtavīrya, fully prepared, / fought the Dānava with lances, mountain peaks, swords, and clubs.

sanskrit_iast:
tān sarvān dānavo viprāḥ śūlena prahasanniva /
vārayāmāsa ghorātmā kalpānte bhairavo yathā //
meaning:
तान् सर्वान् दानवो विप्राः शूलेन प्रहसन्निव /
वारयामास घोरात्मा कल्पान्ते भैरवो यथा //
text_mt: O brahmins, laughing as it were, that fierce-minded Dānava / warded them all off with his trident, like Bhairava at the end of the cosmic age.

sanskrit_iast:
śūrasenādayaḥ pañca rājānastu mahābalāḥ /
yuddhāya kṛtasaṃrambhā videhaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ //
meaning:
शूरसेनादयः पञ्च राजानस्तु महाबलाः /
युद्धाय कृतसंरम्भा विदेहं त्वभिदुद्रुवुः //
text_mt: Then five kings of great strength, beginning with Śūrasena, / eager for battle, rushed against Videha.

sanskrit_iast:
śūro 'straṃ prāhiṇod raudraṃ śūrasenastu vāruṇam /
prājāpatyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇo vāyavyaṃ dhṛṣṇa eva ca //
meaning:
शूरो ऽस्त्रं प्राहिणोद् रौद्रं शूरसेनस्तु वारुणम् /
प्राजापत्यं तथा कृष्णो वायव्यं धृष्ण एव च //
text_mt: Śūra hurled the weapon of Rudra, while Śūrasena discharged that of Varuṇa; / likewise, Kṛṣṇa unleashed the weapon of Prajāpati, and Dhṛṣṇa that of Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
jayadhvajaśca kauberamaindramāgneyameva ca /
bhañjayāmāsa śūlena tānyastrāṇi sa dānavaḥ //
meaning:
जयध्वजश्च कौबेरमैन्द्रमाग्नेयमेव च /
भञ्जयामास शूलेन तान्यस्त्राणि स दानवः //
text_mt: Jayadhvaja [hurled] the weapons of Kubera, Indra, and Agni; / but that Dānava shattered those weapons with his trident.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahāvīryo gadāmādāya bhīṣaṇām /
spṛṣṭvā mantreṇa tarasā cikṣepa na nanāda ca //
meaning:
ततः कृष्णो महावीर्यो गदामादाय भीषणाम् /
स्पृष्ट्वा मन्त्रेण तरसा चिक्षेप न ननाद च //
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa of great prowess, taking up a terrible mace / and consecrating it with a mantra, swiftly hurled it, and he did not roar.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya sā gādāsyoro videhasya śilopamam /
na dānavaṃ cālayituṃ śaśākāntakasaṃnibham //
meaning:
संप्राप्य सा गादास्योरो विदेहस्य शिलोपमम् /
न दानवं चालयितुं शशाकान्तकसंनिभम् //
text_mt: Striking the rock-like chest of Videha, / that mace was unable to shake the Dānava, who resembled Death himself.

sanskrit_iast:
dudruvuste bhayagrastā dṛṣṭvā tasyātipauruṣam /
jayadhvajastu matimān sasmāra jagataḥ patim //
meaning:
दुद्रुवुस्ते भयग्रस्ता दृष्ट्वा तस्यातिपौरुषम् /
जयध्वजस्तु मतिमान् सस्मार जगतः पतिम् //
text_mt: Seized with terror upon seeing his supreme valor, they fled; / but the wise Jayadhvaja remembered the Lord of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇuṃ lokādimaprameyamanāmayam /
trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ pūrvaṃ śrīpatiṃ pītavāsasam //
meaning:
विष्णुं ग्रसिष्णुं लोकादिमप्रमेयमनामयम् /
त्रातारं पुरुषं पूर्वं श्रीपतिं पीतवाससम् //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, who swallows all, source of the worlds, immeasurable, free from disease, / the protector, the primeval Spirit, Lord of Śrī, dressed in yellow garments.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prādurabhūccakraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham /
ādeśād vāsudevasya bhaktānugrahakāraṇāt //
meaning:
ततः प्रादुरभूच्चक्रं सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् /
आदेशाद् वासुदेवस्य भक्तानुग्रहकारणात् //
text_mt: Then the discus, radiant as ten thousand suns, appeared / by the command of Vāsudeva, in order to grant grace to his devotee.

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha jagatāṃ yoniṃ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ /
prāhiṇod vai videhāya dānavebhyo yathā hariḥ //
meaning:
जग्राह जगतां योनिं स्मृत्वा नारायणं नृपः /
प्राहिणोद् वै विदेहाय दानवेभ्यो यथा हरिः //
text_mt: Remembering Nārāyaṇa, the origin of the worlds, the king seized [the discus] / and hurled it at Videha, as Hari does against the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya tasya ghorasya skandhadeśaṃ sudarśanam /
pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa śiro 'driśikharākṛti //
meaning:
संप्राप्य तस्य घोरस्य स्कन्धदेशं सुदर्शनम् /
पृथिव्यां पातयामास शिरो ऽद्रिशिखराकृति //
text_mt: Reaching the neck of that terrible [demon], the Sudarśana [discus] / brought his head, shaped like a mountain peak, down to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin hate devaripau śīrādyā bhrātaro nṛpāḥ /
samāyayuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhrātaraṃ cāpyapūjayan //
meaning:
तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ शीराद्या भ्रातरो नृपाः /
समाययुः पुरीं रम्यां भ्रातरं चाप्यपूजयन् //
text_mt: When that enemy of the gods was slain, the kings, the brothers beginning with Śūra, / returned to the delightful city and honored their brother.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvājagāma bhagavān jayadhvajaparākramam /
kārtavīryasutaṃ draṣṭuṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वाजगाम भगवान् जयध्वजपराक्रमम् /
कार्तवीर्यसुतं द्रष्टुं विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः //
text_mt: Hearing of Jayadhvaja's prowess, the lord Viśvāmitra, / the great sage, arrived to see the son of Kārtavīrya.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā rājā saṃbhrāntamānasaḥ /
samāveśyāsane ramye pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ //
meaning:
तमागतमथो दृष्ट्वा राजा संभ्रान्तमानसः /
समावेश्यासने रम्ये पूजयामास भावतः //
text_mt: Seeing him arrive, the king, with an agitated mind, / seated him on a beautiful seat and honored him with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca bhagavān ghoraḥ prasādād bhavato 'suraḥ /
nipātito mayā saṃkhye videho dānaveśvaraḥ //
meaning:
उवाच भगवान् घोरः प्रसादाद् भवतो ऽसुरः /
निपातितो मया संख्ये विदेहो दानवेश्वरः //
text_mt: He said: "O holy lord, by your favor that terrible Asura, / Videha, the lord of Dānavas, has been struck down by me in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tvadvākyācchinnasaṃdeho viṣṇuṃ satyaparākramam /
prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ tena prasādo me kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
त्वद्वाक्याच्छिन्नसंदेहो विष्णुं सत्यपराक्रमम् /
प्रपन्नः शरणं तेन प्रसादो मे कृतः शुभः //
text_mt: My doubts dispelled by your words, I took refuge in Viṣṇu / of true valor; through him, auspicious grace was bestowed upon me.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣyāmi parameśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ padmadalekṣaṇam /
kathaṃ kena vidhānena saṃpūjyo harirīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यक्ष्यामि परमेशानं विष्णुं पद्मदलेक्षणम् /
कथं केन विधानेन संपूज्यो हरिरीश्वरः //
text_mt: I wish to worship the supreme sovereign Viṣṇu, whose eyes are like lotus petals. / How, and by what rite, is Hari the Lord to be worshipped?

sanskrit_iast:
ko 'yaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ kiṃprabhāvaśca suvrata /
sarvametanmamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me //
meaning:
को ऽयं नारायणो देवः किंप्रभावश्च सुव्रत /
सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे //
text_mt: Who is this god Nārāyaṇa, and of what power is he, O one of good vows? / Tell me all this, for great is my curiosity."

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitra uvāca
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yasmin sarvamidaṃ jagat /
sa viṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtātmā tamāśritya vimucyate //
meaning:
विश्वामित्र उवाच
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां यस्मिन् सर्वमिदं जगत् /
स विष्णुः सर्वभूतात्मा तमाश्रित्य विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Viśvāmitra said: / "From whom proceeds the creation of beings, and in whom this entire world exists, / he is Viṣṇu, the self of all beings; having taken refuge in him, one is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
svavarṇāśramadharmeṇa pūjyo 'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ /
akāmahatabhāvena samārādhyo na cānyathā //
meaning:
स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेण पूज्यो ऽयं पुरुषोत्तमः /
अकामहतभावेन समाराध्यो न चान्यथा //
text_mt: This Supreme Spirit is to be worshipped according to the duty of one's own class and stage of life; / he is to be propitiated with a disposition unassailed by desire, and not otherwise."

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā bhagavāna viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ /
śūrādyaiḥ pūjito viprā jagāmātha svamālayam //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः /
शूराद्यैः पूजितो विप्रा जगामाथ स्वमालयम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the venerable Viśvāmitra, the great sage, / honored by Śūra and the others, O brahmins, went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śūrādayo devamayajanta maheśvaram /
yajñena yajñagamyaṃ taṃ niṣkāmā rudramavyayam //
meaning:
अथ शूरादयो देवमयजन्त महेश्वरम् /
यज्ञेन यज्ञगम्यं तं निष्कामा रुद्रमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Then Śūra and the others worshipped the god Maheśvara / with sacrifice—the unchangeable Rudra, reachable through sacrifice, being free from desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tān vasiṣṭhastu bhagavān yājayāmāsa sarvavit /
gautamo 'triragastyaśca sarve rudraparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
तान् वसिष्ठस्तु भगवान् याजयामास सर्ववित् /
गौतमो ऽत्रिरगस्त्यश्च सर्वे रुद्रपरायणाः //
text_mt: The venerable, omniscient Vasiṣṭha officiated at their sacrifice, / as did Gautama, Atri, and Agastya, all devoted to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrastu bhagavān jayadhvajamarindamam /
yājayāmāsa bhūtādimādidevaṃ janārdanam //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्तु भगवान् जयध्वजमरिन्दमम् /
याजयामास भूतादिमादिदेवं जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: The venerable Viśvāmitra, however, officiated for Jayadhvaja, suppressor of foes, / [in sacrificing to] Janārdana, the origin of beings, the primeval god.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya yajñe mahāyogī sākṣād devaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ /
āvirāsīt sa bhagavān tadadbhutamivābhavat //
meaning:
तस्य यज्ञे महायोगी साक्षाद् देवः स्वयं हरिः /
आविरासीत् स भगवान् तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् //
text_mt: At his sacrifice, the Lord Hari himself, the great yogin, / appeared in visible form; that was truly marvelous.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ jayadhvajaparākramam /
sarvapāpavimuktātmā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यं जयध्वजपराक्रमम् /
सर्वपापविमुक्तात्मा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकविशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever constantly hears this prowess of Jayadhvaja, / his self freed from all sins, goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
jayadhvajasya putro 'bhūt tālājaṅgha iti smṛtaḥ /
śataputrāstu tasyāsan tālajaṅghāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
जयध्वजस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् तालाजङ्घ इति स्मृतः /
शतपुत्रास्तु तस्यासन् तालजङ्घाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Jayadhvaja had a son renowned as Tālājaṅgha; / he had a hundred sons, proclaimed as the Tālajaṅghas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho mahāvīryo vītihotro 'bhavannṛpaḥ /
vṛṣaprabhṛtayaścānye yādavāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां ज्येष्ठो महावीर्यो वीतिहोत्रो ऽभवन्नृपः /
वृषप्रभृतयश्चान्ये यादवाः पुण्यकर्मिणः //
text_mt: The eldest among them was king Vītihotra of great prowess; / and others were the meritorious Yādavas, beginning with Vṛṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣo vaṃśakarasteṣāṃ tasya putro 'bhavanmadhuḥ /
madhoḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīd vṛṣaṇastasya vaṃśabhāk //
meaning:
वृषो वंशकरस्तेषां तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवन्मधुः /
मधोः पुत्रशतं त्वासीद् वृषणस्तस्य वंशभाक् //
text_mt: Vṛṣa was the founder of their lineage; his son was Madhu. / Madhu had a hundred sons; Vṛṣaṇa belonged to his lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
vītihotrasutaścāpi viśruto 'nanta ityuta /
durjayastasya putro 'būt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
वीतिहोत्रसुतश्चापि विश्रुतो ऽनन्त इत्युत /
दुर्जयस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽबूत् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः //
text_mt: The son of Vītihotra was also celebrated as Ananta; / his son was Durjaya, proficient in all the treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāryā rūpavatī guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṅkṛtā /
pativratāsīt patinā svadharmaparipālikā //
meaning:
तस्य भार्या रूपवती गुणैः सर्वैरलङ्कृता /
पतिव्रतासीत् पतिना स्वधर्मपरिपालिका //
text_mt: His wife was beautiful, adorned with all good qualities; / devoted to her husband, she observed her own duty together with her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmahābhāgaḥ kālindītīrasaṃsthitām /
apaśyadurvaśīṃ devīṃ gāyantīṃ madhurasvanām //
meaning:
स कदाचिन्महाभागः कालिन्दीतीरसंस्थिताम् /
अपश्यदुर्वशीं देवीं गायन्तीं मधुरस्वनाम् //
text_mt: Once that fortunate [king] saw the goddess Urvaśī / standing on the bank of the Kālindī, singing with a sweet voice.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāmāhatamanāstatsamīpamupetya vai /
provāca suciraṃ kālaṃ devi rantuṃ mayār'hasi //
meaning:
ततः कामाहतमनास्तत्समीपमुपेत्य वै /
प्रोवाच सुचिरं कालं देवि रन्तुं मयार्ऽहसि //
text_mt: Then, his mind struck by desire, approaching her, / he said: "O goddess, you ought to sport with me for a very long time."

sanskrit_iast:
sā devī nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutam /
reme tena ciraṃ kālaṃ kāmadevamivāparam //
meaning:
सा देवी नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा रूपलावण्यसंयुतम् /
रेमे तेन चिरं कालं कामदेवमिवापरम् //
text_mt: Seeing the king endowed with beauty and charm, / that goddess sported with him for a long time, as if with a second Kāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāt prabuddho rājā tāmurvaśīṃ prāha śobhanām /
gamiṣyāmi purīṃ ramyāṃ hasantī sābravīd vacaḥ //
meaning:
कालात् प्रबुद्धो राजा तामुर्वशीं प्राह शोभनाम् /
गमिष्यामि पुरीं रम्यां हसन्ती साब्रवीद् वचः //
text_mt: After some time, the king awakened and said to the fair Urvaśī: / "I shall go to my delightful city." Laughing, she spoke [these] words:

sanskrit_iast:
na hyanenopabhogena bhavatā rājasundara /
prītiḥ saṃjāyate mahyaṃ sthātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
न ह्यनेनोपभोगेन भवता राजसुन्दर /
प्रीतिः संजायते मह्यं स्थातव्यं वत्सरं पुनः //
text_mt: "Indeed, by this enjoyment with you, handsome king, / my satisfaction has not arisen; you must remain for another year."

sanskrit_iast:
tāmabravīt sa matimān gatvā śīghrataraṃ purīm /
āgamiṣyāmi bhūyo 'tra tanme 'nujñātumarhasi //
meaning:
तामब्रवीत् स मतिमान् गत्वा शीघ्रतरं पुरीम् /
आगमिष्यामि भूयो ऽत्र तन्मे ऽनुज्ञातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: The intelligent one said to her: "Having gone very quickly to my city, / I will return here again; therefore you should grant me permission."

sanskrit_iast:
tamabravīt sā subhagā tathā kuru viśāṃpate /
nānyayāpsarasā tāvad rantavyaṃ bhavat punaḥ //
meaning:
तमब्रवीत् सा सुभगा तथा कुरु विशांपते /
नान्ययाप्सरसा तावद् रन्तव्यं भवत् पुनः //
text_mt: The lovely woman said to him: "Do so, O ruler of people; / meanwhile, you must not sport again with any other Apsaras."

sanskrit_iast:
omityuktvā yayau tūrṇaṃ purīṃ paramaśobhanām /
gatvā pativratāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvā bīto 'bhavannṛpaḥ //
meaning:
ओमित्युक्त्वा ययौ तूर्णं पुरीं परमशोभनाम् /
गत्वा पतिव्रतां पत्नीं दृष्ट्वा बीतो ऽभवन्नृपः //
text_mt: Saying 'Yes,' he quickly went to the exceedingly splendid city. / Having arrived and seen his wife devoted to her husband, the king became frightened.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprekṣya sā guṇavatī bhāryā tasya pativratā /
bhītaṃ prasannayā prāha vācā pīnapayodharā //
meaning:
संप्रेक्ष्य सा गुणवती भार्या तस्य पतिव्रता /
भीतं प्रसन्नया प्राह वाचा पीनपयोधरा //
text_mt: Beholding him afraid, that virtuous wife of his, devoted to her husband / and possessing full breasts, spoke with a serene voice:

sanskrit_iast:
svāmin kimatra bhavato bhītiradya pravartate /
tad brūhi me yathā tattvaṃ na rājñāṃ kīrtaye tvidam //
meaning:
स्वामिन् किमत्र भवतो भीतिरद्य प्रवर्तते /
