तद् ब्रूहि मे यथा तत्त्वं न राज्ञां कीर्तये त्विदम् //
text_mt: "My lord, what fear is arising for you here today? / Tell me that according to the truth; I will not proclaim this to kings."

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyā vākyamākarṇya lajjāvanatacetanaḥ /
novāca kiñcinnṛpatirjñānadṛṣṭyā viveda sā //
meaning:
स तस्या वाक्यमाकर्ण्य लज्जावनतचेतनः /
नोवाच किञ्चिन्नृपतिर्ज्ञानदृष्ट्या विवेद सा //
text_mt: Hearing her words, the king, his mind bowed with shame, / said nothing; but she knew through her eye of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhetavyaṃ tvayā svāmin kāryaṃ pāpaviśodhanam /
bhīte tvayi mahārāja rāṣṭraṃ te nāśameṣyati //
meaning:
न भेतव्यं त्वया स्वामिन् कार्यं पापविशोधनम् /
भीते त्वयि महाराज राष्ट्रं ते नाशमेष्यति //
text_mt: "You must not fear, my lord; a purification of the sin must be performed. / If you are afraid, O great king, your kingdom will meet with destruction."

sanskrit_iast:
tadā sa rājā dyutimān nirgatya tu purāt tataḥ /
gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāmunim //
meaning:
तदा स राजा द्युतिमान् निर्गत्य तु पुरात् ततः /
गत्वा कण्वाश्रमं पुण्यं दृष्ट्वा तत्र महामुनिम् //
text_mt:
Then that radiant king, having departed from that city,
went to Kaṇva's sacred hermitage and saw the great sage there.

sanskrit_iast:
niśamya kaṇvavadanāt prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham /
jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ samuddiśya mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
निशम्य कण्ववदनात् प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम् /
जगाम हिमवत्पृष्ठं समुद्दिश्य महाबलः //
text_mt: Having heard the auspicious rule of expiation from the mouth of Kaṇva, / the mighty [king] departed, heading towards the ridge of the Himavat.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'paśyat pathi rājendro gandharvavaramuttamam /
bhrājamānaṃ śriyā vyomni bhūṣitaṃ divyamālayā //
meaning:
सो ऽपश्यत् पथि राजेन्द्रो गन्धर्ववरमुत्तमम् /
भ्राजमानं श्रिया व्योम्नि भूषितं दिव्यमालया //
text_mt: On the way, that lord of kings saw an excellent, supreme Gandharva / shining in the sky with splendor, adorned with a divine garland.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣya mālāmamitraghnaḥ sasmārāpsarasāṃ varām /
urvaśīṃ tāṃ manaścakre tasyā eveyamarhati //
meaning:
वीक्ष्य मालाममित्रघ्नः सस्माराप्सरसां वराम् /
उर्वशीं तां मनश्चक्रे तस्या एवेयमर्हति //
text_mt: Beholding the garland, that slayer of foes remembered Urvaśī, the best of the apsarases. / He resolved in his mind: "She alone is worthy of this!"

sanskrit_iast:
so 'tīva kāmuko rājā gandharveṇātha tena hi /
cakāra sumahad yuddhaṃ mālāmādātumudyataḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽतीव कामुको राजा गन्धर्वेणाथ तेन हि /
चकार सुमहद् युद्धं मालामादातुमुद्यतः //
text_mt: Extremely overcome with passion, that king then indeed / engaged in a great battle with that Gandharva, bent on taking the garland.

sanskrit_iast:
vijitya samare mālāṃ gṛhītvā durjayo dvijāḥ /
jagāma tāmapsarasaṃ kālindīṃ draṣṭumādarāt //
meaning:
विजित्य समरे मालां गृहीत्वा दुर्जयो द्विजाः /
जगाम तामप्सरसं कालिन्दीं द्रष्टुमादरात् //
text_mt: Having conquered [him] in battle and seized the garland, O twice-born ones, Durjaya / eagerly went to see that apsaras, who was by the Kālindī river.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭvāpsarasaṃ tatra kāmabāṇābhipīḍitaḥ /
babhrāma sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpasamanvitām //
meaning:
अदृष्ट्वाप्सरसं तत्र कामबाणाभिपीडितः /
बभ्राम सकलां पृथ्वीं सप्तद्वीपसमन्विताम् //
text_mt: Not seeing the apsaras there, afflicted by the arrows of love, / he wandered over the whole earth together with its seven islands.

sanskrit_iast:
ākramya himavatpārśvamurvaśīdarśanotsukaḥ /
jagāma śailapravaraṃ hemakūṭamiti śrutam //
meaning:
आक्रम्य हिमवत्पार्श्वमुर्वशीदर्शनोत्सुकः /
जगाम शैलप्रवरं हेमकूटमिति श्रुतम् //
text_mt: Reaching the side of the Himavat, eager to behold Urvaśī, / he went to the excellent mountain known as Hemakūṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatrāpsarovaryā dṛṣṭvā taṃ siṃhavikramam /
kāmaṃ saṃdadhire ghoraṃ bhūṣitaṃ citramālayā //
meaning:
तत्र तत्राप्सरोवर्या दृष्ट्वा तं सिंहविक्रमम् /
कामं संदधिरे घोरं भूषितं चित्रमालया //
text_mt: There the best apsarases, seeing him possessed of the valor of a lion / and adorned with the marvelous garland, felt terrible passion [for him].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmarannurvaśīvākyaṃ tasyāṃ saṃsaktamānasaḥ /
na paśyati smatāḥ sarvāgiriśṛṅgāṇijagmivān //
meaning:
संस्मरन्नुर्वशीवाक्यं तस्यां संसक्तमानसः /
न पश्यति स्मताः सर्वागिरिशृङ्गाणिजग्मिवान् //
text_mt: Remembering Urvaśī's words, with his mind fixed upon her, / he did not even look at all of them as he climbed the mountain peaks.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpyapsarasaṃ divyāmadṛṣṭvā kāmapīḍitaḥ /
devalokaṃ mahāmeruṃ yayau devaparākramaḥ //
meaning:
तत्राप्यप्सरसं दिव्यामदृष्ट्वा कामपीडितः /
देवलोकं महामेरुं ययौ देवपराक्रमः //
text_mt: Not seeing the divine apsaras there either, afflicted by love, / [the king] of divine prowess went to the realm of the gods, to Mount Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra mānasaṃ nāma sarastrailokyaviśrutam /
bheje śṛṅgāṇyatikramya svabāhubalabhāvitaḥ //
meaning:
स तत्र मानसं नाम सरस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
भेजे शृङ्गाण्यतिक्रम्य स्वबाहुबलभावितः //
text_mt: Having crossed the peaks, relying on the strength of his own arms, / he reached the lake there named Mānasa, renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasya tīre subhagāṃ carantīmatilālasām /
dṛṣṭavānanavadyāṅgīṃ tasyai mālāṃ dadau punaḥ //
meaning:
स तस्य तीरे सुभगां चरन्तीमतिलालसाम् /
दृष्टवाननवद्याङ्गीं तस्यै मालां ददौ पुनः //
text_mt: Seeing that lovely woman of faultless limbs wandering on its bank, full of longing, / he gave her the garland once again.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mālayā tadā devīṃ bhūṣitāṃ prekṣya mohitaḥ /
reme kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jānānaḥ suciraṃ tayā //
meaning:
स मालया तदा देवीं भूषितां प्रेक्ष्य मोहितः /
रेमे कृतार्थमात्मानं जानानः सुचिरं तया //
text_mt: Beholding the lady then adorned with the garland, enchanted, / he sported with her for a long time, knowing himself to have achieved his purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
athorvaśī rājavaryaṃ ratānte vākyamabravīt /
kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ purīṃ gatvā vṛthā nṛpa //
meaning:
अथोर्वशी राजवर्यं रतान्ते वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
किं कृतं भवता पूर्वं पुरीं गत्वा वृथा नृप //
text_mt: Then, at the end of lovemaking, Urvaśī spoke these words to the best of kings: / "What did you do previously, O king, having gone in vain to your city?"

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyai sarvamācaṣṭa patnyā yat samudīritam /
kaṇvasya darśanaṃ caiva mālāpaharaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
स तस्यै सर्वमाचष्ट पत्न्या यत् समुदीरितम् /
कण्वस्य दर्शनं चैव मालापहरणं तथा //
text_mt: He told her everything that had been said by his wife, / his seeing of Kaṇva, and likewise the taking of the garland.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvaitad vyāhṛtaṃ tena gacchetyāha hitaiṣiṇī /
śāpaṃ dāsyati te kaṇvo mamāpi bhavataḥ priyā //
meaning:
श्रुत्वैतद् व्याहृतं तेन गच्छेत्याह हितैषिणी /
शापं दास्यति ते कण्वो ममापि भवतः प्रिया //
text_mt: Hearing this spoken by him, she, wishing his welfare, said: "Go! / Kaṇva will pronounce a curse upon you, and upon me, your beloved, as well!"

sanskrit_iast:
tayāsakṛnmahārājaḥ prokto 'pi madamohitaḥ /
na tatyajātha tatpārśvaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ //
meaning:
तयासकृन्महाराजः प्रोक्तो ऽपि मदमोहितः /
न तत्यजाथ तत्पार्श्वं तत्र संन्यस्तमानसः //
text_mt: Although repeatedly urged by her, the great king, deluded by passion / and with his mind fixed on her, did not leave her side.

sanskrit_iast:
tatorvaśī kāmarūpā rājñe svaṃ rūpamutkaṭam /
suromaśaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvadā //
meaning:
ततोर्वशी कामरूपा राज्ञे स्वं रूपमुत्कटम् /
सुरोमशं पिङ्गलाक्षं दर्शयामास सर्वदा //
text_mt: Then Urvaśī, able to take any form at will, displayed to the king a monstrous form of her own, / exceedingly hairy and with reddish-brown eyes, at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ viraktacetaskaḥ smṛtvā kaṇvābhibhāṣitam /
dhiṅmāmiti viniścityatapaḥ kartuṃ samārabhat //
meaning:
तस्यां विरक्तचेतस्कः स्मृत्वा कण्वाभिभाषितम् /
धिङ्मामिति विनिश्चित्यतपः कर्तुं समारभत् //
text_mt: With his heart disgusted with her, remembering what Kaṇva had spoken, / he resolved, "Fie on me!", and began to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaradvādaśakaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
bhūya eva dvādaśakaṃ vāyubhakṣo 'bhavannṛpaḥ //
meaning:
संवत्सरद्वादशकं कन्दमूलफलाशनः /
भूय एव द्वादशकं वायुभक्षो ऽभवन्नृपः //
text_mt: For twelve years the king subsisted on bulbs, roots, and fruits; / then for another twelve years he consumed only air.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ bhītyā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat /
vāsamapsarasā bhūyastapoyogamanuttamam //
meaning:
गत्वा कण्वाश्रमं भीत्या तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत् /
वासमप्सरसा भूयस्तपोयोगमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Going in fear to Kaṇva's hermitage, he reported everything to him— / his dwelling with the apsaras and again his supreme practice of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣya taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ prasanno bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
kartukāmo hi nirbojaṃ tasyāghamidamabravīt //
meaning:
वीक्ष्य तं राजशार्दूलं प्रसन्नो भगवानृषिः /
कर्तुकामो हि निर्बोजं तस्याघमिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Beholding that tiger among kings, the venerable sage was pleased, / and, wishing to render his sin seedless, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha vārāṇasīṃ divyāmīśvarādhyuṣitāṃ purīm /
āste mocayituṃ lokaṃ tatra devo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गच्छ वाराणसीं दिव्यामीश्वराध्युषितां पुरीम् /
आस्ते मोचयितुं लोकं तत्र देवो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: "Go to the divine Vārāṇasī, the city inhabited by the Lord. / The god Maheśvara resides there to liberate the world.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā saṃtarpya vidhivad gaṅgāyāndevatāḥ pitṝn /
dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ liṅgaṅkilbiṣānmokṣyase 'khilāt //
meaning:
स्नात्वा संतर्प्य विधिवद् गङ्गायान्देवताः पितॄन् /
दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं लिङ्गङ्किल्बिषान्मोक्ष्यसे ऽखिलात् //
text_mt: Having bathed and duly satiated the deities and ancestors in the Gaṅgā, / and having beheld the liṅga of Viśveśvara, you will be freed from all sin."

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śirasā kaṇvamanujñāpya ca durjayaḥ /
vārāṇasyāṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpānmukto 'bhavat tataḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य शिरसा कण्वमनुज्ञाप्य च दुर्जयः /
वाराणस्यां हरं दृष्ट्वा पापान्मुक्तो ऽभवत् ततः //
text_mt: Bowing his head to Kaṇva and taking his leave, Durjaya, / having beheld Hara in Vārāṇasī, was then freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma svapurīṃ śubhrāṃ pālayāmāsa medinīm /
yājayāmāsa taṃ kaṇvo yācito ghṛṇayā muniḥ //
meaning:
जगाम स्वपुरीं शुभ्रां पालयामास मेदिनीम् /
याजयामास तं कण्वो याचितो घृणया मुनिः //
text_mt: He went to his own splendid city and protected the earth. / Implored out of compassion, the sage Kaṇva performed sacrifices for him.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro 'tha matimān supratīka iti śrutaḥ /
babhūva jātamātraṃ taṃ rājānamupatasthire //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो ऽथ मतिमान् सुप्रतीक इति श्रुतः /
बभूव जातमात्रं तं राजानमुपतस्थिरे //
text_mt: Then he had an intelligent son known as Supratīka; / as soon as he was born, they attended upon the king.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyāṃ ca mahāvīryāḥ sapta devasutopamāḥ /
kanyā jagṛhire sarvā jandharvadayitā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
उर्वश्यां च महावीर्याः सप्त देवसुतोपमाः /
कन्या जगृहिरे सर्वा जन्धर्वदयिता द्विजाः //
text_mt: And through Urvaśī, seven daughters of great vigor, like daughters of gods, / beloved of Gandharvas, were conceived, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa va kathitaḥ samyak sahastrajita uttamaḥ /
vaṃśaḥ pāpaharo nṛṇāṃ kroṣṭorapi nibodhata //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एष व कथितः सम्यक् सहस्त्रजित उत्तमः /
वंशः पापहरो नृणां क्रोष्टोरपि निबोधत //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वाविशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This excellent lineage of Sahasrajit, which removes the sins of men, / has been properly related to you. Now listen to that of Kroṣṭu as well.

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kroṣṭoreko 'bhavat putro vṛjinīvāniti śrutiḥ /
tasya putro mahān svātiruśadgustatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
क्रोष्टोरेको ऽभवत् पुत्रो वृजिनीवानिति श्रुतिः /
तस्य पुत्रो महान् स्वातिरुशद्गुस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Kroṣṭu had one son named Vṛjinīvat, according to tradition; / his son was the great Svāti; Uśadgu was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
uśadgorabhavat putro nāmnā citraratho balī /
atha caitrarathirloke śaśabinduriti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उशद्गोरभवत् पुत्रो नाम्ना चित्ररथो बली /
अथ चैत्ररथिर्लोके शशबिन्दुरिति स्मृतः //
text_mt: Uśadgu had a mighty son named Citraratha; / then that son of Citraratha was remembered in the world as Śaśabindu.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putraḥ pṛthuyaśā rājābhūd dharmatatparaḥ /
pṛthukarmā ca tatputrastasmāt pṛthujayo 'bhavat //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रः पृथुयशा राजाभूद् धर्मतत्परः /
पृथुकर्मा च तत्पुत्रस्तस्मात् पृथुजयो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: His son was King Pṛthuyaśas, devoted to righteousness; / Pṛthukarman was his son, and from him came Pṛthujaya.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthukīrtirabhūt tasmāt pṛthudānastato 'bhavat /
pṛthuśravāstasya putrastasyāsīt pṛthusattamaḥ //
meaning:
पृथुकीर्तिरभूत् तस्मात् पृथुदानस्ततो ऽभवत् /
पृथुश्रवास्तस्य पुत्रस्तस्यासीत् पृथुसत्तमः //
text_mt: From him came Pṛthukīrti; from him came Pṛthudāna; / Pṛthuśravas was his son; his [son] was Pṛthusattama.

sanskrit_iast:
uśanā tasya putro 'būt siteṣustatsuto 'bhavat /
tasyābhūd rukmakavacaḥ parāvṛt tasya sattamāḥ //
meaning:
उशना तस्य पुत्रो ऽबूत् सितेषुस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
तस्याभूद् रुक्मकवचः परावृत् तस्य सत्तमाः //
text_mt: Uśanas was his son; Siteṣu was his son; / his [son] was Rukmakavaca; Parāvṛt was his [son], O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
parāvṛtaḥ suto jajñe jyāmagho lokaviśrutaḥ /
tasmād vidarbhaḥ saṃjajñe vidarbhāt krathakaiśikau //
meaning:
परावृतः सुतो जज्ञे ज्यामघो लोकविश्रुतः /
तस्माद् विदर्भः संजज्ञे विदर्भात् क्रथकैशिकौ //
text_mt: To Parāvṛt was born a son, Jyāmagha, renowned in the world; / from him Vidarbha was born; from Vidarbha came Kratha and Kaiśika.

sanskrit_iast:
romapādastṛtīyastu babhrustasyātmajo nṛpaḥ /
dhṛtistasyābhavat putraḥ saṃstastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ //
meaning:
रोमपादस्तृतीयस्तु बभ्रुस्तस्यात्मजो नृपः /
धृतिस्तस्याभवत् पुत्रः संस्तस्तस्याप्यभूत् सुतः //
text_mt: Romapāda was the third; his son was King Babhru; / Dhṛti was his son; Saṃsta was also his son.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstasya putro balavān nāmnā viśvasahastu saḥ /
tasya putro mahāvīryaḥ prajāvān kauśikastataḥ /
abhūt tasya suto dhīmān sumantustatsuto 'nalaḥ //
meaning:
संस्तस्य पुत्रो बलवान् नाम्ना विश्वसहस्तु सः /
तस्य पुत्रो महावीर्यः प्रजावान् कौशिकस्ततः /
अभूत् तस्य सुतो धीमान् सुमन्तुस्तत्सुतो ऽनलः //
text_mt: Saṃsta's son was strong, named Viśvasaha; / his son was the very powerful Kauśika, rich in offspring; / then his son was the wise Sumantu; Anala was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
kaiśikasya sutaścediścaidyāstasyābhavan sutāḥ /
teṣāṃ pradhāno jyotiṣmān vapuṣmāṃstatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
कैशिकस्य सुतश्चेदिश्चैद्यास्तस्याभवन् सुताः /
तेषां प्रधानो ज्योतिष्मान् वपुष्मांस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Kaiśika's son was Cedi; the Caidyas were his sons; / the foremost among them was Jyotiṣmat; Vapuṣmat was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
vapuṣmato bṛhanmedhā śrīdevastatsuto 'bhavat /
tasya vītaratho viprā rudrabhakto mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
वपुष्मतो बृहन्मेधा श्रीदेवस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
तस्य वीतरथो विप्रा रुद्रभक्तो महाबलः //
text_mt: Vapuṣmat's [son] was Bṛhanmedhas; Śrīdeva was his son; / his [son] was Vītaratha, O Brahmins, a devotee of Rudra and possessed of great might.

sanskrit_iast:
krathasyāpyabhavat kuntī vṛṣṇī tasyābhavat sutaḥ /
vṛṣṇernivṛttirutpanno daśārhastasya tu dvijāḥ //
meaning:
क्रथस्याप्यभवत् कुन्ती वृष्णी तस्याभवत् सुतः /
वृष्णेर्निवृत्तिरुत्पन्नो दशार्हस्तस्य तु द्विजाः //
text_mt: To Kratha was born Kuntī; Vṛṣṇi was his son; / from Vṛṣṇi, Nivṛtti was born; his [son] was Daśārha, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
daśārhaputropyāroho jīmūtastatsuto 'bhavat /
jaimūtirabhavad vīro vikṛtiḥ paravīrahā //
meaning:
दशार्हपुत्रोप्यारोहो जीमूतस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
जैमूतिरभवद् वीरो विकृतिः परवीरहा //
text_mt: Daśārha's son was Vyāroha; Jīmūta was his son; / the son of Jīmūta was the heroic Vikṛti, slayer of enemy warriors.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhīmarathaḥ putraḥ tasmānnavaratho 'bhavat /
dānadharmarato nityaṃ samyakśīlaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य भीमरथः पुत्रः तस्मान्नवरथो ऽभवत् /
दानधर्मरतो नित्यं सम्यक्शीलपरायणः //
text_mt: His son was Bhīmaratha; from him came Navaratha, / who was constantly devoted to the duty of generosity and intent on perfect conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācinmṛgayāṃ yāto dṛṣṭvā rākṣasamūrjitam /
dudrāva mahātaviṣṭo bhayena munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
कदाचिन्मृगयां यातो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसमूर्जितम् /
दुद्राव महातविष्टो भयेन मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Once, having gone hunting, seeing a mighty rākṣasa, / he fled in great fear through the forest, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
anvadhāvata saṃkruddho rākṣasastaṃ mahābalaḥ /
duryodhano 'gnisaṃkāśaḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ //
meaning:
अन्वधावत संक्रुद्धो राक्षसस्तं महाबलः /
दुर्योधनो ऽग्निसंकाशः शूलासक्तमहाकरः //
text_mt: Enraged, that mighty rākṣasa ran after him— / Duryodhana, resembling fire, his great hand grasping a trident.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā navaratho bhītyā nātidūrādanuttamam /
apaśyat paramaṃ sthānaṃ sarasvatyā sugopitam //
meaning:
राजा नवरथो भीत्या नातिदूरादनुत्तमम् /
अपश्यत् परमं स्थानं सरस्वत्या सुगोपितम् //
text_mt: Out of fear, King Navaratha saw, not far off, an incomparable / and supreme abode, well concealed by Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadvegena mahatā saṃprāpya matimān nṛpaḥ /
vavande śirasā dṛṣṭvā sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
स तद्वेगेन महता संप्राप्य मतिमान् नृपः /
ववन्दे शिरसा दृष्ट्वा साक्षाद् देवीं सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: Reaching it with great speed, the wise king, / seeing the goddess Sarasvatī in person, bowed with his head.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirbaddhāñjaliramitrajit /
papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्बद्धाञ्जलिरमित्रजित् /
पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ त्वामहं शरणं गतः //
text_mt: With folded hands, that conqueror of foes praised her with pleasing words / and fell to the ground like a staff, [saying]: "I have taken refuge in you!"

sanskrit_iast:
namasyāmi mahādevīṃ sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm /
vāgdevatāmanādyantāmīśvarīṃ brahmacāriṇīm //
meaning:
नमस्यामि महादेवीं साक्षाद् देवीं सरस्वतीम् /
वाग्देवतामनाद्यन्तामीश्वरीं ब्रह्मचारिणीम् //
text_mt: "I bow to the great goddess, Sarasvatī herself, / the deity of speech, without beginning or end, the sovereign ruler, observing celibacy.

sanskrit_iast:
namasye jagatāṃ yoniṃ yoginīṃ paramāṃ kalām /
hiraṇyagarbhamahiṣīṃ trinetrāṃ candraśekharām //
meaning:
नमस्ये जगतां योनिं योगिनीं परमां कलाम् /
हिरण्यगर्भमहिषीं त्रिनेत्रां चन्द्रशेखराम् //
text_mt: I bow to the womb of the worlds, the yoginī, the supreme portion, / the consort of Hiraṇyagarbha, the three-eyed one, adorned with the crescent moon.

sanskrit_iast:
namasye paramānandāṃ citkalāṃ brahmarūpiṇīm /
pāhi māṃ parameśāni bhītaṃ śaraṇamāgatam //
meaning:
नमस्ये परमानन्दां चित्कलां ब्रह्मरूपिणीम् /
पाहि मां परमेशानि भीतं शरणमागतम् //
text_mt: I bow to the supreme bliss, the portion of consciousness, having the form of Brahman. / Protect me, O supreme sovereign, who have come for refuge in fear!"

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kruddho rājānaṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ /
hantuṃ samāgataḥ sthānaṃ yatra devī sarasvatī //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राजानं राक्षसेश्वरः /
हन्तुं समागतः स्थानं यत्र देवी सरस्वती //
text_mt: Meanwhile, the enraged lord of the rākṣasas, wishing to slay the king, / arrived at the place where goddess Sarasvatī was.

sanskrit_iast:
samudyamya tadā śūlaṃ praveṣṭuṃ baladarpitaḥ /
trilokamātustatsthānaṃ śaśāṅkādityasaṃnnibham //
meaning:
समुद्यम्य तदा शूलं प्रवेष्टुं बलदर्पितः /
त्रिलोकमातुस्तत्स्थानं शशाङ्कादित्यसंन्निभम् //
text_mt: Raising his trident, proud of his strength, he sought to enter / that place of the Mother of the three worlds, radiant like the moon and sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare mahad bhūtaṃ yugāntādityasannibham /
śūlenorasi nirbhidya pātayāmāsa taṃ bhuvi //
meaning:
तदन्तरे महद् भूतं युगान्तादित्यसन्निभम् /
शूलेनोरसि निर्भिद्य पातयामास तं भुवि //
text_mt: In that interval, a great being, radiant like the sun at the dissolution of an age, / pierced him in the chest with a spear and struck him down to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchetyāha mahārāja na sthātavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ /
idānīṃ nirbhayastūrṇaṃ sthāne 'smin rākṣaso hataḥ //
meaning:
गच्छेत्याह महाराज न स्थातव्यं त्वया पुनः /
इदानीं निर्भयस्तूर्णं स्थाने ऽस्मिन् राक्षसो हतः //
text_mt: It said: "Go, O great king, you should not stay here any longer. / Being fearless, quickly [depart]; the rākṣasa has been killed in this place."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā rājā navarathaḥ parām /
purīṃ jagāma viprendrāḥ purandarapuropamām //
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्य हृष्टात्मा राजा नवरथः पराम् /
पुरीं जगाम विप्रेन्द्राः पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम् //
text_mt: Then, having bowed, his heart delighted, King Navaratha went to his supreme city, / O foremost of Brahmins, which resembled the city of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayāmāsa deveśīṃ tatra bhaktisamanvitaḥ /
īje ca vividhairyajñairhemairdevīṃ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
स्थापयामास देवेशीं तत्र भक्तिसमन्वितः /
ईजे च विविधैर्यज्ञैर्हेमैर्देवीं सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion, he established the ruler of gods there, / and worshipped goddess Sarasvatī with various sacrifices [and gifts of] gold.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cāsīd daśarathaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ /
devyā bhakto mahātejāḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य चासीद् दशरथः पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः /
देव्या भक्तो महातेजाः शकुनिस्तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: He had a son, Daśaratha, who was extremely righteous, / a devotee of the goddess, possessed of great splendour; and Śakuni was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt karambhaḥ saṃbhūto devarāto 'bhavat tataḥ /
īje sa cāśvamedhena devakṣatraśca tatsutaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् करम्भः संभूतो देवरातो ऽभवत् ततः /
ईजे स चाश्वमेधेन देवक्षत्रश्च तत्सुतः //
text_mt: From him Karambha was born, and from him came Devarāta; / and his son was Devakṣatra, who worshipped with the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
madhustasya tu dāyādastasmāt kuruvaśo 'bhavat /
putradvayamabhūt tasya sutrāmā cānureva ca //
meaning:
मधुस्तस्य तु दायादस्तस्मात् कुरुवशो ऽभवत् /
पुत्रद्वयमभूत् तस्य सुत्रामा चानुरेव च //
text_mt: His heir was Madhu, and from him arose Kuruvaśa. / He had two sons, Sutrāman and Anu.

sanskrit_iast:
anostu purukutso 'bhūdaṃśustasya ca rikthabhāk /
athāṃśoḥ sattvato nāma viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān /
mahātmā dānanirato dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
अनोस्तु पुरुकुत्सो ऽभूदंशुस्तस्य च रिक्थभाक् /
अथांशोः सत्त्वतो नाम विष्णुभक्तः प्रतापवान् /
महात्मा दाननिरतो धनुर्वेदविदां वरः //
text_mt: From Anu came Purukutsa, and Aṃśu was his heir. / From Aṃśu came he named Sattvata, a mighty devotee of Viṣṇu, / a great soul devoted to charity, foremost among those skilled in archery.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nāradasya vacanād vāsudevārcanānvitam /
śāstraṃ pravartayāmāsa kuṇḍagolādibhiḥ śrutam //
meaning:
स नारदस्य वचनाद् वासुदेवार्चनान्वितम् /
शास्त्रं प्रवर्तयामास कुण्डगोलादिभिः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: At Nārada's word, he promulgated the treatise / concerned with the worship of Vāsudeva, heard by Kuṇḍas, Golas, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya nāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ sāttvataṃ nāma śobhanam /
pravartate mahāśāstraṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ hitāvaham //
meaning:
तस्य नाम्ना तु विख्यातं सात्त्वतं नाम शोभनम् /
प्रवर्तते महाशास्त्रं कुण्डादीनां हितावहम् //
text_mt: Known by his name, that excellent [text] called the Sāttvata, / a great treatise bringing welfare to Kuṇḍas and others, is set in motion.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvatastasya putro 'bhūt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ /
puṇyaśloko mahārājastena vai tatpravartitam //
meaning:
सात्त्वतस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः /
पुण्यश्लोको महाराजस्तेन वै तत्प्रवर्तितम् //
text_mt: His son was Sāttvata, skilled in all scriptures, / a great king of fair renown; indeed, by him it was promulgated.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvataḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ kauśalyāṃ suṣuve sutān /
andhakaṃ vai mahābhojaṃ vṛṣṇiṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam /
jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bhajamānākhyaṃ dhanurvedavidāṃ varam //
meaning:
सात्त्वतः सत्त्वसंपन्नः कौशल्यां सुषुवे सुतान् /
अन्धकं वै महाभोजं वृष्णिं देवावृधं नृपम् /
ज्येष्ठं च भजमानाख्यं धनुर्वेदविदां वरम् //
text_mt: Sāttvata, endowed with purity, begot sons upon Kauśalyā: / Andhaka, Mahābhoja, Vṛṣṇi, King Devāvṛdha, / and the eldest named Bhajamāna, foremost among those skilled in archery.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ devāvṛdho rājā cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ /
putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama bhūyāditi prabhuḥ //
meaning:
तेषां देवावृधो राजा चचार परमं तपः /
पुत्रः सर्वगुणोपेतो मम भूयादिति प्रभुः //
text_mt: Among them, King Devāvṛdha, the lord, performed supreme austerities, / [wishing,] "May I have a son endowed with all good qualities."

sanskrit_iast:
tasya babhruriti khyātaḥ puṇyaśloko 'bhavannṛpaḥ /
dhārmiko rūpasaṃpannastattvajñānarataḥ sadā //
meaning:
तस्य बभ्रुरिति ख्यातः पुण्यश्लोको ऽभवन्नृपः /
धार्मिको रूपसंपन्नस्तत्त्वज्ञानरतः सदा //
text_mt: He had a kingly son of fair renown known as Babhru, / righteous, endowed with beauty, ever devoted to knowledge of the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajamānasya sṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānā vijajñire /
teṣāṃ pradhānau vikhyātau nimiḥ kṛkaṇa eva ca //
meaning:
भजमानस्य सृञ्जय्यां भजमाना विजज्ञिरे /
तेषां प्रधानौ विख्यातौ निमिः कृकण एव च //
text_mt: To Bhajamāna upon Sṛñjayī were born the Bhajamānas; / the two chief and famous among them were Nimi and Kṛkaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhojakule jātā bhojā vaimārtikāstathā /
vṛṣṇeḥ sumitro balavānanamitraḥ śinastathā //
meaning:
महाभोजकुले जाता भोजा वैमार्तिकास्तथा /
वृष्णेः सुमित्रो बलवाननमित्रः शिनस्तथा //
text_mt: Born in the lineage of Mahābhoja were the Bhojas, and also the Vaimārtikas. / To Vṛṣṇi were born the mighty Sumitra, Anamitra, and Śini.

sanskrit_iast:
anamitrādabhūnnighno nighnasya dvau babhūvatuḥ /
prasenastu mahābhāgaḥ satrājinnāma cottamaḥ //
meaning:
अनमित्रादभून्निघ्नो निघ्नस्य द्वौ बभूवतुः /
प्रसेनस्तु महाभागः सत्राजिन्नाम चोत्तमः //
text_mt: From Anamitra came Nighna, and Nighna had two sons: / the fortunate Prasena, and the excellent one named Satrājit.

sanskrit_iast:
anamitrācchinirjajñe kaniṣṭhād vṛṣṇinandanāt /
satyavān satyasaṃpannaḥ satyakastatsuto 'bhavat //
meaning:
अनमित्राच्छिनिर्जज्ञे कनिष्ठाद् वृष्णिनन्दनात् /
सत्यवान् सत्यसंपन्नः सत्यकस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: From Anamitra, the youngest delighter of Vṛṣṇi, Śini was born; / his son was Satyaka, truthful and endowed with truth.

sanskrit_iast:
sātyakiryuyudhānastu tasyāsaṅgo 'bhavat sutaḥ /
kuṇistasya suto dhīmāṃstasya putro yugandharaḥ //
meaning:
सात्यकिर्युयुधानस्तु तस्यासङ्गो ऽभवत् सुतः /
कुणिस्तस्य सुतो धीमांस्तस्य पुत्रो युगन्धरः //
text_mt: Sātyaki was Yuyudhāna, and his son was Asaṅga. / His wise son was Kuṇi, and his son was Yugandhara.

sanskrit_iast:
mādrayā vṛṣṇeḥ suto jajñe pṛśnirvai yadunandanaḥ /
jajñāte tanayau pṛśneḥ śvaphalkaścitrakaśca ha //
meaning:
माद्रया वृष्णेः सुतो जज्ञे पृश्निर्वै यदुनन्दनः /
जज्ञाते तनयौ पृश्नेः श्वफल्कश्चित्रकश्च ह //
text_mt: By Mādrī, Vṛṣṇi had a son, Pṛśni, who delighted the descendants of Yadu. / Two sons were born to Pṛśni: Śvaphalka and Citraka.

sanskrit_iast:
śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata /
tasyāmajanayat putramakrūraṃ nāma dhārmikam /
upamaṅgustathā maṅguranye ca bahavaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्यामविन्दत /
तस्यामजनयत् पुत्रमक्रूरं नाम धार्मिकम् /
उपमङ्गुस्तथा मङ्गुरन्ये च बहवः सुताः //
text_mt: Śvaphalka took the daughter of the king of Kāśi as his wife; / upon her he begot a righteous son named Akrūra, / Upamaṅgu, Maṅgu, and many other sons.

sanskrit_iast:
akrūrasya smṛtaḥ putro devavāniti viśrutaḥ /
upadevaśca puṇyātmā tayorviśvapramāthinau //
meaning:
अक्रूरस्य स्मृतः पुत्रो देववानिति विश्रुतः /
उपदेवश्च पुण्यात्मा तयोर्विश्वप्रमाथिनौ //
text_mt: The son of Akrūra is remembered as celebrated Devavān, / and the virtuous Upadeva; their [sons] crushed all [foes].

sanskrit_iast:
citrakasyābhavat putraḥ pṛthurvipṛthureva ca /
aśvagrīvaḥ subāhuśca supārśvakagaveṣaṇau //
meaning:
चित्रकस्याभवत् पुत्रः पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च /
अश्वग्रीवः सुबाहुश्च सुपार्श्वकगवेषणौ //
text_mt: Citraka had sons: Pṛthu and Vipṛthu, / Aśvagrīva, Subāhu, Supārśvaka, and Gaveṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
andhakāt kāśyaduhitā lebhe ca caturaḥ sutān /
kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca śuciṃ kambalabarhiṣam //
meaning:
अन्धकात् काश्यदुहिता लेभे च चतुरः सुतान् /
कुकुरं भजमानं च शुचिं कम्बलबर्हिषम् //
text_mt: From Andhaka the daughter of the king of Kāśi obtained four sons: / Kukura, Bhajamāna, Śuci, and Kambalabarhis.

sanskrit_iast:
kukurasya suto vṛṣṇirvṛṣṇestu tanayo 'bhavat /
kapotaromā vipulastasya putro vilomakaḥ //
meaning:
कुकुरस्य सुतो वृष्णिर्वृष्णेस्तु तनयो ऽभवत् /
कपोतरोमा विपुलस्तस्य पुत्रो विलोमकः //
text_mt: The son of Kukura was Vṛṣṇi, and Vṛṣṇi's son was / the noble Kapotaromā; his son was Vilomaka.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsīt tumburusakhā vidvān putro nalaḥ kila /
khyāyate tasya nāmānuranorānakadundubhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्यासीत् तुम्बुरुसखा विद्वान् पुत्रो नलः किल /
ख्यायते तस्य नामानुरनोरानकदुन्दुभिः //
text_mt: He had a learned son, Nala, a friend of Tumburu; / his name is known as Anu, and from Anu came Ānakadundubhi.

sanskrit_iast:
sa govardhanamāsādya tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ /
varaṃ tasmai dadau devo brahmā lokamaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
स गोवर्धनमासाद्य तताप विपुलं तपः /
वरं तस्मै ददौ देवो ब्रह्मा लोकमहेश्वरः //
text_mt: He, having reached Govardhana, performed immense austerities. / Lord Brahmā, the great lord of the worlds, granted him a boon:

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśasya cākṣayāṃ kīrti gānayogamanuttamam /
gurorabhyadhikaṃ viprāḥ kāmarūpitvameva ca //
meaning:
वंशस्य चाक्षयां कीर्ति गानयोगमनुत्तमम् /
गुरोरभ्यधिकं विप्राः कामरूपित्वमेव च //
text_mt: imperishable fame for his lineage, the supreme discipline of song / surpassing [that of] the preceptor, O Brahmins, and the ability to take any form at will.

sanskrit_iast:
sa labdhvā varamavyagro vareṇyaṃ vṛṣavāhanam /
pūjayāmāsa gānena sthāṇuṃ tridaśapūjitam //
meaning:
स लब्ध्वा वरमव्यग्रो वरेण्यं वृषवाहनम् /
पूजयामास गानेन स्थाणुं त्रिदशपूजितम् //
text_mt: Having obtained the boon, calm and collected, he worshipped the desirable, bull-riding / Sthāṇu, adored by the thirty [gods], with singing.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya gānaratasyātha bhagavānambikāpatiḥ /
kanyāratnaṃ dadau devo durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi //
meaning:
तस्य गानरतस्याथ भगवानम्बिकापतिः /
कन्यारत्नं ददौ देवो दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि //
text_mt: Then, as he was devoted to singing, the divine lord, the husband of Ambikā, / gave him an exceptional jewel of a maiden, difficult to obtain even for the thirty [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sa saṅgato rājā gānayogamanuttamam /
aśikṣayadamitraghnaḥ priyāṃ tāṃ bhrāntalocanām //
meaning:
तया स सङ्गतो राजा गानयोगमनुत्तमम् /
अशिक्षयदमित्रघ्नः प्रियां तां भ्रान्तलोचनाम् //
text_mt: United with her, that king, slayer of his foes, / taught that supreme discipline of song to his beloved with rolling eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa subhujaṃ nāma śobhanam /
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāṃ hrīmatīmapi kanyakām //
meaning:
तस्यामुत्पादयामास सुभुजं नाम शोभनम् /
रूपलावण्यसंपन्नां ह्रीमतीमपि कन्यकाम् //
text_mt: Upon her he begot a fair [son] named Subhuja, / and also a modest maiden endowed with beauty and charm.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastaṃ jananī putraṃ bālye vayasi śobhanam /
śikṣayāmāsa vidhivad gānavidyāṃ ca kanyakām //
meaning:
ततस्तं जननी पुत्रं बाल्ये वयसि शोभनम् /
शिक्षयामास विधिवद् गानविद्यां च कन्यकाम् //
text_mt: Then, during their boyhood and youth, the mother duly taught / the science of singing to that fair son and to the maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtopanayano vedānadhītya vidhivad guroḥ /
udvavāhātmajāṃ kanyāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ tu mānasīm //
meaning:
कृतोपनयनो वेदानधीत्य विधिवद् गुरोः /
उद्ववाहात्मजां कन्यां गन्धर्वाणां तु मानसीम् //
text_mt: Having undergone the sacred thread rite and duly studied the Vedas from his teacher, / he married a mind-born daughter of the gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa pañca putrānanuttamān /
vīṇāvādanatattvajñān gānaśāstraviśāradān //
meaning:
तस्यामुत्पादयामास पञ्च पुत्राननुत्तमान् /
वीणावादनतत्त्वज्ञान् गानशास्त्रविशारदान् //
text_mt: Upon her he begot five peerless sons / who knew the true nature of playing the lute and were skilled in the science of song.

sanskrit_iast:
putraiḥ pautraiḥ sapatnīko rājā gānaviśāradaḥ /
pūjayāmāsa gānena devaṃ tripuranāśanam //
meaning:
पुत्रैः पौत्रैः सपत्नीको राजा गानविशारदः /
पूजयामास गानेन देवं त्रिपुरनाशनम् //
text_mt: Together with his sons and grandsons and with his wife, that king, skilled in music, / worshipped with singing the god who destroyed the three cities.

sanskrit_iast:
hrīmatī cāpi yā kanyā śrīrivāyatalocanā /
subāhurnāma gandharvastāmādāya yayau purīm //
meaning:
ह्रीमती चापि या कन्या श्रीरिवायतलोचना /
सुबाहुर्नाम गन्धर्वस्तामादाय ययौ पुरीम् //
text_mt: And as for the modest maiden with long eyes like Śrī, / a gandharva named Subāhu took her and went to his city.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmapyabhavan putrā gandharvasya sutejasaḥ /
suṣeṇavīrasugrīvasubhojanaravāhanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्यामप्यभवन् पुत्रा गन्धर्वस्य सुतेजसः /
सुषेणवीरसुग्रीवसुभोजनरवाहनाः //
text_mt: Upon her, the gandharva also had sons of great splendour: / Suṣeṇa, Vīra, Sugrīva, Subhoja, and Naravāhana.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsīdabhijit putro vīrastvānakadundubheḥ /
punarvasuścābhijitaḥ saṃbabhūvāhukaḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
अथासीदभिजित् पुत्रो वीरस्त्वानकदुन्दुभेः /
पुनर्वसुश्चाभिजितः संबभूवाहुकः सुतः //
text_mt: Then the heroic Abhijit was the son of Ānakadundubhi; / from Abhijit came Punarvasu, and his son was Āhuka.

sanskrit_iast:
āhukasyograsenaśca devakaśca dvijottamāḥ /
devakasya sutā vīrā jajñire tridaśopamāḥ //
meaning:
आहुकस्योग्रसेनश्च देवकश्च द्विजोत्तमाः /
देवकस्य सुता वीरा जज्ञिरे त्रिदशोपमाः //
text_mt: To Āhuka were born Ugrasena and Devaka, O best of the twice-born. / Heroic sons resembling the thirty [gods] were born to Devaka:

sanskrit_iast:
devavānupadevaśca sudevo devarakṣitaḥ /
teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan vasudevāya tā dadau //
meaning:
देववानुपदेवश्च सुदेवो देवरक्षितः /
तेषां स्वसारः सप्तासन् वसुदेवाय ता ददौ //
text_mt: Devavān, Upadeva, Sudeva, and Devarakṣita; / they had seven sisters, whom he gave in marriage to Vasudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkadevopadevā ca tathānyā devarakṣitā /
śrīdevā śāntidevā ca sahadevā sahadevā ca suvratā /
devakī cāpi tāsāṃ tu variṣṭhābhūt sumadhyamā //
meaning:
वृकदेवोपदेवा च तथान्या देवरक्षिता /
श्रीदेवा शान्तिदेवा च सहदेवा सहदेवा च सुव्रता /
देवकी चापि तासां तु वरिष्ठाभूत् सुमध्यमा //
text_mt:
Vṛkadevā and Upadevā, and likewise another, Devarakṣitā,
Śrīdevā, Śāntidevā, Sahadevā of excellent vows,
and also Devakī; among them she of slender waist was the foremost.

sanskrit_iast:
agrasenasya putro 'bhūnnyagrodhaḥ kaṃsa eva ca /
subhūmī rāṣṭrapālaśca tuṣṭimāñchaṅkureva ca //
meaning:
अग्रसेनस्य पुत्रो ऽभून्न्यग्रोधः कंस एव च /
सुभूमी राष्ट्रपालश्च तुष्टिमाञ्छङ्कुरेव च //
text_mt:
Ugrasena had sons: Nyagrodha and Kaṃsa,
Subhūmi, Rāṣṭrapāla, Tuṣṭimat, and Śaṅku.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajamānādabūt putraḥ prakhyāto 'sau vidūrathaḥ /
tasya śūraḥ śamistasmāt pratikṣatrastato 'bhavat //
meaning:
भजमानादबूत् पुत्रः प्रख्यातो ऽसौ विदूरथः /
तस्य शूरः शमिस्तस्मात् प्रतिक्षत्रस्ततो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
From Bhajamāna was born that renowned son, Vidūratha;
his son was Śūra; from him came Śami; and Pratikṣatra was born from him.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhojastatastasmād hṛdikaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ /
kṛtavarmātha tatputro devarastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sa śūrastatsuto dhīmān vasudevo 'tha tatsutaḥ //
meaning:
स्वयंभोजस्ततस्तस्माद् हृदिकः शत्रुतापनः /
कृतवर्माथ तत्पुत्रो देवरस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः /
स शूरस्तत्सुतो धीमान् वसुदेवो ऽथ तत्सुतः //

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevāvanmahābāhurvāsudevo jagadguruḥ /
babhūva devakīputro devairabhyarthito hariḥ //
meaning:
वसुदेवावन्महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो जगद्गुरुः /
बभूव देवकीपुत्रो देवैरभ्यर्थितो हरिः //
text_mt:
From Vasudeva, the mighty-armed Vāsudeva, the teacher of the universe,
became the son of Devakī—Hari, beseeched by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā vasudevasya śobhanā /
asūta patnī saṃkarṣaṃ rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ halāyudham //
meaning:
रोहिणी च महाभागा वसुदेवस्य शोभना /
असूत पत्नी संकर्षं रामं ज्येष्ठं हलायुधम् //
text_mt:
And the illustrious and auspicious Rohiṇī, wife of Vasudeva,
bore the plough-armed elder [son], Rāma Saṃkarṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva paramātmāsau vāsudevo jaganmayaḥ /
halāyudhaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāccheṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
स एव परमात्मासौ वासुदेवो जगन्मयः /
हलायुधः स्वयं साक्षाच्छेषः संकर्षणः प्रभुः //
text_mt:
He indeed is that Supreme Self, Vāsudeva composed of the universe;
the plough-armed lord Saṃkarṣaṇa is himself Śeṣa manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguśāpacchalenaiva mānayan mānuṣīṃ tanum /
babhūta tasyāṃ devakyāṃ rohiṇyāmapi mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
भृगुशापच्छलेनैव मानयन् मानुषीं तनुम् /
बभूत तस्यां देवक्यां रोहिण्यामपि माधवः //
text_mt:
Honoring a human body merely under the pretext of Bhṛgu’s curse,
Mādhava was born from that Devakī and also from Rohiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
umādehasamudbhūtā yoganidrā ca kauśīkī /
niyogād vāsudevasya yaśodātanayā hyabhūt //
meaning:
उमादेहसमुद्भूता योगनिद्रा च कौशीकी /
नियोगाद् वासुदेवस्य यशोदातनया ह्यभूत् //
text_mt:
And Kauśikī, Yoganidrā born from Umā’s body,
became Yaśodā’s daughter by the command of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye vasudevasya vāsudevāgrajāḥ sutāḥ /
prāgeva kaṃsastān sarvān jaghāna munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
ये चान्ये वसुदेवस्य वासुदेवाग्रजाः सुताः /
प्रागेव कंसस्तान् सर्वान् जघान मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt:
Those other sons of Vasudeva who were elder brothers of Vāsudeva—
Kaṃsa killed them all beforehand, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣeṇaśca tathodāyī bhadraseno mahābalaḥ /
ṛjudāso bhadradāsaḥ kīrtimānapi pūrvajaḥ //
meaning:
सुषेणश्च तथोदायी भद्रसेनो महाबलः /
ऋजुदासो भद्रदासः कीर्तिमानपि पूर्वजः //
text_mt:
Suṣeṇa, likewise Udāyin, Bhadrasena of great might,
Ṛjudāsa, Bhadradāsa, and also the eldest, Kīrtimat.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣveteṣu sarveṣu rohiṇī vasudevataḥ /
asūta rāmaṃ lokeśaṃ balabhadraṃ halāyudham //
meaning:
हतेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु रोहिणी वसुदेवतः /
असूत रामं लोकेशं बलभद्रं हलायुधम् //
text_mt:
When all these were slain, Rohiṇī bore from Vasudeva
Rāma, the lord of the world, Balabhadra, the plough-armed one.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte 'tha rāme devānāmādimātmānamacyutam /
asūta devakī kṛṣṇaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam //
meaning:
जाते ऽथ रामे देवानामादिमात्मानमच्युतम् /
असूत देवकी कृष्णं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् //
text_mt:
Then, when Rāma was born, Devakī bore Kṛṣṇa,
the first self of the gods, the imperishable one, whose chest is marked with the śrīvatsa.

sanskrit_iast:
revatī nāma rāmasya bhāryāsīt suguṇānvitā /
tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putrau dvau niśaṭholmukau //
meaning:
रेवती नाम रामस्य भार्यासीत् सुगुणान्विता /
तस्यामुत्पादयामास पुत्रौ द्वौ निशठोल्मुकौ //
text_mt:
Rāma had a wife named Revatī, endowed with noble qualities;
upon her he begot two sons, Niśaṭha and Ulmuka.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśastrīsahastrāṇi kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ /
babhūvurātmajāstāsu śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ //
meaning:
षोडशस्त्रीसहस्त्राणि कृष्णस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः /
बभूवुरात्मजास्तासु शतशो ऽथ सहस्त्रशः //
text_mt:
Sixteen thousand were the wives of Kṛṣṇa, of unwearied action;
upon them were born sons by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
cārudeṣṇaḥ sucāruśca cāruveṣo yaśodharaḥ /
cāruśravāścāruyaśāḥ pradyumnaḥ śaṅkha eva ca //
meaning:
चारुदेष्णः सुचारुश्च चारुवेषो यशोधरः /
चारुश्रवाश्चारुयशाः प्रद्युम्नः शङ्ख एव च //
text_mt:
Cārudeṣṇa, Sucāru, Cāruveṣa, Yaśodhara,
Cāruśravas, Cāruyaśas, Pradyumna, and Śaṅkha:

sanskrit_iast:
rukmiṇya vāsudevasyāṃ mahābalaparākramāḥ /
viśiṣṭāḥ sarvaputrāṇāṃ saṃbabhūvurim sutāḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मिण्य वासुदेवस्यां महाबलपराक्रमाः /
विशिष्टाः सर्वपुत्राणां संबभूवुरिम् सुताः //
text_mt:
These sons, endowed with great strength and prowess,
foremost among all sons, were born to Vāsudeva from Rukmiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
tān dṛṣṭvā tanayān vīrān raukmiṇeyāñjanārdanam /
jāmbavatyabravīt kṛṣṇaṃ bhāryā tasya śucismitā //
meaning:
तान् दृष्ट्वा तनयान् वीरान् रौक्मिणेयाञ्जनार्दनम् /
जाम्बवत्यब्रवीत् कृष्णं भार्या तस्य शुचिस्मिता //
text_mt:
Seeing those heroic sons born of Rukmiṇī,
his wife Jāmbavatī, of pure smile, said to Janārdana Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
mama tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa viśiṣṭaṃ guṇavattamam /
sureśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi dānavasūdana //
meaning:
मम त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष विशिष्टं गुणवत्तमम् /
सुरेशसदृशं पुत्रं देहि दानवसूदन //
text_mt:
“O lotus-eyed one, O slayer of Dānavas,
grant me an eminent son, most virtuous, equal to the lord of gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
jātbavatyā vacaḥ śrutvā jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ /
samārebhe tapaḥ kartuṃ taponidhirarindamaḥ //
meaning:
जात्बवत्या वचः श्रुत्वा जगन्नाथः स्वयं हरिः /
समारेभे तपः कर्तुं तपोनिधिररिन्दमः //
text_mt:
Hearing the word of Jāmbavatī, the lord of the world, Hari himself,
a treasure of austerity and subduer of enemies, undertook to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhā yathāsau devakīsutaḥ /
dṛṣṭvā lebhe sutaṃ rudraṃ taptvā tīvraṃ mahat tapaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तच्छृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठा यथासौ देवकीसुतः /
दृष्ट्वा लेभे सुतं रुद्रं तप्त्वा तीव्रं महत् तपः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Hear that, O best of sages: how that son of Devakī,
having performed severe and great austerity, saw Rudra and obtained a son.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
atha devo hṛṣīkeśo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ /
tatāpa ghoraṃ putrārthaṃ nidānaṃ tapasastapaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अथ देवो हृषीकेशो भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः /
तताप घोरं पुत्रार्थं निदानं तपसस्तपः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Then the divine Hṛṣīkeśa, the blessed Supreme Spirit,
a primary source of austerity, performed terrible austerity for the sake of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
svecchayāpyavatīrṇo 'sau kṛtakṛtyo 'pi viśvadhṛk /
cacāra svātmano mūlaṃ bodhayan bhāvamaiśvaram //
meaning:
स्वेच्छयाप्यवतीर्णो ऽसौ कृतकृत्यो ऽपि विश्वधृक् /
चचार स्वात्मनो मूलं बोधयन् भावमैश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Though descended by his own will, though fulfilled in all actions, the upholder of all
acted, teaching the sovereign state that is the source of his own self.

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma yogibhirjuṣṭaṃ nānāpakṣisamākulam /
āśramaṃ tūpamanyorvai munīndrasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
जगाम योगिभिर्जुष्टं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम् /
आश्रमं तूपमन्योर्वै मुनीन्द्रस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt:
He went to the hermitage of Upamanyu, the great-souled prince of sages,
frequented by yogins and filled with various birds.

sanskrit_iast:
tapattrirājamārūḍhaḥ suparṇamatitejasam /
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तपत्त्रिराजमारूढः सुपर्णमतितेजसम् /
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः //
text_mt:
Mounted upon the bird-king Suparṇa of exceeding radiance,
conch, discus, and mace in hand, marked with the śrīvatsa,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam /
ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ vedaghoṣanināditam //
meaning:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं नानापुष्पोपशोभितम् /
ऋषीणामाश्रमैर्जुष्टं वेदघोषनिनादितम् //
text_mt:
overspread with various trees and creepers, adorned with diverse flowers,
frequented by the hermitages of ṛṣis, echoing with the recitation of the Vedas,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃharkṣaśarabhākīrṇaṃ śārdūlagajasaṃyutam /
vimalasvādupānīyaiḥ sarobhirupaśobhitam //
meaning:
सिंहर्क्षशरभाकीर्णं शार्दूलगजसंयुतम् /
विमलस्वादुपानीयैः सरोभिरुपशोभितम् //
text_mt:
crowded with lions, bears, and śarabhas, filled with tigers and elephants,
adorned with lakes of clear, sweet water,

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmairvividhairjuṣṭaṃ devatāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
ṛṣikairṛṣiputraiśca mahāmunigaṇaistathā //
meaning:
आरामैर्विविधैर्जुष्टं देवतायतनैः शुभैः /
ऋषिकैरृषिपुत्रैश्च महामुनिगणैस्तथा //
text_mt:
frequented by various groves, with auspicious shrines of deities,
by ṛṣis, sons of ṛṣis, and hosts of great sages,

sanskrit_iast:
vedādhyayanasaṃpannaiḥ sevitaṃ cāgnihotribhiḥ /
yogibhirdhyānaniratairnāsāgragatalocanaiḥ //
meaning:
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नैः सेवितं चाग्निहोत्रिभिः /
योगिभिर्ध्याननिरतैर्नासाग्रगतलोचनैः //
text_mt:
served by those accomplished in Vedic study and maintainers of sacred fires,
by yogins dedicated to meditation with eyes fixed on the tip of the nose,

sanskrit_iast:
upetaṃ sarvataḥ puṇyaṃ jñānibhistattvadarśibhiḥ /
nadībhirabhito juṣṭaṃ jāpakairbrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
उपेतं सर्वतः पुण्यं ज्ञानिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः /
नदीभिरभितो जुष्टं जापकैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt:
sacred, attended on all sides by the wise who perceive reality,
frequented round about by rivers, by silent chanters and expounders of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
sevitaṃ tāpasaiḥ puṇyairīśārādhanatatparaiḥ /
praśāntaiḥ satyasaṃkalpairniḥ śokairnirupadravaiḥ //
meaning:
सेवितं तापसैः पुण्यैरीशाराधनतत्परैः /
प्रशान्तैः सत्यसंकल्पैर्निः शोकैर्निरुपद्रवैः //
text_mt:
served by holy ascetics devoted to the worship of the Lord,
peaceful, of true resolve, free from grief and free from adversity,

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmāvadātasarvāṅgai rudrajāpyaparāyaṇaiḥ /
muṇḍitairjaṭilaiḥ śuddhaistathānyaiśca śikhājaṭaiḥ /
sevitaṃ tāpasairnitya jñānibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ //
meaning:
भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गै रुद्रजाप्यपरायणैः /
मुण्डितैर्जटिलैः शुद्धैस्तथान्यैश्च शिखाजटैः /
सेवितं तापसैर्नित्य ज्ञानिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः //
text_mt:
their limbs whitened with ashes, dedicated to the silent recitation of Rudra,
some shaven, some matted-haired, pure, others with braided tufts of hair,
served constantly by ascetics, the wise and celibate students.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāśramavare ramye siddhāśramavibhūṣite /
gaṅgā bhagavatī nityaṃ vahatyevāghanāśinī //
meaning:
तत्राश्रमवरे रम्ये सिद्धाश्रमविभूषिते /
गङ्गा भगवती नित्यं वहत्येवाघनाशिनी //
text_mt:
There in that delightful, excellent hermitage, adorned by the hermitage of perfected ones,
the blessed Gaṅgā flows perpetually, destroying sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tānanviṣya viśvātmā tāpasān vītakalmaṣān /
praṇāmenātha vacasā pūjayāmāsa mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
स तानन्विष्य विश्वात्मा तापसान् वीतकल्मषान् /
प्रणामेनाथ वचसा पूजयामास माधवः //
text_mt:
Seeking out those sinless ascetics, Mādhava,
the Self of all, honored them with obeisance and words.

sanskrit_iast:
te te dṛṣṭvā jagadyoniṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam /
praṇemurbhaktisaṃyuktā yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum //
meaning:
ते ते दृष्ट्वा जगद्योनिं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् /
प्रणेमुर्भक्तिसंयुक्ता योगिनां परमं गुरुम् //
text_mt:
Seeing the source of the world bearing the conch, discus, and mace,
they bowed with devotion to the supreme teacher of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti vaidikairmantraiḥ kṛtvā hṛdi sanātanam /
procuranyonyamavyaktamādidevaṃ mahāmunim //
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः कृत्वा हृदि सनातनम् /
प्रोचुरन्योन्यमव्यक्तमादिदेवं महामुनिम् //
text_mt:
Praising him with Vedic mantras, holding the eternal one in their hearts,
they spoke to one another of that unmanifest primal god, the great sage:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ sa bhagavānekaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ /
agacchatyadhunā devaḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ svayam //
meaning:
अयं स भगवानेकः साक्षान्नारायणः परः /
अगच्छत्यधुना देवः पुराणपुरुषः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
“This is the one blessed Lord, the supreme Nārāyaṇa manifest;
now the god, the ancient person himself, approaches.

sanskrit_iast:
ayamevāvyayaḥ straṣṭā saṃhartā caiva rakṣakaḥ /
amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā munīn draṣṭumihāgataḥ //
meaning:
अयमेवाव्ययः स्त्रष्टा संहर्ता चैव रक्षकः /
अमूर्तो मूर्तिमान् भूत्वा मुनीन् द्रष्टुमिहागतः //
text_mt:
He alone is the imperishable creator, destroyer, and protector;
becoming embodied though formless, he has come here to see the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca samāgacchati sarvagaḥ /
anādirakṣayo 'nanto mahābhūto maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एष धाता विधाता च समागच्छति सर्वगः /
अनादिरक्षयो ऽनन्तो महाभूतो महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
He, the supporter and ordainer, the all-pervading one, approaches;
beginningless, indestructible, endless, the great entity, the great lord.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā śrutvā haristeṣāṃ vacāṃsi vacanātigaḥ /
yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindaḥ sthānaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा श्रुत्वा हरिस्तेषां वचांसि वचनातिगः /
ययौ स तूर्णं गोविन्दः स्थानं तस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt:
Hearing their words again and again, Hari, beyond the realm of speech,
Govinda went swiftly to the dwelling of that great soul.

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśyātha bhāvena tīrthe tīrthe sa yādavaḥ /
cakāra devakīsūnurdevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam //
meaning:
उपस्पृश्याथ भावेन तीर्थे तीर्थे स यादवः /
चकार देवकीसूनुर्देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् //
text_mt:
Having sipped water with devotion at each holy ford, the Yādava,
the son of Devakī, performed libations to the gods, ṛṣis, and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīnāṃ tīrasaṃsthāni sthāpitāni munīśvaraiḥ /
liṅgāni pūjayāmāsa śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
नदीनां तीरसंस्थानि स्थापितानि मुनीश्वरैः /
लिङ्गानि पूजयामास शंभोरमिततेजसः //
text_mt:
He worshipped the liṅgas of Śambhu of immeasurable splendor
which were situated on the banks of rivers and established by sovereign sages.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ yatra yatra janārdanam /
pūjayāñcakrire puṣpairakṣataistatra vāsinaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा समायान्तं यत्र यत्र जनार्दनम् /
पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे पुष्पैरक्षतैस्तत्र वासिनः //
text_mt:
Seeing Janārdana approaching wherever he went,
the inhabitants there worshipped him with flowers and unbroken grains.

sanskrit_iast:
samīkṣya vāsudevaṃ taṃ śārṅgaśaṅkhāsidhāriṇam /
tasthire niścalāḥ sarve śubhāṅgaṃ tannivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
समीक्ष्य वासुदेवं तं शार्ङ्गशङ्खासिधारिणम् /
तस्थिरे निश्चलाः सर्वे शुभाङ्गं तन्निवासिनः //
text_mt:
Beholding Vāsudeva of auspicious limbs, holding bow, conch, and sword,
all the dwellers of that place stood motionless.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni tatrārurukṣūṇāṃ mānasāni janārdanam /
dṛṣṭvā samīhitānyāsan niṣkrāmanti purāhiram //
meaning:
यानि तत्रारुरुक्षूणां मानसानि जनार्दनम् /
दृष्ट्वा समीहितान्यासन् निष्क्रामन्ति पुराहिरम् //
text_mt:
The desires that arose in the minds of those who longed to attain Janārdana
upon seeing him, were realized before Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
athāvagāhya gaṅgāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam /
ādāya puṣpavaryāṇi munīndrasyāviśad gṛham //
meaning:
अथावगाह्य गङ्गायां कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम् /
आदाय पुष्पवर्याणि मुनीन्द्रस्याविशद् गृहम् //
text_mt:
Then, having bathed in the Gaṅgā and performed libations to the gods and others,
taking choice flowers, he entered the dwelling of the prince of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigraham /
jaṭācīradharaṃ śāntaṃ nanāma śirasā munim //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं योगिनां श्रेष्ठं भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहम् /
जटाचीरधरं शान्तं ननाम शिरसा मुनिम् //
text_mt: Seeing him, the foremost of yogins, his body smeared with ashes, / wearing matted locks and bark garments, tranquil, he bowed his head to the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ālokya kṛṣṇamāyāntaṃ pūjayāmāsa tattvavit /
āsane cāsayāmāsa yogināṃ prathamātithim //
meaning:
आलोक्य कृष्णमायान्तं पूजयामास तत्त्ववित् /
आसने चासयामास योगिनां प्रथमातिथिम् //
text_mt: Beholding Kṛṣṇa arriving, the knower of truth honored him, / and seated the foremost guest among yogins upon a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vacasāṃ yoniṃ jānīmaḥ paramaṃ padam /
viṣṇumavyaktasaṃsthānaṃ śiṣyabhāvena saṃsthitam //
meaning:
उवाच वचसां योनिं जानीमः परमं पदम् /
विष्णुमव्यक्तसंस्थानं शिष्यभावेन संस्थितम् //
text_mt: He said: “We recognize the source of speech, the supreme state, / Viṣṇu, whose abode is the unmanifest, standing in the guise of a disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
svāgataṃ te hṛṣīkeśa saphalāni tapāṃsi naḥ /
yad sākṣādeva viśvātmā madgehaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ //
meaning:
स्वागतं ते हृषीकेश सफलानि तपांसि नः /
यद् साक्षादेव विश्वात्मा मद्गेहं विष्णुरागतः //
text_mt: Welcome to you, Hṛṣīkeśa! Our austerities bear fruit, / since Viṣṇu, the Soul of All, has arrived in person at my home.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ na paśyanti munayo yatanto 'pi hi yoginaḥ /
tādṛśasyātha bhavataḥ kimāgamanakāraṇam //
meaning:
त्वां न पश्यन्ति मुनयो यतन्तो ऽपि हि योगिनः /
तादृशस्याथ भवतः किमागमनकारणम् //
text_mt: Even striving yogin sages do not behold you; / what, then, is the cause of the arrival of one such as you?”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvopamanyostad vākyaṃ bhagavān keśimardanaḥ /
vyājahāra mahāyogī vacanaṃ praṇipatya tam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वोपमन्योस्तद् वाक्यं भगवान् केशिमर्दनः /
व्याजहार महायोगी वचनं प्रणिपत्य तम् //
text_mt: Having heard those words of Upamanyu, the Lord, the crusher of Keśin, / the great yogin, bowed down to him and uttered these words:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bhagavan draṣṭumicchāmi girīśaṃ kṛttivāsasam /
saṃprāpto bhavataḥ sthānaṃ bhagavaddarśanotsukaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
भगवन् द्रष्टुमिच्छामि गिरीशं कृत्तिवाससम् /
संप्राप्तो भवतः स्थानं भगवद्दर्शनोत्सुकः //
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “O Lord, I wish to see the Lord of the Mountain, clad in animal skins. / Desirous of the sight of the Lord, I have arrived at your abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśo dṛśyo yogavidāṃ varaḥ /
mayācireṇa kutrāhaṃ drakṣyāmi tamumāpatim //
meaning:
कथं स भगवानीशो दृश्यो योगविदां वरः /
मयाचिरेण कुत्राहं द्रक्ष्यामि तमुमापतिम् //
text_mt: How may that Lord, the ruler, the best of knowers of yoga, be seen / by me without delay? Where shall I behold that husband of Umā?”

sanskrit_iast:
ityāha bhagavānukto dṛśyate parameśvaraḥ /
bhaktyā cogreṇa tapasā tatkuruṣveha yatnataḥ //
meaning:
इत्याह भगवानुक्तो दृश्यते परमेश्वरः /
भक्त्या चोग्रेण तपसा तत्कुरुष्वेह यत्नतः //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the Lord [sage] said: “The Supreme Lord is beheld / through devotion and fierce austerity. Therefore, undertake that here with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
iheśvaraṃ devadevaṃ munīndrā brahmavādinaḥ /
dhyāyanto 'trāsate devaṃ jāpinastāpasāśca ye //
meaning:
इहेश्वरं देवदेवं मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्मवादिनः /
ध्यायन्तो ऽत्रासते देवं जापिनस्तापसाश्च ये //
text_mt: Here the foremost of sages who discourse on Brahman reside, / meditating upon the Lord, the God of gods, as do ascetics chanting prayers.

sanskrit_iast:
iha devaḥ sapatnīko bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ /
krīḍate vividhairbhūtairyogibhiḥ parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
इह देवः सपत्नीको भगवान् वृषभध्वजः /
क्रीडते विविधैर्भूतैर्योगिभिः परिवारितः //
text_mt: Here the divine, glorious one whose banner bears a bull, with his consort, / plays, surrounded by various spirits and yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāśrame purā rudrāt tapastaptvā sudāruṇam /
lebhe maheśvarād yogaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ //
meaning:
इहाश्रमे पुरा रुद्रात् तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम् /
लेभे महेश्वराद् योगं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः //
text_mt: Formerly, in this hermitage, having performed terrible austerity toward Rudra, / the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha obtained yoga from the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva bhagavān vyasaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ /
dṛṣṭvā taṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ labdhavānīśvareśvaram //
meaning:
इहैव भगवान् व्यसः कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः /
दृष्ट्वा तं परमं ज्ञानं लब्धवानीश्वरेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Right here the glorious master Vyāsa, Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, / having beheld him, attained the supreme knowledge from the Lord of lords.

sanskrit_iast:
ihāśramavare ramye tapastaptvā kapardinaḥ /
avindat putrakān rudrāt surabhirbhaktisaṃyutā //
meaning:
इहाश्रमवरे रम्ये तपस्तप्त्वा कपर्दिनः /
अविन्दत् पुत्रकान् रुद्रात् सुरभिर्भक्तिसंयुता //
text_mt: Having performed austerity toward the braided-haired one in this lovely, excellent hermitage, / Surabhi, endowed with devotion, obtained sons from Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva devatāḥ pūrvaṃ kālād bhītā maheśvaram /
dṛṣṭavanto haraṃ śrīmannirbhayā nirvṛtiṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
इहैव देवताः पूर्वं कालाद् भीता महेश्वरम् /
दृष्टवन्तो हरं श्रीमन्निर्भया निर्वृतिं ययुः //
text_mt: Right here formerly, the gods, terrified of time, / beheld the Great Lord Hara, O glorious one, and went to rest, free from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
ihārādhya mahādevaṃ sāvarṇistapatāṃ varaḥ /
labdhavān paramaṃ yogaṃ granthakāratvamuttamam //
meaning:
इहाराध्य महादेवं सावर्णिस्तपतां वरः /
लब्धवान् परमं योगं ग्रन्थकारत्वमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having propitiated Mahādeva here, Sāvarṇi, the best of the ascetic, / obtained supreme yoga and the excellent authorship of a treatise.

sanskrit_iast:
pravartayāmāsa śubhāṃ kṛtvā vai saṃhitāṃ dvijaḥ /
paurāṇikīṃ supuṇyārthāṃ sacchiṣyeṣu dvijātiṣu //
meaning:
प्रवर्तयामास शुभां कृत्वा वै संहितां द्विजः /
पौराणिकीं सुपुण्यार्थां सच्छिष्येषु द्विजातिषु //
text_mt: Having composed an auspicious collection concerning Purāṇas, bringing great merit, / that twice-born man set it forth among the twice-born who were his good disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva saṃhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāpeyaḥ śāṃśapāyanaḥ /
mahādevaṃ cakāremāṃ paurāṇīṃ tanniyogataḥ /
dvādaśaiva sahastrāṇi ślokānāṃ puruṣottama //
meaning:
इहैव संहितां दृष्ट्वा कापेयः शांशपायनः /
महादेवं चकारेमां पौराणीं तन्नियोगतः /
द्वादशैव सहस्त्राणि श्लोकानां पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: Right here, having seen that compilation, Śāṃśapāyana of the Kapi gotra / made this Purāṇic [compilation] of twelve thousand verses / by the command of Mahādeva, O Supreme Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
iha pravartitā puṇyā dvyaṣṭasāhastrikottarā /
vāyavīyottaraṃ nāma purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam /
ihaiva khyāpitaṃ śiṣyaiḥ śāṃśapāyanabhāṣitam //
meaning:
इह प्रवर्तिता पुण्या द्व्यष्टसाहस्त्रिकोत्तरा /
वायवीयोत्तरं नाम पुराणं वेदसंमितम् /
इहैव ख्यापितं शिष्यैः शांशपायनभाषितम् //
text_mt: Here was set forth that meritorious Purāṇa named Vāyavīyottara, / consisting of sixteen thousand verses, equal to the Vedas; / spoken by Śāṃśapāyana, it was proclaimed right here by disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
yājñavalkyo mahāyogī dṛṣṭvātra tapasā haram /
cakāra tanniyogena yogaśāstramanuttamam //
meaning:
याज्ञवल्क्यो महायोगी दृष्ट्वात्र तपसा हरम् /
चकार तन्नियोगेन योगशास्त्रमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Having seen Hara here through austerity, the great yogin Yājñavalkya / composed the unsurpassed treatise on yoga by his command.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva bhṛguṇā pūrvaṃ taptvā vai paramaṃ tapaḥ /
śukro maheśvarāt putro labdho yogavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
इहैव भृगुणा पूर्वं तप्त्वा वै परमं तपः /
शुक्रो महेश्वरात् पुत्रो लब्धो योगविदां वरः //
text_mt: Right here formerly, having performed supreme austerity, / Bhṛgu obtained from the Great Lord his son Śukra, the best among knowers of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādihaiva deveśaṃ tapastaptvā maheśvaram /
draṣṭumarhasi viśveśamugraṃ bhīmaṃ kapardinam //
meaning:
तस्मादिहैव देवेशं तपस्तप्त्वा महेश्वरम् /
द्रष्टुमर्हसि विश्वेशमुग्रं भीमं कपर्दिनम् //
text_mt: Therefore, having performed austerity right here, you ought to behold / the Lord of gods, the Great Lord, the Lord of all, fierce, formidable, the braided-haired one.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā dadau jñānamupamanyurmahāmuniḥ /
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ kṛṣṇāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा ददौ ज्ञानमुपमन्युर्महामुनिः /
व्रतं पाशुपतं योगं कृष्णायाक्लिष्टकर्मणे //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the great sage Upamanyu gave knowledge, / the Pāśupata vow, and yoga to Kṛṣṇa, whose deeds are unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena munivaryeṇa vyāhṛto madhusūdanaḥ /
tatraiva tapasā devaṃ rudramārādhayat prabhuḥ //
meaning:
स तेन मुनिवर्येण व्याहृतो मधुसूदनः /
तत्रैव तपसा देवं रुद्रमाराधयत् प्रभुः //
text_mt: Instructed by that best of sages, the Lord Madhusūdana, / right there through austerity, propitiated the divine Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmauddhūlitasarvāṅgo muṇḍo valkalasaṃyutaḥ /
jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ śivaikāhitamānasaḥ //
meaning:
भस्मौद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गो मुण्डो वल्कलसंयुतः /
जजाप रुद्रमनिशं शिवैकाहितमानसः //
text_mt: His entire body smeared with ashes, his head shaved, wearing bark garments, / he incessantly recited prayers to Rudra, his mind fixed exclusively on Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bahutithe kāle somaḥ somārdhabhūṣaṇaḥ /
adṛśyata mahādevo vyomni devyā maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ततो बहुतिथे काले सोमः सोमार्धभूषणः /
अदृश्यत महादेवो व्योम्नि देव्या महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Then, after a great length of time, the Moon-crowned, adorned with the half-moon, / Mahādeva, the Great Lord, was seen in the sky along with the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ citramālaṃ
pinākinaṃ śūlinaṃ devadevam /
śārdūlacarmāmbarasaṃvṛtāṅgaṃ
devyā mahādevamasau dadarśa //
meaning:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चित्रमालं
पिनाकिनं शूलिनं देवदेवम् /
शार्दूलचर्माम्बरसंवृताङ्गं
देव्या महादेवमसौ ददर्श //
text_mt: Crowned, bearing a mace, with a varied garland, / wielding the Pināka, holding a trident, the God of gods, / his limbs covered with a tiger skin as a garment— / he beheld that Mahādeva along with the Goddess;

sanskrit_iast:
paraśvadhāsaktakaraṃ trinetraṃ
nṛsiṃhacarmāvṛtasarvagātram /
samudgirantaṃ praṇavaṃ bṛhantaṃ
sahastrasūryapratimaṃ dadarśa //
meaning:
परश्वधासक्तकरं त्रिनेत्रं
नृसिंहचर्मावृतसर्वगात्रम् /
समुद्गिरन्तं प्रणवं बृहन्तं
सहस्त्रसूर्यप्रतिमं ददर्श //
text_mt: his hand resting on an axe, three-eyed, / his entire body covered in the skin of a man-lion, / uttering the great sacred syllable Oṃ, / resembling a thousand suns—[thus] he beheld him;

sanskrit_iast:
prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purastāt
sanātanaṃ yoginamīśitāram /
aṇoraṇīyāṃsamanantaśaktiṃ
prāṇeśvaraṃ śaṃbhumasau dadarśa //
meaning:
प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं पुरस्तात्
सनातनं योगिनमीशितारम् /
अणोरणीयांसमनन्तशक्तिं
प्राणेश्वरं शंभुमसौ ददर्श //
text_mt: the master, the ancient Person before him, / the eternal yogin, the ruler, / subtler than the subtle, of infinite power, / the Lord of breath, Śambhu—[thus] he beheld him;

sanskrit_iast:
na yasya devā na pitāmaho 'pi
nendro na cāgnirvaruṇo na mṛtyuḥ /
prabhāvamadyāpi vadanti rudraṃ
tamādidevaṃ purato dadarśa //
meaning:
न यस्य देवा न पितामहो ऽपि
नेन्द्रो न चाग्निर्वरुणो न मृत्युः /
प्रभावमद्यापि वदन्ति रुद्रं
तमादिदेवं पुरतो ददर्श //
text_mt: whose power not even the gods, nor the Grandfather, / nor Indra, nor Agni, Varuṇa, nor Death / can describe even today—that primeval god, Rudra, / he beheld before him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadānvapaśyad giriśasya vāme
svātmānamavyaktamanantarūpam /
stuvantamīśaṃ bahubhirvacobhiḥ
śaṅkhāsicakrārpitahastamādyam //
meaning:
तदान्वपश्यद् गिरिशस्य वामे
स्वात्मानमव्यक्तमनन्तरूपम् /
स्तुवन्तमीशं बहुभिर्वचोभिः
शङ्खासिचक्रार्पितहस्तमाद्यम् //
text_mt: Then he saw on the left of the Mountain Dweller / his own self, unmanifest, of endless forms, / praising the Lord with many words, / the primeval one whose hands bore the conch, sword, and discus.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sureśaṃ
haṃsādhirūḍhaṃ puruṣaṃ dadarśa /
stuvānamīśasya paraṃ prabhāvaṃ
pitāmahaṃ lokaguruṃ divastham //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिं दक्षिणतः सुरेशं
हंसाधिरूढं पुरुषं ददर्श /
स्तुवानमीशस्य परं प्रभावं
पितामहं लोकगुरुं दिवस्थम् //
text_mt: On the right he saw the Lord of the gods, his hands joined in reverence, / the Person mounted upon a goose, / standing in heaven, praising the supreme majesty of the Lord— / the Grandfather, the teacher of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśvarānarkasahastrakalpān
nandīśvarādīnamitaprabhāvān /
trilokabhartuḥ purato 'nvapaśyat
kumāramagnipatimaṃ saśākham //
meaning:
गणेश्वरानर्कसहस्त्रकल्पान्
नन्दीश्वरादीनमितप्रभावान् /
त्रिलोकभर्तुः पुरतो ऽन्वपश्यत्
कुमारमग्निपतिमं सशाखम् //
text_mt: The lords of the troops, resembling a thousand suns, / Nandīśvara and others of boundless majesty, / he saw before the sustainer of the three worlds, / as well as Kumāra, resembling fire, with Śākha.

sanskrit_iast:
marīcimatriṃ pulahaṃ pulastyaṃ
pracetasaṃ dakṣamathāpi kaṇvam /
parāśaraṃ tatparato vasiṣṭhaṃ
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ cāpi manuṃ dadarśa //
meaning:
मरीचिमत्रिं पुलहं पुलस्त्यं
प्रचेतसं दक्षमथापि कण्वम् /
पराशरं तत्परतो वसिष्ठं
स्वायंभुवं चापि मनुं ददर्श //
text_mt: He saw Marīci, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, / Pracetas, Dakṣa, and also Kaṇva, / Parāśara, and beyond him Vasiṣṭha, / and Svāyambhuva Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva mantrairamarapradhānaṃ
baddhāñjalirviṣṇurudārabuddhiḥ /
praṇamya devyā giriśaṃ sabhaktyā
svātmanyathātmānamasau vicintya //
meaning:
तुष्टाव मन्त्रैरमरप्रधानं
बद्धाञ्जलिर्विष्णुरुदारबुद्धिः /
प्रणम्य देव्या गिरिशं सभक्त्या
स्वात्मन्यथात्मानमसौ विचिन्त्य //
text_mt: The noble-minded Viṣṇu praised the foremost of the immortals with mantras, / with hands joined in reverence, / having bowed with devotion to the Mountain Dweller with the Goddess, / and contemplating that Self within his own self:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
namo 'stu te śāśvata sarvayone
brahmādhipaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti /
tapaśca sattvaṃ ca rajastamaśca
tvāmeva sarva pravadanti santaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
नमो ऽस्तु ते शाश्वत सर्वयोने
ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति /
तपश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तमश्च
त्वामेव सर्व प्रवदन्ति सन्तः //
text_mt: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Salutation to you, eternal one, womb of all! / The sages declare you to be the ruler of Brahman. / You are austerity, goodness, passion, and darkness; / the virtuous declare that you are indeed everything.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmā hariratha viśvayoniragniḥ
saṃhartā dinakaramaṇḍalādhivāsaḥ /
prāṇastvaṃ hutavahavāsavādibheda-
satvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam //
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्मा हरिरथ विश्वयोनिरग्निः
संहर्ता दिनकरमण्डलाधिवासः /
प्राणस्त्वं हुतवहवासवादिभेद-
सत्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम् //
text_mt: You are Brahmā, Hari, the source of the universe, and Agni; / you are the destroyer, whose dwelling is the disc of the sun; / you are breath, divided as the fire, Indra, and the rest; / to you, the one God and Lord, I resort for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhyāstvāṃ viguṇamathāhurekarūpaṃ
yogāstvāṃ satatamupāsate hṛdistham /
vedāstvāmabhidadhatīha rudramagniṃ
tvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam //
meaning:
सांख्यास्त्वां विगुणमथाहुरेकरूपं
योगास्त्वां सततमुपासते हृदिस्थम् /
वेदास्त्वामभिदधतीह रुद्रमग्निं
त्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम् //
text_mt: The Sāṃkhyas declare you to be devoid of qualities and of a single form; / yogins perpetually worship you residing within the heart; / the Vedas declare you to be Rudra and fire here; / to you, the one God and Lord, I resort for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tvātpāde kusumamathāpi patramekaṃ
dattvāsau bhavati vimuktaviśvabandhaḥ /
sarvāghaṃ praṇudati siddhayogijuṣṭaṃ
smṛtvā te padayugalaṃ bhavatprasādāt //
meaning:
त्वात्पादे कुसुममथापि पत्रमेकं
दत्त्वासौ भवति विमुक्तविश्वबन्धः /
सर्वाघं प्रणुदति सिद्धयोगिजुष्टं
स्मृत्वा ते पदयुगलं भवत्प्रसादात् //
text_mt: By offering a single flower or even a leaf at your feet, / a person becomes freed from all bonds; / remembering your pair of feet attended by perfected yogins, / he casts off every sin through your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāśeṣavibhāgahīnamamalaṃ hṛdyantarāvasthitaṃ
tattvaṃ jyotiranantamekamacalaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ sarvagam /
sthānaṃ prāhuranādimadhyanidhanaṃ yasmādidaṃ jāyate
nityaṃ tvāmahamupaimi satyavibhavaṃviśveśvarantaṃśivam //
meaning:
यस्याशेषविभागहीनममलं हृद्यन्तरावस्थितं
तत्त्वं ज्योतिरनन्तमेकमचलं सत्यं परं सर्वगम् /
स्थानं प्राहुरनादिमध्यनिधनं यस्मादिदं जायते
नित्यं त्वामहमुपैमि सत्यविभवंविश्वेश्वरन्तंशिवम् //
text_mt: Whose pure reality, devoid of all divisions, residing within the heart, / the teachers declare to be the eternal, unmoving, supreme, all-pervading, boundless light, / the truth, the station without beginning, middle, or end, from which this [world] arises— / to you, that Śiva, the eternal Lord of all, whose power is real, I continually resort.”

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo nīlakaṇṭhāya trinetrāya ca raṃhase /
mahādevāya te nityamīśānāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं नमो नीलकण्ठाय त्रिनेत्राय च रंहसे /
महादेवाय ते नित्यमीशानाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Om. Homage to the blue-throated one, to the three-eyed one, and to the swift one! / Homage, homage to you, Mahādeva, the eternal sovereign lord!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ pinākine tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāya daṇḍine /
namaste vajrahastāya digvastrāya kapardine //
meaning:
नमः पिनाकिने तुभ्यं नमो मुण्डाय दण्डिने /
नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय दिग्वस्त्राय कपर्दिने //
text_mt: Homage to you who bear the Pināka, homage to the shaven-headed, to the staff-bearer! / Homage to you whose hand holds a thunderbolt, whose garment is space, and who wear matted hair!

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhairavanādāya kālarūpāya daṃṣṭriṇe /
nāgayajñopavītāya namaste vahniretase //
meaning:
नमो भैरवनादाय कालरूपाय दंष्ट्रिणे /
नागयज्ञोपवीताय नमस्ते वह्निरेतसे //
text_mt: Homage to the one of terrifying roar, to the form of time, to the fanged one! / Homage to you whose sacred thread is a serpent, whose seed is fire!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te girīśāya svāhākārāya te namaḥ /
namo muktāṭṭahāsāya bhīmāya ca namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते गिरीशाय स्वाहाकाराय ते नमः /
नमो मुक्ताट्टहासाय भीमाय च नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage be to you, Lord of the Mountains, homage to you who are the Svāhā-call! / Homage to the one whose loud laughter is unleashed, and homage, homage to the terrible one!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste kāmanāśāya namaḥ kālapramāthine /
namo bhairavaveṣāya harāya ca niṣaṅgiṇe //
meaning:
नमस्ते कामनाशाय नमः कालप्रमाथिने /
नमो भैरववेषाय हराय च निषङ्गिणे //
text_mt: Homage to you, destroyer of Kāma, homage to the crusher of death! / Homage to the one of terrifying guise, to Hara, and to the bearer of quivers!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te tryambakāya namaste kṛttivāsase /
namo 'mbikādhipataye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते त्र्यम्बकाय नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे /
नमो ऽम्बिकाधिपतये पशूनां पतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage be to you, Tryambaka, homage to you who are clad in animal skin! / Homage to the lord of Ambikā, homage to the lord of beasts!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste vyomarūpāya vyomādhipataye namaḥ /
naranārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartine //
meaning:
नमस्ते व्योमरूपाय व्योमाधिपतये नमः /
नरनारीशरीराय सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिने //
text_mt: Homage to you whose form is space, homage to the lord of space, / to the one whose body is man and woman, to the promoter of Sāṅkhya and Yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
namo daivatanāthāya devānugataliṅgine /
kumāragurave tubhyaṃ devadevāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो दैवतनाथाय देवानुगतलिङ्गिने /
कुमारगुरवे तुभ्यं देवदेवाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the lord of deities, to the one whose emblem is attended by the gods, / to you the teacher of Kumāra, homage to you the God of gods!

sanskrit_iast:
tamo yajñādhipataye namaste brahmacāriṇe /
mṛgavyādhāya mahate brahmādhipataye namaḥ //
meaning:
तमो यज्ञाधिपतये नमस्ते ब्रह्मचारिणे /
मृगव्याधाय महते ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the lord of sacrifice, homage to you who practice celibacy! / Homage to the great deer-hunter, to the lord of Brahman!

sanskrit_iast:
namo haṃsāya viśvāya mohanāya namo namaḥ /
yogine yogagamyāya yogamāyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो हंसाय विश्वाय मोहनाय नमो नमः /
योगिने योगगम्याय योगमायाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the Swan, to the All, homage, homage to the bewitcher! / Homage to you, the yogin, accessible through yoga, the yoga-illusion!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste prāṇapālāya ghaṇṭānādapriyāya ca /
kapāline namastubhyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते प्राणपालाय घण्टानादप्रियाय च /
कपालिने नमस्तुभ्यं ज्योतिषां पतये नमः //
text_mt: Homage to you, protector of the vital breath, and lover of the ringing bell! / Homage to you, the skull-bearer, homage to the lord of lights!

sanskrit_iast:
namo namo namastubhyaṃ bhūya eva namo namaḥ /
mahyaṃ sarvātmanā kāmān prayaccha parameśvara //
meaning:
नमो नमो नमस्तुभ्यं भूय एव नमो नमः /
मह्यं सर्वात्मना कामान् प्रयच्छ परमेश्वर //
text_mt: Homage, homage, homage to you, again and yet again homage, homage! / Bestow desires upon me with all your soul, O supreme lord!

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi bhaktyā deveśamabhiṣṭūya sa mādhavaḥ /
papāta pādayorviprā devadevyoḥ sa daṇḍavat //
meaning:
एवं हि भक्त्या देवेशमभिष्टूय स माधवः /
पपात पादयोर्विप्रा देवदेव्योः स दण्डवत् //
text_mt: Having thus praised the Lord of gods with devotion, that Mādhava / fell prostrate like a staff at the feet of the God and Goddess, O brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpya bhagavān somaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ keśiniṣūdanam /
babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ //
meaning:
उत्थाप्य भगवान् सोमः कृष्णं केशिनिषूदनम् /
बभाषे मधुरं वाक्यं मेघगम्भीरनिः स्वनः //
text_mt: Raising up Kṛṣṇa, the slayer of Keśin, the blessed lord with Umā, / with a voice deep as a thundercloud, spoke sweet words:

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa tapastaptaṃ tvayāvyaya /
tvameva dātā sarveṣāṃ kāmānāṃ kāmināmiha //
meaning:
किमर्थं पुण्डरीकाक्ष तपस्तप्तं त्वयाव्यय /
त्वमेव दाता सर्वेषां कामानां कामिनामिह //
text_mt: "For what purpose, O lotus-eyed one, has austerity been performed by you, the imperishable? / You alone here are the giver of all desires to those who have desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi sā paramā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā /
nānavāptaṃ tvayā tāta vidyate puruṣottama //
meaning:
त्वं हि सा परमा मूर्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया /
नानवाप्तं त्वया तात विद्यते पुरुषोत्तम //
text_mt: For you are that supreme manifestation of mine named Nārāyaṇa; / there is nothing unattained by you, dear one, O Supreme Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
vettha nārāyaṇānantamātmānaṃ parameśvaram /
mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ svena yogena keśava //
meaning:
वेत्थ नारायणानन्तमात्मानं परमेश्वरम् /
महादेवं महायोगं स्वेन योगेन केशव //
text_mt: You know Nārāyaṇa, the endless Self, the supreme lord, / Mahādeva, the great yoga, through your own yoga, O Keśava."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tadvacanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prahasan vai vṛṣadhvajam /
uvāca vīkṣya viśveśaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं कृष्णः प्रहसन् वै वृषध्वजम् /
उवाच वीक्ष्य विश्वेशं देवीं च हिमशैलजाम् //
text_mt: Hearing those words, Kṛṣṇa, laughing, looking upon the bull-bannered / Lord of the Universe and the goddess born of the mountain of snow, said:

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaṃ hi bhavatā sarvaṃ svena yogena śaṅkara /
icchāmyātmasamaṃ putraṃ tvadbhaktaṃ dehi śaṅkara //
meaning:
ज्ञातं हि भवता सर्वं स्वेन योगेन शङ्कर /
इच्छाम्यात्मसमं पुत्रं त्वद्भक्तं देहि शङ्कर //
text_mt: "Indeed, everything is known by you through your own yoga, O Śaṅkara. / I desire a son equal to myself, devoted to you; grant him, O Śaṅkara!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathāstvityāha viśvātmā prahṛṣṭamanasā haraḥ /
devīmālokya girijāṃ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje //
meaning:
तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा प्रहृष्टमनसा हरः /
देवीमालोक्य गिरिजां केशवं परिषस्वजे //
text_mt: "So be it," said Hara, the soul of the universe, with a delighted mind. / Looking at the goddess, daughter of the mountain, he embraced Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā jagatāṃ mātā śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī /
vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśaṃ devī himagirīndrajā //
meaning:
ततः सा जगतां माता शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी /
व्याजहार हृषीकेशं देवी हिमगिरीन्द्रजा //
text_mt: Then she, the mother of the worlds, whose body forms half of Śaṅkara, / the goddess born of the king of snowy mountains, spoke to Hṛṣīkeśa:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsa jāne tavānantāṃ niścalāṃ sarvadācyuta /
ananyāmīśvare bhaktimātmanyapi ca keśava //
meaning:
वत्स जाने तवानन्तां निश्चलां सर्वदाच्युत /
अनन्यामीश्वरे भक्तिमात्मन्यपि च केशव //
text_mt: "Child, I know your endless, unwavering devotion at all times, O Acyuta, / undivided toward the Lord and also toward yourself, O Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ /
prārthito daivataiḥ pūrvaṃ saṃjāto daivakīsutaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं हि नारायणः साक्षात् सर्वात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः /
प्रार्थितो दैवतैः पूर्वं संजातो दैवकीसुतः //
text_mt: For you are Nārāyaṇa manifest, the Soul of all, the Supreme Spirit, / formerly petitioned by the deities, born as the son of Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
paśya tvamātmanātmānamātmīyamamalaṃ padam /
nāvayorvidyate bheda evaṃ paśyanti sūrayaḥ //
meaning:
पश्य त्वमात्मनात्मानमात्मीयममलं पदम् /
नावयोर्विद्यते भेद एवं पश्यन्ति सूरयः //
text_mt: See yourself by yourself, your own stainless abode; / between the two of us no difference exists—thus the wise perceive.

sanskrit_iast:
imānimān varāniṣṭān matto gṛhṇīṣva keśava /
sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ jñānaṃ tat pārameśvaram /
īśvare niścalāṃ bhaktimātmanyapi paraṃ balam //
meaning:
इमानिमान् वरानिष्टान् मत्तो गृह्णीष्व केशव /
सर्वज्ञत्वं तथैश्वर्यं ज्ञानं तत् पारमेश्वरम् /
ईश्वरे निश्चलां भक्तिमात्मन्यपि परं बलम् //
text_mt: Receive from me these desired boons, O Keśava: / omniscience, likewise sovereignty, that knowledge belonging to the supreme lord, / unwavering devotion toward the Lord, and supreme power in yourself as well."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastayā kṛṣṇo mahādevyā janārdanaḥ /
āśiṣaṃ śirasāhṛṅṇād devo 'pyāha maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तया कृष्णो महादेव्या जनार्दनः /
आशिषं शिरसाहृङ्णाद् देवो ऽप्याह महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Addressed thus by that Great Goddess, Kṛṣṇa Janārdana / accepted the blessing with his head, and the divine Maheśvara also spoke.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya kṛṣṇaṃ bhagavānatheśaḥ
kareṇa devyā saha devadevaḥ /
saṃpūjyamāno munibhiḥ sureśai-
r jagāma kailāsagiriṃ girīśaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapūrāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
प्रगृह्य कृष्णं भगवानथेशः
करेण देव्या सह देवदेवः /
संपूज्यमानो मुनिभिः सुरेशै-
र् जगाम कैलासगिरिं गिरीशः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपूराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुर्विशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Taking Kṛṣṇa by the hand along with the goddess, / the blessed Lord, the God of gods, / worshipped by sages and chiefs of gods, / the Lord of the Mountains departed for Mount Kailāsa.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the auspicious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
praviśya meruśikharaṃ kailāsaṃ kanakaprabham /
rarāma bhagavān somaḥ keśavena maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
प्रविश्य मेरुशिखरं कैलासं कनकप्रभम् /
रराम भगवान् सोमः केशवेन महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having entered Kailāsa, a peak of Meru shining like gold, / the blessed Lord with Umā, Maheśvara, disported with Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyaṃstaṃ mahātmānaṃ kailāsagirivāsinaḥ /
pūjayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ devadevamathācyutam //
meaning:
अपश्यंस्तं महात्मानं कैलासगिरिवासिनः /
पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं देवदेवमथाच्युतम् //
text_mt: The inhabitants of Mount Kailāsa saw that great-souled one; / they worshipped Kṛṣṇa, the God of gods, Acyuta:

sanskrit_iast:
caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ kālameghasamaprabham /
kirīṭinaṃ śārṅgapāṇi śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam //
meaning:
चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्गं कालमेघसमप्रभम् /
किरीटिनं शार्ङ्गपाणि श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् //
text_mt: four-armed, noble-limbed, shining like a dark cloud, / diademed, holding the Śārṅga bow in hand, his chest marked with the Śrīvatsa,

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam /
dadhānamurasā mālāṃ vaijayantīmanuttamām //
meaning:
दीर्घबाहुं विशालाक्षं पीतवाससमच्युतम् /
दधानमुरसा मालां वैजयन्तीमनुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: long-armed, wide-eyed, clad in yellow garments, Acyuta, / wearing upon his chest the supreme Vaijayantī garland,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrājamānaṃ śriyā divyaṃ yuvānamatikomalam /
padmāṅghrinayanaṃ cāru susmitaṃ sugatipradam //
meaning:
भ्राजमानं श्रिया दिव्यं युवानमतिकोमलम् /
पद्माङ्घ्रिनयनं चारु सुस्मितं सुगतिप्रदम् //
text_mt: radiant with splendor, divine, youthful, exceedingly tender, / with lotus-like feet and eyes, handsome, smiling sweetly, granting the good path.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācit tatra līlārthaṃ devakīnandavardhanaḥ /
bhrājamānaḥ śrīyā kṛṣṇaścacāra girikandare //
meaning:
कदाचित् तत्र लीलार्थं देवकीनन्दवर्धनः /
भ्राजमानः श्रीया कृष्णश्चचार गिरिकन्दरे //
text_mt: Once, for the sake of play, Kṛṣṇa, who increases the joy of Devakī, / shining with splendor, wandered in a mountain cave.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāpsarasāṃ mukhyā nāgakanyāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ /
siddhā yakṣāśca gandharvāstatra tatra jaganmayam //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसां मुख्या नागकन्याश्च कृत्स्नशः /
सिद्धा यक्षाश्च गन्धर्वास्तत्र तत्र जगन्मयम् //
text_mt: The foremost of Gandharvas and Apsarases, and all the Nāga maidens, / the Siddhas, Yakṣas, and Gandharvas, everywhere seeing him whose essence is the world,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatvā harṣādutphullocanāḥ /
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वाश्चर्यं परं गत्वा हर्षादुत्फुल्लोचनाः /
मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि महात्मनः //
text_mt: went into supreme wonder, their eyes blossoming with joy, / and showered down rains of flowers on the head of that great-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvakanyakā divyāstadvadapsarasāṃ varāḥ /
dṛṣṭvā cakamire kṛṣṇaṃ strastavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वकन्यका दिव्यास्तद्वदप्सरसां वराः /
दृष्ट्वा चकमिरे कृष्णं स्त्रस्तवस्त्रविभूषणाः //
text_mt: Divine Gandharva maidens, and likewise the best among Apsarases, / seeing Kṛṣṇa, desired him, their garments and ornaments slipping off.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścid gāyanti vividhāṃ gītiṃ gītaviśāradāḥ /
saṃprekṣya devakīsūnuṃ sundaryaḥ kāmamohitāḥ //
meaning:
काश्चिद् गायन्ति विविधां गीतिं गीतविशारदाः /
संप्रेक्ष्य देवकीसूनुं सुन्दर्यः काममोहिताः //
text_mt: Some, skilled in music, sang various songs, / the beautiful women bewildered by love upon beholding the son of Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścidvilāsabahulā nṛtyanti sma tadagrataḥ /
saṃprekṣya saṃsthitāḥ kāścit papustadvadanāmṛtam //
meaning:
काश्चिद्विलासबहुला नृत्यन्ति स्म तदग्रतः /
संप्रेक्ष्य संस्थिताः काश्चित् पपुस्तद्वदनामृतम् //
