text_mt: Some, full of coquetry, danced before him; / others stood gazing and drank the nectar of his face.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi svāṅgādādāya sādaram /
bhūṣayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ kāminyo lokabhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
काश्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि स्वाङ्गादादाय सादरम् /
भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं कामिन्यो लोकभूषणम् //
text_mt: Taking the finest ornaments from their own bodies, some women in love / respectfully adorned Kṛṣṇa, the ornament of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi samādāya tadaṅgataḥ /
svātmānaṃ būṣayāmāsuḥ svātmagairapi mādhavam //
meaning:
काश्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि समादाय तदङ्गतः /
स्वात्मानं बूषयामासुः स्वात्मगैरपि माधवम् //
text_mt: Some, taking the finest ornaments from his limbs, / adorned themselves, and with ornaments from their own bodies [they adorned] Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścidāgatya kṛṣṇasya samīpaṃ kāmamohitāḥ /
cucumburvadanāmbhojaṃ harermugdhamṛgekṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
काश्चिदागत्य कृष्णस्य समीपं काममोहिताः /
चुचुम्बुर्वदनाम्भोजं हरेर्मुग्धमृगेक्षणाः //
text_mt: Some, bewildered by desire, approached Kṛṣṇa / and kissed the lotus face of Hari, their eyes like bewildered deer.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya kāścid govindaṃ kareṇa bhavanaṃ svakam /
prāpayāmāsurlokādiṃ māyayā tasya mohitāḥ //
meaning:
प्रगृह्य काश्चिद् गोविन्दं करेण भवनं स्वकम् /
प्रापयामासुर्लोकादिं मायया तस्य मोहिताः //
text_mt: Taking Govinda by the hand, some led him to their own home, / bewildered by his illusory creative power, though he is the source of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kāmān kamalalocanaḥ /
bahūni kṛtvā rūpāṇi pūrayāmāsa līlayā //
meaning:
तासां स भगवान् कृष्णः कामान् कमललोचनः /
बहूनि कृत्वा रूपाणि पूरयामास लीलया //
text_mt: Assuming many forms in play, the blessed Kṛṣṇa, / lotus-eyed, fulfilled their desires.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vai suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevapure hariḥ /
reme nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat //
meaning:
एवं वै सुचिरं कालं देवदेवपुरे हरिः /
रेमे नारायणः श्रीमान् मायया मोहयञ्जगत् //
text_mt: Thus for a very long time in the city of the God of gods Hari, / the glorious Nārāyaṇa, took delight, bewitching the world through his illusory creative power.

sanskrit_iast:
gate bahutithe kāle dvāravatyāṃ nivāsinaḥ /
babhūvurvihvalā bhītā govindavirahe janāḥ //
meaning:
गते बहुतिथे काले द्वारवत्यां निवासिनः /
बभूवुर्विह्वला भीता गोविन्दविरहे जनाः //
text_mt: When a long time had passed, the inhabitants dwelling in Dvāravatī / became distressed and frightened in separation from Govinda.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ suparṇo balavān pūrvameva visajitaḥ /
kṛṣṇena mārgamāṇastaṃ himavantaṃ yayau girim //
meaning:
ततः सुपर्णो बलवान् पूर्वमेव विसजितः /
कृष्णेन मार्गमाणस्तं हिमवन्तं ययौ गिरिम् //
text_mt: Then the powerful Suparṇa, who had been dispatched earlier / by Kṛṣṇa, searching for him, went to the Himavant mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭvā tatra govindaṃ praṇamya śirasā munim /
ājagāmopamanyuṃ taṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
अदृष्ट्वा तत्र गोविन्दं प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् /
आजगामोपमन्युं तं पुरीं द्वारवतीं पुनः //
text_mt: Not seeing Govinda there, he bowed his head before that sage, / Upamanyu, and returned again to the city of Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare mahādaityā rākṣasāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ /
ājagmurdvārakāṃ śubhrāṃ bhīṣayantaḥ sahastraśaḥ //
meaning:
तदन्तरे महादैत्या राक्षसाश्चातिभीषणाः /
आजग्मुर्द्वारकां शुभ्रां भीषयन्तः सहस्त्रशः //
text_mt: In the meantime, great Daityas and terrifying Rākṣasas / came by the thousands to radiant Dvārakā, spreading terror.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tān suparṇo balavān kṛṣṇatulyaparākramaḥ /
hatvā yuddhena mahatā rakṣati sma purīṃ śubhām //
meaning:
स तान् सुपर्णो बलवान् कृष्णतुल्यपराक्रमः /
हत्वा युद्धेन महता रक्षति स्म पुरीं शुभाम् //
text_mt: That mighty Suparṇa, equal in prowess to Kṛṣṇa, / slew them in a great battle and protected the fair city.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
dṛṣṭvā kailāsaśikhare kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatīṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नारदो भगवानृषिः /
दृष्ट्वा कैलासशिखरे कृष्णं द्वारवतीं गतः //
text_mt: At that very time, the lordly sage Nārada, / having seen Kṛṣṇa upon the peak of Mount Kailāsa, went to Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradamṛṣiṃ sarve tatra nivāsinaḥ /
procurnārāyaṇo nāthaḥ kutrāste bhagavān hariḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा नारदमृषिं सर्वे तत्र निवासिनः /
प्रोचुर्नारायणो नाथः कुत्रास्ते भगवान् हरिः //
text_mt: Seeing that sage Nārada, all the inhabitants there / said: “Where does our lord, the blessed Hari Nārāyaṇa, dwell?”

sanskrit_iast:
sa tānuvāca bhagavān kailasaśikhare hariḥ /
ramate 'dya mahāyogīṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvāhamihāgataḥ //
meaning:
स तानुवाच भगवान् कैलसशिखरे हरिः /
रमते ऽद्य महायोगीं तं दृष्ट्वाहमिहागतः //
text_mt: The venerable one said to them: “Upon the peak of Mount Kailāsa Hari / delights today, that great yogin; having seen him, I have come here.”

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopaśrutya vacanaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ /
jagāmākāśago viprāḥ kailāsaṃ girimuttamam //
meaning:
तस्योपश्रुत्य वचनं सुपर्णः पततां वरः /
जगामाकाशगो विप्राः कैलासं गिरिमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Hearing his words, Suparṇa, the best of winged creatures, / flying through the sky, O brāhmaṇas, went to Mount Kailāsa, the excellent mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa devakīsūnuṃ bhavane ratnamaṇḍite /
varāsanasthaṃ govindaṃ devadevāntike harim //
meaning:
ददर्श देवकीसूनुं भवने रत्नमण्डिते /
वरासनस्थं गोविन्दं देवदेवान्तिके हरिम् //
text_mt: He beheld Devakī's son in a jewel-adorned palace, / Govinda seated upon an excellent throne, Hari near the God of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
upāsyamānamamarairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ /
mahādevagaṇaiḥ siddhairyogibhiḥ parivāritam //
meaning:
उपास्यमानममरैर्दिव्यस्त्रीभिः समन्ततः /
महादेवगणैः सिद्धैर्योगिभिः परिवारितम् //
text_mt: worshiped on all sides by immortals and celestial maidens, / and surrounded by Mahādeva’s attendants, Siddhas, and yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau suparṇaḥ śaṅkaraṃ śivam /
nivedayāmāsa hareḥ pravṛttiṃ dvārake pure //
meaning:
प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ सुपर्णः शङ्करं शिवम् /
निवेदयामास हरेः प्रवृत्तिं द्वारके पुरे //
text_mt: Bowing like a staff upon the ground before Śaṅkara, Śiva, / Suparṇa reported the events in the city of Dvārakā to Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamya śirasā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam /
ājagāma purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ so 'nujñāto hareṇa tu //
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा शङ्करं नीललोहितम् /
आजगाम पुरीं कृष्णः सो ऽनुज्ञातो हरेण तु //
text_mt: Then, bowing his head to Śaṅkara Nīlalohita, / Kṛṣṇa departed for the city, permitted by Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
āruhya kaśyapasutaṃ strīgaṇairabhipūjitaḥ /
vacobhiramṛtāsvādairmānito madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
आरुह्य कश्यपसुतं स्त्रीगणैरभिपूजितः /
वचोभिरमृतास्वादैर्मानितो मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Mounting the son of Kaśyapa, honored by crowds of women, / Madhusūdana was revered with words sweet as nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣya yāntamamitraghnaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ varāḥ /
anvagacchan mahoyogaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam //
meaning:
वीक्ष्य यान्तममित्रघ्नं गन्धर्वाप्सरसां वराः /
अन्वगच्छन् महोयोगं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् //
text_mt: Seeing that slayer of foes depart, the foremost Gandharvas and Apsarases / followed him of great yoga, bearer of the conch, discus, and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayitvā viśvātmā sarvā evāṅganā hariḥ /
yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindo divyāṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm //
meaning:
विसर्जयित्वा विश्वात्मा सर्वा एवाङ्गना हरिः /
ययौ स तूर्णं गोविन्दो दिव्यां द्वारवतीं पुरीम् //
text_mt: Having dismissed all the women, Hari, the Self of the universe, / Govinda swiftly went to the celestial city of Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
gate muraripau naiva kāminyo munipuṅgavāḥ /
niśeva candrarahitā vinā tena cakāśire //
meaning:
गते मुररिपौ नैव कामिन्यो मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
निशेव चन्द्ररहिता विना तेन चकाशिरे //
text_mt: When the enemy of Mura had gone, the enamored women, O foremost sages, / did not shine at all without him, like a night deprived of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā paurajanāstūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanamuttamam /
maṇḍayāñcakrire divyāṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा पौरजनास्तूर्णं कृष्णागमनमुत्तमम् /
मण्डयाञ्चक्रिरे दिव्यां पुरीं द्वारवतीं शुभाम् //
text_mt: Quickly hearing of Kṛṣṇa’s auspicious arrival, the citizens / adorned the splendid, fair city of Dvāravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
patākābhirviśālābhirdhvajai ratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ /
lājādibhiḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣayāñcakrire tadā //
meaning:
पताकाभिर्विशालाभिर्ध्वजै रत्नपरिष्कृतैः /
लाजादिभिः पुरीं रम्यां भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा //
text_mt: With broad pennants and banners adorned with gems, / and with parched grain and the like, they decorated the charming city then.

sanskrit_iast:
avādayanta vividhān vāditrān madhurasvanān /
śaṅkhān sahastraśo dadhmurvoṇāvādān vitenire //
meaning:
अवादयन्त विविधान् वादित्रान् मधुरस्वनान् /
शङ्खान् सहस्त्रशो दध्मुर्वोणावादान् वितेनिरे //
text_mt: They sounded various sweet-toned instruments, / blew conches by the thousands, and played upon lutes.

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭamātre govinde purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām /
agāyan madhuraṃ gānaṃ striyo yauvanaśālinaḥ //
meaning:
प्रविष्टमात्रे गोविन्दे पुरीं द्वारवतीं शुभाम् /
अगायन् मधुरं गानं स्त्रियो यौवनशालिनः //
text_mt: As soon as Govinda entered the fair city of Dvāravatī, / women endowed with youth sang sweet songs.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā nanṛturīśānaṃ sthitāḥ prāsādamūrdhasu /
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vasudevasutopari //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा ननृतुरीशानं स्थिताः प्रासादमूर्धसु /
मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षाणि वसुदेवसुतोपरि //
text_mt: Seeing the Lord, standing on the roofs of palaces, they danced, / and showered rains of flowers upon the son of Vasudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya bhavanaṃ kṛṣṇa āśīrvādābhivardhitaḥ /
varāsane mahāyogī bhāti devībhiranvitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रविश्य भवनं कृष्ण आशीर्वादाभिवर्धितः /
वरासने महायोगी भाति देवीभिरन्वितः //
text_mt: Entering his palace, hailed with blessings, / the great yogin Kṛṣṇa shone on an excellent throne, accompanied by his queens,

sanskrit_iast:
suramye maṇḍape śubhre śaṅkhādyaiḥ parivāritaḥ /
ātmajairabhito mukhyaiḥ strīsahastraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सुरम्ये मण्डपे शुभ्रे शङ्खाद्यैः परिवारितः /
आत्मजैरभितो मुख्यैः स्त्रीसहस्त्रैश्च संवृतः //
text_mt: in a very charming, bright pavilion, surrounded by Śaṅkha and others, / encircled on all sides by his foremost sons and by thousands of women.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsanavare ramye jāmbavatyā sahācyutaḥ /
bhrājate mālayā devo yathā devyā samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रासनवरे रम्ये जाम्बवत्या सहाच्युतः /
भ्राजते मालया देवो यथा देव्या समन्वितः //
text_mt: There upon an excellent, charming throne, Acyuta with Jāmbavatī, / the god shone with his garland, as if accompanied by the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
ājagmurdevagandharvā draṣṭuṃ lokādimavyayam /
maharṣayaḥ pūrvajātā mārkaṇḍeyādayo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
आजग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वा द्रष्टुं लोकादिमव्ययम् /
महर्षयः पूर्वजाता मार्कण्डेयादयो द्विजाः //
text_mt: Gods and Gandharvas came to see the imperishable source of the worlds, / as did primeval great sages, Mārkaṇḍeya and other twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam /
nanāmotthāya śirasā svāsanaṃ ca dadau hariḥ //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् कृष्णो मार्कण्डेयं समागतम् /
ननामोत्थाय शिरसा स्वासनं च ददौ हरिः //
text_mt: Then the blessed Kṛṣṇa, rising, bowed with his head / to Mārkaṇḍeya who had arrived, and Hari gave him his own seat.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūjya tānṛṣigaṇān praṇāmena mahābhujaḥ /
visarjayāmāsa harirdattvā tadabhivāñchitān //
meaning:
संपूज्य तानृषिगणान् प्रणामेन महाभुजः /
विसर्जयामास हरिर्दत्त्वा तदभिवाञ्छितान् //
text_mt: Having honored those hosts of sages with salutations, the mighty-armed / Hari dismissed them after granting what they desired.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā madhyāhnasamaye devadevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ /
snātvā śuklāmbaro bhānumupatiṣṭhat kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
तदा मध्याह्नसमये देवदेवः स्वयं हरिः /
स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरो भानुमुपतिष्ठत् कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Then, at midday, the God of gods, Hari himself, / bathed, donned white garments, and stood with folded hands before the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
jajāpa jāpyaṃ vidhivat prekṣamāṇo divākaram /
tarpayāmāsa deveśo deveśo devān munigaṇān pitṝn //
meaning:
जजाप जाप्यं विधिवत् प्रेक्षमाणो दिवाकरम् /
तर्पयामास देवेशो देवेशो देवान् मुनिगणान् पितॄन् //
text_mt: Looking toward the sun, he muttered prayers according to rule; / the Lord of gods propitiated the gods, hosts of sages, and the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya devabhavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena caiva hi /
pūjayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ bhūteśaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
प्रविश्य देवभवनं मार्कण्डेयेन चैव हि /
पूजयामास लिङ्गस्थं भूतेशं भूतिभूषणम् //
text_mt: Entering the temple of the god along with Mārkaṇḍeya, / he worshiped the Lord of beings, adorned with ashes, present in the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya niyamaṃ sarvaṃ niyantāsau nṛṇāṃ svayam /
bhojayitvā munivaraṃ brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca //
meaning:
समाप्य नियमं सर्वं नियन्तासौ नृणां स्वयम् /
भोजयित्वा मुनिवरं ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च //
text_mt: Having completed all observances, he, the controller of men himself, / fed the foremost sage and honored the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātmayogaṃ viprendrā mārkaṇḍeyena cācyutaḥ /
kathāḥ paurāṇikīḥ puṇyāścakre putrādibhirvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वात्मयोगं विप्रेन्द्रा मार्कण्डेयेन चाच्युतः /
कथाः पौराणिकीः पुण्याश्चक्रे पुत्रादिभिर्वृतः //
text_mt: Fixing himself in meditation, O foremost of brāhmaṇas, Acyuta / recounted sacred ancient tales with Mārkaṇḍeya, surrounded by his sons and others.

sanskrit_iast:
athaitat sarvamakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā karma mahāmuniḥ /
mārkaṇḍeyo hasan kṛṣṇaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
अथैतत् सर्वमखिलं दृष्ट्वा कर्म महामुनिः /
मार्कण्डेयो हसन् कृष्णं बभाषे मधुरं वचः //
text_mt: Then, seeing all this entire rite, the great sage / Mārkaṇḍeya smiled and spoke sweet words to Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kaḥ samārādhyate devo bhavatā karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ /
brūhi tvaṃ karmabhiḥ pūjyo yogināṃ dhyeya eva ca //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
कः समाराध्यते देवो भवता कर्मभिः शुभैः /
ब्रूहि त्वं कर्मभिः पूज्यो योगिनां ध्येय एव च //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “Which god is worshiped by you through auspicious rites? / Speak! You are the one to be worshiped through rites, and the one to be meditated upon by yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi tat paramaṃ brahma nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam /
bhārāvataraṇārthāya jāto vṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ //
meaning:
त्वं हि तत् परमं ब्रह्म निर्वाणममलं पदम् /
भारावतरणार्थाय जातो वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः //
text_mt: For you are that supreme Brahman, the stainless abode of nirvāṇa; / the Lord born in the Vṛṣṇi lineage to remove the earth's burden.”

sanskrit_iast:
tamabravīnmahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ /
śṛṇvatāmeva putrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prahasanniva //
meaning:
तमब्रवीन्महाबाहुः कृष्णो ब्रह्मविदां वरः /
शृण्वतामेव पुत्राणां सर्वेषां प्रहसन्निव //
text_mt: To him the mighty-armed Kṛṣṇa, foremost of knowers of Brahman, / spoke, as if smiling, while all his sons were listening:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tathyameva na saṃśayaḥ /
tathāpi devamīśānaṃ pūjayāmi sanātanam //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भवता कथितं सर्वं तथ्यमेव न संशयः /
तथापि देवमीशानं पूजयामि सनातनम् //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / “Everything stated by you is true indeed, there is no doubt; / nevertheless, I worship the eternal god, the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
na me viprāsti kartavyaṃ nānavāptaṃ kathañcana /
pūjayāmi tathāpīśaṃ jānannaitat paraṃ śivam //
meaning:
न मे विप्रास्ति कर्तव्यं नानवाप्तं कथञ्चन /
पूजयामि तथापीशं जानन्नैतत् परं शिवम् //
text_mt: There is nothing for me to do, O brāhmaṇa, nor anything unobtained; / nonetheless I worship the Lord, knowing this supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
na vai paśyanti taṃ devaṃ māyayā mohitā janāḥ /
tato 'haṃ svātmano mūlaṃ jñāpayan pūjayāmi tam //
meaning:
न वै पश्यन्ति तं देवं मायया मोहिता जनाः /
ततो ऽहं स्वात्मनो मूलं ज्ञापयन् पूजयामि तम् //
text_mt: People deluded by māyā do not truly see that god; / therefore, making known the origin of my own self, I worship him.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca liṅgārcanāt puṇyaṃ lokesmin bhītināśanam /
tathā liṅge hitāyaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ pūjayecchivam //
meaning:
न च लिङ्गार्चनात् पुण्यं लोकेस्मिन् भीतिनाशनम् /
तथा लिङ्गे हितायैषां लोकानां पूजयेच्छिवम् //
text_mt: And in this world there is no merit higher than worship of the liṅga, destroying fear; / thus, for the welfare of these worlds, one should worship Śiva in the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'haṃ talliṅgamityāhurvedavādavido janāḥ /
tato 'hamātmamīśānaṃ pūjayāmyātmanaiva tu //
meaning:
यो ऽहं तल्लिङ्गमित्याहुर्वेदवादविदो जनाः /
ततो ऽहमात्ममीशानं पूजयाम्यात्मनैव तु //
text_mt: Those who know the teachings of the Veda declare that I am that liṅga; / therefore I worship the Lord, the Self, through my own self alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva paramā mūrtistanmayo 'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
nāvayordyite bhedo vedeṣvevaṃ viniścayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव परमा मूर्तिस्तन्मयो ऽहं न संशयः /
नावयोर्द्यिते भेदो वेदेष्वेवं विनिश्चयः //
text_mt: I am his supreme form, identical with him—there is no doubt; / between the two of us no difference is seen: such is the conviction in the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa devo mahādevaḥ sadā saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ /
dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca vandyaśca jñeyo liṅge maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एष देवो महादेवः सदा संसारभीरुभिः /
ध्येयः पूज्यश्च वन्द्यश्च ज्ञेयो लिङ्गे महेश्वरः //
text_mt: This god, Mahādeva, Maheśvara in the liṅga, is always / to be meditated upon, worshiped, praised, and known by those afraid of saṃsāra.”

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kiṃ talliṅgaṃ suraśreṣṭha liṅge saṃpūjyate ca kaḥ /
brūhi kṛṣṇa viśālākṣa gahanaṃ hyetaduttamam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
किं तल्लिङ्गं सुरश्रेष्ठ लिङ्गे संपूज्यते च कः /
ब्रूहि कृष्ण विशालाक्ष गहनं ह्येतदुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “What is that liṅga, O best of gods, and who is worshiped in the liṅga? / Tell me, large-eyed Kṛṣṇa, for this is profound and supreme.”

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ liṅgamityāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram /
vedā mahesvaraṃ devamāhurliṅginamavyayam //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं लिङ्गमित्याहुरानन्दं ज्योतिरक्षरम् /
वेदा महेस्वरं देवमाहुर्लिङ्गिनमव्ययम् //
text_mt: [Kṛṣṇa said:] / “They say the liṅga is the unmanifest, bliss, the imperishable light; / the Vedas declare the divine Maheśvara to be the imperishable possessor of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
purā caikārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame /
prabodhārthaṃ brahmaṇo me prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ //
meaning:
पुरा चैकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे /
प्रबोधार्थं ब्रह्मणो मे प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं शिवः //
text_mt: And formerly, when the immobile and mobile had perished in the terrible single ocean, / Śiva himself manifested for the awakening of Brahmā and me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt kālāt samārabhya brahmā cāhaṃ sadaiva hi /
pūjayāvo mahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
तस्मात् कालात् समारभ्य ब्रह्मा चाहं सदैव हि /
पूजयावो महादेवं लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Beginning from that time, Brahmā and I indeed always / worship Mahādeva out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.”

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kathaṃ liṅgamabhūt pūrvamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam /
prabodhārthaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇa vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
कथं लिङ्गमभूत् पूर्वमैश्वरं परमं पदम् /
प्रबोधार्थं स्वयं कृष्ण वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “How did that supreme abode of the Lord, the liṅga, arise formerly? / For our enlightenment, Kṛṣṇa, you yourself deign to tell it now.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
āsodekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam /
madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
आसोदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम् /
मध्ये चैकार्णवे तस्मिन् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / “There was a terrible, undivided single ocean filled with darkness; / and in the midst of that single ocean, the bearer of the conch, discus, and mace—”

sanskrit_iast:
sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvāhaṃ sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt
sahastrabāhuryuktātmā śayito 'haṃ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्त्रशीर्षा भूत्वाहं सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात्
सहस्त्रबाहुर्युक्तात्मा शयितो ऽहं सनातनः //
text_mt: Becoming a thousand-headed, thousand-eyed, thousand-footed, / thousand-armed one, focused in self, I, the eternal one, lay sleeping.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare dūratā paśyami hyamitaprabham /
koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूरता पश्यमि ह्यमितप्रभम् /
कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम् //
text_mt: In the meantime, I saw from afar one of immeasurable splendor, / resembling ten million suns, shining forth and surrounded by fortune;

sanskrit_iast:
caturvaraktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham /
kṛṣṇājiradharaṃ devamṛgyajuḥ sāmabhiḥ stutam //
meaning:
चतुर्वरक्त्रं महायोगं पुरुषं काञ्चनप्रभम् /
कृष्णाजिरधरं देवमृग्यजुः सामभिः स्तुतम् //
text_mt: a four-faced person of great yoga, possessing a golden luster, / wearing a black antelope skin, a god praised with the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
nimeṣamātreṇa sa māṃ prāpto yogavidāṃ varaḥ /
vyājahāra svayaṃ brahmā smayamāno mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
निमेषमात्रेण स मां प्राप्तो योगविदां वरः /
व्याजहार स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्मयमानो महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: In the twinkling of an eye, he, the best among knowers of yoga, reached me; / Brahmā himself, of great majesty, smiled and spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
kastvaṃ kuto vā kiṃ ceha tiṣṭhase vaha me prabho /
ahaṃ kartā hi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
कस्त्वं कुतो वा किं चेह तिष्ठसे वह मे प्रभो /
अहं कर्ता हि लोकानां स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः //
text_mt: “Who are you, or whence [did you come], and why do you stay here? Tell me, O lord. / For I am the creator of the worlds, the self-born Great-Grandfather.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca ha /
ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणाहमुवाच ह /
अहं कर्तास्मि लोकानां संहर्ता च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Thus addressed at that time by Brahmā, I spoke indeed: / “I am the creator of the worlds and the destroyer again and again.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vivāde vitate māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ /
prabodhārthaṃ paraṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam //
meaning:
एवं विवादे वितते मायया परमेष्ठिनः /
प्रबोधार्थं परं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम् //
text_mt: While such a dispute was extended through the illusory creative power of Parameṣṭhin, / the supreme liṅga, whose nature is Śiva, manifested itself for our awakening;

sanskrit_iast:
kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam /
kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāntavarjitam //
meaning:
कालानलसमप्रख्यं ज्वालामालासमाकुलम् /
क्षयवृद्धिविनिर्मुक्तमादिमध्यान्तवर्जितम् //
text_mt: resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution, crowded with wreaths of flames, / free from decay and growth, devoid of beginning, middle, and end.

sanskrit_iast:
tato māmāha bhagavānadho gaccha tvamāśu vai /
antamasya vijānīma ūrdhvaṃ gacche 'hamityajaḥ //
meaning:
ततो मामाह भगवानधो गच्छ त्वमाशु वै /
अन्तमस्य विजानीम ऊर्ध्वं गच्छे ऽहमित्यजः //
text_mt: Then the unborn lord said to me: “You go below quickly indeed; / let us find its end; I will go upward.”

sanskrit_iast:
tadāśu samayaṃ kṛtvā gatāvūrdhvamadhaśca dvau /
pitāmaho 'pyahaṃ nāntaṃ jñātavantau samāḥ śatam //
meaning:
तदाशु समयं कृत्वा गतावूर्ध्वमधश्च द्वौ /
पितामहो ऽप्यहं नान्तं ज्ञातवन्तौ समाः शतम् //
text_mt: Then, having quickly made an agreement, the two of us went upward and downward; / yet neither the Grandfather nor I could find its end for a hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vismayamāpannau bhītau devasya śūlinaḥ /
māyayā mohitau tasya dhyāyantau viśvamīśvaram //
meaning:
ततो विस्मयमापन्नौ भीतौ देवस्य शूलिनः /
मायया मोहितौ तस्य ध्यायन्तौ विश्वमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: Then, struck with wonder and frightened of the spear-bearing god, / bewildered by his illusory creative power, meditating on the Lord of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
proccārantau mahānādamoṅkāraṃ paramaṃ padam /
prahvāñjalipuṭopetau śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭuvatuḥ param //
meaning:
प्रोच्चारन्तौ महानादमोङ्कारं परमं पदम् /
प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटोपेतौ शंभुं तुष्टुवतुः परम् //
text_mt: pronouncing the great sound, the syllable Oṃ, the supreme state, / with hands joined respectfully, the two of them praised supreme Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ /
anādimalasaṃsārarogavaidyāya śaṃbhave /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णू ऊचतुः /
अनादिमलसंसाररोगवैद्याय शंभवे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: Brahmā and Viṣṇu said: / “To Śambhu, the physician for the disease of beginningless, impure worldly existence, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
pralayārṇavasaṃsthāya pralayodbhūtihetave /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
प्रलयार्णवसंस्थाय प्रलयोद्भूतिहेतवे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the one abiding in the ocean of dissolution, the cause of creation and dissolution, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālāvṛtāṅgāya jvalanastambharūpiṇe /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
ज्वालामालावृताङ्गाय ज्वलनस्तम्भरूपिणे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the one whose limbs are enveloped by garlands of flames, having the form of a pillar of fire, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
ādimadhyāntahīnāya svabāvāmaladīptaye /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
आदिमध्यान्तहीनाय स्वबावामलदीप्तये /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the one devoid of beginning, middle, and end, possessing an inherently pure luster, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya mahate jyotiṣe 'nantatejase /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
महादेवाय महते ज्योतिषे ऽनन्ततेजसे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to Mahādeva, the great light, of endless radiance, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānapuruṣeśāya vyomarūpāya vedhase /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
प्रधानपुरुषेशाय व्योमरूपाय वेधसे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the lord of primordial matter and the spirit, whose form is space, the creator, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
nirvikārāya satyāya nityāyāmalatejase /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
निर्विकाराय सत्याय नित्यायामलतेजसे /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the changeless, true, eternal one of pure splendor, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntasārarūpāya kālarūpāya dhīmate /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye //
meaning:
वेदान्तसाररूपाय कालरूपाय धीमते /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये //
text_mt: to the one whose form is the essence of Vedānta, whose form is Time, the wise one, / salutation to Śiva, the tranquil, to Brahman whose form is the liṅga!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ /
bhāti devo mahāyogī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु व्यक्तो भूत्वा महेश्वरः /
भाति देवो महायोगी सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः //
text_mt: Being thus praised, Maheśvara became manifest; / the god, the great yogin, shone like ten million suns,

sanskrit_iast:
vaktrakoṭisahastreṇa grasamāna ivāmbaram /
sahastrahastacaraṇaḥ sūryasomāgnilocanaḥ //
meaning:
वक्त्रकोटिसहस्त्रेण ग्रसमान इवाम्बरम् /
सहस्त्रहस्तचरणः सूर्यसोमाग्निलोचनः //
text_mt: as if swallowing the sky with ten million thousand mouths, / having a thousand hands and feet, with the sun, the moon, and fire as his eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
pinākapāṇirbhagavān kṛttivāsāstriśūlabhṛt /
vyālayajñopavītaśca meghadundubhiniḥ svanaḥ //
meaning:
पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान् कृत्तिवासास्त्रिशूलभृत् /
व्यालयज्ञोपवीतश्च मेघदुन्दुभिनिः स्वनः //
text_mt: the lord holding the Pināka in his hand, clad in an animal hide, bearing a trident, / with a serpent as his sacred thread, his voice like the roar of clouds and kettledrums.

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau /
paśyetaṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ pramucyatām //
meaning:
अथोवाच महादेवः प्रीतो ऽहं सुरसत्तमौ /
पश्येतं मां महादेवं भयं सर्वं प्रमुच्यताम् //
text_mt: Then Mahādeva said: “I am pleased, O two best of gods; / behold me, Mahādeva; let all fear be cast away!

sanskrit_iast:
yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau /
ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
vāmapārśve ca me viṣṇuḥ pālako hṛdaye haraḥ //
meaning:
युवां प्रसूतौ गात्रेभ्यो मम पूर्वं सनातनौ /
अयं मे दक्षिणे पार्श्वे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
वामपार्श्वे च मे विष्णुः पालको हृदये हरः //
text_mt: You two were previously born from my limbs, eternal ones: / this Brahmā on my right side is the Grandfather of the world, / on my left side is Viṣṇu the protector, and Hara is in my heart.

sanskrit_iast:
prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyak varaṃ dadmi yathepsitam /
evamuktvātha māṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ /
āliṅgya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prasādābhimukho 'bhavat //
meaning:
प्रीतो ऽहं युवयोः सम्यक् वरं दद्मि यथेप्सितम् /
एवमुक्त्वाथ मां देवो महादेवः स्वयं शिवः /
आलिङ्ग्य देवं ब्रह्माणं प्रसादाभिमुखो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: I am pleased with both of you; I grant a boon as desired.” / Having thus spoken to me, the god, Mahādeva, Śiva himself, / embraced the god Brahmā and turned to show grace.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇipatya maheśvaram /
ūcatuḥ prekṣya tadvaktraṃ nārāyaṇapitāmahau //
meaning:
ततः प्रहृष्टमनसौ प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् /
ऊचतुः प्रेक्ष्य तद्वक्त्रं नारायणपितामहौ //
text_mt: Then, their minds delighted, having bowed down before Maheśvara, / Nārāyaṇa and the Grandfather looked at his face and said:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau /
bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva maheśvare //
meaning:
यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो वरश्च नौ /
भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि देव महेश्वरे //
text_mt: “If pleasure has arisen [in you], and if a boon is to be given to us, / may our devotion ever be directed to you, O god Maheśvara!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ prahasan parameśvaraḥ /
uvāca māṃ mahādevaḥ prītaḥ prītena cetasā //
meaning:
ततः स भगवानीशः प्रहसन् परमेश्वरः /
उवाच मां महादेवः प्रीतः प्रीतेन चेतसा //
text_mt: Then that lord, the ruler, smiling, the Supreme Lord, / Mahādeva, pleased, spoke to me with a glad heart.

sanskrit_iast:
deva uvāca
pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate /
vatsa vatsa hare viśvaṃ pālayaitaccarācaram //
meaning:
देव उवाच
प्रलयस्थितिसर्गाणां कर्ता त्वं धरणीपते /
वत्स वत्स हरे विश्वं पालयैतच्चराचरम् //
text_mt: The god said: / “You are the maker of dissolution, maintenance, and creation, O lord of the earth; / child, child Hari, protect this universe of moving and unmoving beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā /
sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधा भिन्नो ऽस्म्यहं विष्णो ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया /
सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निर्गुणो ऽपि निरञ्जनः //
text_mt: I am divided threefold, O Viṣṇu, under the names Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Hara, / by the qualities of creation, preservation, and dissolution, though I am devoid of qualities and spotless.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham /
bhaviṣyatyeṣa bhagavāṃstava putraḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
संमोहं त्यज भो विष्णो पालयैनं पितामहम् /
भविष्यत्येष भगवांस्तव पुत्रः सनातनः //
text_mt: Cast away delusion, O Viṣṇu! Protect this Grandfather; / this venerable one will become your eternal son.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ ca bhavato vaktrāt kalpādau ghorarūpadhṛk /
śūlapāṇirbhaviṣyāmi krodhajastava putrakaḥ //
meaning:
अहं च भवतो वक्त्रात् कल्पादौ घोररूपधृक् /
शूलपाणिर्भविष्यामि क्रोधजस्तव पुत्रकः //
text_mt: And I, assuming a dreadful form, / bearing a trident in hand, will be born from your mouth at the beginning of the kalpa, born from wrath, as your son.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ munisattama /
anugṛhya ca māṃ devastatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो ब्रह्माणं मुनिसत्तम /
अनुगृह्य च मां देवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to Brahmā, O best of sages, / and having shown grace to me, the god disappeared right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā /
liṅga tallayanād brahman brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु लिङ्गार्चा सुप्रतिष्ठिता /
लिङ्ग तल्लयनाद् ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मणः परमं वपुः //
text_mt: From then on, the worship of the liṅga was well established in the worlds; / it is called a liṅga, O Brahman, because of dissolution into it; it is the supreme body of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
etalliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te mayānagha /
etad budhyanti yogajñā na devā na ca dānavāḥ //
meaning:
एतल्लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यं भाषितं ते मयानघ /
एतद् बुध्यन्ति योगज्ञा न देवा न च दानवाः //
text_mt: This greatness of the liṅga has been proclaimed to you by me, O sinless one; / the knowers of yoga understand this, neither the gods nor the Dānavas [do].

sanskrit_iast:
etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam /
yena sūkṣmamacintyaṃ tat paśyanti jñāna vakṣuṣaḥ //
meaning:
एतद्धि परमं ज्ञानमव्यक्तं शिवसंज्ञितम् /
येन सूक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं तत् पश्यन्ति ज्ञान वक्षुषः //
text_mt: For this is the supreme unmanifest knowledge called Śiva, / through which those with eyes of knowledge perceive that subtle, unthinkable [truth].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaskāraṃ prakurmahe /
mahādevāya rudrāya devadevāya liṅgine //
meaning:
तस्मै भगवते नित्यं नमस्कारं प्रकुर्महे /
महादेवाय रुद्राय देवदेवाय लिङ्गिने //
text_mt: To that lord we constantly offer salutation: / to Mahādeva, to Rudra, the god of gods, the bearer of the liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
namo vedarahasyāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ /
vibhīṣaṇāya śāntāya sthāṇave hetave namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो वेदरहस्याय नीलकण्ठाय वै नमः /
विभीषणाय शान्ताय स्थाणवे हेतवे नमः //
text_mt: salutation to the secret of the Vedas, salutation indeed to the blue-necked one, / to the dreadful, the peaceful, the pillar-like, salutation to the cause;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇe vāmadevāya trinetrāya mahīyase /
śaṅkarāya maheśāya girīśāya śivāya ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणे वामदेवाय त्रिनेत्राय महीयसे /
शङ्कराय महेशाय गिरीशाय शिवाय च //
text_mt: to Brahman, to Vāmadeva, the three-eyed, the exceedingly great, / to Śaṅkara, to Maheśa, to the lord of mountains, and to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kuruṣva satataṃ dhyāyasva manasā haram /
saṃsārasāgarādasmādacirāduttariṣyasi //
meaning:
नमः कुरुष्व सततं ध्यायस्व मनसा हरम् /
संसारसागरादस्मादचिरादुत्तरिष्यसि //
text_mt: Constantly offer salutations, meditate with your mind on Hara; / you will quickly cross over this ocean of worldly existence.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa vāsudevena vyāhṛto munipuṅgavaḥ /
jagāma manasā devamīśānaṃ viśvatomukham //
meaning:
एवं स वासुदेवेन व्याहृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः /
जगाम मनसा देवमीशानं विश्वतोमुखम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed by Vāsudeva, that eminent sage / went with his mind to the god Īśāna, facing every direction.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya śirasā kṛṣṇamanujñāto mahāmuniḥ /
jagāma cepsitaṃ deśaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य शिरसा कृष्णमनुज्ञातो महामुनिः /
जगाम चेप्सितं देशं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt: Having bowed with his head to Kṛṣṇa, permitted [by him], the great sage / went to the desired place of the trident-bearing god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imaṃ śrāvayennityaṃ liṅgādhyāyamanuttamam /
śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
य इमं श्रावयेन्नित्यं लिङ्गाध्यायमनुत्तमम् /
शृणुयाद् वा पठेद् वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Whoever causes this incomparable chapter on the liṅga to be heard daily, / or hears it, or reads it, is released from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sakṛdapi hyetat tapaścaraṇamuttamam /
vāsudevasya viprendrāḥ pāpaṃ muñciti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सकृदपि ह्येतत् तपश्चरणमुत्तमम् /
वासुदेवस्य विप्रेन्द्राः पापं मुञ्चिति मानवः //
text_mt: Even having heard once this supreme performance of austerities / by Vāsudeva, O best of brahmins, a person is freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
japed vāharaharnityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate /
evamāha mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
जपेद् वाहरहर्नित्यं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते /
एवमाह महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Or if he recites it daily every day, he is magnified in the world of Brahmā. / Thus spoke the great yogin, the lord Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tato labdhavaraḥ kṛṣṇo jāmbavatyāṃ maheśvarāt /
ajījananmahātmānaṃ sāmbamātmajamuttamam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततो लब्धवरः कृष्णो जाम्बवत्यां महेश्वरात् /
अजीजनन्महात्मानं साम्बमात्मजमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Then Kṛṣṇa, having obtained a boon from Maheśvara, begot upon Jāmbavatī / the great-souled Sāmba, his excellent son.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnasyāpyabhūt putro hyaniruddho mahābalaḥ /
tāvubhau guṇasaṃpannau kṛṣṇasyaivāpare tanū //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नस्याप्यभूत् पुत्रो ह्यनिरुद्धो महाबलः /
तावुभौ गुणसंपन्नौ कृष्णस्यैवापरे तनू //
text_mt: Pradyumna also had a son, the mighty Aniruddha. / Both of them, endowed with virtues, were other bodies of Kṛṣṇa himself.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā ca kaṃsaṃ narakamanyāṃśca śataśo 'surān /
vijitya līlayā śakraṃ jitvā bāṇaṃ mahāsuram //
meaning:
हत्वा च कंसं नरकमन्यांश्च शतशो ऽसुरान् /
विजित्य लीलया शक्रं जित्वा बाणं महासुरम् //
text_mt: Having slain Kaṃsa, Naraka, and hundreds of other asuras, / having playfully overcome Śakra, and having defeated the great asura Bāṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayitvā jagat kṛtsnaṃ loke dharmāṃśca śāśvatān /
cakre nārāyaṇo gantuṃ svasthānaṃ buddhimuttamām //
meaning:
स्थापयित्वा जगत् कृत्स्नं लोके धर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् /
चक्रे नारायणो गन्तुं स्वस्थानं बुद्धिमुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: and having established the entire world and the eternal duties among men, / Nārāyaṇa resolved to depart to his own realm.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare viprā bhṛgvādyāḥ kṛṣṇamīśvaram /
ājagmurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛtakāryaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्रा भृग्वाद्याः कृष्णमीश्वरम् /
आजग्मुर्द्वारकां द्रष्टुं कृतकार्यं सनातनम् //
text_mt: In the meantime, O brāhmaṇas, Bhṛgu and other [sages] came to Dvārakā / to see the lord Kṛṣṇa, the eternal one who had accomplished his work.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tānuvāca viśvātmā praṇipatyābhipūjya ca /
āsaneṣūpaviṣṭān vai saha rāmeṇa dhīmatā //
meaning:
स तानुवाच विश्वात्मा प्रणिपत्याभिपूज्य च /
आसनेषूपविष्टान् वै सह रामेण धीमता //
text_mt: He, the soul of all, bowing down and honoring them / as they sat on seats along with the wise Rāma, addressed them:

sanskrit_iast:
gamiṣye tat paraṃ sthānaṃ svakīyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñitam /
kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi prasīdadhvaṃ munīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
गमिष्ये तत् परं स्थानं स्वकीयं विष्णुसंज्ञितम् /
कृतानि सर्वकार्याणि प्रसीदध्वं मुनीश्वराः //
text_mt: “I shall go to that supreme abode of mine called Viṣṇu. / All deeds have been accomplished; be gracious, O best of sages!

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptamadhunāśubham /
bhaviṣyanti janāḥ sarve hyasmin pāpānuvartinaḥ //
meaning:
इदं कलियुगं घोरं संप्राप्तमधुनाशुभम् /
भविष्यन्ति जनाः सर्वे ह्यस्मिन् पापानुवर्तिनः //
text_mt: This dreadful, inauspicious Kali age has now arrived; / in it all people will pursue sin.

sanskrit_iast:
pravartayadhvaṃ majjñānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham /
yeneme kalijaiḥ pāpairmucyante hi dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
प्रवर्तयध्वं मज्ज्ञानं ब्राह्मणानां हितावहम् /
येनेमे कलिजैः पापैर्मुच्यन्ते हि द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Promote my knowledge, which brings welfare to brāhmaṇas, / so that these best of twice-born may indeed be freed from sins born of Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
ye māṃ janāḥ saṃsmaranti kalau sakṛdapi prabhum /
teṣāṃ naśyatu tat pāpaṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame //
meaning:
ये मां जनाः संस्मरन्ति कलौ सकृदपि प्रभुम् /
तेषां नश्यतु तत् पापं भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे //
text_mt: The people who remember me, the lord, even once in the Kali [age], / may the sins of those devotees of the Supreme Spirit be destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yer'cayiṣyantimāṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ kaliyuge dvijāḥ /
vidhānā vedadṛṣṭena te gamiṣyanti tat padam //
meaning:
येर्ऽचयिष्यन्तिमां भक्त्या नित्यं कलियुगे द्विजाः /
विधाना वेददृष्टेन ते गमिष्यन्ति तत् पदम् //
text_mt: The twice-born who will worship me with devotion constantly in the Kali age / according to the rules perceived in the Veda, they will go to that realm.

sanskrit_iast:
ye brāhmaṇā vaṃśajātā yuṣmākaṃ vai sahastraśaḥ /
teṣāṃ nārāyaṇe bhaktirbhaviṣyati kalau yuge //
meaning:
ये ब्राह्मणा वंशजाता युष्माकं वै सहस्त्रशः /
तेषां नारायणे भक्तिर्भविष्यति कलौ युगे //
text_mt: The thousands of brāhmaṇas born in your lineages, / will have devotion to Nārāyaṇa in the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
parāt parataraṃ yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ /
na te tatra gamiṣyanti ye dviṣanti maheśvaram //
meaning:
परात् परतरं यान्ति नारायणपरायणाः /
न ते तत्र गमिष्यन्ति ये द्विषन्ति महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Those devoted to Nārāyaṇa go to that which is higher than the highest; / but those who hate Maheśvara will not go there.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ homaṃ tapastaptaṃ jñānaṃ yajñādiko vidhiḥ /
teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipraṃ ye nindanti pinākinam //
meaning:
ध्यानं होमं तपस्तप्तं ज्ञानं यज्ञादिको विधिः /
तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रं ये निन्दन्ति पिनाकिनम् //
text_mt: Meditation, fire-offerings, austerity performed, knowledge, rites such as sacrifices— / all these quickly perish for those who revile the Wielder of the Pināka.

sanskrit_iast:
yo māṃ samāśrayennityamekāntaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ /
vinindya devamīśānaṃ sa yāti narakāyutam //
meaning:
यो मां समाश्रयेन्नित्यमेकान्तं भावमाश्रितः /
विनिन्द्य देवमीशानं स याति नरकायुतम् //
text_mt: He who takes refuge in me constantly, devoted with undivided sentiment, / but reviles the god Īśāna, goes to ten thousand hells.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sā parihartavyā nindā paśupatau dvijāḥ /
karmaṇā manasā vācā tadbhakteṣvapi yatnataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सा परिहर्तव्या निन्दा पशुपतौ द्विजाः /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तद्भक्तेष्वपि यत्नतः //
text_mt: Therefore, O twice-born, reviling of Paśupati / in action, thought, and word—even towards his devotees—must be avoided with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu dakṣādhvare śaptā dadhīyena dvijottamāḥ /
bhaviṣyanti kalau bhaktaiḥ parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
ये तु दक्षाध्वरे शप्ता दधीयेन द्विजोत्तमाः /
भविष्यन्ति कलौ भक्तैः परिहार्याः प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: Those who were cursed by Dadhīca at the sacrifice of Dakṣa, O best of twice-born, / will exist in Kali; they should be avoided with effort by devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
dviṣanto devamīśānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ /
śaptāśca gautamenorvyāṃ na saṃbhāṣyā dvijottamaiḥ //
meaning:
द्विषन्तो देवमीशानं युष्माकं वंशसंभवाः /
शप्ताश्च गौतमेनोर्व्यां न संभाष्या द्विजोत्तमैः //
text_mt: Those born in your lineage who hate the god Īśāna / and are cursed by Gautama on earth should not be spoken to by the best of twice-born.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktāḥ kṛṣṇena sarva eva maharṣayaḥ /
omityuktvā yayustūrṇaṃsvāni sthānāni sattamāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ताः कृष्णेन सर्व एव महर्षयः /
ओमित्युक्त्वा ययुस्तूर्णंस्वानि स्थानानि सत्तमाः //
text_mt: Having been thus addressed by Kṛṣṇa, all the great sages / said 'Om' and quickly departed to their own abodes, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo līlayaiva jaganmayaḥ /
saṃhṛtya svakulaṃ sarvaṃ yayau tat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ततो नारायणः कृष्णो लीलयैव जगन्मयः /
संहृत्य स्वकुलं सर्वं ययौ तत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Then Kṛṣṇa Nārāyaṇa, whose essence is the world, by mere play / destroyed his entire clan and went to that supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa vaḥ samāsena rājñāṃ vaṃśo 'nukīrtitaḥ /
na śakyo vistarād vaktuṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha //
meaning:
इत्येष वः समासेन राज्ञां वंशो ऽनुकीर्तितः /
न शक्यो विस्तराद् वक्तुं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छथ //
text_mt: Thus the lineage of kings has been recounted to you in brief; / it cannot be spoken of in full detail. What more do you wish to hear?

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi vaṃśānāṃ kathanaṃ śubham /
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि वंशानां कथनं शुभम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever recites or listens to this auspicious narration of the lineages / is freed from all sins and honored in the heavenly realm.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam /
eṣāṃ svabhāvaṃ sūtādya kathayasva samāsataḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चेति चतुर्युगम् /
एषां स्वभावं सूताद्य कथयस्व समासतः //
text_mt: The sages said: / Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali are the four ages. / O Sūta, speak to us today in brief regarding their nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
gate nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe svameva paramaṃ padam /
pārthaḥ paramadharmātmā pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
गते नारायणे कृष्णे स्वमेव परमं पदम् /
पार्थः परमधर्मात्मा पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / When Kṛṣṇa Nārāyaṇa had gone to his own supreme abode, / Pārtha, the most righteous Pāṇḍava, scorcher of enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā cevottaravidhiṃ śokena mahatāvṛtaḥ /
apaśyat pathi gacchantaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim //
meaning:
कृत्वा चेवोत्तरविधिं शोकेन महतावृतः /
अपश्यत् पथि गच्छन्तं कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम् //
text_mt: having performed the funeral rites and being enveloped in great grief, / saw the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana traveling along the road,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyairabhitaḥ saṃvṛtaṃ brahmavādinam /
papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tyaktvā śokaṃ tadār'junaḥ //
meaning:
शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैरभितः संवृतं ब्रह्मवादिनम् /
पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ त्यक्त्वा शोकं तदार्ऽजुनः //
text_mt: surrounded on all sides by disciples and grand-disciples, expounding the Veda. / Then Arjuna, casting aside grief, fell like a staff upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca paramaprītaḥ kasmād deśānmahāmune /
idānīṃ gacchasi kṣipraṃ kaṃ vā deśaṃ prati prabho //
meaning:
उवाच परमप्रीतः कस्माद् देशान्महामुने /
इदानीं गच्छसि क्षिप्रं कं वा देशं प्रति प्रभो //
text_mt: Exceedingly pleased, he said: “From what country, O great sage, / do you come quickly now, or to which country [do you go], O lord?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdarśanād vai bhavataḥ śoko me vipulo gataḥ /
idānīṃ mama yat kāryaṃ brūhi padmadalekṣaṇa //
meaning:
संदर्शनाद् वै भवतः शोको मे विपुलो गतः /
इदानीं मम यत् कार्यं ब्रूहि पद्मदलेक्षण //
text_mt: By the mere sight of you, my vast grief has departed. / Tell me what is now my duty, O lotus-petal-eyed one!”

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam /
upaviśya nadītire śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto muniḥ //
meaning:
तमुवाच महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनः स्वयम् /
उपविश्य नदीतिरे शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिः //
text_mt: To him the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana himself, the great yogin, / having sat down on the bank of the river surrounded by disciples, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptaṃ pāṇḍunandana /
tato gacchāmi devasya vārāṇasīṃ mahāpurīm //
meaning:
इदं कलियुगं घोरं संप्राप्तं पाण्डुनन्दन /
ततो गच्छामि देवस्य वाराणसीं महापुरीम् //
text_mt: “This dreadful Kali age has arrived, O son of Pāṇḍu; / therefore I am going to the great city of the god, Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
asmin kaliyuge ghore lokāḥ pāpānuvartinaḥ /
bhaviṣyanti mahāpāpā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
अस्मिन् कलियुगे घोरे लोकाः पापानुवर्तिनः /
भविष्यन्ति महापापा वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिताः //
text_mt: In this dreadful Kali age, people will follow sin; / they will be great sinners, devoid of the system of classes and life stages.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyat paśyāmi jantūnāṃmuktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm /
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge //
meaning:
नान्यत् पश्यामि जन्तूनांमुक्त्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम् /
सर्वपापप्रशमनं प्रायश्चित्तं कलौ युगे //
text_mt: I see no other expiation that allays all sins / for living beings in the Kali age, other than the city of Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca sarveṣveteṣu vai narāḥ /
bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ //
meaning:
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च सर्वेष्वेतेषु वै नराः /
भविष्यन्ति महात्मानो धार्मिकाः सत्यवादिनः //
text_mt: In the Kṛta, Tretā, and Dvāpara [ages], men in all these / will indeed be great-souled, righteous, and truthful.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi lokeṣu vikhyāto dhṛtimāñ janavatsalaḥ /
pālayādya paraṃ dharmaṃ svakīyaṃ mucyase bhayāt //
meaning:
त्वं हि लोकेषु विख्यातो धृतिमाञ् जनवत्सलः /
पालयाद्य परं धर्मं स्वकीयं मुच्यसे भयात् //
text_mt: You are renowned in the worlds, steadfast, and affectionate to people; / uphold your supreme duty today, and you will be freed from fear.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto bhagavatā pārthaḥ parapurañjayaḥ /
pṛṣṭavān praṇipatyāsau yugadharmān dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो भगवता पार्थः परपुरञ्जयः /
पृष्टवान् प्रणिपत्यासौ युगधर्मान् द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the blessed lord, Pārtha, conqueror of enemies' cities, / bowed down and asked about the duties of the ages, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai provāca sakalaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ /
praṇamya devamīśānaṃ yugadharmān sanātanān //
meaning:
तस्मै प्रोवाच सकलं मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः /
प्रणम्य देवमीशानं युगधर्मान् सनातनान् //
text_mt: To him the sage, the son of Satyavatī, having bowed to the god Īśāna, / proclaimed all the eternal duties of the ages:

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmi te samāsena yugadharmān nareśvara /
na śakyate mayā pārtha vistareṇābhibhāṣitum //
meaning:
वक्ष्यामि ते समासेन युगधर्मान् नरेश्वर /
न शक्यते मया पार्थ विस्तरेणाभिभाषितुम् //
text_mt: “I shall speak to you in brief of the duties of the ages, O ruler of men; / it is not possible for me, O Pārtha, to declare them in full detail.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tatastretāyugaṃ budhaiḥ /
tṛtīyaṃ dvāparaṃ pārtha caturthaṃ kalirucyate //
meaning:
आद्यं कृतयुगं प्रोक्तं ततस्त्रेतायुगं बुधैः /
तृतीयं द्वापरं पार्थ चतुर्थं कलिरुच्यते //
text_mt: The first is said by the wise to be the Kṛta age; then the Tretā age; / the third is the Dvāpara, O Pārtha; the fourth is called Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate /
dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge //
meaning:
ध्यानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां ज्ञानमुच्यते /
द्वापरे यज्ञमेवाहुर्दानमेव कलौ युगे //
text_mt: Meditation is supreme in the Kṛta age; in the Tretā, knowledge is said to be [supreme]; / in the Dvāpara, they say sacrifice alone [is supreme]; giving alone in the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ /
dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ kalau rudro maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा कृतयुगे देवस्त्रेतायां भगवान् रविः /
द्वापरे दैवतं विष्णुः कलौ रुद्रो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Brahmā is the god in the Kṛta age; in the Tretā, the blessed Sun; / in the Dvāpara, Viṣṇu is the deity; in Kali, Rudra Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇustathā sūryaḥ sarva eva kaliṣvapi /
pūjyate bhagavān rudraścaturṣvapi pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा सूर्यः सर्व एव कलिष्वपि /
पूज्यते भगवान् रुद्रश्चतुर्ष्वपि पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the Sun are indeed all [worshiped]; / but the blessed Rudra, the Wielder of the Pināka, is worshiped in all four [ages], even in the Kali [periods].

sanskrit_iast:
ādye kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ /
tretāyuge tripādaḥ syād dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ /
tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
आद्ये कृतयुगे धर्मश्चतुष्पादः सनातनः /
त्रेतायुगे त्रिपादः स्याद् द्विपादो द्वापरे स्थितः /
त्रिपादहीनस्तिष्ये तु सत्तामात्रेण तिष्ठति //
text_mt: In the first Kṛta age, the eternal duty stands on four legs; / in the Tretā age it would be on three legs; in the Dvāpara it stands on two legs; / but in Kali, deprived of three legs, it stands by mere existence.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte tu mithunotpattirvṛttiḥ sākṣād rasollasā /
prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sadānandāśca bhoginaḥ //
meaning:
कृते तु मिथुनोत्पत्तिर्वृत्तिः साक्षाद् रसोल्लसा /
प्रजास्तृप्ताः सदा सर्वाः सदानन्दाश्च भोगिनः //
text_mt: In the Kṛta [age], generation occurs through couples, and livelihood arises directly from the delight of the earth's essence; / all creatures are always contented, always blissful, and enjoying [life].

sanskrit_iast:
adhamottamatvaṃ nāstyāsāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ purañjaya /
tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasmin kṛte yuge //
meaning:
अधमोत्तमत्वं नास्त्यासां निर्विशेषाः पुरञ्जय /
तुल्यमायुः सुखं रूपं तासां तस्मिन् कृते युगे //
text_mt: There is no inferiority or superiority among them; they are without distinction, O conqueror of cities; / in that Kṛta age, their lifespan, happiness, and beauty are equal.

sanskrit_iast:
viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā /
dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhā mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकान्तबहुलास्तथा /
ध्याननिष्ठास्तपोनिष्ठा महादेवपरायणाः //
text_mt: Free from sorrow, abounding in purity, and abounding in solitude, / devoted to meditation, devoted to austerity, and dedicated to Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ /
parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketaḥ parantapa //
meaning:
ता वै निष्कामचारिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः /
पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्यनिकेतः परन्तप //
text_mt: they move about desireless, their minds ever joyful; / dwelling on mountains and ocean [shores], homeless indeed, O scorcher of foes.”

sanskrit_iast:
rasollāsā kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate tataḥ /
tasyāṃ siddhau praṇaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhiravartata //
meaning:
रसोल्लासा कालयोगात् त्रेताख्ये नश्यते ततः /
तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रणष्टायामन्या सिद्धिरवर्तत //
text_mt: Then, through the influence of time, the delight in essence perished in the [age] named Tretā; / when that perfection was lost, another perfection arose.

sanskrit_iast:
apāṃ saukṣmye pratihate tadā meghātmanā tu vai /
meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam //
meaning:
अपां सौक्ष्म्ये प्रतिहते तदा मेघात्मना तु वै /
मेघेभ्यः स्तनयित्नुभ्यः प्रवृत्तं वृष्टिसर्जनम् //
text_mt: When the subtleness of the waters was obstructed, in the form of clouds, / the discharge of rain then began from the thundering clouds.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale /
prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣā vai gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
सकृदेव तया वृष्ट्या संयुक्ते पृथिवीतले /
प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षा वै गृहसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: As soon as the surface of the earth was united with that rain, / there appeared for them the trees known as houses.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapratyupayogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate /
vartayanti sma tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वप्रत्युपयोगस्तु तासां तेभ्यः प्रजायते /
वर्तयन्ति स्म तेभ्यस्तास्त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रजाः //
text_mt: All utility arose for them from those [trees]; / those creatures sustained themselves by means of them at the dawn of the Tretā age.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyatāt /
rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat //
meaning:
ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्यतात् /
रागलोभात्मको भावस्तदा ह्याकस्मिको ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Then, after a great length of time, due to a transformation in them, / a state characterized by passion and greed suddenly arose.

sanskrit_iast:
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā /
praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
विपर्ययेण तासां तु तेन तत्कालभाविना /
प्रणश्यन्ति ततः सर्वे वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: Because of that transformation occurring in them at that time, / all those trees known as houses then perished.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ /
abhidhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā //
meaning:
ततस्तेषु प्रनष्टेषु विभ्रान्ता मैथुनोद्भवाः /
अभिध्यायन्ति तां सिद्धिं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा //
text_mt: Then, when those [trees] were lost, those born of sexual union, bewildered, / meditating on truth, meditated upon that [lost] perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ /
vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca //
meaning:
प्रादुर्बभूवुस्तासां तु वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः /
वस्त्राणि ते प्रसूयन्ते फलान्याभरणानि च //
text_mt: The trees known as houses appeared for them again; / they produced garments, fruits, and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam /
amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu //
meaning:
तेष्वेव जायते तासां गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् /
अमाक्षिकं महावीर्यं पुटके पुटके मधु //
text_mt: In them alone was born for them, in pod after pod, / potent honey that was not made by bees, endowed with fragrance, color, and savor.

sanskrit_iast:
tena tā vartayanti sma tretāyugamukhe prijāḥ /
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā sarvā vai vigatajvarāḥ //
meaning:
तेन ता वर्तयन्ति स्म त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रिजाः /
हृष्टपुष्टास्तया सिद्ध्या सर्वा वै विगतज्वराः //
text_mt: By means of that, those creatures sustained themselves at the dawn of the Tretā age, / delighted and nourished by that perfection, all free from feverish anguish.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstadā /
vṛkṣāṃstān paryagṛhṇanta madhu cāmākṣikaṃ balāt //
meaning:
ततः कालान्तरेणैव पुनर्लोभावृतास्तदा /
वृक्षांस्तान् पर्यगृह्णन्त मधु चामाक्षिकं बलात् //
text_mt: Then, after an interval of time, overcome once more by greed, / they seized those trees and the honey not made by bees by force.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai /
praṇaṣṭāmadhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacit kvacit //
meaning:
तासां तेनापचारेण पुनर्लोभकृतेन वै /
प्रणष्टामधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षाः क्वचित् क्वचित् //
text_mt: Because of that transgression of theirs, caused once again by greed, / the wish-fulfilling trees vanished in places, along with the honey.

sanskrit_iast:
śītavarṣātapaistīvrai statastā duḥ khitā bhṛśam /
dvandvaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca //
meaning:
शीतवर्षातपैस्तीव्रै स्ततस्ता दुः खिता भृशम् /
द्वन्द्वैः संपीड्यमानास्तु चक्रुरावरणानि च //
text_mt: Severely distressed then by intense cold, rain, and heat, / afflicted by the pairs of opposites, they made shelters.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā dvandvapratīghātān vārtopāyamacintayan /
naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā //
meaning:
कृत्वा द्वन्द्वप्रतीघातान् वार्तोपायमचिन्तयन् /
नष्टेषु मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षेषु वै तदा //
text_mt: Having devised counters against the pairs of opposites, they thought of means of livelihood, / when the wish-fulfilling trees had indeed vanished along with the honey.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ /
vārtāyāḥ sādhikā hyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रादुर्बभौ तासां सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे पुनः /
वार्तायाः साधिका ह्यन्या वृष्टिस्तासां निकामतः //
text_mt: Then another perfection appeared again for them in the Tretā age, / which accomplished their livelihood: rain according to their desire.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyūdakānīha yāni nimnairgatāni tu /
avahan vṛṣṭisaṃtatyā strotaḥ sthānāni nimnagāḥ //
meaning:
तासां वृष्ट्यूदकानीह यानि निम्नैर्गतानि तु /
अवहन् वृष्टिसंतत्या स्त्रोतः स्थानानि निम्नगाः //
text_mt: The waters of rain that flowed along the lowlands here / carried forth channels of flow continually through the rain, becoming rivers flowing downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punastadapāṃ stokā āpannāḥ pṛthivītale /
apāṃ bhūṇeśca saṃyogādoṣadhyastāstadābhavan //
meaning:
ये पुनस्तदपां स्तोका आपन्नाः पृथिवीतले /
अपां भूणेश्च संयोगादोषध्यस्तास्तदाभवन् //
text_mt: The drops of those waters, however, that fell upon the surface of the earth, / from the union of the waters and the earth, became annual plants.

sanskrit_iast:
aphālakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa /
ṛtupuṣpaphalaiścaiva vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire //
meaning:
अफालकृष्टाश्चानुप्ता ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश /
ऋतुपुष्पफलैश्चैव वृक्षगुल्माश्च जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Fourteen varieties, wild and cultivated, unploughed by shares and unsown, / and trees and shrubs, were born with seasonal flowers and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prādurabhūt tāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ /
avaśyaṃ bhāvinār'the na tretāyugavaśena vai //
meaning:
ततः प्रादुरभूत् तासां रागो लोभश्च सर्वशः /
अवश्यं भाविनार्ऽथे न त्रेतायुगवशेन वै //
text_mt: Then passion and greed arose on all sides among them, / through what was inevitable, under the power of the Tretā age.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān /
vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam //
meaning:
ततस्ताः पर्यगृह्णन्त नदीक्षेत्राणि पर्वतान् /
वृक्षगुल्मौषधीश्चैव प्रसह्य तु यथाबलम् //
text_mt: Then they seized rivers, fields, mountains, / trees, shrubs, and plants by force according to their strength.

sanskrit_iast:
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tā oṣadhyo viviśurmahīm /
pitāmahaniyogena dudoha pṛthivīṃ pṛthuḥ //
meaning:
विपर्ययेण तासां ता ओषध्यो विविशुर्महीम् /
पितामहनियोगेन दुदोह पृथिवीं पृथुः //
text_mt: Due to their transgression, those plants entered into the earth; / by the command of the Grandfather, Pṛthu milked the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastā jagṛhuḥ sarvā anyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ /
vasudāradhanādyāṃstu balāt kālabalena tu //
meaning:
ततस्ता जगृहुः सर्वा अन्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः /
वसुदारधनाद्यांस्तु बलात् कालबलेन तु //
text_mt: Then, frantic with anger, through the power of time / they seized each other's lands, wives, wealth, and the like by force.

sanskrit_iast:
maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvaitad bhagavānajaḥ /
sasarja kṣatriyān brahmā brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca //
meaning:
मर्यादायाः प्रतिष्ठार्थं ज्ञात्वैतद् भगवानजः /
ससर्ज क्षत्रियान् ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च //
text_mt: Knowing this, the unborn, blessed lord Brahmā / created Kṣatriyas for the establishment of order and for the welfare of the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ /
yajñapravartanaṃ caiva paśuhiṃsāvivarjitam //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थां च त्रेतायां कृतवान् प्रभुः /
यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चैव पशुहिंसाविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: And the Lord established the order of the social classes and life stages in the Tretā [age], / as well as the institution of sacrifice devoid of harm to animals.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāpareṣvatha vidyante matibhedāḥ sadā nṛṇām /
rāgo lobhastathā yuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ //
meaning:
द्वापरेष्वथ विद्यन्ते मतिभेदाः सदा नृणाम् /
रागो लोभस्तथा युद्धं तत्त्वानामविनिश्चयः //
text_mt: In Dvāpara ages, there are always differences of intellect among men: / passion, greed, war, and uncertainty regarding truths.

sanskrit_iast:
eko vedaścatuṣpādastretāsviha vidhīyate /
vedavyāsaiścaturdhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu //
meaning:
एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस्त्रेतास्विह विधीयते /
वेदव्यासैश्चतुर्धा तु व्यस्यते द्वापरादिषु //
text_mt: One single Veda with four quarters is prescribed in the Tretā [ages] here; / but in the Dvāpara and subsequent [ages] it is divided fourfold by the arrangers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiputraiḥ punarbhedād bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ /
mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिपुत्रैः पुनर्भेदाद् भिद्यन्ते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः /
मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः //
text_mt: Due to division by the sons of ṛṣis through errors of view, / [the Vedas] are split by arrangements of mantras and Brāhmaṇas, and alterations of accents and letters.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥ sāmnāṃ saṃhanyante śrutarṣibhiḥ /
sāmānyād vaikṛtāccaivadṛṣṭibhedaiḥ kvacit kvacit //
meaning:
संहिता ऋग्यजुः साम्नां संहन्यन्ते श्रुतर्षिभिः /
सामान्याद् वैकृताच्चैवदृष्टिभेदैः क्वचित् क्वचित् //
text_mt: Compilations of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma [Vedas] are composed by the learned sages / through standard and modified [forms], and here and there through differing viewpoints;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca /
itihāsapurāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi suvrata //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं कल्पसूत्राणि मन्त्रप्रवचनानि च /
इतिहासपुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि सुव्रत //
text_mt: [as well as] the Brāhmaṇa texts, Kalpasūtras, expositions of mantras, / histories, Purāṇas, and treatises on duty, O you of noble vows!

sanskrit_iast:
avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathaiva vāyādhyupadravāḥ /
vāṅmanaḥ kāyajairduḥ sairnirvedo jāyate nṛṇām //
meaning:
अवृष्टिर्मरणं चैव तथैव वायाध्युपद्रवाः /
वाङ्मनः कायजैर्दुः सैर्निर्वेदो जायते नृणाम् //
text_mt: Drought, death, and afflictions such as diseases occur; / from sufferings born of speech, mind, and body, dispassion is born among men.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥ khamokṣavicāraṇā /
vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyād doṣadarśanam //
meaning:
निर्वेदाज्जायते तेषां दुः खमोक्षविचारणा /
विचारणाच्च वैराग्यं वैराग्याद् दोषदर्शनम् //
text_mt: From dispassion arises their inquiry into liberation from suffering; / from inquiry comes detachment, and from detachment the discernment of faults.

sanskrit_iast:
doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva dvāpare jñānasaṃbhavaḥ /
eṣā rajastamoyuktā vṛttirvai dvāpare smṛtā //
meaning:
दोषाणां दर्शनाच्चैव द्वापरे ज्ञानसंभवः /
एषा रजस्तमोयुक्ता वृत्तिर्वै द्वापरे स्मृता //
text_mt: From the discernment of faults in the Dvāpara [age] arises knowledge; / this conduct in the Dvāpara is declared to be joined with passion and darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye kṛte tu dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravartate /
dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge //
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
आद्ये कृते तु धर्मो ऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्तते /
द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे //
इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
In the initial Kṛta [age] duty exists, and it proceeds into the Tretā; / having become disordered in the Dvāpara, it perishes in the Kali age.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām /
sādhayanti narā nityaṃ tamasā vyākulīkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
तिष्ये मायामसूयां च वधं चैव तपस्विनाम् /
साधयन्ति नरा नित्यं तमसा व्याकुलीकृताः //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / In the Kali age, men, perturbed by darkness, / constantly practice deceit, malice, and the killing of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
kalau pramārako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣud bhayaṃ tathā /
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ //
meaning:
कलौ प्रमारको रोगः सततं क्षुद् भयं तथा /
अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं देशानां च विपर्ययः //
text_mt: In the Kali [age] there is fatal disease, constant hunger and fear, / the terrible fear of drought, and ruin of territories.

sanskrit_iast:
adhārmikā anācārā mahākopālpacetasaḥ /
anṛtaṃ vadanti te lubdhāstiṣye jātāḥ suduḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
अधार्मिका अनाचारा महाकोपाल्पचेतसः /
अनृतं वदन्ति ते लुब्धास्तिष्ये जाताः सुदुः प्रजाः //
text_mt: Unrighteous, immoral, prone to great anger, of little intelligence, / the wretched people born in the Kali age are greedy and speak untruth.

sanskrit_iast:
duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ /
viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam //
meaning:
दुरिष्टैर्दुरधीतैश्च दुराचारैर्दुरागमैः /
विप्राणां कर्मदोषैश्च प्रजानां जायते भयम् //
text_mt: Due to improper sacrifices, faulty studies, evil conduct, false scriptures, / and the defective actions of the priests, fear arises for the people.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhīyate kalau vedān na yajanti dvijātayaḥ /
yajantyanyāyato vedān paṭhante cālpabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
नाधीयते कलौ वेदान् न यजन्ति द्विजातयः /
यजन्त्यन्यायतो वेदान् पठन्ते चाल्पबुद्धयः //
text_mt: In the Kali [age], the twice-born do not study the Vedas nor do they sacrifice; / or, having small intellect, they recite the Vedas and sacrifice lawlessly.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ mantrayaunaiśca saṃbandho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha /
bhaviṣyati kalau tasmiñ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
शूद्राणां मन्त्रयौनैश्च संबन्धो ब्राह्मणैः सह /
भविष्यति कलौ तस्मिञ् शयनासनभोजनैः //
text_mt: There will be connection between Śūdras and Brāhmaṇas through mantras and marriage, / as well as in sleeping, sitting, and dining in that Kali [age].

sanskrit_iast:
rājānaḥ sūdrabhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇān bādhayanti ca /
bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā prajāyete nareśvara //
meaning:
राजानः सूद्रभूयिष्ठा ब्राह्मणान् बाधयन्ति च /
भ्रूणहत्या वीरहत्या प्रजायेते नरेश्वर //
text_mt: Kings, mostly Śūdras, will oppress the Brāhmaṇas; / slaying of embryos and slaying of heroes will occur, O lord of men!

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ dānaṃ devatānāṃ tathār'canam /
anyāni caiva karmāṇi na kurvanti dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
स्नानं होमं जपं दानं देवतानां तथार्ऽचनम् /
अन्यानि चैव कर्माणि न कुर्वन्ति द्विजातयः //
text_mt: Ablution, fire-offering, silent recitation, gift-giving, and the worship of deities, / and other rites, the twice-born do not perform.

sanskrit_iast:
vinindanti mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇān puruṣottamam /
āmnāyadharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni kalau yuge //
meaning:
विनिन्दन्ति महादेवं ब्राह्मणान् पुरुषोत्तमम् /
आम्नायधर्मशास्त्राणि पुराणानि कलौ युगे //
text_mt: In the Kali age, they revile Mahādeva, Brāhmaṇas, the Supreme Spirit, / the sacred scriptures, the treatises on duty, and the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvantyavedadṛṣṭāni karmāṇi vividhāni tu /
svadharme 'bhirucirnaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ prijāyate //
meaning:
कुर्वन्त्यवेददृष्टानि कर्माणि विविधानि तु /
स्वधर्मे ऽभिरुचिर्नैव ब्राह्मणानां प्रिजायते //
text_mt: They perform various rites not seen in the Veda; / no interest in one's own duty arises among the Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍairvṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ /
bahuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam //
meaning:
कुशीलचर्याः पाषण्डैर्वृथारूपैः समावृताः /
बहुयाचनको लोको भविष्यति परस्परम् //
text_mt: Leading lives of bad conduct, surrounded by heretics in vain garbs, / the people will be constantly begging from one another.

sanskrit_iast:
aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ /
pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge //
meaning:
अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः /
प्रमदाः केशशूलिन्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे //
text_mt: In the Kali age, cities will sell food, crossroads will be places of execution, / and women will have hair as their merchandise.

sanskrit_iast:
śukladantājinākhyāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ /
śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite //
meaning:
शुक्लदन्ताजिनाख्याश्च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः /
शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: With white teeth, wearing deer skins, shaven-headed, or dressed in ochre robes, / Śūdras will practice ascetic discipline when the end of the age arrives.

sanskrit_iast:
śasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailābhimarṣiṇaḥ /
caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ //
meaning:
शस्यचौरा भविष्यन्ति तथा चैलाभिमर्षिणः /
चौराश्चौरस्य हर्तारो हर्तुर्हर्ता तथापरः //
text_mt: There will be thieves of grain, and likewise those who snatch garments; / thieves will rob a thief, and another robber will rob the robber.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥ khapracuratālpāyurdehotsādaḥ sarogatā /
adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam //
meaning:
दुः खप्रचुरताल्पायुर्देहोत्सादः सरोगता /
अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात् तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
Abundance of suffering, short lifespan, physical decay, and sickness—
because of dedication to unrighteousness, conduct in the Kali age is remembered as dominated by darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣāyiṇo 'tha nirgranthāstathā kāpālikāśca ye /
vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare //
meaning:
काषायिणो ऽथ निर्ग्रन्थास्तथा कापालिकाश्च ये /
वेदविक्रयिणश्चान्ये तीर्थविक्रयिणः परे //
text_mt:
Those wearing ochre robes, and the Nirgranthas, and likewise the Kāpālikas,
and others who sell the Veda, and others who sell holy places—

sanskrit_iast:
āsanasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ /
tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃśca śūdrā rājopajīvinaḥ //
meaning:
आसनस्थान् द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा न चलन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः /
ताडयन्ति द्विजेन्द्रांश्च शूद्रा राजोपजीविनः //
text_mt:
Seeing twice-born men seated, those dull of intellect do not stir;
and Śūdras living by service to kings even strike the best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāsanasthāḥ śūdrāstu dvijamadhye parantapa /
jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālabalena tu //
meaning:
उच्चासनस्थाः शूद्रास्तु द्विजमध्ये परन्तप /
ज्ञात्वा न हिंसते राजा कलौ कालबलेन तु //
text_mt:
Śūdras seated on high seats among the twice-born, O scorcher of foes—
knowing this, the king does not punish them in the Kali age, due to the power of the time.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiśca hasitaiścaiva tathānyairmaṅgalairdvijāḥ /
śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhagyabalānvitāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पैश्च हसितैश्चैव तथान्यैर्मङ्गलैर्द्विजाः /
शूद्रानभ्यर्चयन्त्यल्पश्रुतभग्यबलान्विताः //
text_mt:
With flowers and with smiles, and likewise with other auspicious offerings, twice-born men
worship Śūdras, endowed [only] with little learning, fortune, and strength.

sanskrit_iast:
na prekṣante 'rcitāṃścāpi śūdrā dvijavarān nṛpa /
sevāvasaramālokya dvāri tiṣṭhanti ca dvijāḥ //
meaning:
न प्रेक्षन्ते ऽर्चितांश्चापि शूद्रा द्विजवरान् नृप /
सेवावसरमालोक्य द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति च द्विजाः //
text_mt:
And even when honored, Śūdras do not look upon the best of the twice-born, O king;
and the twice-born stand at the door, watching for an opportunity to serve.

sanskrit_iast:
vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ /
sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau //
meaning:
वाहनस्थान् समावृत्य शूद्राञ् शूद्रोपजीविनः /
सेवन्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्तुवन्ति स्तुतिभिः कलौ //
text_mt:
Surrounding Śūdras seated in conveyances, Brāhmaṇas living off Śūdras
serve them there and praise them with hymns in the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyāpayanti vai vedāñ śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ /
paṭhanti vaidikān mantrān nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ //
meaning:
अध्यापयन्ति वै वेदाञ् शूद्राञ् शूद्रोपजीविनः /
पठन्ति वैदिकान् मन्त्रान् नास्तिक्यं घोरमाश्रिताः //
text_mt:
Living off Śūdras, they teach the Vedas to Śūdras;
they recite Vedic mantras, resorting to terrible disbelief.

sanskrit_iast:
tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ /
yatayaśca bhaviṣyanti śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ //
meaning:
तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः /
यतयश्च भविष्यन्ति शतशो ऽथ सहस्त्रशः //
text_mt:
And the best of the twice-born will become sellers of the fruits of austerities and sacrifices;
and ascetics will exist by hundreds and by thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśayanti hyadhītāni nādhigacchanti cānagha /
gāyanti laukikairgānairdaivatāni narādhipa //
meaning:
नाशयन्ति ह्यधीतानि नाधिगच्छन्ति चानघ /
गायन्ति लौकिकैर्गानैर्दैवतानि नराधिप //
text_mt:
For they ruin what has been studied and do not understand it, O sinless one;
they sing to the deities with worldly songs, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmapāśupatācārāstathā vai pāñcarātrikāḥ /
bhaviṣyanti kalau tasmin brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā //
meaning:
वामपाशुपताचारास्तथा वै पाञ्चरात्रिकाः /
भविष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियास्तथा //
text_mt:
Following the left-handed Pāśupata practices, and likewise Pāñcarātras,
Brāhmaṇas and likewise Kṣatriyas will become in that Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate /
kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān //
meaning:
ज्ञानकर्मण्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते /
कीटमूषकसर्पाश्च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान् //
text_mt:
When knowledge and action have ceased and the world has fallen into inactivity,
worms, mice, and serpents will overpower human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kurvānti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ kuleṣu vai /
dadhīcaśāpanirdagdhāḥ purā dakṣādhvare dvijāḥ //
meaning:
कुर्वान्ति चावताराणि ब्राह्मणानां कुलेषु वै /
दधीचशापनिर्दग्धाः पुरा दक्षाध्वरे द्विजाः //
text_mt:
And indeed, those twice-born consumed long ago by Dadhīca's curse at Dakṣa's sacrifice
make incarnations in the families of Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
nindanti ca mahādevaṃ tamasāviṣṭacetasaḥ /
vṛthā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti kalau tasmin yugāntike //
meaning:
निन्दन्ति च महादेवं तमसाविष्टचेतसः /
वृथा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके //
text_mt:
Their minds pervaded by darkness, they revile Mahādeva;
they will practice righteousness in vain in that Kali age at the end of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye śāpanirdagdhā gautamasya mahātmanaḥ /
sarve te ca bhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇādyāḥ svajātiṣu //
meaning:
ये चान्ये शापनिर्दग्धा गौतमस्य महात्मनः /
सर्वे ते च भविष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाद्याः स्वजातिषु //
text_mt:
And whatever others were consumed by the curse of the great-souled Gautama,
all of them will become Brāhmaṇas and the like in their respective castes.

sanskrit_iast:
vinindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ /
vedabāhyavratācārā durācārā vṛthāśramāḥ //
meaning:
विनिन्दन्ति हृषीकेशं ब्राह्मणान् ब्रह्मवादिनः /
वेदबाह्यव्रताचारा दुराचारा वृथाश्रमाः //
text_mt:
They revile Hṛṣīkeśa and Brāhmaṇas who proclaim the Veda;
their vows and conduct outside the Veda, behaving wickedly, their stages of life in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni ca /
tamasāviṣṭamanaso vaiḍālavṛttikādhamāḥ //
meaning:
मोहयन्ति जनान् सर्वान् दर्शयित्वा फलानि च /
तमसाविष्टमनसो वैडालवृत्तिकाधमाः //
text_mt:
Showing [false] fruits, they delude all the people,
their minds pervaded by darkness, vile hypocrites like cats.

sanskrit_iast:
kalau rudro mahādevo lokānāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ /
na devatā bhavennṛṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca daivatam //
meaning:
कलौ रुद्रो महादेवो लोकानामीश्वरः परः /
न देवता भवेन्नृणां देवतानां च दैवतम् //
text_mt:
In the Kali age, Rudra Mahādeva, the supreme lord of the worlds,
will not be the deity to men, even though he is the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣyatyavatārāṇi śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ /
śrautasmārtapratiṣṭhārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
करिष्यत्यवताराणि शङ्करो नीललोहितः /
श्रौतस्मार्तप्रतिष्ठार्थं भक्तानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt:
Śaṅkara the blue-red one will make incarnations
to establish the Vedic and traditional ordinances, out of desire for the welfare of his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
upadekṣyati tajjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ brahmasaṃjñitam /
sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi dharmān vedanidarśitān //
meaning:
उपदेक्ष्यति तज्ज्ञानं शिष्याणां ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् /
सर्ववेदान्तसारं हि धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान् //
text_mt:
He will teach to his disciples that knowledge named Brahman,
which is the essence of all Vedānta, and the duties shown by the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
ye taṃ viprā niṣevante yena kenopacārataḥ /
vijityakalijān doṣān yānti te paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ये तं विप्रा निषेवन्ते येन केनोपचारतः /
विजित्यकलिजान् दोषान् यान्ति ते परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Those Brāhmaṇas who attend upon him with any service whatsoever,
overcoming the faults born of the Kali age, attain the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
anāyāsena sumahat puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ /
anekadoṣaduṣṭasya kalereṣa mahān guṇaḥ //
meaning:
अनायासेन सुमहत् पुण्यमाप्नोति मानवः /
अनेकदोषदुष्टस्य कलेरेष महान् गुणः //
text_mt:
Without exertion a human being attains very great merit;
this is the great virtue of the Kali age, which is corrupted by manifold faults.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prāpya māheśvaraṃ yugam /
viśeṣād brāhmaṇo rudramīśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्राप्य माहेश्वरं युगम् /
विशेषाद् ब्राह्मणो रुद्रमीशानं शरणं व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
Therefore, having reached the age belonging to Maheśvara, with every effort
a Brāhmaṇa in particular should go for refuge to Rudra, Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
ye namanti virūpākṣamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam /
prasannacetaso rudraṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ये नमन्ति विरूपाक्षमीशानं कृत्तिवाससम् /
प्रसन्नचेतसो रुद्रं ते यान्ति परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Those who bow to Virūpākṣa, Īśāna, who wears animal skins,
to Rudra with a tranquil mind, they attain the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvam /
anyadevanamaskārānna tatphalamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
यथा रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्रुवम् /
अन्यदेवनमस्कारान्न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Just as bowing to Rudra yields the fruit of all rituals for certain,
one cannot obtain that fruit from bowing to any other deity.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhe kaliyuge doṣāṇāmekaśodhanam /
mahādevanamaskāro dhyānaṃ dānamiti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
एवंविधे कलियुगे दोषाणामेकशोधनम् /
महादेवनमस्कारो ध्यानं दानमिति श्रुतिः //
text_mt:
In such a Kali age, the sole purifier of faults
is bowing to Mahādeva, meditation, and giving: so says the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanīśvarānanyān tyaktvā devaṃ maheśvaram /
samāśrayed virūpākṣaṃ yadīcchet paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
तस्मादनीश्वरानन्यान् त्यक्त्वा देवं महेश्वरम् /
समाश्रयेद् विरूपाक्षं यदीच्छेत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, abandoning other non-rulers, one should resort to the god Maheśvara,
to Virūpākṣa, if one desires the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
nārcayantīha ye rudraṃ śivaṃ tridaśavanditam /
teṣāṃ dānaṃ tapo yajño vṛthā jīvitameva ca //
meaning:
नार्चयन्तीह ये रुद्रं शिवं त्रिदशवन्दितम् /
तेषां दानं तपो यज्ञो वृथा जीवितमेव च //
text_mt:
Those who do not worship Rudra here, Śiva who is praised by the thirty gods,
their giving, their asceticism, their sacrifice, and their very life are in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
namo rudrāya mahate devadevāya śūline /
tryambakāya trinetrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो रुद्राय महते देवदेवाय शूलिने /
त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिनेत्राय योगिनां गुरवे नमः //
text_mt:
