Homage to great Rudra, the God of gods, bearer of the trident;
homage to Tryambaka, three-eyed, the teacher of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu vāmadevāya mahādevāya vedhase /
śaṃbhave sthāṇave nityaṃ śivāya parameṣṭhine /
namaḥ śomāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya hetave //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु वामदेवाय महादेवाय वेधसे /
शंभवे स्थाणवे नित्यं शिवाय परमेष्ठिने /
नमः शोमाय रुद्राय महाग्रासाय हेतवे //

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye 'haṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmacāriṇam /
mahādevaṃ mahāyogamīśānaṃ cāmbikāpatim //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये ऽहं विरूपाक्षं शरण्यं ब्रह्मचारिणम् /
महादेवं महायोगमीशानं चाम्बिकापतिम् //
text_mt:
I take refuge in Virūpākṣa, the refuge, practicing celibacy,
Mahādeva, the great yogin, Īśāna, and lord of Ambikā,

sanskrit_iast:
yogināṃ yogadātāraṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam /
yogināṃ kurumācāryaṃ yogigamyaṃ pinākinam //
meaning:
योगिनां योगदातारं योगमायासमावृतम् /
योगिनां कुरुमाचार्यं योगिगम्यं पिनाकिनम् //
text_mt:
Giver of yoga to yogins, enveloped in yoga-māyā,
the teacher of yogins, accessible to yogins, bearer of the Pināka,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāratāraṇaṃ rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇo 'dhipam /
śāśvataṃ sarvagaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam //
meaning:
संसारतारणं रुद्रं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणो ऽधिपम् /
शाश्वतं सर्वगं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्राह्मणप्रियम् //
text_mt:
Savior from transmigration, Rudra, Brahman, sovereign of Brahman,
eternal, all-pervading, devoted to holy wisdom, beloved of Brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
kapardinaṃ kālamūrtimamūrti parameśvaram /
ekamūrti mahāmūrti vedavedyaṃ divaspatim //
meaning:
कपर्दिनं कालमूर्तिममूर्ति परमेश्वरम् /
एकमूर्ति महामूर्ति वेदवेद्यं दिवस्पतिम् //
text_mt:
Having matted hair, embodiment of Time, formless, supreme lord,
single form, mighty form, knowable through the Vedas, lord of heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśvamūrti vyāpinaṃ viśvaretasam /
kālāgniṃ kāladahanaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmanāśanam //
meaning:
नीलकण्ठं विश्वमूर्ति व्यापिनं विश्वरेतसम् /
कालाग्निं कालदहनं कामदं कामनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Blue-throated, having the universe as his form, all-pervading, the seed of the universe,
fire of Time, burner of Time, bestower of desire, destroyer of desire.

sanskrit_iast:
namasye giriśaṃ devaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam /
vilohitaṃ lelihānamāhityaṃ parameṣṭhinam /
ugraṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasaḥ param //
meaning:
नमस्ये गिरिशं देवं चन्द्रावयवभूषणम् /
विलोहितं लेलिहानमाहित्यं परमेष्ठिनम् /
उग्रं पशुपतिं भीमं भास्करं तमसः परम् //
text_mt:
I bow to the god Giriśa, adorned with a crescent moon,
dark-red, darting out his tongue, solar, Parameṣṭhin,
fierce, lord of animals, terrible, luminous, beyond darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ /
atītānāgatānāṃ vai yāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं युगानां वै समासतः /
अतीतानागतानां वै यावन्मन्वन्तरक्षयः //
text_mt:
Thus this characteristic of the ages has been declared in brief,
of those past and future, up to the end of the manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai /
vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै /
व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पः कल्पेन चैव हि //
text_mt:
And by one manvantara, all intervals indeed
are explained, there is no doubt, and also kalpa by kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣu vai /
tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेषु वै /
तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नामरूपैर्भवन्त्युत //
text_mt:
In all the manvantaras, past and future,
all [the rulers] have equal pride, with the same names and forms.

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto bhagavatā kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ /
babhāra paramāṃ bhaktimīśāne 'vyabhicāriṇīm //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो भगवता किरीटी श्वेतवाहनः /
बभार परमां भक्तिमीशाने ऽव्यभिचारिणीम् //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by the Blessed One, he who wears the diadem, drawn by white horses,
bore supreme, unwavering devotion toward Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
namaścakāra tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum /
sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ skṣād viṣṇuṃ vyavasthitam //
meaning:
नमश्चकार तमृषिं कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम् /
सर्वज्ञं सर्वकर्तारं स्क्षाद् विष्णुं व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt:
He bowed to that sage, the lord Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana,
omniscient, the creator of all, who was visibly established as Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca punarvyāsaḥ pāthaṃ parapurañjayam /
karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇataṃ muniḥ //
meaning:
तमुवाच पुनर्व्यासः पाथं परपुरञ्जयम् /
कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतं मुनिः //
text_mt:
Vyāsa spoke again to that son of Pṛthā, conqueror of enemy cities,
touching the bowed [prince] with both his very auspicious hands, the sage [said]:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyo 'syanugṛhīto 'si tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate /
trailokye śaṅkare nūnaṃ bhaktaḥ parapurañjaya //
meaning:
धन्यो ऽस्यनुगृहीतो ऽसि त्वादृशो ऽन्यो न विद्यते /
त्रैलोक्ये शङ्करे नूनं भक्तः परपुरञ्जय //
text_mt:
“You are fortunate, you are favored; another like you does not exist
in the three worlds, surely, as a devotee of Śaṅkara, O conqueror of enemy cities.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavānasi taṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvatomukham /
pratyakṣameva sarveśaṃ rudraṃ sarvajagadgurum //
meaning:
दृष्टवानसि तं देवं विश्वाक्षं विश्वतोमुखम् /
प्रत्यक्षमेव सर्वेशं रुद्रं सर्वजगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt:
You have seen that god whose eyes are everywhere, whose face is everywhere,
directly before your eyes, the lord of all, Rudra, the teacher of the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ tadaiśvaraṃ divyaṃ yathāvad viditaṃ tvayā /
svayameva hṛṣīkeśaḥ prītyovāca sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानं तदैश्वरं दिव्यं यथावद् विदितं त्वया /
स्वयमेव हृषीकेशः प्रीत्योवाच सनातनः //
text_mt:
That divine, lordly knowledge has been properly understood by you;
Hṛṣīkeśa himself, the eternal one, spoke [it] out of affection.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha gaccha svakaṃ sthānaṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi /
vrajasva parayā bhaktyā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ śivam //
meaning:
गच्छ गच्छ स्वकं स्थानं न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि /
व्रजस्व परया भक्त्या शरण्यं शरणं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Go, go to your own place; you should not grieve;
go with supreme devotion for refuge to Śiva, the refuge.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānanugṛhyārjunaṃ prabhuḥ /
jagāma śaṅkarapurīṃ samārādhayituṃ bhavam //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाननुगृह्यार्जुनं प्रभुः /
जगाम शङ्करपुरीं समाराधयितुं भवम् //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, having shown favor to Arjuna, that powerful lord
went to Śaṅkara's city to worship Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍaveyo 'pi tad vākyāt saṃprāpya śaraṇaṃ śivam /
saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi tadbhaktiparamo 'bhavat //
meaning:
पाण्डवेयो ऽपि तद् वाक्यात् संप्राप्य शरणं शिवम् /
संत्यज्य सर्वकर्माणि तद्भक्तिपरमो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
The son of Pāṇḍu also, on his word, having taken refuge in Śiva
and abandoned all actions, became entirely devoted to him.

sanskrit_iast:
nārjunena samaḥ śaṃbhorbhaktyā bhūto bhaviṣyati /
muktvā satyavatīsūnuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā devakīsutam //
meaning:
नार्जुनेन समः शंभोर्भक्त्या भूतो भविष्यति /
मुक्त्वा सत्यवतीसूनुं कृष्णं वा देवकीसुतम् //
text_mt:
There has been none equal to Arjuna in devotion to Śambhu, nor shall there ever be,
except for the son of Satyavatī or Kṛṣṇa, the son of Devakī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaḥ satyāya dhīmate /
pārāśaryāya munaye vyāsāyāmitatejase //
meaning:
तस्मै भगवते नित्यं नमः सत्याय धीमते /
पाराशर्याय मुनये व्यासायामिततेजसे //
text_mt:
Perpetual obeisance to that lord, truthful and wise,
the sage, son of Parāśara, Vyāsa of immeasurable splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ sākṣād viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ /
ko hyanyastattvato rudraṃ vetti taṃ parameśvaram //
meaning:
कृष्णद्वैपायनः साक्षाद् विष्णुरेव सनातनः /
को ह्यन्यस्तत्त्वतो रुद्रं वेत्ति तं परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana is manifestly the eternal Viṣṇu himself;
for who else truly knows Rudra, that supreme lord?

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kurudhvaṃ tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ satyavatīsutam /
pārāśaryaṃ mahātmānaṃ yoginaṃ viṣṇumavyayam //
meaning:
नमः कुरुध्वं तमृषिं कृष्णं सत्यवतीसुतम् /
पाराशर्यं महात्मानं योगिनं विष्णुमव्ययम् //
text_mt:
Offer obeisance to that seer Kṛṣṇa, the son of Satyavatī,
the son of Parāśara, the great-souled yogin, the imperishable Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktāstu munayaḥ sarva eva samīhitāḥ /
preṇemustaṃ mahātmānaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवमुक्तास्तु मुनयः सर्व एव समीहिताः /
प्रेणेमुस्तं महात्मानं व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus addressed, all the sages who were assembled
bowed down to that great-souled Vyāsa, the son of Satyavatī.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
prāpya vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ /
kimakārṣonmahābuddhiḥ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
प्राप्य वाराणसीं दिव्यां कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः /
किमकार्षोन्महाबुद्धिः श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
Having reached divine Vārāṇasī, what did the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana
of great intellect do? For we are eager to hear.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
prāpya vārāṇasī divyāmupaspṛśya mahāmuniḥ /
pūjayāmāsa jāhnavyāṃ devaṃ viśveśvaraṃ śivam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
प्राप्य वाराणसी दिव्यामुपस्पृश्य महामुनिः /
पूजयामास जाह्नव्यां देवं विश्वेश्वरं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having reached divine Vārāṇasī, the great sage, having sipped water,
worshipped the god, the lord of the universe, Śiva, in the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgataṃ puniṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra ye nivasanti vai /
pūjayāñcakrire vyāsaṃ munayo munipuṅgavam //
meaning:
तमागतं पुनिं दृष्ट्वा तत्र ये निवसन्ति वै /
पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे व्यासं मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt:
Seeing that sage arrived, the sages who dwelt there
worshipped Vyāsa, the foremost of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
papracchuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve kathāḥ pāpavināśanīḥ /
mahādevāśrayāḥ puṇyā mokṣadharmān sanātanān //
meaning:
पप्रच्छुः प्रणताः सर्वे कथाः पापविनाशनीः /
महादेवाश्रयाः पुण्या मोक्षधर्मान् सनातनान् //
text_mt:
Having bowed down, they all asked about tales that destroy sin,
sacred tales centered on Mahādeva, and the eternal duties of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi kathayāmāsa sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
māhātmyaṃ devadevasya dharmān vedanidarśitān //
meaning:
स चापि कथयामास सर्वज्ञो भगवानृषिः /
माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान् //
text_mt:
And that lord, the all-knowing seer, also recounted
the greatness of the god of gods, and the duties taught by the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ madhye munīndrāṇāṃ vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ /
pṛṣṭavān jaiminirvyāsaṃ gūḍhamarthaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
तेषां मध्ये मुनीन्द्राणां व्यासशिष्यो महामुनिः /
पृष्टवान् जैमिनिर्व्यासं गूढमर्थं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
In the midst of those foremost of sages, Vyāsa's pupil, the great sage
Jaimini, questioned Vyāsa about the hidden, eternal truth.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
bhagavan saṃśayaṃ tvekaṃ chettumarhasi tattvataḥ /
na vidyate hyaviditaṃ bhavatā paramarṣiṇā //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
भगवन् संशयं त्वेकं छेत्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः /
न विद्यते ह्यविदितं भवता परमर्षिणा //

sanskrit_iast:
kecid dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmamevāpare janāḥ /
anye sāṃkhyaṃ tathā yogaṃ tapastvanye maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
केचिद् ध्यानं प्रशंसन्ति धर्ममेवापरे जनाः /
अन्ये सांख्यं तथा योगं तपस्त्वन्ये महर्षयः //
text_mt:
Some praise meditation, other people [praise] righteous duty alone;
others Sāṃkhya and yoga, while other great seers [praise] asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryamatho maunamanye prāharmaharṣayaḥ /
ahiṃsāṃ satyamapyanye saṃnyāsamapare viduḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यमथो मौनमन्ये प्राहर्महर्षयः /
अहिंसां सत्यमप्यन्ये संन्यासमपरे विदुः //
text_mt:
Other great seers have proclaimed celibacy, and silence;
others non-violence and truth, while others recognise renunciation.

sanskrit_iast:
kecid dayāṃ praśaṃsanti dānamadhyayanaṃ tathā /
tīrthayātrāṃ tathā kecidanye cendriyanigraham //
meaning:
केचिद् दयां प्रशंसन्ति दानमध्ययनं तथा /
तीर्थयात्रां तथा केचिदन्ये चेन्द्रियनिग्रहम् //
text_mt:
Some praise compassion, and similarly giving, and study;
some likewise pilgrimage, and others the restraint of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
kimeteṣāṃ bhavejjyāyaḥ prabrūhi munipuṅgava /
yadi vā vidyate 'pyanyad guhyaṃ tadvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
किमेतेषां भवेज्ज्यायः प्रब्रूहि मुनिपुङ्गव /
यदि वा विद्यते ऽप्यन्यद् गुह्यं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Declare, O foremost of sages, which of these is superior;
or if there is anything else that is secret, you ought to tell it.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sa jaiminervākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ /
prāha gambhīrayā vācā praṇamya vṛṣaketanam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा स जैमिनेर्वाक्यं कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः /
प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा प्रणम्य वृषकेतनम् //
text_mt:
Hearing that speech of Jaimini, the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana
spoke in a deep voice, having bowed to the one whose banner is the bull:

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mune /
vakṣye guhyatamād guhyaṃ śruṇvantvanye maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
साधु साधु महाभाग यत्पृष्टं भवता मुने /
वक्ष्ये गुह्यतमाद् गुह्यं श्रुण्वन्त्वन्ये महर्षयः //
text_mt:
“Well said, well said, O fortunate one, what has been asked by you, O sage!
I shall declare that which is secret beyond the secret; let the other great seers listen.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvareṇa purā proktaṃ jñānametat sanātanam /
gūḍhamaprājñavidviṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वरेण पुरा प्रोक्तं ज्ञानमेतत् सनातनम् /
गूढमप्राज्ञविद्विष्टं सेवितं सूक्ष्मदर्शिभिः //
text_mt:
This eternal knowledge was declared anciently by the Lord,
hidden, disliked by the foolish, frequented by those who perceive subtle truths.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśraddadhāne dātavyaṃ nābhakte parameṣṭhinaḥ /
na vedavidviṣu śubhaṃ jñānanānāṃ jñānamuttamam //
meaning:
नाश्रद्दधाने दातव्यं नाभक्ते परमेष्ठिनः /
न वेदविद्विषु शुभं ज्ञाननानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
This auspicious, supreme knowledge among knowledges must not be given to one devoid of faith,
nor to one who is not devoted to the Supreme Lord, nor to those who hate the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
meruśṛṅge purā devamīśānaṃ tripuradviṣam /
devāsanagatā devī mahādevamapṛcchata //
meaning:
मेरुशृङ्गे पुरा देवमीशानं त्रिपुरद्विषम् /
देवासनगता देवी महादेवमपृच्छत //
text_mt:
Formerly, on the peak of Meru, the goddess seated on the divine throne
asked the god, the ruler, the enemy of Tripura, Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
devyuvāca
devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāmārtināśana /
kathaṃ tvāṃ puruṣo devamacirādeva paśyati //
meaning:
देव्युवाच
देवदेव महादेव भक्तानामार्तिनाशन /
कथं त्वां पुरुषो देवमचिरादेव पश्यति //
text_mt:
The goddess said:
O god of gods, O Mahādeva, O destroyer of the distress of devotees,
how does a person behold you, the god, in no time at all?

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhyayogastathā dhyānaṃ karmayogo 'tha vaidikaḥ /
āyāsabahulā loke yāni cānyāni śaṅkara //
meaning:
सांख्ययोगस्तथा ध्यानं कर्मयोगो ऽथ वैदिकः /
आयासबहुला लोके यानि चान्यानि शङ्कर //
text_mt:
Sāṃkhya, yoga, meditation, and the Vedic yoga of action,
and whatever others there are in the world, O Śaṅkara, involve much toil.

sanskrit_iast:
yena vibrāntacittānāṃ yogināṃ karmiṇāmapi /
dṛśyo hi bhagavān sūkṣmaḥ sarveṣāmatha dehinām //
meaning:
येन विब्रान्तचित्तानां योगिनां कर्मिणामपि /
दृश्यो हि भगवान् सूक्ष्मः सर्वेषामथ देहिनाम् //
text_mt:
By what [means] is the subtle Lord visible
to yogins, to men of action, and to all embodied beings whose minds are bewildered?

sanskrit_iast:
etad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ gūḍhaṃ brahmādisevitama /
hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ brūhi kāmāṅganāśana //
meaning:
एतद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं गूढं ब्रह्मादिसेवितम /
हिताय सर्वभक्तानां ब्रूहि कामाङ्गनाशन //
text_mt:
Declare this most secret knowledge, hidden, cultivated by Brahmā and the rest,
for the benefit of all devotees, O destroyer of the body of Kāma!”

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
avācyametad vijñānaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam /
vakṣye tava yathā tattvaṃ yaduktaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अवाच्यमेतद् विज्ञानं ज्ञानमज्ञैर्बहिष्कृतम् /
वक्ष्ये तव यथा तत्त्वं यदुक्तं परमर्षिभिः //

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ mama vārāṇasī purī /
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī //
meaning:
परं गुह्यतमं क्षेत्रं मम वाराणसी पुरी /
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां संसारार्णवतारिणी //
text_mt:
My supreme, most secret sacred field is the city of Vārāṇasī,
carrying across the ocean of worldly existence for all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bhaktā mahādevi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ /
nivasanti mahātmānaḥ paraṃ niyamamāsthitāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र भक्ता महादेवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः /
निवसन्ति महात्मानः परं नियममास्थिताः //
text_mt:
There my devotees, O great goddess, undertaking my vow,
great-souled, dwell observing the supreme discipline.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ sthānānāmuttamaṃ ca tat /
jñānānāmuttamaṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama //
meaning:
उत्तमं सर्वतीर्थानां स्थानानामुत्तमं च तत् /
ज्ञानानामुत्तमं ज्ञानमविमुक्तं परं मम //
text_mt:
It is the best of all holy places, the best of all dwelling-places,
the best knowledge among knowledges, my supreme Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānāntaraṃ pavitrāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca /
śmaśānasaṃsthitānyeva divyabhūmigatāni ca //
meaning:
स्थानान्तरं पवित्राणि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च /
श्मशानसंस्थितान्येव दिव्यभूमिगतानि च //
text_mt:
There are other places: holy bathing places and temples,
fixed in the cremation grounds, and located in celestial realms.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrloke naiva saṃlagnamantarikṣe mamālayam /
ayuktāstanna paśyanti yuktāḥ paśyanti cetasā //
meaning:
भूर्लोके नैव संलग्नमन्तरिक्षे ममालयम् /
अयुक्तास्तन्न पश्यन्ति युक्ताः पश्यन्ति चेतसा //
text_mt:
My abode is not attached to the earthly realm; it is in the intermediate space.
The unintegrated do not perceive it; the integrated perceive it with the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
śmasānametad vikhyātamavimuktamiti śrutam /
kālo bhūtvā jagadidaṃ saṃharāmyatra sundari //
meaning:
श्मसानमेतद् विख्यातमविमुक्तमिति श्रुतम् /
कालो भूत्वा जगदिदं संहराम्यत्र सुन्दरि //
text_mt:
This cremation ground is celebrated, heard of as Avimukta;
having become Time, I dissolve this world here, O fair one.

sanskrit_iast:
devīdaṃ sarvaguhyānāṃ sthānaṃ priyatamaṃ mama /
madbhaktāstatra gacchanti māmeva praviśanti te //
meaning:
देवीदं सर्वगुह्यानां स्थानं प्रियतमं मम /
मद्भक्तास्तत्र गच्छन्ति मामेव प्रविशन्ति ते //
text_mt:
O goddess, this place among all secrets is the dearest to me;
my devotees go there, and they enter into me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat /
dhyānamadhyayanaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
दत्तं जप्तं हुतं चेष्टं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् /
ध्यानमध्ययनं ज्ञानं सर्वं तत्राक्षयं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Whatever is given, recited, offered in fire, sacrificed, what austerity is performed,
meditation, Vedic study, and knowledge—everything there becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntarasahastreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam /
avimuktaṃ praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam //
meaning:
जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेषु यत्पापं पूर्वसंचितम् /
अविमुक्तं प्रविष्टस्य तत्सर्वं व्रजति क्षयम् //
text_mt:
Whatever sin has been accumulated previously in thousands of other births
all comes to destruction for one who has entered Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye varṇasaṃkarāḥ /
striyo mlecchāśca ye cānye saṃkīrṇāḥ pāpayonayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये वर्णसंकराः /
स्त्रियो म्लेच्छाश्च ये चान्ये संकीर्णाः पापयोनयः //
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, those born of mixed castes,
women, mlecchas, and whatever other mixed, sinful wombs there are,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭāḥ pipīlikāścaiva ye cānye mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ /
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptā avimukte varānane //
meaning:
कोटाः पिपीलिकाश्चैव ये चान्ये मृगपक्षिणः /
कालेन निधनं प्राप्ता अविमुक्ते वरानने //
text_mt:
worms, ants, and whatever other animals and birds,
meeting their death in Avimukta in the course of time, O lovely-faced one,

sanskrit_iast:
candrārdhamaulayastryakṣā mahāvṛṣabhavāhanāḥ /
śive mama pure devi jāyante tatra mānavāḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्धमौलयस्त्र्यक्षा महावृषभवाहनाः /
शिवे मम पुरे देवि जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः //
text_mt:
crowned with the crescent moon, three-eyed, riding on the great bull,
human beings are born there, O goddess, in my auspicious city.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvimukte mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī /
īśvarānugṛhītā hi sarve yānti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
नाविमुक्ते मृतः कश्चिन्नरकं याति किल्बिषी /
ईश्वरानुगृहीता हि सर्वे यान्ति परां गतिम् //
text_mt:
No sinner who dies in Avimukta goes to hell;
for all, graced by the Lord, attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam /
aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ //
meaning:
मोक्षं सुदुर्लभं मत्वा संसारं चातिभीषणम् /
अश्मना चरणौ हत्वा वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः //
text_mt:
Reflecting that liberation is very difficult to attain and worldly existence is exceedingly terrifying,
a man should break his legs with a stone and dwell in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhā tapasā cāpi pūtasya parameśvari /
yatra tatra vipannasya gatiḥ saṃsāramokṣaṇī //
meaning:
दुर्लभा तपसा चापि पूतस्य परमेश्वरि /
यत्र तत्र विपन्नस्य गतिः संसारमोक्षणी //
text_mt:
O supreme ruler, even for one purified by austerities, difficult to obtain
is the state that frees from worldly existence for one who dies anywhere [else].

sanskrit_iast:
prasādājjāyate hyetanmama śailendranandini /
aprabuddhā na paśyanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ //
meaning:
प्रसादाज्जायते ह्येतन्मम शैलेन्द्रनन्दिनि /
अप्रबुद्धा न पश्यन्ति मम मायाविमोहिताः //
text_mt:
For this arises from my grace, O daughter of the king of mountains;
the unawakened, deluded by my illusory creative power, do not see it.

sanskrit_iast:
avimuktaṃ na sevanti mūḍhā ye tamasāvṛtāḥ /
viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye te vasanti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अविमुक्तं न सेवन्ति मूढा ये तमसावृताः /
विण्मूत्ररेतसां मध्ये ते वसन्ति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
The fools covered by darkness who do not resort to Avimukta
dwell again and again in the midst of feces, urine, and semen.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamāno 'pi yo vidvān vased vighnaśatairapi /
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati //
meaning:
हन्यमानो ऽपि यो विद्वान् वसेद् विघ्नशतैरपि /
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति //
text_mt:
The wise man who dwells [there], even if struck down by hundreds of obstacles,
goes to the supreme state, having reached which he does not grieve.

sanskrit_iast:
janmamṛtyujarāmuktaṃ paraṃ yāti śivālayam /
apunarmaraṇānāṃ hi sā gatirmokṣakāṅkṣiṇām /
yāṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāditi manyanti paṇḍatāḥ //
meaning:
जन्ममृत्युजरामुक्तं परं याति शिवालयम् /
अपुनर्मरणानां हि सा गतिर्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम् /
यां प्राप्य कृतकृत्यः स्यादिति मन्यन्ति पण्डताः //

sanskrit_iast:
na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñairnāpi vidyayā /
prāpyate gatirutkṛṣṭā yāvimukte tu labhyate //
meaning:
न दानैर्न तपोभिश्च न यज्ञैर्नापि विद्यया /
प्राप्यते गतिरुत्कृष्टा याविमुक्ते तु लभ्यते //
text_mt:
Not by gifts, nor by austerities, nor by sacrifices, nor even by learning
is that exalted destination attained which is obtained in Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvarṇā vivarṇāśca caṇḍālādyā jugupsitāḥ /
kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehā ye viśiṣṭaiḥ pātakaistathā /
bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ teṣāmavimuktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ //
meaning:
नानावर्णा विवर्णाश्च चण्डालाद्या जुगुप्सिताः /
किल्बिषैः पूर्णदेहा ये विशिष्टैः पातकैस्तथा /
भेषजं परमं तेषामविमुक्तं विदुर्बुधाः //
text_mt:
People of various castes and the outcaste, Caṇḍālas and other despised folk,
those whose bodies are filled with sins and with particular grave crimes—
the wise know Avimukta to be their supreme medicine.

sanskrit_iast:
avimuktaṃ paraṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ padam /
avimuktaṃ paraṃ tattvamavimuktaṃ paraṃ śivam //
meaning:
अविमुक्तं परं ज्ञानमविमुक्तं परं पदम् /
अविमुक्तं परं तत्त्वमविमुक्तं परं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Avimukta is supreme knowledge, Avimukta is the supreme state,
Avimukta is the supreme reality, Avimukta is the supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vai naiṣṭhikīṃ dīkṣāmavimukte vasanti ye /
teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ dadāmyante paraṃ padam //
meaning:
कृत्वा वै नैष्ठिकीं दीक्षामविमुक्ते वसन्ति ये /
तेषां तत्परमं ज्ञानं ददाम्यन्ते परं पदम् //
text_mt:
Those who, having undertaken lifelong initiation, dwell in Avimukta—
to them at the end I give that supreme knowledge, the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyāgaṃ naimiṣaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīśailo 'tha mahālayaḥ /
kedāraṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca gayā puṣkarameva ca //
meaning:
प्रायागं नैमिषं पुण्यं श्रीशैलो ऽथ महालयः /
केदारं भद्रकर्णं च गया पुष्करमेव च //
text_mt:
Prayāga, sacred Naimiṣa, Śrīśaila, and Mahālaya,
Kedāra and Bhadrakarṇa, Gayā and Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
kurukṣetraṃ rudrakoṭirnarmadāmrātakeśvaram /
śāligrāmaṃ ca kubjāmraṃ kokāmukhamanuttamam /
prabhāsaṃ vijayeśānaṃ gokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇakam //
meaning:
कुरुक्षेत्रं रुद्रकोटिर्नर्मदाम्रातकेश्वरम् /
शालिग्रामं च कुब्जाम्रं कोकामुखमनुत्तमम् /
प्रभासं विजयेशानं गोकर्णं भद्रकर्णकम् //
text_mt:
Kurukṣetra, Rudrakoṭi, Narmadā, Āmrātakeśvara,
Śāligrāma, Kubjāmra, Kokāmukha the unsurpassed,
Prabhāsa, Vijayeśāna, Gokarṇa, and Bhadrakarṇaka—

sanskrit_iast:
etāni puṇyasthānāni trailokye viśrutāni ha /
na yāsyanti paraṃ mokṣaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtāḥ //
meaning:
एतानि पुण्यस्थानानि त्रैलोक्ये विश्रुतानि ह /
न यास्यन्ति परं मोक्षं वाराणस्यां यथा मृताः //
text_mt:
these holy places are indeed renowned across the three worlds;
yet [those who die there] will not attain supreme liberation as do those who die in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa gaṅgā tripathagāminī /
praviṣṭā nāśayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam //
meaning:
वाराणस्यां विशेषेण गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी /
प्रविष्टा नाशयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम् //
text_mt:
Especially in Vārāṇasī, the Gaṅgā flowing in three streams,
once entered, destroys sin accumulated through hundreds of other births.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra sulabhā gaṅgā śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo japaḥ /
vratāni sarvamevaitad vārāṇasyāṃ sudurlabham //
meaning:
अन्यत्र सुलभा गङ्गा श्राद्धं दानं तपो जपः /
व्रतानि सर्वमेवैतद् वाराणस्यां सुदुर्लभम् //
text_mt:
Elsewhere the Gaṅgā, ancestral offering rites, gifting, austerity, recitation,
and vows are easily obtained; all this is very hard to obtain in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
yajeta juhuyānnityaṃ dadātyarcayate 'marān /
vāyubhakṣaśca satataṃ vārāṇasyāṃ stito naraḥ //
meaning:
यजेत जुहुयान्नित्यं ददात्यर्चयते ऽमरान् /
वायुभक्षश्च सततं वाराणस्यां स्तितो नरः //
text_mt:
A man stationed in Vārāṇasī should constantly sacrifice and make oblations,
give gifts, worship the immortals, and subsist only on air.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi vādhārmiko naraḥ /
vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya punāti sakalaṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
यदि पापो यदि शठो यदि वाधार्मिको नरः /
वाराणसीं समासाद्य पुनाति सकलं नरः //
text_mt:
Whether a man is sinful, whether a rogue, or whether unrighteous,
once he reaches Vārāṇasī, the man purifies everything.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ yer'cayanti stuvanti vai /
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste vijñeyā gaṇeśvarāḥ //
meaning:
वाराणस्यां महादेवं येर्ऽचयन्ति स्तुवन्ति वै /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते विज्ञेया गणेश्वराः //
text_mt:
Those who worship and praise Mahādeva in Vārāṇasī,
freed from all sins, are to be known as lords of the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra yogajñānābhyāṃ saṃnyāsādathavānyataḥ /
prāpyate tat paraṃ sthānaṃ sahastreṇaiva janmanā //
meaning:
अन्यत्र योगज्ञानाभ्यां संन्यासादथवान्यतः /
प्राप्यते तत् परं स्थानं सहस्त्रेणैव जन्मना //
text_mt:
Elsewhere through yoga and knowledge, or elsewhere through renunciation,
that supreme state is attained only after a thousand births.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhaktā devadeveśe vārāṇasyāṃ vasanti vai /
te vindanti paraṃ mokṣamekenaiva tu janmanā //
meaning:
ये भक्ता देवदेवेशे वाराणस्यां वसन्ति वै /
ते विन्दन्ति परं मोक्षमेकेनैव तु जन्मना //
text_mt:
Those devotees of the God of gods who dwell in Vārāṇasī
attain supreme liberation in a single birth.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yogastathā jñānaṃ muktirekena janmanā /
avimuktaṃ samāsādya nānyad gacchet tapovanam //
meaning:
यत्र योगस्तथा ज्ञानं मुक्तिरेकेन जन्मना /
अविमुक्तं समासाद्य नान्यद् गच्छेत् तपोवनम् //
text_mt:
Where yoga as well as knowledge and liberation [are attained] in a single birth,
having reached that Avimukta, one should not go to any other penance-grove.

sanskrit_iast:
yato mayā na muktaṃ tadavimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtam /
tadeva guhyaṃ guhyānāmetad vijñāya mucyate //
meaning:
यतो मया न मुक्तं तदविमुक्तं ततः स्मृतम् /
तदेव गुह्यं गुह्यानामेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते //
text_mt:
Because it has not been abandoned (mukta) by me, it is therefore called Avimukta;
it is the secret of secrets; having known this, one is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānājñānābhiniṣṭhānāṃ paramānandamicchatām /
yā gatirvihitā subhru sāvimukte mṛtasya tu //
meaning:
ज्ञानाज्ञानाभिनिष्ठानां परमानन्दमिच्छताम् /
या गतिर्विहिता सुभ्रु साविमुक्ते मृतस्य तु //
text_mt:
O fair-browed woman, the destination that is ordained for those established in knowledge or ignorance who desire supreme bliss,
that very destination belongs to one who dies in Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni caivāvimuktasya dehe tūktāni kṛtsnaśaḥ /
purī vārāṇasī tebhyaḥ sthānebhyo hyadhikāśubhā //
meaning:
यानि चैवाविमुक्तस्य देहे तूक्तानि कृत्स्नशः /
पुरी वाराणसी तेभ्यः स्थानेभ्यो ह्यधिकाशुभा //
text_mt:
And all the places that are spoken of in the body of Avimukta,
the city of Vārāṇasī is more auspicious than those places.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sākṣānmahādevo dehānte svayamīśvaraḥ /
vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahma tatraiva hyavimuktakam //
meaning:
यत्र साक्षान्महादेवो देहान्ते स्वयमीश्वरः /
व्याचष्टे तारकं ब्रह्म तत्रैव ह्यविमुक्तकम् //
text_mt:
Where, at the end of the body, Mahādeva, the Lord himself in visible form,
expounds the saving Brahman—that very place is Avimuktaka.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tat parataraṃ tattvamavimuktamiti śrutam /
ekena janmanā devi vārāṇasyāṃ tadāpnuyāt //
meaning:
यत् तत् परतरं तत्त्वमविमुक्तमिति श्रुतम् /
एकेन जन्मना देवि वाराणस्यां तदाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
That higher reality known as Avimukta,
O goddess, one may obtain in Vārāṇasī in a single birth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye ca hṛdaye caiva mūrdhani /
yathāvimuktāditye vārāṇasyāṃ vyavasthitam //
meaning:
भ्रूमध्ये नाभिमध्ये च हृदये चैव मूर्धनि /
यथाविमुक्तादित्ये वाराणस्यां व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt:
Between the eyebrows, in the navel, in the heart, and at the crown of the head,
as in the sun of Avimukta, it is established in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṇāyāstathā cāsyā madhye vārāṇasī purī /
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ tattvaṃ nityamevāvimuktakam //
meaning:
वरणायास्तथा चास्या मध्ये वाराणसी पुरी /
तत्रैव संस्थितं तत्त्वं नित्यमेवाविमुक्तकम् //
text_mt:
Between the Varaṇā and the Asī lies the city of Vārāṇasī;
right there is that reality perpetually established as Avimuktaka.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasyāḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
yatra nārāyaṇo devo mahādevo diveśvaraḥ //
meaning:
वाराणस्याः परं स्थानं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
यत्र नारायणो देवो महादेवो दिवेश्वरः //
text_mt:
There has never been nor will there be a place higher than Vārāṇasī,
where the god Nārāyaṇa is, [and] Mahādeva, the lord of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ /
upāsate māṃ satataṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः /
उपासते मां सततं देवदेवं पितामहम् //
text_mt:
There the gods, with Gandharvas, with Yakṣas, Uragas, and Rākṣasas,
constantly revere me, the God of gods, the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpātakino ye ca ye tebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ /
vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya te yānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
महापातकिनो ये च ये तेभ्यः पापकृत्तमाः /
वाराणसीं समासाद्य ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt:
Those who have committed the great sins, and those who are even worse sinners than them,
having reached Vārāṇasī, go to the supreme destination.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmumukṣurniyato vased vai maraṇāntikam /
vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevājjñānaṃ labdhvā vimucyate //
meaning:
तस्मान्मुमुक्षुर्नियतो वसेद् वै मरणान्तिकम् /
वाराणस्यां महादेवाज्ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा विमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Therefore a seeker of liberation, restrained, should dwell [there] until death;
having obtained knowledge from Mahādeva in Vārāṇasī, he is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ /
tato naiva caret pāpaṃ kāyena manasā girā //
meaning:
किन्तु विघ्ना भविष्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसः /
ततो नैव चरेत् पापं कायेन मनसा गिरा //
text_mt:
However, obstacles will arise for one whose mind is afflicted by sin;
therefore one should never commit sin by body, mind, or speech.

sanskrit_iast:
etad rahasyaṃ vedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca suvratāḥ /
avimuktāśrayaṃ jñānaṃ na kaścid vetti tattvataḥ //
meaning:
एतद् रहस्यं वेदानां पुराणानां च सुव्रताः /
अविमुक्ताश्रयं ज्ञानं न कश्चिद् वेत्ति तत्त्वतः //
text_mt:
O men of good vows, this is the secret of the Vedas and the Purāṇas;
no one truly knows the knowledge that rests upon Avimukta.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śṛṇvatāṃ parameṣṭhinām /
devyai devena kathitaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam //
meaning:
देवतानामृषीणां च शृण्वतां परमेष्ठिनाम् /
देव्यै देवेन कथितं सर्वपापविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
While the gods and the Parameṣṭhin ṛṣis were listening,
[this teaching] that destroys all sins was spoken by the God to the Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ /
yatheśvarāṇāṃ giriśaḥ sthānānāṃ caitaduttamam //
meaning:
यथा नारायणः श्रेष्ठो देवानां पुरुषोत्तमः /
यथेश्वराणां गिरिशः स्थानानां चैतदुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Just as Nārāyaṇa, the Supreme Spirit, is the best among the gods,
and just as Giriśa is the best among lords, so is this the best among places.

sanskrit_iast:
yaiḥ samārādhito rudraḥ pūrvasminneva janmani /
te vindanti paraṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ śivālayam //
meaning:
यैः समाराधितो रुद्रः पूर्वस्मिन्नेव जन्मनि /
ते विन्दन्ति परं क्षेत्रमविमुक्तं शिवालयम् //
text_mt:
Those by whom Rudra was propitiated in a previous birth
attain the supreme holy field, Avimukta, the abode of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
kalikalmaṣasaṃbhūtā yeṣāmupahatā matiḥ /
na teṣāṃ vedituṃ śakyaṃ sthānaṃ tat parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
कलिकल्मषसंभूता येषामुपहता मतिः /
न तेषां वेदितुं शक्यं स्थानं तत् परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt:
Those whose intellects are ruined, born of the defilement of the Kali age,
are not able to know that place of the Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast:
ye smaranti sadā kālaṃ vindanti ca purīmimām /
teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipramihāmutra ca pātakam //
meaning:
ये स्मरन्ति सदा कालं विन्दन्ति च पुरीमिमाम् /
तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रमिहामुत्र च पातकम् //
text_mt:
Those who constantly remember time and reach this city,
their crime is quickly destroyed both in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni ceha prakurvanti pātakāni kṛtālayāḥ /
nāśayet tāni sarvāṇi devaḥ kālatanuḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
यानि चेह प्रकुर्वन्ति पातकानि कृतालयाः /
नाशयेत् तानि सर्वाणि देवः कालतनुः शिवः //
text_mt:
Whatever sins those who have made their dwelling here commit,
the god Śiva, whose form is Time, destroys them all.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchatāmidaṃ sthānaṃ sevituṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām /
mṛtānāṃ ca punarjanam na bhūyo bhavasāgare //
meaning:
आगच्छतामिदं स्थानं सेवितुं मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम् /
मृतानां च पुनर्जनम् न भूयो भवसागरे //
text_mt:
For those seekers of liberation who come to resort to this place
and die, there is no rebirth again in the ocean of mundane existence.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ /
yogī vāpyathavāyogī pāpī vā puṇyakṛttamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः /
योगी वाप्यथवायोगी पापी वा पुण्यकृत्तमः //
text_mt:
Therefore, with every effort, a man should dwell in Vārāṇasī,
whether a yogin or a non-yogin, a sinner or the foremost doer of merit.

sanskrit_iast:
na vedavacanāt pitrorna caiva guruvādataḥ /
matirutkramaṇīyā syādavimuktagatiṃ prati //
meaning:
न वेदवचनात् पित्रोर्न चैव गुरुवादतः /
मतिरुत्क्रमणीया स्यादविमुक्तगतिं प्रति //
text_mt:
Neither through the word of the Vedas, nor of parents, nor by the instruction of a teacher
should one's resolve toward the path of Avimukta be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ityevamuktvā bhagavān vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ /
sahaiva śiṣyapravarairvārāṇasyāṃ cacāra ha //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvaṃvibhāge ekonatriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासो वेदविदां वरः /
सहैव शिष्यप्रवरैर्वाराणस्यां चचार ह //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वंविभागे एकोनत्रिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having spoken thus, the blessed Vyāsa, foremost among knowers of the Veda,
wandered in Vārāṇasī together with his eminent disciples.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sa śiṣyaiḥ saṃvṛto dhīmān gururdvaipāyano muniḥ /
jagāma vipulaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ muktidāyakam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
स शिष्यैः संवृतो धीमान् गुरुर्द्वैपायनो मुनिः /
जगाम विपुलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारं मुक्तिदायकम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Surrounded by his disciples, the wise sage, the teacher Dvaipāyana,
went to the vast liṅga named Oṅkāra, which bestows liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrābhyarcya mahādevaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ /
provāca tasya māhātmyaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām //
meaning:
तत्राभ्यर्च्य महादेवं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः /
प्रोवाच तस्य माहात्म्यं मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped Mahādeva there along with his disciples, the great sage
proclaimed its majesty to the sages of cultivated self:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ nāma śobhanam /
asya smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
इदं तद् विमलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारं नाम शोभनम् /
अस्य स्मरणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt:
This is that pure, auspicious liṅga named Oṅkāra;
by the mere remembrance of it, one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
etat parataraṃ jñānaṃ pañcayatanamuttamam /
sevitaṃ sūribhirnityaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vimokṣadam //
meaning:
एतत् परतरं ज्ञानं पञ्चयतनमुत्तमम् /
सेवितं सूरिभिर्नित्यं वाराणस्यां विमोक्षदम् //
text_mt:
This higher knowledge, the excellent five-fold sanctuary,
ever frequented by wise men, bestows liberation in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
atra sākṣānmahādevaḥ pañcāyatanavigrahaḥ /
ramate bhagavān rudro jantūnāmapavargadaḥ //
meaning:
अत्र साक्षान्महादेवः पञ्चायतनविग्रहः /
रमते भगवान् रुद्रो जन्तूनामपवर्गदः //
text_mt:
Here Mahādeva, the blessed Rudra, whose embodiment is the five-fold sanctuary,
delights visibly, granting liberation to living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tat pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ pañcārthamiti śabdyate /
tadetad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāre samavasthitam //
meaning:
यत् तत् पाशुपतं ज्ञानं पञ्चार्थमिति शब्द्यते /
तदेतद् विमलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारे समवस्थितम् //
text_mt:
That which is the Pāśupata knowledge, known as consisting of five subjects—
that very [knowledge] is established in this pure liṅga at Oṅkāra.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntyatītā tathā śāntirvidyā caiva parā kalā /
pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśca pañcārthaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram //
meaning:
शान्त्यतीता तथा शान्तिर्विद्या चैव परा कला /
प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्च पञ्चार्थं लिङ्गमैश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Śāntyatītā, Śānti, Vidyā the supreme power (kalā),
Pratiṣṭhā, and Nivṛtti—[these] constitute the five-subject liṅga of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcānāmapi devānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sadāśrayam /
oṅkārabodhakaṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamucyate //
meaning:
पञ्चानामपि देवानां ब्रह्मादीनां सदाश्रयम् /
ओङ्कारबोधकं लिङ्गं पञ्चायतनमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Ever the refuge of even the five deities beginning with Brahmā,
the liṅga that makes known the syllable Om is called the five-fold sanctuary.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsmaredaiśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamavyayam /
dehānte tatparaṃ jyotirānandaṃ viśate budhaḥ //
meaning:
संस्मरेदैश्वरं लिङ्गं पञ्चायतनमव्ययम् /
देहान्ते तत्परं ज्योतिरानन्दं विशते बुधः //
text_mt: The wise man should remember that imperishable, sovereign liṅga consisting of five abodes; / at the end of the body he enters that supreme light, which is bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
atra devarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhā brahmarṣayastathā /
upāsya devamīśānaṃ prāptavantaḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
अत्र देवर्षयः पूर्वं सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयस्तथा /
उपास्य देवमीशानं प्राप्तवन्तः परं पदम् //
text_mt: Here formerly the celestial sages, the perfected beings, and likewise the Brahman-sages, / having worshipped the Lord Īśāna, attained the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyodaryāstaṭe puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ guhyatamaṃ śubham /
gocarmamātraṃ viprendrā oṅkāreśvaramuttamam //
meaning:
मत्स्योदर्यास्तटे पुण्यं स्थानं गुह्यतमं शुभम् /
गोचर्ममात्रं विप्रेन्द्रा ओङ्कारेश्वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: On the bank of the Matsyodarī is an auspicious, most secret, holy place, / measuring merely a cow's hide, O best of Brahmins, the excellent Oṅkāreśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaḥ madhyameśvaramuttamam /
viśveśvaraṃ tathoṅkāraṃ kapardeśvarameva ca //
meaning:
कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गः मध्यमेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
विश्वेश्वरं तथोङ्कारं कपर्देश्वरमेव च //
text_mt: The liṅga Kṛttivāseśvara, the excellent Madhyameśvara, / Viśveśvara, and likewise Oṅkāra, and Kapardeśvara as well—

sanskrit_iast:
etāni guhyaliṅgāni vārāṇasyāṃ dvijottamāḥ /
na kaścidiha jānāti vinā śaṃbhoranugrahāt //
meaning:
एतानि गुह्यलिङ्गानि वाराणस्यां द्विजोत्तमाः /
न कश्चिदिह जानाति विना शंभोरनुग्रहात् //
text_mt: these are the secret liṅgas in Vārāṇasī, O best of the twice-born; / no one here knows them without Śambhu's grace.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā yayau kṛṣṇaḥ pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ /
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ draṣṭuṃ devasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ कृष्णः पाराशर्यो महामुनिः /
कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं द्रष्टुं देवस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇa, the great sage, the son of Parāśara, went / to see the liṅga Kṛttivāseśvara of the trident-bearing god.

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya tathā śiṣyairmāhātmyaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ /
kathayāmāsa śiṣyebhyo bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ //
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य तथा शिष्यैर्माहात्म्यं कृत्तिवाससः /
कथयामास शिष्येभ्यो भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः //
text_mt: Having fully worshipped [it] together with his disciples, the Lord, the foremost knower of Brahman, / recounted to his disciples the greatness of Kṛttivāsas:

sanskrit_iast:
asmin sthāne purā daityo hastī bhūtvā bhavāntikam /
brāhmaṇān hantumāyāto ye 'tra nityamupāsate //
meaning:
अस्मिन् स्थाने पुरा दैत्यो हस्ती भूत्वा भवान्तिकम् /
ब्राह्मणान् हन्तुमायातो ये ऽत्र नित्यमुपासते //
text_mt: “In this place of old a demon, having assumed the form of an elephant, came near Bhava / to kill the Brahmins who constantly worship here.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ liṅgānmahādevaḥ prādurāsīt trilocanaḥ /
rakṣaṇārthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां लिङ्गान्महादेवः प्रादुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः /
रक्षणार्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठा भक्तानां भक्तवत्सलः //
text_mt: From the liṅga, Mahādeva, the three-eyed Lord, fond of his devotees, / manifested himself, O best of the twice-born, to protect those devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā gajākṛtiṃ daityaṃ śūlenāvajñayā haraḥ /
vasastasyākarot kṛttiṃ kṛttivāseśvarastataḥ //
meaning:
हत्वा गजाकृतिं दैत्यं शूलेनावज्ञया हरः /
वसस्तस्याकरोत् कृत्तिं कृत्तिवासेश्वरस्ततः //
text_mt: Having slain the demon in elephant form contemptuously with his trident, / Hara made its hide his garment; hence he is Kṛttivāseśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
atra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā munayo munipuṅgavāḥ /
tenaiva ca śarīreṇa prāptāstat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
अत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्ता मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
तेनैव च शरीरेण प्राप्तास्तत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Here the sages, the foremost among sages, attained supreme perfection; / with that very body they attained that supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā vidyeśvarā rudrāḥ śivāye ca prakīrtitāḥ /
kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ nityamāvṛtya saṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
विद्या विद्येश्वरा रुद्राः शिवाये च प्रकीर्तिताः /
कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं नित्यमावृत्य संस्थिताः //
text_mt: The lores, the lords of knowledge, the Rudras, and the Śivas that are proclaimed, / constantly remain encircling the liṅga Kṛttivāseśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoramadharmabahulaṃ janāḥ /
kṛttivāsaṃ na muñcanti kṛtārthāste na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा कलियुगं घोरमधर्मबहुलं जनाः /
कृत्तिवासं न मुञ्चन्ति कृतार्थास्ते न संशयः //
text_mt: People who, knowing the Kaliyuga to be terrible and full of unrighteousness, / do not abandon Kṛttivāsas, have achieved their aim; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntarasahastreṇa mokṣo 'nyatrāpyate na vā /
ekena janmanā mokṣaḥ kṛttivāse tu labhyate //
meaning:
जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेण मोक्षो ऽन्यत्राप्यते न वा /
एकेन जन्मना मोक्षः कृत्तिवासे तु लभ्यते //
text_mt: Liberation is attained elsewhere through a thousand other births, or perhaps not; / but at Kṛttivāsa liberation is gained in a single birth.

sanskrit_iast:
ālayaḥ sarvasiddhānāmetat sthānaṃ vadanti hi /
gopitaṃ devadevena mahādevena śaṃbhunā //
meaning:
आलयः सर्वसिद्धानामेतत् स्थानं वदन्ति हि /
गोपितं देवदेवेन महादेवेन शंभुना //
text_mt: Indeed, they call this place the dwelling of all perfected beings, / concealed by the God of gods, Mahādeva Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
yuge yuge hyatra dāntā brāhmaṇā vedapārāgāḥ /
upāsate mahādevaṃ japanti śatarudriyam //
meaning:
युगे युगे ह्यत्र दान्ता ब्राह्मणा वेदपारागाः /
उपासते महादेवं जपन्ति शतरुद्रियम् //
text_mt: Age after age here, restrained Brahmins who have mastered the Vedas / worship Mahādeva and recite the Śatarudrīya.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti satataṃ devaṃ tryambakaṃ kṛttivāsasam /
dhyāyanti hṛdaye devaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvāntaraṃ śivam //
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति सततं देवं त्र्यम्बकं कृत्तिवाससम् /
ध्यायन्ति हृदये देवं स्थाणुं सर्वान्तरं शिवम् //
text_mt: They constantly praise the three-eyed god who wears an animal hide; / in their heart they meditate upon the god, Sthāṇu, the innermost of all, Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyanti siddhāḥ kila gītakāni
ye vārāṇasyāṃ nivasanti viprāḥ /
teṣāmathaikena bhavena muktir
ye kṛttivāsaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ //
meaning:
गायन्ति सिद्धाः किल गीतकानि
ये वाराणस्यां निवसन्ति विप्राः /
तेषामथैकेन भवेन मुक्तिर्
ये कृत्तिवासं शरणं प्रपन्नाः //
text_mt: The perfected beings indeed sing these verses: / for those Brahmins who dwell in Vārāṇasī / and have taken refuge in Kṛttivāsas, / there is liberation in a single birth.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprāpya loke jagatāmabhīṣṭaṃ
sudurlabhaṃ viprakuleṣu janma /
dhyāne samādhāya japanti rudraṃ
dhyāyanti citte yatayo maheśam //
meaning:
संप्राप्य लोके जगतामभीष्टं
सुदुर्लभं विप्रकुलेषु जन्म /
ध्याने समाधाय जपन्ति रुद्रं
ध्यायन्ति चित्ते यतयो महेशम् //
text_mt: Having attained in this world a birth among Brahmin families, / desired by all worlds and very difficult to attain, / ascetics recite Rudra with composure in meditation, / and meditate upon Maheśa in their mind.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayanti prabhumīśitāraṃ
vārāṇasīmadhyagatā munindrāḥ /
yajanti yajñairabhisaṃdhihīnāḥ
stuvanti rudraṃ praṇamanti śaṃbhum //
meaning:
आराधयन्ति प्रभुमीशितारं
वाराणसीमध्यगता मुनिन्द्राः /
यजन्ति यज्ञैरभिसंधिहीनाः
स्तुवन्ति रुद्रं प्रणमन्ति शंभुम् //
text_mt: Residing in the midst of Vārāṇasī, the lords among sages worship the Lord, the sovereign; / free of personal motives, they sacrifice with sacrifices; / they praise Rudra and bow down to Śambhu:

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhavāyāmalayogadhāmne
sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purāṇam /
smarāmi rudraṃ hṛdaye niviṣṭaṃ
jāne mahādevamanekarūpam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāgetriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
नमो भवायामलयोगधाम्ने
स्थाणुं प्रपद्ये गिरिशं पुराणम् /
स्मरामि रुद्रं हृदये निविष्टं
जाने महादेवमनेकरूपम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागेत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
‘Homage to Bhava, the flawless abode of yoga! / I take refuge in Sthāṇu, Giriśa, the ancient one; / I remember Rudra seated in the heart; / I know Mahādeva of manifold forms.’ ”

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter in the first section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
samābhāṣya munīn dhīmān devadevasya śūlinaḥ /
jagāma liṅgaṃ tad draṣṭuṃ kapardeśvaramavyayam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
समाभाष्य मुनीन् धीमान् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः /
जगाम लिङ्गं तद् द्रष्टुं कपर्देश्वरमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having spoken to the sages, the wise one went / to see that imperishable liṅga Kapardeśvara of the trident-bearing God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayitvā pitṝn dvijāḥ /
piśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinam //
meaning:
स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् द्विजाः /
पिशाचमोचने तीर्थे पूजयामास शूलिनम् //
text_mt: Having bathed there according to rule and having made water-offerings to the ancestors, O twice-born, / he worshipped the trident-bearer at the sacred site of Piśācamocana.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāścaryamapaśyaṃste munayo guruṇā saha /
menire kṣetramāhātmyaṃ praṇemurgiriśaṃ haram //
meaning:
तत्राश्चर्यमपश्यंस्ते मुनयो गुरुणा सह /
मेनिरे क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं प्रणेमुर्गिरिशं हरम् //
text_mt: There the sages together with their guru saw a wonder; / they acknowledged the greatness of the sacred precinct and bowed down to Giriśa Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
kaścidabhyājagāmedaṃ śārdūlo ghorarūpadhṛk /
mṛgīmekāṃ bhakṣayituṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam //
meaning:
कश्चिदभ्याजगामेदं शार्दूलो घोररूपधृक् /
मृगीमेकां भक्षयितुं कपर्देश्वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: A certain tiger of terrible appearance came to this / excellent Kapardeśvara to devour a doe.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sā bhītahṛdayā kṛtvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam /
dhāvamānā susaṃbhrāntā vyāghrasya vaśamāgatā //
meaning:
तत्र सा भीतहृदया कृत्वा कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् /
धावमाना सुसंभ्रान्ता व्याघ्रस्य वशमागता //
text_mt: There, her heart filled with fear, having circumambulated again and again / as she ran, utterly bewildered, she fell into the power of the tiger.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ vidārya nakhaistīkṣṇaiḥ śārdūlaḥ sumahābalaḥ /
jagāma cānyaṃ vijanaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā munīśvarān //
meaning:
तां विदार्य नखैस्तीक्ष्णैः शार्दूलः सुमहाबलः /
जगाम चान्यं विजनं देशं दृष्ट्वा मुनीश्वरान् //
text_mt: Having torn her apart with sharp claws, the tiger of very great strength, / seeing the lords among sages, went away to another, solitary place.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtamātrā ca sā bālā kapardeśāgrato mṛgī /
adṛśyata mahājvālā vyomni sūryasamaprabhā //
meaning:
मृतमात्रा च सा बाला कपर्देशाग्रतो मृगी /
अदृश्यत महाज्वाला व्योम्नि सूर्यसमप्रभा //
text_mt: And as soon as she died before Kapardeśa, that young doe / was seen in the sky as a great flame of light, with radiance equal to the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrā nīlakaṇṭhā ca śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajā /
vṛṣādhirūḍhā puruṣaistādṛśaireva saṃvṛtā //
meaning:
त्रिनेत्रा नीलकण्ठा च शशाङ्काङ्कितमूर्धजा /
वृषाधिरूढा पुरुषैस्तादृशैरेव संवृता //
text_mt: three-eyed, blue-throated, with the crescent moon marking her hair, / mounted on a bull, surrounded by beings just like herself.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcinti khecarāstasya mūrdhani /
gaṇeśvaraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā na dṛṣṭastatkṣaṇāt tataḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पवृष्टिं विमुञ्चिन्ति खेचरास्तस्य मूर्धनि /
गणेश्वरः स्वयं भूत्वा न दृष्टस्तत्क्षणात् ततः //
text_mt: Sky-farers showered a rain of flowers upon its head; / having become a lord of the gaṇas himself, he was seen no more from that moment.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvaitadāścaryavaraṃ jaiminipramukhā dvijāḥ /
kapardeśvaramāhātmyaṃ papracchurgurumacyutam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वैतदाश्चर्यवरं जैमिनिप्रमुखा द्विजाः /
कपर्देश्वरमाहात्म्यं पप्रच्छुर्गुरुमच्युतम् //
text_mt: Having seen this supreme wonder, the twice-born led by Jaimini / asked their infallible guru about the greatness of Kapardeśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ provāca bhagavān devāgre copaviśya saḥ /
kapardeśasya māhātmyaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
तेषां प्रोवाच भगवान् देवाग्रे चोपविश्य सः /
कपर्देशस्य माहात्म्यं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: Sitting before the god and bowing to the one whose banner bears a bull, / the Lord told them the greatness of Kapardeśa:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ devasya talliṅgaṃ kapardośvaramuttamam /
smṛtvaivāśeṣapāpaughaṃ kṣipramasya vimuñcati //
meaning:
इदं देवस्य तल्लिङ्गं कपर्दोश्वरमुत्तमम् /
स्मृत्वैवाशेषपापौघं क्षिप्रमस्य विमुञ्चति //
text_mt: “This is that excellent liṅga Kapardeśvara of the god; / merely by remembering it, one is quickly freed from an entire flood of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhādayo doṣā vārāṇasīnivāsinām /
vighnāḥ sarve vinaśyanti kapardeśvarapūjanāt //
meaning:
कामक्रोधादयो दोषा वाराणसीनिवासिनाम् /
विघ्नाः सर्वे विनश्यन्ति कपर्देश्वरपूजनात् //
text_mt: Flaws such as desire and anger among the dwellers of Vārāṇasī, / and all obstacles, are destroyed through the worship of Kapardeśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sadaiva draṣṭavyaṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam /
pūjitavyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vaidikaiḥ stavaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सदैव द्रष्टव्यं कपर्देश्वरमुत्तमम् /
पूजितव्यं प्रयत्नेन स्तोतव्यं वैदिकैः स्तवैः //
text_mt: Therefore, the excellent Kapardeśvara should always be seen, / worshipped with exertion, and praised with Vedic hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyatāmatra niyataṃ yogināṃ śāntacetasām /
jāyate yogasaṃsiddhiḥ sā ṣaṇmāse na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायतामत्र नियतं योगिनां शान्तचेतसाम् /
जायते योगसंसिद्धिः सा षण्मासे न संशयः //
text_mt: For yogins of peaceful mind who constantly meditate here, / the full success of yoga arises in six months; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyādayaḥ pāpā vinaśyantyasya pūjanāt /
piśācamocane kuṇḍe snātasyātra samīpataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्यादयः पापा विनश्यन्त्यस्य पूजनात् /
पिशाचमोचने कुण्डे स्नातस्यात्र समीपतः //
text_mt: Sins such as Brahmin-murder are destroyed through the worship of this [liṅga], / for one who has bathed here nearby in the pool of Piśācamocana.

sanskrit_iast:
asmin kṣetre purā viprāstapasvī śaṃsitavrataḥ /
śaṅkukarṇa iti khyātaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram /
jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmarūpiṇam //
meaning:
अस्मिन् क्षेत्रे पुरा विप्रास्तपस्वी शंसितव्रतः /
शङ्कुकर्ण इति ख्यातः पूजयामास शङ्करम् /
जजाप रुद्रमनिशं प्रणवं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् //
text_mt: In this sacred precinct of old, O twice-born, an ascetic of strict vows / renowned as Śaṅkukarṇa worshipped Śaṅkara; / he incessantly recited Rudra, the Praṇava whose nature is Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ stotrairnamaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ /
uvāsa tatra yogātmā kṛtvā dīkṣāṃ tu naiṣṭhikīma //
meaning:
पुष्पधूपादिभिः स्तोत्रैर्नमस्कारैः प्रदक्षिणैः /
उवास तत्र योगात्मा कृत्वा दीक्षां तु नैष्ठिकीम //
text_mt: With flowers, incense, and the like, with hymns of praise, bowings, and circumambulations, / the yogic-souled one lived there, having undertaken the lifelong vow.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācidāgataṃ pretaṃ paśyati sma kṣudhānvitam /
asthicarmapinaddhāṅgaṃ niḥ śvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
कदाचिदागतं प्रेतं पश्यति स्म क्षुधान्वितम् /
अस्थिचर्मपिनद्धाङ्गं निः श्वसन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: At one time he saw a hungry ghost who had come, / his limbs covered with only bone and skin, sighing again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa muniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ /
provāca ko bhavān kasmād deśād deśamimaṃśritaḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा स मुनिश्रेष्ठः कृपया परया युतः /
प्रोवाच को भवान् कस्माद् देशाद् देशमिमंश्रितः //
text_mt: Seeing him, that best of sages, filled with supreme compassion, / said: ‘Who are you? From what country have you resorted to this place?’

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai piśācaḥ kṣudhayā pīḍyamāno 'bravīd vacaḥ /
pūrvajanmanyahaṃ vipro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ /
putrapautrādibhiryuktaḥ kuṭumbabharaṇotsukaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मै पिशाचः क्षुधया पीड्यमानो ऽब्रवीद् वचः /
पूर्वजन्मन्यहं विप्रो धनधान्यसमन्वितः /
पुत्रपौत्रादिभिर्युक्तः कुटुम्बभरणोत्सुकः //
text_mt: Tormented by hunger, the ghost spoke words to him: / ‘In my previous birth I was a Brahmin endowed with wealth and grain, / accompanied by sons, grandsons, and others, eager to maintain my family.

sanskrit_iast:
na pūjitā mayā devā gāvo 'pyatithayastathā /
na kadācit kṛtaṃ puṇyamalpaṃ vā svalpameva vā //
meaning:
न पूजिता मया देवा गावो ऽप्यतिथयस्तथा /
न कदाचित् कृतं पुण्यमल्पं वा स्वल्पमेव वा //
text_mt: I did not worship the gods, nor cows, nor guests; / never was any merit made, whether small or very slight.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā bhagavān devo govṛṣeśvaravāhanaḥ /
viśveśvaro vārāṇasyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭe namaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एकदा भगवान् देवो गोवृषेश्वरवाहनः /
विश्वेश्वरो वाराणस्यां दृष्टः स्पृष्टे नमस्कृतः //
text_mt: Once the Lord, the god whose vehicle is the lord of bulls, / Viśveśvara, was seen, touched, and bowed to in Vārāṇasī.’

sanskrit_iast:
tadācireṇa kālena pañcatvamahamāgataḥ /
na dṛṣṭaṃ nanmayā ghoraṃ yamasya vadanaṃ mune //
meaning:
तदाचिरेण कालेन पञ्चत्वमहमागतः /
न दृष्टं नन्मया घोरं यमस्य वदनं मुने //
text_mt:
Then, after a short time, I came to death.
Yet I did not see the terrifying face of Yama, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśīṃ yonimāpannaḥ paiśācīṃ kṣudhayānvitaḥ /
pipāsayādhunākrānto na jānāmi hitāhitam //
meaning:
ईदृशीं योनिमापन्नः पैशाचीं क्षुधयान्वितः /
पिपासयाधुनाक्रान्तो न जानामि हिताहितम् //
text_mt:
Having obtained such an existence as a piśāca, overcome with hunger
and now overwhelmed by thirst, I do not know what is beneficial or harmful.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi kañcit samuddhartumupāyaṃ paśyasi prabho /
kuruṣva taṃ namastubhyaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
यदि कञ्चित् समुद्धर्तुमुपायं पश्यसि प्रभो /
कुरुष्व तं नमस्तुभ्यं त्वामहं शरणं गतः //
text_mt:
If you see any means to rescue me, O lord,
please perform it; reverence to you, I have come to you for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ śaṅkukarṇo 'tha piśācamidamabravīt /
tvādṛśo na hi loke 'smin vidyate puṇyakṛttamaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः शङ्कुकर्णो ऽथ पिशाचमिदमब्रवीत् /
त्वादृशो न हि लोके ऽस्मिन् विद्यते पुण्यकृत्तमः //
text_mt:
Addressed thus, Śaṅkukarṇa then said this to the piśāca:
“Indeed, there is no one in this world who has performed greater merit than you.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tvayā bhagavān pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭo viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ /
saṃspṛṣṭo vandito bhūyaḥ ko 'nyastvatsadṛśo bhuvi //
meaning:
यत् त्वया भगवान् पूर्वं दृष्टो विश्वेश्वरः शिवः /
संस्पृष्टो वन्दितो भूयः को ऽन्यस्त्वत्सदृशो भुवि //
text_mt:
Because earlier you beheld the Lord Viśveśvara, Śiva,
touched him, and repeatedly venerated him, who else on earth is your equal?

sanskrit_iast:
tena karmavipākena deśametaṃ samāgataḥ /
snānaṃ kuruṣva śīghraṃ tvamasmin kuṇḍe samāhitaḥ /
yenemāṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ kṣiprameva prahāsyasi //
meaning:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन देशमेतं समागतः /
स्नानं कुरुष्व शीघ्रं त्वमस्मिन् कुण्डे समाहितः /
येनेमां कुत्सितां योनिं क्षिप्रमेव प्रहास्यसि //
text_mt:
Through the ripening of that action, you have arrived at this place.
Bathe quickly in this pool with a concentrated mind,
whereby you will immediately cast off this vile birth.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa evamukto muninā piśāco
dayālunā devavaraṃ trinetram /
smṛtvā kapardeśvaramīśitāraṃ
cakre samādhāya mano 'vagāham //
meaning:
स एवमुक्तो मुनिना पिशाचो
दयालुना देववरं त्रिनेत्रम् /
स्मृत्वा कपर्देश्वरमीशितारं
चक्रे समाधाय मनो ऽवगाहम् //
text_mt:
Spoken to thus by the compassionate sage, the piśāca,
remembering the supreme god, the three-eyed Lord Kapardeśvara,
concentrated his mind and took a plunge [into the water].

sanskrit_iast:
tadāvagāḍho munisaṃnidhāne
mamāra divyābharaṇopapannaḥ /
adṛśyatārkapratime vimāne
śaśāṅkacihnāṅkitacārumauliḥ //
meaning:
तदावगाढो मुनिसंनिधाने
ममार दिव्याभरणोपपन्नः /
अदृश्यतार्कप्रतिमे विमाने
शशाङ्कचिह्नाङ्कितचारुमौलिः //
text_mt:
Having plunged then in the presence of the sage,
he died, endowed with celestial ornaments,
and was seen on a chariot like the sun,
his handsome crown adorned with the crescent moon mark.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāti rudrairabhito divasthaiḥ
samāvṛto yogibhairaprameyaiḥ /
sabālakhilyādibhireṣa devo
yathodaye bhānuraśeṣadevaḥ //
meaning:
विभाति रुद्रैरभितो दिवस्थैः
समावृतो योगिभैरप्रमेयैः /
सबालखिल्यादिभिरेष देवो
यथोदये भानुरशेषदेवः //
text_mt:
He shone, surrounded on all sides by Rudras dwelling in heaven,
by immeasurable yogins,
and by the Bālakhilyas and others, like the sun,
the god of all, rising at dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti siddhā divi devasaṅghā
nṛtyanti divyāpsaraso 'bhirāmāḥ /
muñcanti vṛṣṭiṃ kusumāmbumiśrāṃ
gandharvavidyādharakiṃnarādyāḥ //
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति सिद्धा दिवि देवसङ्घा
नृत्यन्ति दिव्याप्सरसो ऽभिरामाः /
मुञ्चन्ति वृष्टिं कुसुमाम्बुमिश्रां
गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिंनराद्याः //

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūyamāno 'tha munīndrasaṅghai-
ravāpya bodhaṃ bhagavātprasādāt /
samāviśanmaṇḍalametadagryaṃ
trayīmayaṃ yatra vibhāti rudraḥ //
meaning:
संस्तूयमानो ऽथ मुनीन्द्रसङ्घै-
रवाप्य बोधं भगवात्प्रसादात् /
समाविशन्मण्डलमेतदग्र्यं
त्रयीमयं यत्र विभाति रुद्रः //
text_mt:
Then, praised by hosts of supreme sages,
attaining wisdom by the grace of the Lord,
he entered this foremost orb composed of the three Vedas,
where Rudra shines.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vimuktaṃ sa piśācabhūtaṃ
muniḥ prahṛṣṭo manasā maheśam /
vicintya rudraṃ kavimekamagniṃ
praṇamya tuṣṭāva kapardinaṃ tam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा विमुक्तं स पिशाचभूतं
मुनिः प्रहृष्टो मनसा महेशम् /
विचिन्त्य रुद्रं कविमेकमग्निं
प्रणम्य तुष्टाव कपर्दिनं तम् //
text_mt:
Seeing that creature freed from being a piśāca,
the sage was delighted in his mind; reflecting upon the Great Lord,
Rudra, the wise, the one fire,
he bowed and praised the Kapardin.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkukarṇa uvāca
kapardinaṃ tvāṃ parataḥ parastād
goptāramekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam /
vrajāmi yogeśvaramīśitāra-
mādityamagniṃ kapilādhirūḍham //
meaning:
शङ्कुकर्ण उवाच
कपर्दिनं त्वां परतः परस्ताद्
गोप्तारमेकं पुरुषं पुराणम् /
व्रजामि योगेश्वरमीशितार-
मादित्यमग्निं कपिलाधिरूढम् //
text_mt:
Śaṅkukarṇa said:
“To you, the Kapardin, beyond the beyond,
the sole guardian, the ancient spirit,
the lord of yoga, the ruler,
the sun, the fire mounted upon the tawny cow, I go [for refuge].

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ brahmapāraṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ
hiraṇmayaṃ yoginamādimantam /
vrajāmi rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ divasthaṃ
mahāmuniṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram //
meaning:
त्वां ब्रह्मपारं हृदि सन्निविष्टं
हिरण्मयं योगिनमादिमन्तम् /
व्रजामि रुद्रं शरणं दिवस्थं
महामुनिं ब्रह्ममयं पवित्रम् //
text_mt:
To you, the limit of Brahman, seated in the heart,
golden, the yogin, possessing beginning and end,
to Rudra who dwells in heaven, I go for refuge,
to the great sage, composed of Brahman, pure.

sanskrit_iast:
sahastrapādākṣiśiro 'bhiyuktaṃ
sahastrabāhuṃ namasaḥ parastāt /
tvāṃ brahāmapāraṃ praṇamāmi śaṃbhuṃ
hiraṇyagarbhādhipatiṃ trinetram //
meaning:
सहस्त्रपादाक्षिशिरो ऽभियुक्तं
सहस्त्रबाहुं नमसः परस्तात् /
त्वां ब्रहामपारं प्रणमामि शंभुं
हिरण्यगर्भाधिपतिं त्रिनेत्रम् //
text_mt:
Possessing a thousand feet, eyes, and heads,
having a thousand arms, beyond darkness,
to you, the limit of Brahman, Śaṃbhu, I bow,
the lord of Hiraṇyagarbha, the three-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ prasūtirjagato vināśo
yenāvṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ śivena /
taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhagavantamīśaṃ
praṇamya nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
यतः प्रसूतिर्जगतो विनाशो
येनावृतं सर्वमिदं शिवेन /
तं ब्रह्मपारं भगवन्तमीशं
प्रणम्य नित्यं शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt:
From whom is the birth and destruction of the universe,
by whom, Śiva, all this is pervaded,
to that Lord, the ruler, the limit of Brahman,
bowing constantly, I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
aliṅgamālokavihīnarūpaṃ
svayaṃprabhaṃ citpatimekarudram /
taṃ brahmapāraṃ parameśvaraṃ tvāṃ
namaskariṣye na yato 'nyadasti //
meaning:
अलिङ्गमालोकविहीनरूपं
स्वयंप्रभं चित्पतिमेकरुद्रम् /
तं ब्रह्मपारं परमेश्वरं त्वां
नमस्करिष्ये न यतो ऽन्यदस्ति //
text_mt:
Without a mark, whose form is devoid of light,
self-luminous, the lord of consciousness, the sole Rudra,
to you, the Supreme Lord, the limit of Brahman,
I will offer reverence, since there is none other than you.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yoginastyaktasabījayogā
labdhvā samādhiṃ paramārthabhūtāḥ /
paśyanti devaṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ
taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam //
meaning:
यं योगिनस्त्यक्तसबीजयोगा
लब्ध्वा समाधिं परमार्थभूताः /
पश्यन्ति देवं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यं
तं ब्रह्मपारं भवतः स्वरूपम् //
text_mt:
Whom yogins who have abandoned seeded yoga,
having attained absorption, becoming reality itself,
behold as God, I am eternally bowed;
to that real form of yours, the limit of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
na yatra nāmādiviśeṣakḷpti-
r na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati yatsvarūpam /
taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ
svayaṃbhuvaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
न यत्र नामादिविशेषकॢप्ति-
र् न संदृशे तिष्ठति यत्स्वरूपम् /
तं ब्रह्मपारं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यं
स्वयंभुवं त्वां शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt:
Where there is no conceptualisation of names and the like,
whose real form does not remain within sight,
to that limit of Brahman I am eternally bowed;
to you, the self-existent, I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yad vedavādābhiratā videhaṃ
sabrahmavijñānamabhedamekam /
paśyantyanekaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpaṃ
sabrahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityam //
meaning:
यद् वेदवादाभिरता विदेहं
सब्रह्मविज्ञानमभेदमेकम् /
पश्यन्त्यनेकं भवतः स्वरूपं
सब्रह्मपारं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यम् //
text_mt:
Whom those devoted to the teachings of the Veda behold
as bodiless, united with the knowledge of Brahman, non-different, the one
and manifold real form of yours,
to that with the limit of Brahman I am eternally bowed.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ purāṇo
vivartate yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ /
namāmi taṃ jyotiṣi saṃniviṣṭaṃ
kālaṃ bṛhantaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam //
meaning:
यतः प्रधानं पुरुषः पुराणो
विवर्तते यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः /
नमामि तं ज्योतिषि संनिविष्टं
कालं बृहन्तं भवतः स्वरूपम् //
text_mt:
From whom primordial nature [and] the ancient spirit
evolve, to whom the gods bow down,
to that great Time seated in light,
the real form of yours, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
vrajāmi nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ guheśaṃ
sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purārim /
śivaṃ prapadye haramindumauliṃ
pinākinaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi //
meaning:
व्रजामि नित्यं शरणं गुहेशं
स्थाणुं प्रपद्ये गिरिशं पुरारिम् /
शिवं प्रपद्ये हरमिन्दुमौलिं
पिनाकिनं त्वां शरणं व्रजामि //

sanskrit_iast:
stutvaivaṃ śaṅkukarṇo 'sau bhagavantaṃ kapardinam /
papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau proccaran praṇavaṃ param //
meaning:
स्तुत्वैवं शङ्कुकर्णो ऽसौ भगवन्तं कपर्दिनम् /
पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ प्रोच्चरन् प्रणवं परम् //
text_mt:
Having thus praised the Lord Kapardin,
Śaṅkukarṇa fell upon the ground like a staff,
uttering aloud the supreme Praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇāt paramaṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam /
jñānamānandamadvaitaṃ koṭikālāgnisannibham //
meaning:
तत्क्षणात् परमं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम् /
ज्ञानमानन्दमद्वैतं कोटिकालाग्निसन्निभम् //
text_mt:
At that moment, a supreme liṅga appeared, whose nature is Śiva,
knowledge, bliss, non-dual,
resembling millions of fires of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkukarṇo 'tha muktātmā tadātmā sarvago 'malaḥ /
nililye vimale liṅge tadbhutamivābhavat //
meaning:
शङ्कुकर्णो ऽथ मुक्तात्मा तदात्मा सर्वगो ऽमलः /
निलिल्ये विमले लिङ्गे तद्भुतमिवाभवत् //

sanskrit_iast:
etad rahasyamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vaḥ kapardinaḥ /
na kaścid vetti tamasā vidvānapyatra muhyati //
meaning:
एतद् रहस्यमाख्यातं माहात्म्यं वः कपर्दिनः /
न कश्चिद् वेत्ति तमसा विद्वानप्यत्र मुह्यति //
text_mt:
This secret greatness of Kapardin has been told to you;
no one knows it through ignorance, and even a learned man is bewildered here.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imāṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm /
bhaktaḥ pāpaviśuddhātmā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
य इमां शृणुयान्नित्यं कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् /
भक्तः पापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Whoever constantly hears this story that destroys sins,
devoted, his soul purified from sins, would attain proximity to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhecca satataṃ śuddho brahmapāraṃ mahāstavam /
prātarmadhyāhnasamaye sa yogaṃ prāpnuyāt param //
meaning:
पठेच्च सततं शुद्धो ब्रह्मपारं महास्तवम् /
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसमये स योगं प्राप्नुयात् परम् //
text_mt:
And whoever, purified, constantly recites this great hymn, the Brahmapāra,
at morning and noon time, shall attain supreme yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva nityaṃ vatsyāmo devadevaṃ kapardinam /
drakṣyāmaḥ satataṃ devaṃ pūjayāmo 'tha śūlinam //
meaning:
इहैव नित्यं वत्स्यामो देवदेवं कपर्दिनम् /
द्रक्ष्यामः सततं देवं पूजयामो ऽथ शूलिनम् //
text_mt:
“Here alone we shall dwell constantly with Kapardin, the god of gods;
we shall behold the god constantly and worship the wielder of the trident.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ /
uvāsa tatra yuktātmā pūjayan vai kapardinam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekatriśodhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासः शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः /
उवास तत्र युक्तात्मा पूजयन् वै कपर्दिनम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकत्रिशोध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord Vyāsa, the great sage, together with his disciples,
dwelt there with controlled mind, worshipping Kapardin.

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
uṣitvā tatra bhagavān kapardeśāntike punaḥ /
draṣṭuṃ yayau madhyameśaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇān prabhuḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
उषित्वा तत्र भगवान् कपर्देशान्तिके पुनः /
द्रष्टुं ययौ मध्यमेशं बहुवर्षगणान् प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having dwelt there near Kapardeśa for a host of many years,
the lord, the venerable one, went again to see Madhyameśa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra mandākinīṃ puṇyāmṛṣisaṅganiṣevitām /
nadīṃ vimalapānīyāṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭo 'bhavanmuniḥ //
meaning:
तत्र मन्दाकिनीं पुण्यामृषिसङ्गनिषेविताम् /
नदीं विमलपानीयां दृष्ट्वा हृष्टो ऽभवन्मुनिः //
text_mt:
Seeing the holy Mandākinī river there, frequented by hosts of sages,
having clear waters, the sage was delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāmanvīkṣya munibhiḥ saha dvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ /
cakāra bhāvapūtātmā snānaṃ snānavidhānavit //
meaning:
स तामन्वीक्ष्य मुनिभिः सह द्वैपायनः प्रभुः /
चकार भावपूतात्मा स्नानं स्नानविधानवित् //
text_mt:
Looking upon it together with the sages, the lord Dvaipāyana,
his soul purified by devotion, knowing the rules of bathing, bathed.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtarpya vidhivad devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā /
pūjayāmāsa lokādiṃ puṣpairnānāvidhairbhavam //
meaning:
संतर्प्य विधिवद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा /
पूजयामास लोकादिं पुष्पैर्नानाविधैर्भवम् //
text_mt:
Having duly offered water to the gods, the sages, and the hosts of ancestors,
he worshipped Bhava, the source of the world, with various kinds of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya śiṣyapravaraiḥ sārdhaṃ satyavatīsutaḥ /
madhyameśvaramīśānamarcayāmāsa śūlinam //
meaning:
प्रविश्य शिष्यप्रवरैः सार्धं सत्यवतीसुतः /
मध्यमेश्वरमीशानमर्चयामास शूलिनम् //
text_mt:
Entering together with his excellent disciples, the son of Satyavatī
worshipped Īśāna, Madhyameśvara, the wielder of the trident.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ /
draṣṭuṃ samāgatā rudraṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram //
meaning:
ततः पाशुपताः शान्ता भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः /
द्रष्टुं समागता रुद्रं मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Then Pāśupatas, peaceful, their bodies smeared with ashes,
came to see Rudra, the Lord Madhyameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārāsaktamanaso vedādhyayanatatparāḥ /
jaṭilā muṇḍitāścāpi śuklayajñopavītinaḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्कारासक्तमनसो वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः /
जटिला मुण्डिताश्चापि शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनः //
text_mt:
Their minds were attached to the syllable Oṃ, devoted to the study of the Vedas;
some had matted hair, some were shaved, and they wore white sacred threads.

sanskrit_iast:
kaupīnavasanāḥ kecidapare cāpyavāsasaḥ /
brahmacaryaratāḥ śāntā vedāntajñānatatparāḥ //
meaning:
कौपीनवसनाः केचिदपरे चाप्यवाससः /
ब्रह्मचर्यरताः शान्ता वेदान्तज्ञानतत्पराः //
text_mt:
Some wore loincloths, and others were naked;
devoted to celibacy, peaceful, intent upon the knowledge of the Vedānta.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā dvaipāyanaṃ viprāḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munim /
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamidaṃ vacanamabruvan //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा द्वैपायनं विप्राः शिष्यैः परिवृतं मुनिम् /
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायमिदं वचनमब्रुवन् //
text_mt:
Seeing the sage Dvaipāyana surrounded by his disciples, the brahmins,
having worshipped him according to rule, spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
ko bhavān kuta āyātaḥ saha śiṣyairmahāmune /
procuḥ pailādayaḥ śiṣyāstānṛṣīn brahmabhāvitān //
meaning:
को भवान् कुत आयातः सह शिष्यैर्महामुने /
प्रोचुः पैलादयः शिष्यास्तानृषीन् ब्रह्मभावितान् //
text_mt:
“Who are you, and whence have you come together with your disciples, O great sage?”
Paila and the other disciples replied to those sages contemplating Brahman:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ satyavatīsūnuḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ /
vyāsaḥ svayaṃ hṛṣīkeśo yena vedāḥ pṛthak kṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अयं सत्यवतीसूनुः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः /
व्यासः स्वयं हृषीकेशो येन वेदाः पृथक् कृताः //
text_mt: This sage is Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, the son of Satyavatī, / Vyāsa, Hṛṣīkeśa himself, by whom the Vedas were divided.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya devo mahādevaḥ sākṣādeva pinākadhṛk /
aṃśāṃśenābhavat putro nāmnā śuka iti prabhuḥ //
meaning:
यस्य देवो महादेवः साक्षादेव पिनाकधृक् /
अंशांशेनाभवत् पुत्रो नाम्ना शुक इति प्रभुः //
text_mt: The god Mahādeva himself, the wielder of the Pināka bow, / became his powerful son named Śuka by a portion of a portion.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sa sākṣānmahādevaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram /
prapannaḥ parayā bhaktyā yasya tajjñānamaiśvaram //
meaning:
यः स साक्षान्महादेवं सर्वभावेन शङ्करम् /
प्रपन्नः परया भक्त्या यस्य तज्ज्ञानमैश्वरम् //
text_mt: He took refuge in Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, directly with all his being, / through supreme devotion, whose sovereign knowledge that is.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhāḥ /
nemuravyagramanasaḥ procuḥ satyavatīsutam //
meaning:
ततः पाशुपताः सर्वे हृष्टसर्वतनूरुहाः /
नेमुरव्यग्रमनसः प्रोचुः सत्यवतीसुतम् //
text_mt: Then all the Pāśupatas, with every hair on their bodies standing on end with joy, / bowed with steady minds and addressed the son of Satyavatī:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan bhavatā jñātaṃ vijñānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
prisādād devadevasya yat tanmāheśvaraṃ param //
meaning:
भगवन् भवता ज्ञातं विज्ञानं परमेष्ठिनः /
प्रिसादाद् देवदेवस्य यत् तन्माहेश्वरं परम् //
text_mt: “O blessed one, by you is known the higher wisdom of the supreme Lord, / that supreme wisdom relating to Maheśvara, through the grace of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadāsmākamavyaktaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamam /
kṣipraṃ paśyema taṃ devaṃ śrutvā bhagavato mukhāt //
meaning:
तद्वदास्माकमव्यक्तं रहस्यं गुह्यमुत्तमम् /
क्षिप्रं पश्येम तं देवं श्रुत्वा भगवतो मुखात् //
text_mt: Tell us that unmanifest, supreme, secret mystery, / so that having heard it from the blessed one’s mouth we may swiftly behold that God.”

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayitvā tāñchiṣyān sumantupramukhāṃstataḥ /
provāca tatparaṃ jñānaṃ yogibhyo yogavittamaḥ //
meaning:
विसर्जयित्वा ताञ्छिष्यान् सुमन्तुप्रमुखांस्ततः /
प्रोवाच तत्परं ज्ञानं योगिभ्यो योगवित्तमः //
text_mt: Having dismissed those disciples led by Sumantu, / the greatest knower of yoga proclaimed that supreme knowledge to the yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇādeva vimalaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ jyotiruttamam /
līnāstatraiva te viprāḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata //
meaning:
तत्क्षणादेव विमलं संभूतं ज्योतिरुत्तमम् /
लीनास्तत्रैव ते विप्राः क्षणादन्तरधीयत //
text_mt: At that very moment a spotless, supreme light arose; / the twice-born were absorbed right there, and in a moment it vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śiṣyān samāhūya bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ /
provāca madhyameśasya māhātmyaṃ pailapūrvakān //
meaning:
ततः शिष्यान् समाहूय भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः /
प्रोवाच मध्यमेशस्य माहात्म्यं पैलपूर्वकान् //
text_mt: Then, summoning his disciples led by Paila, the blessed one, / the greatest knower of Brahman, declared the majesty of Madhyameśa:

sanskrit_iast:
asmin sthāne svayaṃ devo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ /
ramate bhagavān nityaṃ rudraiśca parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
अस्मिन् स्थाने स्वयं देवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः /
रमते भगवान् नित्यं रुद्रैश्च परिवारितः //
text_mt: “In this place, the blessed Lord Maheśvara himself, together with the Goddess, / constantly takes delight, surrounded by the Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
atra pūrvaṃ hṛṣīkeśo viśvātmā devakīsutaḥ /
uvāsa vatsaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā pāśupatairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अत्र पूर्वं हृषीकेशो विश्वात्मा देवकीसुतः /
उवास वत्सरं कृष्णः सदा पाशुपतैर्वृतः //
text_mt: Here formerly Hṛṣīkeśa Kṛṣṇa, the Soul of All, the son of Devakī, / dwelt for a year, constantly surrounded by Pāśupatas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgo rudrādhyayanatatparaḥ /
ārādhayan hariḥ śaṃbhuṃ kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam //
meaning:
भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गो रुद्राध्ययनतत्परः /
आराधयन् हरिः शंभुं कृत्वा पाशुपतं व्रतम् //
text_mt: His whole body smeared with ashes, intent on reciting the Rudra hymns, / Hari worshipped Śambhu after undertaking the Pāśupata vow.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya te bahavaḥ śiṣyā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ /
labdhvā tadvacanājjñānaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram //
meaning:
तस्य ते बहवः शिष्या ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः /
लब्ध्वा तद्वचनाज्ज्ञानं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: His many disciples, devoted to celibacy, / having obtained knowledge from his words, beheld Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devo mahādevaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nīlalohitaḥ /
dadau kṛṣṇāsya bhagavāna varado varamuttamam //
meaning:
तस्य देवो महादेवः प्रत्यक्षं नीललोहितः /
ददौ कृष्णास्य भगवान वरदो वरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: To him the blessed god Mahādeva, the blue-throated red one, / visibly appeared as the granter of boons and gave an excellent boon to Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
yer'cayiṣyanti govindaṃ madbhaktā vidhipūrvakam /
teṣāṃ tadaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyati jaganmaya //
meaning:
येर्ऽचयिष्यन्ति गोविन्दं मद्भक्ता विधिपूर्वकम् /
तेषां तदैश्वरं ज्ञानमुत्पत्स्यति जगन्मय //
text_mt: ‘Those devotees of mine who will worship Govinda according to the rules, / in them that sovereign knowledge will arise, O you who embody the world!

sanskrit_iast:
namasyor'cayitavyaśca dhyātavyo matparairjanaiḥ /
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādād dvijātibhiḥ //
meaning:
नमस्योर्ऽचयितव्यश्च ध्यातव्यो मत्परैर्जनैः /
भविष्यसि न संदेहो मत्प्रसादाद् द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt: You shall be bowed to, worshipped, and meditated upon by people devoted to me, / by the twice-born through my grace; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'tra drakṣyanti deveśaṃ snātvā rudraṃ pinākinam /
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāmāśu vinaśyati //
meaning:
ये ऽत्र द्रक्ष्यन्ति देवेशं स्नात्वा रुद्रं पिनाकिनम् /
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं तेषामाशु विनश्यति //
text_mt: Those who, having bathed here, behold Rudra, the wielder of the Pināka, the Lord of gods, / their sins such as the killing of a brahmin are swiftly destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāṃstyajanti ye martyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api /
te yānti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
प्राणांस्त्यजन्ति ये मर्त्याः पापकर्मरता अपि /
ते यान्ति तत् परं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: The mortals who cast off their vital breaths [here], even if attached to sinful deeds, / they go to that supreme abode; there is no deliberation needed on this.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyāstu khalu te viprā mandākinyāṃ kṛtodakāḥ /
arcayanti mahādevaṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram //
meaning:
धन्यास्तु खलु ते विप्रा मन्दाकिन्यां कृतोदकाः /
अर्चयन्ति महादेवं मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: Fortunate indeed are those twice-born who, having performed water-rites in the Mandākinī, / worship the Lord, Mahādeva, Madhyameśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tviha /
ekaikaśaḥ kṛtaṃ viprāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam //
meaning:
स्नानं दानं तपः श्राद्धं पिण्डनिर्वपणं त्विह /
एकैकशः कृतं विप्राः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम् //
text_mt: Bathing, gift-giving, austerity, ancestral offering rites, and the offering of rice-balls, / each performed here, O twice-born, purifies the family up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnihatyāmupaspṛśya rāhugraste divākare /
yat phalaṃ labhate martyastasmād daśaguṇaṃ tviha //
meaning:
संनिहत्यामुपस्पृश्य राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे /
यत् फलं लभते मर्त्यस्तस्माद् दशगुणं त्विह //
text_mt: Whatever fruit a mortal attains by sipping water at Saṃnihitī / when the sun is seized by Rāhu, ten times that is gained here.’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā mahāyogī madhyameśānti ke prabhuḥ /
uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjayan vai maheśvaram //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा महायोगी मध्यमेशान्ति के प्रभुः /
उवास सुचिरं कालं पूजयन् वै महेश्वरम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the master, the great yogin, dwelt for a very long time / near Madhyameśa, indeed worshipping Maheśvara.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tataḥ sarvāṇi guhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca /
jagāma bhagavān vyāso jaiminipramukhairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततः सर्वाणि गुह्यानि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च /
जगाम भगवान् व्यासो जैमिनिप्रमुखैर्वृतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Then the blessed Vyāsa, surrounded by [disciples] led by Jaimini, / went to all the secret sacred bathing places and shrines:

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgādadhikaṃ śubham /
viśvarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tālatīrthamanuttamam //
meaning:
प्रयागं परमं तीर्थं प्रयागादधिकं शुभम् /
विश्वरूपं तथा तीर्थं तालतीर्थमनुत्तमम् //
