text_mt: The supreme sacred bathing place Prayāga, and the auspicious one superior to Prayāga, / likewise the sacred bathing place Viśvarūpa, and the unsurpassed Tālatīrtha;

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caivārṣabhaṃ param /
svarnolaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ gaurītīrthamanuttamam //
meaning:
आकाशाख्यं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैवार्षभं परम् /
स्वर्नोलं च महातीर्थं गौरीतीर्थमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: the great sacred bathing place named Ākāśa, and the supreme sacred bathing place Ārṣabha, / the great sacred bathing place Svarnola, and the unsurpassed Gaurītīrtha;

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ svargadvāraṃ tathaiva ca /
jambukeśvaramityuktaṃ dharmākhyaṃ tīrthamuttamam //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यं तथा तीर्थं स्वर्गद्वारं तथैव च /
जम्बुकेश्वरमित्युक्तं धर्माख्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: likewise the sacred bathing place Prājāpatya, and also Svargadvāra, / the one named Jambukeśvara, and the excellent sacred bathing place called Dharma;

sanskrit_iast:
gayātīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva mahānadī /
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vāyutīrthamanuttamam //
meaning:
गयातीर्थं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैव महानदी /
नारायणं परं तीर्थं वायुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: the great sacred bathing place Gayātīrtha, and the sacred bathing place Mahānadī, / the supreme sacred bathing place Nārāyaṇa, and the unsurpassed Vāyutīrtha;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānatīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam /
yamatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃvartakaṃ śubham //
meaning:
ज्ञानतीर्थं परं गुह्यं वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम् /
यमतीर्थं महापुण्यं तीर्थं संवर्तकं शुभम् //
text_mt: the supreme, secret Jñānatīrtha, the excellent sacred bathing place Vārāha, / the greatly holy Yamatīrtha, and the auspicious sacred bathing place Saṃvartaka;

sanskrit_iast:
agnitīrthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kalaśeśvaramuttamam /
nāgatīrthaṃ somatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अग्नितीर्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कलशेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
नागतीर्थं सोमतीर्थं सूर्यतीर्थं तथैव च //
text_mt: Agnitīrtha, O best of the twice-born, the excellent Kalaśeśvara, / Nāgatīrtha, Somatīrtha, and likewise Sūryatīrtha;

sanskrit_iast:
parvatākhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ maṇikarṇamanuttamam /
ghaṭotkacaṃ tīrthavaraṃ śrītīrthaṃ ca pitāmaham //
meaning:
पर्वताख्यं महागुह्यं मणिकर्णमनुत्तमम् /
घटोत्कचं तीर्थवरं श्रीतीर्थं च पितामहम् //
text_mt: the greatly secret one named Parvata, the unsurpassed Maṇikarṇa, / the superior sacred bathing place Ghaṭotkaca, Śrītīrtha, and Pitāmaha;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātīrthaṃ tu deveśaṃ yayātestīrthamuttamam /
kāpilaṃ caiva someśaṃ brahmatīrthamanuttamam //
meaning:
गङ्गातीर्थं तु देवेशं ययातेस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् /
कापिलं चैव सोमेशं ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Gaṅgātīrtha, Deveśa, the excellent sacred bathing place of Yayāti, / Kāpila, Someśa, and the unsurpassed Brahmatīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
atra liṅgaṃ purānīya brahmā snātuṃ yadā gataḥ /
tadānīṃ sthāpayāmāsa viṣṇustalliṅgamaiśvaram //
meaning:
अत्र लिङ्गं पुरानीय ब्रह्मा स्नातुं यदा गतः /
तदानीं स्थापयामास विष्णुस्तल्लिङ्गमैश्वरम् //
text_mt: Formerly, having brought a liṅga here, when Brahmā went to bathe, / at that time Viṣṇu installed that sovereign liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ snātvā samāgatya brahmā provāca taṃ harim /
mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmāt sthāpitavānasi //
meaning:
ततः स्नात्वा समागत्य ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तं हरिम् /
मयानीतमिदं लिङ्गं कस्मात् स्थापितवानसि //
text_mt: Then Brahmā, having bathed and returned, said to that Hari: / “Why have you installed this liṅga brought by me?”

sanskrit_iast:
tamāha viṣṇustvatto 'pi rudre bhaktirdṛḍhā mama /
tasmāt pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃnāmnā tava bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तमाह विष्णुस्त्वत्तो ऽपि रुद्रे भक्तिर्दृढा मम /
तस्मात् प्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गंनाम्ना तव भविष्यति //
text_mt: Viṣṇu said to him: “My devotion to Rudra is firmer even than yours; / therefore the installed liṅga shall be named after you.”

sanskrit_iast:
bhūteśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasamudbhavam /
gandharvatīrthaṃ paramaṃ vāhneyaṃ tīrthamuttamam //
meaning:
भूतेश्वरं तथा तीर्थं तीर्थं धर्मसमुद्भवम् /
गन्धर्वतीर्थं परमं वाह्नेयं तीर्थमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Likewise the sacred bathing place Bhūteśvara, the sacred bathing place Dharmasamudbhava, / the supreme Gandharvatīrtha, and the excellent sacred bathing place Vāhneya;

sanskrit_iast:
daurvāsikaṃ vyomatīrthaṃ candratīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ /
citrāṅgadeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vidyādhareśvaram //
meaning:
दौर्वासिकं व्योमतीर्थं चन्द्रतीर्थं द्विजोत्तमाः /
चित्राङ्गदेश्वरं पुण्यं पुण्यं विद्याधरेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Daurvāsika, Vyomatīrtha, and Candratīrtha, O best of the twice-born, / the holy Citrāṅgadeśvara, and the holy Vidyādhareśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
kedāratīrthamugrākhyaṃ kālañjaramanuttamam /
sārasvataṃ prabhāsaṃ ca bhadrakarṇaṃ hradaṃ śubham //
meaning:
केदारतीर्थमुग्राख्यं कालञ्जरमनुत्तमम् /
सारस्वतं प्रभासं च भद्रकर्णं ह्रदं शुभम् //
text_mt: the sacred bathing place Kedāra, the one named Ugra, the unsurpassed Kālañjara, / Sārasvata, Prabhāsa, and the auspicious Bhadrakarṇa pool;

sanskrit_iast:
laukikākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam /
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ goprekṣyaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam //
meaning:
लौकिकाख्यं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैव वृषध्वजम् /
हिरण्यगर्भं गोप्रेक्ष्यं तीर्थं चैव वृषध्वजम् //
text_mt: the great sacred bathing place named Laukika, and the sacred bathing place Vṛṣadhvaja, / Hiraṇyagarbha, Goprekṣya, and the sacred bathing place Vṛṣadhvaja;

sanskrit_iast:
upaśāntaṃ śivaṃ caiva vyāghreśvaramanuttamam /
trilocanaṃ mahātīrthaṃ lolārkaṃ cottarāhvayam //
meaning:
उपशान्तं शिवं चैव व्याघ्रेश्वरमनुत्तमम् /
त्रिलोचनं महातीर्थं लोलार्कं चोत्तराह्वयम् //
text_mt: Upaśānta, Śiva, and the unsurpassed Vyāghreśvara, / the great sacred bathing place Trilocana, and Lolārka, also called Uttara;

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam /
śukreśvaraṃ mahāpuṇyamānandapuramuttamam //
meaning:
कपालमोचनं तीर्थं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् /
शुक्रेश्वरं महापुण्यमानन्दपुरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: the sacred bathing place Kapālamocana, which destroys [the sin of] brahmin-slaughter, / the greatly holy Śukreśvara, and the excellent Ānandapura.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīni tīrthāni prādhānyāt kathitāni tu /
na śakyaṃ vistarād vaktuṃ tīrthasaṃkhyā dvijāttamāḥ //
meaning:
एवमादीनि तीर्थानि प्राधान्यात् कथितानि तु /
न शक्यं विस्तराद् वक्तुं तीर्थसंख्या द्विजात्तमाः //
text_mt: These and other sacred bathing places have been spoken of according to their prominence; / it is not possible to state the full number of sacred bathing places in detail, O best of twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvābhyarcya pinākinam /
upoṣya tatra tatrāsau pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
तेषु सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पिनाकिनम् /
उपोष्य तत्र तत्रासौ पाराशर्यो महामुनिः //
text_mt: Having bathed in all those sacred bathing places, worshipped the wielder of the Pināka, / and fasted in each of those places, that great sage, the son of Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayitvā pitṝn devān kṛtvā piṇḍapridānakam /
jagāma punarevāpi yatra viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् देवान् कृत्वा पिण्डप्रिदानकम् /
जगाम पुनरेवापि यत्र विश्वेश्वरः शिवः //
text_mt: having offered libations to the ancestors and gods, and made offerings of rice-balls, / went back once again to where Viśveśvara Śiva is.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvābhyarcya paraṃ liṅgaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ /
uvāca śiṣyān dharmātmā svān deśān gantumarhathā //
meaning:
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य परं लिङ्गं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः /
उवाच शिष्यान् धर्मात्मा स्वान् देशान् गन्तुमर्हथा //
text_mt: Having bathed and worshipped the supreme liṅga together with his disciples, / the righteous-minded great sage said to his disciples: “You should go to your own lands.”

sanskrit_iast:
te praṇamya mahātmānaṃ jagmuḥ pailādayo dvijāḥ /
vāsaṃ ca tatra niyato vārāṇasyāṃ cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं जग्मुः पैलादयो द्विजाः /
वासं च तत्र नियतो वाराणस्यां चकार सः //
text_mt: Having bowed to the great-souled one, those twice-born led by Paila departed, / and he made his fixed abode right there in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
śānto dāntastriṣavaṇaṃsnātvābhyarcya pinākinam /
bhaikṣāhāro viśuddhātmā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तो दान्तस्त्रिषवणंस्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पिनाकिनम् /
भैक्षाहारो विशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः //
text_mt:
Calm, self-controlled, bathing at the three junctures of the day, worshipping the wielder of the Pināka,
living on alms, pure in mind, devoted to celibacy,

sanskrit_iast:
kadācid vasatā tatra vyāsenāmitatejasā /
bhramamāṇena bhikṣā tu naiva labdhā dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
कदाचिद् वसता तत्र व्यासेनामिततेजसा /
भ्रममाणेन भिक्षा तु नैव लब्धा द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
once, as Vyāsa of immeasurable splendour was living there,
wandering about, O best of the twice-born, he obtained no alms at all.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ krodhāvṛtatanurnarāṇāmiha vāsinām /
vighnaṃ sṛjāmi sarveṣāṃ yena siddhirvihīyate //
meaning:
ततः क्रोधावृततनुर्नराणामिह वासिनाम् /
विघ्नं सृजामि सर्वेषां येन सिद्धिर्विहीयते //
text_mt:
Then, his body overcome by anger, [he thought]: "For the men dwelling here,
I shall create an obstacle for them all, whereby their spiritual attainment is ruined."

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣaṇe sā mahādevī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī /
prādurāsīt svayaṃ prītyā veṣaṃ kṛtvā tu mānuṣam //
meaning:
तत्क्षणे सा महादेवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी /
प्रादुरासीत् स्वयं प्रीत्या वेषं कृत्वा तु मानुषम् //
text_mt:
At that instant the Great Goddess herself, making up half the body of Śaṅkara,
appeared out of affection, assuming a human form.

sanskrit_iast:
bho bho vyāsa mahābuddhe śaptavyā bhavatā na hi /
gṛhāṇa bhikṣāṃ mattastvamuktvaivaṃ pradadau śivā //
meaning:
भो भो व्यास महाबुद्धे शप्तव्या भवता न हि /
गृहाण भिक्षां मत्तस्त्वमुक्त्वैवं प्रददौ शिवा //
text_mt:
"O Vyāsa of great intellect, you must not curse!
Accept alms from me." Having spoken thus, Śivā gave [them to him].

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ca mahādevī krodhanastvaṃ bhavān yataḥ /
iha kṣetre na vastavyaṃ kṛtaghno 'si tvayā sadā //
meaning:
उवाच च महादेवी क्रोधनस्त्वं भवान् यतः /
इह क्षेत्रे न वस्तव्यं कृतघ्नो ऽसि त्वया सदा //
text_mt:
And the Great Goddess said: "Since you are wrathful,
you must not dwell in this sacred field. You have ever been ungrateful."

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavān dhyānājjñātvā parāṃ śivām /
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā stutvā ca pravaraiḥ stavaiḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तः स भगवान् ध्यानाज्ज्ञात्वा परां शिवाम् /
उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा स्तुत्वा च प्रवरैः स्तवैः //
text_mt:
Spoken to thus, the blessed one, knowing through meditation that she was the supreme Śivā,
bowed down, praised her with the finest hymns of praise, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ praveśaṃ dehi śāṅkari /
evamastvityanujñāya devī cāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यामथाष्टम्यां प्रवेशं देहि शाङ्करि /
एवमस्त्वित्यनुज्ञाय देवी चान्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
"Grant me entry on the fourteenth day and on the eighth, O Śāṅkarī!"
Consenting with "May it be so," the goddess disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa bhagavān vyāso mahāyogī purātanaḥ /
jñātvā kṣetraguṇān sarvān sthitastasyātha pārśvataḥ //
meaning:
एवं स भगवान् व्यासो महायोगी पुरातनः /
ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रगुणान् सर्वान् स्थितस्तस्याथ पार्श्वतः //
text_mt:
Thus the blessed Vyāsa, the ancient great yogin,
knowing all the virtues of the sacred field, stayed on its perimeter.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vyāsaṃ sthitaṃ jñātvā kṣetraṃ sevanti paṇḍitāḥ /
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ //
meaning:
एवं व्यासं स्थितं ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं सेवन्ति पण्डिताः /
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः //
text_mt:
Knowing that Vyāsa stays thus, wise men resort to the sacred field.
Therefore, with every effort, a man should dwell in Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
yaḥ paṭhedavimuktasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyādapi /
śrāvayed vā dvijān śāntān so 'piyātiparāṅgatim //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
यः पठेदविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं शृणुयादपि /
श्रावयेद् वा द्विजान् शान्तान् सो ऽपियातिपराङ्गतिम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Whoever reads the majesty of Avimukta, or even listens to it,
or recites it to calm twice-born men, he too goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye rātrāvahani vā dvijāḥ /
nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu devatāyataneṣu ca //
meaning:
श्राद्धे वा दैविके कार्ये रात्रावहनि वा द्विजाः /
नदीनां चैव तीरेषु देवतायतनेषु च //
text_mt:
At an ancestral offering rite or in a ritual for the gods, by night or by day, O twice-born ones,
and on the banks of rivers and in shrines of deities,

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ /
japedīśaṃ namaskṛtya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayastriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स्नात्वा समाहितमना दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जितः /
जपेदीशं नमस्कृत्य स याति परमां गतिम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रयस्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
having bathed with concentrated mind, free from deceit and envy,
whoever recites [it], bowing to the Lord, attains the supreme state.

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter in the former section of the holy Kūrma Purāṇa, in the compilation of six thousand verses.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
māhātmyamavimuktasya yathāvat tadudīritam /
idānīṃ tu prayāgasya māhātmyaṃ brūhi suvrata //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
माहात्म्यमविमुक्तस्य यथावत् तदुदीरितम् /
इदानीं तु प्रयागस्य माहात्म्यं ब्रूहि सुव्रत //
text_mt:
The sages said:
The majesty of Avimukta has been proclaimed in full.
Now tell us, O one of good vows, the majesty of Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni tīrthāni tatraiva viśrutāni mahānti vai /
idānīṃ kathayāsmākaṃ sūta sarvārthavid bhavān //
meaning:
यानि तीर्थानि तत्रैव विश्रुतानि महान्ति वै /
इदानीं कथयास्माकं सूत सर्वार्थविद् भवान् //
text_mt:
Whatever great and famed sacred bathing places exist right there,
tell those to us now, O Sūta, for you know all subjects.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve vistareṇa bravīmi vaḥ /
prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ yatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे विस्तरेण ब्रवीमि वः /
प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं यत्र देवः पितामहः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Listen, all you sages; I shall tell you in detail
the majesty of Prayāga, where the divine Grandfather dwells.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyena kathitaṃ kaunteyāya mahātmane /
yathā yudhiṣṭhirāyaitat tadvakṣye bhavatāmaham //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयेन कथितं कौन्तेयाय महात्मने /
यथा युधिष्ठिरायैतत् तद्वक्ष्ये भवतामहम् //
text_mt:
As it was told by Mārkaṇḍeya to the magnanimous son of Kuntī,
to Yudhiṣṭhira, so shall I tell it to you.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatya kauravāna sarvān bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pārthivaḥ /
śokena mahātāviṣṭā mumoha sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ //
meaning:
निहत्य कौरवान सर्वान् भ्रातृभिः सह पार्थिवः /
शोकेन महाताविष्टा मुमोह स युधिष्ठिरः //
text_mt:
Having slain all the Kauravas along with his brothers, the king,
overcome with great sorrow, that Yudhiṣṭhira fell into despair.

sanskrit_iast:
acireṇātha kālena mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ /
saṃprāpto hāstinapuraṃ rājadvāre sa tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
अचिरेणाथ कालेन मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः /
संप्राप्तो हास्तिनपुरं राजद्वारे स तिष्ठति //
text_mt:
Then, before long, Mārkaṇḍeya of great ascetic heat
arrived at Hāstinapura and stood at the royal gate.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapālo 'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājñaḥ kathitavān drutam /
mārkaṇḍeyo draṣṭumicchaṃstvāmāste dvāryasau muniḥ //
meaning:
द्वारपालो ऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा राज्ञः कथितवान् द्रुतम् /
मार्कण्डेयो द्रष्टुमिच्छंस्त्वामास्ते द्वार्यसौ मुनिः //
text_mt:
Seeing him, the doorkeeper promptly reported to the king:
"That sage Mārkaṇḍeya stands at the door, desiring to see you."

sanskrit_iast:
tvarito dharmaputrastu dvārametyāha tatparam /
svāgataṃ te mahāprājña svāgataṃ te mahāmune //
meaning:
त्वरितो धर्मपुत्रस्तु द्वारमेत्याह तत्परम् /
स्वागतं ते महाप्राज्ञ स्वागतं ते महामुने //
text_mt:
Swiftly going to the gate, the son of Dharma then addressed him:
"Welcome to you, O very wise one! Welcome to you, O great sage!

sanskrit_iast:
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me tāritaṃ kulam /
adya me pitarastuṣṭāstvayi tuṣṭe mahāmune //
meaning:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे तारितं कुलम् /
अद्य मे पितरस्तुष्टास्त्वयि तुष्टे महामुने //
text_mt:
Today my birth has borne fruit; today my family is delivered;
today my ancestors are pleased, when you are pleased, O great sage!"

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsanamupasthāpya pādaśaucārcanādibhiḥ /
yudhiṣṭhiro mahātmeti pūjayāmāsa taṃ munim //
meaning:
सिंहासनमुपस्थाप्य पादशौचार्चनादिभिः /
युधिष्ठिरो महात्मेति पूजयामास तं मुनिम् //
text_mt:
Having offered a lion-throne, with washing of the feet, worship, and the like,
the magnanimous Yudhiṣṭhira honoured that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyastatastuṣṭaḥ provāca sa yudhiṣṭhiram /
kimarthaṃ muhyase vidvan sarvaṃ jñātvāhamāgataḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयस्ततस्तुष्टः प्रोवाच स युधिष्ठिरम् /
किमर्थं मुह्यसे विद्वन् सर्वं ज्ञात्वाहमागतः //
text_mt:
Then Mārkaṇḍeya, being pleased, said to Yudhiṣṭhira:
"Why are you bewildered, wise one? Knowing everything, I have come."

sanskrit_iast:
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā praṇamyāha mahāmunim /
kathaya tvaṃ samāsena yena mucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ //
meaning:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्रणम्याह महामुनिम् /
कथय त्वं समासेन येन मुच्येत किल्बिषैः //
text_mt:
Then King Yudhiṣṭhira, bowing, said to the great sage:
"Tell me in brief that whereby one may be freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatā vahavo yuddhe puṃso niraparādhinaḥ /
asmābhiḥ kauravaiḥ sārdhaṃ prasaṅgānmunipuṅgava //
meaning:
निहता वहवो युद्धे पुंसो निरपराधिनः /
अस्माभिः कौरवैः सार्धं प्रसङ्गान्मुनिपुङ्गव //
text_mt:
Many innocent men were slain in battle
by us together with the Kauravas as a consequence [of the conflict], O eminent sage.

sanskrit_iast:
yena hiṃsāsamudbhūtājjanmāntarakṛtādapi /
mucyate pātakādasmāt tad bhavān vaktumarhati //
meaning:
येन हिंसासमुद्भूताज्जन्मान्तरकृतादपि /
मुच्यते पातकादस्मात् तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति //
text_mt:
That whereby one may be freed from this sin born of violence,
even if committed in another birth, you ought to tell that."

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārat /
prayāgagamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
शृणु राजन् महाभाग यन्मां पृच्छसि भारत् /
प्रयागगमनं श्रेष्ठं नराणां पापनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Listen, O fortunate king, to what you ask of me, O descendant of Bharata:
journeying to Prayāga is the best, destroying the sins of men.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devo mahādevo rudro viśvāmareśvaraḥ /
samāste bhagavān brahmā svayaṃbhūrapi daivadaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्रो विश्वामरेश्वरः /
समास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरपि दैवदैः //
text_mt:
There the god Mahādeva, Rudra, the lord of all immortals, dwells,
and the blessed Brahmā, the self-born one, also [dwells there] with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi prayāgagamane phalam /
mṛtānāṃ kā gatistatra snātānāmapi kiṃ phalam //
meaning:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच
भगवञ्च्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रयागगमने फलम् /
मृतानां का गतिस्तत्र स्नातानामपि किं फलम् //
text_mt:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O blessed one, I wish to hear the fruit of journeying to Prayāga.
What is the destination of those who die there, and what is the fruit for those who bathe?

sanskrit_iast:
ye vasanti prayāge tu brūhi teṣāṃ tu kiṃ phalam /
bhavatā viditaṃ hyetat tanme brūhi namo 'stu te //
meaning:
ये वसन्ति प्रयागे तु ब्रूहि तेषां तु किं फलम् /
भवता विदितं ह्येतत् तन्मे ब्रूहि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
For those who dwell in Prayāga, tell what is their fruit?
For this is known to you; tell it to me, homage be to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa yā ceṣṭā yacca tatphalam /
purā maharṣibhiḥ samyak kathyamānaṃ mayā śrutam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
कथयिष्यामि ते वत्स या चेष्टा यच्च तत्फलम् /
पुरा महर्षिभिः सम्यक् कथ्यमानं मया श्रुतम् //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
"I shall tell you, my child, what is the practice and what is its fruit,
as it was properly recounted of old by the great sages and heard by me.

sanskrit_iast:
etat prajāpatikṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
atra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ //
meaning:
एतत् प्रजापतिक्षेत्रं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् /
अत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः //
text_mt:
This sacred field of Prajāpati is renowned in the three worlds;
having bathed here, they go to heaven; those who die [here] do not return to rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra brahmādayo devā rakṣāṃ kurvanti saṃgatāḥ /
bahūnyanyāni tīrthāni sarvapāpāpahāni tu //
meaning:
तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा रक्षां कुर्वन्ति संगताः /
बहून्यन्यानि तीर्थानि सर्वपापापहानि तु //
text_mt:
There Brahmā and the other gods assembled maintain protection.
Moreover, there are many other sacred bathing places that take away all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kathituṃ neha śaknomi bahuvarṣaśatairapi /
saṃkṣepeṇa pravakṣyāmi prayāgasyeha kīrtanam //
meaning:
कथितुं नेह शक्नोमि बहुवर्षशतैरपि /
संक्षेपेण प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रयागस्येह कीर्तनम् //
text_mt:
I cannot tell of them here even in many hundreds of years;
I shall proclaim in brief the praise of Prayāga here.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭirdhanuḥ sahastrāṇi yāni rakṣanti jāhnavīm /
yamunāṃ rakṣati sadā savitā saptavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
षष्टिर्धनुः सहस्त्राणि यानि रक्षन्ति जाह्नवीम् /
यमुनां रक्षति सदा सविता सप्तवाहनः //
text_mt:
Sixty thousand bow-lengths protect the Jāhnavī;
Savitar, who has seven steeds, always protects the Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāge tu viśeṣeṇa svayaṃ vasati vāsavaḥ /
maṇḍalaṃ rakṣati hariḥ sarvadevaiśca sammitam //
meaning:
प्रयागे तु विशेषेण स्वयं वसति वासवः /
मण्डलं रक्षति हरिः सर्वदेवैश्च सम्मितम् //
text_mt:
At Prayāga, however, Vāsava himself dwells especially;
Hari protects the circle, which is measured with all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nyagrodhaṃ rakṣate nityaṃ śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ /
sthānaṃ rakṣanti vai devāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham //
meaning:
न्यग्रोधं रक्षते नित्यं शूलपाणिर्महेश्वरः /
स्थानं रक्षन्ति वै देवाः सर्वपापहरं शुभम् //
text_mt:
Maheśvara, holding the trident in hand, constantly protects the banyan tree;
the gods indeed protect the auspicious place that removes all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
svakarmaṇāvṛto loko naiva gacchati tatpadam /
svalpaṃ svalpataraṃ pāpaṃ yadā tasya narādhipa /
prayāgaṃ smaramāṇasya sarvamāyāti saṃkṣayam //
meaning:
स्वकर्मणावृतो लोको नैव गच्छति तत्पदम् /
स्वल्पं स्वल्पतरं पापं यदा तस्य नराधिप /
प्रयागं स्मरमाणस्य सर्वमायाति संक्षयम् //
text_mt:
Veiled by his own actions, a person never reaches that station.
When his sin is slight, very slight indeed, O ruler of men,
all of it goes to destruction for one who remembers Prayāga.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāt tasya tīrthasya nāma saṃkīrtanādapi /
muttikālambhanād vāpi naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate //
meaning:
दर्शनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य नाम संकीर्तनादपि /
मुत्तिकालम्भनाद् वापि नरः पापात् प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
From the sight of that sacred bathing place, from the recitation of its name,
or even from the application of its clay, a man is freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca kuṇḍāni rājendra yeṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī /
prayāgaṃ viśataḥ puṃsaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
पञ्च कुण्डानि राजेन्द्र येषां मध्ये तु जाह्नवी /
प्रयागं विशतः पुंसः पापं नश्यति तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt:
There are five pools, O king of kings, in the midst of which is the Jāhnavī;
for a man entering Prayāga, sin is destroyed in that very instant.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu gaṅgāṃ yaḥ smarate naraḥ /
api duṣkṛtakarmāsau labhate paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
योजनानां सहस्त्रेषु गङ्गां यः स्मरते नरः /
अपि दुष्कृतकर्मासौ लभते परमां गतिम् //
text_mt:
The man who remembers the Gaṅgā across thousands of leagues,
even if he has performed evil actions, attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtanānmucyate pāpād dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṇi paśyati /
tathopaspṛśya rājendra svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
कीर्तनान्मुच्यते पापाद् दृष्ट्वा भद्राणि पश्यति /
तथोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
From praising [her] he is freed from sin; by seeing [her] he beholds auspicious things;
and by sipping her water, O lord of kings, he is honoured in the world of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhito yadi vā dīnaḥ krūddho vāpi bhavennaraḥ /
gaṅgāyamunamāsādya tyajet prāṇān prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
व्याधितो यदि वा दीनः क्रूद्धो वापि भवेन्नरः /
गङ्गायमुनमासाद्य त्यजेत् प्राणान् प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt:
Whether a man be diseased, afflicted, or angry,
reaching the Gaṅgā and Yamunā, he should cast off his life with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptakāñcanavarṇābhairvimānairbhānuvarṇibhiḥ /
īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
दीप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभैर्विमानैर्भानुवर्णिभिः /
ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान् वदन्ति मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt:
With aerial chariots possessing the brilliance of blazing gold, having the colour of the sun,
he obtains his desired wishes, so the foremost sages declare."

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaratnamayairdivyairnānādhvajasamākulaiḥ /
varāṅganāsamākīrṇairmodate śubhalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वरत्नमयैर्दिव्यैर्नानाध्वजसमाकुलैः /
वराङ्गनासमाकीर्णैर्मोदते शुभलक्षणः //
text_mt:
With [aerial cars] made of every jewel, celestial, crowded with varied banners,
filled with excellent women, he rejoices, possessing auspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
gītavāditranirghoṣaiḥ prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate /
yāvanna smarate janma tāpat svarge mahīyate //
meaning:
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैः प्रसुप्तः प्रतिबुध्यते /
यावन्न स्मरते जन्म तापत् स्वर्गे महीयते //
text_mt:
He is awakened from sleep by sounds of singing and instrumental music;
so long as he does not recall his [previous] birth, so long is he honored in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt svargāt paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇakarmā narottama /
hiraṇyaratnasaṃpūrṇe samṛddhe jāyate kule //
meaning:
तस्मात् स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टः क्षीणकर्मा नरोत्तम /
हिरण्यरत्नसंपूर्णे समृद्धे जायते कुले //
text_mt:
Fallen from that heaven when his karma is exhausted, O best of men,
he is born in a wealthy family filled with gold and jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva smarate tīrthaṃ smaraṇāt tatra gacchati /
deśastho yadi vāraṇye videśe yadi vā gṛhe //
meaning:
तदेव स्मरते तीर्थं स्मरणात् तत्र गच्छति /
देशस्थो यदि वारण्ये विदेशे यदि वा गृहे //
text_mt:
He remembers that very ford; by remembering, he goes there,
whether he is in his own country, in the forest, abroad, or in his home.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgaṃ smaramāṇastu yastu prāṇān parityajet /
brahmalokamavāpnoti vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
प्रयागं स्मरमाणस्तु यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति वदन्ति मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt:
Remembering Prayāga, whoever gives up his life
attains the world of Brahmā, say the foremost sages.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣā mahī yatra hiraṇmayī /
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāstatra loke sa gacchati //
meaning:
सर्वकामफला वृक्षा मही यत्र हिरण्मयी /
ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धास्तत्र लोके स गच्छति //
text_mt:
Where trees yield all desired fruits and the ground is golden,
where there are seers, sages, and accomplished beings—to that world he goes.

sanskrit_iast:
strīsahastrākule ramye mandākinyāstaṭe śubhe /
modate munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svakṛteneha karmaṇā //
meaning:
स्त्रीसहस्त्राकुले रम्ये मन्दाकिन्यास्तटे शुभे /
मोदते मुनिभिः सार्धं स्वकृतेनेह कर्मणा //
text_mt:
On the charming, auspicious bank of the Mandākinī, crowded with thousands of women,
he rejoices together with sages by virtue of his own deed done here.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhacāraṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyate divi daivataiḥ /
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambudvīpapatirbhavet //
meaning:
सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वैः पूज्यते दिवि दैवतैः /
ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो जम्बुद्वीपपतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt:
He is worshipped in heaven by Siddhas, Cāraṇas, Gandharvas, and deities;
then, falling from that heaven, he becomes the ruler of Jambūdvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śubhāni karmāṇi cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ /
guṇavān vittasaṃpanno bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ /
karmaṇā manasā vācā satyadharmapratiṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः शुभानि कर्माणि चिन्तयानः पुनः पुनः /
गुणवान् वित्तसंपन्नो भवतीह न संशयः /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सत्यधर्मप्रतिष्ठितः //
text_mt:
Thereupon, continually reflecting on auspicious deeds,
he undoubtedly becomes virtuous and wealthy in this world,
established in truth and righteousness in deed, mind, and speech.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu grāmaṃ pratīcchati /
suvarṇamatha muktāṃ vā tathaivānyān pratigrahān //
meaning:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यस्तु ग्रामं प्रतीच्छति /
सुवर्णमथ मुक्तां वा तथैवान्यान् प्रतिग्रहान् //
text_mt:
He who accepts a village between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā,
or gold, or pearls, or likewise other gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
svakārye pitṛkārye vā devatābhyarcane 'pi vā /
niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ yāvat tatphalamaśnute //
meaning:
स्वकार्ये पितृकार्ये वा देवताभ्यर्चने ऽपि वा /
निष्फलं तस्य तत् तीर्थं यावत् तत्फलमश्नुते //
text_mt:
for his own sake, for ancestral rites, or for the worship of deities—
fruitless for him is that holy ford as long as he enjoys that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
atastīrthe na gṛhṇīyāt puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca /
nimitteṣu ca sarveṣu apramatto dvijo bhavet //
meaning:
अतस्तीर्थे न गृह्णीयात् पुण्येष्वायतनेषु च /
निमित्तेषु च सर्वेषु अप्रमत्तो द्विजो भवेत् //
text_mt:
Therefore, let him not receive [gifts] at a holy ford, or in sacred shrines;
in all circumstances a twice-born should be vigilant.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāṃ pāṭalāvarṇāṃ yastu dhenuṃ prayacchati /
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ cailakaṇṭhāṃ payasvinīm //
meaning:
कपिलां पाटलावर्णां यस्तु धेनुं प्रयच्छति /
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरां चैलकण्ठां पयस्विनीम् //
text_mt:
Whoever gives away a brown, tawny-colored cow
with golden horns, silver hooves, a cloth around her neck, and yielding milk—

sanskrit_iast:
yāvad romāṇi tasyā vai santi gātreṣu sattama /
tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catustriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यावद् रोमाणि तस्या वै सन्ति गात्रेषु सत्तम /
तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुस्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
as many hairs as are on her body, O best of beings,
for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of Rudra.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa tīrthayātrāvidhikramam /
ārṣeṇa tu vidhānena yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
कथयिष्यामि ते वत्स तीर्थयात्राविधिक्रमम् /
आर्षेण तु विधानेन यथा दृष्टं यथा श्रुतम् //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I shall describe to you, dear one, the sequence of rules for pilgrimage to holy fords,
according to the traditional ordinance, as it has been seen and as it has been heard.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgatīrthayātrārtho yaḥ prayāti naraḥ kvacit /
balīvardaṃ samārūḍhaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam //
meaning:
प्रयागतीर्थयात्रार्थो यः प्रयाति नरः क्वचित् /
बलीवर्दं समारूढः शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम् //
text_mt:
Whoever sets out for a pilgrimage to the ford of Prayāga
mounted on an ox, hear also the consequence of that:

sanskrit_iast:
narake vasate ghore samāḥ kalpaśatāyutam /
tato nivartate ghoro gavāṃ krodho hi dāruṇaḥ /
salilaṃ ca na gṛhṇanti pitarastasya dehinaḥ //
meaning:
नरके वसते घोरे समाः कल्पशतायुतम् /
ततो निवर्तते घोरो गवां क्रोधो हि दारुणः /
सलिलं च न गृह्णन्ति पितरस्तस्य देहिनः //

sanskrit_iast:
yastu putrāṃstathā bālān snāpayet pāyayet tathā /
yathātmanā tathā sarvān dānaṃ vipreṣu dāpayet //
meaning:
यस्तु पुत्रांस्तथा बालान् स्नापयेत् पाययेत् तथा /
यथात्मना तथा सर्वान् दानं विप्रेषु दापयेत् //
text_mt:
Whoever bathes his sons and children, and gives them drink,
and causes gifts to be given to Brahmins for all of them just as for himself—

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryāllobhamohād vā gacched yānena yo naraḥ /
niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ tasamādyānaṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्याल्लोभमोहाद् वा गच्छेद् यानेन यो नरः /
निष्फलं तस्य तत् तीर्थं तसमाद्यानं विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
the man who goes by a vehicle out of opulence, greed, or delusion,
fruitless for him is that holy ford; therefore, let him avoid a vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu kanyāṃ prayacchati /
ārṣeṇa tu vivāhena yathā vibhavavistaram //
meaning:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यस्तु कन्यां प्रयच्छति /
आर्षेण तु विवाहेन यथा विभवविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
Whoever gives away a maiden between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā
according to the traditional rite of marriage, according to the extent of his wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
na sa paśyati taṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ tena karmaṇā /
uttarān sa kurūn gatvā modate kālamakṣayam //
meaning:
न स पश्यति तं घोरं नरकं तेन कर्मणा /
उत्तरान् स कुरून् गत्वा मोदते कालमक्षयम् //
text_mt:
he does not see that dreadful hell by virtue of that deed;
having gone to the Northern Kurus, he rejoices for an imperishable time.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭamūlaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet /
sarvalokānatikramya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
वटमूलं समाश्रित्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
सर्वलोकानतिक्रम्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt:
Whoever gives up his life resorting to the root of the banyan tree,
transcending all the worlds, he goes to the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra brahmādayo devā diśaśca sadigīśvarāḥ /
lokapālāśca siddhāśca pitaro lokasaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः /
लोकपालाश्च सिद्धाश्च पितरो लोकसंमताः //
text_mt:
There Brahmā and the other gods, the directions along with their guardians,
the world-protectors, the Siddhas, and the ancestors honored by the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumārapramukhāstathā brahmarṣayo 'pare /
nāgāḥ supārṇāḥ siddhāśca tathā nityaṃ samāsate /
hariśca bhagavānāste prajāpatipuraskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽपरे /
नागाः सुपार्णाः सिद्धाश्च तथा नित्यं समासते /
हरिश्च भगवानास्ते प्रजापतिपुरस्कृतः //

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtam /
prayāgaṃ rājaśārdūla triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam //
meaning:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये पृथिव्या जघनं स्मृतम् /
प्रयागं राजशार्दूल त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् //
text_mt:
The region between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā is declared to be the loins of the earth;
[it is] Prayāga, O tiger among kings, renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame saṃśitavrataḥ /
tulyaṃ phalavāpnoti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ //
meaning:
तत्राभिषेकं यः कुर्यात् संगमे संशितव्रतः /
तुल्यं फलवाप्नोति राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः //
text_mt:
Whoever performs ablution there at the confluence, firm in his vow,
attains a fruit equal to [that of] the royal consecration and the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
na mātṛvacanāt tāta na lokavacanādapi /
matirutkramaṇīyā te prayāgagāmanaṃ prati //
meaning:
न मातृवचनात् तात न लोकवचनादपि /
मतिरुत्क्रमणीया ते प्रयागगामनं प्रति //
text_mt:
Neither on the words of a mother, O dear one, nor on the words of people,
should your intention to go to Prayāga be set aside.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa tīrtha sahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathāpare /
teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva tīrthānāṃ kurunandana //
meaning:
दश तीर्थ सहस्त्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथापरे /
तेषां सान्निध्यमत्रैव तीर्थानां कुरुनन्दन //
text_mt:
Ten thousand holy fords, and sixty crores of others—
the presence of these fords is right here, O delight of the Kurus.

sanskrit_iast:
yā gatiryogayuktasya sattvasthasya manīṣiṇaḥ /
sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇān gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame //
meaning:
या गतिर्योगयुक्तस्य सत्त्वस्थस्य मनीषिणः /
सा गतिस्त्यजतः प्राणान् गङ्गायमुनसंगमे //
text_mt:
The state attained by the wise man devoted to yoga and abiding in purity
is the state attained by one who gives up his life at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
na te jīvanti loke 'smin yatra tatra yudhiṣṭhira /
ye prayāgaṃ na saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutam //
meaning:
न ते जीवन्ति लोके ऽस्मिन् यत्र तत्र युधिष्ठिर /
ये प्रयागं न संप्राप्तास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् //
text_mt:
They do not truly live in this world anywhere, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
who have not reached Prayāga, renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tat tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ paramaṃ padam /
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śaśāṅka iva rāhuṇā //
meaning:
एवं दृष्ट्वा तु तत् तीर्थं प्रयागं परमं पदम् /
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शशाङ्क इव राहुणा //
text_mt:
Having thus beheld that holy ford, Prayāga, the supreme abode,
one is freed from all sins like the moon from Rāhu.

sanskrit_iast:
kambalāśvatarau nāgau yamunādakṣiṇe taṭe /
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ यमुनादक्षिणे तटे /
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt:
The two serpent-deities Kambala and Aśvatara are on the southern bank of the Yamunā;
having bathed there and drunk [its water], one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā naraḥ sthānaṃ mahādevasya dhīmataḥ /
ātmānaṃ tārayet pūrvaṃ daśātītān daśāparān //
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा नरः स्थानं महादेवस्य धीमतः /
आत्मानं तारयेत् पूर्वं दशातीतान् दशापरान् //
text_mt:
A man having gone there to the abode of the wise Mahādeva
saves himself, ten ancestors before him, and ten descendants after him.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tu naraḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet /
svargalokamavāpnoti yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
कृत्वाभिषेकं तु नरः सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् /
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाहूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt:
Having performed ablution, a man obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice;
he attains the heavenly world until the dissolution of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapārśve tu gaṅgāyāstrailokyakhyātimān nṛpa /
avacaḥ sarvasāmudraḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ ca viśrutam //
meaning:
पूर्वपार्श्वे तु गङ्गायास्त्रैलोक्यख्यातिमान् नृप /
अवचः सर्वसामुद्रः प्रतिष्ठानं च विश्रुतम् //
text_mt:
On the eastern bank of the Gaṅgā, celebrated in the three worlds, O king,
is celebrated Pratiṣṭhāna, where the ocean is accessible to all.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī jitakrodhastrirātraṃ yadi tiṣṭhati /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधस्त्रिरात्रं यदि तिष्ठति /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt:
If a student of the Veda, having conquered anger, stays there for three nights
with his soul purified of all sins, he obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
uttareṇa pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhāgīrathyāstu savyataḥ /
haṃsaprapatanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam //
meaning:
उत्तरेण प्रतिष्ठानं भागीरथ्यास्तु सव्यतः /
हंसप्रपतनं नाम तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् //
text_mt:
North of Pratiṣṭhāna and on the left side of the Bhāgīrathī
is the holy ford named Haṃsaprapatana, renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhaphalaṃ tatra smṛtamātrāt tu jāyate /
yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvat svarge mahīyate //
meaning:
अश्वमेधफलं तत्र स्मृतमात्रात् तु जायते /
यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च तावत् स्वर्गे महीयते //
text_mt:
The fruit of a horse sacrifice arises there merely by being remembered;
as long as the moon and sun endure, so long is he honored in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśīpuline ramye vipule haṃsapāṇḍure /
parityajatiyaḥ prāṇān śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam //
meaning:
उर्वशीपुलिने रम्ये विपुले हंसपाण्डुरे /
परित्यजतियः प्राणान् शृणु तस्यापि यत् फलम् //
text_mt:
On the charming, broad sandbank of Urvaśī, white like a swan,
whoever gives up his life, hear also the fruit thereof:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca /
āste sa pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ svargaloke narādhipa //
meaning:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्त्राणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च /
आस्ते स पितृभिः सार्धं स्वर्गलोके नराधिप //
text_mt:
For sixty thousand and six hundred years,
he dwells together with his ancestors in the heavenly world, O lord of men.

sanskrit_iast:
athaṃ saṃdhyāvaṭe ramye brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ /
naraḥ śucirupāsīta brahmalokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अथं संध्यावटे रम्ये ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः /
नरः शुचिरुपासीत ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Now, at the charming evening banyan tree, chaste and with subdued senses,
let a man worship in purity; he shall attain the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭitīrthaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet /
koṭivarṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
कोटितीर्थं समाश्रित्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
कोटिवर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
Whoever gives up his life resorting to Koṭitīrtha
is glorified in the heavenly world for a thousand crores of years.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā bahutīrthatapovanā /
siddhakṣetraṃ hi tajjñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
यत्र गङ्गा महाभागा बहुतीर्थतपोवना /
सिद्धक्षेत्रं हि तज्ज्ञेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt:
Where the illustrious Gaṅgā has many holy fords and penance groves,
that should indeed be known as an accomplished field; here no doubt should be entertained.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣitau tārayate martyān nāgāṃstārayate 'pyadhaḥ /
divi tārayate devāṃstena tripathagā smṛtā //
meaning:
क्षितौ तारयते मर्त्यान् नागांस्तारयते ऽप्यधः /
दिवि तारयते देवांस्तेन त्रिपथगा स्मृता //
text_mt:
She delivers mortals on earth, and she delivers serpents below;
she delivers the gods in heaven; therefore she is known as the Three-Pathed River.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadasthīni gaṅgāyāṃ tiṣṭhanti puruṣasya tu /
tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
यावदस्थीनि गङ्गायां तिष्ठन्ति पुरुषस्य तु /
तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
As long as the bones of a man remain in the Gaṅgā,
for that many thousands of years he is honored in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nadīnāṃ paramā nadī /
mokṣadā sarvabhūtānāṃ mahāpātakināmapi //
meaning:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं नदीनां परमा नदी /
मोक्षदा सर्वभूतानां महापातकिनामपि //
text_mt: It is the supreme pilgrimage site among pilgrimage sites, the supreme river among rivers, / granting liberation to all beings, even to the greatest sinners.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā /
gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame //
meaning:
सर्वत्र सुलभा गङ्गा त्रिषु स्थानेषु दुर्लभा /
गङ्गाद्वारे प्रयागे च गङ्गासागरसंगमे //
text_mt: Everywhere the Gaṅgā is easy of access, [but] difficult of access in three places: / at Gaṅgādvāra, at Prayāga, and at the confluence of the Gaṅgā with the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāme bhūtānāṃ pāpopahatacetasām /
gatimanveṣamāṇānāṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā gatiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषामे भूतानां पापोपहतचेतसाम् /
गतिमन्वेषमाणानां नास्ति गङ्गासमा गतिः //
text_mt: For all beings whose minds are afflicted by sin / and who seek a refuge, there is no refuge equal to the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam /
māheśvarāt paribhraṣṭā sarvapāpaharā śubhā //
meaning:
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् /
माहेश्वरात् परिभ्रष्टा सर्वपापहरा शुभा //
text_mt: The purifier of purifiers and the auspiciousness of auspicious things, / fallen from the Great Lord, destroying all sins, she is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte yuge tu tīrthāni tretāyāṃ puṣkaraṃ param /
dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ kalau gaṅgāṃ viśiṣyate //
meaning:
कृते युगे तु तीर्थानि त्रेतायां पुष्करं परम् /
द्वापरे तु कुरुक्षेत्रं कलौ गङ्गां विशिष्यते //
text_mt: In the Kṛta Yuga [all] pilgrimage sites [are foremost], in the Tretā Puṣkara is supreme, / in the Dvāpara Kurukṣetra, [and] in the Kali the Gaṅgā is distinguished.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāmeva niṣeveta prayāge tu viśeṣataḥ /
nānyat kaliyugodbhūtaṃ malaṃ hantuṃ suduṣkṛtam //
meaning:
गङ्गामेव निषेवेत प्रयागे तु विशेषतः /
नान्यत् कलियुगोद्भूतं मलं हन्तुं सुदुष्कृतम् //
text_mt: One should resort only to the Gaṅgā, especially at Prayāga; / there is nothing else to destroy the very wicked stain born of the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmo vā sakāmo vā gaṅgāyāṃ yo vipadyate /
sa mṛto jāyate svarge narakaṃ ca na paśyati //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अकामो वा सकामो वा गङ्गायां यो विपद्यते /
स मृतो जायते स्वर्गे नरकं च न पश्यति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whether without desire or with desire, whoever meets his end in the Gaṅgā, / he is born in heaven upon death and never sees hell.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the auspicious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
ṣaṣṭistīrthasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭistīrthaśatāni ca /
māghamāse gamiṣyanti gaṅgāyamunasaṃgamam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
षष्टिस्तीर्थसहस्त्राणि षष्टिस्तीर्थशतानि च /
माघमासे गमिष्यन्ति गङ्गायमुनसंगमम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Sixty thousand pilgrimage sites and six hundred pilgrimage sites / will go in the month of Māgha to the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śatasahastrasya samyag dattasya yat phalam /
prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snātasya tat phalam //
meaning:
गवां शतसहस्त्रस्य सम्यग् दत्तस्य यत् फलम् /
प्रयागे माघमासे तु त्र्यहं स्नातस्य तत् फलम् //
text_mt: Whatever fruit is attained from giving a hundred thousand cows properly, / that same fruit belongs to one who bathes for three days at Prayāga in the month of Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhye kārṣāgniṃ yastu sādhayet /
ahīnāṅgo 'pyarogaśca pañcendriyasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये कार्षाग्निं यस्तु साधयेत् /
अहीनाङ्गो ऽप्यरोगश्च पञ्चेन्द्रियसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Whoever, between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā, practices the dried cow-dung fire ritual, / with unmaimed limbs, free from disease, and possessing his five senses,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvanti romakūpāṇi tasya gātreṣu mānada /
tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
यावन्ति रोमकूपाणि तस्य गात्रेषु मानद /
तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt: As many pores of the skin as there are on his body, O giver of honor, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambūdvīpapatirbhavet /
sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ //
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame lokaviśrute /
rāhugrasto yathā somo vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो जम्बूद्वीपपतिर्भवेत् /
स भुक्त्वा विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः //
जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् संगमे लोकविश्रुते /
राहुग्रस्तो यथा सोमो विमुक्तः सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt:
Then, having descended from heaven, he becomes the ruler of Jambūdvīpa; / having enjoyed extensive pleasures, he resorts to that pilgrimage site again.

Whoever enters the water at that world-renowned confluence, / freed from all sins like the moon seized by Rāhu,

sanskrit_iast:
somalokamavāpnoti somena saha modate /
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatāni ca //
meaning:
सोमलोकमवाप्नोति सोमेन सह मोदते /
षष्टिं वर्षसहस्त्राणि षष्टिं वर्षशतानि च //
text_mt: Attains the world of the Moon and rejoices with Soma / for sixty thousand years and sixty hundred years.

sanskrit_iast:
svargataḥ śakraloke 'sau munigandharvasevitaḥ /
tato bhraṣṭastu rājendra samṛddhe jāyate kule //
meaning:
स्वर्गतः शक्रलोके ऽसौ मुनिगन्धर्वसेवितः /
ततो भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र समृद्धे जायते कुले //
text_mt: Having gone to heaven, he [dwells] in Śakra's world, attended by sages and Gandharvas; / then, having fallen [from there], O king of kings, he is born in a prosperous family.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ śirāstvayodhārāmurdhvapādaḥ pibennaraḥ /
śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
अधः शिरास्त्वयोधारामुर्ध्वपादः पिबेन्नरः /
शतं वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt: If a man, head downward and feet upward, drinks water, / he is glorified in the heavenly world for a hundred thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād bhraṣṭastu rājendra agnihotrī bhavennaraḥ /
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद् भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र अग्निहोत्री भवेन्नरः /
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः //
text_mt: Falling from there, O king of kings, the man becomes a maintainer of the sacred fire; / having enjoyed extensive pleasures, he resorts to that pilgrimage site again.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svadehaṃ vikarted vā śakunibhyaḥ prayacchati /
vihagairupabhuktasya śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam //
meaning:
यः स्वदेहं विकर्तेद् वा शकुनिभ्यः प्रयच्छति /
विहगैरुपभुक्तस्य शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम् //
text_mt: Or whoever carves off his own body and offers it to birds— / hear the fruit of him whose [flesh] has been consumed by birds:

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi somaloke mahīyate /
tatastasmāt paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
शतं वर्षसहस्त्राणि सोमलोके महीयते /
ततस्तस्मात् परिभ्रष्टो राजा भवति धार्मिकः //
text_mt: He is glorified in the world of the Moon for a hundred thousand years; / then, falling from there, he becomes a righteous king,

sanskrit_iast:
guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vidvān supriyavākyavān /
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstatatīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ //
meaning:
गुणवान् रूपसंपन्नो विद्वान् सुप्रियवाक्यवान् /
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तततीर्थं भजते पुनः //
text_mt: Virtuous, endowed with beauty, learned, and speaking very pleasant words; / having enjoyed extensive pleasures, he resorts to that pilgrimage site again.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare yamunātīre prayāgasya tu dakṣiṇe /
ṛṇapramocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu paramaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
उत्तरे यमुनातीरे प्रयागस्य तु दक्षिणे /
ऋणप्रमोचनं नाम तीर्थं तु परमं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: On the northern bank of the Yamunā, but to the south of Prayāga, / the pilgrimage site named Ṛṇapramocana is traditionally regarded as supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarātroṣitaḥ snātvā ṛṇaistatra pramucyate /
sūryalokamavāpnoti anṛṇaśca sadā bhavet //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एकरात्रोषितः स्नात्वा ऋणैस्तत्र प्रमुच्यते /
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति अनृणश्च सदा भवेत् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having fasted for one night and bathed, he is released from debts there; / he attains the world of the Sun and becomes forever free of debt.

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the auspicious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍaya uvāca
tapanasya sutā devī triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā /
samāgatā mahābhāgā yamunā yatra nimnagā //
meaning:
मार्कण्डय उवाच
तपनस्य सुता देवी त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता /
समागता महाभागा यमुना यत्र निम्नगा //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The divine daughter of the Sun, renowned in the three worlds, / the fortunate river Yamunā, has arrived where [the Gaṅgā flows].

sanskrit_iast:
yenaiva niḥ sṛtā gaṅgā tenaiva yamunā gatā /
yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu kīrtanāt pāpanāśanī //
meaning:
येनैव निः सृता गङ्गा तेनैव यमुना गता /
योजनानां सहस्त्रेषु कीर्तनात् पापनाशनी //
text_mt: Along the very path the Gaṅgā came forth, along that path the Yamunā has gone; / she destroys sin through being glorified across thousands of leagues.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca yamunāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira /
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam /
prāṇāṃstyajati yastatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च यमुनायां युधिष्ठिर /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम् /
प्राणांस्त्यजति यस्तत्र स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Having bathed and drunk there in the Yamunā, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / completely freed from all sins, one purifies one's lineage up to the seventh generation; / whoever abandons his life-breaths there goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
agnitīrthamiti khyātaṃ yamunādakṣiṇa taṭe /
paścime dharmarājasya tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ smṛtam /
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ //
meaning:
अग्नितीर्थमिति ख्यातं यमुनादक्षिण तटे /
पश्चिमे धर्मराजस्य तीर्थं त्वनरकं स्मृतम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः //
text_mt: There is [the site] renowned as Agnitīrtha on the southern bank of the Yamunā; / to the west of Dharmarāja's [abode], the pilgrimage site is remembered as Anaraka; / having bathed there, they go to heaven; those who die [there] have no rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā saṃtarpayecchuciḥ /
dharmarājaṃ mahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा संतर्पयेच्छुचिः /
धर्मराजं महापापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Having bathed on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, pure, one should offer libations / to Dharmarāja; he is freed from great sins, there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa tīrthasahastrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyastathāparāḥ /
prayāge saṃsthitāni syurevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
दश तीर्थसहस्त्राणि त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तथापराः /
प्रयागे संस्थितानि स्युरेवमाहुर्मनीषिणः //
text_mt: Ten thousand pilgrimage sites and thirty crores more / are situated at Prayāga; so say the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
tistraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt /
divi bhūmyantarikṣe ca tatsarvaṃ jāhnavī smṛtā //
meaning:
तिस्त्रः कोट्योर्ऽधकोटी च तीर्थानां वायुरब्रवीत् /
दिवि भूम्यन्तरिक्षे च तत्सर्वं जाह्नवी स्मृता //
text_mt: Vāyu spoke of three and a half crores of pilgrimage sites / in heaven, on earth, and in the mid-region; all that is traditionally known as the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā sa deśastat tapovanam /
siddhikṣetraṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam //
meaning:
यत्र गङ्गा महाभागा स देशस्तत् तपोवनम् /
सिद्धिक्षेत्रं तु तज्ज्ञेयं गङ्गातीरसमाश्रितम् //
text_mt: Where the illustrious Gaṅgā is, that region is an ascetic grove; / that which is situated on the bank of the Gaṅgā should be known as a realm of attainment.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra devo mahādevo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ /
āste vaṭeśvaro nityaṃ tat tīrthaṃ tat tapovanam //
meaning:
यत्र देवो महादेवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः /
आस्ते वटेश्वरो नित्यं तत् तीर्थं तत् तपोवनम् //
text_mt: Where the god Mahādeva, the Great Lord, resides eternally / as Vaṭeśvara along with the goddess, that is a pilgrimage site, that is an ascetic grove.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ satyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasya ca /
suhṛdāṃ ca japet karṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya tu //
meaning:
इदं सत्यं द्विजातीनां साधूनामात्मजस्य च /
सुहृदां च जपेत् कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य तु //
text_mt: One should whisper this truth into the ear of twice-born people, of virtuous men, of one's own son, / of friends, and of an obedient disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ medhyamidaṃ sukham /
idaṃ puṇyamidaṃ ramyaṃ pāvanaṃ dharmyamuttamam //
meaning:
इदं धन्यमिदं स्वर्ग्यमिदं मेध्यमिदं सुखम् /
इदं पुण्यमिदं रम्यं पावनं धर्म्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: This brings prosperity, this leads to heaven, this is pure, this brings happiness, / this is meritorious, this is delightful, purifying, lawful, and supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣoṇāmidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam /
atrādhītya dvijo 'dhyāyaṃ nirmalatvamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
महर्षोणामिदं गुह्यं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम् /
अत्राधीत्य द्विजो ऽध्यायं निर्मलत्वमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: This is a secret of the great sages, releasing from all sins; / having recited this chapter here, a twice-born person attains purity.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā śuciḥ /
jātismaritvaṃ labhate nākapṛṣṭhe ca modate //
meaning:
यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं तीर्थं पुण्यं सदा शुचिः /
जातिस्मरित्वं लभते नाकपृष्ठे च मोदते //
text_mt: And whoever, always pure, constantly hears of this holy pilgrimage site, / attains memory of past lives and rejoices in the vault of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyante tānitīrthāni sadbhiḥ śiṣṭānudarśibhiḥ /
snāhi tīrtheṣu kauravya na ca vakramatirbhava //
meaning:
प्राप्यन्ते तानितीर्थानि सद्भिः शिष्टानुदर्शिभिः /
स्नाहि तीर्थेषु कौरव्य न च वक्रमतिर्भव //
text_mt: Those pilgrimage sites are reached by the virtuous who follow the cultured; / bathe in the pilgrimage sites, O descendant of Kuru, and do not be crooked-minded.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa bhagavān mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ /
tīrtāni kathayāmāsa pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānicit //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः /
तीर्तानि कथयामास पृथिव्यां यानि कानिचित् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the venerable Mārkaṇḍeya, the great sage, / told of whatever pilgrimage sites there are on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūsamudrādisaṃsthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ jyotiṣāṃ sthitam /
pṛṣṭaḥ provāca sakalamuktvātha prayayo muniḥ //
meaning:
भूसमुद्रादिसंस्थानं प्रमाणं ज्योतिषां स्थितम् /
पृष्टः प्रोवाच सकलमुक्त्वाथ प्रययो मुनिः //
text_mt: The layout of the earth, the oceans, and so forth, and the established measure of the heavenly luminaries; / questioned, the sage explained everything, and having spoken, he departed.

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ kalyamutthāya paṭhate 'tha śṛṇoti vā /
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ purvavibhāge saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
य इदं कल्यमुत्थाय पठते ऽथ शृणोति वा /
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पुर्वविभागे सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whoever, having risen at dawn, recites or hears this, / is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Rudra.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the auspicious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkūrma uvāca
evamuktāstu munayo naimiṣīyā mahāmatim /
papracchuruttaraṃ sūtaṃ pṛthivyādivinirṇayam //
meaning:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
एवमुक्तास्तु मुनयो नैमिषीया महामतिम् /
पप्रच्छुरुत्तरं सूतं पृथिव्यादिविनिर्णयम् //
text_mt: The auspicious Tortoise said: / Having been addressed thus, the dwellers of Naimiṣa forest asked / the wise Sūta for the subsequent determination of the earth and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathito bhavatā sūta sargaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ śubhaḥ /
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmastrilokasyāsya maṇḍalam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथितो भवता सूत सर्गः स्वयंभुवः शुभः /
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्रिलोकस्यास्य मण्डलम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / The auspicious primary creation of the Self-born has been told by you, O Sūta; / now we wish to hear of the orb of these three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvantaḥ sāgarā dvīpāstathā varṣāṇi parvatāḥ /
vanāni saritaḥ sūryagrahāṇāṃ sthitireva ca //
meaning:
यावन्तः सागरा द्वीपास्तथा वर्षाणि पर्वताः /
वनानि सरितः सूर्यग्रहाणां स्थितिरेव च //
text_mt: As many oceans, continents, and continental realms as there are, / the mountains, forests, rivers, and the positions of the sun and planets,

sanskrit_iast:
yadādhāramidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yeṣāṃ pṛthvī purā tviyam /
nṛpāṇāṃ tatsamāsena sūta vaktumihārhasi //
meaning:
यदाधारमिदं कृत्स्नं येषां पृथ्वी पुरा त्वियम् /
नृपाणां तत्समासेन सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि //
text_mt: Upon which all this is supported, and to which kings this earth belonged in ancient times; / O Sūta, you ought to tell this in brief here.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
vakṣye devādidevāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave /
namaskṛtvāprameyāya yaduktaṃ tena dhīmatā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
वक्ष्ये देवादिदेवाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे /
नमस्कृत्वाप्रमेयाय यदुक्तं तेन धीमता //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having bowed to the God of gods, Viṣṇu, the all-powerful, / the immeasurable, I will relate what was spoken by that wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvasya tu manoḥ prāgukto yaḥ priyavrataḥ /
putrastasyābhavan putrāḥ prajāpatisamā daśa //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवस्य तु मनोः प्रागुक्तो यः प्रियव्रतः /
पुत्रस्तस्याभवन् पुत्राः प्रजापतिसमा दश //
text_mt: Now, the son of Svāyambhuva Manu mentioned before was Priyavrata; / to him were born ten sons equal to the lords of creatures:

sanskrit_iast:
agnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca vapuṣmān dyutimāṃstathā /
medhā medhātithirhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca //
meaning:
अग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश्च वपुष्मान् द्युतिमांस्तथा /
मेधा मेधातिथिर्हव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च //
text_mt: Agnīdhra, Agnibāhu, Vapuṣmat, Dyutimat, / Medhā, Medhātithi, Havya, Savana, and Putra,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ /
dhārmiko dānanirataḥ sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ //
meaning:
ज्योतिष्मान् दशमस्तेषां महाबलपराक्रमः /
धार्मिको दाननिरतः सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः //
text_mt: and Jyotiṣmat was the tenth of them, endowed with great strength and prowess, / righteous, devoted to giving, and compassionate toward all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
medhāgnibāhuputrāstu trayo yogaparāyaṇāḥ /
jātismarā mahābhāgā na rājye dadhire matim //
meaning:
मेधाग्निबाहुपुत्रास्तु त्रयो योगपरायणाः /
जातिस्मरा महाभागा न राज्ये दधिरे मतिम् //
text_mt: The three sons Medhā, Agnibāhu, and Putra, however, devoted to yoga, / recollecting past births and most fortunate, set not their minds upon kingship.

sanskrit_iast:
priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcad vai saptadvīpeṣu sapta tān /
jambudvīpeśvaraṃ putramagnīdhramakaronnṛpaḥ //
meaning:
प्रियव्रतो ऽभ्यषिञ्चद् वै सप्तद्वीपेषु सप्त तान् /
जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरं पुत्रमग्नीध्रमकरोन्नृपः //
text_mt: Priyavrata consecrated those seven [others] across the seven continents; / the king made his son Agnīdhra lord of Jambūdvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣdvīpeśvaraścaiva tena medhātithiḥ kṛtaḥ /
śālmaleśaṃ vapuṣmantaṃ narendramabhiṣiktavān //
meaning:
प्लक्ष्द्वीपेश्वरश्चैव तेन मेधातिथिः कृतः /
शाल्मलेशं वपुष्मन्तं नरेन्द्रमभिषिक्तवान् //
text_mt: By him Medhātithi was made lord of Plakṣadvīpa, / and the king consecrated Vapuṣmat as lord of Śālmala.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣmantaṃ kuśadvīpe rājānaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ /
dyutimantaṃ ca rājānaṃ krauñcadvīpe samādiśat //
meaning:
ज्योतिष्मन्तं कुशद्वीपे राजानं कृतवान् प्रभुः /
द्युतिमन्तं च राजानं क्रौञ्चद्वीपे समादिशत् //
text_mt: The lord made Jyotiṣmat king in Kuśadvīpa, / and appointed Dyutimat as king in Krauñcadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
śākadvīpeśvaraṃ cāpi havyaṃ cakre priyavrataḥ /
puṣkarādhipatiṃ cakre savanaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
शाकद्वीपेश्वरं चापि हव्यं चक्रे प्रियव्रतः /
पुष्कराधिपतिं चक्रे सवनं च प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Priyavrata also made Havya lord of Śākadvīpa, / and the lord of creatures made Savana ruler of Puṣkara.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkare savanasyāpi mahāvītaḥ suto 'bhavat /
dhātikiścaiva dvāvetau putrau putravatāṃ varau //
meaning:
पुष्करे सवनस्यापि महावीतः सुतो ऽभवत् /
धातिकिश्चैव द्वावेतौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ //
text_mt: In Puṣkara, to Savana was born a son, Mahāvīta, / and Dhātiki—these two sons, the best among those with sons.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā mahātmanaḥ /
nāmnā tu dhātakeścāpi dhātakīkhaṇḍamucyate //
meaning:
महावीतं स्मृतं वर्षं तस्य नाम्ना महात्मनः /
नाम्ना तु धातकेश्चापि धातकीखण्डमुच्यते //
text_mt: The continental realm named Mahāvīta is recorded after that great-souled one, / and after the name of Dhātaki, it is called Dhātakīkhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
śākadvīpeśvarasyātha havyasyāpyabhavan sutāḥ /
jaladaśca kumāraśca sukumāro maṇīcakaḥ /
kusumottaro 'tha modākiḥ saptamaḥ syānmahādrumaḥ //
meaning:
शाकद्वीपेश्वरस्याथ हव्यस्याप्यभवन् सुताः /
जलदश्च कुमारश्च सुकुमारो मणीचकः /
कुसुमोत्तरो ऽथ मोदाकिः सप्तमः स्यान्महाद्रुमः //
text_mt: Then, to Havya, the lord of Śākadvīpa, were born sons: / Jalada, Kumāra, Sukumāra, Maṇīcaka, / Kusumottara, Modāki, and the seventh was Mahādruma.

sanskrit_iast:
jaladaṃ jaladasyātha varṣaṃ prathamamucyate /
kumārasya tu kaumāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ sukumārakam //
meaning:
जलदं जलदस्याथ वर्षं प्रथममुच्यते /
कुमारस्य तु कौमारं तृतीयं सुकुमारकम् //
text_mt: The first continental realm of Jalada is called Jalada; / that of Kumāra is Kaumāra, and the third is Sukumāra.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇīcakaṃ caturthaṃ tu pañcamaṃ kusumottaram /
modākaṃ ṣaṣṭhamityuktaṃ saptamaṃ tu mahādrumam //
meaning:
मणीचकं चतुर्थं तु पञ्चमं कुसुमोत्तरम् /
मोदाकं षष्ठमित्युक्तं सप्तमं तु महाद्रुमम् //
text_mt: The fourth is Maṇīcaka, the fifth Kusumottara, / the sixth is spoken of as Modāka, and the seventh as Mahādruma.

sanskrit_iast:
krauñcadvīpeśvarasyāpi sutā dyutimato 'bhavan /
kuśalaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dvitīyastu manoharaḥ //
meaning:
क्रौञ्चद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि सुता द्युतिमतो ऽभवन् /
कुशलः प्रथमस्तेषां द्वितीयस्तु मनोहरः //
text_mt: To Dyutimat, the lord of Krauñcadvīpa, sons were also born: / Kuśala was the first of them, and the second was Manohara;

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṇastṛtīyaḥ saṃproktaścaturthaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ /
andhakāro muniścaiva dundubhiścaiva saptamaḥ /
teṣāṃ svanāmabhirdeśāḥ krauñcadvīpāśrayāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
उष्णस्तृतीयः संप्रोक्तश्चतुर्थः प्रवरः स्मृतः /
अन्धकारो मुनिश्चैव दुन्दुभिश्चैव सप्तमः /
तेषां स्वनामभिर्देशाः क्रौञ्चद्वीपाश्रयाः शुभाः //
text_mt: Uṣṇa is declared the third, the fourth is recorded as Pravara, / Andhakāra, Muni, and Dundubhi as the seventh. / Their auspicious realms, situated in Krauñcadvīpa, are named after themselves.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣmataḥ kuśadvīpe saptaivāsan mahaujasaḥ /
udbhedo veṇumāṃścaivāśvaratho lambano dhṛtiḥ /
ṣaṣṭhaḥ prabhākāraścāpi saptamaḥ kapilaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ज्योतिष्मतः कुशद्वीपे सप्तैवासन् महौजसः /
उद्भेदो वेणुमांश्चैवाश्वरथो लम्बनो धृतिः /
षष्ठः प्रभाकारश्चापि सप्तमः कपिलः स्मृतः //
text_mt: To Jyotiṣmat in Kuśadvīpa there were seven sons of great splendour: / Udbheda, Veṇumat, Aśvaratha, Lambana, Dhṛti, / the sixth was Prabhākara, and the seventh is recorded as Kapila.

sanskrit_iast:
svanāmacihnitān yatra tathā varṣāṇi suvratāḥ /
jñeyāni sapta tānyeṣu dvīpeṣvevaṃ na yo mataḥ //
meaning:
स्वनामचिह्नितान् यत्र तथा वर्षाणि सुव्रताः /
ज्ञेयानि सप्त तान्येषु द्वीपेष्वेवं न यो मतः //
text_mt: O you of virtuous vows, the continental realms there are marked with their own names; / thus those seven are to be known in these continents […]

sanskrit_iast:
śālmaladvīpanāthasya sutāścāsan vapuṣmataḥ /
śvetaśca haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā /
vaidyutau mānasaścaiva saptamaḥ suprabho mataḥ //
meaning:
शाल्मलद्वीपनाथस्य सुताश्चासन् वपुष्मतः /
श्वेतश्च हरितश्चैव जीमूतो रोहितस्तथा /
वैद्युतौ मानसश्चैव सप्तमः सुप्रभो मतः //
text_mt: The sons of Vapuṣmat, the lord of Śālmaladvīpa, were: / Śveta, Harita, Jīmūta, Rohita, / Vaidyuta, Mānasa, and the seventh is considered Suprabha.

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣadvīpeśvarasyāpi sapta medhātitheḥ sutāḥ /
jyeṣṭhaḥ śāntabhayasteṣāṃ śiśiraśca sukhodayaḥ /
ānandaśca śivaścaiva kṣemakaśca dhruvastathā //
meaning:
प्लक्षद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि सप्त मेधातिथेः सुताः /
ज्येष्ठः शान्तभयस्तेषां शिशिरश्च सुखोदयः /
आनन्दश्च शिवश्चैव क्षेमकश्च ध्रुवस्तथा //
text_mt: Medhātithi, the lord of Plakṣadvīpa, also had seven sons: / the eldest of them was Śāntabhaya, Śiśira, Sukhodaya, / Ānanda, Śiva, Kṣemaka, and Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyaḥ śākadvīpāntikeṣu vai /
varṇāśramavibhāgena svadharmo muktaye dvijāḥ //
meaning:
प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयः शाकद्वीपान्तिकेषु वै /
वर्णाश्रमविभागेन स्वधर्मो मुक्तये द्विजाः //
text_mt: One's own duty according to the division of classes and life stages / in Plakṣadvīpa and the others up to Śākadvīpa is known to lead to liberation, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
jambudvīpeśvarasyāpi putrāstvāsan mahābalāḥ /
agnīdhrasya dvijaśreṣṭhāstannāmāni nibodhata //
meaning:
जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि पुत्रास्त्वासन् महाबलाः /
अग्नीध्रस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तन्नामानि निबोधत //
text_mt: The lord of Jambūdvīpa, Agnīdhra, also had sons of great might, / O best of the twice-born; listen to their names:

sanskrit_iast:
nābhiḥ kiṃpuruṣaścaiva tathā haririlāvṛtaḥ /
ramyo hiraṇvāṃśca kururbhadrāśvaḥ ketumāhalakaḥ //
meaning:
नाभिः किंपुरुषश्चैव तथा हरिरिलावृतः /
रम्यो हिरण्वांश्च कुरुर्भद्राश्वः केतुमाहलकः //
text_mt: Nābhi, Kiṃpuruṣa, Hari, Ilāvṛta, / Ramya, Hiraṇvat, Kuru, Bhadrāśva, and Ketumāla.

sanskrit_iast:
jambudvīpeśvaro rājā sa cāgnīdhro mahāmatiḥ /
vibhajya navadhā tebhyo yathānyāyaṃ dadau punaḥ //
meaning:
जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरो राजा स चाग्नीध्रो महामतिः /
विभज्य नवधा तेभ्यो यथान्यायं ददौ पुनः //
text_mt: Agnīdhra, the wise king and lord of Jambūdvīpa, / having divided it into nine parts, gave them to them according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhestu dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ himāhvaṃ pradadau punaḥ /
hemakūṭaṃ tato varṣaṃ dadau kiṃpuruṣāya tu //
meaning:
नाभेस्तु दक्षिणं वर्षं हिमाह्वं प्रददौ पुनः /
हेमकूटं ततो वर्षं ददौ किंपुरुषाय तु //
text_mt: To Nābhi he gave the southern continental realm named Hima; / then to Kiṃpuruṣa he gave the continental realm Hemakūṭa;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ naiṣadhaṃ varṣaṃ haraye dattavān pitā /
ilāvṛtāya pradadau merumadhyamilāvṛtam //
meaning:
तृतीयं नैषधं वर्षं हरये दत्तवान् पिता /
इलावृताय प्रददौ मेरुमध्यमिलावृतम् //
text_mt: the third, the Naiṣadha realm, the father gave to Hari; / to Ilāvṛta he gave Ilāvṛta, situated in the centre around Meru;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlācalāśritaṃ varṣaṃ ramyāya pradadau pitā /
śvetaṃ yaduttaraṃ varṣaṃ pitrā dattaṃ hiraṇvate //
meaning:
नीलाचलाश्रितं वर्षं रम्याय प्रददौ पिता /
श्वेतं यदुत्तरं वर्षं पित्रा दत्तं हिरण्वते //
text_mt: the continental realm adjacent to Mount Nīla the father gave to Ramya; / the northern realm, Śveta, was given by the father to Hiraṇvat;

sanskrit_iast:
yaduttaraṃ śṛṅgavato varṣaṃ tat kuruve dadau /
meroḥ pūrveṇa yad varṣaṃ bhadrāśvāya nyavedayat /
gandhamādanavarṣaṃ tu ketumālāya dattavān //
meaning:
यदुत्तरं शृङ्गवतो वर्षं तत् कुरुवे ददौ /
मेरोः पूर्वेण यद् वर्षं भद्राश्वाय न्यवेदयत् /
गन्धमादनवर्षं तु केतुमालाय दत्तवान् //
text_mt: the continental realm north of Śṛṅgavat he gave to Kuru; / the realm east of Meru he assigned to Bhadrāśva; / and the Gandhamādana realm he gave to Ketumāla.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣeṣveteṣu tān putrānabhiṣicya narādhipaḥ /
saṃsārakaṣṭatāṃ jñātvā tapastepe vanaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
वर्षेष्वेतेषु तान् पुत्रानभिषिच्य नराधिपः /
संसारकष्टतां ज्ञात्वा तपस्तेपे वनं गतः //
text_mt: Having consecrated those sons over these continental realms, the lord of men, / realising the misery of worldly existence, went to the forest and performed austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
himāhvayaṃ tu yasyaitannābherāsīnmahātmanaḥ /
tasyarṣabho 'bhavat putro marudevyāṃ mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
हिमाह्वयं तु यस्यैतन्नाभेरासीन्महात्मनः /
तस्यर्षभो ऽभवत् पुत्रो मरुदेव्यां महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: To that great-souled Nābhi, who possessed the realm named Hima, / was born of Merudevī a son of great splendour, Ṛṣabha.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣabhād bharato jajñe vīraḥ putraśatāgrajaḥ /
so 'bhiṣicyarṣabhaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ /
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā tapastepe yathāvidhi //
meaning:
ऋषभाद् भरतो जज्ञे वीरः पुत्रशताग्रजः /
सो ऽभिषिच्यर्षभः पुत्रं भरतं पृथिवीपतिः /
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गत्वा तपस्तेपे यथाविधि //
text_mt: From Ṛṣabha was born Bharata, a hero, the eldest of a hundred sons. / Having consecrated his son Bharata, that lord of the earth, Ṛṣabha, / entered the forest-dweller stage of life and performed austerities according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā karṣito 'tyarthaṃ kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ /
jñānayogarato bhūtvā mahāpāśupato 'bhavat //
meaning:
तपसा कर्षितो ऽत्यर्थं कृशो धमनिसंततः /
ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा महापाशुपतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Extremely emaciated by asceticism, thin, his veins standing out, / devoted to the yoga of knowledge, he became a great Pāśupata.

sanskrit_iast:
sumatirbharatasyābhūt putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ /
sumatestaijasastasmādindridyumno vyajāyata //
meaning:
सुमतिर्भरतस्याभूत् पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः /
सुमतेस्तैजसस्तस्मादिन्द्रिद्युम्नो व्यजायत //
text_mt: Sumati, supremely righteous, was the son of Bharata; / from Sumati was born Taijasa, [and] from him Indradyumna was born;

sanskrit_iast:
parameṣṭhī sutastasmāt pratīhārastadanvayaḥ /
pratiharteti vikhyāta utpannastasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
परमेष्ठी सुतस्तस्मात् प्रतीहारस्तदन्वयः /
प्रतिहर्तेति विख्यात उत्पन्नस्तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: Parameṣṭhin was his son, and in his line was Pratīhāra; / born as his son was the renowned Pratihartṛ;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavastasmādathodgīthaḥ prastāvastatsuto 'bhavat /
pṛthustatastato rakto raktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
भवस्तस्मादथोद्गीथः प्रस्तावस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
पृथुस्ततस्ततो रक्तो रक्तस्यापि गयः सुतः //
text_mt: from him came Bhava; then Udgītha; Prastāva was his son; / Pṛthu came from him, then Rakta; and Gaya was the son of Rakta;

sanskrit_iast:
naro gayasya tanayastasya putro virāḍabhūt /
tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata //
meaning:
नरो गयस्य तनयस्तस्य पुत्रो विराडभूत् /
तस्य पुत्रो महावीर्यो धीमांस्तस्मादजायत //
text_mt: Nara was the son of Gaya, and his son was Virāj; / his son was of great prowess, and from him was born Dhīmat;

sanskrit_iast:
mahānto 'pi tataścābhūd bhauvanastatsuto 'bhavat /
tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuśca virajo rajastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ //
meaning:
महान्तो ऽपि ततश्चाभूद् भौवनस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् /
त्वष्टा त्वष्टुश्च विरजो रजस्तस्याप्यभूत् सुतः //
text_mt: from him came Mahānta, and Bhauvana was his son; / Tvaṣṭṛ, and from Tvaṣṭṛ came Virajas, and Rajas was his son;

sanskrit_iast:
śatajid rajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ dvijāḥ /
teṣāṃ pradhāno balavān viśvajyotiriti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शतजिद् रजसस्तस्य जज्ञे पुत्रशतं द्विजाः /
तेषां प्रधानो बलवान् विश्वज्योतिरिति स्मृतः //
text_mt: to that Rajas, a hundred sons were born, led by Śatajit, O twice-born ones; / the chief among them was the mighty one recorded as Viśvajyotis.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kṣemakaṃ nāma pārthivam /
asūta putraṃ dharmajñaṃ mahābāhumarindamam //
meaning:
आराध्य देवं ब्रह्माणं क्षेमकं नाम पार्थिवम् /
असूत पुत्रं धर्मज्ञं महाबाहुमरिन्दमम् //
text_mt: Having propitiated the god Brahmā, he begot a king named Kṣemaka, / a righteous son, mighty-armed and subduer of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
ete purastād rājāno mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ /
eṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtaiśca bhukteyaṃ pṛthivī purā //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एते पुरस्ताद् राजानो महासत्त्वा महौजसः /
एषां वंशप्रसूतैश्च भुक्तेयं पृथिवी पुरा //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
These were the kings of old, endowed with great courage and immense splendour; / by those born in their lineages this earth was formerly enjoyed.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter in the former section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the auspicious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ /
trailokyasyāsya mānaṃ vo na śakyaṃ vistareṇa tu //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपेण द्विजोत्तमाः /
त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य मानं वो न शक्यं विस्तरेण तु //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Beyond this, I shall describe briefly to you, O best of the twice-born, / the measurement of this threefold world; it cannot be told in full.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarloko 'tha mahastataḥ /
janastapaśca satyaṃ ca lokāstvaṇḍodbhavā matāḥ //
meaning:
भूर्लोको ऽथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोको ऽथ महस्ततः /
जनस्तपश्च सत्यं च लोकास्त्वण्डोद्भवा मताः //
text_mt: Bhūrloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka, and then Mahas, / Janas, Tapas, and Satya are considered the worlds arisen from the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramasoryāvat kiraṇairavabhāsate /
tāvad bhūrloka ākhyātaḥ purāṇe dvijapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्यावत् किरणैरवभासते /
तावद् भूर्लोक आख्यातः पुराणे द्विजपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: As far as the sun and moon illumine with their rays, / so far is Bhūrloka declared in the Purāṇa, O eminent twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpramāṇo bhūrloko vistarāt parimaṇḍalāt /
bhuvarloko 'pi tāvānsyānmaṇḍalād bhāskarasya tu //
meaning:
यावत्प्रमाणो भूर्लोको विस्तरात् परिमण्डलात् /
भुवर्लोको ऽपि तावान्स्यान्मण्डलाद् भास्करस्य तु //
text_mt: To whatever extent Bhūrloka extends in width and circumference, / Bhuvarloka is of that same extent, up to the solar disc.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃyanmaṇḍalād vyomadhruvoyāvadvyavasthitaḥ /
svarlokaḥ sa samākhyātastatra vāyostu nemayaḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वंयन्मण्डलाद् व्योमध्रुवोयावद्व्यवस्थितः /
स्वर्लोकः स समाख्यातस्तत्र वायोस्तु नेमयः //
text_mt:
The space above that orb up to where the Pole Star is situated
is called Svarloka; there indeed are the rims of the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
āvahaḥ pravahaścaiva tathaivānuvahaḥ paraḥ /
saṃvaho vivahaścātha tadūrdhvaṃ syāt parāvahaḥ //
meaning:
आवहः प्रवहश्चैव तथैवानुवहः परः /
संवहो विवहश्चाथ तदूर्ध्वं स्यात् परावहः //
text_mt:
Āvaha, Pravaha, and likewise next Anuvaha,
Saṃvaha, Vivaha, and then above that Parāvaha,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā parivahaścordhvaṃ vāyorvai sapta nemayaḥ /
bhūmeryojanalakṣe tu bhānorvai maṇḍalaṃ sthitam //
meaning:
तथा परिवहश्चोर्ध्वं वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः /
भूमेर्योजनलक्षे तु भानोर्वै मण्डलं स्थितम् //
text_mt:
and above is Parivaha: these are the seven rims of the wind.
One hundred thousand yojanas from the earth is the orb of the sun situated.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣe divākarasyāpi maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam /
nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tallakṣeṇa prakāśate //
meaning:
लक्षे दिवाकरस्यापि मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम् /
नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं तल्लक्षेण प्रकाशते //
text_mt:
One hundred thousand [yojanas] from the sun is the orb of the moon declared to be;
at that same hundred thousand shines the entire sphere of constellations.

sanskrit_iast:
dvelakṣe hyuttare viprā budho nakṣatramaṇḍalāt /
tāvatpramāṇabhāge tu budhasyāpyuśanāḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
द्वेलक्षे ह्युत्तरे विप्रा बुधो नक्षत्रमण्डलात् /
तावत्प्रमाणभागे तु बुधस्याप्युशनाः स्थितः //
text_mt:
Two hundred thousand [yojanas] further, O brāhmaṇas, is Mercury above the sphere of constellations;
at a distance equal to that from Mercury stands Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgārako 'pi śukrasya tatpramāṇo vyavasthitaḥ /
lakṣadvayena bhaumasya sthito devapurohitaḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गारको ऽपि शुक्रस्य तत्प्रमाणो व्यवस्थितः /
लक्षद्वयेन भौमस्य स्थितो देवपुरोहितः //
text_mt:
Mars is situated at that same distance from Venus;
two hundred thousand [yojanas] from Mars stands the priest of the gods [Jupiter].

sanskrit_iast:
saurirdvilakṣeṇa guror grahāṇāmatha maṇḍalam /
saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ tasmāllakṣamātre prikāśate //
meaning:
सौरिर्द्विलक्षेण गुरोर् ग्रहाणामथ मण्डलम् /
सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षमात्रे प्रिकाशते //
text_mt:
Saturn is two hundred thousand from Jupiter; then comes the sphere of the planets;
from that, at a distance of just a hundred thousand, shines the constellation of the Seven Sages.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ lakṣamātre sthito dhruvaḥ /
meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ /
tatra dharmaḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषीणां मण्डलादूर्ध्वं लक्षमात्रे स्थितो ध्रुवः /
मेढीभूतः समस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः /
तत्र धर्मः स भगवान् विष्णुर्नारायणः स्थितः //

sanskrit_iast:
navayojanasāhastro viṣkambhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ /
triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
नवयोजनसाहस्त्रो विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः /
त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः //
text_mt:
The diameter of the sun is declared to be nine thousand yojanas;
its circumference is three times that in measure of the orb.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇastasya vistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ /
tulyastayostu svarbhānurbhūtvādhastāt prasarpati //
meaning:
द्विगुणस्तस्य विस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः /
तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर्भूत्वाधस्तात् प्रसर्पति //
text_mt:
The extent of the moon is declared to be twice its extent;
becoming equal to both of them, Rāhu glides underneath.

sanskrit_iast:
addhṛtya pṛthivīcchāyāṃ nirmito maṇḍalākṛtiḥ /
svarbhānostu vṛhat sthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yat tamomayam //
meaning:
अद्धृत्य पृथिवीच्छायां निर्मितो मण्डलाकृतिः /
स्वर्भानोस्तु वृहत् स्थानं तृतीयं यत् तमोमयम् //
text_mt:
Taking the earth’s shadow, it was fashioned in circular form;
the great place of Rāhu is the third, composed of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate /
bhārgavāt pādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते /
भार्गवात् पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt:
The size of Venus is prescribed as a sixteenth part of the moon;
Jupiter is to be known as one-fourth less than Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurāvubhau smṛtau /
vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतेः पादहीनौ वक्रसौरावुभौ स्मृतौ /
विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः //
text_mt:
Both Mars and Saturn are declared to be one-fourth less than Jupiter;
and in extent and in orb Mercury is one-fourth less than them.

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai /
budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalāt tathā //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्तीह यानि वै /
बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलात् तथा //
text_mt:
The forms of stars and constellations that are embodied here,
are equal to Mercury in extent and in orb.

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparāt /
śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परात् /
शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने //
text_mt:
The forms of stars and constellations diminish with respect to one another
by five hundred, four, three, and two yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvaranikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu /
yojanānyardhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
सर्वावरनिकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु /
योजनान्यर्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते //
text_mt:
The most inferior of all the spheres of stars
are just half a yojana; smaller than those there are none.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ /
sauro 'ṅgirāśca vakraśca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
उपरिष्टात् त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्पिणः /
सौरो ऽङ्गिराश्च वक्रश्च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः //
text_mt:
Above them are three planets that travel afar;
Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars are to be known as slow-moving.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'dhastācca catvāraḥ punaranye mahāgrahāḥ /
sūryaḥ saumo budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽधस्ताच्च चत्वारः पुनरन्ये महाग्रहाः /
सूर्यः सौमो बुधश्चैव भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रगाः //
text_mt:
Below them are four other great planets:
the sun, the moon, Mercury, and Venus, which move swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmimān /
tadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ sa sūryo 'dhastāt prasarpati //
meaning:
दक्षिणायनमार्गस्थो यदा चरति रश्मिमान् /
तदा सर्वग्रहाणां स सूर्यो ऽधस्तात् प्रसर्पति //
text_mt:
When the radiant [sun] moves situated on the path of the southern course,
