प्रोच्यते भगवान् ब्रह्मा महान् ब्रह्ममयो ऽमलः //
text_mt: Because of being superior to all principles, the greatness of the Supreme Lord / is proclaimed: the Lord Brahmā is great, composed of Brahman, free from stain.

sanskrit_iast:
yo māmevaṃ vijānāti mahāyogeśvareśvaram /
so 'vikalpena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यो मामेवं विजानाति महायोगेश्वरेश्वरम् /
सो ऽविकल्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: He who knows me thus as the Lord of the Great Lords of Yoga / is united [with me] by unswerving yoga; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ prerayitā devaḥ paramānandamāśritaḥ /
nṛtyāmi yogī satataṃ yastad veda sa vedavit //
meaning:
सो ऽहं प्रेरयिता देवः परमानन्दमाश्रितः /
नृत्यामि योगी सततं यस्तद् वेद स वेदवित् //
text_mt: I am that impelling god, resting in supreme bliss; / as a yogi I dance perpetually. He who knows that knows the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ sarvavedeṣu niṣṭhitam /
prasannacetase deyaṃ dhārmikāyāhitāgnaye //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं सर्ववेदेषु निष्ठितम् /
प्रसन्नचेतसे देयं धार्मिकायाहिताग्नये //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this most secret knowledge is grounded in all the Vedas; / it should be given to one of serene mind, righteous, who maintains the sacred fire.

Thus ends the fourth chapter in the latter section (the Īśvaragītā) of the Kūrma Purāṇa containing six thousand verses.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
etāvaduktvā bhagavān yogināṃ parameśvaraḥ /
nanarta paramaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ saṃpradarśayan //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् योगिनां परमेश्वरः /
ननर्त परमं भावमैश्वरं संप्रदर्शयन् //
title: pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having spoken thus, the Lord, the supreme lord of yogis, / danced, displaying his supreme, sovereign state.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ te dadṛśurīśānaṃ tejasāṃ paramaṃ nidhim /
nṛtyamānaṃ mahādevaṃ viṣṇunā gagane 'male //
meaning:
तं ते ददृशुरीशानं तेजसां परमं निधिम् /
नृत्यमानं महादेवं विष्णुना गगने ऽमले //
text_mt: They saw him, the Lord, the supreme receptacle of splendors, / Mahādeva dancing with Viṣṇu in the pure sky.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ viduryogatattvajñā yogino yatamānasāḥ /
tamīśaṃ sarvabhūtānāmākaśe dadṛśuḥ kila //
meaning:
यं विदुर्योगतत्त्वज्ञा योगिनो यतमानसाः /
तमीशं सर्वभूतानामाकशे ददृशुः किल //
text_mt: Him whom the yogis, knowers of the truth of yoga with restrained minds, know, / that Lord of all beings they truly beheld in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ yenedaṃ preryate jagat /
nṛtyamānaḥ svayaṃ viprairviśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate //
meaning:
यस्य मायामयं सर्वं येनेदं प्रेर्यते जगत् /
नृत्यमानः स्वयं विप्रैर्विश्वेशः खलु दृश्यते //
text_mt: By whom all is made of illusory creative power, by whom this world is impelled, / dancing Himself, that Lord of the universe was indeed seen by the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
yat pādapaṅkajaṃ smṛtvā puruṣo 'jñānajaṃ bhayam /
jahati nṛtyamānaṃ taṃ bhūteśaṃ dadṛśuḥ kila //
meaning:
यत् पादपङ्कजं स्मृत्वा पुरुषो ऽज्ञानजं भयम् /
जहति नृत्यमानं तं भूतेशं ददृशुः किल //
text_mt: Remembering whose lotus feet a man abandons fear born of ignorance— / him, the Lord of beings, dancing, they truly beheld.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ śāntā bhaktisamanvitāḥ /
jyotirmayaṃ prapaśyanti sa yogī dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः शान्ता भक्तिसमन्विताः /
ज्योतिर्मयं प्रपश्यन्ति स योगी दृश्यते किल //
text_mt: Him whom those free from slumber, with controlled breath, peaceful and endowed with devotion / behold as composed of light—that yogi was truly seen.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'jñānānmocayet kṣipraṃ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ /
tameva mocakaṃ rudramākāśe dadṛśuḥ param //
meaning:
यो ऽज्ञानान्मोचयेत् क्षिप्रं प्रसन्नो भक्तवत्सलः /
तमेव मोचकं रुद्रमाकाशे ददृशुः परम् //
text_mt: He who, being pleased, fond of his devotees, quickly liberates from ignorance— / that very liberator, supreme Rudra, they beheld in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasracaraṇākṛtim /
sahasrabāhuṃ jaṭilaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam //
meaning:
सहस्रशिरसं देवं सहस्रचरणाकृतिम् /
सहस्रबाहुं जटिलं चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरम् //
text_mt: The god with a thousand heads, whose form has a thousand feet, / with a thousand arms, matted hair, and adorned with the crescent moon on his crest;

sanskrit_iast:
vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram /
daṇḍapāṇiṃ trayīnetraṃ sūryasomāgnilocanam //
meaning:
वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं शूलासक्तमहाकरम् /
दण्डपाणिं त्रयीनेत्रं सूर्यसोमाग्निलोचनम् //
text_mt: Wearing a tiger skin, holding a trident with his great hand, / holding a staff in hand, with three eyes—the sun, moon, and fire as his eyes;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍaṃ tejasā svena sarvamāvṛtya ca sthitam /
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham //
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डं तेजसा स्वेन सर्वमावृत्य च स्थितम् /
दंष्ट्राकरालं दुर्धर्षं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: Enveloping the entire cosmic egg with his own radiance and abiding there, / fearsome with fangs, unassailable, equal in radiance to ten million suns;

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamabhyantaraṃ param /
sṛjantamanalajvālaṃ dahantamakhilaṃ jagat /
nṛtyantaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ viśvakarmāṇamīśvaram //
meaning:
अण्डस्थं चाण्डबाह्यस्थं बाह्यमभ्यन्तरं परम् /
सृजन्तमनलज्वालं दहन्तमखिलं जगत् /
नृत्यन्तं ददृशुर्देवं विश्वकर्माणमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: Abiding within the cosmic egg and outside the cosmic egg, exterior, interior, supreme, / emitting flames of fire, burning the entire world, / they beheld the god dancing, the maker of the universe, the Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ devānāmapi daivatam /
paśūnāṃ patimīśānaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiravyayam //
meaning:
महादेवं महायोगं देवानामपि दैवतम् /
पशूनां पतिमीशानं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरव्ययम् //
text_mt: Mahādeva, the great yoga, the deity even of the gods, / the Lord of beasts, the ruler, the imperishable light of lights;

sanskrit_iast:
pinākinaṃ viśālākṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām /
kālātmānaṃ kālakālaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
पिनाकिनं विशालाक्षं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम् /
कालात्मानं कालकालं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: The wielder of the Pināka bow, large-eyed, the medicine for those afflicted with the disease of worldly existence, / whose self is Time, the Death of Time, the God of gods, the Great Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
umāpatiṃ virūpākṣaṃ yogānandamayaṃ param /
jñānavairāgyanilayaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
उमापतिं विरूपाक्षं योगानन्दमयं परम् /
ज्ञानवैराग्यनिलयं ज्ञानयोगं सनातनम् //
text_mt: The lord of Umā, the odd-eyed, filled with the bliss of yoga, supreme, / the abode of knowledge and dispassion, eternal yoga of knowledge;

sanskrit_iast:
śāśvataiśvaryavibhavaṃ dharmādhāraṃ durāsadam /
mahendropendranamitaṃ maharṣigaṇavanditam //
meaning:
शाश्वतैश्वर्यविभवं धर्माधारं दुरासदम् /
महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रनमितं महर्षिगणवन्दितम् //
text_mt: Possessing the majesty of eternal sovereignty, the foundation of righteousness, difficult to approach, / bowed to by great Indra and Upendra, praised by the hosts of great sages;

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ mahāyogeśvareśvaram /
yogināṃ paramaṃ brahma yogināṃ yogavanditam /
yogināṃ hṛdi tiṣṭhantaṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam //
meaning:
आधारं सर्वशक्तीनां महायोगेश्वरेश्वरम् /
योगिनां परमं ब्रह्म योगिनां योगवन्दितम् /
योगिनां हृदि तिष्ठन्तं योगमायासमावृतम् //
text_mt: The foundation of all powers, the Lord of the Great Lords of Yoga, / the supreme Brahman of yogis, worshipped through yoga by yogis, / abiding in the hearts of yogis, enveloped by the illusory creative power of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena jagato yoniṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam /
īśvareṇaikatāpannamapaśyan brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
क्षणेन जगतो योनिं नारायणमनामयम् /
ईश्वरेणैकतापन्नमपश्यन् ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: In an instant, those who teach of Brahman beheld Nārāyaṇa, / the source of the world, free from ailment, attained to oneness with the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rudranārāyaṇātmakam /
kṛtārthaṃ menire santaḥ svātmānaṃ brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तदैश्वरं रूपं रुद्रनारायणात्मकम् /
कृतार्थं मेनिरे सन्तः स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: Having seen that sovereign form whose nature is Rudra and Nārāyaṇa, / those virtuous teachers of Brahman considered themselves fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumāraḥ sanako bhṛguśca
sanātanaścaiva sanandanaśca /
rudro 'ṅgirā vāmadevātha śukro
maharṣiratriḥ kapilo marīciḥ //
meaning:
सनत्कुमारः सनको भृगुश्च
सनातनश्चैव सनन्दनश्च /
रुद्रो ऽङ्गिरा वामदेवाथ शुक्रो
महर्षिरत्रिः कपिलो मरीचिः //
text_mt: Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, Bhṛgu, / Sanātana, and Sanandana, / Rudra, Aṅgiras, Vāmadeva, then Śukra, / the great sage Atri, Kapila, and Marīci—

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvātha rudraṃ jagadīśitāraṃ
taṃ padmanābhāśritavāmabhāgam /
dhyātvā hṛdisthaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā
baddhvāñjaliṃ sveṣu śiraḥsu bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वाथ रुद्रं जगदीशितारं
तं पद्मनाभाश्रितवामभागम् /
ध्यात्वा हृदिस्थं प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्ना
बद्ध्वाञ्जलिं स्वेषु शिरःसु भूयः //
text_mt: Having then seen Rudra, the ruler of the universe, / whose left side was occupied by the lotus-navelled [Viṣṇu], / meditating on him residing in the heart, bowing low with the head, / folding their hands repeatedly over their heads,

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāramuccārya vilokya devam
antaḥśarīre nihitaṃ guhāyām /
samastuvan brahmamayairvacobhir
ānandapūrṇāyatamānasāste //
meaning:
ओङ्कारमुच्चार्य विलोक्य देवम्
अन्तःशरीरे निहितं गुहायाम् /
समस्तुवन् ब्रह्ममयैर्वचोभिर्
आनन्दपूर्णायतमानसास्ते //
text_mt: Uttering the syllable Oṃ, seeing the god / placed in the secret cavity within the body, / they praised him with words composed of Brahman, / filled with bliss, their minds restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
tvāmekamīśaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ
prāṇeśvaraṃ rudramanantayogam /
namāma sarve hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ
pracetasaṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
त्वामेकमीशं पुरुषं पुराणं
प्राणेश्वरं रुद्रमनन्तयोगम् /
नमाम सर्वे हृदि सन्निविष्टं
प्रचेतसं ब्रह्ममयं पवित्रम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / To you, the one Lord, the ancient Spirit, / the lord of the vital breath, Rudra of infinite yoga, / residing in the heart, we all bow— / the wise one, composed of Brahman, the pure.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ paśyanti munayo brahmayoniṃ
dāntāḥ śāntā vimalaṃ rukmavarṇam /
dhyātvātmasthamacalaṃ sve śarīre
kaviṃ parebhyaḥ paramaṃ tatparaṃ ca //
meaning:
त्वां पश्यन्ति मुनयो ब्रह्मयोनिं
दान्ताः शान्ता विमलं रुक्मवर्णम् /
ध्यात्वात्मस्थमचलं स्वे शरीरे
कविं परेभ्यः परमं तत्परं च //
text_mt: The restrained and peaceful sages behold you, the source of Brahman, / spotless, of golden hue, / meditating on you as unmoved, abiding within the self in their own body, / the seer, higher than the highest, and beyond that.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ prasūtā jagataḥ prasūtiḥ
sarvātmabhūstvaṃ paramāṇubhūtaḥ /
aṇoraṇīyān mahato mahīyāṃ-
stvāmeva sarvaṃ pravadanti santaḥ //
meaning:
त्वत्तः प्रसूता जगतः प्रसूतिः
सर्वात्मभूस्त्वं परमाणुभूतः /
अणोरणीयान् महतो महीयां-
स्त्वामेव सर्वं प्रवदन्ति सन्तः //
text_mt: From you the birth of the world is brought forth; / you are the self of all, become the ultimate atom; / subtler than the subtle, greater than the great— / the virtuous proclaim you alone to be all.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbho jagadantarātmā
tvatto 'dhijātaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ /
saṃjāyamāno bhavatā visṛṣṭo
yathāvidhānaṃ sakalaṃ sasarja //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भो जगदन्तरात्मा
त्वत्तो ऽधिजातः पुरुषः पुराणः /
संजायमानो भवता विसृष्टो
यथाविधानं सकलं ससर्ज //
text_mt: Hiraṇyagarbha, the inner self of the world, / the ancient Spirit, was born from you; / coming into being, dispatched by you, / he created all according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatto vedāḥ sakalāḥ saṃprasūtā-
stvayyevānte saṃsthitiṃ te labhante /
paśyāmastvāṃ jagato hetubhūtaṃ
nṛtyantaṃ sve hṛdaye sanniviṣṭam //
meaning:
त्वत्तो वेदाः सकलाः संप्रसूता-
स्त्वय्येवान्ते संस्थितिं ते लभन्ते /
पश्यामस्त्वां जगतो हेतुभूतं
नृत्यन्तं स्वे हृदये सन्निविष्टम् //
text_mt: From you all the Vedas have been brought forth; / in you alone at the end do they find their resting place. / We behold you, the cause of the world, / dancing, established in our own heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaivedaṃ bhrāmyate brahmacakraṃ
māyāvī tvaṃ jagatāmekanāthaḥ /
namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannā
yogātmānaṃ citpatiṃ divyanṛtyam //
meaning:
त्वयैवेदं भ्राम्यते ब्रह्मचक्रं
मायावी त्वं जगतामेकनाथः /
नमामस्त्वां शरणं संप्रपन्ना
योगात्मानं चित्पतिं दिव्यनृत्यम् //
text_mt: By you alone is this wheel of Brahman caused to turn; / you are the master of illusory creative power, the sole master of the worlds. / We bow to you, having sought refuge, / whose essence is yoga, the Lord of consciousness, of divine dance.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyāmastvāṃ paramākāśamadhye
nṛtyantaṃ te mahimānaṃ smarāmaḥ /
sarvātmānaṃ bahudhā sanniviṣṭaṃ
brahmānandamanubhūyānubhūya //
meaning:
पश्यामस्त्वां परमाकाशमध्ये
नृत्यन्तं ते महिमानं स्मरामः /
सर्वात्मानं बहुधा सन्निविष्टं
ब्रह्मानन्दमनुभूयानुभूय //
text_mt: We behold you dancing in the midst of supreme space; / we contemplate your greatness, / you who are the self of all, established manifoldly, / experiencing again and again the bliss of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāraste vācako muktibījaṃ
tvamakṣaraṃ prakṛtau gūḍharūpam /
tattvāṃ satyaṃ pravadantīha santaḥ
svayaṃprabhaṃ bhavato yatprakāśam //
meaning:
ओङ्कारस्ते वाचको मुक्तिबीजं
त्वमक्षरं प्रकृतौ गूढरूपम् /
तत्त्वां सत्यं प्रवदन्तीह सन्तः
स्वयंप्रभं भवतो यत्प्रकाशम् //
text_mt: The syllable Oṃ is your designator, the seed of liberation; / you are the imperishable, whose form is concealed in primordial matter. / The virtuous here proclaim that you are the truth, / self-luminous, whose light originates from yourself.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti tvāṃ satataṃ sarvavedā
namanti tvāmṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ /
śāntātmānaḥ satyasaṃdhā variṣṭhaṃ
viśanti tvāṃ yatayo brahmaniṣṭhāḥ //
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति त्वां सततं सर्ववेदा
नमन्ति त्वामृषयः क्षीणदोषाः /
शान्तात्मानः सत्यसंधा वरिष्ठं
विशन्ति त्वां यतयो ब्रह्मनिष्ठाः //
text_mt: All the Vedas praise you constantly; / the sages whose faults have diminished bow to you. / With tranquil minds, true to their vows, / the ascetics intent on Brahman enter you, the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
eko vedo bahuśākho hyanantas
tvāmevaikaṃ bodhayatyekarūpam /
vedyaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ ye prapannā-
steṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām //
meaning:
एको वेदो बहुशाखो ह्यनन्तस्
त्वामेवैकं बोधयत्येकरूपम् /
वेद्यं त्वां शरणं ये प्रपन्ना-
स्तेषां शान्तिः शाश्वती नेतरेषाम् //
text_mt: The single, endless Veda of many branches / makes known only you, the one whose form is singular. / To those who have sought refuge in you, who alone should be known, / belongs eternal peace, not to others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavānīśo 'nādimāṃstejorāśir
brahmā viśvaṃ parameṣṭhī variṣṭhaḥ /
svātmānandamanubhūyādhiśete
svayaṃ jyotiracalo nityamuktaḥ //
meaning:
भवानीशो ऽनादिमांस्तेजोराशिर्
ब्रह्मा विश्वं परमेष्ठी वरिष्ठः /
स्वात्मानन्दमनुभूयाधिशेते
स्वयं ज्योतिरचलो नित्यमुक्तः //
text_mt: You are the Lord, beginningless, a mass of splendour, / Brahmā, the universe, the supreme ruler, the highest. / Experiencing the bliss of your own Self, you repose, / self-luminous, immovable, eternally liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
eko rudrastvaṃ karoṣīha viśvaṃ
tvaṃ pālayasyakhilaṃ viśvarūpaḥ /
tvāmevānte nilayaṃ vindatīdaṃ
namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannāḥ //
meaning:
एको रुद्रस्त्वं करोषीह विश्वं
त्वं पालयस्यखिलं विश्वरूपः /
त्वामेवान्ते निलयं विन्दतीदं
नमामस्त्वां शरणं संप्रपन्नाः //
text_mt: You, the sole Rudra, make the universe here; / you protect all things, multiform in aspect. / In you alone this [universe] finds dissolution at the end. / Seeking refuge, we bow to you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmekamāhuḥ kavimekarudraṃ
prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ harimagnimīśam /
indraṃ mṛtyumanilaṃ cekitānaṃ
dhātāramādityamanekarūpam //
meaning:
त्वामेकमाहुः कविमेकरुद्रं
प्राणं बृहन्तं हरिमग्निमीशम् /
इन्द्रं मृत्युमनिलं चेकितानं
धातारमादित्यमनेकरूपम् //
text_mt: They call you alone the seer, the sole Rudra, / the great breath of life, Hari, Agni, the Lord, / Indra, death, the wind, the conscious spirit, / the creator, the sun, having many forms.

sanskrit_iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ
tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam /
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā
sanātanastvaṃ puruṣottamo 'si //
meaning:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् /
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तमो ऽसि //
text_mt: You are the imperishable supreme [truth] to be known; / you are the ultimate repository of this universe. / You are the imperishable guardian of eternal law; / you are the primeval Supreme Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva viṣṇuścaturānanastvaṃ
tvameva rudro bhagavānadhīśaḥ /
tvaṃ viśvanābhiḥ prakṛtiḥ pratiṣṭhā
sarveśvarastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si //
meaning:
त्वमेव विष्णुश्चतुराननस्त्वं
त्वमेव रुद्रो भगवानधीशः /
त्वं विश्वनाभिः प्रकृतिः प्रतिष्ठा
सर्वेश्वरस्त्वं परमेश्वरो ऽसि //
text_mt: You alone are Viṣṇu, and you are the four-faced [Brahmā]; / you alone are the blessed Lord Rudra, the sovereign ruler. / You are the navel of the universe, primordial matter, the foundation; / you are the ruler of all, the supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇa-
mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt /
cinmātramavyaktamacintyarūpaṃ
khaṃ brahma śūnyaṃ prakṛtiṃ nirguṇaṃ ca //
meaning:
त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं पुराण-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् /
चिन्मात्रमव्यक्तमचिन्त्यरूपं
खं ब्रह्म शून्यं प्रकृतिं निर्गुणं च //
text_mt: They speak of you as the one ancient person, / sun-coloured, beyond darkness, / pure consciousness, unmanifest, of inconceivable form, / space, Brahman, the void, primordial matter, and devoid of qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
yadantarā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti
yadavyayaṃ nirmalamekarūpam /
kimapyacintyaṃ tava rūpametat
tadantarā yatpratibhāti tattvam //
meaning:
यदन्तरा सर्वमिदं विभाति
यदव्ययं निर्मलमेकरूपम् /
किमप्यचिन्त्यं तव रूपमेतत्
तदन्तरा यत्प्रतिभाति तत्त्वम् //
text_mt: Within which all this shines, / which is imperishable, stainless, uniform— / whatever this inconceivable form of yours may be, / that is the reality which shines within.

sanskrit_iast:
yogeśvaraṃ rudramanantaśaktiṃ
parāyaṇaṃ brahmatanuṃ pavitram /
namāma sarve śaraṇārthinastvāṃ
prasīda bhūtādhipate maheśa //
meaning:
योगेश्वरं रुद्रमनन्तशक्तिं
परायणं ब्रह्मतनुं पवित्रम् /
नमाम सर्वे शरणार्थिनस्त्वां
प्रसीद भूताधिपते महेश //
text_mt: To the lord of yoga, to Rudra of infinite power, / the supreme goal, whose body is Brahman, the pure one, / we all bow, seeking refuge in you: / be gracious, lord of beings, Maheśa!

sanskrit_iast:
tvatpādapadmasmaraṇādaśeṣa-
saṃsārabījaṃ vilayaṃ prayāti /
mano niyamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ
prasādayāmo vayamekamīśam //
meaning:
त्वत्पादपद्मस्मरणादशेष-
संसारबीजं विलयं प्रयाति /
मनो नियम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादयामो वयमेकमीशम् //
text_mt: From the remembrance of your lotus feet / the entire seed of worldly existence dissolves away. / Restraining the mind, bowing the body, / we propitiate the one Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhavāyāstu bhavodbhavāya
kālāya sarvāya harāya tubhyam /
namo 'stu rudrāya kapardine te
namo 'gnaye deva namaḥ śivāya //
meaning:
नमो भवायास्तु भवोद्भवाय
कालाय सर्वाय हराय तुभ्यम् /
नमो ऽस्तु रुद्राय कपर्दिने ते
नमो ऽग्नये देव नमः शिवाय //
text_mt: Homage to Bhava, to the source of worldly existence, / to Time, to Śarva, to Hara, homage to you! / Homage to Rudra, to you who wear matted hair, / homage to Agni, O god, homage to Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa bhagavān devaḥ kapardī vṛṣavāhanaḥ /
saṃhṛtya paramaṃ rūpaṃ prakṛtistho 'bhavad bhavaḥ //
meaning:
ततः स भगवान् देवः कपर्दी वृषवाहनः /
संहृत्य परमं रूपं प्रकृतिस्थो ऽभवद् भवः //
text_mt: Then that blessed god, the matted-haired one whose mount is the bull, / withdrew that supreme form and returned to his natural state, Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
te bhavaṃ bhūtabhavyeśaṃ pūrvavat samavasthitam /
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vismitā vākyamabruvan //
meaning:
ते भवं भूतभव्येशं पूर्ववत् समवस्थितम् /
दृष्ट्वा नारायणं देवं विस्मिता वाक्यमब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Seeing Bhava, the lord of past and future, / standing as before along with the divine Nārāyaṇa, they were astonished and said:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa govṛṣāṅkitaśāsana /
dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ rūpaṃ nirvṛtāḥ sma sanātana //
meaning:
भगवन् भूतभव्येश गोवृषाङ्कितशासन /
दृष्ट्वा ते परमं रूपं निर्वृताः स्म सनातन //
text_mt: “O blessed one, lord of past and future, whose edict bears the mark of the bull, / having seen your supreme form, we are fulfilled, O eternal one!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatprasādādamale parasmin parameśvare /
asmākaṃ jāyate bhaktistvayyevāvyabhicāriṇī //
meaning:
भवत्प्रसादादमले परस्मिन् परमेश्वरे /
अस्माकं जायते भक्तिस्त्वय्येवाव्यभिचारिणी //
text_mt: By your grace, toward you, the stainless, / supreme, transcendent Lord, our unfailing devotion is born.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmo māhātmyaṃ tava śaṅkara /
bhūyo 'pi tava yannityaṃ yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामो माहात्म्यं तव शङ्कर /
भूयो ऽपि तव यन्नित्यं याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Now we wish to hear your majesty, O Śaṅkara, / and once again that which is your eternal true nature, O supreme ruler.”

sanskrit_iast:
sa teṣāṃ vākyamākarṇya yogināṃ yogasiddhidaḥ /
prāhaḥ gambhīrayā vācā samālokya ca mādhavam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स तेषां वाक्यमाकर्ण्य योगिनां योगसिद्धिदः /
प्राहः गम्भीरया वाचा समालोक्य च माधवम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Hearing their words, he who grants the accomplishments of yoga to yogins / spoke in a deep voice, looking at Mādhava:

Thus ends the fifth chapter in the (Īśvaragītā of the) latter section of the six-thousand-verse compilation of the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve yathāvat parameṣṭhinaḥ /
vakṣyāmīśasya māhātmyaṃ yattadvedavido viduḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे यथावत् परमेष्ठिनः /
वक्ष्यामीशस्य माहात्म्यं यत्तद्वेदविदो विदुः //
title: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The Lord said:
“Listen, all you sages, properly; / I shall declare the majesty of the supreme ruler, the Lord, which the knowers of the Veda know.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokaikanirmātā sarvalokaikarakṣitā /
sarvalokaikasaṃhartā sarvātmāhaṃ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वलोकैकनिर्माता सर्वलोकैकरक्षिता /
सर्वलोकैकसंहर्ता सर्वात्माहं सनातनः //
text_mt: I am the sole creator of all worlds, the sole protector of all worlds, / the sole destroyer of all worlds, the eternal Self of all.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva vastūnāmantaryāmī pitā hyaham /
madhye cāntaḥ sthitaṃ sarvaṃ nāhaṃ sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव वस्तूनामन्तर्यामी पिता ह्यहम् /
मध्ये चान्तः स्थितं सर्वं नाहं सर्वत्र संस्थितः //
text_mt: I am indeed the inner controller and father of all entities; / everything is situated within me, yet I am not situated everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhiradbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yatsvarūpaṃ tu māmakam /
mamaiṣā hyupamā viprā māyayā darśitā mayā //
meaning:
भवद्भिरद्भुतं दृष्टं यत्स्वरूपं तु मामकम् /
ममैषा ह्युपमा विप्रा मायया दर्शिता मया //
text_mt: That wonderful form of mine which was seen by you, / was merely a likeness shown by me through my illusory creative power, O Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāmantarā samavasthitaḥ /
prerayāmi jagat kṛtsnaṃ kriyāśāktiriyaṃ mama //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव भावानामन्तरा समवस्थितः /
प्रेरयामि जगत् कृत्स्नं क्रियाशाक्तिरियं मम //
text_mt: Situated within all states of being, / I impel the entire universe; this is my power of action,

sanskrit_iast:
yayedaṃ ceṣṭate viśvaṃ tatsvabhāvānuvarti ca /
so 'haṃ kālo jagat kṛtsnaṃ prerayāmi kalātmakam //
meaning:
ययेदं चेष्टते विश्वं तत्स्वभावानुवर्ति च /
सो ऽहं कालो जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रेरयामि कलात्मकम् //
text_mt: by which this universe acts, conforming to its own nature. / As Time, I impel the whole universe composed of time-units.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃśena jagat kṛtsnaṃ karomi munipuṅgavāḥ /
saṃharāmyekarūpeṇa dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu //
meaning:
एकांशेन जगत् कृत्स्नं करोमि मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
संहराम्येकरूपेण द्विधावस्था ममैव तु //
text_mt: With a single portion I make the entire universe, O best of sages; / with a single form I withdraw it; twofold indeed is my condition.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimadhyāntanirmukto māyātattvapravartakaḥ /
kṣobhayāmi ca sargādau pradhānapuruṣāvubhau //
meaning:
आदिमध्यान्तनिर्मुक्तो मायातत्त्वप्रवर्तकः /
क्षोभयामि च सर्गादौ प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ //
text_mt: Free from beginning, middle, and end, the instigator of the principle of illusory creative power, / I agitate both primordial matter and the spirit at the beginning of creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ saṃjāyate viśvaṃ saṃyuktābhyāṃ parasparam /
mahadādikrameṇaiva mama tejo vijṛmbhate //
meaning:
ताभ्यां संजायते विश्वं संयुक्ताभ्यां परस्परम् /
महदादिक्रमेणैव मम तेजो विजृम्भते //
text_mt: From those two joined together the universe is born; / through the sequence beginning with the intellect, my splendour unfolds.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hi sarvajagatsākṣī kālacakrapravartakaḥ /
hiraṇyagarbho mārtaṇḍaḥ so 'pi maddehasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
यो हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी कालचक्रप्रवर्तकः /
हिरण्यगर्भो मार्तण्डः सो ऽपि मद्देहसंभवः //
text_mt: He who is the witness of the whole world, the wheel-turner of time, / Hiraṇyagarbha, the sun—he too is born of my body.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai divyaṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam /
dattavānātmajān vedān kalpādau caturo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मै दिव्यं स्वमैश्वर्यं ज्ञानयोगं सनातनम् /
दत्तवानात्मजान् वेदान् कल्पादौ चतुरो द्विजाः //
text_mt: To him I gave my own divine sovereignty, the eternal yoga of knowledge, / and the four Vedas born of myself at the beginning of the cosmic cycle, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sa manniyogato devo brahmā madbhāvabhāvitaḥ /
divyaṃ tanmāmakaiśvaryaṃ sarvadā vahati svayam //
meaning:
स मन्नियोगतो देवो ब्रह्मा मद्भावभावितः /
दिव्यं तन्मामकैश्वर्यं सर्वदा वहति स्वयम् //
text_mt: By my command that god Brahmā, filled with devotion to me, / always carries by himself that divine sovereignty of mine.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvalokanirmātā manniyogena sarvavit /
bhūtvā caturmukhaḥ sargaṃ sṛjatyevātmasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
स सर्वलोकनिर्माता मन्नियोगेन सर्ववित् /
भूत्वा चतुर्मुखः सर्गं सृजत्येवात्मसंभवः //
text_mt: He, the creator of all worlds, omniscient by my command, / having become four-faced, self-born, creates the creation.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pi nārāyaṇo 'nanto lokānāṃ prabhavāvyayaḥ /
mamaiva paramā mūrtiḥ karoti paripālanam //
meaning:
यो ऽपि नारायणो ऽनन्तो लोकानां प्रभवाव्ययः /
ममैव परमा मूर्तिः करोति परिपालनम् //
text_mt: He also who is Nārāyaṇa, the infinite, the imperishable source of the worlds, / my own highest form, carries out preservation.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'ntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudraḥ kālātmakaḥ prabhuḥ /
madājñayāsau satataṃ saṃhariṣyati me tanuḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽन्तकः सर्वभूतानां रुद्रः कालात्मकः प्रभुः /
मदाज्ञयासौ सततं संहरिष्यति मे तनुः //
text_mt: He who is the destroyer of all beings, Rudra, the sovereign lord in the form of Time— / by my command that body of mine will continually destroy.

sanskrit_iast:
havyaṃ vahati devānāṃ kavyaṃ kavyāśināmapi /
pākaṃ ca kurute vahniḥ so 'pi macchakticoditaḥ //
meaning:
हव्यं वहति देवानां कव्यं कव्याशिनामपि /
पाकं च कुरुते वह्निः सो ऽपि मच्छक्तिचोदितः //
text_mt: Fire carries the oblation to the gods and the ancestral food to the consumers of kavya, / and cooks [food], impelled by my power alone.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktamāhārajātaṃ ca pacate tadaharniśam /
vaiśvānaro 'gnirbhagavānīśvarasya niyogataḥ //
meaning:
भुक्तमाहारजातं च पचते तदहर्निशम् /
वैश्वानरो ऽग्निर्भगवानीश्वरस्य नियोगतः //
text_mt: And day and night the blessed fire Vaiśvānara / digests the ingested food according to the command of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pi sarvāmbhasāṃ yonirvaruṇo devapuṅgavaḥ /
so 'pi saṃjīvayet kṛtsnamīśasyaiva niyogataḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽपि सर्वाम्भसां योनिर्वरुणो देवपुङ्गवः /
सो ऽपि संजीवयेत् कृत्स्नमीशस्यैव नियोगतः //
text_mt: Varuṇa, the best among gods, who is the source of all waters, / enlivens everything by the command of the Lord alone.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'ntastiṣṭhati bhūtānāṃ bahirdevaḥ prabhañjanaḥ /
madājñayāsau bhūtānāṃ śarīrāṇi bibharti hi //
meaning:
यो ऽन्तस्तिष्ठति भूतानां बहिर्देवः प्रभञ्जनः /
मदाज्ञयासौ भूतानां शरीराणि बिभर्ति हि //
text_mt: The god Wind, who resides inside and outside beings, / sustains the bodies of beings by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pi saṃjīvano nṝṇāṃ devānāmamṛtākaraḥ /
somaḥ sa manniyogena coditaḥ kila vartate //
meaning:
यो ऽपि संजीवनो नॄणां देवानाममृताकरः /
सोमः स मन्नियोगेन चोदितः किल वर्तते //
text_mt: Soma, who is the reviver of mortals and the mine of nectar for the gods, / exists indeed impelled by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svabhāsā jagat kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati sarvadā /
sūryo vṛṣṭiṃ vitanute śāstreṇaiva svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
यः स्वभासा जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति सर्वदा /
सूर्यो वृष्टिं वितनुते शास्त्रेणैव स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: The Sun, who constantly illuminates the whole world with his light, / produces rain by the rule of the Self-born.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pyaśeṣajagacchāstā śakraḥ sarvāmareśvaraḥ /
yajvanāṃ phalado devo vartate 'sau madājñayā //
meaning:
यो ऽप्यशेषजगच्छास्ता शक्रः सर्वामरेश्वरः /
यज्वनां फलदो देवो वर्तते ऽसौ मदाज्ञया //
text_mt: Śakra, the sovereign ruler of the whole world, the lord of all immortals, / the god who bestows fruit on sacrificers, functions by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ praśāstā hyasādhūnāṃ vartate niyamādiha /
yamo vaivasvato devo devadevaniyogataḥ //
meaning:
यः प्रशास्ता ह्यसाधूनां वर्तते नियमादिह /
यमो वैवस्वतो देवो देवदेवनियोगतः //
text_mt: Yama Vaivasvata, the god who acts as the chastiser / of the wicked here by restraint, [does so] by the command of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pi sarvadhanādhyakṣo dhanānāṃ saṃpradāyakaḥ /
so 'pīśvaraniyogena kubero vartate sadā //
meaning:
यो ऽपि सर्वधनाध्यक्षो धनानां संप्रदायकः /
सो ऽपीश्वरनियोगेन कुबेरो वर्तते सदा //
text_mt: Kubera, who is the supervisor of all wealth, the bestower of riches, / constantly functions by the command of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvarakṣasāṃ nāthastāmasānāṃ phalapradaḥ /
manniyogādasau devo vartate nirṛtiḥ sadā //
meaning:
यः सर्वरक्षसां नाथस्तामसानां फलप्रदः /
मन्नियोगादसौ देवो वर्तते निरृतिः सदा //
text_mt: He who is the lord of all rākṣasas, who grants fruits to those of dark nature, / that god Nirṛti constantly stands by my appointment.

sanskrit_iast:
vetālagaṇabhūtānāṃ svāmī bhogaphalapradaḥ /
īśānaḥ kila bhaktānāṃ so 'pi tiṣṭhanmamājñayā //
meaning:
वेतालगणभूतानां स्वामी भोगफलप्रदः /
ईशानः किल भक्तानां सो ऽपि तिष्ठन्ममाज्ञया //
text_mt: The master of vetālas, gaṇas, and bhūtas, who bestows the fruit of enjoyment / upon devotees, Īśāna indeed also remains by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vāmadevo 'ṅgirasaḥ śiṣyo rudragaṇāgraṇīḥ /
rakṣako yogināṃ nityaṃ vartate 'sau madājñayā //
meaning:
यो वामदेवो ऽङ्गिरसः शिष्यो रुद्रगणाग्रणीः /
रक्षको योगिनां नित्यं वर्तते ऽसौ मदाज्ञया //
text_mt: He who is Vāmadeva, disciple of Aṅgiras, foremost of the host of Rudras, / constant protector of yogins, remains by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yaśca sarvajagatpūjyo vartate vighnakārakaḥ /
vināyako dharmanetā so 'pi madvacanāt kila //
meaning:
यश्च सर्वजगत्पूज्यो वर्तते विघ्नकारकः /
विनायको धर्मनेता सो ऽपि मद्वचनात् किल //
text_mt: And Vināyaka, worshipped by the entire world, creator of obstacles, / leader of dharma, exists indeed by my word.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'pi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho devasenāpatiḥ prabhuḥ /
skando 'sau vartate nityaṃ svayaṃbhūrvidhicoditaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽपि ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो देवसेनापतिः प्रभुः /
स्कन्दो ऽसौ वर्तते नित्यं स्वयंभूर्विधिचोदितः //
text_mt: He who is foremost among knowers of Brahman, commander of the gods' army, the lord, / that Skanda exists eternally, self-born, impelled by my ordinance.

sanskrit_iast:
ye ca prajānāṃ patayo marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ /
sṛjanti vividhaṃ lokaṃ parasyaiva niyogataḥ //
meaning:
ये च प्रजानां पतयो मरीच्याद्या महर्षयः /
सृजन्ति विविधं लोकं परस्यैव नियोगतः //
text_mt: And the lords of beings, the great seers headed by Marīci, / create the diverse world only by the order of the Supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
yā ca śrīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyam /
patnī nārāyaṇasyāsau vartate madanugrahāt //
meaning:
या च श्रीः सर्वभूतानां ददाति विपुलां श्रियम् /
पत्नी नारायणस्यासौ वर्तते मदनुग्रहात् //
text_mt: And Śrī, who grants abundant prosperity to all beings, / that wife of Nārāyaṇa exists by my grace.

sanskrit_iast:
vācaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ yā ca devī sarasvatī /
sāpīśvaraniyogena coditā saṃpravartate //
meaning:
वाचं ददाति विपुलां या च देवी सरस्वती /
सापीश्वरनियोगेन चोदिता संप्रवर्तते //
text_mt: And the goddess Sarasvatī, who gives copious speech, / she too acts impelled by the command of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yāśeṣapuruṣān ghorānnarakāt tārayiṣyati /
sāvitrī saṃsmṛtā devī devājñānuvidhāyinī //
meaning:
याशेषपुरुषान् घोरान्नरकात् तारयिष्यति /
सावित्री संस्मृता देवी देवाज्ञानुविधायिनी //
text_mt: She who delivers all people from dread hell, / the goddess Sāvitrī, when remembered, obeys the command of the God.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatī paramā devī brahmavidyāpradāyinī /
yāpi dhyātā viśeṣeṇa sāpi madvacanānugā //
meaning:
पार्वती परमा देवी ब्रह्मविद्याप्रदायिनी /
यापि ध्याता विशेषेण सापि मद्वचनानुगा //
text_mt: Pārvatī, the supreme goddess, giver of the knowledge of Brahman, / she too, especially meditated upon, conforms to my word.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nantamahimānantaḥ śeṣo 'śeṣāmaraprabhuḥ /
dadhāti śirasā lokaṃ so 'pi devaniyogataḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽनन्तमहिमानन्तः शेषो ऽशेषामरप्रभुः /
दधाति शिरसा लोकं सो ऽपि देवनियोगतः //
text_mt: He whose majesty is endless, Ananta, Śeṣa, lord of all the immortals, / supports the world on his head, he too by the God’s appointment.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'gniḥ saṃvartako nityaṃ vaḍavārūpasaṃsthitaḥ /
pibatyakhilamambhodhimīśvarasya niyogataḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽग्निः संवर्तको नित्यं वडवारूपसंस्थितः /
पिबत्यखिलमम्भोधिमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः //
text_mt: The cosmic fire Saṃvartaka, which perpetually stationed in the form of a mare / drinks the entire ocean by the command of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ye caturdaśa loke 'smin manavaḥ prathitaujasaḥ /
pālayanti prajāḥ sarvāste 'pi tasya niyogataḥ //
meaning:
ये चतुर्दश लोके ऽस्मिन् मनवः प्रथितौजसः /
पालयन्ति प्रजाः सर्वास्ते ऽपि तस्य नियोगतः //
text_mt: The fourteen Manus of renowned power in this world / protect all beings, they too by his appointment.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaśca tathāśvinau /
anyāśca devatāḥ sarvā macchāstreṇaiva dhiṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतश्च तथाश्विनौ /
अन्याश्च देवताः सर्वा मच्छास्त्रेणैव धिष्ठिताः //
text_mt: The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, and Maruts, and likewise the two Aśvins, / and all other deities are governed solely by my law.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvā garuḍā ṛkṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāścacāraṇāḥ /
yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācāśca sthitāḥ śāstre svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वा गरुडा ऋक्षाः सिद्धाः साध्याश्चचारणाः /
यक्षरक्षः पिशाचाश्च स्थिताः शास्त्रे स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: Gandharvas, Garuḍas, bears, Siddhas, Sādhyas, and Cāraṇas, / Yakṣas, Rakṣases, and Piśācas stand in the ordinance of the Self-born.

sanskrit_iast:
kalākāṣṭhānimeṣāśca muhūrtā divasāḥ kṣapāḥ /
ṛtavaḥ pakṣamāsāśca sthitāḥ śāstre prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
कलाकाष्ठानिमेषाश्च मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः /
ऋतवः पक्षमासाश्च स्थिताः शास्त्रे प्रजापतेः //
text_mt: Kalās, kāṣṭhās, twinklings of an eye, muhūrtas, days, nights, / seasons, fortnights, and months stand in the ordinance of the Lord of Creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
yugamanvantarāṇyeva mama tiṣṭhanti śāsane /
parāścaiva parārdhāśca kālabhedāstathā pare //
meaning:
युगमन्वन्तराण्येव मम तिष्ठन्ति शासने /
पराश्चैव परार्धाश्च कालभेदास्तथा परे //
text_mt: Yugas and manvantaras indeed abide in my rule, / as do parā periods and half-parā periods, and other divisions of time.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca /
niyogādeva vartante devasya paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विधानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च /
नियोगादेव वर्तन्ते देवस्य परमात्मनः //
text_mt: The four kinds of beings, both stationary and moving, / exist only by the command of the God, the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
pātālāni ca sarvāṇi bhuvanāni ca śāsanāt /
brahmāṇḍāni ca vartante sarvāṇyeva svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
पातालानि च सर्वाणि भुवनानि च शासनात् /
ब्रह्माण्डानि च वर्तन्ते सर्वाण्येव स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: And all netherworlds and worlds, by the command / of the Self-born, and all cosmic eggs exist.

sanskrit_iast:
atītānyapyasaṃkhyāni brahmāṇḍāni mamājñayā /
pravṛttāni padārthaughaiḥ sahitāni samantataḥ //
meaning:
अतीतान्यप्यसंख्यानि ब्रह्माण्डानि ममाज्ञया /
प्रवृत्तानि पदार्थौघैः सहितानि समन्ततः //
text_mt: Even countless past cosmic eggs, along with / heaps of things on every side, proceeded by my command.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍāni bhaviṣyanti saha vastubhirātmagaiḥ /
vahiṣyanti sadaivājñāṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डानि भविष्यन्ति सह वस्तुभिरात्मगैः /
वहिष्यन्ति सदैवाज्ञां परस्य परमात्मनः //
text_mt: Cosmic eggs will come to be along with their internal objects; / they will always carry out the command of the Supreme, the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca /
bhūtādirādiprakṛtirniyoge mama vartate //
meaning:
भूमिरापो ऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च /
भूतादिरादिप्रकृतिर्नियोगे मम वर्तते //
text_mt: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind, and intellect, / egoity, and primordial matter—all abide in my command.

sanskrit_iast:
yāśeṣajagatāṃ yonirmohinī sarvadehinām /
māyā vivartate nityaṃ sāpīśvaraniyogataḥ //
meaning:
याशेषजगतां योनिर्मोहिनी सर्वदेहिनाम् /
माया विवर्तते नित्यं सापीश्वरनियोगतः //
text_mt: That womb of all the worlds, deluder of all embodied souls, / illusory creative power, revolves perpetually, she too by the command of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yo vai dehabhṛtāṃ devaḥ puruṣaḥ paṭhyate paraḥ /
ātmāsau vartate nityamīśvarasya niyogataḥ //
meaning:
यो वै देहभृतां देवः पुरुषः पठ्यते परः /
आत्मासौ वर्तते नित्यमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः //
text_mt: That god who is proclaimed as the supreme spirit of embodied beings, / that self exists perpetually by the appointment of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhūya mohakalilaṃ yayā paśyati tat padam /
sāpi vidyā maheśasya niyogavaśavartinī //
meaning:
विधूय मोहकलिलं यया पश्यति तत् पदम् /
सापि विद्या महेशस्य नियोगवशवर्तिनी //
text_mt: Shaking off the turbidity of delusion, that [knowledge] by which one sees that state / is also knowledge obedient to the command of the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena mama śaktyātmakaṃ jagat /
mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ mayyeva pralayaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मम शक्त्यात्मकं जगत् /
मयैव प्रेर्यते कृत्स्नं मय्येव प्रलयं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: What need is there of saying much here? The world has my power as its essence; / the whole is impelled by me alone, and in me alone it dissolves.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ hi bhagavānīśaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ /
paramātmā paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate //
meaning:
अहं हि भगवानीशः स्वयं ज्योतिः सनातनः /
परमात्मा परं ब्रह्म मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: For I am the Lord, the master, self-luminous, eternal, / the Supreme Self, the supreme Brahman; indeed nothing else exists other than me.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat paramaṃ jñānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ mayā /
jñātvā vimucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतत् परमं ज्ञानं युष्माकं कथितं मया /
ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते जन्तुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) षष्ठो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this supreme knowledge has been told to you by me; / knowing it, a creature is freed from the bond of birth and transmigratory existence.

Thus ends the sixth chapter in the latter section (in the Īśvaragītā) of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve prabhāvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
yaṃ jñātvā puruṣo mukto na saṃsāre patet punaḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे प्रभावं परमेष्ठिनः /
यं ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो मुक्तो न संसारे पतेत् पुनः //
title: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The Lord said:
Listen, all sages, to the majesty of the Supreme Lord, / knowing which a person is liberated and does not fall back into transmigratory existence.

sanskrit_iast:
parāt parataraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ niṣkalaṃ dhruvam /
nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ mama //
meaning:
परात् परतरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं निष्कलं ध्रुवम् /
नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं तद्धाम परमं मम //
text_mt: Higher than the highest Brahman, eternal, partless, steadfast, / constant bliss, without conceptual construction—that is my supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ brahmavidāṃ brahmā svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ /
māyāvināmahaṃ devaḥ purāṇo hariravyayaḥ //
meaning:
अहं ब्रह्मविदां ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः /
मायाविनामहं देवः पुराणो हरिरव्ययः //
text_mt: Among knowers of Brahman I am Brahmā, the self-born facing every direction; / among wielders of illusory power I am the ancient god, imperishable Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
yogināmasmyahaṃ śaṃbhuḥ strīṇāṃ devī girīndrajā /
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurvasūnāmasmi pāvakaḥ //
meaning:
योगिनामस्म्यहं शंभुः स्त्रीणां देवी गिरीन्द्रजा /
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्वसूनामस्मि पावकः //
text_mt: Among yogins I am Śaṃbhu; among women, the goddess born of the lord of mountains; / among the Ādityas I am Viṣṇu; among the Vasus I am fire.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāhaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāmaham /
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham //
meaning:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चाहं गरुडः पततामहम् /
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् //
text_mt: Among Rudras I am Śaṅkara; among birds I am Garuḍa; / among great elephants I am Airāvata; among weapon-bearers I am Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭho 'haṃ devānāṃ ca śatakratuḥ /
śilpināṃ viśvakarmāhaṃ prahlādo 'smyamaradviṣām //
meaning:
ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठो ऽहं देवानां च शतक्रतुः /
शिल्पिनां विश्वकर्माहं प्रह्लादो ऽस्म्यमरद्विषाम् //
text_mt: Among seers I am Vasiṣṭha; among gods I am Indra of a hundred sacrifices; / among artisans I am Viśvakarman; among enemies of the immortals I am Prahlāda.

sanskrit_iast:
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāso gaṇānāṃ ca vināyakaḥ /
vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadro 'haṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ //
meaning:
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासो गणानां च विनायकः /
वीराणां वीरभद्रो ऽहं सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः //
text_mt: Among sages I am Vyāsa; among the hosts I am Vināyaka; / among warriors I am Vīrabhadra; among the perfected I am the sage Kapila.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāmahaṃ merurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ /
vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyamasmyaham //
meaning:
पर्वतानामहं मेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः /
वज्रं प्रहरणानां च व्रतानां सत्यमस्म्यहम् //
text_mt: Among mountains I am Meru; among constellations, the Moon; / the thunderbolt among weapons; and truth among vows am I.

sanskrit_iast:
ananto bhogināṃ devaḥ senānīnāṃ ca pāvakiḥ /
āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तो भोगिनां देवः सेनानीनां च पावकिः /
आश्रमाणां च गार्हस्थमीश्वराणां महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Among serpent-beings I am the god Ananta; among generals, the son of Fire; / among the stages of life, householdership; among lords, Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākalpaśca kalpānāṃ yugānāṃ kṛtamasmyaham /
kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ ca vīrakaḥ //
meaning:
महाकल्पश्च कल्पानां युगानां कृतमस्म्यहम् /
कुबेरः सर्वयक्षाणां गणेशानां च वीरकः //
text_mt: Among cosmic aeons I am the great aeon; among yugas I am the Kṛta; / Kubera among all Yakṣas; among troop-leaders, Vīraka.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo 'haṃ nirṛtiḥ sarvarakṣasām /
vāyurbalavatāmasmi dvīpānāṃ puṣkaro 'smyaham //
meaning:
प्रजापतीनां दक्षो ऽहं निरृतिः सर्वरक्षसाम् /
वायुर्बलवतामस्मि द्वीपानां पुष्करो ऽस्म्यहम् //
text_mt: Among lords of creatures I am Dakṣa; Nirṛti among all Rakṣases; / I am the wind among the powerful; among continents I am Puṣkara.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgendrāṇāṃ ca siṃho 'haṃ yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca /
vedānāṃ sāmavedo 'haṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam //
meaning:
मृगेन्द्राणां च सिंहो ऽहं यन्त्राणां धनुरेव च /
वेदानां सामवेदो ऽहं यजुषां शतरुद्रियम् //
text_mt: Among kings of beasts I am the lion; among mechanical instruments, the bow; / among Vedas I am the Sāmaveda; among Yajus formulas, the Śatarudrīya.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī sarvajapyānāṃ guhyānāṃ praṇavo 'smyaham /
sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu //
meaning:
सावित्री सर्वजप्यानां गुह्यानां प्रणवो ऽस्म्यहम् /
सूक्तानां पौरुषं सूक्तं ज्येष्ठसाम च सामसु //
text_mt: Among all texts to be muttered I am the Sāvitrī; among secret things, the Praṇava; / among hymns, the hymn to the Puruṣa; and the Jyeṣṭhasāman among sāmans.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedārthaviduṣāṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo 'smyaham /
brahmāvartastu deśānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmavimuktakam //
meaning:
सर्ववेदार्थविदुषां मनुः स्वायंभुवो ऽस्म्यहम् /
ब्रह्मावर्तस्तु देशानां क्षेत्राणामविमुक्तकम् //
text_mt: Among knowers of the meaning of all the Vedas I am Svāyambhuva Manu; / Brahmāvarta among countries; and Avimukta among holy sites.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyānāmātmavidyāhaṃ jñānānāmaiśvaraṃ param /
bhūtānāmasmyahaṃ vyoma sattvānāṃ mṛtyureva ca //
meaning:
विद्यानामात्मविद्याहं ज्ञानानामैश्वरं परम् /
भूतानामस्म्यहं व्योम सत्त्वानां मृत्युरेव च //
text_mt: Among sciences I am the science of the Self; among forms of knowledge, the supreme knowledge of the Lord; / among elements I am space; and among living beings, death itself.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśānāmasmyahaṃ māyā kālaḥ kalayatāmaham /
gatīnāṃ muktirevāhaṃ pareṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
पाशानामस्म्यहं माया कालः कलयतामहम् /
गतीनां मुक्तिरेवाहं परेषां परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Among fetters I am illusory creative power; among those that reckon, I am Time; / among destinations I am liberation; among the highest, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yaccānyadapi loke 'smin sattvaṃ tejobalādhikam /
tatsarvaṃ pratijānīdhvaṃ mama tejovijṛmbhitam //
meaning:
यच्चान्यदपि लोके ऽस्मिन् सत्त्वं तेजोबलाधिकम् /
तत्सर्वं प्रतिजानीध्वं मम तेजोविजृम्भितम् //
text_mt: And whatever other being in this world is preeminent in splendor and power, / understand all that to be a manifestation of my splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaḥ paśavaḥ proktāḥ sarve saṃsāravartinaḥ /
teṣāṃ patirahaṃ devaḥ smṛtaḥ paśupatirbudhaiḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानः पशवः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे संसारवर्तिनः /
तेषां पतिरहं देवः स्मृतः पशुपतिर्बुधैः //
text_mt: All individuals who abide in transmigratory existence are called individual souls; / I, the God, am their lord, recalled by the wise as Paśupati.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāpāśena badhnāmi paśūnetān svalīlayā /
māmeva mocakaṃ prāhuḥ paśūnāṃ vedavādinaḥ //
meaning:
मायापाशेन बध्नामि पशूनेतान् स्वलीलया /
मामेव मोचकं प्राहुः पशूनां वेदवादिनः //
text_mt: With the fetter of illusory creative power I bind these individual souls by my own play; / exponents of the Veda call me alone the liberator of individual souls.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāpāśena baddhānāṃ mocako 'nyo na vidyate /
māmṛte paramātmānaṃ bhūtādhipatimavyayam //
meaning:
मायापाशेन बद्धानां मोचको ऽन्यो न विद्यते /
मामृते परमात्मानं भूताधिपतिमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Of those bound by the fetter of illusory creative power, there is no other liberator / except me, the Supreme Self, the imperishable sovereign of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatitattvāni māyā karma guṇā iti /
ete pāśāḥ paśupateḥ kleśāśca paśubandhanāḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि माया कर्म गुणा इति /
एते पाशाः पशुपतेः क्लेशाश्च पशुबन्धनाः //
text_mt: The twenty-four principles, illusory creative power, action, and the qualities— / these are the fetters of Paśupati, and afflictions, that bind individual souls.

sanskrit_iast:
mano buddhirahaṅkāraḥ khānilāgnijalāni bhūḥ /
etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāśca tathāpare //
meaning:
मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कारः खानिलाग्निजलानि भूः /
एताः प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकाराश्च तथापरे //
text_mt: Mind, intellect, egoity, space, wind, fire, water, and earth— / these are the eight primary source-materials, and the others are modifications.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu pañcamam /
pāyūpasthaṃ karau pādau vāk caiva daśamī matā //
meaning:
श्रोत्रं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणं चैव तु पञ्चमम् /
पायूपस्थं करौ पादौ वाक् चैव दशमी मता //
text_mt: The ear, skin, two eyes, tongue, and fifth the nose; / the anus, genitals, two hands, two feet, and tenth is considered speech;

sanskrit_iast:
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca /
trayoviṃśatiretāni tattvāni prākṛtāni tu //
meaning:
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च /
त्रयोविंशतिरेतानि तत्त्वानि प्राकृतानि तु //
text_mt: sound, touch, form, taste, and likewise smell: / these twenty-three principles indeed belong to primordial matter.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśakamavyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam /
anādimadhyanidhanaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ param //
meaning:
चतुर्विंशकमव्यक्तं प्रधानं गुणलक्षणम् /
अनादिमध्यनिधनं कारणं जगतः परम् //
text_mt: The twenty-fourth is the unmanifest pradhāna, characterized by qualities, / without beginning, middle, or end, the supreme cause of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti guṇatrayamudāhṛtam /
sāmyāvasthitimeteṣāmavyaktaṃ prakṛtiṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति गुणत्रयमुदाहृतम् /
साम्यावस्थितिमेतेषामव्यक्तं प्रकृतिं विदुः //
text_mt: Sattva, rajas, and tamas: thus is the triad of qualities declared; / the state of equilibrium of these they know as the unmanifest primordial matter.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo 'jñānaṃ rajo miśramudāhṛtam /
guṇānāṃ buddhivaiṣamyād vaiṣamyaṃ kavayo viduḥ //
meaning:
सत्त्वं ज्ञानं तमो ऽज्ञानं रजो मिश्रमुदाहृतम् /
गुणानां बुद्धिवैषम्याद् वैषम्यं कवयो विदुः //
text_mt: Sattva is declared to be knowledge, tamas ignorance, and rajas a mixture; / poets know that the disparity of qualities arises from the disparity of the intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmāviti proktau pāśau dvau bandhasaṃjñitau /
mayyarpitāni karmāṇi nibandhāya vimuktaye //
meaning:
धर्माधर्माविति प्रोक्तौ पाशौ द्वौ बन्धसंज्ञितौ /
मय्यर्पितानि कर्माणि निबन्धाय विमुक्तये //
text_mt: Righteousness and unrighteousness are spoken of as the two snares designated as bondage; / actions offered to me [do not lead] to bondage, [but] to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
avidyāmasmitāṃ rāgaṃ dveṣaṃ cābhiniveśakam /
kleśākhyānacalān prāhuḥ pāśānātmanibandhanān //
meaning:
अविद्यामस्मितां रागं द्वेषं चाभिनिवेशकम् /
क्लेशाख्यानचलान् प्राहुः पाशानात्मनिबन्धनान् //
text_mt: Ignorance, egoism, passion, hatred, and tenacity: / these, called afflictions and unmoving, they declare as the snares binding the self.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmeva pāśānāṃ māyā kāraṇamucyate /
mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sā śaktirmayi tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
एतेषामेव पाशानां माया कारणमुच्यते /
मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सा शक्तिर्मयि तिष्ठति //
text_mt: Of these very snares, illusory creative power is said to be the cause; / that unmanifest primordial root-matter, that power resides in me.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva mūlaprakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣo 'pi ca /
vikārā mahadādīni devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
स एव मूलप्रकृतिः प्रधानं पुरुषो ऽपि च /
विकारा महदादीनि देवदेवः सनातनः //
text_mt: He alone is primordial root-matter, pradhāna, and the spirit; / the modifications beginning with the intellect [are he], the eternal god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva bandhaḥ sa ca bandhakartā
sa eva pāśaḥ paśavaḥ sa eva /
sa veda sarvaṃ na ca tasya vettā
tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स एव बन्धः स च बन्धकर्ता
स एव पाशः पशवः स एव /
स वेद सर्वं न च तस्य वेत्ता
तमाहुरग्र्यं पुरुषं पुराणम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He alone is bondage, and he is the maker of bondage; / he alone is the snare, and the bound beasts are he alone; / he knows all, and there is no knower of him; / they declare him to be the foremost, ancient spirit.

Thus ends the seventh chapter in the Latter Section (in the Īśvaragītā) in the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
anyad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ vakṣye brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ /
yenāsau tarate janturghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अन्यद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं वक्ष्ये ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवाः /
येनासौ तरते जन्तुर्घोरं संसारसागरम् //
title: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall declare another most secret knowledge, O best of brahmins, / by which a living being crosses over the terrible ocean of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ brahmamayaḥ śāntaḥ śāśvato nirmalo 'vyayaḥ /
ekākī bhagavānuktaḥ kevalaḥ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अहं ब्रह्ममयः शान्तः शाश्वतो निर्मलो ऽव्ययः /
एकाकी भगवानुक्तः केवलः परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: I am composed of Brahman, peaceful, eternal, spotless, imperishable, / the solitary Lord, declared as the absolute, supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
mama yonirmahad brahma tatra garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham /
mūlaṃ māyābhidhānaṃ tu tato jātamidaṃ jagat //
meaning:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तत्र गर्भं दधाम्यहम् /
मूलं मायाभिधानं तु ततो जातमिदं जगत् //
text_mt: My womb is the great Brahman; into it I place the seed; / the root is named illusory creative power, and from that this world was born.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānaṃ puruṣo hyatmā mahān bhūtādireva ca /
tanmātrāṇi mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi ca jajñire //
meaning:
प्रधानं पुरुषो ह्यत्मा महान् भूतादिरेव च /
तन्मात्राणि महाभूतानीन्द्रियाणि च जज्ञिरे //
text_mt: Pradhāna, the spirit, the self, the intellect, and the origin of elements, / the subtle elements, the gross elements, and the sense organs were born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ṇḍamabhavaddhaimaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham /
tasmin jajñe mahābrahmā macchaktyā copabṛṃhitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽण्डमभवद्धैमं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् /
तस्मिन् जज्ञे महाब्रह्मा मच्छक्त्या चोपबृंहितः //
text_mt: From that arose a golden egg equal in radiance to ten million suns; / within it the great Brahmā was born, augmented by my power.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye bahavo jīvā manmayāḥ sarva eva te /
na māṃ paśyanti pitaraṃ māyayā mama mohitāḥ //
meaning:
ये चान्ये बहवो जीवा मन्मयाः सर्व एव ते /
न मां पश्यन्ति पितरं मायया मम मोहिताः //
text_mt: And whatever other many living beings exist, they all consist of me; / deluded by my illusory creative power, they do not see me, their father.

sanskrit_iast:
yāśca yoniṣu sarvāsu saṃbhavanti hi mūrtayaḥ /
tāsāṃ māyā parā yonirmāmeva pitaraṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
याश्च योनिषु सर्वासु संभवन्ति हि मूर्तयः /
तासां माया परा योनिर्मामेव पितरं विदुः //
text_mt: And whatever forms arise in all wombs, / of them illusory creative power is the supreme womb; they know me alone as the father.

sanskrit_iast:
yo māmevaṃ vijānāti bījinaṃ pitaraṃ prabhum /
sa dhīraḥ sarvalokeṣu na mohamadhigacchati //
meaning:
यो मामेवं विजानाति बीजिनं पितरं प्रभुम् /
स धीरः सर्वलोकेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति //
text_mt: He who knows me thus as the seed-giver, the father, the lord, / that wise person does not fall into delusion in any world.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ /
oṅkāramūrtirbhagavānahaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
ईशानः सर्वविद्यानां भूतानां परमेश्वरः /
ओङ्कारमूर्तिर्भगवानहं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: I am the ruler of all branches of knowledge, the supreme lord of beings, / the Lord whose form is the syllable Oṃ, Brahmā, the lord of creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram /
vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati //
meaning:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् /
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति //
text_mt: He who sees the supreme lord dwelling equally in all beings, / not perishing among those that perish, he truly sees.

sanskrit_iast:
samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram /
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṅgatim //
meaning:
समं पश्यन् हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् /
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति पराङ्गतिम् //
text_mt: For seeing the lord equally abiding everywhere, / he does not injure the self by the self; therefore he attains the supreme path.

sanskrit_iast:
viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca maheśvaram /
pradhānaviniyogajñaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati //
meaning:
विदित्वा सप्त सूक्ष्माणि षडङ्गं च महेश्वरम् /
प्रधानविनियोगज्ञः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति //
text_mt: Knowing the seven subtle [principles] and Maheśvara endowed with six limbs, / he who knows the operation of pradhāna attains the supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñatā tṛptiranādibodhaḥ
svatantratā nityamaluptaśaktiḥ /
anantaśaktiśca vibhorviditvā
ṣaḍāhuraṅgāni maheśvarasya //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञता तृप्तिरनादिबोधः
स्वतन्त्रता नित्यमलुप्तशक्तिः /
अनन्तशक्तिश्च विभोर्विदित्वा
षडाहुरङ्गानि महेश्वरस्य //
text_mt: Omniscience, contentment, beginningless understanding, / independence, power ever unfailing, / and infinite power: knowing [these] of the all-pervading lord, / they declare them to be the six limbs of Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmātrāṇi mana ātmā ca tāni
sūkṣmāṇyāhuḥ sapta tattvātmakāni /
yā sā hetuḥ prakṛtiḥ sā pradhānaṃ
bandhaḥ prokto viniyogo 'pi tena //
meaning:
तन्मात्राणि मन आत्मा च तानि
सूक्ष्माण्याहुः सप्त तत्त्वात्मकानि /
या सा हेतुः प्रकृतिः सा प्रधानं
बन्धः प्रोक्तो विनियोगो ऽपि तेन //
text_mt: The subtle elements, the mind, and the self: these / they call the seven subtle [principles] consisting of entities; / that which is the cause, primordial matter, is pradhāna; / bondage is declared [by it], and by it also employment [and liberation].

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā śaktiḥ prakṛtau līnarūpā
vedeṣūktā kāraṇaṃ brahmayoniḥ /
tasyā ekaḥ parameṣṭhī parastā-
nmaheśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ satyarūpaḥ //
meaning:
या सा शक्तिः प्रकृतौ लीनरूपा
वेदेषूक्ता कारणं ब्रह्मयोनिः /
तस्या एकः परमेष्ठी परस्ता-
न्महेश्वरः पुरुषः सत्यरूपः //
text_mt: That power which has a latent form in primordial matter, / declared in the Vedas as the cause, the womb of Brahman: / beyond it is the one Parameṣṭhin, / Maheśvara, the spirit whose nature is truth.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā yogī paramātmā mahīyān
vyomavyāpī vedavedyaḥ purāṇaḥ /
eko rudro mṛtyuravyaktamekaṃ
bījaṃ viśvaṃ deva ekaḥ sa eva //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा योगी परमात्मा महीयान्
व्योमव्यापी वेदवेद्यः पुराणः /
एको रुद्रो मृत्युरव्यक्तमेकं
बीजं विश्वं देव एकः स एव //
text_mt: Brahmā, the yogin, the supreme self, the most exalted, / pervading space, to be known through the Vedas, the ancient one, / the one Rudra, death, the single unmanifest, / the seed, the universe—that god alone is the one.

sanskrit_iast:
tamevaikaṃ prāhuranye 'pyanekaṃ
tvekātmānaṃ kecidanyattathāhuḥ /
aṇoraṇīyān mahato 'sau mahīyān
mahādevaḥ procyate vedavidbhiḥ //
meaning:
तमेवैकं प्राहुरन्ये ऽप्यनेकं
त्वेकात्मानं केचिदन्यत्तथाहुः /
अणोरणीयान् महतो ऽसौ महीयान्
महादेवः प्रोच्यते वेदविद्भिः //
text_mt: Others declare that very one to be manifold, / but some declare him to be of single self, and others otherwise; / smaller than the smallest, greater than the greatest, / that Mahādeva is proclaimed by knowers of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi yo veda guhāśayaṃ paraṃ
prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam /
hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ
sa buddhimān buddhimatītya tiṣṭhati //
iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एवं हि यो वेद गुहाशयं परं
प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं विश्वरूपम् /
हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं
स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपाराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) अष्टमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He who thus knows the ancient lord lying hidden in the cave, / the supreme spirit whose form is the universe, / the golden one, the supreme goal of the intelligent, / that intelligent person stands having transcended the intellect.

Thus ends the eighth chapter in the Latter Section (in the Īśvaragītā) in the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
niṣkalo nirmalo nityo niṣkriyaḥ parameśvaraḥ /
tanno vada mahādeva viśvarūpaḥ kathaṃ bhavān //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
निष्कलो निर्मलो नित्यो निष्क्रियः परमेश्वरः /
तन्नो वद महादेव विश्वरूपः कथं भवान् //
title: navamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / The supreme lord is partless, spotless, eternal, and inactive; / therefore tell us, O Mahādeva: how is your lordship of universal form?

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
nāhaṃ viśvo na viśvaṃ ca māmṛte vidyate dvijāḥ /
māyānimittamatrāsti sā cātmānamapāśritā //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
नाहं विश्वो न विश्वं च मामृते विद्यते द्विजाः /
मायानिमित्तमत्रास्ति सा चात्मानमपाश्रिता //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I am not the universe, nor does the universe exist without me, O twice-born ones; / the cause here is illusory creative power, and that rests upon the self.

sanskrit_iast:
anādinidhanā śaktirmāyāvyaktasamāśrayā /
tannimittaḥ prapañco 'yamavyaktādabhavat khalu //
meaning:
अनादिनिधना शक्तिर्मायाव्यक्तसमाश्रया /
तन्निमित्तः प्रपञ्चो ऽयमव्यक्तादभवत् खलु //
text_mt: Power without beginning or end, illusory creative power has taken refuge in the unmanifest; / this manifold expansion caused by it indeed arose from the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ prāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram /
ahameva paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं कारणं प्राहुरानन्दं ज्योतिरक्षरम् /
अहमेव परं ब्रह्म मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: They declare the unmanifest to be the cause, bliss, imperishable light; / I alone am the supreme Brahman; indeed nothing other than me exists.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānme viśvarūpatvaṃ niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ /
ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca proktametannidarśanam //
meaning:
तस्मान्मे विश्वरूपत्वं निश्चितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः /
एकत्वे च पृथक्त्वे च प्रोक्तमेतन्निदर्शनम् //
text_mt: Therefore my nature as universal form has been ascertained by knowers of Brahman; / both in unity and in differentiation, this illustration is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tat paramaṃ brahma paramātmā sanātanaḥ /
akāraṇaṃ dvijāḥ prokto na doṣo hyātmanastathā //
meaning:
अहं तत् परमं ब्रह्म परमात्मा सनातनः /
अकारणं द्विजाः प्रोक्तो न दोषो ह्यात्मनस्तथा //
text_mt: I am that supreme Brahman, the eternal supreme self; / I am declared causeless, O twice-born ones, and likewise there is no flaw in the self.

sanskrit_iast:
anantā śaktayo 'vyakte māyādyāḥ saṃsthitā dhruvāḥ /
tasmin divi sthitaṃ nityamavyaktaṃ bhāti kevalam //
meaning:
अनन्ता शक्तयो ऽव्यक्ते मायाद्याः संस्थिता ध्रुवाः /
तस्मिन् दिवि स्थितं नित्यमव्यक्तं भाति केवलम् //
text_mt: In the unmanifest are stationed infinite, fixed powers beginning with illusory creative power; / in that heaven, the eternal, unmanifest [reality] shines as the absolute alone.

sanskrit_iast:
yābhistallakṣyate bhinnamabhinnaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ /
ekayā mama sāyujyamanādinidhanaṃ dhruvam //
meaning:
याभिस्तल्लक्ष्यते भिन्नमभिन्नं तु स्वभावतः /
एकया मम सायुज्यमनादिनिधनं ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: By which [powers] that [reality], although undifferentiated by nature, is perceived as differentiated; / by one [power] there is complete union with me, beginningless, endless, and constant.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃso 'bhūdanyayā bhūtiranyayā tattirohitam /
anādimadhyaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ yujyate 'vidyayā kila //
meaning:
पुंसो ऽभूदन्यया भूतिरन्यया तत्तिरोहितम् /
अनादिमध्यं तिष्ठन्तं युज्यते ऽविद्यया किल //
text_mt: By another came about the manifestation of the person; by another that is concealed; / indeed, through ignorance he becomes attached, although standing without beginning or middle.

sanskrit_iast:
tadetat paramaṃ vyaktaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam /
tadakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
तदेतत् परमं व्यक्तं प्रभामण्डलमण्डितम् /
तदक्षरं परं ज्योतिस्तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् //
text_mt: That very supreme is manifest, adorned with a circle of radiance; / that is the imperishable, supreme light, that is the supreme step of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat /
tadeva ca jagat kṛtsnaṃ tad vijñāya vimucyate //
meaning:
तत्र सर्वमिदं प्रोतमोतं चैवाखिलं जगत् /
तदेव च जगत् कृत्स्नं तद् विज्ञाय विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Upon that all this is woven and interwoven, the entire world; / that alone is the whole world; having known that, one is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha /
ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān vibheti na kutaścana //
meaning:
यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह /
आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् विभेति न कुतश्चन //
text_mt: From which words turn back, along with the mind, without attaining it; / knowing the bliss of Brahman, one is not afraid of anything.

sanskrit_iast:
vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahānta-
mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt /
tad vijñāya parimucyeta vidvān
nityānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ //
meaning:
वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्त-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् /
तद् विज्ञाय परिमुच्येत विद्वान्
नित्यानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः //
text_mt: "I know this great Puruṣa, / sun-colored, beyond darkness." / Knowing that, the wise man is liberated; / he becomes one who has become Brahman, possessing eternal bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti kiñcit
yajjyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ divistham /
tadevātmānaṃ manyamāno 'tha vidvān
ātmānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ //
meaning:
यस्मात् परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चित्
यज्ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरेकं दिविस्थम् /
तदेवात्मानं मन्यमानो ऽथ विद्वान्
आत्मानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः //
text_mt: Higher than whom there is nothing else, / who is the single light among lights abiding in heaven— / the wise man, considering that very reality to be his own Self, / becomes one who has become Brahman, rejoicing in the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tadavyayaṃ kalilaṃ gūḍhadehaṃ
brahmānandamamṛtaṃ viśvadhāma /
vadantyevaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmaniṣṭhā
yatra gatvā na nivarteta bhūyaḥ //
meaning:
तदव्ययं कलिलं गूढदेहं
ब्रह्मानन्दममृतं विश्वधाम /
वदन्त्येवं ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मनिष्ठा
यत्र गत्वा न निवर्तेत भूयः //
text_mt: That imperishable, impenetrable, of hidden body, / the bliss of Brahman, immortal, the abode of all— / thus proclaim the brahmins devoted to Brahman, / going where one does not return again.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇmaye paramākāśatattve
yadarciṣi pravibhātīva tejaḥ /
tadvijñāne paripaśyanti dhīrā
vibhrājamānaṃ vimalaṃ vyoma dhāma //
meaning:
हिरण्मये परमाकाशतत्त्वे
यदर्चिषि प्रविभातीव तेजः /
तद्विज्ञाने परिपश्यन्ति धीरा
विभ्राजमानं विमलं व्योम धाम //
text_mt: In the golden, supreme element of space, / that light which shines forth, as it were, in the flame— / in the realization of that, the wise behold / the radiant, immaculate abode of space.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paraṃ paripaśyanti dhīrā
ātmanyātmānamanubhūyānubhūya /
svayaṃprabhaḥ parameṣṭhī mahīyān
brahmānandī bhagavānīśa eṣaḥ //
meaning:
ततः परं परिपश्यन्ति धीरा
आत्मन्यात्मानमनुभूयानुभूय /
स्वयंप्रभः परमेष्ठी महीयान्
ब्रह्मानन्दी भगवानीश एषः //
text_mt: Beyond that, the wise behold [it], / experiencing the Self again and again in the self: / self-luminous, dwelling in the supreme, greatest, / joyful in Brahman, the Blessed Lord, this Sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ
sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā /
tamevaikaṃ ye 'nupaśyanti dhīrās
teṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām //
meaning:
एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढः
सर्वव्यापी सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा /
तमेवैकं ये ऽनुपश्यन्ति धीरास्
तेषां शान्तिः शाश्वती नेतरेषाम् //
text_mt: The one God hidden in all beings, / all-pervading, the inner Self of all beings— / the wise who behold that one alone, / eternal peace is theirs, not of others.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānanaśirogrīvaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ /
sarvavyāpī ca bhagavān na tasmādanyadiṣyate //
meaning:
सर्वाननशिरोग्रीवः सर्वभूतगुहाशयः /
सर्वव्यापी च भगवान् न तस्मादन्यदिष्यते //
text_mt: With faces, heads, and necks everywhere, resting in the cave of all beings, / the Blessed Lord is all-pervading; nothing other than him is accepted.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetadaiśvaraṃ jñānamuktaṃ vo munipuṅgavāḥ /
gopanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa yogināmapi durlabham //
iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतदैश्वरं ज्ञानमुक्तं वो मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
गोपनीयं विशेषेण योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपाराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) नवमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this knowledge of the Lord has been told to you, O best of sages; / it must be guarded especially; it is difficult to attain even for yogins.

Thus ends the ninth chapter in the latter section (in the Īśvaragītā) of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
aliṅgamekamavyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeti niścitam /
svayañjyotiḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ pare vyomni vyavasthitam //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अलिङ्गमेकमव्यक्तं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मेति निश्चितम् /
स्वयञ्ज्योतिः परं तत्त्वं परे व्योम्नि व्यवस्थितम् //
title: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The Lord said:
The signless is one, unmanifest; the sign is established to be Brahman, / self-luminous, the supreme reality, situated in the highest space.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattadakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam /
nirguṇaṃ śuddhavijñānaṃ tad vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तदक्षरं परमं पदम् /
निर्गुणं शुद्धविज्ञानं तद् वै पश्यन्ति सूरयः //
text_mt: The unmanifest, which is the cause, the imperishable, the supreme state, / devoid of qualities, pure consciousness—that indeed the wise behold.

sanskrit_iast:
tanniṣṭhāḥ śāntasaṃkalpā nityaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitāḥ /
paśyanti tat paraṃ brahma yattalliṅgamiti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
तन्निष्ठाः शान्तसंकल्पा नित्यं तद्भावभाविताः /
पश्यन्ति तत् परं ब्रह्म यत्तल्लिङ्गमिति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Devoted to that, with resolved thoughts stilled, constantly absorbed in its nature, / they behold that supreme Brahman, which sacred revelation says is the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā nahi māṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ vai munipuṅgavāḥ /
nahi tad vidyate jñānaṃ yatastajjñāyate param //
meaning:
अन्यथा नहि मां द्रष्टुं शक्यं वै मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
नहि तद् विद्यते ज्ञानं यतस्तज्ज्ञायते परम् //
text_mt: Otherwise, it is certainly not possible to see me, O best of sages; / for that knowledge does not exist by which that supreme can be known.

sanskrit_iast:
etattatparamaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ kavayo viduḥ /
ajñānamitarat sarvaṃ yasmānmāyāmayaṃ jagat //
meaning:
एतत्तत्परमं ज्ञानं केवलं कवयो विदुः /
अज्ञानमितरत् सर्वं यस्मान्मायामयं जगत् //
text_mt: This is that supreme knowledge, alone, which the wise know; / everything else is ignorance, because the universe consists of illusory creative power.

sanskrit_iast:
yajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ yadavyayam /
mamātmāsau tadevemiti prāhurvipaścitaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ज्ञानं निर्मलं सूक्ष्मं निर्विकल्पं यदव्ययम् /
ममात्मासौ तदेवेमिति प्राहुर्विपश्चितः //
text_mt: That knowledge which is stainless, subtle, non-conceptual, which is imperishable— / that very thing is my Self: thus the wise have declared.

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'pyanekaṃ prapaśyanti te 'pi paśyanti tatparam /
āśritāḥ paramāṃ niṣṭhāṃ buddhvaikaṃ tattvamavyayam //
meaning:
ये ऽप्यनेकं प्रपश्यन्ति ते ऽपि पश्यन्ति तत्परम् /
आश्रिताः परमां निष्ठां बुद्ध्वैकं तत्त्वमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Even those who see the manifold, they too behold that supreme [reality], / having resorted to the highest devotion, realizing the one imperishable principle.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punaḥ paramaṃ tattvamekaṃ vānekamīśvaram /
bhaktyā māṃ saṃprapaśyanti vijñeyāste tadātmakāḥ //
meaning:
ये पुनः परमं तत्त्वमेकं वानेकमीश्वरम् /
भक्त्या मां संप्रपश्यन्ति विज्ञेयास्ते तदात्मकाः //
text_mt: Furthermore, those who behold the supreme principle, the Lord, as one or many, / with devotion seeing me, they should be understood to be of that very nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣādeva prapaśyanti svātmānaṃ parameśvaram /
nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ satyarūpamiti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
साक्षादेव प्रपश्यन्ति स्वात्मानं परमेश्वरम् /
नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं सत्यरूपमिति स्थितिः //
text_mt: Directly indeed they behold their own Self, the Supreme Lord, / eternally blissful, non-conceptual, whose form is truth: such is the established truth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhajante paramānandaṃ sarvagaṃ yattadātmakam /
svātmanyavasthitāḥ śāntāḥ pare 'vyakte parasya tu //
meaning:
भजन्ते परमानन्दं सर्वगं यत्तदात्मकम् /
स्वात्मन्यवस्थिताः शान्ताः परे ऽव्यक्ते परस्य तु //
text_mt: They worship supreme bliss, all-pervading, whose nature is that, / abiding in their own self, pacified, in the supreme unmanifest of the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā vimuktiḥ paramā mama sāyujyamuttamam /
nirvāṇaṃ brahmaṇā caikyaṃ kaivalyaṃ kavayo viduḥ //
meaning:
एषा विमुक्तिः परमा मम सायुज्यमुत्तमम् /
निर्वाणं ब्रह्मणा चैक्यं कैवल्यं कवयो विदुः //
text_mt: This is supreme liberation, my highest complete union; / extinction and oneness with Brahman, absolute isolation, the wise know [it to be].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vastvekaṃ paramaṃ śivam /
sa īśvaro mahādevastaṃ vijñāya vimucyate //
meaning:
तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं वस्त्वेकं परमं शिवम् /
स ईश्वरो महादेवस्तं विज्ञाय विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Therefore, the one supreme reality, without beginning, middle, or end, is Śiva; / he is the Lord, Mahādeva; knowing him, one is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
na tatra sūryaḥ pravibhātīha candro
na nakṣatrāṇi tapano nota vidyut /
tadbhāsedamakhilaṃ bhāti nityaṃ
tannityabhāsamacalaṃ sadvibhāti //
meaning:
न तत्र सूर्यः प्रविभातीह चन्द्रो
न नक्षत्राणि तपनो नोत विद्युत् /
तद्भासेदमखिलं भाति नित्यं
तन्नित्यभासमचलं सद्विभाति //
text_mt: There the sun does not shine, nor here the moon, / nor stars, nor fire, nor lightning; / by his light all this shines constantly; / that eternal light, immovable, exists shining.

sanskrit_iast:
nityoditaṃ saṃvidā nirvikalpaṃ
śuddhaṃ bṛhantaṃ paramaṃ yadvibhāti /
atrāntaraṃ brahmavido 'tha nityaṃ
paśyanti tattvamacalaṃ yat sa īśaḥ //
meaning:
नित्योदितं संविदा निर्विकल्पं
शुद्धं बृहन्तं परमं यद्विभाति /
अत्रान्तरं ब्रह्मविदो ऽथ नित्यं
पश्यन्ति तत्त्वमचलं यत् स ईशः //
text_mt: Eternally risen, non-conceptual through consciousness, / pure, vast, supreme, which shines forth— / within this the knowers of Brahman constantly / behold the immovable reality, which is the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
nityānandamamṛtaṃ satyarūpaṃ
śuddhaṃ vadanti puruṣaṃ sarvavedāḥ /
tadevedamiti praṇaveneśitāraṃ
dhāyāyanti vedārthaviniścitārthāḥ //
meaning:
नित्यानन्दममृतं सत्यरूपं
शुद्धं वदन्ति पुरुषं सर्ववेदाः /
तदेवेदमिति प्रणवेनेशितारं
धायायन्ति वेदार्थविनिश्चितार्थाः //
text_mt: Eternally blissful, immortal, whose nature is truth, / pure, all the Vedas proclaim the Puruṣa; / thinking "That alone is this," by the Praṇava / those whose purpose is determined by the Vedic meaning meditate on the Ruler.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhūmirāpo na mano na vahniḥ
prāṇo 'nilo gaganaṃ nota buddhiḥ /
na cetano 'nyat paramākāśamadhye
vibhāti devaḥ śiva eva kevalaḥ //
meaning:
न भूमिरापो न मनो न वह्निः
प्राणो ऽनिलो गगनं नोत बुद्धिः /
न चेतनो ऽन्यत् परमाकाशमध्ये
विभाति देवः शिव एव केवलः //
text_mt: Neither earth, nor waters, nor mind, nor fire, / nor breath, nor wind, nor ether, nor intellect; / nor any other conscious being in the midst of supreme space— / God alone, Śiva, shines.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetaduktaṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ sarvavedeṣu gūḍham /
jānāti yogī vijane 'tha deśe
yuñjīta yogaṃ prayato hyajasram //
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतदुक्तं परमं रहस्यं
ज्ञानामृतं सर्ववेदेषु गूढम् /
जानाति योगी विजने ऽथ देशे
युञ्जीत योगं प्रयतो ह्यजस्रम् //
इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) दशमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this supreme secret has been spoken, / the nectar of knowledge hidden in all the Vedas; / the yogin who knows it should, in a solitary place, / practice yoga constantly, with self-restraint.

Thus ends the tenth chapter in the latter section (in the Īśvaragītā) of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaṃ paramadurlabham /
yenātmānaṃ prapaśyanti bhānumantamiveśvaram //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगं परमदुर्लभम् /
येनात्मानं प्रपश्यन्ति भानुमन्तमिवेश्वरम् //
title: ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
The Lord said:
Hereafter I shall proclaim yoga, supreme and exceedingly difficult to attain, / by which they behold the Self, the Lord, like the shining sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yogāgnirdahati kṣipramaśeṣaṃ pāpapañjaram /
prasannaṃ jāyate jñānaṃ sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam //
meaning:
योगाग्निर्दहति क्षिप्रमशेषं पापपञ्जरम् /
प्रसन्नं जायते ज्ञानं साक्षान्निर्वाणसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt: The fire of yoga swiftly burns the entire cage of sins; / serene knowledge arises, directly granting the perfection of extinction.

sanskrit_iast:
yogātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ jñānād yogaḥ pravartate /
yogajñānābhiyuktasya prasīdati maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
योगात्संजायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद् योगः प्रवर्तते /
योगज्ञानाभियुक्तस्य प्रसीदति महेश्वरः //
text_mt: From yoga arises knowledge; from knowledge yoga proceeds; / toward one endowed with yoga and knowledge, the Great Lord is gracious.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva vā /
ye yuñjantīha madyogaṃ te vijñeyā maheśvarāḥ //
meaning:
एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं नित्यमेव वा /
ये युञ्जन्तीह मद्योगं ते विज्ञेया महेश्वराः //
text_mt: Once a day, or twice, or thrice, or constantly, / those who here practice my yoga are to be known as great lords.

sanskrit_iast:
yogastu dvividho jñeyo hyabhāvaḥ prathamo mataḥ /
aparastu mahāyogaḥ sarvayogottamottamaḥ //
meaning:
योगस्तु द्विविधो ज्ञेयो ह्यभावः प्रथमो मतः /
अपरस्तु महायोगः सर्वयोगोत्तमोत्तमः //
text_mt: Yoga, however, is to be known as two-fold: the yoga of non-existence is considered the first, / and the other is the Great Yoga, the highest among all yogas.

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyaṃ sarvanirābhāsaṃ svarūpaṃ yatra cintyate /
abhāvayogaḥ sa prokto yenātmānaṃ prapaśyati //
meaning:
शून्यं सर्वनिराभासं स्वरूपं यत्र चिन्त्यते /
अभावयोगः स प्रोक्तो येनात्मानं प्रपश्यति //
text_mt: Where one's own nature is meditated upon as void, devoid of all appearance, / that is declared to be the yoga of non-existence, by which one beholds the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra paśyati cātmānaṃ nityānandaṃ nirañjanam /
mayaikyaṃ sa mahāyogo bhāṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यत्र पश्यति चात्मानं नित्यानन्दं निरञ्जनम् /
मयैक्यं स महायोगो भाषितः परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: And where one beholds the Self as eternal bliss, stainless, / united with me—that is declared to be the Great Yoga, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye yogināṃ yogāḥ śrūyante granthavistare /
sarve te brahmayogasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
ये चान्ये योगिनां योगाः श्रूयन्ते ग्रन्थविस्तरे /
सर्वे ते ब्रह्मयोगस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् //
text_mt: And whatever other yogas of yogins are heard in the extensive treatises, / all of them are not worth a sixteenth part of the yoga of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sākṣāt prapaśyanti vimuktā viśvamīśvaram /
sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ sa yogaḥ paramo mataḥ //
meaning:
यत्र साक्षात् प्रपश्यन्ति विमुक्ता विश्वमीश्वरम् /
सर्वेषामेव योगानां स योगः परमो मतः //
text_mt: Where the liberated directly behold the universe as the Lord, / of all yogas that yoga is considered supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśo 'tha śataśo ye ceśvarabahiṣkṛtāḥ /
na te paśyanti māmekaṃ yogino yatamānasāḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रशो ऽथ शतशो ये चेश्वरबहिष्कृताः /
न ते पश्यन्ति मामेकं योगिनो यतमानसाः //
text_mt: By hundreds and thousands, those who are excluded from the Lord, / even as yogins with controlled minds, do not behold me, the One.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmastathā dhyānaṃ pratyāhāro 'tha dhāraṇā /
samādhiśca muniśreṣṭhā yamo niyama āsanam //
meaning:
प्राणायामस्तथा ध्यानं प्रत्याहारो ऽथ धारणा /
समाधिश्च मुनिश्रेष्ठा यमो नियम आसनम् //
text_mt: Breath control, as well as meditation, sensory withdrawal, and concentration, / and absorption, O best of sages, restraint, observance, posture—

sanskrit_iast:
mayyekacittatāyogo vṛttyantaranirodhataḥ /
tatsādhanānyaṣṭadhā tu yuṣmākaṃ kathitāni tu //
meaning:
मय्येकचित्ततायोगो वृत्त्यन्तरनिरोधतः /
तत्साधनान्यष्टधा तु युष्माकं कथितानि तु //
text_mt: Yoga is single-mindedness upon me through the cessation of other mental activities; / its eightfold means have indeed been spoken to you.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau /
yamāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ proktāścittaśuddhipradā nṛṇām //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ /
यमाः संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ताश्चित्तशुद्धिप्रदा नृणाम् //
text_mt: Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, and non-possession: / these are briefly declared to be the restraints, granting purity of mind to mortals.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā /
akleśajananaṃ proktaṃ tvahiṃsā paramarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा /
अक्लेशजननं प्रोक्तं त्वहिंसा परमर्षिभिः //
text_mt: By action, thought, or speech toward all beings at all times, / causing no affliction is declared by the supreme rṣis to be non-violence.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsāyāḥ paro dharmo nāstyahiṃsā paraṃ sukham /
vidhinā yā bhaveddhiṃsā tvahiṃsaiva prakīrtitā //
meaning:
