He should not play with snakes or weapons, nor touch his bodily apertures,
nor the hairs of secret parts; nor should he travel with an uncultured person.

sanskrit_iast:
na pāṇipādavāṅnetracāpalyaṃ samupāśrayet /
na śiśnodaracāpalyaṃ na ca śravaṇayoḥ kvacit //
meaning:
न पाणिपादवाङ्नेत्रचापल्यं समुपाश्रयेत् /
न शिश्नोदरचापल्यं न च श्रवणयोः क्वचित् //
text_mt:
He should not resort to restlessness of the hands, feet, speech, or eyes;
never to restlessness of the penis and belly, nor of the ears.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāṅganakhavādaṃ vai kuryānnāñjalinā pibet /
nābhihanyājjalaṃ padbhyāṃ pāṇinā vā kadācana //
meaning:
न चाङ्गनखवादं वै कुर्यान्नाञ्जलिना पिबेत् /
नाभिहन्याज्जलं पद्भ्यां पाणिना वा कदाचन //
text_mt:
He should not make sounds with his limbs or fingernails, nor drink from cupped hands;
he should never strike water with his feet or with his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
na śātayediṣṭakābhiḥ phalāni na phalena ca /
na mlecchabhāṣāṃ śikṣeta nākarṣecca padāsanam //
meaning:
न शातयेदिष्टकाभिः फलानि न फलेन च /
न म्लेच्छभाषां शिक्षेत नाकर्षेच्च पदासनम् //
text_mt:
He should not knock down fruits with bricks, nor with another fruit.
He should not learn the language of barbarians, nor drag a footstool toward himself.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhedanamavasphoṭaṃ chedanaṃ vā vilekhanam /
kuryād vimardanaṃ dhīmān nākasmādeva niṣphalam //
meaning:
न भेदनमवस्फोटं छेदनं वा विलेखनम् /
कुर्याद् विमर्दनं धीमान् नाकस्मादेव निष्फलम् //
text_mt:
A wise man should not perform splitting, cracking, cutting, scratching,
or crushing aimlessly and without purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
notsaṅgebhakṣayed bhakṣyaṃ vṛthā ceṣṭāṃ ca nācaret /
na nṛtyedathavā gāyenna vāditrāṇi vādayet //
meaning:
नोत्सङ्गेभक्षयेद् भक्ष्यं वृथा चेष्टां च नाचरेत् /
न नृत्येदथवा गायेन्न वादित्राणि वादयेत् //
text_mt:
He should not eat food placed in his lap, nor engage in useless activity;
he should not dance or sing, nor play musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ /
na laukikaiḥ stavairdevāṃstoṣayed bāhyajairapi //
meaning:
न संहताभ्यां पाणिभ्यां कण्डूयेदात्मनः शिरः /
न लौकिकैः स्तवैर्देवांस्तोषयेद् बाह्यजैरपि //
text_mt:
He should not scratch his head with both hands together.
He should not propitiate the gods with worldly hymns, nor with those derived from external systems.

sanskrit_iast:
nākṣaiḥ krīḍenna dhāveta nāpsu viṇmūtramācaret /
nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃviśennityaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret //
meaning:
नाक्षैः क्रीडेन्न धावेत नाप्सु विण्मूत्रमाचरेत् /
नोच्छिष्टः संविशेन्नित्यं न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत् //
text_mt:
He should not play with dice, nor run, nor discharge feces or urine in water;
he should never lie down while impure from eating, nor take a bath naked.

sanskrit_iast:
na gacchenna paṭhed vāpi na caiva svaśiraḥ spṛśet /
na dantairnakharomāṇi chindyāt suptaṃ na bodhayet //
meaning:
न गच्छेन्न पठेद् वापि न चैव स्वशिरः स्पृशेत् /
न दन्तैर्नखरोमाणि छिन्द्यात् सुप्तं न बोधयेत् //
text_mt:
[While impure from eating] he should not walk or recite, nor touch his own head.
He should not cut his nails or hair with his teeth, nor awaken someone asleep.

sanskrit_iast:
na bālātapamāsevet pretadhūmaṃ vivarjayet /
naikaḥ supyācchūnyagṛhe svayaṃ nopānahau haret //
meaning:
न बालातपमासेवेत् प्रेतधूमं विवर्जयेत् /
नैकः सुप्याच्छून्यगृहे स्वयं नोपानहौ हरेत् //
text_mt:
He should not expose himself to the morning sun; he should avoid the smoke of a corpse.
He should not sleep alone in an empty house; he should not carry shoes in his hands.

sanskrit_iast:
nākāraṇād vā niṣṭhīvenna bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret /
na pādakṣālanaṃ kuryāt pādenaiva kadācana //
meaning:
नाकारणाद् वा निष्ठीवेन्न बाहुभ्यां नदीं तरेत् /
न पादक्षालनं कुर्यात् पादेनैव कदाचन //
text_mt:
He should not spit without a cause; he should not cross a river using his arms.
He should never perform the washing of a foot with the other foot.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgnau pratāpayet pādau na kāṃsye dhāvayed budhaḥ /
nābhiprāsarayed devaṃ brāhmaṇān gāmathāpi vā /
vāyvagniguruviprān vā sūryaṃ vā śaśinaṃ prati //
meaning:
नाग्नौ प्रतापयेत् पादौ न कांस्ये धावयेद् बुधः /
नाभिप्रासरयेद् देवं ब्राह्मणान् गामथापि वा /
वाय्वग्निगुरुविप्रान् वा सूर्यं वा शशिनं प्रति //
text_mt:
A wise man should not warm his feet in fire, nor wash them in a bronze vessel.
He should not stretch out his feet toward a deity, Brahmins, or a cow,
or toward wind, fire, a teacher, priests, the sun, or the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
aśuddhaḥ śayanaṃ yānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ snānavāhanam /
bahirniṣkramaṇaṃ caiva na kurvota kathañcana //
meaning:
अशुद्धः शयनं यानं स्वाध्यायं स्नानवाहनम् /
बहिर्निष्क्रमणं चैव न कुर्वोत कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
While impure, he should under no circumstances lie down, travel,
study the sacred texts, bathe, ride a mount, or step outside.

sanskrit_iast:
svapnamadhyayanaṃ snānamudvartaṃ bhojanaṃ gatim /
ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayornityaṃ madhyāhne caiva varjayet //
meaning:
स्वप्नमध्ययनं स्नानमुद्वर्तं भोजनं गतिम् /
उभयोः संध्ययोर्नित्यं मध्याह्ने चैव वर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
He should constantly avoid sleep, study, bathing, anointing, eating, and travel
at both twilights and at midday.

sanskrit_iast:
na spṛśet pāṇinocchiṣṭo viprogobrāhmaṇānalān /
na cāsanaṃ padā vāpi na devapratimāṃ spṛśet //
meaning:
न स्पृशेत् पाणिनोच्छिष्टो विप्रोगोब्राह्मणानलान् /
न चासनं पदा वापि न देवप्रतिमां स्पृशेत् //
text_mt:
While impure from eating, a Brahmin should not touch with his hand a priest, cows, Brahmins, or fire;
nor should he touch a seat with his foot, nor an image of a deity.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśuddho 'gniṃ paricarenna devān kīrtayedṛṣīn /
nāvagāhedagādhāmbu dhārayennānimittataḥ //
meaning:
नाशुद्धो ऽग्निं परिचरेन्न देवान् कीर्तयेदृषीन् /
नावगाहेदगाधाम्बु धारयेन्नानिमित्ततः //
text_mt:
While impure, he should not attend upon the sacred fire, nor glorify the gods or sages;
he should not plunge into unfathomable water, nor carry [an object] without a purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
na vāmahastenoddhatya pibed vaktreṇa vā jalam /
nottaredanupaspṛśya nāpsu retaḥ samutsṛjet //
meaning:
न वामहस्तेनोद्धत्य पिबेद् वक्त्रेण वा जलम् /
नोत्तरेदनुपस्पृश्य नाप्सु रेतः समुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt:
He should not take up water with the left hand and drink it with his mouth;
he should not step out [of water] without rinsing his mouth, nor discharge semen into water.

sanskrit_iast:
amedhyaliptamanyad vā lohitaṃ vā viṣāṇi vā /
vyatikramenna stravantīṃ nāpsu maithunamācaret /
caityaṃ vṛkṣaṃ na vai chindyānnāpsu ṣṭhīvanamācaret //
meaning:
अमेध्यलिप्तमन्यद् वा लोहितं वा विषाणि वा /
व्यतिक्रमेन्न स्त्रवन्तीं नाप्सु मैथुनमाचरेत् /
चैत्यं वृक्षं न वै छिन्द्यान्नाप्सु ष्ठीवनमाचरेत् //
text_mt:
He should not cross over anything smeared with impurity, blood, or poisons,
nor a river; he should not engage in sexual intercourse in water.
He should not cut down a sacred tree, nor spit into water.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsthibhasmakapālāni na keśānna ca kaṇṭakān /
tuṣāṅgārakarīṣaṃ vā nādhitiṣṭhet kadācana //
meaning:
नास्थिभस्मकपालानि न केशान्न च कण्टकान् /
तुषाङ्गारकरीषं वा नाधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन //
text_mt:
He should never stand upon bones, ashes, skulls, hair,
thorns, chaff, charcoal, or dry cow dung.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāgniṃ laṅghayed dhīmān nopadadhyādadhaḥ kvacit /
na cainaṃ pādataḥ kuryānmukhena na dhamed budhaḥ //
meaning:
न चाग्निं लङ्घयेद् धीमान् नोपदध्यादधः क्वचित् /
न चैनं पादतः कुर्यान्मुखेन न धमेद् बुधः //
text_mt:
A wise man should not step over fire, nor ever place it underneath [himself];
a wise man should not place it near his feet, nor blow upon it with his mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
na kūpamavaroheta nāvekṣetāśuciḥ kvacit /
agnau na ca kṣipedagniṃ nādbhiḥ praśamayet tathā //
meaning:
न कूपमवरोहेत नावेक्षेताशुचिः क्वचित् /
अग्नौ न च क्षिपेदग्निं नाद्भिः प्रशमयेत् तथा //
text_mt:
He should not descend into a well; while impure, he should nowhere look [into one].
He should not throw fire into fire, nor extinguish it with water.

sanskrit_iast:
suhṛnmaraṇamārtiṃ vā na svayaṃ śrāvayet parān /
apaṇyaṃ kūṭapaṇyaṃ vā vikraye na prayojayet //
meaning:
सुहृन्मरणमार्तिं वा न स्वयं श्रावयेत् परान् /
अपण्यं कूटपण्यं वा विक्रये न प्रयोजयेत् //
text_mt:
He should not personally announce the death of a friend or distress to others.
He should not offer unmarketable goods or counterfeit goods for sale.

sanskrit_iast:
na vahniṃ mukhaniśvāsair jvālayennāśucirbudhaḥ /
puṇyasthānodakasthāne sīmāntaṃ vā kṛṣenna tu //
meaning:
न वह्निं मुखनिश्वासैर् ज्वालयेन्नाशुचिर्बुधः /
पुण्यस्थानोदकस्थाने सीमान्तं वा कृषेन्न तु //
text_mt:
A wise man should not kindle fire with the breaths of his mouth, nor while impure.
He must not plow at a holy site, at a water reservoir, or along a boundary.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhindyāt pūrvasamayamabhyupetaṃ kadācana /
parasparaṃ paśūn vyālān pakṣiṇo nāvabodhayet //
meaning:
न भिन्द्यात् पूर्वसमयमभ्युपेतं कदाचन /
परस्परं पशून् व्यालान् पक्षिणो नावबोधयेत् //
text_mt:
He should never break an agreement previously entered into.
He should not set beasts, serpents, or birds against each other.

sanskrit_iast:
parabādhaṃ na kurvota jalavātātapādibhiḥ /
kārayitvā svakarmāṇi kārūn paścānna vañcayet /
sāyaṃprātar gṛhadvārān bhikṣārthaṃ nāvaghaṭṭayet //
meaning:
परबाधं न कुर्वोत जलवातातपादिभिः /
कारयित्वा स्वकर्माणि कारून् पश्चान्न वञ्चयेत् /
सायंप्रातर् गृहद्वारान् भिक्षार्थं नावघट्टयेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
bahirmālyaṃ bahirgandhaṃ bhāryayā saha bhojanam /
vigṛhya vādaṃ kudvārapraveśaṃ ca vivarjayet //
meaning:
बहिर्माल्यं बहिर्गन्धं भार्यया सह भोजनम् /
विगृह्य वादं कुद्वारप्रवेशं च विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
He should avoid wearing a garland outside, wearing fragrance outside, eating with his wife,
quarrelsome dispute, and entering by an improper door.

sanskrit_iast:
na khādanbrāhmaṇastiṣṭhenna jalped vā hasan budhaḥ /
svamagniṃ naiva hastena spṛśennāpsu ciraṃ vaset //
meaning:
न खादन्ब्राह्मणस्तिष्ठेन्न जल्पेद् वा हसन् बुधः /
स्वमग्निं नैव हस्तेन स्पृशेन्नाप्सु चिरं वसेत् //
text_mt:
A wise Brahmin should not stand while chewing, nor converse while laughing.
He should not touch his own sacrificial fire with his hand, nor dwell in water for long.

sanskrit_iast:
na pakṣakeṇopadhamenna śūrpeṇa na pāṇinā /
mukhe naiva dhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata //
meaning:
न पक्षकेणोपधमेन्न शूर्पेण न पाणिना /
मुखे नैव धमेदग्निं मुखादग्निरजायत //
text_mt:
He should not blow upon it with a wing, nor with a winnowing basket, nor with his hand;
he should never blow upon the fire with his mouth, for fire was born from the mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
parastriyaṃ na bhāṣeta nāyājyaṃ yājayed dvijaḥ /
naikaścaret sabhāṃ vipraḥ samavāyaṃ ca varjayet //
meaning:
परस्त्रियं न भाषेत नायाज्यं याजयेद् द्विजः /
नैकश्चरेत् सभां विप्रः समवायं च वर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
A twice-born should not converse with another's wife, nor sacrifice for one unfit to sacrifice.
A Brahmin should not enter an assembly alone, and should avoid a crowd.

sanskrit_iast:
na devāyatanaṃ gacchet kadācid vāpradakṣiṇam /
na vījayed vā vastreṇa na devāyatane svapet //
meaning:
न देवायतनं गच्छेत् कदाचिद् वाप्रदक्षिणम् /
न वीजयेद् वा वस्त्रेण न देवायतने स्वपेत् //
text_mt:
He should never approach a temple without circumambulating it clockwise.
He should not fan with a garment, nor sleep in a temple.

sanskrit_iast:
naiko 'dhvānaṃ prapadyeta nādhārmikajanaiḥ saha /
na vyādhidūṣitairvāpi na śūdraiḥ patitena vā //
meaning:
नैको ऽध्वानं प्रपद्येत नाधार्मिकजनैः सह /
न व्याधिदूषितैर्वापि न शूद्रैः पतितेन वा //
text_mt:
He should not set out on a journey alone, nor in the company of unrighteous people,
nor with those afflicted by disease, nor with Śūdras, nor with an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
nopānadvarjito vātha jalādirahitastathā /
na rātrau nāriṇā sārdhaṃ na vinā ca kamaṇḍalum /
nāgnigobrāhmaṇādīnāmantareṇa vrajet kvacit //
meaning:
नोपानद्वर्जितो वाथ जलादिरहितस्तथा /
न रात्रौ नारिणा सार्धं न विना च कमण्डलुम् /
नाग्निगोब्राह्मणादीनामन्तरेण व्रजेत् क्वचित् //

sanskrit_iast:
na vatsatantrīṃ vitatāmatikrāmet kvacid dvijaḥ /
na ninded yoginaḥ siddhān vratino vāyatīṃstathā //
meaning:
न वत्सतन्त्रीं विततामतिक्रामेत् क्वचिद् द्विजः /
न निन्देद् योगिनः सिद्धान् व्रतिनो वायतींस्तथा //
text_mt:
A twice-born should never step over an extended calf-tethering rope.
He should not revile yogins, accomplished adepts, vow-holders, or ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāyatanaṃ prājño devānāṃ caiva satriṇām /
nākrāmet kāmataśchāyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gorapi //
meaning:
देवतायतनं प्राज्ञो देवानां चैव सत्रिणाम् /
नाक्रामेत् कामतश्छायां ब्राह्मणानां च गोरपि //
text_mt:
A wise man should not intentionally tread upon the shadow of a temple,
of deities, of sacrificial performers, of Brahmins, or of a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
svāṃ tu nākramayecchāyāṃ patitādyairna rogibhiḥ /
nāṅgārabhasmakeśādiṣvadhitiṣṭhet kadācana //
meaning:
स्वां तु नाक्रमयेच्छायां पतिताद्यैर्न रोगिभिः /
नाङ्गारभस्मकेशादिष्वधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन //
text_mt:
He should not allow his own shadow to be trodden upon by outcastes, diseased persons, and the like;
he should never stand upon charcoal, ashes, hair, and such things.

sanskrit_iast:
varjayenmārjanīreṇuṃ snānavastraghacodakam /
na bhakṣayedabhakṣyāṇi nāpeyaṃ ca pibed dvijaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
वर्जयेन्मार्जनीरेणुं स्नानवस्त्रघचोदकम् /
न भक्षयेदभक्ष्याणि नापेयं च पिबेद् द्विजः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षोडशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He should avoid dust from a broom and water wrung from bathing clothes.
A twice-born should not eat uneatable foods, nor drink what is not to be drunk.

Thus ends the sixteenth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
nādyācchūdrasya vipro 'nnaṃ mohād vā yadi vānyataḥ /
sa śūdrayoniṃ vrajati yastu bhuṅkte hyanāpadi //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
नाद्याच्छूद्रस्य विप्रो ऽन्नं मोहाद् वा यदि वान्यतः /
स शूद्रयोनिं व्रजति यस्तु भुङ्क्ते ह्यनापदि //
title: saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / A Brahmin should not eat the food of a Śūdra out of delusion or for any other reason; / indeed, he who eats it when there is no distress goes to a Śūdra womb.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsān yo dvijo bhuṅkte śūdrasyānnaṃ vigarhitam /
jīvanneva bhavecchūdro mṛtaḥ śvā cābhijāyate //
meaning:
षण्मासान् यो द्विजो भुङ्क्ते शूद्रस्यान्नं विगर्हितम् /
जीवन्नेव भवेच्छूद्रो मृतः श्वा चाभिजायते //
text_mt: A twice-born man who eats the blameworthy food of a Śūdra for six months / becomes a Śūdra while still alive, and when dead is reborn as a dog.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrasya ca munīśvarāḥ /
yasyānnenodarasthena mṛtastadyonimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्रस्य च मुनीश्वराः /
यस्यान्नेनोदरस्थेन मृतस्तद्योनिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: O best of sages, of a Brahmin, a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya, / or a Śūdra, in whose womb one is reborn depends upon whose food is in one's belly at death.

sanskrit_iast:
rājānnaṃ nartakānnaṃ ca takṣṇo 'nnaṃ carmakāriṇaḥ /
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca ṣaṇḍhānnaṃ caiva varjayet //
meaning:
राजान्नं नर्तकान्नं च तक्ष्णो ऽन्नं चर्मकारिणः /
गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च षण्ढान्नं चैव वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One should avoid the food of a king, the food of an actor, the food of a carpenter, and of a leatherworker; / the food of a multitude, the food of a courtesan, and the food of a eunuch.

sanskrit_iast:
cakropajīvirajakataskaradhvajināṃ tathā /
gāndharvalohakārānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca varjayet //
meaning:
चक्रोपजीविरजकतस्करध्वजिनां तथा /
गान्धर्वलोहकारान्नं सूतकान्नं च वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Likewise, one should avoid the food of oilmen who live by the wheel, washermen, thieves, and liquor-sellers; / the food of musicians, blacksmiths, and one in birth-impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
kulālacitrakarmānnaṃ vārdhuṣeḥ patitasya ca /
paunarbhavacchatrikayorabhiśastasya caiva hi //
meaning:
कुलालचित्रकर्मान्नं वार्धुषेः पतितस्य च /
पौनर्भवच्छत्रिकयोरभिशस्तस्य चैव हि //
text_mt: The food of a potter, a painter, a usurer, an outcast, / a son of a remarried woman, an umbrella-bearer, and an accused person;

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇakāraśailūṣavyādhabaddhāturasya ca /
cikitsakasya caivānnaṃ puṃścalyā daṇḍikasya ca //
meaning:
सुवर्णकारशैलूषव्याधबद्धातुरस्य च /
चिकित्सकस्य चैवान्नं पुंश्चल्या दण्डिकस्य च //
text_mt: of a goldsmith, an actor, a hunter, one bound, one who is diseased, / a physician, an unchaste woman, and an executioner;

sanskrit_iast:
stenanāstikayorannaṃ devatānindakasya ca /
somavikrayiṇaścānnaṃ śvapākasya viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
स्तेननास्तिकयोरन्नं देवतानिन्दकस्य च /
सोमविक्रयिणश्चान्नं श्वपाकस्य विशेषतः //
text_mt: the food of a thief, an atheist, and a reviler of deities; / the food of a seller of Soma, and especially of a Śvapāka;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryājitasya caivānnaṃ yasya copapatirgṛhe /
utsṛṣṭasya kadaryasya tathaivocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ //
meaning:
भार्याजितस्य चैवान्नं यस्य चोपपतिर्गृहे /
उत्सृष्टस्य कदर्यस्य तथैवोच्छिष्टभोजिनः //
text_mt: and the food of a henpecked man, of one in whose house a paramour lives, / of an abandoned person, of a miser, and likewise of one who eats scraps;

sanskrit_iast:
apāṅktyānnaṃ ca saṅghānnaṃ śastrājīvasya caiva hi /
klībasaṃnyāsinoścānnaṃ mattonmattasya caiva hi /
bhītasya ruditasyānnamavakruṣṭaṃ parikṣutam //
meaning:
अपाङ्क्त्यान्नं च सङ्घान्नं शस्त्राजीवस्य चैव हि /
क्लीबसंन्यासिनोश्चान्नं मत्तोन्मत्तस्य चैव हि /
भीतस्य रुदितस्यान्नमवक्रुष्टं परिक्षुतम् //
text_mt: the food of one excluded from company, the food of an association, of one who lives by weapons, / of a eunuch, of an ascetic who is an impostor, of one intoxicated, and of one insane; / food that is terrified, lamented over, reviled, or sneezed upon;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadviṣaḥ pāparuceḥ śrāddhānnaṃ sūtakasya ca /
vṛthāpākasya caivānnaṃ śāvānnaṃ śvaśurasya ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मद्विषः पापरुचेः श्राद्धान्नं सूतकस्य च /
वृथापाकस्य चैवान्नं शावान्नं श्वशुरस्य च //
text_mt: the food of a hater of Brahmins, of one inclined to sin, ancestral offering rite food, the food of one in birth-impurity, / food cooked in vain, food in death-impurity, and the food of a father-in-law;

sanskrit_iast:
aprajānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ bhṛtakasya tathaiva ca /
kārukānnaṃ viśeṣeṇa śastravikrayiṇastathā //
meaning:
अप्रजानां तु नारीणां भृतकस्य तथैव च /
कारुकान्नं विशेषेण शस्त्रविक्रयिणस्तथा //
text_mt: the food of childless women, and likewise of a hired servant; / the food of artisans especially, and of a seller of weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
śauṇḍānnaṃ ghāṭikānnaṃ ca bhiṣajāmannameva ca /
viddhaprajananasyānnaṃ parivittyannameva ca //
meaning:
शौण्डान्नं घाटिकान्नं च भिषजामन्नमेव च /
विद्धप्रजननस्यान्नं परिवित्त्यन्नमेव च //
text_mt: the food of a tavern-keeper, of a village astrologer, the food of a physician, / the food of a man with pierced genitals, and the food of a younger brother married before the elder;

sanskrit_iast:
punarbhuvo viśeṣeṇa tathaiva didhiṣūpateḥ /
avajñātaṃ cāvadhūtaṃ saroṣaṃ vismayānvitam /
gurorapi na bhoktavyamannaṃ saṃskāravarjitam //
meaning:
पुनर्भुवो विशेषेण तथैव दिधिषूपतेः /
अवज्ञातं चावधूतं सरोषं विस्मयान्वितम् /
गुरोरपि न भोक्तव्यमन्नं संस्कारवर्जितम् //
text_mt: especially of a remarried woman, and likewise of the husband of a remarried woman; / food that is despised, rejected, given in anger or in arrogance; / even if of a guru, food devoid of proper consecration must not be eaten.

sanskrit_iast:
duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyasya sarvamanne vyavasthitam /
yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāni kilbiṣam //
meaning:
दुष्कृतं हि मनुष्यस्य सर्वमन्ने व्यवस्थितम् /
यो यस्यान्नं समश्नाति स तस्याश्नानि किल्बिषम् //
text_mt: For all the wrongdoing of a human being resides in food; / he who eats someone's food eats that person's sin.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdhikaḥ kulamitraśca svagopālaśca nāpitaḥ /
ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaścātmānaṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
आर्धिकः कुलमित्रश्च स्वगोपालश्च नापितः /
एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना यश्चात्मानं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: A sharecropper, a family friend, one's own cowherd, and a barber— / among Śūdras, the food of these may be eaten, as well as of one who surrenders himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśīlavaḥ kumbhakāraḥ kṣetrakarmaka eva ca /
ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā dattvā svalpaṃ paṇaṃ budhaiḥ //
meaning:
कुशीलवः कुम्भकारः क्षेत्रकर्मक एव च /
एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना दत्त्वा स्वल्पं पणं बुधैः //
text_mt: An actor, a potter, and a field-laborer— / the food of these among Śūdras may be eaten by the wise after paying a small fee.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyasaṃ snehapakvaṃ yad gorasaṃ caiva saktavaḥ /
piṇyākaṃ caiva tailaṃ ca śūdrād grāhyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ //
meaning:
पायसं स्नेहपक्वं यद् गोरसं चैव सक्तवः /
पिण्याकं चैव तैलं च शूद्राद् ग्राह्यं द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt: Milk-rice, what is cooked in oil or ghee, dairy products, roasted barley flour, / oilcake, and sesame oil may be accepted from a Śūdra by twice-born men.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛntākaṃ nālikāśākaṃ kusumbhāśmantakaṃ tathā /
palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ śuktaṃ niryāsaṃ caiva varjayet //
meaning:
वृन्ताकं नालिकाशाकं कुसुम्भाश्मन्तकं तथा /
पलाण्डुं लशुनं शुक्तं निर्यासं चैव वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One should avoid eggplant, the leafy vegetable nālikā, safflower, aśmantaka, / onions, garlic, sour gruel, and plant exudations.

sanskrit_iast:
chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca śelaṃ peyūṣameva ca /
vilayaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva kavakāni ca varjayet //
meaning:
छत्राकं विड्वराहं च शेलं पेयूषमेव च /
विलयं सुमुखं चैव कवकानि च वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Mushrooms, domestic pig, śela-fruit, colostrum, / curd whey, sumukha-basil, and fungi should be avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛñjanaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva kakubhāṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca /
udumbaramalābuṃ ca jagdhvā patati vai dvijaḥ //
meaning:
गृञ्जनं किंशुकं चैव ककुभाण्डं तथैव च /
उदुम्बरमलाबुं च जग्ध्वा पतति वै द्विजः //
text_mt: A twice-born man certainly falls from caste by eating / carrots, kiṃśuka, kakubhāṇḍa, / udumbara-figs, and bottle-gourd.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā kṛśarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpameva ca /
anupākṛtamāṃsaṃ ca devānnāni havīṃṣi ca //
meaning:
वृथा कृशरसंयावं पायसापूपमेव च /
अनुपाकृतमांसं च देवान्नानि हवींषि च //
text_mt: Food cooked in vain: kṛśara, barley cakes, milk-rice, and pastry cakes, / unconsecrated meat, offerings to deities, and oblations;

sanskrit_iast:
yavāgūṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca matsyānapyanupākṛtān /
nīpaṃ kapitthaṃ plakṣaṃ ca prayatnena vivarjayet //
meaning:
यवागूं मातुलिङ्गं च मत्स्यानप्यनुपाकृतान् /
नीपं कपित्थं प्लक्षं च प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: barley gruel, citron, and unconsecrated fish; / nīpa, wood-apple, and plakṣa-fruit should be avoided with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇyākaṃ coddhṛtasnehaṃ devadhānya tathaiva ca /
rātrau ca tilasaṃbaddhaṃ prayatnena dadhi tyajet //
meaning:
पिण्याकं चोद्धृतस्नेहं देवधान्य तथैव च /
रात्रौ च तिलसंबद्धं प्रयत्नेन दधि त्यजेत् //
text_mt: Oilcake with the oil extracted, food offered to gods, / and curd mixed with sesame at night should be carefully avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśnīyāt payasā takraṃ na bījānyupajīvayet /
kriyāduṣṭaṃ bhāvaduṣṭamasatsaṃsargi varjayet //
meaning:
नाश्नीयात् पयसा तक्रं न बीजान्युपजीवयेत् /
क्रियादुष्टं भावदुष्टमसत्संसर्गि वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One should not consume buttermilk with milk, nor make a living from seeds; / one should avoid that which is corrupted by improper action, by evil intent, or by bad association.

sanskrit_iast:
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ ca nityaśaḥ /
śvāghrātaṃ ca punaḥ siddhaṃ caṇḍālāvekṣitaṃ tathā //
meaning:
केशकीटावपन्नं च सहृल्लेखं च नित्यशः /
श्वाघ्रातं च पुनः सिद्धं चण्डालावेक्षितं तथा //
text_mt: And food into which hair or insects have fallen, food that causes nausea, / food sniffed by a dog, cooked a second time, or looked upon by a Caṇḍāla;

sanskrit_iast:
udakyayā ca patitairgavā cāghrātameva ca /
anarcitaṃ puryuṃ ṣitaṃ paryāyānnaṃ ca nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
उदक्यया च पतितैर्गवा चाघ्रातमेव च /
अनर्चितं पुर्युं षितं पर्यायान्नं च नित्यशः //
text_mt: food touched by a menstruating woman or outcasts, or sniffed by a cow; / unhallowed food, stale food, and food served in alternating turns constantly;

sanskrit_iast:
kākakukkuṭasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ kṛmibhiścaiva saṃyutam /
manuṣyairapyavaghrātaṃ kuṣṭhinā spṛṣṭameva ca //
meaning:
काककुक्कुटसंस्पृष्टं कृमिभिश्चैव संयुतम् /
मनुष्यैरप्यवघ्रातं कुष्ठिना स्पृष्टमेव च //
text_mt: food touched by crows or domestic cocks, infested with worms, / sniffed by humans, or touched by a leper;

sanskrit_iast:
na rajasvalayā dattaṃ na puṃścālyā saroṣayā /
malabadvāsasā vāpi paravāso 'tha varjayet //
meaning:
न रजस्वलया दत्तं न पुंश्चाल्या सरोषया /
मलबद्वाससा वापि परवासो ऽथ वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: food given by a menstruating woman, by an unchaste woman, or by an angry woman; / or given by one in dirty garments, or one wearing another's garment, should be avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
vivatsāyāśca goḥ kṣīramauṣṭraṃ vānirdaśaṃ tathā /
āvikaṃ sandhinīkṣīramapeyaṃ manurabravīt //
meaning:
विवत्सायाश्च गोः क्षीरमौष्ट्रं वानिर्दशं तथा /
आविकं सन्धिनीक्षीरमपेयं मनुरब्रवीत् //
text_mt: The milk of a cow whose calf has died, camel milk, or milk from a cow within ten days of calving, / sheep milk, and the milk of a cow in heat, Manu declared undrinkable.

sanskrit_iast:
balākaṃ haṃsadātyūhaṃ kalaviṅkaṃ śukaṃ tathā /
kuraraṃ ca cakoraṃ ca jālapādaṃ ca kokilam //
meaning:
बलाकं हंसदात्यूहं कलविङ्कं शुकं तथा /
कुररं च चकोरं च जालपादं च कोकिलम् //
text_mt: The crane, swan, water-hen, sparrow, parrot, / osprey, partridge, web-footed bird, cuckoo,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyasaṃ khañjarīṭaṃ ca śyenaṃ gṛdhraṃ tathaiva ca /
ulūkaṃ cakravākaṃ ca bhāsaṃ pārāvatānapi /
kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva grāmakukkuṭameva ca //
meaning:
वायसं खञ्जरीटं च श्येनं गृध्रं तथैव च /
उलूकं चक्रवाकं च भासं पारावतानपि /
कपोतं टिट्टिभं चैव ग्रामकुक्कुटमेव च //
text_mt: crow, wagtail, hawk, vulture, / owl, ruddy shelduck, vulture-like bhāsa bird, pigeons, / doves, the lapwing, and the domestic cock;

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghraṃ ca mārjāraṃ śvānaṃ śūkarameva ca /
śṛgālaṃ markaṭaṃ caiva gardabhaṃ ca na bhakṣayet //
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रं च मार्जारं श्वानं शूकरमेव च /
शृगालं मर्कटं चैव गर्दभं च न भक्षयेत् //
text_mt: one should not eat lion, tiger, cat, dog, boar, / jackal, monkey, or donkey.

sanskrit_iast:
na bhakṣayet sarvamṛgān pakṣiṇo 'nyān vanecarān /
jalecarān sthalacarān prāṇinaśceti dhāraṇā //
meaning:
न भक्षयेत् सर्वमृगान् पक्षिणो ऽन्यान् वनेचरान् /
जलेचरान् स्थलचरान् प्राणिनश्चेति धारणा //
text_mt: One should not eat all deer, other birds that live in the forest, / or creatures living in water or moving on land: such is the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
godhā kūrmaḥ śaśaḥ śvāvicchalyakaśceti sattamāḥ /
bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhā nityaṃ manurāha prijāpatiḥ //
meaning:
गोधा कूर्मः शशः श्वाविच्छल्यकश्चेति सत्तमाः /
भक्ष्याः पञ्चनखा नित्यं मनुराह प्रिजापतिः //
text_mt: O best of men, the iguana, tortoise, hare, and porcupine— / Manu the Lord of Creatures declared these five-nailed animals fit to be eaten.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyān saśalkān bhuñjīyān māṃsaṃ rauravamevaca /
nivedya devatābhyastu brāhmaṇebhyastu nānyathā //
meaning:
मत्स्यान् सशल्कान् भुञ्जीयान् मांसं रौरवमेवच /
निवेद्य देवताभ्यस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु नान्यथा //
text_mt: One may eat scaly fish and the meat of the ruru-deer / after offering them to the deities and to the Brahmins, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
mayūraṃ tittiraṃ caiva kapotaṃ ca kapiñjalam /
vādhrīṇasaṃ bakaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mīnahaṃsaparājitāḥ //
meaning:
मयूरं तित्तिरं चैव कपोतं च कपिञ्जलम् /
वाध्रीणसं बकं भक्ष्यं मीनहंसपराजिताः //
text_mt: Peacock, francolin partridge, dove, quail, / the old long-eared bird, and the heron may be eaten, [as well as] those untouched by fish and swans.

sanskrit_iast:
śapharaṃ siṃhatuṇḍaṃ ca tathā pāṭhīnarohitau /
matsyāścaite samuddiṣṭā bhakṣaṇāya dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
शफरं सिंहतुण्डं च तथा पाठीनरोहितौ /
मत्स्याश्चैते समुद्दिष्टा भक्षणाय द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The śaphara, the siṃhatuṇḍa, and likewise the pāṭhīna and rohita: / these fish have been declared fit for consumption, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayedeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ ca dvijakāmyayā /
yathāvidhi niyuktaṃ ca prāṇānāmapi cātyaye //
meaning:
प्रोक्षितं भक्षयेदेषां मांसं च द्विजकाम्यया /
यथाविधि नियुक्तं च प्राणानामपि चात्यये //
text_mt: One should eat their meat when sprinkled with consecrated water, at the wish of Brahmins, / when enjoined according to rule, and in danger of losing one's life.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayennaiva māṃsāni śeṣabhojī na lipyate /
auṣadhārthamaśaktau vā niyogād yajñakāraṇāt //
meaning:
भक्षयेन्नैव मांसानि शेषभोजी न लिप्यते /
औषधार्थमशक्तौ वा नियोगाद् यज्ञकारणात् //
text_mt: One should not eat meats [otherwise]; one who eats only sacrificial remnants is not stained / [when eating] for medicine, in weakness, by ritual appointment, or on account of a sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe daive vā māṃsamutsṛjet /
yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvato narakān vrajet //
meaning:
आमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे दैवे वा मांसमुत्सृजेत् /
यावन्ति पशुरोमाणि तावतो नरकान् व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He who, having been invited to an ancestral offering rite or a rite to the gods, rejects meat, / will go to as many hells as there are hairs on the animal.

sanskrit_iast:
adeyaṃ cāpyapeyaṃ ca tathaivāspṛśyameva ca /
dvijātīnāmanālokyaṃ nityaṃ madyamiti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
अदेयं चाप्यपेयं च तथैवास्पृश्यमेव च /
द्विजातीनामनालोक्यं नित्यं मद्यमिति स्थितिः //
text_mt: It is not to be given, not to be drunk, and likewise not to be touched; / liquor is never even to be looked upon by the twice-born: this is the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madyaṃ nityaṃ vivarjayet /
pītvā patati karmabhyastvasaṃbhāṣyo bhaved dvijaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रकारेण मद्यं नित्यं विवर्जयेत् /
पीत्वा पतति कर्मभ्यस्त्वसंभाष्यो भवेद् द्विजः //
text_mt: Therefore, by all means, one should always avoid liquor; / having drunk it, a twice-born falls from his rites and becomes one not to be spoken to.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayitvā hyabhakṣyāṇi pītvāpeyānyapi dvijaḥ /
nādhikārī bhavet tāvad yāvad tanna jahātyadhaḥ //
meaning:
भक्षयित्वा ह्यभक्ष्याणि पीत्वापेयान्यपि द्विजः /
नाधिकारी भवेत् तावद् यावद् तन्न जहात्यधः //
text_mt: Indeed, having consumed uneatables or drunk undrinkables, / a twice-born is not eligible [for rites] until he eliminates it downward.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt pariharennityamabhakṣyāṇi prayatnataḥ /
apeyāni ca vipro vai tathā ced yāti rauravam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तस्मात् परिहरेन्नित्यमभक्ष्याणि प्रयत्नतः /
अपेयानि च विप्रो वै तथा चेद् याति रौरवम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Therefore, a Brahmin must always carefully avoid uneatables / and undrinkables; if he [ingests them], he goes to Raurava.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahāmune /
tadācakṣvākhilaṃ karma yena mucyeta bandhanāt //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां महामुने /
तदाचक्ष्वाखिलं कर्म येन मुच्येत बन्धनात् //
title: aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / Tell us, O great sage, all that rite to be performed daily by Brahmins, / by which one may be freed from bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama /
ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kramād vidhim //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं शृणुध्वं गदतो मम /
अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां क्रमाद् विधिम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Be attentive and listen as I speak; / I shall explain, in order, the rule of daily duties for Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhme muhūrte tūtthāya dharmamarthaṃ ca cintayet /
kāyakleśaṃ tadudbhūtaṃ dhyāyīta manaseśvaram //
meaning:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते तूत्थाय धर्ममर्थं च चिन्तयेत् /
कायक्लेशं तदुद्भूतं ध्यायीत मनसेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Having risen in the Brāhma muhūrta, one should reflect on duty and wealth, / and the bodily distress arising from them, and meditate in mind upon the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣaḥ kāle 'tha saṃprāpte kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ budhaḥ /
snāyānnadīṣu suddhāsu śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
उषः काले ऽथ संप्राप्ते कृत्वा चावश्यकं बुधः /
स्नायान्नदीषु सुद्धासु शौचं कृत्वा यथाविधि //
text_mt: Then, when the time of dawn has arrived, the wise man, having performed what is necessary, / should bathe in pure rivers after performing purification according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snānena pūyante ye 'pi pāpakṛto janāḥ /
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नानेन पूयन्ते ये ऽपि पापकृतो जनाः /
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्रातः स्नानं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Even people who have committed sins are purified by a morning bath; / therefore, with all effort, one should perform the morning bath.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ śubham /
ṛṣīṇāmṛṣitā nityaṃ prātaḥ snānānna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नानं प्रशंसन्ति दृष्टादृष्टकरं शुभम् /
ऋषीणामृषिता नित्यं प्रातः स्नानान्न संशयः //
text_mt: They praise the morning bath as auspicious, yielding visible and invisible fruits; / the seership of the sages is always due to the morning bath—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhe suptasya satataṃ lālā yāḥ saṃstravanti hi /
tato naivācaret karma akṛtvā snānamāditaḥ //
meaning:
मुखे सुप्तस्य सततं लाला याः संस्त्रवन्ति हि /
ततो नैवाचरेत् कर्म अकृत्वा स्नानमादितः //
text_mt: Because saliva constantly trickles from the mouth of one who sleeps, / one should never perform a rite without first taking a bath.

sanskrit_iast:
alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇo ca duḥ svapnaṃ durvicintitam /
prātaḥ snānena pāpāni pūyante nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अलक्ष्मीः कालकर्णो च दुः स्वप्नं दुर्विचिन्तितम् /
प्रातः स्नानेन पापानि पूयन्ते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Misfortune, ill luck, bad dreams, and evil thoughts— / sins are purified by the morning bath: of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca snānaṃ vinā puṃsāṃ pāvanaṃ karma susmṛtam /
home japye viśeṣeṇa tasmāt snānaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
न च स्नानं विना पुंसां पावनं कर्म सुस्मृतम् /
होमे जप्ये विशेषेण तस्मात् स्नानं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Nor is any rite considered purifying for men without a bath, / especially in oblation and recitation; therefore, one should take a bath.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktāvaśiraskaṃ vā snānamasya vidhīyate /
ārdreṇa vāsasā vātha mārjanaṃ kāpilaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
अशक्तावशिरस्कं वा स्नानमस्य विधीयते /
आर्द्रेण वाससा वाथ मार्जनं कापिलं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: In case of incapacity, a bath without wetting the head is prescribed for him, / or wiping with a damp cloth is traditionally known as the Kāpila bath.

sanskrit_iast:
asāmarthye samutpanne snānamevaṃ samācaret /
brāhmādīni yathāśaktau snānānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
असामर्थ्ये समुत्पन्ने स्नानमेवं समाचरेत् /
ब्राह्मादीनि यथाशक्तौ स्नानान्याहुर्मनीषिणः //
text_mt: When incapacity arises, one should bathe in this manner; / the wise speak of baths beginning with the Brāhma according to one's ability.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmamāgneyamuddiṣṭaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyameva ca /
vāruṇaṃ yaugikaṃ tadvat ṣoḍhā snānaṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
ब्राह्ममाग्नेयमुद्दिष्टं वायव्यं दिव्यमेव च /
वारुणं यौगिकं तद्वत् षोढा स्नानं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The Brāhma, the Āgneya, the Vāyavya, and the Divya, / the Vāruṇa, and likewise the Yaugika: the bath is proclaimed to be of six kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ tu mārjanaṃ mantraiḥ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ /
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā pādamastakāddehadhūlanam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मं तु मार्जनं मन्त्रैः कुशैः सोदकबिन्दुभिः /
आग्नेयं भस्मना पादमस्तकाद्देहधूलनम् //
text_mt: The Brāhma is sprinkling with mantras using kuśa grass with drops of water; / the Āgneya is dusting the body from head to foot with ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ hi rajasā proktaṃ vāyavyaṃ snānamuttamam /
yattu sātapavarṣeṇa snānaṃ tad divyamucyate //
meaning:
गवां हि रजसा प्रोक्तं वायव्यं स्नानमुत्तमम् /
यत्तु सातपवर्षेण स्नानं तद् दिव्यमुच्यते //
text_mt: The Vāyavya bath is declared to be [performed] with the dust of cows, an excellent one; / that bath which is taken in rain accompanied by sunshine is called Divya.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇaṃ cāvagāhastu mānasaṃ tvātmavedanam /
yaugikaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ yogo viṣṇuvicintanam //
meaning:
वारुणं चावगाहस्तु मानसं त्वात्मवेदनम् /
यौगिकं स्नानमाख्यातं योगो विष्णुविचिन्तनम् //
text_mt: The Vāruṇa is immersion [in water], while the mental is self-knowledge; / the Yaugika bath is declared to be yoga, the contemplation of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ /
manaḥ śucikaraṃ puṃsāṃ nityaṃ tat snānamācaret //
meaning:
आत्मतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सेवितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः /
मनः शुचिकरं पुंसां नित्यं तत् स्नानमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Known as the sacred ford of the self, frequented by knowers of Brahman, / it purifies the mind of men; one should always take that bath.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktaśced vāruṇaṃ vidvān prājāpatyaṃ tathaiva ca /
prakṣālya dantakāṣṭhaṃ vai bhakṣayitvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
शक्तश्चेद् वारुणं विद्वान् प्राजापत्यं तथैव च /
प्रक्षाल्य दन्तकाष्ठं वै भक्षयित्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: If able, the wise man [should perform] the Vāruṇa and likewise the Prājāpatya; / having washed the tooth-stick and chewed it according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya prayato nityaṃ snānaṃ prātaḥ samācaret /
madhyāṅgulisamasthaulyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitam //
meaning:
आचम्य प्रयतो नित्यं स्नानं प्रातः समाचरेत् /
मध्याङ्गुलिसमस्थौल्यं द्वादशाङ्गुलसंमितम् //
text_mt: having sipped water and purified himself, he should always perform the morning bath. / With a thickness equal to the middle finger, measuring twelve finger-breadths,

sanskrit_iast:
satvacaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ syāt tadagreṇa tu dhāvayet /
kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ mālatīsaṃbhavaṃ śubham /
apāmārgaṃ ca bilvaṃ ca karavīraṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सत्वचं दन्तकाष्ठं स्यात् तदग्रेण तु धावयेत् /
क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भूतं मालतीसंभवं शुभम् /
अपामार्गं च बिल्वं च करवीरं विशेषतः //
text_mt: the tooth-stick should possess bark; one should clean [the teeth] with its tip. / Auspicious is that produced from a milky tree or born of mālatī, / especially apāmārga, bilva, and karavīra.

sanskrit_iast:
varjayitvā ninditāni gṛhītvaikaṃ yathoditam /
parihṛtya dinaṃ pāpaṃ bhakṣayed vai vidhānavit //
meaning:
वर्जयित्वा निन्दितानि गृहीत्वैकं यथोदितम् /
परिहृत्य दिनं पापं भक्षयेद् वै विधानवित् //
text_mt: Having avoided the forbidden ones, taking one as prescribed, / and avoiding inauspicious days, one knowing the rule should chew it.

sanskrit_iast:
notpāṭayeddantakāṣṭaṃnāṅgulyā dhāvayet kvacit /
prakṣālya bhaṅktvā tajjahyācchucaudeśe samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
नोत्पाटयेद्दन्तकाष्टंनाङ्गुल्या धावयेत् क्वचित् /
प्रक्षाल्य भङ्क्त्वा तज्जह्याच्छुचौदेशे समाहितः //
text_mt: One should not uproot the tooth-stick, nor ever clean [the teeth] with a finger; / having washed it and broken it, he should discard it in a clean place, with a composed mind.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā /
ācamya mantravannityaṃ punarācamya vāgyataḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा /
आचम्य मन्त्रवन्नित्यं पुनराचम्य वाग्यतः //
text_mt: Having bathed, he should offer libations to the gods, the sages, and the classes of ancestors; / having sipped water with mantras as prescribed, and having sipped water again with speech restrained,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmārjya mantrairātmānaṃ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ /
āpo hiṣṭhā vyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryā vāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
meaning:
संमार्ज्य मन्त्रैरात्मानं कुशैः सोदकबिन्दुभिः /
आपो हिष्ठा व्याहृतिभिः सावित्र्या वारुणैः शुभैः //
text_mt: cleansing himself with mantras, with kuśa grass with drops of water, / with "āpo hi ṣṭhā," with the vyāhṛtis, with the Sāvitrī, and with auspicious Vāruṇa verses,

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāravyāhṛtiyutāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram /
japtvā jalāñjaliṃ dadyād bhāskaraṃ prati tanmanāḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्कारव्याहृतियुतां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् /
जप्त्वा जलाञ्जलिं दद्याद् भास्करं प्रति तन्मनाः //
text_mt: and reciting the Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas, accompanied by the syllable Oṃ and the vyāhṛtis, / he should offer a double-handful of water toward the sun, his mind fixed on it.

sanskrit_iast:
prākkūleṣu samāsīno darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ /
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet saṃdhyāmiti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
प्राक्कूलेषु समासीनो दर्भेषु सुसमाहितः /
प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा ध्यायेत् संध्यामिति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Seated on darbha grass pointing east, deeply composed, / having performed three breath-controls, he should meditate on the twilight; such is the Vedic teaching.

sanskrit_iast:
yā saṃdhyā sā jagatsūtirmāyātītā hi niṣkalā /
aiśvarī tu parāśaktistattvatrayasamudbhavā //
meaning:
या संध्या सा जगत्सूतिर्मायातीता हि निष्कला /
ऐश्वरी तु पराशक्तिस्तत्त्वत्रयसमुद्भवा //
text_mt: She who is twilight is the source of the universe, beyond illusory creative power, without parts; / she is the supreme sovereign power, arisen from the triad of principles.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ sāvitrīṃ vai japan budhaḥ /
prāṅmukhaḥ satataṃ vipraḥ saṃdhyopāsanamācaret //
meaning:
ध्यात्वार्ऽकमण्डलगतां सावित्रीं वै जपन् बुधः /
प्राङ्मुखः सततं विप्रः संध्योपासनमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Meditating on her present in the orb of the sun and reciting the Sāvitrī, / the wise Brahmin, facing east, should always perform the twilight worship.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyāhīno 'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu /
yadanyat kurute kiñcinna tasya phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
संध्याहीनो ऽशुचिर्नित्यमनर्हः सर्वकर्मसु /
यदन्यत् कुरुते किञ्चिन्न तस्य फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: One destitute of twilight worship is ever impure, unfit for all rites; / whatever else he does, he does not obtain its fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ananyacetasaḥ śāntā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ /
upāsya vidhivat saṃdhyāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvaṃ parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
अनन्यचेतसः शान्ता ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः /
उपास्य विधिवत् संध्यां प्राप्ताः पूर्वं परां गतिम् //
text_mt: With undivided minds, peaceful Brahmins who had mastered the Vedas, / having worshipped twilight according to rule, formerly attained the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nyatra kurute yatnaṃ dharmakārye dvijottamaḥ /
vihāya saṃdhyāpraṇatiṃ sa yāti narakāyutam //
meaning:
यो ऽन्यत्र कुरुते यत्नं धर्मकार्ये द्विजोत्तमः /
विहाय संध्याप्रणतिं स याति नरकायुतम् //
text_mt: The best of the twice-born who exerts himself elsewhere in religious acts, / having abandoned prostration at twilight, goes to ten thousand hells.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃdhyopāsanamācaret /
upāsito bhavet tena devo yogatanuḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन संध्योपासनमाचरेत् /
उपासितो भवेत् तेन देवो योगतनुः परः //
text_mt: Therefore, with every effort, one should perform the twilight worship; / through that, the supreme deity whose body is yoga is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraparamāṃ nityaṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām /
sāvitrariṃ vai japed vidvān prāṅmukhaḥ prayataḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रपरमां नित्यं शतमध्यां दशावराम् /
सावित्ररिं वै जपेद् विद्वान् प्राङ्मुखः प्रयतः स्थितः //
text_mt: A thousand times at best, a hundred at intermediate, ten times at least, / the wise man, facing east and composed, should constantly recite the Sāvitrī.

sanskrit_iast:
athopatiṣṭhedādityamudayantaṃ samāhitaḥ /
mantraistu vividhaiḥ saurerṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
अथोपतिष्ठेदादित्यमुदयन्तं समाहितः /
मन्त्रैस्तु विविधैः सौरेरृग्यजुः सामसंभवैः //
text_mt: Then, with a concentrated mind, he should stand in worship before the rising sun / with various solar mantras originating from the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
upasthāya mahāyogaṃ devadevaṃ divākaram /
kurvota praṇatiṃ bhūmau mūrdhnā tenaiva mantrataḥ //
meaning:
उपस्थाय महायोगं देवदेवं दिवाकरम् /
कुर्वोत प्रणतिं भूमौ मूर्ध्ना तेनैव मन्त्रतः //
text_mt: Having stood in worship before the great yoga, the god of gods, the sun, / he should make a prostration on the ground with his head, along with that very mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ khakholkāya śāntāya kāraṇatrayahetave /
nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ namaste jñānarūpiṇe /
namaste ghṛṇine tubhyaṃ sūryāya brahmarūpiṇe //
meaning:
ओं खखोल्काय शान्ताय कारणत्रयहेतवे /
निवेदयामि चात्मानं नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपिणे /
नमस्ते घृणिने तुभ्यं सूर्याय ब्रह्मरूपिणे //
text_mt: "Oṃ, to Khakholka, the peaceful, the cause of the three causes; / I offer myself to you; reverence to you whose form is knowledge! / Reverence to you, the shining one, to the Sun whose form is Brahman!

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva brahma paramamāpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam /
bhūrbhuvaḥ svastvamoṅkāraḥ sarve rudrāḥ sanātanāḥ /
puruṣaḥ sanmaho 'tastvāṃ praṇamāmi kapardinam //
meaning:
त्वमेव ब्रह्म परममापो ज्योती रसो ऽमृतम् /
भूर्भुवः स्वस्त्वमोङ्कारः सर्वे रुद्राः सनातनाः /
पुरुषः सन्महो ऽतस्त्वां प्रणमामि कपर्दिनम् //
text_mt: You alone are the supreme Brahman, water, light, essence, nectar; / you are the earth, atmosphere, heaven; you are the syllable Oṃ, all eternal Rudras, / the Spirit, real and great; therefore I bow to you, the matted-haired one!

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva viśvaṃ bahudhā sadasat sūyate ca yat /
namo rudrāya sūryāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
त्वमेव विश्वं बहुधा सदसत् सूयते च यत् /
नमो रुद्राय सूर्याय त्वामहं शरणं गतः //
text_mt: You alone are the universe in its many forms, whatever is being and non-being; / reverence to Rudra, to the Sun; I have gone to you for refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
pracetase namastubhyaṃ namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya te /
namo namaste rudrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
प्रचेतसे नमस्तुभ्यं नमो मीढुष्टमाय ते /
नमो नमस्ते रुद्राय त्वामहं शरणं गतः //
text_mt: Reverence to you, the wise one; reverence to you, the most generous; / reverence, reverence to you, Rudra; I have gone to you for refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyabāhave tubhyaṃ hiraṇyapataye namaḥ /
ambikāpataye tubhyamumāyāḥ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यबाहवे तुभ्यं हिरण्यपतये नमः /
अम्बिकापतये तुभ्यमुमायाः पतये नमः //
text_mt: Reverence to you the golden-armed, to the golden lord! / Reverence to you, the husband of Ambikā, to the husband of Umā!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu nīlagrīvāya namastubhyaṃ pinākine /
vilohitāya bhargāya sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु नीलग्रीवाय नमस्तुभ्यं पिनाकिने /
विलोहिताय भर्गाय सहस्राक्षाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Reverence be to the blue-necked one! Reverence to you, the wielder of Pināka, / to the deep-red one, to Bharga, to you the thousand-eyed one!"

sanskrit_iast:
namo haṃsāya te nityamādityāya namo 'stu te /
namaste vajrahastāya tryambakāya namo 'stu te //
meaning:
नमो हंसाय ते नित्यमादित्याय नमो ऽस्तु ते /
नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय त्र्यम्बकाय नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: Praise to you who are the swan; praise to you who are constantly the sun! / Praise to you who hold the thunderbolt in your hand; praise to you, Tryambaka!

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ mahāntaṃ parameśvaram /
hiraṇmayaṃ gṛhe guptamātmānaṃ sarvadehinām //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये त्वां विरूपाक्षं महान्तं परमेश्वरम् /
हिरण्मयं गृहे गुप्तमात्मानं सर्वदेहिनाम् //
text_mt: I take refuge in you, odd-eyed, great, supreme lord, / golden, hidden in the secret chamber [of the heart], the Self of all embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
namasyāmi paraṃ jyotirbrahmāṇaṃ tvāṃ parāṃ gatim /
viśvaṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ naranārīśarīriṇam //
meaning:
नमस्यामि परं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्माणं त्वां परां गतिम् /
विश्वं पशुपतिं भीमं नरनारीशरीरिणम् //
text_mt: I bow to you, the supreme light, Brahman, the highest goal, / the universe, the lord of beasts, the terrible one, whose body is both man and woman.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ sūryāya rudrāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine /
ugrāya sarvabhaktāya tvāṃ prapadye sadaiva hi //
meaning:
नमः सूर्याय रुद्राय भास्वते परमेष्ठिने /
उग्राय सर्वभक्ताय त्वां प्रपद्ये सदैव हि //
text_mt: Praise to the sun, to Rudra, the shining one, who dwells in the highest abode, / to the fierce one, devoted to all; indeed, in you alone do I constantly take refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
etad vai sūryahṛdayaṃ japtvā stavamanuttamam /
prātaḥ kāle 'tha madhyāhne namaskuryād divākaram //
meaning:
एतद् वै सूर्यहृदयं जप्त्वा स्तवमनुत्तमम् /
प्रातः काले ऽथ मध्याह्ने नमस्कुर्याद् दिवाकरम् //
text_mt: Having chanted this Sūryahṛdaya, an unsurpassed hymn of praise, / at dawn and at midday, one should bow to the maker of day.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dhārmikāya dvijātaye /
pradeyaṃ sūryahṛdayaṃ brahmaṇā tu pradarśitam //
meaning:
इदं पुत्राय शिष्याय धार्मिकाय द्विजातये /
प्रदेयं सूर्यहृदयं ब्रह्मणा तु प्रदर्शितम् //
text_mt: This Sūryahṛdaya, revealed indeed by Brahmā, / should be imparted to a son, to a disciple, [or] to a righteous twice-born man.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ vedasārasamudbhavam /
brāhmaṇānāṃ hitaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam //
meaning:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं वेदसारसमुद्भवम् /
ब्राह्मणानां हितं पुण्यमृषिसङ्घैर्निषेवितम् //
text_mt: It dispels all sins, arises from the essence of the Vedas, / is beneficial to Brahmins, brings merit, and is frequented by hosts of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
athāgamya gṛhaṃ vipraḥ samācamya yathāvidhi /
prajvālya vihniṃ vidhivajjuhuyājjātavedasam //
meaning:
अथागम्य गृहं विप्रः समाचम्य यथाविधि /
प्रज्वाल्य विह्निं विधिवज्जुहुयाज्जातवेदसम् //
text_mt: Then, having returned home, sipping water according to rule, / having kindled the fire according to rule, the Brahmin should make an offering into Jātavedas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtvikputro 'tha patnī vā śiṣyo vāpi sahodaraḥ /
prāpyānujñāṃ viśeṣeṇa juhuyurvā yatāvidhi //
meaning:
ऋत्विक्पुत्रो ऽथ पत्नी वा शिष्यो वापि सहोदरः /
प्राप्यानुज्ञां विशेषेण जुहुयुर्वा यताविधि //
text_mt: Or an officiating priest, a son, a wife, a disciple, or even a brother, / having received permission, may especially make the offering according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrapāṇiḥ pūtātmā śuklāmbaradharottaraḥ /
ananyamānaso vahniṃ juhuyāt saṃyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
पवित्रपाणिः पूतात्मा शुक्लाम्बरधरोत्तरः /
अनन्यमानसो वह्निं जुहुयात् संयतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: With sacred grass in hand, purified in self, wearing white upper garments, / with single-pointed mind and restrained senses, he should make the offering into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā darbheṇa yatkarma vinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ /
rākṣasaṃ tadbhavet sarvaṃ nāmutreha phalapradam //
meaning:
विना दर्भेण यत्कर्म विना सूत्रेण वा पुनः /
राक्षसं तद्भवेत् सर्वं नामुत्रेह फलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Whatever rite is performed without darbha grass, or without the sacred thread, / all of that belongs to the demons; it yields no fruit here or hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
daivatāni namaskuryād deyasārānnivedayet /
dadyāt puṣpādikaṃ teṣāṃ vṛddhāṃścaivābhivādayet //
meaning:
दैवतानि नमस्कुर्याद् देयसारान्निवेदयेत् /
दद्यात् पुष्पादिकं तेषां वृद्धांश्चैवाभिवादयेत् //
text_mt: He should bow to the deities and present offerings of excellent food; / he should give them flowers and the like, and he should salute the elders.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ caivāpyupāsīta hitaṃ cāsya samācaret /
vedābhyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prayatnācchaktito dvijaḥ //
meaning:
गुरुं चैवाप्युपासीत हितं चास्य समाचरेत् /
वेदाभ्यासं ततः कुर्यात् प्रयत्नाच्छक्तितो द्विजः //
text_mt: He should attend upon his guru and do what is beneficial for him; / then the twice-born should diligently engage in the study of the Vedas to the best of his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
japedadhyāpayecchiṣyān dhārayecca vicārayet /
avekṣeta ca śāstrāṇi dharmādīni dvijottamaḥ /
vaidikāṃścaiva nigamān vedāṅgāni veśiṣataḥ //
meaning:
जपेदध्यापयेच्छिष्यान् धारयेच्च विचारयेत् /
अवेक्षेत च शास्त्राणि धर्मादीनि द्विजोत्तमः /
वैदिकांश्चैव निगमान् वेदाङ्गानि वेशिषतः //
text_mt: He should recite, teach disciples, retain [the text], and reflect upon it; / and the best among the twice-born should examine the scriptures—those on duty and others— / as well as the Vedic treatises, especially the limbs of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
upeyādīśvaraṃ cātha yogakṣemaprasiddhaye /
sādhayed vividhānarthān kuṭumbārthe tato dvijaḥ //
meaning:
उपेयादीश्वरं चाथ योगक्षेमप्रसिद्धये /
साधयेद् विविधानर्थान् कुटुम्बार्थे ततो द्विजः //
text_mt: Then he should approach the Lord to accomplish the acquisition and preservation [of livelihood]; / then the twice-born should secure various resources for the sake of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
tato madhyāhnasamaye snānārthaṃ mṛdamāharet /
puṣpākṣatān kuśatilān gomayaṃ śuddhameva ca //
meaning:
ततो मध्याह्नसमये स्नानार्थं मृदमाहरेत् /
पुष्पाक्षतान् कुशतिलान् गोमयं शुद्धमेव च //
text_mt: Then, at noon, he should fetch earth for the sake of bathing, / flowers, unbroken grains, kuśa grass, sesame, and pure cow-dung.

sanskrit_iast:
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca /
snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ gartaprastravaṇeṣu ca //
meaning:
नदीषु देवखातेषु तडागेषु सरःसु च /
स्नानं समाचरेन्नित्यं गर्तप्रस्त्रवणेषु च //
text_mt: In rivers, natural ponds, tanks, and lakes, / and in hollows and waterfalls, he should perform his bath daily.

sanskrit_iast:
parakīyanipāneṣu na snāyād vai kadācana /
pañcapiṇḍān samuddhṛtya snāyād vāsaṃbhave punaḥ //
meaning:
परकीयनिपानेषु न स्नायाद् वै कदाचन /
पञ्चपिण्डान् समुद्धृत्य स्नायाद् वासंभवे पुनः //
text_mt: He should never bathe in water reservoirs belonging to others; / or, if there is no other resort, he may bathe after taking out five lumps [of earth].

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ dvābhyāṃ nābhestathopari /
adhaśca tisṛbhiḥ kāyaṃ pādau ṣaḍbhistathaiva ca //
meaning:
मृदैकया शिरः क्षाल्यं द्वाभ्यां नाभेस्तथोपरि /
अधश्च तिसृभिः कायं पादौ षड्भिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: The head is to be washed with one lump of earth, above the navel with two, / the body below with three, and likewise the feet with six.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛttikā ca samuddiṣṭā tvārdrāmalakamātrikā /
gomayasya pramāṇaṃ tat tenāṅgaṃ lepayet tataḥ //
meaning:
मृत्तिका च समुद्दिष्टा त्वार्द्रामलकमात्रिका /
गोमयस्य प्रमाणं तत् तेनाङ्गं लेपयेत् ततः //
text_mt: The measure of earth prescribed is that of a moist āmalaka fruit; / that is also the measure of the cow-dung; with that he should smear his body.

sanskrit_iast:
lepayitvā tu tīrasthastalliṅgaireva mantrataḥ /
prakṣālyācamya vidhivat tataḥ snāyāt samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
लेपयित्वा तु तीरस्थस्तल्लिङ्गैरेव मन्त्रतः /
प्रक्षाल्याचम्य विधिवत् ततः स्नायात् समाहितः //
text_mt: Having smeared it while standing on the bank, reciting mantras appropriate to each mark, / having washed and sipped water according to rule, he should then bathe with a concentrated mind.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimantrya jalaṃ mantraistalliṅgairvāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
bhāvapūtastadavyaktaṃ dhyāyan vai viṣṇumavyayam //
meaning:
अभिमन्त्र्य जलं मन्त्रैस्तल्लिङ्गैर्वारुणैः शुभैः /
भावपूतस्तदव्यक्तं ध्यायन् वै विष्णुमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Having consecrated the water with auspicious mantras addressed to Varuṇa that mark it as such, / purified in feeling, meditating indeed on the unmanifest, imperishable Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
āpo nārāyaṇodbhūtāstā evāsyāyanaṃ punaḥ /
tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ snānakāle smared budhaḥ //
meaning:
आपो नारायणोद्भूतास्ता एवास्यायनं पुनः /
तस्मान्नारायणं देवं स्नानकाले स्मरेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Waters arose from Nārāyaṇa, and they are his abode; / therefore, the wise person should remember the god Nārāyaṇa at the time of bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
procya soṃkāramādityaṃ trirnimajjejjalāśaye /
ācāntaḥ punarācāmenmantreṇānena mantravit //
meaning:
प्रोच्य सोंकारमादित्यं त्रिर्निमज्जेज्जलाशये /
आचान्तः पुनराचामेन्मन्त्रेणानेन मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Having pronounced the syllable Om and the name of the sun, he should plunge three times into the reservoir of water; / having sipped water, the knower of mantras should sip water again with this mantra:

sanskrit_iast:
antaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvato mukhaḥ /
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam //
meaning:
अन्तश्चरसि भूतेषु गुहायां विश्वतो मुखः /
त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कार आपो ज्योती रसो ऽमृतम् //
text_mt: “You move within living beings in the secret chamber [of the heart], facing in all directions; / you are the sacrifice, you are the vaṣaṭ call, the waters, the light, the essence, the nectar of immortality.”

sanskrit_iast:
drupadāṃ vā trirabhyasyed vyāhṛtipraṇavānvitām /
sāvitrīṃ vā japed vidvān tathā caivāghamarṣaṇam //
meaning:
द्रुपदां वा त्रिरभ्यस्येद् व्याहृतिप्रणवान्विताम् /
सावित्रीं वा जपेद् विद्वान् तथा चैवाघमर्षणम् //
text_mt: Or the wise man should repeat the Drupadā verse three times, accompanied by the sacred utterances and the praṇava, / or chant the Sāvitrī verse, and likewise the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kuryādāpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ /
idamāpaḥ pravahata vyāhṛtibhistathaiva ca //
meaning:
ततः संमार्जनं कुर्यादापो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवः /
इदमापः प्रवहत व्याहृतिभिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Then he should perform sprinkling with “You waters are verily refreshing” / and “Carry away this, O waters,” and likewise with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bhimantrya tat tīrthamāpo hiṣṭhādimantrakaiḥ /
antarjalagato magno japet triraghamarṣaṇam //
meaning:
ततो ऽभिमन्त्र्य तत् तीर्थमापो हिष्ठादिमन्त्रकैः /
अन्तर्जलगतो मग्नो जपेत् त्रिरघमर्षणम् //
text_mt: Then, having consecrated that sacred bath with the mantras beginning with “You waters are verily refreshing,” / having plunged underwater, he should recite the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn three times.

sanskrit_iast:
tripadāṃ vātha sāvitrīṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam /
āvartayed vā praṇavaṃ devaṃ vā saṃsmareddharim //
meaning:
त्रिपदां वाथ सावित्रीं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् /
आवर्तयेद् वा प्रणवं देवं वा संस्मरेद्धरिम् //
text_mt: Or he should repeat the three-footed Sāvitrī verse, or “That supreme abode of Viṣṇu,” / or he should repeat the praṇava, or remember the god Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
drupadādiva yo mantro yajurvede pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
antarjale trirāvartya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
द्रुपदादिव यो मन्त्रो यजुर्वेदे प्रतिष्ठितः /
अन्तर्जले त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: The mantra that begins with Drupadā, which is established in the Yajurveda, / being repeated three times while underwater, frees one from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
apaḥ pāṇau samādāya japtvā vai mārjane kṛte /
vinyasya mūrdhni tat toyaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
अपः पाणौ समादाय जप्त्वा वै मार्जने कृते /
विन्यस्य मूर्ध्नि तत् तोयं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: Taking water in the hand and reciting [it], once the sprinkling is performed, / placing that water on the head, one is freed from all mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ /
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam //
meaning:
यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः /
तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापापनोदनम् //
text_mt: Just as the horse-sacrifice is the king of sacrifices, dispelling all sins, / so the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn dispels all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
athopatiṣṭhedādityaṃ mūrdhni puṣpānvitāñjalim /
prakṣipyālokayed devamudvayaṃ tamasaspari //
meaning:
अथोपतिष्ठेदादित्यं मूर्ध्नि पुष्पान्विताञ्जलिम् /
प्रक्षिप्यालोकयेद् देवमुद्वयं तमसस्परि //
text_mt: Then he should attend upon the sun, placing folded hands containing flowers upon his head; / having thrown them, he should look at the god with “Beholding the higher light beyond darkness.”

sanskrit_iast:
udutyaṃ citramityete taccakṣuriti mantrataḥ /
haṃsaḥ śuciṣadetena sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
उदुत्यं चित्रमित्येते तच्चक्षुरिति मन्त्रतः /
हंसः शुचिषदेतेन सावित्र्या च विशेषतः //
text_mt: With the mantras “Looking up at that brilliant light,” “The wonderful [face of the gods has arisen],” and “That eye [appointed by the gods],” / with “The swan seated in the pure ether,” and especially with the Sāvitrī verse,

sanskrit_iast:
anyaiśca vaidikairmantraiḥ sauraiḥ pāpapraṇāśanaiḥ /
sāvitrīṃ vai japet paścājjapayajñaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यैश्च वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः सौरैः पापप्रणाशनैः /
सावित्रीं वै जपेत् पश्चाज्जपयज्ञः स वै स्मृतः //
text_mt: and with other Vedic solar mantras that destroy sin, / he should afterwards chant the Sāvitrī; that is indeed considered the sacrifice of recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
vividhāni pavitrāṇi guhyavidyāstathaiva ca /
śatarudrīyamatharvaśiraḥ saurāṃśca śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
विविधानि पवित्राणि गुह्यविद्यास्तथैव च /
शतरुद्रीयमथर्वशिरः सौरांश्च शक्तितः //
text_mt: According to his ability, he should recite various purifying texts and secret lores, / the Śatarudrīya, the Atharvaśiras, and the solar hymns.

sanskrit_iast:
prākkūleṣu samāsīnaḥ kuśeṣu prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ /
tiṣṭhaṃścedīkṣamāṇor'kaṃ japyaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
प्राक्कूलेषु समासीनः कुशेषु प्राङ्मुखः शुचिः /
तिष्ठंश्चेदीक्षमाणोर्ऽकं जप्यं कुर्यात् समाहितः //
text_mt: Seated on kuśa grass with the tips pointing east, facing east, purified, / or standing while gazing at the sun, he should perform his recitation with a concentrated mind.

sanskrit_iast:
sphāṭikendrākṣarudrākṣaiḥ putrajīvasamudbhavaḥ /
kartavyā tvakṣamālā syāduttarāduttamā smṛtā //
meaning:
स्फाटिकेन्द्राक्षरुद्राक्षैः पुत्रजीवसमुद्भवः /
कर्तव्या त्वक्षमाला स्यादुत्तरादुत्तमा स्मृता //
text_mt: A rosary should be made of crystal, indrākṣa, rudrākṣa, / or originating from the putrajīva plant; each succeeding one is considered better than the former.

sanskrit_iast:
japakāle na bhāṣeta nānyāni prekṣayed budhaḥ /
na kampayecchirogrīvāṃ dantānnaiva prakāśayet //
meaning:
जपकाले न भाषेत नान्यानि प्रेक्षयेद् बुधः /
न कम्पयेच्छिरोग्रीवां दन्तान्नैव प्रकाशयेत् //
text_mt: At the time of recitation, the wise man should not speak, nor look at other things; / he should not shake his head or neck, nor show his teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
guhyakā rākṣasā siddhā haranti prasabhaṃ yataḥ /
ekānte suśubhe deśe tasmājjapyaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
गुह्यका राक्षसा सिद्धा हरन्ति प्रसभं यतः /
एकान्ते सुशुभे देशे तस्माज्जप्यं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Because Guhyakas, demons, and Siddhas seize [the merit] by force, / one should therefore perform the recitation in a secluded, very auspicious place.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālāśaucapatitān dṛṣṭvācamya punarjapet /
taireva bhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā caiva japet punaḥ //
meaning:
चण्डालाशौचपतितान् दृष्ट्वाचम्य पुनर्जपेत् /
तैरेव भाषणं कृत्वा स्नात्वा चैव जपेत् पुनः //
text_mt: Having seen Caṇḍālas, the impure, or the fallen, he should sip water and recite again; / having spoken with them, he should bathe and recite once more.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamya prayato nityaṃ japedaśucidarśane /
saurān mantrān śaktito vai pāvamānīstu kāmataḥ //
meaning:
आचम्य प्रयतो नित्यं जपेदशुचिदर्शने /
सौरान् मन्त्रान् शक्तितो वै पावमानीस्तु कामतः //
text_mt: Having sipped water, purified, upon seeing an impure object he should always recite / solar mantras according to his capacity, and the purifying verses according to his wish.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syāt klinnavāsā vai vārimadhyagato japet /
anyathā tu śucau bhūmyāṃ darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
यदि स्यात् क्लिन्नवासा वै वारिमध्यगतो जपेत् /
अन्यथा तु शुचौ भूम्यां दर्भेषु सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: If his clothes are wet, he should recite standing in the middle of water; / otherwise, very composed, on clean ground upon darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvṛtya namaskṛtvā tataḥ kṣitau /
ācamya ca yathāśāstraṃ śaktyā svādhyāyamācaret //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं समावृत्य नमस्कृत्वा ततः क्षितौ /
आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रं शक्त्या स्वाध्यायमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having turned clockwise in circumambulation, and then bowed down on the earth, / and having sipped water according to the treatise, he should practice Vedic study according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā /
adāvoṅkāramuccārya namo 'nte tarpayāmi vaḥ //
meaning:
ततः संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा /
अदावोङ्कारमुच्चार्य नमो ऽन्ते तर्पयामि वः //
text_mt: Then he should offer libations to the gods, the sages, and the classes of ancestors, / uttering Om at the beginning and “praise” at the end, saying: “I offer libations to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
devān brahmaḥṛṣīṃścaiva tarpayedakṣatodakaiḥ /
tilodakaiḥ pitṝn bhaktyā svasūtroktavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
देवान् ब्रह्मःऋषींश्चैव तर्पयेदक्षतोदकैः /
तिलोदकैः पितॄन् भक्त्या स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः //
text_mt: He should offer libations to the gods and the divine sages with water mixed with unbroken grains, / and to the ancestors with water mixed with sesame seeds, with devotion, according to the rule declared in his own aphorisms.

sanskrit_iast:
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu /
devarṣostarpayed dhīmānudakāñjalibhiḥ pitan //
meaning:
अन्वारब्धेन सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु /
देवर्षोस्तर्पयेद् धीमानुदकाञ्जलिभिः पितन् //
text_mt: With the right hand supported by the left hand, / the wise person should offer libations to the gods and sages, and to the ancestors with hollowed hands of water.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopavītī devānāṃ nivītī ṛṣītarpaṇe /
prācīnāvītī pitrye tu svena tīrthena bhāvataḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञोपवीती देवानां निवीती ऋषीतर्पणे /
प्राचीनावीती पित्र्ये तु स्वेन तीर्थेन भावतः //
text_mt: With the sacred thread worn over the left shoulder for the gods, suspended around the neck for the libation to the sages, / and worn over the right shoulder for ancestral rites, [he should offer water] through its proper sacred spot on the hand, with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu samācamya ca vāgyataḥ /
svairmantrairarcayed devān puṣpaiḥ patrairathāmbubhiḥ //
meaning:
निष्पीड्य स्नानवस्त्रं तु समाचम्य च वाग्यतः /
स्वैर्मन्त्रैरर्चयेद् देवान् पुष्पैः पत्रैरथाम्बुभिः //
text_mt: Having wrung out his bathing cloth, sipped water, and restrained his speech, / he should worship the gods with their own mantras, with flowers, leaves, and water:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sūryaṃ tathaiva madhusūdanam /
anyāṃścābhimatān devān bhaktyā cākrodhano 'tvaraḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं सूर्यं तथैव मधुसूदनम् /
अन्यांश्चाभिमतान् देवान् भक्त्या चाक्रोधनो ऽत्वरः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Śaṅkara, Sūrya, and likewise Madhusūdana, / and other chosen deities, with devotion, free from anger and unhurried.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyād vātha puṣpāṇi sūktena pauruṣeṇa tu /
āpo vā devatāḥ sarvāstena samyak samarcitāḥ //
meaning:
प्रदद्याद् वाथ पुष्पाणि सूक्तेन पौरुषेण तु /
आपो वा देवताः सर्वास्तेन सम्यक् समर्चिताः //
text_mt: Or he may offer flowers with the Puruṣasūkta; / for all deities are water, and by that they are properly worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā praṇavapūrvaṃ vai daivatāni samāhitaḥ /
namaskāreṇa puṣpāṇi vinyased vai pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
ध्यात्वा प्रणवपूर्वं वै दैवतानि समाहितः /
नमस्कारेण पुष्पाणि विन्यसेद् वै पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Having meditated on the deities preceded by the syllable Om, composed in mind, / he should indeed arrange the flowers individually with the word 'namaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
na viṣṇvārādhanāt puṇyaṃ vidyate karma vaidikam /
tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ nityamārādhayeddharim //
meaning:
न विष्ण्वाराधनात् पुण्यं विद्यते कर्म वैदिकम् /
तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं नित्यमाराधयेद्धरिम् //
text_mt: There is no Vedic action more meritorious than the worship of Viṣṇu; / therefore, one should perpetually worship Hari, who is without beginning, middle, or end,

sanskrit_iast:
tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa sūktena puruṣeṇa tu /
naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro sūktena puruṣeṇa tu /
naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro vedeṣūktaścaturṣvapi //
meaning:
तद्विष्णोरिति मन्त्रेण सूक्तेन पुरुषेण तु /
नैताभ्यां सदृशो मन्त्रो सूक्तेन पुरुषेण तु /
नैताभ्यां सदृशो मन्त्रो वेदेषूक्तश्चतुर्ष्वपि //
text_mt: With the mantra 'tad viṣṇoḥ' and with the Puruṣasūkta; / no mantra equal to these two has been spoken even across the four Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
nivedayeta svātmānaṃ viṣṇāvamalatejasi /
tadātmā tanmanāḥ śāntastadviṣṇoriti mantrataḥ //
meaning:
निवेदयेत स्वात्मानं विष्णावमलतेजसि /
तदात्मा तन्मनाः शान्तस्तद्विष्णोरिति मन्त्रतः //
text_mt: One should surrender oneself to Viṣṇu of spotless splendor; / identified with him, intent upon him, peaceful, through the mantra 'tad viṣṇoḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā devamīśānaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam /
ārādhayenmahādevaṃ bhāvapūto maheśvaram //
meaning:
अथवा देवमीशानं भगवन्तं सनातनम् /
आराधयेन्महादेवं भावपूतो महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Or else, purified in thought, he should worship the lord Īśāna, / the eternal Bhagavat, Mahādeva, Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa rudrāgāyatryā praṇavenātha vā punaḥ /
īśānenātha vā rudraistryambakena samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेण रुद्रागायत्र्या प्रणवेनाथ वा पुनः /
ईशानेनाथ वा रुद्रैस्त्र्यम्बकेन समाहितः //
text_mt: With the Rudragāyatrī mantra, or with the syllable Om, / or with the Īśāna mantra, or concentrated with the Tryambaka mantra to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaiḥ patrairathādbhirvā candanādyairmaheśvaram /
uktvā namaḥ śivāyeti mantreṇānena yojayet //
meaning:
पुष्पैः पत्रैरथाद्भिर्वा चन्दनाद्यैर्महेश्वरम् /
उक्त्वा नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रेणानेन योजयेत् //
text_mt: With flowers, leaves, or water, and with sandalwood paste and the like, / he should attend upon Maheśvara, having spoken the mantra: 'Namaḥ Śivāya'.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskuryānmahādevaṃ ṛtaṃ satyamitiśvaram /
nivedayīta svātmānaṃ yo brahmāṇamitīśvaram //
meaning:
नमस्कुर्यान्महादेवं ऋतं सत्यमितिश्वरम् /
निवेदयीत स्वात्मानं यो ब्रह्माणमितीश्वरम् //
text_mt: He should bow down to Mahādeva, the lord, with 'ṛtaṃ satyam'; / he should surrender himself to the lord with 'yo brahmāṇam'.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ dvijaḥ kuryāt pañca brahmāṇi vai japan /
dhyāyīta devamīśānaṃ vyomamadhyagataṃ śivam //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं द्विजः कुर्यात् पञ्च ब्रह्माणि वै जपन् /
ध्यायीत देवमीशानं व्योममध्यगतं शिवम् //
text_mt: The twice-born should make a circumambulation while reciting the five Brahmamantras; / he should meditate on the divine Īśāna, Śiva abiding in the midst of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
athāvalokayedarkaṃ haṃsaḥ suciṣadityṛcā /
kuryāt pañca mahāyajñān gṛhaṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अथावलोकयेदर्कं हंसः सुचिषदित्यृचा /
कुर्यात् पञ्च महायज्ञान् गृहं गत्वा समाहितः //
text_mt: Then he should look at the sun with the verse 'haṃsaḥ śuciṣad'; / having gone home, composed in mind, he should perform the five great sacrifices:

sanskrit_iast:
devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathaiva ca /
mānuṣyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca pañca yajñān pracakṣate //
meaning:
देवयज्ञं पितृयज्ञं भूतयज्ञं तथैव च /
मानुष्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञं च पञ्च यज्ञान् प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: The sacrifice to the gods, the sacrifice to the ancestors, and likewise the sacrifice to living beings, / the sacrifice to humans, and the sacrifice to Brahman—these are proclaimed as the five sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syāt tarpaṇādarvāk brahmayajñaḥ kṛto na hi /
kṛtvā manuṣyayajñaṃ vai tataḥ svādhyāyamācaret //
meaning:
यदि स्यात् तर्पणादर्वाक् ब्रह्मयज्ञः कृतो न हि /
कृत्वा मनुष्ययज्ञं वै ततः स्वाध्यायमाचरेत् //
text_mt: If the sacrifice to Brahman was not performed before the water-libations, / then having performed the sacrifice to humans, he should practice his Vedic study.

sanskrit_iast:
agneḥ paścimato deśe bhūtayajñānta eva vā /
kuśapuñje samāsīnaḥ kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अग्नेः पश्चिमतो देशे भूतयज्ञान्त एव वा /
कुशपुञ्जे समासीनः कुशपाणिः समाहितः //
text_mt: In the place to the west of the fire, or at the conclusion of the sacrifice to living beings, / seated on a bunch of kuśa grass, holding kuśa grass in hand, composed in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
śālāgnau laukike vāgnau jale bhūbhyāmathāpivā /
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryād devayajñaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शालाग्नौ लौकिके वाग्नौ जले भूभ्यामथापिवा /
वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्याद् देवयज्ञः स वै स्मृतः //
text_mt: In the domestic fire or in a secular fire, in water or on the ground, / he should then perform the Vaiśvadeva offering; that is indeed remembered as the sacrifice to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syāllaukike pakvaṃ tato 'nnaṃ tatra hūyate /
śālāgnau tatra devānnaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
यदि स्याल्लौकिके पक्वं ततो ऽन्नं तत्र हूयते /
शालाग्नौ तत्र देवान्नं विधिरेष सनातनः //
text_mt: If food is cooked on a secular fire, then it is offered there; / in the domestic fire, it is food for the gods; this is the eternal rule.

sanskrit_iast:
devebhyastu hutādannāccheṣād bhūtabaliṃ haret /
bhūtayajñaḥ sa vai jñeyo bhūtidaḥ sarvadehinām //
meaning:
देवेभ्यस्तु हुतादन्नाच्छेषाद् भूतबलिं हरेत् /
भूतयज्ञः स वै ज्ञेयो भूतिदः सर्वदेहिनाम् //
text_mt: From the food remaining after offering to the gods, he should present the offering to living beings; / that is to be known as the sacrifice to living beings, which brings prosperity to all embodied souls.

sanskrit_iast:
śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca patitādibhya eva ca /
dadyād bhūmau baliṃ tvannaṃ pakṣibhyo 'tha dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
श्वभ्यश्च श्वपचेभ्यश्च पतितादिभ्य एव च /
दद्याद् भूमौ बलिं त्वन्नं पक्षिभ्यो ऽथ द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: The best of the twice-born should place an offering of food on the ground / for dogs, for dog-cookers, for outcasts and the like, and for birds.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ cānnasya siddhasya patnyamantraṃ baliṃ haret /
bhūtayajñastvayaṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātarvidhīyate //
meaning:
सायं चान्नस्य सिद्धस्य पत्न्यमन्त्रं बलिं हरेत् /
भूतयज्ञस्त्वयं नित्यं सायं प्रातर्विधीयते //
text_mt: And in the evening, the wife should offer a portion from the prepared food without mantras; / this sacrifice to living beings is prescribed perpetually, evening and morning.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ tu bhojayed vipraṃ pitṝnuddiśya sattamam /
nityaśrāddhaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ pitṛyajño gatipradaḥ //
meaning:
एकं तु भोजयेद् विप्रं पितॄनुद्दिश्य सत्तमम् /
नित्यश्राद्धं तदुद्दिष्टं पितृयज्ञो गतिप्रदः //
text_mt: He should feed one excellent vipra, intending it for the ancestors; / that is designated as the perpetual ancestral offering rite, the sacrifice to the ancestors that grants a high destination.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya vā yathāśakti kiñcidannaṃ samāhitaḥ /
vedatattvārthaviduṣe dvijāyaivopapādayet //
meaning:
उद्धृत्य वा यथाशक्ति किञ्चिदन्नं समाहितः /
वेदतत्त्वार्थविदुषे द्विजायैवोपपादयेत् //
text_mt: Or having taken out some food according to his ability, composed in mind, / he should provide it specifically to a twice-born person who knows the true meaning of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedatithiṃ nityaṃ namasyedarcayed dvijam /
manovākkarmabhiḥ śāntamāgataṃ svagṛha tataḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेदतिथिं नित्यं नमस्येदर्चयेद् द्विजम् /
मनोवाक्कर्मभिः शान्तमागतं स्वगृह ततः //
text_mt: He should perpetually honor a guest, and bow to and revere a twice-born person / who has arrived at his house, with mind, speech, and deeds, being calm.

sanskrit_iast:
hantakāramathāgraṃ vā bhikṣāṃ vā śaktito dvijaḥ /
dadyādatithaye nityaṃ budhyeta parameśvaram //
meaning:
हन्तकारमथाग्रं वा भिक्षां वा शक्तितो द्विजः /
दद्यादतिथये नित्यं बुध्येत परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: The twice-born should perpetually give to the guest according to his ability / a hantakāra, or an agra, or an alms-portion, and recognize him as the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣāmāhurgrāsamātramagraṃ tasyāścaturguṇam /
puṣkalaṃ hantakāraṃ tu taccaturguṇamucyate //
meaning:
भिक्षामाहुर्ग्रासमात्रमग्रं तस्याश्चतुर्गुणम् /
पुष्कलं हन्तकारं तु तच्चतुर्गुणमुच्यते //
text_mt: They say that an alms-portion is merely one mouthful; four times that is an agra; / and an abundant hantakāra is declared to be four times that.

sanskrit_iast:
godohamātraṃ kālaṃ vai pratīkṣyo hyatithiḥ svayam /
abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayedatithiṃ yathā //
meaning:
गोदोहमात्रं कालं वै प्रतीक्ष्यो ह्यतिथिः स्वयम् /
अभ्यागतान् यथाशक्ति पूजयेदतिथिं यथा //
text_mt: A guest should himself be awaited for the duration of milking a cow; / one should honor visitors according to ability, just as one would a guest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣāṃ vai bhikṣave dadyād vidhivad brahmacāriṇe /
dadyādannaṃ yathāśakti tvarthibhyo lobhavarjitaḥ //
meaning:
भिक्षां वै भिक्षवे दद्याद् विधिवद् ब्रह्मचारिणे /
दद्यादन्नं यथाशक्ति त्वर्थिभ्यो लोभवर्जितः //
text_mt: He should give alms according to rule to a mendicant and to a celibate student; / free from greed, he should give food according to his ability to those who ask.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapyalābhe tu annaṃ gobhyo nivedayet /
bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vāgyato 'nnamakutsayan //
meaning:
सर्वेषामप्यलाभे तु अन्नं गोभ्यो निवेदयेत् /
भुञ्जीत बन्धुभिः सार्धं वाग्यतो ऽन्नमकुत्सयन् //
text_mt: If none of these are present, he should offer the food to cows; / he should eat together with his relatives, silent and not disparaging the food.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā tu dvijaḥ pañca mahāyajñān dvijottamāḥ /
bhṛñjīta cet sa mūḍhātmā tiryagyoniṃ sagacchati //
meaning:
अकृत्वा तु द्विजः पञ्च महायज्ञान् द्विजोत्तमाः /
भृञ्जीत चेत् स मूढात्मा तिर्यग्योनिं सगच्छति //
text_mt: If a twice-born eats without having performed the five great sacrifices, O best of the twice-born, / that foolish-minded person goes to an animal womb.

sanskrit_iast:
vedābhyāso 'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyā kṣamā /
nāśayatyāśu pāpāni devānāmarcanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वेदाभ्यासो ऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रिया क्षमा /
नाशयत्याशु पापानि देवानामर्चनं तथा //
text_mt: Vedic study every day according to ability, performance of the great sacrifices, forbearance, / and worship of the gods swiftly destroy sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yo mohādathavālasyādakṛtvā devatārcanam /
bhuṅkte sa yāti narakān śūkareṣvabhijāyate //
meaning:
यो मोहादथवालस्यादकृत्वा देवतार्चनम् /
भुङ्क्ते स याति नरकान् शूकरेष्वभिजायते //
text_mt: He who, out of delusion or laziness, eats without having performed worship of the deities, / goes to the hells and is reborn among swine.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kṛtvā karmāṇi vai dvijāḥ /
bhuñjīta svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ sayāti paramāṃ gatim //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा कर्माणि वै द्विजाः /
भुञ्जीत स्वजनैः सार्धं सयाति परमां गतिम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Therefore, having performed the rites with every effort, O twice-born, / one should eat together with one's kin; he goes to the supreme state.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta sūryābhimukha eva vā /
āsīnastvāsane śuddhe bhūmyāṃ pādau nidhāya tu //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
प्राङ्मुखो ऽन्नानि भुञ्जीत सूर्याभिमुख एव वा /
आसीनस्त्वासने शुद्धे भूम्यां पादौ निधाय तु //
title: ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / One should eat food facing east or directly facing the sun, / seated on a pure seat, placing both feet on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhāḥ //
meaning:
आयुष्यं प्राङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते यशस्यं दक्षिणामुखः /
श्रियं प्रत्यङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते ऋतं भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखाः //
text_mt: Facing east, one eats for longevity; facing south, for renown; / facing west, one eats for prosperity; facing north, one eats for truth.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcārdre bhojanaṃ kuryād bhūmau pātraṃ nidhāya tu /
upavāsena tattulyaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चार्द्रे भोजनं कुर्याद् भूमौ पात्रं निधाय तु /
उपवासेन तत्तुल्यं मनुराह प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: One should take one's meal with five parts wet, having placed the dish on the ground; / Manu Prajāpati said that this is equal to a fast.

sanskrit_iast:
upalipte śucau deśe pādau prakṣālya vai karau /
ācamyārdrānano 'krodhaḥ pañcārdre bhojanaṃ caret //
meaning:
उपलिप्ते शुचौ देशे पादौ प्रक्षाल्य वै करौ /
आचम्यार्द्राननो ऽक्रोधः पञ्चार्द्रे भोजनं चरेत् //
text_mt: In a smeared, clean place, having washed feet and hands, / having sipped water, with a wet face and free from anger, one should take a meal with five parts wet.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvyahṛtibhistvannaṃ paridhāyodakena tu /
amṛtopastaraṇamasītyāpośānakriyāṃ caret //
meaning:
महाव्यहृतिभिस्त्वन्नं परिधायोदकेन तु /
अमृतोपस्तरणमसीत्यापोशानक्रियां चरेत् //
text_mt: Having encircled the food with water accompanied by the great sacred utterances, / one should perform the sipping of water with: 'You are the immortal bedding.'

sanskrit_iast:
svāhāpraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ prāṇāyādyāhutiṃ tataḥ /
apānāya tato hutvā vyānāya tadanantaram //
meaning:
स्वाहाप्रणवसंयुक्तां प्राणायाद्याहुतिं ततः /
अपानाय ततो हुत्वा व्यानाय तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Then, having made the first oblation to the in-breath accompanied by 'svāhā' and the syllable Om, / then having offered to the out-breath, immediately after that to the diffused breath,

sanskrit_iast:
udānāya tataḥ kuryāt samānāyeti pañcamīm /
vijñāya tattvameteṣāṃ juhuyādātmani dvijaḥ //
meaning:
उदानाय ततः कुर्यात् समानायेति पञ्चमीम् /
विज्ञाय तत्त्वमेतेषां जुहुयादात्मनि द्विजः //
text_mt: Then he should make the offering to the upward breath, and the fifth to the equal breath; / having understood their reality, the twice-born should offer into himself.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣamannaṃ yathākāmaṃ bhuñjītavyaṃ janairyutam /
dhyātvā tanmanasā devamātmānaṃ vai prajāpatim //
meaning:
शेषमन्नं यथाकामं भुञ्जीतव्यं जनैर्युतम् /
ध्यात्वा तन्मनसा देवमात्मानं वै प्रजापतिम् //
text_mt: The remaining food may be eaten as desired, accompanied by people, / having meditated with concentrated mind on the divine Self, indeed Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtāpidhānamasītyupariṣṭādapaḥ pibet /
ācāntaḥ punarācāmedāyaṃ gauriti mantrataḥ //
meaning:
अमृतापिधानमसीत्युपरिष्टादपः पिबेत् /
आचान्तः पुनराचामेदायं गौरिति मन्त्रतः //
