text_mt: He should drink water over it, saying: 'You are the immortal covering'; / having sipped water, he should sip water again with the mantra: 'āyaṃ gauḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
drupadāṃ vā trirāvartya sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm /
prāṇānāṃ granthirasītyālabhed hṛdayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
द्रुपदां वा त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनीम् /
प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरसीत्यालभेद् हृदयं ततः //
text_mt: Or having repeated three times the Drupadā verse, which destroys all sins, / he should then touch his heart with: 'You are the knot of the life-breaths.'

sanskrit_iast:
ācamyāṅguṣṭhamātreti pādāṅguṣṭhe 'tha dakṣiṇe /
niḥ stravayed hastajalamūrdhvahastaḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
आचम्याङ्गुष्ठमात्रेति पादाङ्गुष्ठे ऽथ दक्षिणे /
निः स्त्रवयेद् हस्तजलमूर्ध्वहस्तः समाहितः //
text_mt: Having sipped water, with the mantra 'aṅguṣṭhamātra', composed in mind with raised hand, / he should cause the water from his hand to flow down onto his right big toe.

sanskrit_iast:
hutānumantraṇaṃ kuryāt śraddhāyāmiti mantrataḥ /
athākṣareṇa svātmānaṃ yojayed brahmaṇeti hi //
meaning:
हुतानुमन्त्रणं कुर्यात् श्रद्धायामिति मन्त्रतः /
अथाक्षरेण स्वात्मानं योजयेद् ब्रह्मणेति हि //
text_mt: He should consecrate what was offered with the mantra beginning 'śraddhāyām'; / then he should unite his own self with Brahman by means of the Imperishable syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva yāgānāmātmayāgaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ /
yo 'nena vidhinā kuryāt sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ kṣayam //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव यागानामात्मयागः परः स्मृतः /
यो ऽनेन विधिना कुर्यात् स याति ब्रह्मणः क्षयम् //
text_mt: Of all sacrifices indeed, the inner sacrifice is taught to be supreme. / One who performs it according to this rule goes to the abode of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopavītī bhuñjīta straggandhālaṅkṛtaḥ śuciḥ /
sāyaṃprāparnāntarā vai saṃdhyāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञोपवीती भुञ्जीत स्त्रग्गन्धालङ्कृतः शुचिः /
सायंप्रापर्नान्तरा वै संध्यायां तु विशेषतः //
text_mt: Wearing the sacred thread, adorned with garlands and sandalwood paste, pure, one should eat, / especially at evening and morning, [avoiding] the twilight junctions.

sanskrit_iast:
nādyāt sūryagrahāt pūrvamahni sāyaṃ śaśigrahāt /
grahakāle ca nāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt tu muktayoḥ //
meaning:
नाद्यात् सूर्यग्रहात् पूर्वमह्नि सायं शशिग्रहात् /
ग्रहकाले च नाश्नीयात् स्नात्वाश्नीयात् तु मुक्तयोः //
text_mt: One should not eat by day before a solar eclipse, nor in the evening before a lunar eclipse; / nor should one eat during an eclipse; having bathed, one should eat when they are released.

sanskrit_iast:
mukte śaśini bhuñjīta yadi na syānmahāniśā /
amuktayorastaṅgatayoradyād dṛṣṭvā pare 'hani //
meaning:
मुक्ते शशिनि भुञ्जीत यदि न स्यान्महानिशा /
अमुक्तयोरस्तङ्गतयोरद्याद् दृष्ट्वा परे ऽहनि //
text_mt: When the moon is released, one may eat, provided it is not midnight; / if the two set while unreleased, one should eat after seeing them on the next day.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśnīyāt prekṣamāṇānāmapradāyaiva durmatiḥ /
na yajñaśiṣṭādand vā na kruddho nānyamānasaḥ //
meaning:
नाश्नीयात् प्रेक्षमाणानामप्रदायैव दुर्मतिः /
न यज्ञशिष्टादन्द् वा न क्रुद्धो नान्यमानसः //
text_mt: The foolish person should not eat while others are watching without giving [to them], / nor [food that is] not the remainder of an offering, nor when angry, nor with his mind elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yasya ratyarthaṃ yasya maithunam /
vṛtyarthaṃ yasya cādhītaṃ niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvitam //
meaning:
आत्मार्थं भोजनं यस्य रत्यर्थं यस्य मैथुनम् /
वृत्यर्थं यस्य चाधीतं निष्फलं तस्य जीवितम् //
text_mt: He whose eating is only for himself, whose sexual intercourse is only for pleasure, / and whose study is only for a livelihood—his life is fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhuṅkte veṣṭitaśirā yacca bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ /
sopānatkaśca yad bhuṅkte sarvaṃ vidyāt tadāsuram //
meaning:
यद्भुङ्क्ते वेष्टितशिरा यच्च भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखः /
सोपानत्कश्च यद् भुङ्क्ते सर्वं विद्यात् तदासुरम् //
text_mt: Whatever one eats with wrapped head, whatever one eats facing north, / and whatever one eats wearing sandals—one should know that all that belongs to the demons.

sanskrit_iast:
nārdharātre na madhyāhne nājīrṇe nārdravastradhṛk /
na ca bhinnāsanagato na śayānaḥ sthito 'pi vā //
meaning:
नार्धरात्रे न मध्याह्ने नाजीर्णे नार्द्रवस्त्रधृक् /
न च भिन्नासनगतो न शयानः स्थितो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Not at midnight, not at midday, not during indigestion, not wearing wet clothes, / and not seated on a broken seat, nor lying down, nor even standing;

sanskrit_iast:
na bhinnabhājane caiva na bhūmyāṃ na ca pāṇiṣu /
nocchiṣṭo ghṛtamādadyānna mūrdhānaṃ spṛśedapi //
meaning:
न भिन्नभाजने चैव न भूम्यां न च पाणिषु /
नोच्छिष्टो घृतमादद्यान्न मूर्धानं स्पृशेदपि //
text_mt: and not in a broken vessel, not on the ground, and not in the hands; / being defiled by food remnants, one should not take ghee, nor should one touch one's head;

sanskrit_iast:
na brahma kīrtayan vāpi na niḥ śeṣaṃ na bhāryayā /
nāndhakāre na cākāśe na ca devālayādiṣu //
meaning:
न ब्रह्म कीर्तयन् वापि न निः शेषं न भार्यया /
नान्धकारे न चाकाशे न च देवालयादिषु //
text_mt: nor reciting sacred text, nor [eating] completely everything, nor with one's wife, / not in darkness, not in an uncovered space, and not in temples and similar places;

sanskrit_iast:
naikavastrastu bhuñjīta na yānaśayanasthitaḥ /
na pādukānirgato 'tha na hasan vilapannapi //
meaning:
नैकवस्त्रस्तु भुञ्जीत न यानशयनस्थितः /
न पादुकानिर्गतो ऽथ न हसन् विलपन्नपि //
text_mt: nor should one eat wearing only a single garment, nor staying in a vehicle or on a bed, / nor having stepped out of sandals, nor laughing, nor bewailing.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvaivaṃ sukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmayet /
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedārthānupabṛṃhayet //
meaning:
भुक्त्वैवं सुखमास्थाय तदन्नं परिणामयेत् /
इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदार्थानुपबृंहयेत् //
text_mt: Having eaten thus, resting at ease, he should digest that food; / through Itihāsas and Purāṇas, he should expand upon the meanings of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta pūrvoktavidhinā dvijaḥ /
āsīnastu japed devīṃ gāyatrīṃ paścimāṃ prati //
meaning:
ततः संध्यामुपासीत पूर्वोक्तविधिना द्विजः /
आसीनस्तु जपेद् देवीं गायत्रीं पश्चिमां प्रति //
text_mt: Then the twice-born should perform the twilight devotion according to the previously stated rule; / seated, facing the west, he should recite the divine Gāyatrī.

sanskrit_iast:
na tiṣṭhati tu yaḥ purvāṃ nāste saṃdhyāṃ tu paścimām /
sa śūdreṇa samo loke sarvadharmavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
न तिष्ठति तु यः पुर्वां नास्ते संध्यां तु पश्चिमाम् /
स शूद्रेण समो लोके सर्वधर्मविवर्जितः //
text_mt: He who does not stand for the morning twilight, and does not sit for the evening twilight, / is equal to a Śūdra in the world, excluded from all duties.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvāgniṃ vidhivanmantrairbhuktvā yajñāvaśiṣṭakam /
sabhṛtyabāndhavajanaḥ svapecchuṣkapado niśi //
meaning:
हुत्वाग्निं विधिवन्मन्त्रैर्भुक्त्वा यज्ञावशिष्टकम् /
सभृत्यबान्धवजनः स्वपेच्छुष्कपदो निशि //
text_mt: Having offered into the fire according to the rule with mantras, having eaten the remnant of the sacrifice, / accompanied by servants and relatives, he should sleep at night with dry feet.

sanskrit_iast:
nottarābhimukhaḥ svapyāt paścimābhimukho na ca /
na cākāśe na nagno vā nāśucirnāsane kvacit //
meaning:
नोत्तराभिमुखः स्वप्यात् पश्चिमाभिमुखो न च /
न चाकाशे न नग्नो वा नाशुचिर्नासने क्वचित् //
text_mt: He should not sleep facing north, nor facing west, / nor in an uncovered space, nor naked, nor impure, nor anywhere upon a seat;

sanskrit_iast:
na śīrṇāyāṃ tu khaṭvāyāṃ śūnyāgāre na caiva hi /
nānuvaṃśaṃ na pālāśe śayane vā kadācana //
meaning:
न शीर्णायां तु खट्वायां शून्यागारे न चैव हि /
नानुवंशं न पालाशे शयने वा कदाचन //
text_mt: and not on a broken cot, nor indeed in an empty house, / nor along the central beam, nor ever on a couch of palāśa wood.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetadakhilenoktamahanyahani vai mayā /
brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛtyajātamapavargaphalapradam //
meaning:
इत्येतदखिलेनोक्तमहन्यहनि वै मया /
ब्राह्मणानां कृत्यजातमपवर्गफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Thus this entire collection of duties of Brahmins has indeed been spoken by me day by day, / bestowing the fruit of final liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikyādathavālasyāt brāhmaṇo na karoti yaḥ /
sa yāti narakān ghorān kākayonau ca jāyate //
meaning:
नास्तिक्यादथवालस्यात् ब्राह्मणो न करोति यः /
स याति नरकान् घोरान् काकयोनौ च जायते //
text_mt: The Brahmin who, out of unbelief or laziness, does not perform [them], / goes to terrible hells and is born in the womb of a crow.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyo vimuktaye panthā muktvāśramavidhiṃ svakam /
tasmāt karmāṇi kurvota tuṣṭaye parameṣṭhinaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
नान्यो विमुक्तये पन्था मुक्त्वाश्रमविधिं स्वकम् /
तस्मात् कर्माणि कुर्वोत तुष्टये परमेष्ठिनः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
There is no other path to liberation except the rule of one's own stage of life; / therefore, one should perform rituals for the satisfaction of the Supreme Lord.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
atha śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ prāpya kāryaṃ dvijottamaiḥ /
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ bhaktyā bhuktimuktiphalapradam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अथ श्राद्धममावास्यां प्राप्य कार्यं द्विजोत्तमैः /
पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं भक्त्या भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् //
title: viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said: / Now, when the new moon arrives, the ancestral offering rite should be performed by the best of the twice-born— / the Piṇḍānvāhāryaka [rite]—with devotion, granting the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

The Piṇḍānvāhāryaka ancestral offering rite is recommended when the king [of planets, the moon,] has waned, / in the afternoon, for the twice-born, with commendable meat.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṣīṇe rājani śasyate /
aparāhne dvijātīnāṃ praśastenāmiṣeṇa ca //
meaning:
पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं क्षीणे राजनि शस्यते /
अपराह्ने द्विजातीनां प्रशस्तेनामिषेण च //

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatprabhṛti hyanyāstithayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣake /
caturdaśīṃ varjayitvā praśastā hyuttarottarāḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिपत्प्रभृति ह्यन्यास्तिथयः कृष्णपक्षके /
चतुर्दशीं वर्जयित्वा प्रशस्ता ह्युत्तरोत्तराः //
text_mt: The other lunar days in the dark fortnight, beginning with the first, / excluding the fourteenth, are indeed progressively more commendable.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyāṣṭakāstistraḥ pauṣamāsādiṣu triṣu /
tistraścānvaṣṭakāḥ puṇyā māghī pañcadaśī tathā //
meaning:
अमावास्याष्टकास्तिस्त्रः पौषमासादिषु त्रिषु /
तिस्त्रश्चान्वष्टकाः पुण्या माघी पञ्चदशी तथा //
text_mt: The new moon, the three Aṣṭakās in the three months beginning with Pauṣa, / and the three meritorious Anvaṣṭakās, as well as the fifteenth day of Māgha;

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśī maghāyuktā varṣāsu tu viśeṣataḥ /
śasyāpākaśrāddhakālā nityāḥ proktā dine dine //
meaning:
त्रयोदशी मघायुक्ता वर्षासु तु विशेषतः /
शस्यापाकश्राद्धकाला नित्याः प्रोक्ता दिने दिने //
text_mt: the thirteenth joined with Maghā, especially during the rainy season; / the times for the ancestral offering rite upon the ripening of grain, and those declared daily as regular:

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikaṃ tu kartavyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ /
bāndhavānāṃ ca maraṇe nārakī syādato 'nyathā //
meaning:
नैमित्तिकं तु कर्तव्यं ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः /
बान्धवानां च मरणे नारकी स्यादतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: The occasional [rite] is to be performed at an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / and at the death of relatives; otherwise, one would become an inhabitant of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyāni caiva śrāddhāni śasyānte grahaṇādiṣu /
ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte 'pyanantakam //
meaning:
काम्यानि चैव श्राद्धानि शस्यान्ते ग्रहणादिषु /
अयने विषुवे चैव व्यतीपाते ऽप्यनन्तकम् //
text_mt: Optional ancestral offering rites too, at the end of grain [harvests], during eclipses and the like, / at a solstice, at an equinox, and also at a Vyatīpāta, yield infinite [fruit].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrāntyamakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā janmadineṣvapi /
nakṣatreṣu ca sarveṣu kāryaṃ kāmyaṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
संक्रान्त्यमक्षयं श्राद्धं तथा जन्मदिनेष्वपि /
नक्षत्रेषु च सर्वेषु कार्यं काम्यं विशेषतः //
text_mt: At an astrological transit, an ancestral offering rite is imperishable, and likewise on birthdays; / and an optional rite is especially to be performed on all the asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ ca labhate kṛtvā kṛttikāsu dvijottamaḥ /
apatyamatha rohiṇyāṃ saumye tu brahmavarcasam //
meaning:
स्वर्गं च लभते कृत्वा कृत्तिकासु द्विजोत्तमः /
अपत्यमथ रोहिण्यां सौम्ये तु ब्रह्मवर्चसम् //
text_mt: Having performed [it] under the Kṛttikās, the best of the twice-born obtains heaven; / under Rohiṇī, offspring; and under Saumya [Mṛgaśiras], spiritual luster;

sanskrit_iast:
raudrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhimārdrāyāṃ śauryameva ca /
punarvasau tathā bhūmiṃ śriyaṃ puṣye tathaiva ca //
meaning:
रौद्राणां कर्मणां सिद्धिमार्द्रायां शौर्यमेव च /
पुनर्वसौ तथा भूमिं श्रियं पुष्ये तथैव च //
text_mt: under Ārdrā, the accomplishment of fierce deeds, and valor; / likewise under Punarvasu, land; and likewise under Puṣya, prosperity;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvān kāmāṃstathā sārpe pitrye saubhāgyameva ca /
aryamṇe tu dhanaṃ vindyāt phālgunyāṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
सर्वान् कामांस्तथा सार्पे पित्र्ये सौभाग्यमेव च /
अर्यम्णे तु धनं विन्द्यात् फाल्गुन्यां पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: under Sārpa [Āśleṣā], all desires; and under Pitrya [Maghā], good fortune; / under Aryaman [Pūrvaphālgunī], he will find wealth; and under Phālgunī [Uttaraphālgunī], destruction of sin;

sanskrit_iast:
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ tathā haste citrāyāṃ ca bahūn sutān /
vāṇijyasiddhiṃ svātau tu viśākhāsu suvarṇakam //
meaning:
ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं तथा हस्ते चित्रायां च बहून् सुतान् /
वाणिज्यसिद्धिं स्वातौ तु विशाखासु सुवर्णकम् //
text_mt: likewise under Hasta, preeminence among kinsmen; and under Citrā, many sons; / under Svātī, success in commerce; and under the Viśākhās, gold;

sanskrit_iast:
maitre bahūni mitrāṇi rājyaṃ śākre tathaiva ca /
mūle kṛṣiṃ labhed yānasiddhimāpye samudrataḥ //
meaning:
मैत्रे बहूनि मित्राणि राज्यं शाक्रे तथैव च /
मूले कृषिं लभेद् यानसिद्धिमाप्ये समुद्रतः //
text_mt: under Maitra [Anurādhā], many friends; and likewise under Śākra [Jyeṣṭhā], kingship; / under Mūla, he will obtain agriculture; and under Āpya [Pūrvāṣāḍhā], success in travel across the sea;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvān kāmān vaiśvadeve śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu śravaṇe punaḥ /
śraviṣṭhāyāṃ tathā kāmān vāruṇe ca paraṃ balam //
meaning:
सर्वान् कामान् वैश्वदेवे श्रैष्ठ्यं तु श्रवणे पुनः /
श्रविष्ठायां तथा कामान् वारुणे च परं बलम् //
text_mt: under Vaiśvadeva [Uttarāṣāḍhā], all desires; and again under Śravaṇa, preeminence; / under Śraviṣṭhā [Dhaniṣṭhā], desires; and under Vāruṇa [Śatabhiṣaj], supreme strength;

sanskrit_iast:
ajaikapāde kupyaṃ syādahirbudhne gṛhaṃ śubham /
revatyāṃ bahavo gāvo hyaśvinyāṃ turagāṃstathā /
yāmye 'tha jīvanaṃ tat syādyadi śrāddhaṃ prayacchati //
meaning:
अजैकपादे कुप्यं स्यादहिर्बुध्ने गृहं शुभम् /
रेवत्यां बहवो गावो ह्यश्विन्यां तुरगांस्तथा /
याम्ये ऽथ जीवनं तत् स्याद्यदि श्राद्धं प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: under Ajaikapād [Pūrvabhādrapadā], there will be base metal; under Ahirbudhnya [Uttarabhādrapadā], an auspicious home; / under Revatī, many cattle; and under Aśvinī, horses; / and under Yāmya [Bharaṇī], livelihood will arise, if he offers the ancestral offering rite.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityavāre tvārogyaṃ candre saubhāgyameva ca /
kauje sarvatra vijayaṃ sarvān kāmān budhasya tu //
meaning:
आदित्यवारे त्वारोग्यं चन्द्रे सौभाग्यमेव च /
कौजे सर्वत्र विजयं सर्वान् कामान् बुधस्य तु //
text_mt: On Sunday, health; and on Monday, good fortune; / on Tuesday, victory everywhere; and on Wednesday, all desires;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāmabhīṣṭā jīve tu dhanaṃ vai bhārgave punaḥ /
śamaiśvare labhedāyuḥ pratipatsu sutān śubhān //
meaning:
विद्यामभीष्टा जीवे तु धनं वै भार्गवे पुनः /
शमैश्वरे लभेदायुः प्रतिपत्सु सुतान् शुभान् //
text_mt: on Thursday, desired knowledge; and on Friday, wealth; / on Saturday, he will obtain long life; on the first lunar days, auspicious sons;

sanskrit_iast:
kanyakāṃ vai dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu vandinaḥ /
paśūnkṣudrāṃścaturthyāṃ tu pañcamyāṃśobhanān sutān //
meaning:
कन्यकां वै द्वितीयायां तृतीयायां तु वन्दिनः /
पशून्क्षुद्रांश्चतुर्थ्यां तु पञ्चम्यांशोभनान् सुतान् //
text_mt: on the second, a daughter; on the third, panegyrists; / on the fourth, small livestock; on the fifth, handsome sons;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyāṃ dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ cāpi saptamyāṃ labhate naraḥ /
aṣṭamyāmapi vāṇijyaṃ labhate śrāddhadaḥ sadā //
meaning:
षष्ट्यां द्यूतं कृषिं चापि सप्तम्यां लभते नरः /
अष्टम्यामपि वाणिज्यं लभते श्राद्धदः सदा //
text_mt: on the sixth, a man obtains gambling [skill] and agriculture; and on the seventh, / even on the eighth, the giver of the ancestral offering rite always obtains commerce;

sanskrit_iast:
syānnavamyāmekakhuraṃ daśamyāṃ dvikhuraṃ bahu /
ekādaśyāṃ tathā rūpyaṃ brahmavarcasvinaḥ sutān //
meaning:
स्यान्नवम्यामेकखुरं दशम्यां द्विखुरं बहु /
एकादश्यां तथा रूप्यं ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः सुतान् //
text_mt: on the ninth, there will be solid-hoofed animals; on the tenth, many cloven-hoofed animals; / likewise on the eleventh, silver and sons endowed with spiritual luster;

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ jātarūpaṃ ca rajataṃ kupyameva ca /
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu kruprajāḥ /
pañcadaśyāṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां जातरूपं च रजतं कुप्यमेव च /
ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं त्रयोदश्यां चतुर्दश्यां तु क्रुप्रजाः /
पञ्चदश्यां सर्वकामानाप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा //
text_mt: on the twelfth, gold, silver, and base metal; / on the thirteenth, preeminence among kinsmen; but on the fourteenth, wicked offspring; / on the fifteenth, the giver of the ancestral offering rite always attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ dvijātibhiḥ /
śastreṇa tu hatānāṃ vai tatra śrāddhaṃ prakalpayet //
meaning:
तस्माच्छ्राद्धं न कर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यां द्विजातिभिः /
शस्त्रेण तु हतानां वै तत्र श्राद्धं प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Therefore, the ancestral offering rite should not be performed on the fourteenth by the twice-born; / rather, for those slain by weapons one should arrange an ancestral offering rite on that [day].

sanskrit_iast:
dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃpattau na kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ /
tasmād bhogāpavargārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryurdvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
द्रव्यब्राह्मणसंपत्तौ न कालनियमः कृतः /
तस्माद् भोगापवर्गार्थं श्राद्धं कुर्युर्द्विजातयः //
text_mt: When there is the presence of materials and Brahmins, no restriction of time is made; / therefore, twice-born people should perform the ancestral offering rite for the sake of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
karmārambheṣu sarveṣu kuryādābhyudayaṃ punaḥ /
putrajanmādiṣu śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇaṃ parvaṇi smṛtam //
meaning:
कर्मारम्भेषु सर्वेषु कुर्यादाभ्युदयं पुनः /
पुत्रजन्मादिषु श्राद्धं पार्वणं पर्वणि स्मृतम् //
text_mt: At the beginning of all rituals, he should perform the prosperity rite [Ābhyudayika]; / at the birth of a son and similar occasions, [an ancestral offering rite]; the Pārvaṇa is traditionally taught at the change of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ahanyahani nityaṃ syāt kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ punaḥ /
ekoddiṣṭādi vijñeyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam //
meaning:
अहन्यहनि नित्यं स्यात् काम्यं नैमित्तिकं पुनः /
एकोद्दिष्टादि विज्ञेयं वृद्धिश्राद्धं तु पार्वणम् //
text_mt: Day by day there should be the regular rite; then the optional and the occasional; / the Ekoddiṣṭa and so forth are to be known; and the Vṛddhi ancestral offering rite is a Pārvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
etat pañcavidhaṃ śrāddhaṃ manunā parikīrtitam /
yātrāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamākhyātaṃ tatprayatnena pālayet //
meaning:
एतत् पञ्चविधं श्राद्धं मनुना परिकीर्तितम् /
यात्रायां षष्ठमाख्यातं तत्प्रयत्नेन पालयेत् //
text_mt: This fivefold ancestral offering rite has been proclaimed by Manu; / on a journey, a sixth is declared—he should observe that with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaye saptamaṃ śrāddhaṃ brahmaṇā paribhāṣitam /
daivikaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ śrāddhaṃ yatkṛtvā mucyate bhayāt //
meaning:
शुद्धये सप्तमं श्राद्धं ब्रह्मणा परिभाषितम् /
दैविकं चाष्टमं श्राद्धं यत्कृत्वा मुच्यते भयात् //
text_mt: A seventh ancestral offering rite has been taught by Brahmā for purification; / and an eighth ancestral offering rite pertains to the deities, having performed which one is freed from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyārātryorna kartavyaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt /
deśānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa bhavet puṇyamanantakam //
meaning:
संध्यारात्र्योर्न कर्तव्यं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् /
देशानां च विशेषेण भवेत् पुण्यमनन्तकम् //
text_mt: It should not be performed during the two twilights or at night, except at the sighting of Rāhu; / and by virtue of holy places, infinite merit will accrue.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgāyāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayāge 'marakaṇṭake /
gāyanti pitaro gāthāṃ kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गायामक्षयं श्राद्धं प्रयागे ऽमरकण्टके /
गायन्ति पितरो गाथां कीर्तयन्ति मनीषिणः //
text_mt: An ancestral offering rite [performed] at the Gaṅgā, at Prayāga, and at Amarakaṇṭaka is imperishable. / The ancestors sing a verse, and the wise recite:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ /
teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gāyāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्राः शीलवन्तो गुणान्विताः /
तेषां तु समवेतानां यद्येको ऽपि गायां व्रजेत् //
text_mt: "Many virtuous and accomplished sons are to be desired, / so that, among all of them assembled, even if just one goes to Gayā,

sanskrit_iast:
gayāṃ prāpyānuṣaṅgeṇa yadi śrāddhaṃ samācaret /
tāritāḥ pitarastena sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
गयां प्राप्यानुषङ्गेण यदि श्राद्धं समाचरेत् /
तारिताः पितरस्तेन स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: and, having reached Gayā, performs an ancestral offering rite in due course, / the ancestors are delivered by him, and he goes to the highest state."

sanskrit_iast:
varāhaparvate caiva gaṅgāyāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ /
vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yatra devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ //
meaning:
वराहपर्वते चैव गङ्गायां वै विशेषतः /
वाराणस्यां विशेषेण यत्र देवः स्वयं हरः //
text_mt: And particularly at Varāhaparvata and at the Gaṅgā, / especially in Vārāṇasī, where God Hara is himself present;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgādvāre prabhāse ca bilvake nīlaparvate /
kurukṣetre ca kubjāmre bhṛgutuṅge mahālaye //
meaning:
गङ्गाद्वारे प्रभासे च बिल्वके नीलपर्वते /
कुरुक्षेत्रे च कुब्जाम्रे भृगुतुङ्गे महालये //
text_mt: at Gaṅgādvāra, Prabhāsa, Bilvaka, Nīlaparvata, / Kurukṣetra, Kubjāmra, Bhṛgutuṅga, and Mahālaya;

sanskrit_iast:
kedāre phalgutīrthe ca naimiṣāraṇya eva ca /
sarasvatyāṃ viśeṣeṇa puṣkareṣu viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
केदारे फल्गुतीर्थे च नैमिषारण्य एव च /
सरस्वत्यां विशेषेण पुष्करेषु विशेषतः //
text_mt: at Kedāra, the tīrtha of Phalgu, and in the Naimiṣa forest, / especially on the Sarasvatī, and particularly at the Puṣkaras;

sanskrit_iast:
narmadāyāṃ kuśāvarte śrīśaile bhadrakarṇake /
vetravatyāṃ vipāśāyāṃ godāvaryāṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
नर्मदायां कुशावर्ते श्रीशैले भद्रकर्णके /
वेत्रवत्यां विपाशायां गोदावर्यां विशेषतः //
text_mt: on the Narmadā, at Kuśāvarta, Śrīśaila, Bhadrakarṇaka, / on the Vetravatī, the Vipāśā, and especially on the Godāvarī;

sanskrit_iast:
evamādiṣu cānyeṣu tīrtheṣu pulineṣu ca /
nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu tuṣyanti pitaraḥ sadā //
meaning:
एवमादिषु चान्येषु तीर्थेषु पुलिनेषु च /
नदीनां चैव तीरेषु तुष्यन्ति पितरः सदा //
text_mt: at these and other holy places, on sandbanks, / and on the banks of rivers, the ancestors are always satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
vrīhibhiśca yavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalena vā /
śyāmākaiśca yavaiḥ śākairnovāraiśca priyaṅgubhiḥ /
gaudhūmaiśca tilairmudgairmāsaṃ prīṇayate pitṝn //
meaning:
व्रीहिभिश्च यवैर्माषैरद्भिर्मूलफलेन वा /
श्यामाकैश्च यवैः शाकैर्नोवारैश्च प्रियङ्गुभिः /
गौधूमैश्च तिलैर्मुद्गैर्मासं प्रीणयते पितॄन् //
text_mt: With wild rice, barley, black gram, water, or roots and fruits, / with śyāmāka grain, barley, greens, nīvāra rice, and priyaṅgu millet, / and with wheat, sesame, and mung beans, one satisfies the ancestors for a month.

sanskrit_iast:
āmrān pāne ratānikṣūn mṛdvīkāṃśca sadāḍimān /
vidāryāśca bharaṇḍāśca śrāddhakāle prādapayet //
meaning:
आम्रान् पाने रतानिक्षून् मृद्वीकांश्च सदाडिमान् /
विदार्याश्च भरण्डाश्च श्राद्धकाले प्रादपयेत् //
text_mt: One should offer mangoes, drinking-liquids, sugarcanes, grapes, along with pomegranates, / vidārī tubers, and bharaṇḍa fruits at the time of the ancestral offering rite.

sanskrit_iast:
lājān madhuyutān dadyāt saktūn śarkarayā saha /
dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena śṛṅgāṭakakaśerukān //
meaning:
लाजान् मधुयुतान् दद्यात् सक्तून् शर्करया सह /
दद्याच्छ्राद्धे प्रयत्नेन शृङ्गाटककशेरुकान् //
text_mt: One should offer parched grains with honey, and roasted barley meal with sugar; / at the ancestral offering rite, one should diligently give water chestnuts and kaśeruka tubers.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīn māsān hāriṇenatu /
aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākuneneha pañca tu //
meaning:
द्वौ मासौ मत्स्यमांसेन त्रीन् मासान् हारिणेनतु /
औरभ्रेणाथ चतुरः शाकुनेनेह पञ्च तु //
text_mt: For two months [they are satisfied] with fish, for three months with deer meat, / for four with mutton, and for five here with bird meat;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsāṃśchāgamāṃsena pārṣatenātha sapta vai /
aṣṭāveṇasya māṃsena rauraveṇa navaiva tu //
meaning:
षण्मासांश्छागमांसेन पार्षतेनाथ सप्त वै /
अष्टावेणस्य मांसेन रौरवेण नवैव तु //
text_mt: for six months with goat meat, and for seven with spotted deer meat; / for eight with the meat of the blackbuck, and for nine with that of the ruru deer;

sanskrit_iast:
daśamāsāṃstu tṛpyanti varāhamahiṣāmiṣaiḥ /
śaśakūrmaryormāṃsena māsānekādaśaiva tu //
meaning:
दशमासांस्तु तृप्यन्ति वराहमहिषामिषैः /
शशकूर्मर्योर्मांसेन मासानेकादशैव तु //
text_mt: for ten months they are satisfied with the flesh of boars and buffaloes; / and for eleven months with the meat of hares and tortoises;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena tu /
vārdhroṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī //
meaning:
संवत्सरं तु गव्येन पयसा पायसेन तु /
वार्ध्रोणसस्य मांसेन तृप्तिर्द्वादशवार्षिकी //
text_mt: for a full year with bovine milk and milk-rice pudding; / with the meat of a rhinoceros, the satisfaction lasts for twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkaṃ khaṅgalohāmiṣaṃ madhu /
ānantyāyaiva kalpante munyannāni ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
कालशाकं महाशल्कं खङ्गलोहामिषं मधु /
आनन्त्यायैव कल्पन्ते मुन्यन्नानि च सर्वशः //
text_mt: Kālaśāka greens, mahāśalka fish, the flesh of the rhinoceros, honey, / and the food of sages in every way serve for infinity.

sanskrit_iast:
krītvā labdhvā svayaṃ vātha mṛtānāhṛtya vā dvijaḥ /
dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena tadasyākṣayamucyate //
meaning:
क्रीत्वा लब्ध्वा स्वयं वाथ मृतानाहृत्य वा द्विजः /
दद्याच्छ्राद्धे प्रयत्नेन तदस्याक्षयमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having bought it, obtained it, or [found it] dead himself, having brought it, a twice-born / should diligently offer it at the ancestral offering rite; that is said to be imperishable for him.

sanskrit_iast:
pippalīṃ kramukaṃ caiva tathā caiva masūrakam /
kūṣmāṇḍālābuvārtākān bhūstṛṇaṃ surasaṃ tathā //
meaning:
पिप्पलीं क्रमुकं चैव तथा चैव मसूरकम् /
कूष्माण्डालाबुवार्ताकान् भूस्तृणं सुरसं तथा //
text_mt: Long pepper, betel nut, and likewise lentils, / pumpkin, bottle gourd, eggplant, fragrant grass, and holy basil;

sanskrit_iast:
kusumbhapiṇḍamūlaṃ vai tandulīyakameva ca /
rājamāṣāṃstathā kṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ ca vivarjayet //
meaning:
कुसुम्भपिण्डमूलं वै तन्दुलीयकमेव च /
राजमाषांस्तथा क्षीरं माहिषं च विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: safflower, radish, and amaranth greens, / cowpeas, and buffalo milk—one should avoid these.

sanskrit_iast:
kodravān kovidārāṃścapālakyān maricāṃstathā /
varjayet sarvayatnena śrāddhakāle dvijottamaḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
कोद्रवान् कोविदारांश्चपालक्यान् मरिचांस्तथा /
वर्जयेत् सर्वयत्नेन श्राद्धकाले द्विजोत्तमः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे विशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Kodo millet, kovidāra, spinach, and black pepper, / the best of the twice-born should avoid with every effort at the time of an ancestral offering rite.

Thus ends the twentieth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
snātvā yathoktaṃ saṃtarpya pitṝṃścandrakṣaye dvijaḥ /
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt saumyamanāḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
स्नात्वा यथोक्तं संतर्प्य पितॄंश्चन्द्रक्षये द्विजः /
पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं कुर्यात् सौम्यमनाः शुचिः //
title: ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having bathed, satisfied the ancestors according to the rule at the new moon, / pure and serene in mind, a twice-born should perform the piṇḍānvāhāryaka ancestral offering rite.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvameva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam /
tīrthaṃ tad havyakavyānāṃ pradāne cātithiḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वमेव परीक्षेत ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् /
तीर्थं तद् हव्यकव्यानां प्रदाने चातिथिः स्मृतः //
text_mt: First he should examine a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Veda; / he is a worthy recipient for the offerings to gods and ancestors, and a guest is so regarded.

sanskrit_iast:
ye somapā virajaso dharmajñāḥ śāntacetasaḥ /
vratino niyamasthāśca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ //
meaning:
ये सोमपा विरजसो धर्मज्ञाः शान्तचेतसः /
व्रतिनो नियमस्थाश्च ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः //
text_mt: Those who drink the soma, are free from passion, know dharma, and are calm of mind, / observant of vows, steady in restraints, and approaching their wives only during the fertile period;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāgnirapyadhīyāno yajurvedavideva ca /
bahvṛcaśca trisauparṇastrimadhurvātha yo bhavet //
meaning:
पञ्चाग्निरप्यधीयानो यजुर्वेदविदेव च /
बह्वृचश्च त्रिसौपर्णस्त्रिमधुर्वाथ यो भवेत् //
text_mt: one who maintains the five fires, is dedicated to study, and knows the Yajurveda, / one who recites the Ṛgveda, knows the Trisauparṇa hymns, or knows the Trimadhu verses;

sanskrit_iast:
triṇāciketacchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmaga eva ca /
atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā rudrādhyāyī viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
त्रिणाचिकेतच्छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामग एव च /
अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता रुद्राध्यायी विशेषतः //
text_mt: one who knows the Triṇāciketa fire, a chanter of the Sāmaveda, one who sings the Jyeṣṭhasāman, / a student of the Atharvaśiras, and especially one who recites the Śatarudrīya;

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraparo vidvān nyāyavicca ṣaḍaṅgavit /
mantrabrāhmaṇaviccaiva yaśca syād dharmapāṭhakaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रपरो विद्वान् न्यायविच्च षडङ्गवित् /
मन्त्रब्राह्मणविच्चैव यश्च स्याद् धर्मपाठकः //
text_mt: one devoted to the daily fire sacrifice, learned, knowledgeable in logic and in the six Vedāṅgas, / knowing the mantras and Brāhmaṇas, and one who recites the treatises on dharma;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣivratī ṛṣīkaśca tathā dvādaśavārṣikaḥ /
brahmadeyānusaṃtāno garbhaśuddhaḥ sahasradaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिव्रती ऋषीकश्च तथा द्वादशवार्षिकः /
ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतानो गर्भशुद्धः सहस्रदः //
text_mt: one observing the sage's vow, a sage-like man, one who has studied for twelve years, / an offspring born of a pure marriage rite, pure from conception, and a giver of thousands;

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇavratacaraḥ satyavādī purāṇavit /
gurudevāgnipūjāsu prasakto jñānatatparaḥ //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणव्रतचरः सत्यवादी पुराणवित् /
गुरुदेवाग्निपूजासु प्रसक्तो ज्ञानतत्परः //
text_mt: one who observes the lunar penance, speaks truth, and knows the Purāṇas, / devoted to the worship of guru, gods, and fire, intent on spiritual knowledge;

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktaḥ sarvato dhīro brahmabhūto dvijottamaḥ /
mahādevārcanarato vaiṣṇavaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ //
meaning:
विमुक्तः सर्वतो धीरो ब्रह्मभूतो द्विजोत्तमः /
महादेवार्चनरतो वैष्णवः पङ्क्तिपावनः //
text_mt: liberated on all sides, steadfast, identified with Brahman, the best of the twice-born, / devoted to the worship of Mahādeva, a devotee of Viṣṇu—such a one sanctifies the row;

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsānirato nityamapratigrahaṇastathā /
satriṇo dānaniratā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसानिरतो नित्यमप्रतिग्रहणस्तथा /
सत्रिणो दाननिरता विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः //
text_mt: constantly devoted to non-violence, and likewise not receiving gifts, / performing long soma sacrifices, devoted to giving gifts—these are to be known as sanctifiers of the row;

sanskrit_iast:
yuvānaḥ śrotriyāḥ svasthā mahāyajñaparāyaṇāḥ /
sāvitrījāpaniratā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ //
meaning:
युवानः श्रोत्रियाः स्वस्था महायज्ञपरायणाः /
सावित्रीजापनिरता ब्राह्मणाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः //
text_mt: youths learned in the Veda, healthy, devoted to the great sacrifices, / intent on muttering the Sāvitrī mantra—such brāhmaṇas sanctify the row;

sanskrit_iast:
kulīnāḥ śrutavantaśca śīlavantastapasvinaḥ /
agnicitsnātakā viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ //
meaning:
कुलीनाः श्रुतवन्तश्च शीलवन्तस्तपस्विनः /
अग्निचित्स्नातका विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः //
text_mt: well-born, learned, virtuous, practicing austerities, / vipras who have piled the fire-altar and performed the bath of completion are to be known as sanctifiers of the row;

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitrorhite yuktaḥ prātaḥ snāyī tathā dvijaḥ /
adhyātmavinmunirdānto vijñeyaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ //
meaning:
मातापित्रोर्हिते युक्तः प्रातः स्नायी तथा द्विजः /
अध्यात्मविन्मुनिर्दान्तो विज्ञेयः पङ्क्तिपावनः //
text_mt: a twice-born dedicated to the welfare of his parents, bathing in the morning, / knowing the supreme Self, a sage, self-restrained—he is to be known as a sanctifier of the row;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaniṣṭho mahāyogī vedāntārthavicintakaḥ /
śraddhāluḥ śrāddhanirato brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञाननिष्ठो महायोगी वेदान्तार्थविचिन्तकः /
श्रद्धालुः श्राद्धनिरतो ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः //
text_mt: established in knowledge, a great yogin, contemplating the meaning of the Vedānta, / faithful, devoted to ancestral offering rites—such a brāhmaṇa sanctifies the row;

sanskrit_iast:
vedavidyārataḥ snāto brahmacaryaparaḥ sadā /
atharvaṇo mumukṣuśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ //
meaning:
वेदविद्यारतः स्नातो ब्रह्मचर्यपरः सदा /
अथर्वणो मुमुक्षुश्च ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः //
text_mt: devoted to Vedic learning, bathed, ever intent on celibacy, / knower of the Atharvaveda, and a seeker of liberation—such a brāhmaṇa sanctifies the row;

sanskrit_iast:
asamānapravarako hyasagotrastathaiva ca /
asaṃbandhī ca vijñeyo brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ //
meaning:
असमानप्रवरको ह्यसगोत्रस्तथैव च /
असंबन्धी च विज्ञेयो ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः //
text_mt: having different pravaras, not of the same gotra, / and not a relative—such a brāhmaṇa is to be known as a sanctifier of the row.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayed yoginaṃ pūrvaṃ tattvajñānarataṃ yatim /
alābhe naiṣṭhikaṃ dāntamupakurvāṇakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
भोजयेद् योगिनं पूर्वं तत्त्वज्ञानरतं यतिम् /
अलाभे नैष्ठिकं दान्तमुपकुर्वाणकं तथा //
text_mt: First he should feed a yogin, an ascetic devoted to knowledge of the truth; / if none is available, a perpetual student, one who is self-controlled, or a temporary student;

sanskrit_iast:
tadalābhe gṛhasthaṃ tu mumukṣuṃ saṅgavarjitam /
sarvālābhe sādhakaṃ vā gṛhasthamapi bhojayet //
meaning:
तदलाभे गृहस्थं तु मुमुक्षुं सङ्गवर्जितम् /
सर्वालाभे साधकं वा गृहस्थमपि भोजयेत् //
text_mt: if he is unavailable, then a householder who is a seeker of liberation, free from attachment; / if none of these are available, he may even feed a practicing householder.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛterguṇatattvajño yasyāśnāti yatirhaviḥ /
phalaṃ vedavidāṃ tasya sahasrādatiricyate //
meaning:
प्रकृतेर्गुणतत्त्वज्ञो यस्याश्नाति यतिर्हविः /
फलं वेदविदां तस्य सहस्रादतिरिच्यते //
text_mt: If an ascetic who knows the reality of the qualities of primordial matter eats one's oblation, / the fruit of that surpasses [feeding] a thousand knowers of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād yatnena yogīndramīśvarajñānatatparam /
bhojayed havyakavyeṣu alābhāditarān dvijān //
meaning:
तस्माद् यत्नेन योगीन्द्रमीश्वरज्ञानतत्परम् /
भोजयेद् हव्यकव्येषु अलाभादितरान् द्विजान् //
text_mt: Therefore, one should diligently feed a lord of yogins, intent on knowledge of the Lord, / at the offerings to gods and ancestors; if unavailable, other twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vai prathamaḥ kalpaḥ pridāne havyakavyayoḥ /
anukalpastvayaṃ jñeyaḥ sadā sadbhiranuṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः प्रिदाने हव्यकव्ययोः /
अनुकल्पस्त्वयं ज्ञेयः सदा सद्भिरनुष्ठितः //
text_mt: This indeed is the primary rule for the giving of offerings to gods and ancestors; / but this secondary rule is to be known as always observed by the virtuous:

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahaṃ mātulaṃ ca svastrīyaṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum /
dauhitraṃ viṭpatiṃ bandhumṛtvigyājyau ca bhojayet //
meaning:
मातामहं मातुलं च स्वस्त्रीयं श्वशुरं गुरुम् /
दौहित्रं विट्पतिं बन्धुमृत्विग्याज्यौ च भोजयेत् //
text_mt: one should feed the maternal grandfather, the maternal uncle, the sister's son, the father-in-law, the guru, / the daughter's son, the son-in-law, a relative, the officiating priest, and the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast:
na śrāddhe bhojayenmitraṃ dhanaiḥ kāryo 'sya saṃgrahaḥ /
paiśācī dakṣiṇā sā hi naivāmutra phalapradā //
meaning:
न श्राद्धे भोजयेन्मित्रं धनैः कार्यो ऽस्य संग्रहः /
पैशाची दक्षिणा सा हि नैवामुत्र फलप्रदा //
text_mt: One should not feed a friend at an ancestral offering rite; he should be won over with wealth. / For that priestly gift is demoniacal and yields no fruit in the world beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
kāma śrāddhe 'rcayenmitraṃ nābhirūpamapi tvarim /
dviṣatā hi havirbhuktaṃ bhavati pretya niṣphalam //
meaning:
काम श्राद्धे ऽर्चयेन्मित्रं नाभिरूपमपि त्वरिम् /
द्विषता हि हविर्भुक्तं भवति प्रेत्य निष्फलम् //
text_mt: At will, one may honor a friend in an ancestral offering rite, but never an enemy, even if handsome; / for the sacrificial offering eaten by a foe becomes fruitless in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati /
tasmai havyaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो ह्यनधीयानस्तृणाग्निरिव शाम्यति /
तस्मै हव्यं न दातव्यं न हि भस्मनि हूयते //
text_mt: For an unlearned brahmin is extinguished like a fire of grass; / a sacrificial offering must not be given to him, for an offering is not poured into ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
yatheriṇe bījamuptvā na vaptā labhate phalam /
tathānṛce havirdattvā na dātā labhate phalam //
meaning:
यथेरिणे बीजमुप्त्वा न वप्ता लभते फलम् /
तथानृचे हविर्दत्त्वा न दाता लभते फलम् //
text_mt: Just as a sower who sows seed in barren ground reaps no fruit, / so a giver who offers an oblation to one ignorant of the Ṛgveda reaps no reward.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvato grasate piṇḍān havyakavyeṣvamantravit /
tāvato grasate pretya dīptān sthūlāṃstvayoguḍān //
meaning:
यावतो ग्रसते पिण्डान् हव्यकव्येष्वमन्त्रवित् /
तावतो ग्रसते प्रेत्य दीप्तान् स्थूलांस्त्वयोगुडान् //
text_mt: As many morsels as a man ignorant of mantras consumes in offerings to gods and ancestors, / so many glowing, thick iron balls he swallows after death.

sanskrit_iast:
api vidyākulairyuktā hīnavṛttā narādhamāḥ /
yatraite bhuñjate havyaṃ tad bhavedāsura dvijāḥ //
meaning:
अपि विद्याकुलैर्युक्ता हीनवृत्ता नराधमाः /
यत्रैते भुञ्जते हव्यं तद् भवेदासुर द्विजाः //
text_mt: Even if endowed with learning and lineage, vile men of low conduct— / where these consume the offering, O twice-born, that becomes demonic.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vedaśca vedī ca vicchidyete tripūruṣam /
sa vai durbrāhmaṇo nārhaḥ śrāddhādiṣu kadācana //
meaning:
यस्य वेदश्च वेदी च विच्छिद्येते त्रिपूरुषम् /
स वै दुर्ब्राह्मणो नार्हः श्राद्धादिषु कदाचन //
text_mt: He whose Veda and sacrificial altar have been broken off for three generations, / he indeed is a base Brahmin, never worthy of ancestral offering rites and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrapreṣyo bhṛto rājño vṛṣalo grāmayājakaḥ /
badhabandhopajīvī ca ṣaḍete brahmabandhavaḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रप्रेष्यो भृतो राज्ञो वृषलो ग्रामयाजकः /
बधबन्धोपजीवी च षडेते ब्रह्मबन्धवः //
text_mt: One in service to a Śūdra, one maintained by a king, a rogue, a village priest, / and one who lives by killing and binding: these six are degraded Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
dattānuyogān vṛtyarthaṃ patitān manurabravīt /
vedavikrāyiṇo hyete śrāddhādiṣu vigarhitāḥ //
meaning:
दत्तानुयोगान् वृत्यर्थं पतितान् मनुरब्रवीत् /
वेदविक्रायिणो ह्येते श्राद्धादिषु विगर्हिताः //
text_mt: Manu declared those who impart instruction for the sake of livelihood to be fallen; / for these sellers of the Veda are censured in ancestral offering rites and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutivikrayiṇo ye tu parapūrvāsamudbhavāḥ /
asamānān yājayanti patitāste prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
श्रुतिविक्रयिणो ये तु परपूर्वासमुद्भवाः /
असमानान् याजयन्ति पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Those who sell the Vedic scriptures, those born of a woman previously married to another, / and those who perform sacrifices for unequal persons are declared fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃskṛtādhyāpakā ye bhṛtyā vādhyāpayanti ye /
adhīyate tathā vedān patitāste prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
असंस्कृताध्यापका ये भृत्या वाध्यापयन्ति ये /
अधीयते तथा वेदान् पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Those who teach the uninitiated, those who teach as hirelings, / and likewise those who study the Vedas [from such], are declared fallen.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhaśrāvakanirgranthāḥ pañcarātravido janāḥ /
kāpālikāḥ pāśupatāḥ pāṣaṇḍā ye ca tadvidhāḥ //
meaning:
वृद्धश्रावकनिर्ग्रन्थाः पञ्चरात्रविदो जनाः /
कापालिकाः पाशुपताः पाषण्डा ये च तद्विधाः //
text_mt: The ancient Śrāvakas, the Nirgranthas, people knowing the Pañcarātra, / Kāpālikas, Pāśupatas, heretics, and those of similar kinds—

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāśnanti havīṃṣyete durātmānastu tāmasāḥ /
na tasya tad bhavecchrāddhaṃ pretya ceha phalapradam //
meaning:
यस्याश्नन्ति हवींष्येते दुरात्मानस्तु तामसाः /
न तस्य तद् भवेच्छ्राद्धं प्रेत्य चेह फलप्रदम् //
text_mt: if these wicked, dark-natured ones consume one's offerings, / that ancestral offering rite will yield no fruit for him either here or after death.

sanskrit_iast:
anāśramo yo dvijaḥ syādāśramī vā nirarthakaḥ /
mithyāśramī ca te viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktidūṣakāḥ //
meaning:
अनाश्रमो यो द्विजः स्यादाश्रमी वा निरर्थकः /
मिथ्याश्रमी च ते विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिदूषकाः //
text_mt: A twice-born man who is without an order of life, or one who belongs to an order in vain, / and one falsely in an order: such Brahmins are to be known as defilers of the assembly row.

sanskrit_iast:
duścarmā kunakhī kuṣṭhī śvitrī ca śyāvadantakaḥ /
viddhaprajananaścaiva stenaḥ klībo 'tha nāstikaḥ //
meaning:
दुश्चर्मा कुनखी कुष्ठी श्वित्री च श्यावदन्तकः /
विद्धप्रजननश्चैव स्तेनः क्लीबो ऽथ नास्तिकः //
text_mt: A man with bad skin, one with diseased nails, a leper, one with leukoderma, one with black teeth, / one with a pierced organ of generation, a thief, an impotent man, and an atheist;

sanskrit_iast:
madyapo vṛṣalīsakto vīrahā didhiṣūpatiḥ /
āgāradāhī kuṇḍāśī somavikrayiṇo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
मद्यपो वृषलीसक्तो वीरहा दिधिषूपतिः /
आगारदाही कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयिणो द्विजाः //
text_mt: a wine-drinker, one attached to a Śūdra woman, a killer of an initiated man, the husband of a younger sister married before the elder, / an incendiary, one who eats from the son of an adulteress, and twice-born who sell soma;

sanskrit_iast:
parivettā tathā hiṃstraḥ parivittirnirākṛtiḥ /
paunarbhavaḥ kusīdī ca tathā nakṣatradarśakaḥ //
meaning:
परिवेत्ता तथा हिंस्त्रः परिवित्तिर्निराकृतिः /
पौनर्भवः कुसीदी च तथा नक्षत्रदर्शकः //
text_mt: likewise a younger brother married before the elder, a violent man, an elder brother remaining unmarried after the younger, one who has neglected the Vedas, / the son of a remarried woman, a usurer, and an astrologer;

sanskrit_iast:
gītavāditranirato vyādhitaḥ kāṇa eva ca /
hīnāṅgaścātiriktāṅgo hyavakīrṇistathaiva ca //
meaning:
गीतवादित्रनिरतो व्याधितः काण एव च /
हीनाङ्गश्चातिरिक्ताङ्गो ह्यवकीर्णिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: one devoted to singing and playing musical instruments, a sick man, a one-eyed man, / one with a missing limb, one with a redundant limb, and a celibate student who has broken his vow;

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādūṣī kuṇḍagolau abhiśasto 'tha devalaḥ /
mitradhruk piśunaścaiva nityaṃ bhāryānuvartakaḥ //
meaning:
कन्यादूषी कुण्डगोलौ अभिशस्तो ऽथ देवलः /
मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनश्चैव नित्यं भार्यानुवर्तकः //
text_mt: a defiler of maidens, the son of an adulterous wife, the son of a widow, an accused man, a temple priest, / a betrayer of friends, a slanderer, and one constantly subservient to his wife;

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitrorgurostyāgī dāratyāgī tathaiva ca /
gotrabhid bhraṣṭaśaucaśca kāṇḍaspṛṣṭastathaiva ca //
meaning:
मातापित्रोर्गुरोस्त्यागी दारत्यागी तथैव च /
गोत्रभिद् भ्रष्टशौचश्च काण्डस्पृष्टस्तथैव च //
text_mt: one who abandons mother and father or guru, one who abandons his wife, / one who causes division in a lineage, one whose purity is lost, and one touched by an arrow;

sanskrit_iast:
anapatyaḥ kūṭasākṣī yācako raṅgajīvakaḥ /
samudrayāyī kṛtahā tathā samayabhedakaḥ //
meaning:
अनपत्यः कूटसाक्षी याचको रङ्गजीवकः /
समुद्रयायी कृतहा तथा समयभेदकः //
text_mt: one without offspring, a false witness, a beggar, one who lives by the stage, / a sea-voyager, a destroyer of what was done, and a breaker of agreements;

sanskrit_iast:
devanindāparaścaiva vedanindāratastathā /
dvijanindārataścaite varjyāḥ śrāddhādikarmasu //
meaning:
देवनिन्दापरश्चैव वेदनिन्दारतस्तथा /
द्विजनिन्दारतश्चैते वर्ज्याः श्राद्धादिकर्मसु //
text_mt: one intent on reviling the gods, one devoted to reviling the Veda, / and one devoted to reviling the twice-born: these must be avoided in rites such as the ancestral offering rite.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaghnaḥ piśunaḥ krūro nāstiko vedanindakaḥ /
mitradhruk kuhakaścaiva viśeṣāt paṅktidūṣakāḥ //
meaning:
कृतघ्नः पिशुनः क्रूरो नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः /
मित्रध्रुक् कुहकश्चैव विशेषात् पङ्क्तिदूषकाः //
text_mt: The ungrateful, the slanderer, the cruel, the atheist, the reviler of the Veda, / the betrayer of friends, and the fraud—these are especially defilers of the assembly row.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve punarabhojyānnāstvadānārhāśca karmasu /
brahmabhāvanirastāśca varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे पुनरभोज्यान्नास्त्वदानार्हाश्च कर्मसु /
ब्रह्मभावनिरस्ताश्च वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: All these are persons whose food should not be eaten, unworthy to receive gifts in rituals, / and devoid of the contemplation of Brahman; they should be carefully avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrānnarasapuṣṭāṅgaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitaḥ /
mahāyajñavihīnaśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रान्नरसपुष्टाङ्गः संध्योपासनवर्जितः /
महायज्ञविहीनश्च ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिदूषकः //
text_mt: A Brahmin whose limbs are nourished by the essence of a Śūdra's food, who is devoid of twilight devotions, / and who is without the great sacrifices, is a defiler of the assembly row.

sanskrit_iast:
adhītanāśanaścaiva snānahomavivarjitaḥ /
tāmaso rājasaścaiva brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ //
meaning:
अधीतनाशनश्चैव स्नानहोमविवर्जितः /
तामसो राजसश्चैव ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिदूषकः //
text_mt: One who has lost what he studied, devoid of bathing and fire-offerings, / dull-natured and passion-driven: such a Brahmin is a defiler of the assembly row.

sanskrit_iast:
bahunātra kimuktena vihitān ye na kurvate /
ninditānācarantyete varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāya
IN REE NICHT ZULÄSSIGE ZEICHEN:
meaning:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन विहितान् ये न कुर्वते /
निन्दितानाचरन्त्येते वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकविशो ऽध्याय
इन् रेए निछ्त् Zउल्Äस्सिगे Zएइछेन्:
text_mt:
What is the use of saying much here? Those who do not perform what is ordained / and practice what is censured must be carefully avoided.

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
gomayenodakairbhūmiṃ śodhayitvā samāhitaḥ /
saṃnipātya dvijān sarvān sādhubhiḥ saṃnimantrayet //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
गोमयेनोदकैर्भूमिं शोधयित्वा समाहितः /
संनिपात्य द्विजान् सर्वान् साधुभिः संनिमन्त्रयेत् //
title: dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Having purified the ground with cow-dung and water, concentrated in mind, / having brought together all the twice-born, he should invite them along with righteous men.

sanskrit_iast:
śvo bhaviṣyati me śrāddhaṃ pūrvedyurabhipūjya ca /
asaṃbhave paredyurvā yathoktairlakṣaṇairyutān //
meaning:
श्वो भविष्यति मे श्राद्धं पूर्वेद्युरभिपूज्य च /
असंभवे परेद्युर्वा यथोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतान् //
text_mt: "Tomorrow my ancestral offering rite will take place"—having honored them on the preceding day, / or on the next day if that is not possible, men endowed with the stated characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya te pitaraḥ śrutvā śrāddhakālamupasthitam /
anyonyaṃ manasā dhyātvā saṃpatanti manojavāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य ते पितरः श्रुत्वा श्राद्धकालमुपस्थितम् /
अन्योन्यं मनसा ध्यात्वा संपतन्ति मनोजवाः //
text_mt: His ancestors, hearing that the time for the ancestral offering rite has arrived, / thinking of one another with the mind, arrive swift as thought.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaiste sahāśnanti pitaro hyantarikṣagāḥ /
vāyubhūtāstu tiṣṭhanti bhuktvā yānti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणैस्ते सहाश्नन्ति पितरो ह्यन्तरिक्षगाः /
वायुभूतास्तु तिष्ठन्ति भुक्त्वा यान्ति परां गतिम् //
text_mt: The ancestors, traveling through the atmosphere, eat together with those Brahmins; / remaining in the form of wind, having eaten, they go to the highest state.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantritāśca te viprāḥ śrāddhakāla upasthite /
vaseyurniyatāḥ sarve brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
आमन्त्रिताश्च ते विप्राः श्राद्धकाल उपस्थिते /
वसेयुर्नियताः सर्वे ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः //
text_mt: And those twice-born who are invited, when the time of the ancestral offering rite has arrived, / should all live restrained, devoted to celibacy.

sanskrit_iast:
akrodhano 'tvaro 'mattaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ /
bhāraṃ maithunamadhvānaṃ śrāddhakṛd varjayejjapam //
meaning:
अक्रोधनो ऽत्वरो ऽमत्तः सत्यवादी समाहितः /
भारं मैथुनमध्वानं श्राद्धकृद् वर्जयेज्जपम् //
text_mt: Free from anger, unhurried, not intoxicated, speaking truth, and concentrated in mind, / the performer of the ancestral offering rite should avoid carrying loads, sexual intercourse, travel, and muttered recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantrito brāhmaṇo vā yo 'nyasmai kurute kṣaṇam /
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sūkaratvāṃ prāyāti ca //
meaning:
आमन्त्रितो ब्राह्मणो वा यो ऽन्यस्मै कुरुते क्षणम् /
स याति नरकं घोरं सूकरत्वां प्रायाति च //
text_mt: An invited Brahmin who agrees to another's invitation / goes to a dreadful hell and arrives at the state of a pig.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantrayitvā yo mohādanyaṃ cāmantrayed dvijam /
sa tasmādadhikaḥ pāpī viṣṭhākīṭo 'bhijāyate //
meaning:
आमन्त्रयित्वा यो मोहादन्यं चामन्त्रयेद् द्विजम् /
स तस्मादधिकः पापी विष्ठाकीटो ऽभिजायते //
text_mt: He who, having invited one, out of delusion invites another twice-born, / is a greater sinner than he, and is reborn as an insect in excrement.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe nimantrito vipro maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati /
brahmahatyāmavāpnoti tiryagyonau ca jāyate //
meaning:
श्राद्धे निमन्त्रितो विप्रो मैथुनं यो ऽधिगच्छति /
ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्नोति तिर्यग्योनौ च जायते //
text_mt: A Brahmin invited to an ancestral offering rite who approaches sexual intercourse / incurs the guilt of killing a Brahmin and is born in the womb of an animal.

sanskrit_iast:
nimantritastu yo vipro hyadhvānaṃ yāti durmatiḥ /
bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ pāṃśubhojanāḥ //
meaning:
निमन्त्रितस्तु यो विप्रो ह्यध्वानं याति दुर्मतिः /
भवन्ति पितरस्तस्य तं मासं पांशुभोजनाः //
text_mt: The evil-minded Brahmin who, having been invited, undertakes a journey, / his ancestors feed on dust for that month.

sanskrit_iast:
nimantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe prakuryāt kalahaṃ dvijaḥ /
bhavanti tasya tanmāsaṃ pitaro malabhojanāḥ //
meaning:
निमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे प्रकुर्यात् कलहं द्विजः /
भवन्ति तस्य तन्मासं पितरो मलभोजनाः //
text_mt: The twice-born man who, having been invited to an ancestral offering rite, engages in a quarrel, / his ancestors feed on filth for that month.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnimantritaḥ śrāddhe niyatātmā bhaved dvijaḥ /
akrodhanaḥ śaucaparaḥ kartā caiva jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्निमन्त्रितः श्राद्धे नियतात्मा भवेद् द्विजः /
अक्रोधनः शौचपरः कर्ता चैव जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Therefore, an invited twice-born man at an ancestral offering rite should be self-restrained, / free from anger, intent on purity, and the performer too must have conquered his senses.

sanskrit_iast:
śvobhūte dakṣiṇāṃ gatvā diśaṃ darbhān samāhitaḥ /
samūlānāhared vāri dakṣiṇāgrān sunirmalān //
meaning:
श्वोभूते दक्षिणां गत्वा दिशं दर्भान् समाहितः /
समूलानाहरेद् वारि दक्षिणाग्रान् सुनिर्मलान् //
text_mt: When the next day has come, having gone toward the southern quarter, composed in mind, / he should fetch darbha grass with roots, water, with southern tips, completely pure.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ vibhaktaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam /
śuciṃ deśaṃ viviktaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet //
meaning:
दक्षिणाप्रवणं स्निग्धं विभक्तं शुभलक्षणम् /
शुचिं देशं विविक्तं च गोमयेनोपलेपयेत् //
text_mt: Sloping toward the south, smooth, clearly marked, possessing auspicious signs, / pure, and solitary: he should smear such a place with cow-dung.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu svabhūmau caiva sānuṣu /
vivikteṣu ca tuṣyanti dattena pitaraḥ sadā //
meaning:
नदीतीरेषु तीर्थेषु स्वभूमौ चैव सानुषु /
विविक्तेषु च तुष्यन्ति दत्तेन पितरः सदा //
text_mt: On riverbanks, at sacred pilgrimage sites, on one's own land, on mountain ridges, / and in solitary places, the ancestors are always pleased with what is given.

sanskrit_iast:
pārakye bhūmibhāge tu pitṝṇāṃ naiva nirvapet /
svāmibhistad vihanyeta mohād yat kriyate naraiḥ //
meaning:
पारक्ये भूमिभागे तु पितॄणां नैव निर्वपेत् /
स्वामिभिस्तद् विहन्येत मोहाद् यत् क्रियते नरैः //
text_mt: He should never make offerings to the ancestors on ground belonging to another; / for what is done by men out of delusion is nullified by the owners.

sanskrit_iast:
aṭavyaḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca /
sarvāṇyasvāmikānyāhurna hi teṣu parigrahaḥ //
meaning:
अटव्यः पर्वताः पुण्यास्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च /
सर्वाण्यस्वामिकान्याहुर्न हि तेषु परिग्रहः //
text_mt: Forests, sacred mountains, pilgrimage sites, and temples— / all these are called ownerless, for there is no private possession of them.

sanskrit_iast:
tilān pravikiret tatra sarvato bandhayedajān /
asuropahataṃ sarvaṃ tilaiḥ śuddhyatyajena vā //
meaning:
तिलान् प्रविकिरेत् तत्र सर्वतो बन्धयेदजान् /
असुरोपहतं सर्वं तिलैः शुद्ध्यत्यजेन वा //
text_mt: He should scatter sesame seeds there, and tether goats on all sides; / whatever is polluted by demons is purified by sesame seeds or by a goat.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'nnaṃ bahusaṃskāraṃ naikavyañjanamacyutam /
coṣyapeyasamṛddhaṃ ca yathāśaktyā prakalpayet //
meaning:
ततो ऽन्नं बहुसंस्कारं नैकव्यञ्जनमच्युतम् /
चोष्यपेयसमृद्धं च यथाशक्त्या प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Then he should prepare food with many seasonings, not having only one condiment, unfailing, / rich in dishes to be sucked and drunk, according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nivṛtte madhyāhne luptalomanakhān dvijān /
abhigamya yathāmārgaṃ prayacched dantadhāvanam //
meaning:
ततो निवृत्ते मध्याह्ने लुप्तलोमनखान् द्विजान् /
अभिगम्य यथामार्गं प्रयच्छेद् दन्तधावनम् //
text_mt: Then, when midday has passed, having approached the twice-born / who have cut their hair and nails, he should provide them tooth-sticks according to custom.

sanskrit_iast:
tailamabhyañjanaṃ snānaṃ snānīyaṃ ca pṛthagvidham /
pātrairaudumbarairdadyād vaiśvadaivatyapūrvakam //
meaning:
तैलमभ्यञ्जनं स्नानं स्नानीयं च पृथग्विधम् /
पात्रैरौदुम्बरैर्दद्याद् वैश्वदैवत्यपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: He should give oil, unguent, a bath, and various bathing preparations / in vessels of udumbara wood, beginning with those dedicated to all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ snātvā nivṛttebhyaḥ pratyutthāyakṛtāñjaliḥ /
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca saṃprayacched yathākramam //
meaning:
ततः स्नात्वा निवृत्तेभ्यः प्रत्युत्थायकृताञ्जलिः /
पाद्यमाचमनीयं च संप्रयच्छेद् यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, rising to meet them when they have bathed and returned, with joined palms, / he should offer water for the feet and water for sipping in the proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cātra viśvedevānāṃ viprāḥ pūrvaṃ nimantritāḥ /
prāṅmukhānyāsanānyeṣāṃ tridarbhopahitāni ca //
meaning:
ये चात्र विश्वेदेवानां विप्राः पूर्वं निमन्त्रिताः /
प्राङ्मुखान्यासनान्येषां त्रिदर्भोपहितानि च //
text_mt: And those Brahmins who are invited here earlier for all the gods, / their seats should face the east and be covered with three darbha blades.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāmukhayuktāni pitṝṇāmāsanāni ca /
dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi prokṣitāni tilodakaiḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणामुखयुक्तानि पितॄणामासनानि च /
दक्षिणाग्रैकदर्भाणि प्रोक्षितानि तिलोदकैः //
text_mt: The seats of the ancestors face south, / with single darbha grass blades pointing south, sprinkled with water and sesame.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣūpaveśayedetānāsanaṃ spṛśya sa dvijam /
āsadhvamiti saṃjalpan āsanāste pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
तेषूपवेशयेदेतानासनं स्पृश्य स द्विजम् /
आसध्वमिति संजल्पन् आसनास्ते पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Touching the seat and the twice-born, he should seat them upon those [seats], / saying, 'Be seated,' [each] in their separate seats.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau daive prāṅmukhau pitrye trayaścodaṅmukhāstathā /
ekaikaṃ vā bhavet tatra devamātāmaheṣvapi //
meaning:
द्वौ दैवे प्राङ्मुखौ पित्र्ये त्रयश्चोदङ्मुखास्तथा /
एकैकं वा भवेत् तत्र देवमातामहेष्वपि //
text_mt: Two [brahmins] face east for the gods, and three face north for the ancestors; / or there may be one for each, also for the deities and maternal grandfathers.

sanskrit_iast:
satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca śaucaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadam /
pañcaitān vistaro hanti tasmānneheta vistaram //
meaning:
सत्क्रियां देशकालौ च शौचं ब्राह्मणसंपदम् /
पञ्चैतान् विस्तरो हन्ति तस्मान्नेहेत विस्तरम् //
text_mt: Hospitable welcome, place and time, purity, and the excellence of brahmins— / excessive display spoils these five; therefore, one should not desire excessive display.

sanskrit_iast:
api vā bhojayedekaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam /
śrutaśīlādisaṃpannamalakṣaṇavivarjitam //
meaning:
अपि वा भोजयेदेकं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् /
श्रुतशीलादिसंपन्नमलक्षणविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: Or he may feed just one brahmin who has mastered the Veda, / endowed with learning and good conduct, and free from inauspicious marks.

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtya pātre cānnaṃ tat sarvasmāt prakṛtāt punaḥ /
devatāyatane cāsmai nivedyānyatpravartayet //
meaning:
उद्धृत्य पात्रे चान्नं तत् सर्वस्मात् प्रकृतात् पुनः /
देवतायतने चास्मै निवेद्यान्यत्प्रवर्तयेत् //
text_mt: Taking out that food in a dish from the entire prepared food, / he should offer it to him in the shrine of the deity and then proceed with the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsyedagnau tadannaṃ tu dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe /
tasmādekamapi śreṣṭhaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ bhojayed dvijam //
meaning:
प्रास्येदग्नौ तदन्नं तु दद्याद् वा ब्रह्मचारिणे /
तस्मादेकमपि श्रेष्ठं विद्वांसं भोजयेद् द्विजम् //
text_mt: He should throw that food into the fire or give it to a Vedic student; / therefore, he should feed even a single excellent and learned twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣuko brahmacārī vā bhojanārthamupasthitaḥ /
upaviṣṭeṣu yaḥ śrāddhe kāmaṃ tamapi bhojayet //
meaning:
भिक्षुको ब्रह्मचारी वा भोजनार्थमुपस्थितः /
उपविष्टेषु यः श्राद्धे कामं तमपि भोजयेत् //
text_mt: If a mendicant or a Vedic student arrives for food / when the [guests] are seated at the ancestral offering rite, one may gladly feed him as well.

sanskrit_iast:
atithiryasya nāśnāti na tacchrāddhaṃ praśasyate /
tasmāt prayatnācchrāddheṣu pūjyā hyatithayo dvijaiḥ //
meaning:
अतिथिर्यस्य नाश्नाति न तच्छ्राद्धं प्रशस्यते /
तस्मात् प्रयत्नाच्छ्राद्धेषु पूज्या ह्यतिथयो द्विजैः //
text_mt: An ancestral offering rite in which a guest does not eat is not praised; / therefore, guests must be honored with effort at ancestral offering rites by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ātithyarahite śrāddhe bhuñjate ye dvijātayaḥ /
kākayoniṃ vrajantyete dātā caiva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
आतिथ्यरहिते श्राद्धे भुञ्जते ये द्विजातयः /
काकयोनिं व्रजन्त्येते दाता चैव न संशयः //
text_mt: Those twice-born who eat at an ancestral offering rite devoid of hospitality to guests / enter the womb of a crow, and so does the giver, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnāṅgaḥ patitaḥ kuṣṭhī vraṇī pukkasanāstikau /
kukkuṭāḥ śūkarāḥ śvāno varjyāḥ śrāddheṣu dūrataḥ //
meaning:
हीनाङ्गः पतितः कुष्ठी व्रणी पुक्कसनास्तिकौ /
कुक्कुटाः शूकराः श्वानो वर्ज्याः श्राद्धेषु दूरतः //
text_mt: One missing a limb, an outcaste, a leper, one with sores, a Pukkasa, an atheist, / roosters, pigs, and dogs must be kept far away from ancestral offering rites.

sanskrit_iast:
bībhatsumaśuciṃ nagnaṃ mattaṃ dhūrtaṃ rajasvalām /
nīlakāṣāyavasanaṃ pāṣaṇḍāṃśca vivarjayet //
meaning:
बीभत्सुमशुचिं नग्नं मत्तं धूर्तं रजस्वलाम् /
नीलकाषायवसनं पाषण्डांश्च विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One should avoid a loathsome person, an impure person, a naked person, a madman, a rogue, a menstruating woman, / one wearing blue or ochre garments, and heretics.

sanskrit_iast:
yat tatra kriyate karma paitṛkaṃ brāhmaṇān prati /
tatsarvameva kartavyaṃ vaiśvadaivatyapūrvakam //
meaning:
यत् तत्र क्रियते कर्म पैतृकं ब्राह्मणान् प्रति /
तत्सर्वमेव कर्तव्यं वैश्वदैवत्यपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Whatever rite for the ancestors is performed there towards the brahmins, / all of that must be preceded by [the rite for] all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yathopaviṣṭān sarvāṃstānalaṅkuryād vibhūṣaṇaḥ /
stragdāmabhiḥ śiroveṣṭairdhūpavāso 'nulepanaiḥ //
meaning:
यथोपविष्टान् सर्वांस्तानलङ्कुर्याद् विभूषणः /
स्त्रग्दामभिः शिरोवेष्टैर्धूपवासो ऽनुलेपनैः //
text_mt: He should adorn all of them seated as they are with ornaments, / garlands of flowers, turbans, incense, garments, and unguents.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvāvāhayed devān brāhmaṇānāmanujñayā /
udaṅmukho yathānyāyaṃ viśve devāsa ityṛcā //
meaning:
ततस्त्वावाहयेद् देवान् ब्राह्मणानामनुज्ञया /
उदङ्मुखो यथान्यायं विश्वे देवास इत्यृचा //
text_mt: Then, with the permission of the brahmins, facing north, / he should invoke the gods according to rule with the verse, 'O all the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
dve pavitre gṛhītvātha bhājane kṣālite punaḥ /
śaṃ no devyā jalaṃ kṣiptvā yavo 'sīti yavāṃstathā //
meaning:
द्वे पवित्रे गृहीत्वाथ भाजने क्षालिते पुनः /
शं नो देव्या जलं क्षिप्त्वा यवो ऽसीति यवांस्तथा //
text_mt: Taking two strainers of grass, and washed vessels, / pouring water with 'May the divine [waters] bring us bliss,' and barley grains with 'You are barley,'

sanskrit_iast:
yā divyā iti mantraṇa haste tvarghaṃ vinikṣipet /
pradadyād gandhamālyāni dhūpādīni ca śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
या दिव्या इति मन्त्रण हस्ते त्वर्घं विनिक्षिपेत् /
प्रदद्याद् गन्धमाल्यानि धूपादीनि च शक्तितः //
text_mt: he should pour water for honorific offering into the hand with the mantra 'May the divine [waters]'; / he should present perfumes, garlands, incense, and the like according to his means.

sanskrit_iast:
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryāduśantastvetyṛcā budhaḥ //
meaning:
अपसव्यं ततः कृत्वा पितॄणां दक्षिणामुखः /
आवाहनं ततः कुर्यादुशन्तस्त्वेत्यृचा बुधः //
text_mt: Then, shifting the sacred thread to the right shoulder, facing south, / the wise man should make the invocation of the ancestors with the verse 'Willingly you [have been placed]'.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyantu nastataḥ /
śaṃ no devyodakaṃ pātre tilo 'sīti tilāṃstathā //
meaning:
आवाह्य तदनुज्ञातो जपेदायन्तु नस्ततः /
शं नो देव्योदकं पात्रे तिलो ऽसीति तिलांस्तथा //
text_mt: Having invoked them and being permitted, he should then chant 'May they come to us,' / [pouring] water into the vessel with 'May the divine [waters] bring us bliss,' and sesame seeds with 'You are sesame.'

sanskrit_iast:
kṣiptvā cārghaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ dattvā hasteṣu vai punaḥ /
saṃstravāṃśca tataḥ sarvān pātre kuryāt samāhitaḥ /
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānametena nyubjaṃ pātraṃ nidhāpayet //
meaning:
क्षिप्त्वा चार्घं यथापूर्वं दत्त्वा हस्तेषु वै पुनः /
संस्त्रवांश्च ततः सर्वान् पात्रे कुर्यात् समाहितः /
पितृभ्यः स्थानमेतेन न्युब्जं पात्रं निधापयेत् //
text_mt: Pouring it out and presenting water for honorific offering into their hands as before, / he should then collect all the drippings in a vessel, concentrated in mind; / with 'This is the place for the ancestors,' he should place the vessel upside down.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau kariṣyetyādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutam /
kuruṣvetyabhyanujñāto juhuyādupavītavān //
meaning:
अग्नौ करिष्येत्यादाय पृच्छत्यन्नं घृतप्लुतम् /
कुरुष्वेत्यभ्यनुज्ञातो जुहुयादुपवीतवान् //
text_mt: Taking the food soaked in clarified butter, he asks, 'Shall I offer into the fire?' / Permitted with 'Do so,' wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, he should offer oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopavītinā homaḥ kartavyaḥ kuśapāṇinā /
prācīnāvītinā pitryaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ tu homavat //
meaning:
यज्ञोपवीतिना होमः कर्तव्यः कुशपाणिना /
प्राचीनावीतिना पित्र्यं वैश्वदेवं तु होमवत् //
text_mt: The fire oblation is to be performed by one wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, with kuśa grass in hand; / the ancestral rite by one wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, but the rite to all the gods is like the fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇaṃ pātayejjānuṃ devān paricaran pumān /
pitṛṇāṃ paricaryāsu pātayeditaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
दक्षिणं पातयेज्जानुं देवान् परिचरन् पुमान् /
पितृणां परिचर्यासु पातयेदितरं तथा //
text_mt: A man should bend his right knee when serving the gods; / likewise, he should bend the other in services to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā nama iti bruvan /
agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadheti juhuyāt tataḥ //
meaning:
सोमाय वै पितृमते स्वधा नम इति ब्रुवन् /
अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधेति जुहुयात् ततः //
text_mt: Saying 'svadhā, homage to Soma accompanied by the ancestors,' / he should then offer oblation into the fire with 'svadhā to Agni, conveyor of ancestral offerings.'

sanskrit_iast:
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāvevopapādayet /
mahādevāntike vātha goṣṭhe vā susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अग्न्यभावे तु विप्रस्य पाणावेवोपपादयेत् /
महादेवान्तिके वाथ गोष्ठे वा सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: In the absence of a sacred fire, he should place it right in the hand of a brahmin, / or near Mahādeva, or in a cowpen, fully composed.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastairabhyanujñāto gatvā vai dakṣiṇāṃ diśam /
gomayenopatipyorvoṃ sthānaṃ kṛtvā tu saikatam //
meaning:
ततस्तैरभ्यनुज्ञातो गत्वा वै दक्षिणां दिशम् /
गोमयेनोपतिप्योर्वों स्थानं कृत्वा तु सैकतम् //
text_mt: Then, permitted by them, going to the southern direction, / smearing the earth with cow dung and making a sandy place,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ caturastraṃ vā dakṣiṇāvanataṃ śubham /
trirullikhet tasya madhyaṃ darbheṇaikena caiva hi //
meaning:
मण्डलं चतुरस्त्रं वा दक्षिणावनतं शुभम् /
त्रिरुल्लिखेत् तस्य मध्यं दर्भेणैकेन चैव हि //
text_mt: a circular or square auspicious mandala sloping towards the south, / he should draw three lines across its center with a single blade of darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃstīrya tatsthāne darbhān vaidakṣiṇāgrakān /
trīn piṇḍān nirvapet tatra haviḥ śeṣātsamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः संस्तीर्य तत्स्थाने दर्भान् वैदक्षिणाग्रकान् /
त्रीन् पिण्डान् निर्वपेत् तत्र हविः शेषात्समाहितः //
text_mt: Then, scattering darbha blades with their tips pointing south in that place, / he should place there three balls of offering from the remainder of the sacrificial oblation, concentrated in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nyupya piṇḍāṃstu taṃ hastaṃ nimṛjyāllepabhāginām /
teṣu darbheṣvathācamya trirāyamya śanairasūn /
tadannaṃ tu namaskuryāt pitṝneva ca mantravit //
meaning:
न्युप्य पिण्डांस्तु तं हस्तं निमृज्याल्लेपभागिनाम् /
तेषु दर्भेष्वथाचम्य त्रिरायम्य शनैरसून् /
तदन्नं तु नमस्कुर्यात् पितॄनेव च मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: Having placed the balls of offering, he should wipe that hand for the sharers of the scrapings / upon those darbha blades, and having sipped water and slowly restrained his breaths three times, / the knower of mantras should pay homage to that food and to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
udakaṃ ninayeccheṣaṃ śanaiḥ piṇḍāntike punaḥ /
avajighrecca tān piṇḍān yathānyuptān samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
उदकं निनयेच्छेषं शनैः पिण्डान्तिके पुनः /
अवजिघ्रेच्च तान् पिण्डान् यथान्युप्तान् समाहितः //
text_mt: He should slowly pour out the remaining water near the balls of offering, / and, concentrated in mind, he should smell those balls of offering as they were laid down.

sanskrit_iast:
atha piṇḍāvaśiṣṭānnaṃ vidhinā bhojayed dvijān /
māṃsānyapūpān vividhān dadyāt kṛsarapāyasam //
meaning:
अथ पिण्डावशिष्टान्नं विधिना भोजयेद् द्विजान् /
मांसान्यपूपान् विविधान् दद्यात् कृसरपायसम् //
text_mt: Then, according to rule, he should feed the twice-born the food remaining from the balls of offering; / he should give various meats, cakes, kṛsara, and milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
sūpaśākaphalānīkṣūn payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu /
annaṃ caiva yathākāmaṃ vividhaṃ bhakṣyapeyakam //
meaning:
सूपशाकफलानीक्षून् पयो दधि घृतं मधु /
अन्नं चैव यथाकामं विविधं भक्ष्यपेयकम् //
text_mt: soups, vegetables, fruits, sugarcane, milk, curd, clarified butter, honey, / and various food to their desire, of varied snacks and beverages.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yadiṣṭaṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ tatsarvaṃ vinivedayet /
dhānyāṃstilāṃśca vividhān śarkarā vividhāstathā //
meaning:
यद् यदिष्टं द्विजेन्द्राणां तत्सर्वं विनिवेदयेत् /
धान्यांस्तिलांश्च विविधान् शर्करा विविधास्तथा //
text_mt: Whatever is desired by the best of the twice-born, he should offer all of that: / grains, various sesame seeds, and various kinds of sugar.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣṇamannaṃ dvijātibhyo dātavyaṃ śreya icchatā /
anyatra phalamūlebhyaḥ pānakebhyastathaiva ca //
meaning:
उष्णमन्नं द्विजातिभ्यो दातव्यं श्रेय इच्छता /
अन्यत्र फलमूलेभ्यः पानकेभ्यस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Hot food should be given to the twice-born by one who desires welfare, / except for fruits, roots, and drinks.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśrūṇi pātayejjātu na kupyennānṛtaṃ vadet /
na pādena spṛśedannaṃ na caitadavadhūnayet //
meaning:
नाश्रूणि पातयेज्जातु न कुप्येन्नानृतं वदेत् /
न पादेन स्पृशेदन्नं न चैतदवधूनयेत् //
text_mt: One must never shed tears, nor become angry, nor speak untruth; / he should not touch the food with his foot, nor shake it about.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhena caiva yat dattaṃ yad bhuktaṃ tvarayā punaḥ /
yātudhānā vilumpanti jalpatā copapāditam //
meaning:
क्रोधेन चैव यत् दत्तं यद् भुक्तं त्वरया पुनः /
यातुधाना विलुम्पन्ति जल्पता चोपपादितम् //
text_mt: What is given in anger, what is eaten in haste, / and what is served while chattering, demons plunder.

sanskrit_iast:
svinnagātro na tiṣṭheta sannidhau tu dvijanmanām /
na cātra śyenakākādīn pakṣiṇaḥ pratiṣedhayet /
tadrūpāḥ pitarastatra samāyānti bubhukṣavaḥ //
meaning:
स्विन्नगात्रो न तिष्ठेत सन्निधौ तु द्विजन्मनाम् /
न चात्र श्येनकाकादीन् पक्षिणः प्रतिषेधयेत् /
तद्रूपाः पितरस्तत्र समायान्ति बुभुक्षवः //
text_mt: One should not stand in the presence of the twice-born with a sweating body, / nor should one drive away hawks, crows, and other birds there; / the ancestors come there in their form, hungry for food.

sanskrit_iast:
na dadyāt tatra hastena pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ tathā /
na cāyasena pātreṇa na caivāśraddhayā punaḥ //
meaning:
न दद्यात् तत्र हस्तेन प्रत्यक्षलवणं तथा /
न चायसेन पात्रेण न चैवाश्रद्धया पुनः //
text_mt: One must not give visible salt by hand there, / nor in an iron vessel, nor without faith.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanena tu pātreṇa rājataudumbareṇa vā /
dattamakṣayatāṃ yāti khaḍgena ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
काञ्चनेन तु पात्रेण राजतौदुम्बरेण वा /
दत्तमक्षयतां याति खड्गेन च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Given in a golden vessel, or in a silver or copper vessel, / and especially in a rhinoceros horn vessel, it becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
pātre tu mṛṇmaye yo vai śrāddhe bhojayate pitan /
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ bhoktā caiva purodhasaḥ //
meaning:
पात्रे तु मृण्मये यो वै श्राद्धे भोजयते पितन् /
स याति नरकं घोरं भोक्ता चैव पुरोधसः //
text_mt: He who feeds the ancestors at an ancestral offering rite in an earthen vessel / goes to a dreadful hell, and so does the eater of the family priest's food.

sanskrit_iast:
na paṅktyāṃ viṣamaṃ dadyānna yācenna ca dāpayet /
yācitā dāpitā dātā narakān yānti dāruṇān //
meaning:
न पङ्क्त्यां विषमं दद्यान्न याचेन्न च दापयेत् /
याचिता दापिता दाता नरकान् यान्ति दारुणान् //
text_mt: One should not distribute unevenly in a row, nor solicit, nor cause others to give; / those who solicit, those who cause others to give, and the giver go to severe hells.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjīran vāgyatāḥ śiṣṭā na brūyuḥ prākṛtān guṇān /
tāvaddhi pitaro 'śnanti yāvannoktā havirguṇāḥ //
meaning:
भुञ्जीरन् वाग्यताः शिष्टा न ब्रूयुः प्राकृतान् गुणान् /
तावद्धि पितरो ऽश्नन्ति यावन्नोक्ता हविर्गुणाः //
text_mt: The disciplined ones should eat with speech restrained, and should not speak of worldly qualities; / for the ancestors eat only so long as the qualities of the sacrificial food are not spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgrāsanopaviṣṭastu bhuñjota prathamaṃ dvijaḥ /
bahūnāṃ paśyatāṃ so 'jñaḥ paṅktyā harati kilbiṣam //
meaning:
नाग्रासनोपविष्टस्तु भुञ्जोत प्रथमं द्विजः /
बहूनां पश्यतां सो ऽज्ञः पङ्क्त्या हरति किल्बिषम् //
text_mt: Seated at the head of the row, a twice-born should not eat first; / while many look on, that ignorant one takes away the sin of the entire row.

sanskrit_iast:
na kiñcid varjayecchrāddhe niyuktastu dvijottamaḥ /
na māṃsaṃ pratiṣedheta na cānyasyānnamīkṣayet //
meaning:
न किञ्चिद् वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे नियुक्तस्तु द्विजोत्तमः /
न मांसं प्रतिषेधेत न चान्यस्यान्नमीक्षयेत् //
text_mt: Appointed to the ancestral offering rite, the best of the twice-born should avoid nothing; / he should not refuse meat, nor should he look at another’s food.

sanskrit_iast:
yo nāśnāti dvijo māṃsaṃ niyuktaḥ pitṛkarmaṇi /
sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavānekaviṃśatim //
meaning:
यो नाश्नाति द्विजो मांसं नियुक्तः पितृकर्मणि /
स प्रेत्य पशुतां याति संभवानेकविंशतिम् //
text_mt: The twice-born who, appointed to the ancestral rite, does not eat meat, / after death becomes a beast for twenty-one rebirths.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyaṃ śrāvayedeṣāṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi /
itihāsapurāṇāni śrāddhakalpāṃśca śobhanān //
meaning:
स्वाध्यायं श्रावयेदेषां धर्मशास्त्राणि चैव हि /
इतिहासपुराणानि श्राद्धकल्पांश्च शोभनान् //
text_mt: He should recite to them sacred study and indeed the codes of law, / the histories and Purāṇas, and the auspicious procedural rules for the ancestral offering rite.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'nnamutsṛjed bhukte agrato vikiran bhuvi /
pṛṣṭvā tṛptāḥ stha ityevaṃ tṛptānācāmayet tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽन्नमुत्सृजेद् भुक्ते अग्रतो विकिरन् भुवि /
पृष्ट्वा तृप्ताः स्थ इत्येवं तृप्तानाचामयेत् ततः //
text_mt: Then, once [they] have eaten, he should scatter food on the ground in front of them; / having asked, 'Are you satisfied?', he should then have the satisfied ones rinse their mouths.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāntānanujānīyādabhito ramyatāmiti /
svadhāstviti ca taṃ brūyurbrāhmaṇāstadanantaram //
meaning:
आचान्ताननुजानीयादभितो रम्यतामिति /
स्वधास्त्विति च तं ब्रूयुर्ब्राह्मणास्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: He should permit those who have rinsed, saying everywhere, 'May it be delightful'; / and immediately after that, the brahmins should say to him, 'May there be svadhā.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣāmannaśeṣaṃ nivedayet /
yathā brūyustathā kuryādanujñātastu vai dvijaiḥ //
meaning:
ततो भुक्तवतां तेषामन्नशेषं निवेदयेत् /
यथा ब्रूयुस्तथा कुर्यादनुज्ञातस्तु वै द्विजैः //
text_mt: Then he should offer the remainder of the food to those who have eaten; / as they say, so he should do, permitted indeed by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrye svadita ityeva vākyaṃ goṣṭheṣu sūnṛtam /
saṃpannamityabhyudaye daive rocata ityapi //
meaning:
पित्र्ये स्वदित इत्येव वाक्यं गोष्ठेषु सूनृतम् /
संपन्नमित्यभ्युदये दैवे रोचत इत्यपि //
text_mt: In rites for the ancestors the truthful utterance is 'It has been relished'; in assemblies, 'It is complete'; / in rites for prosperity and rites for the gods, it is 'It is pleasing.'

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya brāhmaṇāṃstān vai daivapūrvaṃ tu vāgyataḥ /
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamākāṅ kṣanyācetemān varān pitṝn //
meaning:
विसृज्य ब्राह्मणांस्तान् वै दैवपूर्वं तु वाग्यतः /
दक्षिणां दिशमाकाङ् क्षन्याचेतेमान् वरान् पितॄन् //
text_mt: Having dismissed those brahmins, beginning with those for the gods, restrained in speech, / facing the southern direction, he should ask these boons of the ancestors:

sanskrit_iast:
dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatireva ca /
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahudeyaṃ ca nosttviti //
meaning:
दातारो नो ऽभिवर्धन्तां वेदाः संततिरेव च /
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद् बहुदेयं च नोस्त्त्विति //
text_mt: 'May givers increase for us, as well as the Vedas and offspring; / and may faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give.'

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍāṃstu go 'javiprebhyo dadyādagnau jale 'pi vā /
madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ piṇḍamadyāt patnī sutārthinī //
meaning:
पिण्डांस्तु गो ऽजविप्रेभ्यो दद्यादग्नौ जले ऽपि वा /
मध्यमं तु ततः पिण्डमद्यात् पत्नी सुतार्थिनी //
text_mt: He should give the balls of food to cows, goats, or brahmins, or into fire or water; / then the wife who desires a son should eat the middle ball.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya hastāvācamya jñātīn śeṣeṇa toṣayet /
jñātiṣvapi catuṣṭeṣu svān bhṛtyān bhojayot tataḥ /
paścāt svayaṃ ca patnībhiḥ śeṣamannaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य हस्तावाचम्य ज्ञातीन् शेषेण तोषयेत् /
ज्ञातिष्वपि चतुष्टेषु स्वान् भृत्यान् भोजयोत् ततः /
पश्चात् स्वयं च पत्नीभिः शेषमन्नं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having washed both hands and rinsed his mouth, he should satisfy his kinsmen with the remainder; / when the kinsmen are also satisfied, he should then feed his own servants; / afterwards he himself and his wives should partake of the remaining food.

sanskrit_iast:
nodvāsayet taducchiṣṭaṃ yāvannāstaṅgato raviḥ /
brahmacārī bhavetāṃ tu dampatī rajanīṃ tu tām //
meaning:
नोद्वासयेत् तदुच्छिष्टं यावन्नास्तङ्गतो रविः /
ब्रह्मचारी भवेतां तु दम्पती रजनीं तु ताम् //
text_mt: He should not remove those leftovers until the sun has set; / the husband and wife should remain celibate for that night.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā śrāddhaṃ tathā bhuktvā sevate yastu maithunam /
mahārauravamāsādya kīṭayoniṃ vrajet punaḥ //
meaning:
दत्त्वा श्राद्धं तथा भुक्त्वा सेवते यस्तु मैथुनम् /
महारौरवमासाद्य कीटयोनिं व्रजेत् पुनः //
text_mt: Having performed an ancestral offering rite or eaten at one, he who engages in sexual intercourse, / having reached Mahāraurava, enters the womb of an insect again.

sanskrit_iast:
śucirakrodhanaḥ śāntaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ /
svādhyāyaṃ ca tathādhvānaṃ kartā bhoktā ca varjayet //
meaning:
शुचिरक्रोधनः शान्तः सत्यवादी समाहितः /
स्वाध्यायं च तथाध्वानं कर्ता भोक्ता च वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Pure, free from anger, peaceful, truthful, and focused, / both the performer and the eater should avoid sacred study and travel.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā paraśrāddhaṃ bhuñjate ye dvijātayaḥ /
mahāpātikibhistulyā yānti te narakān bahūn //
meaning:
श्राद्धं भुक्त्वा परश्राद्धं भुञ्जते ये द्विजातयः /
महापातिकिभिस्तुल्या यान्ति ते नरकान् बहून् //
text_mt: The twice-born who eat at an ancestral offering rite and then eat at another’s ancestral offering rite, / equal to perpetrators of major sins, go to many hells.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vo vihitaḥ samyak śrāddhakalpaḥ sanātanaḥ /
āmena vartayennityamudāsīno 'tha tattvavit //
meaning:
एष वो विहितः सम्यक् श्राद्धकल्पः सनातनः /
आमेन वर्तयेन्नित्यमुदासीनो ऽथ तत्त्ववित् //
text_mt: This eternal procedural rule of the ancestral offering rite has been properly laid down for you; / a dispassionate person or one who knows the truth should perform it continually with raw food.

sanskrit_iast:
anagniradhvago vāpi tathaiva vyasanānvitaḥ /
āmaśrāddhaṃ dvijaḥ kuryād vidhijñaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ /
tenāgnau karaṇaṃ kuryāt piṇḍāṃstenaiva nirvapet //
meaning:
अनग्निरध्वगो वापि तथैव व्यसनान्वितः /
आमश्राद्धं द्विजः कुर्याद् विधिज्ञः श्रद्धयान्वितः /
तेनाग्नौ करणं कुर्यात् पिण्डांस्तेनैव निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: Without a sacred fire, on a journey, or likewise afflicted by misfortune, / a twice-born who knows the rules and is endowed with faith should perform an ancestral offering rite with raw food; / with it he should perform the rite into the fire, and with it he should offer the balls of food.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nena vidhinā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt saṃyatamānasaḥ /
vyapetakalpaṣo nityaṃ yogināṃ vartate padam //
meaning:
यो ऽनेन विधिना श्राद्धं कुर्यात् संयतमानसः /
व्यपेतकल्पषो नित्यं योगिनां वर्तते पदम् //
text_mt: Whoever performs the ancestral offering rite according to this rule with a restrained mind, / freed from sins, continually abides in the state of the yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryād dvijottamaḥ /
ārādhito bhavedīśastena samyak sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
