तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं कुर्याद् द्विजोत्तमः /
आराधितो भवेदीशस्तेन सम्यक् सनातनः //
text_mt: Therefore the best of the twice-born should perform the ancestral offering rite with every effort; / by that, the eternal Lord is properly worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
api mūlairphalairvāpi prakuryānnirdhano dvijaḥ /
tilodakaistarpayed vā pitṝn snātvā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अपि मूलैर्फलैर्वापि प्रकुर्यान्निर्धनो द्विजः /
तिलोदकैस्तर्पयेद् वा पितॄन् स्नात्वा समाहितः //
text_mt: Even with roots or fruits a poor twice-born should perform it; / or, having bathed and focused his mind, he should satisfy the ancestors with water mixed with sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
na jīvatpitṛko dadyāddhomāntaṃ cābhidhīyate /
yeṣāṃ vāpi pitā dadyāt teṣāṃ caike pracakṣate //
meaning:
न जीवत्पितृको दद्याद्धोमान्तं चाभिधीयते /
येषां वापि पिता दद्यात् तेषां चैके प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: One whose father is alive should not make offerings, and it is taught that his rite ends with the oblations into fire; / or some declare that he offers to those to whom his father makes offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ /
yo yasya mriyate tasmai deyaṃ nānyasya tena tu //
meaning:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः /
यो यस्य म्रियते तस्मै देयं नान्यस्य तेन तु //
text_mt: The father, the grandfather, and likewise the great-grandfather: / whoever among these has died, to him offering is to be made by him, not to another.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojayed vāpi jīvantaṃ yathākāmaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ /
na jīvantamatikramya dadāti śrūyate śrutiḥ //
meaning:
भोजयेद् वापि जीवन्तं यथाकामं तु भक्तितः /
न जीवन्तमतिक्रम्य ददाति श्रूयते श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Or he may feed the living one at will with devotion; / the sacred revelation is heard: 'One does not give by passing over the living.'

sanskrit_iast:
dvyāmuṣyāyaṇiko dadyād bījikṣetrikayoḥ samam /
ṛkyādardhaṃ samādadyānniyogotpādito yadi //
meaning:
द्व्यामुष्यायणिको दद्याद् बीजिक्षेत्रिकयोः समम् /
ऋक्यादर्धं समादद्यान्नियोगोत्पादितो यदि //
text_mt: A son belonging to two fathers should give equally to the biological father and the husband of the mother; / he should take half of the inheritance, if he was produced through appointed levirate.

sanskrit_iast:
aniyuktaḥ suto yaśca śulkato jāyate tviha /
pradadyād bījine piṇḍaṃ kṣetriṇe tu tato 'nyathā //
meaning:
अनियुक्तः सुतो यश्च शुल्कतो जायते त्विह /
प्रदद्याद् बीजिने पिण्डं क्षेत्रिणे तु ततो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: A son who is not appointed and is born here from a bride-price, / should offer the ball of food to the biological father; otherwise, to the mother's husband.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau piṇḍau nirvapet tābhyāṃ kṣetriṇe bījine tathā /
kīrtayedatha caikasmin bījinaṃ kṣetriṇaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
द्वौ पिण्डौ निर्वपेत् ताभ्यां क्षेत्रिणे बीजिने तथा /
कीर्तयेदथ चैकस्मिन् बीजिनं क्षेत्रिणं ततः //
text_mt: He should offer two balls of food to the two of them, to the mother's husband and to the biological father; / or he should pronounce both the biological father and the mother's husband in a single [ball].

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāhani tu kartavyamekodiṣṭaṃ vidhānataḥ /
aśauce sve parikṣīṇe kāmyaṃ vai kāmataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
मृताहनि तु कर्तव्यमेकोदिष्टं विधानतः /
अशौचे स्वे परिक्षीणे काम्यं वै कामतः पुनः //
text_mt: On the day of death, the rite for a single ancestor should be performed according to the rules; / when one's own ritual impurity has ended, the optional rite [may be performed] again according to desire.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāhne caiva kartavyaṃ śrāddhamabhyudayārthinā /
devavatsarvameva syād yavaiḥ kāryā tilakriyā //
meaning:
पूर्वाह्ने चैव कर्तव्यं श्राद्धमभ्युदयार्थिना /
देववत्सर्वमेव स्याद् यवैः कार्या तिलक्रिया //
text_mt: In the forenoon, the ancestral offering rite should be performed by one seeking prosperity; / everything should be done as for the gods, and the rite with sesame seeds should be done with barley.

sanskrit_iast:
darbhāśca ṛjavaḥ kāryā yugmān vai bhojayed dvijān /
nāndīmukhāstu pitaraḥ prīyantāmiti vācayet //
meaning:
दर्भाश्च ऋजवः कार्या युग्मान् वै भोजयेद् द्विजान् /
नान्दीमुखास्तु पितरः प्रीयन्तामिति वाचयेत् //
text_mt: The darbha grasses should be straight, and he should feed an even number of twice-born; / he should cause them to say, 'May the joyous ancestors be pleased.'

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tu pūrvaṃ syāt pitṝṇāṃ syādanantaram /
tato mātāmahānāṃ tu vṛddhau śrāddhatrayaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
मातृश्राद्धं तु पूर्वं स्यात् पितॄणां स्यादनन्तरम् /
ततो मातामहानां तु वृद्धौ श्राद्धत्रयं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The ancestral offering rite to the mothers should come first, then to the fathers; / then to the maternal grandfathers: on auspicious occasions, a triad of ancestral offering rites is handed down.

sanskrit_iast:
davapūrvaṃ pradadyād vai na kuryādapradakṣiṇam /
prāṅmukho nirvapet piṇḍānupavītī samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
दवपूर्वं प्रदद्याद् वै न कुर्यादप्रदक्षिणम् /
प्राङ्मुखो निर्वपेत् पिण्डानुपवीती समाहितः //
text_mt: He should give beginning with the gods and must not make a counter-clockwise circumambulation; / facing east, wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, he should offer the balls of food with a focused mind.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ tu mātaraḥ pūjyā bhaktyā vai sagaṇeśvarāḥ /
sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu pratimāsu dvijātiṣu //
meaning:
पूर्वं तु मातरः पूज्या भक्त्या वै सगणेश्वराः /
स्थण्डिलेषु विचित्रेषु प्रतिमासु द्विजातिषु //
text_mt: First the Mothers together with the lords of the Gaṇas should be worshipped with devotion, / on decorated altars, in images, or in twice-born [brahmins].

sanskrit_iast:
puṣperdhūpaiśca naivedyairgandhādyairbhūṣaṇairapi /
pūjayitvā mātṛgaṇaṃ kūryācchrāddhatrayaṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पेर्धूपैश्च नैवेद्यैर्गन्धाद्यैर्भूषणैरपि /
पूजयित्वा मातृगणं कूर्याच्छ्राद्धत्रयं बुधः //
text_mt: With flowers, incense, food offerings, perfumes and the like, and ornaments, / having worshipped the host of Mothers, the wise man should perform the triad of ancestral offering rites.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā mātṛyāgaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet /
tasya krodhasamāviṣṭā hiṃsāmicchanti mātaraḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
IN REE NICHT ZULÄSSIGE ZEICHEN:
meaning:
अकृत्वा मातृयागं तु यः श्राद्धं परिवेषयेत् /
तस्य क्रोधसमाविष्टा हिंसामिच्छन्ति मातरः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्वाविशो ऽध्यायः
इन् रेए निछ्त् Zउल्Äस्सिगे Zएइछेन्:
text_mt:
He who distributes food at an ancestral offering rite without having performed the sacrifice to the Mothers, / the Mothers, filled with anger, desire injury for him.

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
daśāhaṃ prāhurāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vipaścitaḥ /
mṛteṣu vātha jāteṣu brāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
दशाहं प्राहुराशौचं सपिण्डेषु विपश्चितः /
मृतेषु वाथ जातेषु ब्राह्मणानां द्विजोत्तमाः //
title: trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / The wise say that ritual impurity lasts ten days among sapindas, / when deaths or births occur among brahmins, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
nityāni caiva karmāṇi kāmyāni ca viśeṣataḥ /
nakuryād vihitaṃ kiñcit svādhyāyaṃ manasāpica //
meaning:
नित्यानि चैव कर्माणि काम्यानि च विशेषतः /
नकुर्याद् विहितं किञ्चित् स्वाध्यायं मनसापिच //
text_mt: Obligatory rites and especially optional ones, / anything prescribed he should not perform, nor sacred study even in thought.

sanskrit_iast:
śucīnakrodhanān bhūmyān śālāgnau bhāvayed dvijān /
śuṣkānnena phalairvāpi vaitānaṃ juhuyāt tathā //
meaning:
शुचीनक्रोधनान् भूम्यान् शालाग्नौ भावयेद् द्विजान् /
शुष्कान्नेन फलैर्वापि वैतानं जुहुयात् तथा //
text_mt: He should maintain pure, non-angry twice-born who are grounded in the domestic fire; / and he should offer the solemn sacrificial ritual with dry food or with fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
na spṛśeyurimānanye na ca tebhyaḥ samāharet /
caturthe pañcame vāhni saṃsparśaḥ kathito budhaiḥ //
meaning:
न स्पृशेयुरिमानन्ये न च तेभ्यः समाहरेत् /
चतुर्थे पञ्चमे वाह्नि संस्पर्शः कथितो बुधैः //
text_mt: Others should not touch these, nor should one collect [food] from them; / contact is stated by the wise to be permissible on the fourth or fifth day.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtake tu sapiṇḍānāṃ saṃsparśo na praduṣyati /
sūtakaṃ sūtikāṃ caiva varjayitvā nṛṇāṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
सूतके तु सपिण्डानां संस्पर्शो न प्रदुष्यति /
सूतकं सूतिकां चैव वर्जयित्वा नृणां पुनः //
text_mt: At birth, contact among sapindas is not corrupted, / except for the newborn and the woman who has given birth, among people.

sanskrit_iast:
adhīyānastathā yajvā vedavicca pitā bhavet /
saṃspṛśyāḥ sarva evaite snānānmātā daśāhataḥ //
meaning:
अधीयानस्तथा यज्वा वेदविच्च पिता भवेत् /
संस्पृश्याः सर्व एवैते स्नानान्माता दशाहतः //
text_mt: The father who studies, sacrifices, and knows the Veda— / all these may be touched after bathing; the mother after ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhaṃ nirguṇe proktamaśaucaṃ cātinirguṇe /
ekadvitriguṇairyuktaṃ catustryekadinaiḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
दशाहं निर्गुणे प्रोक्तमशौचं चातिनिर्गुणे /
एकद्वित्रिगुणैर्युक्तं चतुस्त्र्येकदिनैः शुचिः //
text_mt: Ritual impurity is declared to be ten days for one lacking qualities, and for one utterly lacking qualities; / for one endowed with one, two, or three qualities, he is pure in four, three, or one day.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhāt tu paraṃ samyagadhīyīta juhoti ca /
caturthe tasya saṃsparśaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
दशाहात् तु परं सम्यगधीयीत जुहोति च /
चतुर्थे तस्य संस्पर्शं मनुराह प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: After ten days he may study properly and offer oblations; / Manu Prajāpati stated that contact with him is permissible on the fourth [day].

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāhīnasya mūrkhasya mahārogiṇa eva ca /
yatheṣṭācaraṇasyāhurmaraṇāntamaśauvakam //
meaning:
क्रियाहीनस्य मूर्खस्य महारोगिण एव च /
यथेष्टाचरणस्याहुर्मरणान्तमशौवकम् //
text_mt: For one devoid of ritual acts, a fool, a person afflicted with a grave disease, / and one who acts willfully, they declare that impurity lasts until death.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ daśarātraṃ vā brāhmaṇānāmaśaucakam /
prāksaṃskārāt trirātraṃ syāt tasmādūrdhvaṃ daśāhakam //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं दशरात्रं वा ब्राह्मणानामशौचकम् /
प्राक्संस्कारात् त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तस्मादूर्ध्वं दशाहकम् //
text_mt: For Brāhmaṇas, impurity lasts three nights or ten nights: / before the rite of initiation it lasts three nights, and after that ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
ūnadvivārṣike prete mātāpitrostadiṣyate /
trirātreṇa śucistvanyo yadi hyatyantanirguṇaḥ //
meaning:
ऊनद्विवार्षिके प्रेते मातापित्रोस्तदिष्यते /
त्रिरात्रेण शुचिस्त्वन्यो यदि ह्यत्यन्तनिर्गुणः //
text_mt: When a child under two years old dies, that [impurity] is prescribed for the mother and father; / but another [relative] becomes pure in three nights, if he is entirely devoid of virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
adantajātamaraṇe pitrorekāhamiṣyate /
jātadante trirātraṃ syād yadi syātāṃ tu nirguṇau //
meaning:
अदन्तजातमरणे पित्रोरेकाहमिष्यते /
जातदन्ते त्रिरात्रं स्याद् यदि स्यातां तु निर्गुणौ //
text_mt: On the death of one whose teeth have not appeared, one day is prescribed for the parents; / when the teeth have appeared, it lasts three nights, if they are devoid of virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
ādantajananāt sadya ācaulādekarātrakam /
trirātramaupanayanāt sapiṇḍānāmudāhṛtam //
meaning:
आदन्तजननात् सद्य आचौलादेकरात्रकम् /
त्रिरात्रमौपनयनात् सपिण्डानामुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Until the appearance of teeth, [purification is] immediate; until the tonsure rite, it lasts one night; / until the investiture with the sacred thread, it is declared to last three nights for sapiṇḍas.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātrasya bālasya yadi syānmaraṇaṃ pituḥ /
mātuśca sūtakaṃ tat syāt pitā syāt spṛśya eva ca //
meaning:
जातमात्रस्य बालस्य यदि स्यान्मरणं पितुः /
मातुश्च सूतकं तत् स्यात् पिता स्यात् स्पृश्य एव च //
text_mt: If the father of an infant just born should die, / that constitutes birth impurity for the mother, but the father would have been touchable.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ kartavyaṃ sodarasya ca /
ūrdhvaṃ daśāhādekāhaṃ sodaro yadi nirguṇaḥ //
meaning:
सद्यः शौचं सपिण्डानां कर्तव्यं सोदरस्य च /
ऊर्ध्वं दशाहादेकाहं सोदरो यदि निर्गुणः //
text_mt: Immediate purification is to be observed by sapiṇḍas and by a brother of the same womb; / after ten days, [it lasts] one day if the brother of the same womb is devoid of virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
athordhvaṃ dantajananāt sapiṇḍānāmaśaucakam /
ekarātraṃ nirguṇānāṃ cailādūrdhvaṃ trirātrakam //
meaning:
अथोर्ध्वं दन्तजननात् सपिण्डानामशौचकम् /
एकरात्रं निर्गुणानां चैलादूर्ध्वं त्रिरात्रकम् //
text_mt: Now, after the appearance of teeth, the impurity for sapiṇḍas / who are devoid of virtue lasts one night; after the tonsure rite, it lasts three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
adantajātamaraṇaṃ saṃbhaved yadi sattamāḥ /
ekarātraṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ yadi te 'tyantanirguṇāḥ //
meaning:
अदन्तजातमरणं संभवेद् यदि सत्तमाः /
एकरात्रं सपिण्डानां यदि ते ऽत्यन्तनिर्गुणाः //
text_mt: If the death of one whose teeth have not appeared should occur, O best of men, / [the impurity] lasts one night for sapiṇḍas if they are entirely devoid of virtue.

sanskrit_iast:
vratādeśāt sapiṇḍānāmarvāk snānaṃ vidhīyate /
sarveṣāmeva guṇināmūrdhvaṃ tu viṣamaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
व्रतादेशात् सपिण्डानामर्वाक् स्नानं विधीयते /
सर्वेषामेव गुणिनामूर्ध्वं तु विषमं पुनः //
text_mt: Before the teaching of the vows, bathing is prescribed for sapiṇḍas, / for all who are endowed with virtue; but after that, it varies.

sanskrit_iast:
arvāk ṣaṇmāsataḥ strīṇāṃ yadi syād garbhasaṃstravaḥ /
tadā māsasamaistāsāmaśaucaṃ divasaiḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
अर्वाक् षण्मासतः स्त्रीणां यदि स्याद् गर्भसंस्त्रवः /
तदा माससमैस्तासामशौचं दिवसैः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: If women have a miscarriage before six months, / then their impurity is traditionally said to equal the number of days as the months [of pregnancy].

sanskrit_iast:
tata ūrdhvaṃ tu patane strīṇāṃ dvādaśarātrikam /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ garbhastrāvācca vā tataḥ //
meaning:
तत ऊर्ध्वं तु पतने स्त्रीणां द्वादशरात्रिकम् /
सद्यः शौचं सपिण्डानां गर्भस्त्रावाच्च वा ततः //
text_mt: After that, in the case of a stillbirth, [it lasts] twelve nights for women; / for sapiṇḍas, purification is immediate, or else it is reckoned from that miscarriage.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhacyutāvahorātraṃ sapiṇḍe 'tyantanirguṇe /
yatheṣṭācaraṇe jñātau trirātramiti niścayaḥ //
meaning:
गर्भच्युतावहोरात्रं सपिण्डे ऽत्यन्तनिर्गुणे /
यथेष्टाचरणे ज्ञातौ त्रिरात्रमिति निश्चयः //
text_mt: Upon a miscarriage, [impurity lasts] a day and a night when a sapiṇḍa is entirely devoid of virtue; / for a kinsman who acts willfully, it lasts three nights: this is the settled rule.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syāt sūtake sūtirmaraṇe vā mṛtirbhavet /
śeṣeṇaiva bhavecchuddhirahaḥ śeṣe trirātrakam //
meaning:
यदि स्यात् सूतके सूतिर्मरणे वा मृतिर्भवेत् /
शेषेणैव भवेच्छुद्धिरहः शेषे त्रिरात्रकम् //
text_mt: If a birth occurs during birth impurity, or a death during death impurity, / purification occurs through the remainder [of the first]; if only one day remains, it lasts three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇotpattiyoge tu maraṇācchuddhiriṣyate /
aghavṛddhimadāśaucamūrghvaṃ cet tena śudhyati //
meaning:
मरणोत्पत्तियोगे तु मरणाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते /
अघवृद्धिमदाशौचमूर्घ्वं चेत् तेन शुध्यति //
text_mt: When a birth coincides with a death, purification is accepted through the death; / if an impurity involving a heavier burden follows, one is purified by that [longer one].

sanskrit_iast:
atha cet pañcamīrātrimatītya parato bhavet /
aghavṛddhimadāśaucaṃ tadā pūrveṇa śudhyati //
meaning:
अथ चेत् पञ्चमीरात्रिमतीत्य परतो भवेत् /
अघवृद्धिमदाशौचं तदा पूर्वेण शुध्यति //
text_mt: If, however, after the fifth night has passed, another [event] occurs / that involves an impurity of greater burden, then one is purified by the earlier one.

sanskrit_iast:
deśāntaragataṃ śrutvā sūtakaṃ śāvameva tu /
tāvadaprayato martyo yāvaccheṣaḥ samāpyate //
meaning:
देशान्तरगतं श्रुत्वा सूतकं शावमेव तु /
तावदप्रयतो मर्त्यो यावच्छेषः समाप्यते //
text_mt: Hearing of a birth impurity or a death impurity occurring in a distant country, / a mortal is impure only as long as the remaining period is completed.

sanskrit_iast:
atīte sūtake proktaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātrakam /
tathaiva maraṇe snānamūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarād yadi //
meaning:
अतीते सूतके प्रोक्तं सपिण्डानां त्रिरात्रकम् /
तथैव मरणे स्नानमूर्ध्वं संवत्सराद् यदि //
text_mt: When a birth impurity has elapsed, three nights are declared for sapiṇḍas; / likewise on a death, bathing alone [is required] if it is after a year.

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntaviccādhīyāno yo 'gnimān vṛttikarṣitaḥ /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ bhavet tasya sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā //
meaning:
वेदान्तविच्चाधीयानो यो ऽग्निमान् वृत्तिकर्षितः /
सद्यः शौचं भवेत् तस्य सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा //
text_mt: One who knows the Vedānta, is devoted to study, keeps the sacred fires, and is constrained in his livelihood— / for him, purification is immediate in all states and at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāmasaṃskṛtānāṃ tu pradānāt pūrvataḥ sadā /
sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātraṃ syāt saṃskāre bhartureva hi //
meaning:
स्त्रीणामसंस्कृतानां तु प्रदानात् पूर्वतः सदा /
सपिण्डानां त्रिरात्रं स्यात् संस्कारे भर्तुरेव हि //
text_mt: For unmarried women, before their marriage, / [impurity] for sapiṇḍas lasts three nights; upon the sacrament of marriage, it falls to the husband alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ahastvadattakanyānāmaśaucaṃ maraṇe smṛtam /
ūnadvivarṣānmaraṇe sadyaḥ śaucamudāhṛtam //
meaning:
अहस्त्वदत्तकन्यानामशौचं मरणे स्मृतम् /
ऊनद्विवर्षान्मरणे सद्यः शौचमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: On the death of unbetrothed girls, impurity is traditionally remembered as one day; / on the death of one under two years of age, purification is declared to be immediate.

sanskrit_iast:
ādantāt sodare sadya ācaulādekarātrakam /
āpradānāt trirātraṃ syād daśarātramataḥ param //
meaning:
आदन्तात् सोदरे सद्य आचौलादेकरात्रकम् /
आप्रदानात् त्रिरात्रं स्याद् दशरात्रमतः परम् //
text_mt: Until teeth appear, [purification is] immediate for a uterine brother; until the tonsure rite, it lasts one night; / until marriage, it lasts three nights; beyond that, ten nights.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānāṃ maraṇe trirātraṃ syādaśaucakam /
ekodakānāṃ maraṇe sūtake caitadeva hi //
meaning:
मातामहानां मरणे त्रिरात्रं स्यादशौचकम् /
एकोदकानां मरणे सूतके चैतदेव हि //
text_mt: On the death of maternal grandfathers, impurity lasts three nights; / and this very same [rule applies] on the death or birth of relatives connected by libations of water.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣiṇī yonisambandhe bāndhaveṣu tathaiva ca /
ekarātraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ gurau sabrahmacāriṇi //
meaning:
पक्षिणी योनिसम्बन्धे बान्धवेषु तथैव च /
एकरात्रं समुद्दिष्टं गुरौ सब्रह्मचारिणि //
text_mt: A day and a half is prescribed for blood relatives, and likewise for uterine kin; / one night is enjoined for a guru or a fellow Vedic student.

sanskrit_iast:
prete rājani sajyotiryasya syād viṣaye sthitiḥ /
gṛhe mṛtāsu dattāsu kanyakāsu tryahaṃ pituḥ //
meaning:
प्रेते राजनि सज्योतिर्यस्य स्याद् विषये स्थितिः /
गृहे मृतासु दत्तासु कन्यकासु त्र्यहं पितुः //
text_mt: When a king dies, [impurity lasts] as long as the day or night endures for one living in his realm; / when married daughters die in the [paternal] house, [impurity lasts] three days for the father.

sanskrit_iast:
parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu putreṣu kṛtakeṣu ca /
trirātraṃ syāt tathācārye svabhāryāsvanyagāsu ca //
meaning:
परपूर्वासु भार्यासु पुत्रेषु कृतकेषु च /
त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तथाचार्ये स्वभार्यास्वन्यगासु च //
text_mt: For wives previously married to another, for adopted sons, / and likewise for an ācārya and one's own wives who have gone to another, it lasts three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryaputre patnyāṃ ca ahorātramudāhṛtam /
ekāhaṃ syādupādhyāye svagrāme śrotriye 'pi ca //
meaning:
आचार्यपुत्रे पत्न्यां च अहोरात्रमुदाहृतम् /
एकाहं स्यादुपाध्याये स्वग्रामे श्रोत्रिये ऽपि च //
text_mt: For the son of an ācārya and for his wife, a day and a night is declared; / it lasts one day for an upādhyāya, and also for a Vedic scholar in one's own village.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātramasapiṇḍeṣu svagṛhe saṃsthiteṣu ca /
ekāhaṃ cāsvavarye syādekarātraṃ tadiṣyate //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रमसपिण्डेषु स्वगृहे संस्थितेषु च /
एकाहं चास्ववर्ये स्यादेकरात्रं तदिष्यते //
text_mt: [It lasts] three nights for non-sapiṇḍas who die in one's own house; / and it lasts one day for one of a different caste, or one night is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ śvaśrūmaraṇe śvaśure vai tadeva hi /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sagotre saṃsthite sati //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं श्वश्रूमरणे श्वशुरे वै तदेव हि /
सद्यः शौचं समुद्दिष्टं सगोत्रे संस्थिते सति //
text_mt: On the death of a mother-in-law, it lasts three nights, and indeed the same for a father-in-law; / immediate purification is enjoined when a member of the same gotra dies.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhyed vipro daśāhena dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ /
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudyati //
meaning:
शुद्ध्येद् विप्रो दशाहेन द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः /
वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुद्यति //
text_mt: A Brāhmaṇa is purified in ten days, a king in twelve days, / a Vaiśya in fifteen days, and a Śūdra is purified in a month.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatraviṭśūdradāyādā ye syurviprasya bāndhavāḥ /
teṣāmaśauce viprasya daśāhācchuddhiriṣyate //
meaning:
क्षत्रविट्शूद्रदायादा ये स्युर्विप्रस्य बान्धवाः /
तेषामशौचे विप्रस्य दशाहाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते //
text_mt: Those who are heirs belonging to the Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, or Śūdra classes, and are kin of a Brāhmaṇa— / in the impurity of those, purification for the Brāhmaṇa is prescribed after ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
rājanyavaiśyāvapyevaṃ hīnavarṇāsu yoniṣu /
svameva śaucaṃ kuryātāṃ viśuddhyarthamasaṃśayam //
meaning:
राजन्यवैश्यावप्येवं हीनवर्णासु योनिषु /
स्वमेव शौचं कुर्यातां विशुद्ध्यर्थमसंशयम् //
text_mt: Likewise, a Kṣatriya and a Vaiśya, in the case of relations of lower caste, / should observe their own period of purity for purification, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tūttaravarṇānāmaśaucaṃ kuryurādṛtāḥ /
tadvarṇavidhidṛṣṭena svaṃ tu śaucaṃ svayoniṣu //
meaning:
सर्वे तूत्तरवर्णानामशौचं कुर्युरादृताः /
तद्वर्णविधिदृष्टेन स्वं तु शौचं स्वयोनिषु //
text_mt: All persons, however, should observe the impurity of the higher castes with respect, / according to the rule laid down for that caste, but their own period of purity among their own kind.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍrātraṃ vā trirātraṃ syādekarātraṃ krameṇa hi /
vaiśyakṣatriyaviprāṇāṃ śūdreṣvāśaucameva tu //
meaning:
षड्रात्रं वा त्रिरात्रं स्यादेकरात्रं क्रमेण हि /
वैश्यक्षत्रियविप्राणां शूद्रेष्वाशौचमेव तु //
text_mt: Six nights, three nights, or one night in order / is indeed the impurity for Vaiśyas, Kṣatriyas, and Brāhmaṇas in the case of Śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhamāso 'tha ṣaḍrātraṃ trirātraṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ /
śūdrakṣatriyaviprāṇāṃ vaiśyeṣvāśaucamiṣyate //
meaning:
अर्धमासो ऽथ षड्रात्रं त्रिरात्रं द्विजपुङ्गवाः /
शूद्रक्षत्रियविप्राणां वैश्येष्वाशौचमिष्यते //
text_mt: Half a month, six nights, and three nights, O best of the twice-born, / is the impurity prescribed for Śūdras, Kṣatriyas, and Brāhmaṇas in the case of Vaiśyas.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍrātraṃ vai daśāhaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ /
aśaucaṃ kṣatriye proktaṃ krameṇa dvijapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
षड्रात्रं वै दशाहं च विप्राणां वैश्यशूद्रयोः /
अशौचं क्षत्रिये प्रोक्तं क्रमेण द्विजपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Six nights and ten days for Brāhmaṇas, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, / in order, O best of the twice-born, is declared to be the impurity in the case of a Kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdraviṭkṣatriyāṇāṃ tu brāhmaṇe saṃsthite sati /
daśarātreṇa śuddhiḥ syādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रविट्क्षत्रियाणां तु ब्राह्मणे संस्थिते सति /
दशरात्रेण शुद्धिः स्यादित्याह कमलोद्भवः //
text_mt: When a Brāhmaṇa dies, for Śūdras, Vaiśyas, and Kṣatriyas, / purification occurs in ten nights; so said the Lotus-born [Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
asapiṇḍaṃ dvijaṃ pretaṃ vipro nirhṛtya bandhuvat /
aśitvā ca sahoṣitvā daśarātreṇa śudhyati //
meaning:
असपिण्डं द्विजं प्रेतं विप्रो निर्हृत्य बन्धुवत् /
अशित्वा च सहोषित्वा दशरात्रेण शुध्यति //
text_mt: A Brāhmaṇa who carries out a deceased twice-born non-sapiṇḍa like a kinsman, / eating with them and staying with them, is purified in ten nights.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyannamatti teṣāṃ tu trirātreṇa tataḥ śuciḥ /
anadannannamahnaiva na ca tasmin gṛhe vaset //
meaning:
यद्यन्नमत्ति तेषां तु त्रिरात्रेण ततः शुचिः /
अनदन्नन्नमह्नैव न च तस्मिन् गृहे वसेत् //
text_mt: If he eats their food, he becomes pure after three nights; / not eating their food and not dwelling in that house, [he is pure] in just one day.

sanskrit_iast:
sodakeṣvetadeva syānmāturāpteṣu bandhuṣu /
daśāhena śavasparśe sapiṇḍaścaiva śudhyati //
meaning:
सोदकेष्वेतदेव स्यान्मातुराप्तेषु बन्धुषु /
दशाहेन शवस्पर्शे सपिण्डश्चैव शुध्यति //
text_mt: The same rule applies in the case of water-kinsmen and close relatives of the mother; / and upon touching a corpse, a sapiṇḍa is purified in ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi nirharati pretaṃ prolabhākrāntamānasaḥ /
daśāhena dvijaḥ śudhyed dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ //
meaning:
यदि निर्हरति प्रेतं प्रोलभाक्रान्तमानसः /
दशाहेन द्विजः शुध्येद् द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः //
text_mt: If one carries out a deceased person with a mind overcome by greed, / a twice-born is purified in ten days, and a king in twelve days.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhamāsena vaiśyastu śūdro māsena śudhyati /
ṣaḍrātreṇāthavā sarve trirātreṇāthavā punaḥ //
meaning:
अर्धमासेन वैश्यस्तु शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति /
षड्रात्रेणाथवा सर्वे त्रिरात्रेणाथवा पुनः //
text_mt: A Vaiśya is purified in half a month, and a Śūdra is purified in a month; / or all of them [are purified] in six nights, or again in three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthaṃ caiva nirhṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ dhanavarjitam /
snātvā saṃprāśya tu ghṛtaṃ śudhyanti brāhmaṇādayaḥ //
meaning:
अनाथं चैव निर्हृत्य ब्राह्मणं धनवर्जितम् /
स्नात्वा संप्राश्य तु घृतं शुध्यन्ति ब्राह्मणादयः //
text_mt: Having carried out a destitute Brāhmaṇa who was without a protector, / Brāhmaṇas and others are purified after bathing and tasting clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
avaraśced varaṃ varṇamavaraṃ vā varo yadi /
aśauce saṃspṛśet snehāt tadāśaucena śudhyati //
meaning:
अवरश्चेद् वरं वर्णमवरं वा वरो यदि /
अशौचे संस्पृशेत् स्नेहात् तदाशौचेन शुध्यति //
text_mt: If a lower caste person touches a higher caste person, or a higher caste touches a lower / during impurity out of affection, he is purified according to that person's impurity.

sanskrit_iast:
pretībhūtaṃ dvijaṃ vipro yo 'nugacchata kāmataḥ /
snātvā sacailaṃ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati //
meaning:
प्रेतीभूतं द्विजं विप्रो यो ऽनुगच्छत कामतः /
स्नात्वा सचैलं स्पृष्ट्वाग्निं घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति //
text_mt: A Brāhmaṇa who intentionally follows a deceased twice-born person / becomes pure after bathing with his clothes on, touching fire, and tasting clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhāt kṣatriye śuddhirvaiśye syācca dvyahena tu /
śūdre dinatrayaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaśataṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
एकाहात् क्षत्रिये शुद्धिर्वैश्ये स्याच्च द्व्यहेन तु /
शूद्रे दिनत्रयं प्रोक्तं प्राणायामशतं पुनः //
text_mt: Purification occurs after one day in the case of a Kṣatriya, after two days in the case of a Vaiśya; / three days are declared in the case of a Śūdra, along with a hundred breath controls.

sanskrit_iast:
anasthisaṃcite śūdre rauti ced brāhmaṇaḥ svakaiḥ /
trirātraṃ syāt tathāśaucamekāhaṃ tvanyathā smṛtam //
meaning:
अनस्थिसंचिते शूद्रे रौति चेद् ब्राह्मणः स्वकैः /
त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तथाशौचमेकाहं त्वन्यथा स्मृतम् //
text_mt: If a Brāhmaṇa weeps along with the relatives over a Śūdra whose bones have not been gathered, / the impurity lasts three nights; otherwise, it is remembered as lasting one day.

sanskrit_iast:
asthisaṃcayanādarvāgekāhaṃ kṣatravaiśyayoḥ /
anyathā caiva sajyotirbrāhmaṇe snānameva tu //
meaning:
अस्थिसंचयनादर्वागेकाहं क्षत्रवैश्ययोः /
अन्यथा चैव सज्योतिर्ब्राह्मणे स्नानमेव तु //
text_mt: Before the collection of the bones, [impurity lasts] one day for a Kṣatriya and a Vaiśya; / otherwise, it is until the appearance of stars, but in the case of a Brāhmaṇa, bathing alone [is required].

sanskrit_iast:
anasthisaṃcit vipre brāhmaṇo rauti cet tadā /
snānenaiva bhavecchuddhiḥ sacailena na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अनस्थिसंचित् विप्रे ब्राह्मणो रौति चेत् तदा /
स्नानेनैव भवेच्छुद्धिः सचैलेन न संशयः //
text_mt: If a Brāhmaṇa weeps for a Brāhmaṇa whose bones have not been collected, / then purification occurs merely through bathing with one's clothes on, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
yastaiḥ sahāśanaṃ kuryācchayanādīni caiva hi /
bāndhavo vāparo vāpi sa daśāhena śudhyati //
meaning:
यस्तैः सहाशनं कुर्याच्छयनादीनि चैव हि /
बान्धवो वापरो वापि स दशाहेन शुध्यति //
text_mt: Whoever shares a meal or takes rest with them, / whether a relative or another person, becomes purified after ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
yasteṣāmannamaśnāti sakṛdevāpi kāmataḥ /
tadāśauce nivṛtte 'sau snānaṃ kṛtvā viśudhyati //
meaning:
यस्तेषामन्नमश्नाति सकृदेवापि कामतः /
तदाशौचे निवृत्ते ऽसौ स्नानं कृत्वा विशुध्यति //
text_mt: Whoever eats their food even once intentionally, / becomes purified by taking a bath once that period of impurity has ended.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvattadannamaśnāti durbhikṣopahato naraḥ /
tāvantyahānyaśaucaṃ syāt prāyaścittaṃ tataścaret //
meaning:
यावत्तदन्नमश्नाति दुर्भिक्षोपहतो नरः /
तावन्त्यहान्यशौचं स्यात् प्रायश्चित्तं ततश्चरेत् //
text_mt: For as many days as a man, struck by famine, eats their food, / for that many days there shall be impurity, and he should then perform an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
dāhādyaśaucaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijānāmagnihotriṇām /
sapiṇḍānāṃ tu maraṇe maraṇāditareṣu ca //
meaning:
दाहाद्यशौचं कर्तव्यं द्विजानामग्निहोत्रिणाम् /
सपिण्डानां तु मरणे मरणादितरेषु च //
text_mt: Impurity should be observed from the time of cremation for twice-born maintainers of the sacred fire, / but upon the death of sapiṇḍas, and for others, [it begins] from the moment of death.

sanskrit_iast:
sapiṇḍatā ca puruṣe saptame vinivartate /
samānodakabhāvastu janmanāmnoravedane //
meaning:
सपिण्डता च पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते /
समानोदकभावस्तु जन्मनाम्नोरवेदने //
text_mt: The status of being sapiṇḍas ceases in the seventh generation, / but the relationship of samānodakas ceases when birth and names are no longer remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ /
lepabhājastrayaścātmā sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣaṇ //
meaning:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः /
लेपभाजस्त्रयश्चात्मा सापिण्ड्यं साप्तपौरुषण् //
text_mt: The father, the grandfather, and likewise the great-grandfather, / three sharers of the oblation-wipings, and oneself—the status of sapiṇḍa extends through seven generations.

sanskrit_iast:
aprattānāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣam /
ūḍhānāṃ bhartusāpiṇḍyaṃ prāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
अप्रत्तानां तथा स्त्रीणां सापिण्ड्यं साप्तपौरुषम् /
ऊढानां भर्तुसापिण्ड्यं प्राह देवः पितामहः //
text_mt: For unmarried women, the sapiṇḍa relationship extends through seven generations; / for married women, the sapiṇḍa relationship is with the husband: thus spoke the divine Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
ye caikajātā bahavo bhinnayonaya eva ca /
bhinnavarṇāstu sāpiṇḍyaṃ bhavet teṣāṃ tripūruṣam //
meaning:
ये चैकजाता बहवो भिन्नयोनय एव च /
भिन्नवर्णास्तु सापिण्ड्यं भवेत् तेषां त्रिपूरुषम् //
text_mt: And those born of one father but different wombs, / being of different castes, their sapiṇḍa relationship extends to three generations.

sanskrit_iast:
kāravaḥ śilpino vaidyā dāsīdāsāstathaiva ca /
dātāro niyamī caiva brahmavidbrahmacāriṇau //
meaning:
कारवः शिल्पिनो वैद्या दासीदासास्तथैव च /
दातारो नियमी चैव ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मचारिणौ //
text_mt: Artisans, craftsmen, physicians, as well as female and male slaves, / generous donors, one bound by an observance, the knower of Brahman, and the student of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
satriṇo vratinastāvat sadyaḥ śaucā udāhṛtāḥ /
rājā caivābhiṣiktaśca prāṇasatriṇa eva ca //
meaning:
सत्रिणो व्रतिनस्तावत् सद्यः शौचा उदाहृताः /
राजा चैवाभिषिक्तश्च प्राणसत्रिण एव च //
text_mt: sacrificers, and those undergoing a vow are declared to be purified immediately; / and also an anointed king, and those performing the sacrifice of life.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñe vivāhakāle ca devayāge tathaiva ca /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ durbhikṣe cāpyupadrave //
meaning:
यज्ञे विवाहकाले च देवयागे तथैव च /
सद्यः शौचं समाख्यातं दुर्भिक्षे चाप्युपद्रवे //
text_mt: In a sacrifice, at the time of marriage, and likewise in a rite for the gods, / immediate purification is proclaimed, as well as during a famine or a calamity.

sanskrit_iast:
ḍimbāhavahatānāṃ ca vidyutā pārthivairdvijaiḥ /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ sarpādimaraṇe tathā //
meaning:
डिम्बाहवहतानां च विद्युता पार्थिवैर्द्विजैः /
सद्यः शौचं समाख्यातं सर्पादिमरणे तथा //
text_mt: For those killed in riots and battles, by lightning, by kings, or by twice-born men, / immediate purification is proclaimed, and likewise in death caused by a snake and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau maruprapatane vīrādhvanyapyanāśake /
brāhmaṇārthe ca saṃnyaste sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
अग्नौ मरुप्रपतने वीराध्वन्यप्यनाशके /
ब्राह्मणार्थे च संन्यस्ते सद्यः शौचं विधीयते //
text_mt: In entering fire, leaping from a cliff, on the hero's path, in fasting to death, / for the sake of a Brāhmaṇa, or when having renounced, immediate purification is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
naiṣṭhikānāṃ vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām /
nāśaucaṃ kīrtyate sadbhiḥ patite ca tathā mṛte //
meaning:
नैष्ठिकानां वनस्थानां यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् /
नाशौचं कीर्त्यते सद्भिः पतिते च तथा मृते //
text_mt: For perpetual students, forest hermits, ascetics, and students of the Veda, / no impurity is declared by the virtuous; and likewise when an outcaste has died.

sanskrit_iast:
patitānāṃ na dāhaḥ syānnāntyeṣṭirnāsthisaṃcayaḥ /
na cāśrupātapiṇḍau vā kāryaṃ śrāddhādi kaṅkvacit //
meaning:
पतितानां न दाहः स्यान्नान्त्येष्टिर्नास्थिसंचयः /
न चाश्रुपातपिण्डौ वा कार्यं श्राद्धादि कङ्क्वचित् //
text_mt: For outcastes there shall be no cremation, no funeral rite, and no collection of bones, / neither the shedding of tears nor funeral cakes, nor should any ancestral offering rite and the like be performed anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpādayet tathātmānaṃ svayaṃ yo 'gniviṣādibhiḥ /
vihitaṃ tasya nāśaucaṃ nāgnirnāpyudakādikam //
meaning:
व्यापादयेत् तथात्मानं स्वयं यो ऽग्निविषादिभिः /
विहितं तस्य नाशौचं नाग्निर्नाप्युदकादिकम् //
text_mt: Whoever destroys himself by fire, poison, and the like, / for him no impurity is ordained, neither fire nor water offerings and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kaścit pramādena mriyate 'gniviṣādibhiḥ /
tasyāśaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kāryaṃ caivodakādikam //
meaning:
अथ कश्चित् प्रमादेन म्रियते ऽग्निविषादिभिः /
तस्याशौचं विधातव्यं कार्यं चैवोदकादिकम् //
text_mt: Now, if someone dies through negligence by fire, poison, and the like, / impurity should be observed for him, and water offerings and the like must be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte kumāre tadahaḥ kāmaṃ kuryāt pratigraham /
hiraṇyadhānyagovāsastilānnaguḍasarpiṣām //
meaning:
जाते कुमारे तदहः कामं कुर्यात् प्रतिग्रहम् /
हिरण्यधान्यगोवासस्तिलान्नगुडसर्पिषाम् //
text_mt: When a son is born, on that day one may freely accept gifts / of gold, grain, cattle, clothing, sesame, cooked food, molasses, and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
phalāni puṣpaṃ śākaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ kāṣṭhameva ca /
toyaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailamauṣadhaṃ kṣīrameva ca /
āśaucināṃ gṛhād grāhyaṃ śuṣkānnaṃ caiva nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
फलानि पुष्पं शाकं च लवणं काष्ठमेव च /
तोयं दधि घृतं तैलमौषधं क्षीरमेव च /
आशौचिनां गृहाद् ग्राह्यं शुष्कान्नं चैव नित्यशः //
text_mt: Fruits, flowers, vegetables, salt, firewood, / water, curd, clarified butter, oil, medicine, and milk, / and dry food may always be accepted from the house of those who are impure.

sanskrit_iast:
āhitāgniryathānyāyaṃ dagdhavyastribhiragnibhiḥ /
anāhitāgnirgṛhyeṇa laukikenetaro janaḥ //
meaning:
आहिताग्निर्यथान्यायं दग्धव्यस्त्रिभिरग्निभिः /
अनाहिताग्निर्गृह्येण लौकिकेनेतरो जनः //
text_mt: One who maintains the sacred fires should be cremated with the three fires according to rule; / one who does not maintain the sacred fires with the domestic fire, and other people with the common fire.

sanskrit_iast:
dehābhāvāt palāśaistu kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ punaḥ /
dāhaḥ kāryo yathānyāyaṃ sapiṇḍaiḥ śraddhayānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
देहाभावात् पलाशैस्तु कृत्वा प्रतिकृतिं पुनः /
दाहः कार्यो यथान्यायं सपिण्डैः श्रद्धयान्वितैः //
text_mt: In the absence of a body, however, having made an effigy out of palāśa leaves, / cremation should be performed according to rule by the sapiṇḍas endowed with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛtprasiñcantyudakaṃ nāmagotreṇa vāgyatāḥ /
daśāhaṃ bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarve caivārdravāsasaḥ //
meaning:
सकृत्प्रसिञ्चन्त्युदकं नामगोत्रेण वाग्यताः /
दशाहं बान्धवैः सार्धं सर्वे चैवार्द्रवाससः //
text_mt: With restrained speech, wearing wet clothes together with the kinsmen, / they should pour water once, uttering the name and lineage, for ten days.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍaṃ pratidinaṃ dadyuḥ sāyaṃ prātaryathāvidhi /
pretāya ca gṛhadvāri caturthe bhojayed dvijān //
meaning:
पिण्डं प्रतिदिनं दद्युः सायं प्रातर्यथाविधि /
प्रेताय च गृहद्वारि चतुर्थे भोजयेद् द्विजान् //
text_mt: They should offer a funeral cake every day at evening and morning according to the rule, / for the deceased spirit at the door of the house, and on the fourth day feed the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye 'hani kartavyaṃ kṣurakarma sabāndhavaiḥ /
caturthe bāndhavaiḥ sarvairasthanāṃ saṃcayanaṃ bhavet /
pūrvaṃ tu bhojayed viprānayugmān śraddhayā śucīn //
meaning:
द्वितीये ऽहनि कर्तव्यं क्षुरकर्म सबान्धवैः /
चतुर्थे बान्धवैः सर्वैरस्थनां संचयनं भवेत् /
पूर्वं तु भोजयेद् विप्रानयुग्मान् श्रद्धया शुचीन् //
text_mt: On the second day, shaving should be performed together with the relatives; / on the fourth day, the collection of bones should be performed by all the relatives; / but first, one should feed pure twice-born men in odd numbers with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcame navame caiva tathaivaikādaśe 'hani /
ayugmān bhojayed viprān navaśrāddhaṃ tu tadviduḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमे नवमे चैव तथैवैकादशे ऽहनि /
अयुग्मान् भोजयेद् विप्रान् नवश्राद्धं तु तद्विदुः //
text_mt: On the fifth, ninth, and likewise eleventh day, / one should feed twice-born men in odd numbers; they know this as the rite for the newly deceased.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśe 'hni kurvota pretamuddiśya bhāvataḥ /
dvādaśe vātha kartavyamanindye tvathavāhani /
ekaṃ pavitramekor'ghaḥ piṇḍapātraṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
एकादशे ऽह्नि कुर्वोत प्रेतमुद्दिश्य भावतः /
द्वादशे वाथ कर्तव्यमनिन्द्ये त्वथवाहनि /
एकं पवित्रमेकोर्ऽघः पिण्डपात्रं तथैव च //
text_mt: On the eleventh day, one should perform [the rite] for the deceased spirit with devotion, / or it should be done on the twelfth day, or on an unblamable day; / there should be one strain of darbha grass, one water offering, and likewise one cake vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mṛtāhni kartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram /
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ pūrṇe saṃvatsare punaḥ //
meaning:
एवं मृताह्नि कर्तव्यं प्रतिमासं तु वत्सरम् /
सपिण्डीकरणं प्रोक्तं पूर्णे संवत्सरे पुनः //
text_mt: In this manner, it should be done on the day of death each month for a year; / when the year is completed, the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa rite is prescribed once more.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāccatvāri pātrāṇi pretādīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ /
pretārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pātramāsecayet tataḥ //
meaning:
कुर्याच्चत्वारि पात्राणि प्रेतादीनां द्विजोत्तमाः /
प्रेतार्थं पितृपात्रेषु पात्रमासेचयेत् ततः //
text_mt: One should prepare four vessels for the deceased spirit and the ancestors, O best of the twice-born; / then one should pour the vessel for the deceased spirit into the vessels for the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ piṇḍānapyevameva hi /
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ devapūrvaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यां पिण्डानप्येवमेव हि /
सपिण्डीकरणं श्राद्धं देवपूर्वं विधीयते //
text_mt: along with the two verses 'ye samānāḥ'; and the funeral cakes in this very same manner; / the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa ancestral offering rite is ordained to be preceded by an offering to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnāvāhayet tatra punaḥ pretaṃ ca nirdiśet /
ye sapiṇḍīkṛtāḥ pretāna teṣāṃ syāt pṛthakkriyāḥ /
yastu kuryāt pṛthak piṇḍaṃ pitṛhā so 'bhijāyate //
meaning:
पितॄनावाहयेत् तत्र पुनः प्रेतं च निर्दिशेत् /
ये सपिण्डीकृताः प्रेतान तेषां स्यात् पृथक्क्रियाः /
यस्तु कुर्यात् पृथक् पिण्डं पितृहा सो ऽभिजायते //
text_mt: One should invoke the ancestors there, and again designate the deceased spirit; / for those deceased spirits who have been united through the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa rite, there can be no separate rites; / whoever makes a separate cake becomes a killer of his ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte pitari vai putraḥ piṇḍamabdaṃ samācaret /
dadyāccānnaṃ sodakumbhaṃ pratyahaṃ pretadharmataḥ //
meaning:
मृते पितरि वै पुत्रः पिण्डमब्दं समाचरेत् /
दद्याच्चान्नं सोदकुम्भं प्रत्यहं प्रेतधर्मतः //
text_mt: When the father dies, the son should indeed perform the offering of the funeral cake for a year, / and give food with a jar of water every day according to the duty toward the deceased spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvaṇena vidhānena saṃvatsarikamiṣyate /
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
पार्वणेन विधानेन संवत्सरिकमिष्यते /
प्रतिसंवत्सरं कार्यं विधिरेष सनातनः //
text_mt: The annual rite is prescribed according to the rules of the new-and-full-moon ancestor rites; / it should be performed every year; this is the eternal rule.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitroḥ sutaiḥ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānādikaṃ ca yat /
patnī kuryāt sutābhāve patnya bhāve sahodahaḥ //
meaning:
मातापित्रोः सुतैः कार्यं पिण्डदानादिकं च यत् /
पत्नी कुर्यात् सुताभावे पत्न्य भावे सहोदहः //
text_mt: Whatever offering of cakes and the like must be done for parents by sons, / the wife should do in the absence of a son, and a uterine brother in the absence of a wife.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhāne jīvan vā śrāddhamācaret /
kṛtvā dānādikaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अनेनैव विधाने जीवन् वा श्राद्धमाचरेत् /
कृत्वा दानादिकं सर्वं श्रद्धायुक्तः समाहितः //
text_mt: According to this very rule, while living, one may perform an ancestral offering rite for oneself, / performing all giving of gifts and the like, endowed with faith and composed in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vaḥ kathitaḥ samyag gṛhasthānāṃ kriyāvidhiḥ /
strīṇāṃ tu bhartṛśuśrūṣā dharmo nānya iheṣyate //
meaning:
एष वः कथितः सम्यग् गृहस्थानां क्रियाविधिः /
स्त्रीणां तु भर्तृशुश्रूषा धर्मो नान्य इहेष्यते //
text_mt: This proper rule of rites for householders has been told to you; / for women, however, service to the husband is recognized as duty, none other in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmaparamo nityamīśvirārpitamānasaḥ /
prāpnoti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ yaduktaṃ vedavādibhiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स्वधर्मपरमो नित्यमीश्विरार्पितमानसः /
प्राप्नोति तत् परं स्थानं यदुक्तं वेदवादिभिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Constantly devoted to his own duty, his mind offered up to the Lord, / he attains that supreme station which is proclaimed by the teachers of the Veda.

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
agnihotraṃ tu juhuyādādyante 'harniśoḥ sadā /
darśena caiva pakṣānte paurṇamāsena caiva hi //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अग्निहोत्रं तु जुहुयादाद्यन्ते ऽहर्निशोः सदा /
दर्शेन चैव पक्षान्ते पौर्णमासेन चैव हि //
title: caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
One should always offer the agnihotra oblation at the beginning and end of day and night, / and at the end of each fortnight with the new-moon sacrifice and the full-moon sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
śasyānte navaśasyeṣṭyā tathartvante dvijo 'dhvaraiḥ /
paśunā tvayanasyānte samānte saumikairmakhaiḥ //
meaning:
शस्यान्ते नवशस्येष्ट्या तथर्त्वन्ते द्विजो ऽध्वरैः /
पशुना त्वयनस्यान्ते समान्ते सौमिकैर्मखैः //
text_mt: at the harvest with the sacrifice of first fruits, and at the end of each season the twice-born should offer with soma sacrifices; / at the end of a half-year with an animal sacrifice, and at the end of the year with soma rites.

sanskrit_iast:
nāniṣṭvā navaśasyeṣṭyā paśunā vāgnimān dvijaḥ /
navānnamadyānmāṃsaṃ vā dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ //
meaning:
नानिष्ट्वा नवशस्येष्ट्या पशुना वाग्निमान् द्विजः /
नवान्नमद्यान्मांसं वा दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः //
text_mt: Without having sacrificed with the offering of first fruits or with an animal, the twice-born maintainer of sacred fire / who wishes to live a long life should not eat new grain or meat.

sanskrit_iast:
navenānnena cāniṣṭvā paśuhavyena cāganyaḥ /
prāṇānevāttumicchanti navānnāmiṣagṛddhinaḥ //
meaning:
नवेनान्नेन चानिष्ट्वा पशुहव्येन चागन्यः /
प्राणानेवात्तुमिच्छन्ति नवान्नामिषगृद्धिनः //
text_mt: When one has not offered the new grain and animal oblations, the sacred fires / wish to consume the very life-breaths of the one who is greedy for new grain and meat.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrān śāntihomāṃśca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ /
pitṝṃścaivāṣṭakāsvarcan nityamanvaṣṭakāsu ca //
meaning:
सावित्रान् शान्तिहोमांश्च कुर्यात् पर्वसु नित्यशः /
पितॄंश्चैवाष्टकास्वर्चन् नित्यमन्वष्टकासु च //
text_mt: One should always perform the Sāvitrī oblations and pacificatory fire offerings on the new- and full-moon days, / always worshiping the ancestors on the eighth-day rites and on the days following the eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dharmaḥ paro nityamapadharmo 'nya ucyate /
trayāṇāmiha varṇānāṃ gṛhasthāśramavāsinām //
meaning:
एष धर्मः परो नित्यमपधर्मो ऽन्य उच्यते /
त्रयाणामिह वर्णानां गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनाम् //
text_mt: This is the supreme eternal duty; another, the duty in times of distress, is now declared / for the three castes dwelling here in the householder stage of life.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstikyādathavālasyād yo 'gnīn nādhātumicchati /
yajeta vā na yajñena sa yāti narakān bahūn //
meaning:
नास्तिक्यादथवालस्याद् यो ऽग्नीन् नाधातुमिच्छति /
यजेत वा न यज्ञेन स याति नरकान् बहून् //
text_mt:
He who, out of atheism or out of laziness, does not wish to establish the sacred fires
or does not sacrifice with sacrifice, goes to many hells:

sanskrit_iast:
tāmistramandhatāmistraṃ mahārauravarauravau /
kumbhīpākaṃ vaitaraṇīmasipatravanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तामिस्त्रमन्धतामिस्त्रं महारौरवरौरवौ /
कुम्भीपाकं वैतरणीमसिपत्रवनं तथा //
text_mt:
Tāmistra, Andhatāmistra, Mahāraurava and Raurava,
Kumbhīpāka, Vaitaraṇī, and likewise Asipatravana.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṃśca narakān ghorān saṃprāpyānte sudurmatiḥ /
antyajānāṃ kule viprāḥ śūdrayonau ca jāyate //
meaning:
अन्यांश्च नरकान् घोरान् संप्राप्यान्ते सुदुर्मतिः /
अन्त्यजानां कुले विप्राः शूद्रयोनौ च जायते //
text_mt:
Having reached other dreadful hells, at the end, that utterly foolish man,
O Brahmins, is born into a family of outcastes and in a Śūdra womb.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇo hi viśeṣataḥ /
ādhāyāgniṃ viśuddhātmā yajeta parameśvaram //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो हि विशेषतः /
आधायाग्निं विशुद्धात्मा यजेत परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, by every effort, a Brahmin especially,
having established the sacred fire with a purified self, should worship the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotrāt paro dharmo dvijānāṃ neha vidyate /
tasmādārādhayennityamagnihotreṇa śāśvatam //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रात् परो धर्मो द्विजानां नेह विद्यते /
तस्मादाराधयेन्नित्यमग्निहोत्रेण शाश्वतम् //
text_mt:
No duty higher than the Agnihotra exists here for the twice-born;
therefore, one should constantly worship the eternal [Lord] through the Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścādhāyāgnimālasyānna yaṣṭuṃ devamicchati /
so 'sau mūḍho na saṃbhāṣyaḥ kiṃ punarnāstiko janaḥ //
meaning:
यश्चाधायाग्निमालस्यान्न यष्टुं देवमिच्छति /
सो ऽसौ मूढो न संभाष्यः किं पुनर्नास्तिको जनः //
text_mt:
And he who, having established the sacred fire, does not wish to sacrifice to the deity out of laziness,
that foolish man is not to be spoken to; how much less an atheistic person!

sanskrit_iast:
yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye /
adhikaṃ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati //
meaning:
यस्य त्रैवार्षिकं भक्तं पर्याप्तं भृत्यवृत्तये /
अधिकं चापि विद्येत स सोमं पातुमर्हति //
text_mt:
He who has grain enough for three years to maintain his dependents,
and has even more, is entitled to drink Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vai sarvayajñānāṃ somaḥ prathama iṣyate /
somenārādhayed devaṃ somalokamaheśvaram //
meaning:
एष वै सर्वयज्ञानां सोमः प्रथम इष्यते /
सोमेनाराधयेद् देवं सोमलोकमहेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
This indeed is regarded as the first among all sacrifices, namely the Soma [sacrifice];
with Soma one should worship the deity, the great Lord of the world of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
na somayāgādadhiko maheśārādhane kratuḥ /
samo vā vidyate tasmāt somenābhyarcayet param //
meaning:
न सोमयागादधिको महेशाराधने क्रतुः /
समो वा विद्यते तस्मात् सोमेनाभ्यर्चयेत् परम् //
text_mt:
There is no sacrifice greater than the Soma sacrifice in worshipping the Great Lord,
nor one equal to it; therefore, one should worship the Supreme [Lord] with Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahena viprāṇāmādāvabhihitaḥ śubhaḥ /
dharmo vimuktaye sākṣācchrautaḥ smārto dvidhā punaḥ //
meaning:
पितामहेन विप्राणामादावभिहितः शुभः /
धर्मो विमुक्तये साक्षाच्छ्रौतः स्मार्तो द्विधा पुनः //
text_mt:
In the beginning, auspicious duty was declared by the Grandfather to the Brahmins
for direct liberation, which is two-fold again: scriptural and traditional.

sanskrit_iast:
śrautastretāgnisaṃbandhāt smārtaḥ pūrvaṃ mayoditaḥ /
śreyaskaratamaḥ śrautastasmācchrautaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
श्रौतस्त्रेताग्निसंबन्धात् स्मार्तः पूर्वं मयोदितः /
श्रेयस्करतमः श्रौतस्तस्माच्छ्रौतं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
The scriptural is connected to the triad of fires; the traditional was previously spoken by me.
The scriptural is the most conducive to welfare; therefore, one should practice the scriptural.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhāvabhihitau dharmau vedādeva viniḥ sṛtau /
śiṣṭācārastṛtīyaḥ syācchratismṛtyoralābhataḥ //
meaning:
उभावभिहितौ धर्मौ वेदादेव विनिः सृतौ /
शिष्टाचारस्तृतीयः स्याच्छ्रतिस्मृत्योरलाभतः //
text_mt:
Both duties described have emerged from the Veda itself;
the conduct of the virtuous is the third, in the absence of scripture and tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmeṇābhigato yaistu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ /
te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā nityamātmaguṇānvitāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मेणाभिगतो यैस्तु वेदः सपरिबृंहणः /
ते शिष्टा ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्ता नित्यमात्मगुणान्विताः //
text_mt:
Those by whom the Veda along with its supplements has been acquired through duty
are declared to be the virtuous Brahmins, constantly endowed with the qualities of the self.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmabhimato yaḥ syāccetasā nityameva hi /
sa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ sadbhirnānyeṣāmiti dhāraṇā //
meaning:
तेषामभिमतो यः स्याच्चेतसा नित्यमेव हि /
स धर्मः कथितः सद्भिर्नान्येषामिति धारणा //
text_mt:
Whatever is approved by them in their mind constantly, indeed,
that is declared as duty by the good; not that of others—such is the precept.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca vedānāmupabṛṃhaṇam /
ekasmād brahmavijñānaṃ dharmajñānaṃ tathaikataḥ //
meaning:
पुराणं धर्मशास्त्रं च वेदानामुपबृंहणम् /
एकस्माद् ब्रह्मविज्ञानं धर्मज्ञानं तथैकतः //
text_mt:
The Purāṇa and the Dharmaśāstra are the elaboration of the Vedas:
from the one comes knowledge of Brahman, and from the other knowledge of duty.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ tatpramāṇataraṃ smṛtam /
dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ tad brahmajñāne parā pramā //
meaning:
धर्मं जिज्ञासमानानां तत्प्रमाणतरं स्मृतम् /
धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणं तद् ब्रह्मज्ञाने परा प्रमा //
text_mt:
For those desiring to understand duty, that [Dharmaśāstra] is considered the higher authority;
the Dharmaśāstra and that Purāṇa are the supreme authority regarding the knowledge of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyato jāyate dharmo brahmavidyā ca vaidikī /
tasmād dharmaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śraddhātavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ
IN REE NICHT ZULÄSSIGE ZEICHEN:
meaning:
नान्यतो जायते धर्मो ब्रह्मविद्या च वैदिकी /
तस्माद् धर्मं पुराणं च श्रद्धातव्यं द्विजातिभिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुर्विशो ऽध्यायः
इन् रेए निछ्त् Zउल्Äस्सिगे Zएइछेन्:

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
eṣa vo 'bhihitaḥ kṛtsno gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ /
dvijāteḥ paramo dharmo vartanāni nibodhata //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एष वो ऽभिहितः कृत्स्नो गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनः /
द्विजातेः परमो धर्मो वर्तनानि निबोधत //
title: pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
This entire supreme duty of the twice-born dwelling in the stage of the householder
has been declared to you; now learn their means of livelihood.

sanskrit_iast:
dvividhastu gṛhī jñeyaḥ sādhakaścāpyasādhakaḥ /
adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca pūrvasyāhuḥ pratigraham /
kusīdakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ prakurvotāsvayaṅkṛtam //
meaning:
द्विविधस्तु गृही ज्ञेयः साधकश्चाप्यसाधकः /
अध्यापनं याजनं च पूर्वस्याहुः प्रतिग्रहम् /
कुसीदकृषिवाणिज्यं प्रकुर्वोतास्वयङ्कृतम् //

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣerabhāvād vāṇijyaṃ tadabhāvāt kusīdakam /
āpatkalpo hyaṃ jñeyaḥ pūrvokto mukhya iṣyate //
meaning:
कृषेरभावाद् वाणिज्यं तदभावात् कुसीदकम् /
आपत्कल्पो ह्यं ज्ञेयः पूर्वोक्तो मुख्य इष्यते //
text_mt:
In the absence of agriculture, [he may pursue] commerce; in the absence of that, usury.
For this is to be known as a procedure for times of distress; the previously mentioned is considered primary.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ vā karṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāṇijyaṃ vā kusīdakam /
kaṣṭā pāpīyasī vṛttiḥ kusīdaṃ tad vivarjayet //
meaning:
स्वयं वा कर्षणं कुर्याद् वाणिज्यं वा कुसीदकम् /
कष्टा पापीयसी वृत्तिः कुसीदं तद् विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt:
Or he may personally perform ploughing, or trade, or usury;
usury is a painful, most sinful livelihood; he should abandon that.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣātravṛttiṃ parāṃ prahurna svayaṃ karṣaṇaṃ dvijaiḥ /
tasmāt kṣātreṇa varteta vartanenāpadi dvijaḥ //
meaning:
क्षात्रवृत्तिं परां प्रहुर्न स्वयं कर्षणं द्विजैः /
तस्मात् क्षात्रेण वर्तेत वर्तनेनापदि द्विजः //
text_mt:
They declare the livelihood of a Kṣatriya to be superior, not ploughing done by twice-born themselves;
therefore, in times of distress, a twice-born may maintain himself by the livelihood of a Kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
tena cāvāpyajīvaṃstu vaiśyavṛttiṃ kṛṣiṃ vrajet /
na kathañcana kurvota brāhmaṇaḥ karma karṣaṇam //
meaning:
तेन चावाप्यजीवंस्तु वैश्यवृत्तिं कृषिं व्रजेत् /
न कथञ्चन कुर्वोत ब्राह्मणः कर्म कर्षणम् //
text_mt:
And if unable to obtain a livelihood through that, he may go to agriculture, the livelihood of a Vaiśya;
under no circumstances should a Brahmin perform the work of ploughing [himself].

sanskrit_iast:
labdhalābhaḥ pitṝn devān brāhmaṇāṃścāpi pūjayet /
te tṛptāstasya taṃ doṣaṃ śamayanti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
लब्धलाभः पितॄन् देवान् ब्राह्मणांश्चापि पूजयेत् /
ते तृप्तास्तस्य तं दोषं शमयन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt:
Having obtained profit, he should also worship the ancestors, the gods, and the Brahmins;
they, being satisfied, dispel that fault of his, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyād bhāgaṃ tu viṃśakam /
triṃśadbhāgaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛṣiṃ kurvan na duṣyati //
meaning:
देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च दद्याद् भागं तु विंशकम् /
त्रिंशद्भागं ब्राह्मणानां कृषिं कुर्वन् न दुष्यति //
text_mt:
He should give a twentieth portion to the gods and the ancestors,
and a thirtieth portion to Brahmins; practicing agriculture, he does not incur fault.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṇik pradadyād dviguṇaṃ kusīdī triguṇaṃ punaḥ /
kṛṣīvalo na doṣeṇa yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
वणिक् प्रदद्याद् द्विगुणं कुसीदी त्रिगुणं पुनः /
कृषीवलो न दोषेण युज्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
A merchant should give twice that, and a usurer thrice that;
the cultivator is not associated with fault; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
śiloñchaṃ vāpyādadīta gṛhasthaḥ sādhakaḥ punaḥ /
vidyāśilpādayastvanye bahavo vṛttihetavaḥ //
meaning:
शिलोञ्छं वाप्याददीत गृहस्थः साधकः पुनः /
विद्याशिल्पादयस्त्वन्ये बहवो वृत्तिहेतवः //
text_mt:
Or the practicing householder may adopt gleaning and collecting ears of grain;
there are, however, many other means of livelihood such as learning and crafts.

sanskrit_iast:
asādhakastu yaḥ prokto gṛhasthāśramasaṃsthitaḥ /
śiloñche tasya kathite dve vṛttī paramarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
असाधकस्तु यः प्रोक्तो गृहस्थाश्रमसंस्थितः /
शिलोञ्छे तस्य कथिते द्वे वृत्ती परमर्षिभिः //
text_mt:
As for the one who is declared a non-practitioner living in the stage of the householder,
two livelihoods have been stated for him by the supreme sages: gleaning and collecting ears of grain.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtenāthavā jīvenmṛtenāpyathavā yadi /
ayācitaṃ syādamṛtaṃ mṛtaṃ bhekṣaṃ tu yācitam //
meaning:
अमृतेनाथवा जीवेन्मृतेनाप्यथवा यदि /
अयाचितं स्यादमृतं मृतं भेक्षं तु याचितम् //
text_mt:
Or he may live by the 'nectar', or else if he chooses, by the 'dead';
what is unasked would be the 'nectar', while the 'dead' is food obtained by begging.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśūladhānyako vā syāt kumbhīdhānyaka eva vā /
tryahaihiko vāpi bhavedaśvastanika eva ca //
meaning:
कुशूलधान्यको वा स्यात् कुम्भीधान्यक एव वा /
त्र्यहैहिको वापि भवेदश्वस्तनिक एव च //
text_mt:
He may have grain enough for a granary, or he may have grain enough for a jar,
or he may have grain for three days, or he may have nothing for tomorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ dvijānāṃ gṛhamedhinām /
śreyān paraḥ paro jñeyo dharmato lokajittamaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्णामपि चैतेषां द्विजानां गृहमेधिनाम् /
श्रेयान् परः परो ज्ञेयो धर्मतो लोकजित्तमः //
text_mt:
Even among these four householder twice-born,
each subsequent one is to be known as superior in duty and the greatest conqueror of worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkarmaiko bhavatyeṣāṃ tribhiranyaḥ pravartate /
dvābhyāmekaścaturthastu brahmasatreṇa jīvati //
meaning:
षट्कर्मैको भवत्येषां त्रिभिरन्यः प्रवर्तते /
द्वाभ्यामेकश्चतुर्थस्तु ब्रह्मसत्रेण जीवति //
text_mt:
One of these engages in the six duties; another proceeds with three;
one with two, while the fourth lives by the sacrifice to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
vartayaṃstu śiloñchābhyāmagnihotraparāyaṇaḥ /
iṣṭīḥ pārvāyaṇāntīyāḥ kevalā nirvapet sadā //
meaning:
वर्तयंस्तु शिलोञ्छाभ्यामग्निहोत्रपरायणः /
इष्टीः पार्वायणान्तीयाः केवला निर्वपेत् सदा //
text_mt:
Maintaining himself by gleaning and collecting ears of grain, devoted to the Agnihotra,
he should always offer only the sacrifices ending at the full and new moon.

sanskrit_iast:
na lokavṛtiṃ varteta vṛttihetoḥ kathañcana /
ajihmāmaśaṭhāṃ śuddhāṃ jīved brāhmaṇajīvikām //
meaning:
न लोकवृतिं वर्तेत वृत्तिहेतोः कथञ्चन /
अजिह्मामशठां शुद्धां जीवेद् ब्राह्मणजीविकाम् //
text_mt:
He should under no circumstances live by worldly conduct for the sake of livelihood;
he should live by a straightforward, honest, pure Brahmin livelihood.

sanskrit_iast:
yācitvā vāpi sadbhyo 'nnaṃ pitṝndevāṃstu toṣayet /
yācayed vā śuciṃ dāntaṃ na tṛpyeta svayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
याचित्वा वापि सद्भ्यो ऽन्नं पितॄन्देवांस्तु तोषयेत् /
याचयेद् वा शुचिं दान्तं न तृप्येत स्वयं ततः //
text_mt:
Or, having begged food from the virtuous, he should satisfy the ancestors and the gods;
or he may beg from one who is pure and restrained, but should not satisfy himself from that.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhasthastoṣayenna tu /
devān pitṛṃśca vidhinā śunāṃ yoniṃ vrajatyasau //
meaning:
यस्तु द्रव्यार्जनं कृत्वा गृहस्थस्तोषयेन्न तु /
देवान् पितृंश्च विधिना शुनां योनिं व्रजत्यसौ //
text_mt:
A householder who, having acquired wealth, does not satisfy
the gods and ancestors according to the rule, goes to the womb of dogs.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca śreyo mokṣaścatuṣṭayam /
dharmāviruddhaḥ kāmaḥ syād brāhmaṇānāṃ tu netaraḥ //
meaning:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च श्रेयो मोक्षश्चतुष्टयम् /
धर्माविरुद्धः कामः स्याद् ब्राह्मणानां तु नेतरः //
text_mt:
Duty, wealth, pleasure, and liberation are the four-fold welfare;
for Brahmins, pleasure must not be opposed to duty, but no other.

sanskrit_iast:
yor'tho dharmāya nātmārthaḥ sor'tho 'narthastathetaraḥ /
tasmādarthaṃ samāsādya dadyād vai juhuyād yajet //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
IN REE NICHT ZULÄSSIGE ZEICHEN:
meaning:
योर्ऽथो धर्माय नात्मार्थः सोर्ऽथो ऽनर्थस्तथेतरः /
तस्मादर्थं समासाद्य दद्याद् वै जुहुयाद् यजेत् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः
इन् रेए निछ्त् Zउल्Äस्सिगे Zएइछेन्:
text_mt:
That wealth which is not for duty, but for oneself, is a calamity; and likewise the other.
Therefore, having obtained wealth, one should give, offer into the fire, and sacrifice.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānadharmamanuttamam /
brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavādinām //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानधर्ममनुत्तमम् /
ब्रह्मणाभिहितं पूर्वमृषीणां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् //
title: ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Now therefore I shall proclaim the unsurpassed duty of giving,
which was declared of old by Brahmā to the sages who proclaim Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
arthānāmudite pātre śraddhayā pratipādanam /
dānamityabhinirdiṣṭaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam //
meaning:
अर्थानामुदिते पात्रे श्रद्धया प्रतिपादनम् /
दानमित्यभिनिर्दिष्टं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम् //
text_mt:
Bestowing wealth upon a worthy recipient with faith
is defined as gift, which grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yad dadāti viśiṣṭebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ /
tad vai vittamahaṃ manye śeṣaṃ kasyāpi rakṣati //
meaning:
यद् ददाति विशिष्टेभ्यः श्रद्धया परया युतः /
तद् वै वित्तमहं मन्ये शेषं कस्यापि रक्षति //
text_mt:
What one gives to distinguished men endowed with supreme faith,
that indeed I consider real wealth; the remainder one preserves for someone else.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ dānamucyate /
caturthaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ sarvadānottamottamam //
meaning:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं त्रिविधं दानमुच्यते /
चतुर्थं विमलं प्रोक्तं सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Gift is said to be three-fold: regular, occasional, and optional;
a fourth is declared as the pure, the highest of the high among all gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
ahanyahani yat kiñcid dīyate 'nupakāriṇe /
anuddiśya phalaṃ tasmād brāhmaṇāya tu nityakam //
meaning:
अहन्यहनि यत् किञ्चिद् दीयते ऽनुपकारिणे /
अनुद्दिश्य फलं तस्माद् ब्राह्मणाय तु नित्यकम् //
text_mt:
Whatever is given day by day to one who has done no service,
without anticipating any fruit from it, to a Brahmin, is the regular [gift].

sanskrit_iast:
yat tu pāpopaśāntyarthaṃ dīyate viduṣāṃ kare /
naimittikaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dānaṃ sadbhiranuṣṭhitam //
meaning:
यत् तु पापोपशान्त्यर्थं दीयते विदुषां करे /
नैमित्तिकं तदुद्दिष्टं दानं सद्भिरनुष्ठितम् //
text_mt:
That which is given into the hand of wise men for the pacification of sin,
performed by the virtuous, is designated as the occasional gift.

sanskrit_iast:
apatyavijayaiśvaryasvargārthaṃ yat pradīyate /
dānaṃ tat kāmyamākhyātamṛṣibhirdharmacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
अपत्यविजयैश्वर्यस्वर्गार्थं यत् प्रदीयते /
दानं तत् काम्यमाख्यातमृषिभिर्धर्मचिन्तकैः //
text_mt: That gift which is bestowed for the sake of offspring, victory, sovereignty, or heaven / is declared by the sages, contemplators of duty, to be optional.

sanskrit_iast:
yadīśvaraprīṇanārthaṃ brahmavitsu pradīyate /
cetasā dharmayuktena dānaṃ tad vimalaṃ śivam //
meaning:
यदीश्वरप्रीणनार्थं ब्रह्मवित्सु प्रदीयते /
चेतसा धर्मयुक्तेन दानं तद् विमलं शिवम् //
text_mt: That which is bestowed upon knowers of Brahman to propitiate the Lord, / with a mind intent on righteousness, is pure and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
dānadharmaṃ niṣeveta pātramāsādya śaktitaḥ /
utpatsyate hi tatpātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ //
meaning:
दानधर्मं निषेवेत पात्रमासाद्य शक्तितः /
उत्पत्स्यते हि तत्पात्रं यत् तारयति सर्वतः //
text_mt: One should practice the duty of giving according to one's capacity, having found a worthy recipient; / for that worthy recipient will arise who delivers [the giver] in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭumbabhaktavasanād deyaṃ yadatiricyate /
anyathā dīyate yaddhi na tad dānaṃ phalapradam //
meaning:
कुटुम्बभक्तवसनाद् देयं यदतिरिच्यते /
अन्यथा दीयते यद्धि न तद् दानं फलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Whatever remains over and above the food and clothing of one's family should be given; / for what is given otherwise is not a gift that yields fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotriyāya kulīnāya vinītāya tapasvine /
vṛttasthāya daridrāya pradeyaṃ bhaktipūrvakam //
meaning:
श्रोत्रियाय कुलीनाय विनीताय तपस्विने /
वृत्तस्थाय दरिद्राय प्रदेयं भक्तिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: To a Vedic scholar, well-born, disciplined, ascetic, / established in good conduct, and poor, one should give with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu dadyānmahīṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye /
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati //
meaning:
यस्तु दद्यान्महीं भक्त्या ब्राह्मणायाहिताग्नये /
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति //
text_mt: He who devoutly gives land to a Brāhmaṇa who maintains the sacred fires / goes to the supreme abode, reaching which he grieves no more.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣubhiḥ saṃtatāṃ bhumiṃ yavagodhūmaśalinīm /
dadāti vedaviduṣe yaḥ sa bhūyo na jāyate //
meaning:
इक्षुभिः संततां भुमिं यवगोधूमशलिनीम् /
ददाति वेदविदुषे यः स भूयो न जायते //
text_mt: He who gives to a knower of the Vedas land covered with sugarcane / and rich in barley and wheat is not born again.

sanskrit_iast:
gocarmamātrāmapi vā yo bhūmiṃ saṃprayacchati /
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
गोचर्ममात्रामपि वा यो भूमिं संप्रयच्छति /
ब्राह्मणाय दरिद्राय सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: He who presents even a cow-hide measure of land / to a poor Brāhmaṇa is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidānāt paraṃ dānaṃ vidyate neha kiñcana /
annadānaṃ tena tulyaṃ vidyādānaṃ tato 'dhikam //
meaning:
भूमिदानात् परं दानं विद्यते नेह किञ्चन /
अन्नदानं तेन तुल्यं विद्यादानं ततो ऽधिकम् //
text_mt: No gift in this world is superior to a gift of land; / the gift of food is equal to it, and the gift of knowledge is greater still.

sanskrit_iast:
yo brāhmaṇāya śāntāya śucaye dharmaśāline /
dadāti vidyāṃ vidhinā brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
यो ब्राह्मणाय शान्ताय शुचये धर्मशालिने /
ददाति विद्यां विधिना ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: He who gives knowledge according to rule to a peaceful, / pure, and righteous Brāhmaṇa is exalted in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādaharahastvannaṃ śraddhayā brahmacāriṇe /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaṇaḥ sthānamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
दद्यादहरहस्त्वन्नं श्रद्धया ब्रह्मचारिणे /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणः स्थानमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Day by day one should give food with faith to a student of the Vedas; / freed from all sins, he attains the abode of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthāyānnadānena phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ /
āmamevāsya dātavyaṃ dattvāpnoti parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
गृहस्थायान्नदानेन फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः /
आममेवास्य दातव्यं दत्त्वाप्नोति परां गतिम् //
text_mt: By giving food to a householder, a man attains a reward; / raw [food] alone should be given to him, and having given it, he attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā /
upoṣya vidhinā śāntaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
वैशाख्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु ब्राह्मणान् सप्त पञ्च वा /
उपोष्य विधिना शान्तः शुचिः प्रयतमानसः //
text_mt: On the full moon of Vaiśākha, having fasted according to rule, peaceful, / pure, and restrained in mind, [approaching] five or seven Brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā tilaiḥ kṛṣṇairmadhunā na viśeṣataḥ /
gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya vācayed vā svyaṃ vadet //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा तिलैः कृष्णैर्मधुना न विशेषतः /
गन्धादिभिः समभ्यर्च्य वाचयेद् वा स्व्यं वदेत् //
text_mt: and having honoured them especially with black sesame seeds and honey, / worshipping them with perfumes and other offerings, he should recite or say himself:

sanskrit_iast:
prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti yad vā manasi vartate /
yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati //
meaning:
प्रीयतां धर्मराजेति यद् वा मनसि वर्तते /
यावज्जीवकृतं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति //
text_mt: “May the King of Justice be pleased,” or whatever is in his heart; / the sin committed throughout his life is destroyed that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛttvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī /
dadāti yastu viprāya sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam //
meaning:
कृष्णाजिने तिलान् कृत्त्वा हिरण्यं मधुसर्पिषी /
ददाति यस्तु विप्राय सर्वं तरति दुष्कृतम् //
text_mt: He who, having placed sesame seeds, gold, honey, and clarified butter on a black antelope skin, / gives it to a Brāhmaṇa, overcomes all wrongdoing.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtānnamudakumbhaṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ /
nirdiśya dharmarājāya viprebhyo mucyate bhayāt //
meaning:
कृतान्नमुदकुम्भं च वैशाख्यां च विशेषतः /
निर्दिश्य धर्मराजाय विप्रेभ्यो मुच्यते भयात् //
text_mt: Especially on the full moon of Vaiśākha, having dedicated cooked food / and a water-jar to the King of Justice, [and giving them] to Brāhmaṇas, he is freed from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇatilayuktaistu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā /
tarpayedudapātraistu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
सुवर्णतिलयुक्तैस्तु ब्राह्मणान् सप्त पञ्च वा /
तर्पयेदुदपात्रैस्तु ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: One who gratifies five or seven Brāhmaṇas / with water-vessels together with gold and sesame seeds dispels the killing of a Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
māghamāse tu viprastu dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ /
śuklāmvaradharaḥ kṛṣṇaistilairhutvā hutāśanam //
meaning:
माघमासे तु विप्रस्तु द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः /
शुक्लाम्वरधरः कृष्णैस्तिलैर्हुत्वा हुताशनम् //
text_mt: In the month of Māgha, having fasted on the twelfth day, / wearing white garments, offering black sesame seeds into the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu tilāneva samāhitaḥ /
janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ tarati vai dvijaḥ //
meaning:
प्रदद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु तिलानेव समाहितः /
जन्मप्रभृति यत्पापं सर्वं तरति वै द्विजः //
text_mt: a twice-born should attentively give only sesame seeds to Brāhmaṇas; / he indeed overcomes all sin committed since birth.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyāmanuprāpya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine /
yatkicid devadeveśaṃ dadyāccoddiśya śaṅkaram //
meaning:
अमावस्यामनुप्राप्य ब्राह्मणाय तपस्विने /
यत्किचिद् देवदेवेशं दद्याच्चोद्दिश्य शङ्करम् //
text_mt: When the new moon arrives, whatever one might give to an ascetic Brāhmaṇa, / dedicating it to Śaṅkara, the lord of the god of gods, [with the words:]

sanskrit_iast:
prīyatāmīśvaraḥ somo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ /
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati //
meaning:
प्रीयतामीश्वरः सोमो महादेवः सनातनः /
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति //
text_mt: “May the Lord, Soma, the eternal Mahādeva, be pleased,” / the sin committed across seven births is destroyed that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam /
ārādhayed dvijamukhe na tasyāsti punarbhavaḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा देवं पिनाकिनम् /
आराधयेद् द्विजमुखे न तस्यास्ति पुनर्भवः //
text_mt: He who, having bathed on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / worships the bow-wielding god through the mouth of a twice-born, has no rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhārmikāya dvijātaye /
snātvābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषेण धार्मिकाय द्विजातये /
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं पादप्रक्षालनादिभिः //
text_mt: Especially on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, to a righteous twice-born, / having bathed and worshipped according to rule with washing of the feet and other rites,

sanskrit_iast:
prīyatāṃ me mahādevo dadyād dravyaṃ svakīyakam /
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
प्रीयतां मे महादेवो दद्याद् द्रव्यं स्वकीयकम् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: [saying,] “May Mahādeva be pleased with me,” he should give his own wealth; / freed from all sins, he attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaiḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
amāvāsyāyāṃ bhaktaistu pūjanīyastrilocanaḥ //
meaning:
द्विजैः कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषतः /
अमावास्यायां भक्तैस्तु पूजनीयस्त्रिलोचनः //
text_mt: The three-eyed god should be worshipped by devotees among the twice-born / especially on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, on the eighth of the dark fortnight, and on the new moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam /
arcayed bāhmaṇamukhe sa gacchet paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
एकादश्यां निराहारो द्वादश्यां पुरुषोत्तमम् /
अर्चयेद् बाह्मणमुखे स गच्छेत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Fasting on the eleventh day, he who worships the Supreme Spirit on the twelfth day / through the mouth of a Brāhmaṇa goes to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā tithirvaiṣṇavīṃ syād dvādaśī śuklapakṣake /
tasyāmārādhayed devaṃ prayatnena janārdanam //
meaning:
एषा तिथिर्वैष्णवीं स्याद् द्वादशी शुक्लपक्षके /
तस्यामाराधयेद् देवं प्रयत्नेन जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: This twelfth day in the bright fortnight is sacred to Viṣṇu; / on it one should worship the divine Janārdana with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiñcid devamīśānamuddiśya brāhmaṇe śucau /
dīyate viṣṇave vāpi tadanantaphalapradam //
meaning:
यत्किञ्चिद् देवमीशानमुद्दिश्य ब्राह्मणे शुचौ /
दीयते विष्णवे वापि तदनन्तफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Whatever is given to a pure Brāhmaṇa, / dedicated to the divine Īśāna or to Viṣṇu, grants infinite fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
yo hi yāṃ devatāmicchet samārādhayituṃ naraḥ /
brāhmaṇān pūjayed yatnāt satasyāṃ toṣayet tataḥ //
meaning:
यो हि यां देवतामिच्छेत् समाराधयितुं नरः /
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेद् यत्नात् सतस्यां तोषयेत् ततः //
text_mt: Whatever deity a man wishes to worship, / he should diligently worship Brāhmaṇas; thereby he pleases that [deity].

sanskrit_iast:
dvijānāṃ vapurāsthāya nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ /
pūjyante brāhmaṇālābhe pratimādiṣvapi kvacit //
meaning:
द्विजानां वपुरास्थाय नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति देवताः /
पूज्यन्ते ब्राह्मणालाभे प्रतिमादिष्वपि क्वचित् //
text_mt: Taking the bodies of the twice-born, deities reside constantly; / in the absence of a Brāhmaṇa, they are sometimes worshipped in images and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tat tat phalamabhīpsatā /
dvijeṣu devatā nityaṃ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत् तत् फलमभीप्सता /
द्विजेषु देवता नित्यं पूजनीया विशेषतः //
text_mt: Therefore, by one desiring this or that fruit with every effort, / the deities should constantly be worshipped especially in the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhūtikāmaḥ satataṃ pūjayed vai purandaram /
brahmavarcasakāmastu brahmāṇaṃ brahmakāmukaḥ //
meaning:
विभूतिकामः सततं पूजयेद् वै पुरन्दरम् /
ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्तु ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मकामुकः //
text_mt: One who desires prosperity should constantly worship Purandara; / one who desires Vedic splendor should worship Brahmā; one who desires Brahman [should worship Brahmā];

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyakāmo 'tha raviṃ dhanakāmo hutāśanam /
karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu pūjayed vai vināyakam //
meaning:
आरोग्यकामो ऽथ रविं धनकामो हुताशनम् /
कर्मणां सिद्धिकामस्तु पूजयेद् वै विनायकम् //
text_mt: one who desires health, the Sun; one who desires wealth, Fire; / one who desires the success of undertakings should worship Vināyaka;

sanskrit_iast:
bhogakāmastu śaśinaṃ balakāmaḥ samīraṇam /
mumukṣuḥ sarvasaṃsārāt prayatnenārcayeddharim //
meaning:
भोगकामस्तु शशिनं बलकामः समीरणम् /
मुमुक्षुः सर्वसंसारात् प्रयत्नेनार्चयेद्धरिम् //
text_mt: one who desires enjoyment, the Moon; one who desires strength, the Wind; / a seeker of liberation from all worldly existence should worship Hari with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu yogaṃ tathā mokṣamanvicchejjñānamaiśvaram /
sor'cayed vai virūpākṣaṃ prayatneneśvareśvaram //
meaning:
यस्तु योगं तथा मोक्षमन्विच्छेज्ज्ञानमैश्वरम् /
सोर्ऽचयेद् वै विरूपाक्षं प्रयत्नेनेश्वरेश्वरम् //
text_mt: He who seeks yoga, liberation, and divine knowledge / should diligently worship the odd-eyed god, the lord of lords.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vāñchanti mahāyogān jñānāni ca maheśvaram /
te pūjayanti bhūteśaṃ keśavaṃ cāpi bhoginaḥ //
meaning:
ये वाञ्छन्ति महायोगान् ज्ञानानि च महेश्वरम् /
ते पूजयन्ति भूतेशं केशवं चापि भोगिनः //
text_mt: Those who desire great yogas and knowledge worship Maheśvara, / the lord of beings, while enjoyers worship Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
vāridastṛptimāpnoti sukhamakṣayyamannadaḥ /
tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam //
meaning:
वारिदस्तृप्तिमाप्नोति सुखमक्षय्यमन्नदः /
तिलप्रदः प्रजामिष्टां दीपदश्चक्षुरुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The giver of water attains satisfaction; the giver of food, imperishable happiness; / the giver of sesame seeds, desirable offspring; the giver of a lamp, excellent sight.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmidaḥ sarvamāpnoti dīrghamāyurhiraṇyadaḥ /
gṛhado 'gryāṇi veśmāni rūpyado rūpamuttamam //
meaning:
भूमिदः सर्वमाप्नोति दीर्घमायुर्हिरण्यदः /
गृहदो ऽग्र्याणि वेश्मानि रूप्यदो रूपमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The giver of land attains everything; the giver of gold, long life; / the giver of a house, superior dwellings; the giver of silver, excellent beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsodaścandrasālokyamaśvisālokyamaśvadaḥ /
anaḍudaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo vradhnasya viṣṭapam //
meaning:
वासोदश्चन्द्रसालोक्यमश्विसालोक्यमश्वदः /
अनडुदः श्रियं पुष्टां गोदो व्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् //
text_mt: The giver of clothing [attains] residence in the realm of the Moon; the giver of a horse, residence in the realm of the Aśvins; / the giver of an ox, abundant prosperity; the giver of a cow, the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yānaśayyāprado bhāryāmaiśvaryamabhayapradaḥ /
dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahmasātmyatām //
meaning:
यानशय्याप्रदो भार्यामैश्वर्यमभयप्रदः /
धान्यदः शाश्वतं सौख्यं ब्रह्मदो ब्रह्मसात्म्यताम् //
text_mt: The giver of a vehicle and a bed [attains] a wife; the giver of security, sovereignty; / the giver of grain, eternal happiness; the giver of the Veda, oneness with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
dhānyānyapi yathāśakti vipreṣu pratipādayet /
vedavitsu viśiṣṭeṣu pretya svargaṃ samaśnute //
meaning:
धान्यान्यपि यथाशक्ति विप्रेषु प्रतिपादयेत् /
वेदवित्सु विशिष्टेषु प्रेत्य स्वर्गं समश्नुते //
text_mt: One should also bestow grains according to one's ability on Brāhmaṇas; / [giving them] to distinguished knowers of the Veda, one enjoys heaven after death.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ ghāsapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
indhanānāṃ pradānena dīptāgnirjāyate naraḥ //
meaning:
गवां घासप्रदानेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
इन्धनानां प्रदानेन दीप्ताग्निर्जायते नरः //
text_mt: By giving grass to cows, one is freed from all sins; / by giving firewood, a man becomes endowed with a blazing digestive fire.

sanskrit_iast:
phalamūlāni śākāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca /
pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu mudā yuktaḥ sadā bhavet //
meaning:
फलमूलानि शाकानि भोज्यानि विविधानि च /
प्रदद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु मुदा युक्तः सदा भवेत् //
text_mt: Fruits, roots, vegetables, and various types of food / one should give to Brāhmaṇas; he will always remain filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ rogiṇe rogaśāntaye /
dadāno rogarahitaḥ sukhī dīrghāyureva ca //
meaning:
औषधं स्नेहमाहारं रोगिणे रोगशान्तये /
ददानो रोगरहितः सुखी दीर्घायुरेव च //
text_mt: One who gives medicine, oil, and food to a sick person to alleviate illness / becomes free from illness, happy, and long-lived.

sanskrit_iast:
asipatravanaṃ mārgaṃ kṣuradhārāsamanvitam /
tīvritāpaṃ ca tarati chatropānatprado naraḥ //
meaning:
असिपत्रवनं मार्गं क्षुरधारासमन्वितम् /
तीव्रितापं च तरति छत्रोपानत्प्रदो नरः //
text_mt: A man who gives an umbrella and sandals crosses the path / of the Forest of Sword-like Leaves, sharp with razor edges and intensely scorching.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi dayitaṃ gṛhe /
tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣyamicchatā //
meaning:
यद् यदिष्टतमं लोके यच्चापि दयितं गृहे /
तत्तद् गुणवते देयं तदेवाक्ष्यमिच्छता //
text_mt: Whatever is most cherished in the world, and whatever is beloved in the home, / that should be given to a virtuous person by one desiring it to be imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
apane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ /
saṃkrāntyādiṣu kāleṣu dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam //
meaning:
अपने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः /
संक्रान्त्यादिषु कालेषु दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: At the solstice and the equinox, during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / and at times such as the transition of the sun, what is given becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca /
dattvā cākṣayamāpnoti nadīṣu ca vaneṣu ca //
meaning:
प्रयागादिषु तीर्थेषु पुण्येष्वायतनेषु च /
दत्त्वा चाक्षयमाप्नोति नदीषु च वनेषु च //
text_mt:
And by giving at holy sites such as Prayāga, at sacred temples,
at rivers, and in forests, one attains imperishable [fruit].

sanskrit_iast:
