dānadharmāt paro dharmo bhūtānāṃ neha vidyate /
tasmād viprāya dātavyaṃ śrotriyāya dvijātibhiḥ //
meaning:
दानधर्मात् परो धर्मो भूतानां नेह विद्यते /
तस्माद् विप्राय दातव्यं श्रोत्रियाय द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt:
There is no higher duty for living beings here than the duty of giving;
therefore, twice-born people must give to a learned brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
svagāyurbhūtikāmena tathā pāpopaśāntaye /
mumukṣuṇā ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathānvaham //
meaning:
स्वगायुर्भूतिकामेन तथा पापोपशान्तये /
मुमुक्षुणा च दातव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तथान्वहम् //
text_mt:
By one desiring heaven, long life, and prosperity, as well as for the appeasement of sin,
and by a mumukṣu, gifts must thus be given daily to brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dīyamānaṃ tu yo mohād goviprāgnisureṣu ca /
nivārayati pāpātmā tiryagyoniṃ vrajet tu saḥ //
meaning:
दीयमानं तु यो मोहाद् गोविप्राग्निसुरेषु च /
निवारयति पापात्मा तिर्यग्योनिं व्रजेत् तु सः //
text_mt:
But that wicked person who, through delusion, obstructs [a gift]
being given to cows, brāhmaṇas, fire, or the gods, goes to an animal womb.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā nārcayed brāhmaṇān surān /
sarvasvamapahṛtyainaṃ rājā rāṣṭrāt pravāsayet //
meaning:
यस्तु द्रव्यार्जनं कृत्वा नार्चयेद् ब्राह्मणान् सुरान् /
सर्वस्वमपहृत्यैनं राजा राष्ट्रात् प्रवासयेत् //
text_mt:
The king should confiscate all the wealth of him who, having acquired property,
does not honour brāhmaṇas and gods, and banish him from the realm.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu durbhikṣavelāyāmannādyaṃ na prayacchati /
mriyamāṇeṣu vipreṣu brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu garhitaḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु दुर्भिक्षवेलायामन्नाद्यं न प्रयच्छति /
म्रियमाणेषु विप्रेषु ब्राह्मणः स तु गर्हितः //
text_mt:
But that brāhmaṇa who does not give food in a time of famine,
when vipras are dying, is truly contemptible.

sanskrit_iast:
na tasmāt pratigṛhṇīyurna viśeyuśca tena hi /
aṅkayitvā svakād rāṣṭrāt taṃ rājā vipravāsayet //
meaning:
न तस्मात् प्रतिगृह्णीयुर्न विशेयुश्च तेन हि /
अङ्कयित्वा स्वकाद् राष्ट्रात् तं राजा विप्रवासयेत् //
text_mt:
One should not receive [anything] from him, nor should they enter [communion] with him;
having branded him, the king should banish him from his kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvasadbhyo dadātīha svadravyaṃ dharmasādhanam /
sa pūrvābhyadhikaḥ pāpī narake pacyate naraḥ //
meaning:
यस्त्वसद्भ्यो ददातीह स्वद्रव्यं धर्मसाधनम् /
स पूर्वाभ्यधिकः पापी नरके पच्यते नरः //
text_mt:
He who gives here to unworthy men his own property, which is a means for [accomplishing] duty,
that sinful man, worse than the former, is cooked in hell.

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyavanto ye viprā vidyāvanto jitendriyāḥ /
satyasaṃyamasaṃyuktāstebhyo dadyād dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
स्वाध्यायवन्तो ये विप्रा विद्यावन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः /
सत्यसंयमसंयुक्तास्तेभ्यो दद्याद् द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
To those vipras who recite the sacred texts, possess knowledge, have mastered their senses,
and are endowed with truth and self-restraint, to them one should give, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
subhuktamapi vidvāṃsaṃ dhārmikaṃ bhojayed dvijam /
na tu mūrkhamavṛttasthaṃ daśarātramupoṣitam //
meaning:
सुभुक्तमपि विद्वांसं धार्मिकं भोजयेद् द्विजम् /
न तु मूर्खमवृत्तस्थं दशरात्रमुपोषितम् //
text_mt:
One should feed a learned, virtuous twice-born even if he has already eaten well,
but never a fool who lives unrighteously, even if he has fasted for ten nights.

sanskrit_iast:
sannikṛṣṭamatikramya śrotriyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati /
sa tena karmaṇā pāpī dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam //
meaning:
सन्निकृष्टमतिक्रम्य श्रोत्रियं यः प्रयच्छति /
स तेन कर्मणा पापी दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम् //
text_mt:
He who passes over a nearby Vedic scholar and gives [elsewhere],
that sinner, by that deed, burns his family up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
yadisyādadhiko vipraḥ śīlavidyādibhiḥ svayam /
tasmai yatnena dātavyaṃ atikramyāpi sannidhim //
meaning:
यदिस्यादधिको विप्रः शीलविद्यादिभिः स्वयम् /
तस्मै यत्नेन दातव्यं अतिक्रम्यापि सन्निधिम् //
text_mt:
If a vipra should himself be superior in good conduct, learning, and the like,
to him [the gift] should be given with effort, even passing over someone nearby.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇīyād dadyādarcitameva ca /
tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye //
meaning:
यो ऽर्चितं प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् दद्यादर्चितमेव च /
तावुभौ गच्छतः स्वर्गं नरकं तु विपर्यये //
text_mt:
He who receives what is honored, and he who gives with honor,
both of them go to heaven; in the reverse case, however, to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
na vāryapi prayaccheta nāstike haituke 'pi ca /
pāṣaṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu nāvedavidi dharmavit //
meaning:
न वार्यपि प्रयच्छेत नास्तिके हैतुके ऽपि च /
पाषण्डेषु च सर्वेषु नावेदविदि धर्मवित् //
text_mt:
He who knows duty should not give even water to a non-believer, nor to a rationalist skeptic,
nor to any heretics, nor to one who does not know the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
apūpaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca gāmaśvaṃ pṛthivīṃ tilān /
avidvān pratigṛhṇāno bhasmī bhavati kāṣṭhavat //
meaning:
अपूपं च हिरण्यं च गामश्वं पृथिवीं तिलान् /
अविद्वान् प्रतिगृह्णानो भस्मी भवति काष्ठवत् //
text_mt:
Accepting a cake, gold, a cow, a horse, land, or sesame seeds,
an unlearned man turns to ash like a piece of wood.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātibhyo dhanaṃ lipset praśastebhyo dvijottamaḥ /
api vā jātimātrebhyo na tu śūdrāt kathañcana //
meaning:
द्विजातिभ्यो धनं लिप्सेत् प्रशस्तेभ्यो द्विजोत्तमः /
अपि वा जातिमात्रेभ्यो न तु शूद्रात् कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
The best of the twice-born should desire wealth from commendable twice-born men,
or even from those twice-born merely by birth, but never from a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttisaṅkocamanvicchenneheta dhanavistaram /
dhanalobhe prasaktastu brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate //
meaning:
वृत्तिसङ्कोचमन्विच्छेन्नेहेत धनविस्तरम् /
धनलोभे प्रसक्तस्तु ब्राह्मण्यादेव हीयते //
text_mt:
He should seek contraction of his livelihood; he should not desire expansion of wealth,
for one who is attached to the greed for wealth falls away from his brāhmaṇahood itself.

sanskrit_iast:
vedānadhītya sakalān yajñāṃścāvāpya sarvaśaḥ /
na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti saṅkocād yāmavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
वेदानधीत्य सकलान् यज्ञांश्चावाप्य सर्वशः /
न तां गतिमवाप्नोति सङ्कोचाद् यामवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Having studied all the Vedas and performed sacrifices everywhere,
one does not attain that goal which one would attain through contraction [of desires].

sanskrit_iast:
pratigraharucirna syāt yātrārthaṃ tu samāharet /
sthityarthādadhikaṃ gṛhṇan brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatim //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहरुचिर्न स्यात् यात्रार्थं तु समाहरेत् /
स्थित्यर्थादधिकं गृह्णन् ब्राह्मणो यात्यधोगतिम् //
text_mt:
He should not take pleasure in receiving gifts; he should gather only for the sake of sustenance;
taking more than is necessary for subsistence, a brāhmaṇa falls to a low state.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu yācanako nityaṃ na sa svargasya bhājanam /
udvejayati bhūtāni yathā caurastathaiva saḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु याचनको नित्यं न स स्वर्गस्य भाजनम् /
उद्वेजयति भूतानि यथा चौरस्तथैव सः //
text_mt:
He who is constantly a beggar is not a recipient of heaven;
he distresses living beings, just as a thief does.

sanskrit_iast:
gurūn bhṛtyāṃścojjihīrṣurarciṣyan devatātithīn /
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
गुरून् भृत्यांश्चोज्जिहीर्षुरर्चिष्यन् देवतातिथीन् /
सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न तु तृप्येत् स्वयं ततः //
text_mt:
Desiring to support gurus and servants, and intending to honor gods and guests,
he may accept from all; but he should not himself be satisfied thereby.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gṛhastho yuktātmā devatātithipūjakaḥ /
vartamānaḥ saṃyātātmā yāti tat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
एवं गृहस्थो युक्तात्मा देवतातिथिपूजकः /
वर्तमानः संयातात्मा याति तत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Thus a householder, disciplined, worshipping deities and guests,
conducting himself with a controlled mind, reaches that supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
putre nidhāya vā sarvaṃ gatvāraṇyaṃ tu tattvavit /
ekākī vicarennityamudāsīnaḥ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रे निधाय वा सर्वं गत्वारण्यं तु तत्त्ववित् /
एकाकी विचरेन्नित्यमुदासीनः समाहितः //
text_mt:
Or, having placed everything upon his son and gone to the forest, knowing the true reality,
he should wander continually alone, indifferent, and concentrated in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vaḥ kathito dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ dvijottamāḥ /
jñātvānutiṣṭhenniyataṃ tathānuṣṭhāpayed dvijān //
meaning:
एष वः कथितो धर्मो गृहस्थानां द्विजोत्तमाः /
ज्ञात्वानुतिष्ठेन्नियतं तथानुष्ठापयेद् द्विजान् //
text_mt:
This duty of householders has been declared to you, O best of the twice-born;
having known it, one should perform it constantly, and likewise cause the twice-born to perform it.

sanskrit_iast:
iti devamanādimekamīśaṃ
gṛhadharmeṇa samarcayedajastram /
samatītya sa sarvabhūtayoniṃ
prakṛtiṃ yāti paraṃ na yāti janma //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति देवमनादिमेकमीशं
गृहधर्मेण समर्चयेदजस्त्रम् /
समतीत्य स सर्वभूतयोनिं
प्रकृतिं याति परं न याति जन्म //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus one should incessantly worship the one beginningless God, the Lord,
through the duty of the householder;
having transcended primordial matter, the womb of all beings, he reaches the Supreme and does not go to [re]birth.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā dvitīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ /
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchet sadāraḥ sāgnireva ca //
nikṣipya bhāryāṃ putreṣu gacched vanamathāpi vā /
dṛṣṭvāpatyasya cāpatyaṃ jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एवं गृहाश्रमे स्थित्वा द्वितीयं भागमायुषः /
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गच्छेत् सदारः साग्निरेव च //
निक्षिप्य भार्यां पुत्रेषु गच्छेद् वनमथापि वा /
दृष्ट्वापत्यस्य चापत्यं जर्जरीकृतविग्रहः //
title: saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having thus lived in the stage of a householder for the second part of one's life,
one should enter the stage of a forest hermit along with his wife and together with his sacred fire;
or, having entrusted his wife to his sons, he may go to the forest,
having seen the child of his child, with his body worn out by old age.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhne praśaste cottarāyaṇe /
gatvāraṇyaṃ niyamavāṃstapaḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षस्य पूर्वाह्ने प्रशस्ते चोत्तरायणे /
गत्वारण्यं नियमवांस्तपः कुर्यात् समाहितः //
text_mt:
In the forenoon of the bright fortnight, during the auspicious northern course of the sun,
having gone to the forest, observing vows, he should practice austerity, concentrated in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
phalamūlāni pūtāni nityamāhāramāharet /
yatāhāro bhavet tena pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ //
meaning:
फलमूलानि पूतानि नित्यमाहारमाहरेत् /
यताहारो भवेत् तेन पूजयेत् पितृदेवताः //
text_mt:
He should always gather pure fruits and roots for food;
he should be restrained in his food, and with that he should worship the ancestors and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvātithiṃ nityaṃ snātvā cābhyarcayet surān /
gṛhādāhṛtya cāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयित्वातिथिं नित्यं स्नात्वा चाभ्यर्चयेत् सुरान् /
गृहादाहृत्य चाश्नीयादष्टौ ग्रासान् समाहितः //
text_mt:
Having always honored a guest and having bathed, he should worship the gods;
and having brought [food] from a house, he should eat eight mouthfuls, collected in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāśca bibhṛyānnityaṃ nakharomāṇi notsṛjet /
svādhyāyaṃ sarvadā kuryānniyacched vācamanyataḥ //
meaning:
जटाश्च बिभृयान्नित्यं नखरोमाणि नोत्सृजेत् /
स्वाध्यायं सर्वदा कुर्यान्नियच्छेद् वाचमन्यतः //
text_mt:
He should constantly wear matted hair and should not cut his nails and hair;
he should always engage in recitation of the sacred texts and restrain his speech from everything else.

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraṃ ca juhuyāt pañcayajñān samācaret /
munyannaiṃrvividhairmedhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रं च जुहुयात् पञ्चयज्ञान् समाचरेत् /
मुन्यन्नैंर्विविधैर्मेध्यैः शाकमूलफलेन वा //
text_mt:
He should perform the daily fire offering and carry out the five daily sacrifices,
with various pure hermit foods, or with vegetables, roots, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
cīravāsā bhavennityaṃ snāyāt triṣavaṇaṃ śuciḥ /
sarvabhūtānukampī syāt pratigrahavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
चीरवासा भवेन्नित्यं स्नायात् त्रिषवणं शुचिः /
सर्वभूतानुकम्पी स्यात् प्रतिग्रहविवर्जितः //
text_mt:
He should always wear rags or bark, bathe at the three junctures of the day, pure;
he should be compassionate to all beings, and free from accepting gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
darśena paurṇamāsena yajet niyataṃ dvijaḥ /
ṛkṣeṣvāgrayaṇe caiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet /
uttarāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dakṣasyāyanameva ca //
meaning:
दर्शेन पौर्णमासेन यजेत् नियतं द्विजः /
ऋक्षेष्वाग्रयणे चैव चातुर्मास्यानि चाहरेत् /
उत्तरायणं च क्रमशो दक्षस्यायनमेव च //
text_mt:
A twice-born should regularly sacrifice with the new-moon and full-moon rites,
and he should perform the sacrifice of first fruits under the asterisms, and the four-month rites,
and gradually during the northern course and the southern course of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsantaiḥ śāradairmedhyairmunyannaiḥ svayamāhṛtaiḥ /
puroḍāśāṃścarūṃścaiva vidhivannirvapet pṛthak //
meaning:
वासन्तैः शारदैर्मेध्यैर्मुन्यन्नैः स्वयमाहृतैः /
पुरोडाशांश्चरूंश्चैव विधिवन्निर्वपेत् पृथक् //
text_mt:
With pure hermit-foods of spring and autumn gathered by himself,
he should separately offer sacrificial cakes and boiled rice offerings according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
devatābhyaśca tad hutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ /
śeṣaṃ samupabhuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
देवताभ्यश्च तद् हुत्वा वन्यं मेध्यतरं हविः /
शेषं समुपभुञ्जीत लवणं च स्वयं कृतम् //
text_mt:
And having offered that most pure wild oblation to the deities,
he should consume the remainder, along with salt made by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
varjayenmadhumāṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca /
bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukaṃ caiva śleṣmātakaphalāni ca //
meaning:
वर्जयेन्मधुमांसानि भौमानि कवकानि च /
भूस्तृणं शिग्रुकं चैव श्लेष्मातकफलानि च //
text_mt:
He should avoid honey and meat, mushrooms that grow from the earth,
fragrant grass, moringa, and śleṣmātaka fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
na phālakṛṣṭamaśnīyādutsṛṣṭamapi kenacit /
na grāmajātānyārto 'pi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca //
meaning:
न फालकृष्टमश्नीयादुत्सृष्टमपि केनचित् /
न ग्रामजातान्यार्तो ऽपि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च //
text_mt:
He should not eat what has been plowed by a plowshare, even if discarded by someone,
nor fruits and flowers that have grown in a village, even if he is distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇenaiva vidhinā vahniṃ paricaret sadā /
na druhyet sarvabhūtāni nirdvandvo nirbhayo bhavet //
meaning:
श्रावणेनैव विधिना वह्निं परिचरेत् सदा /
न द्रुह्येत् सर्वभूतानि निर्द्वन्द्वो निर्भयो भवेत् //
text_mt:
He should constantly attend to the fire according to the Śrāvaṇa rule;
he should not injure any beings, and he should be free from dualities and free from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
na naktaṃ kiñcidaśnīyād rātrau dhyānaparo bhavet /
jitendriyo jitakrodhastattvajñānavicintakaḥ /
brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ na patnīmapi saṃśrayet //
meaning:
न नक्तं किञ्चिदश्नीयाद् रात्रौ ध्यानपरो भवेत् /
जितेन्द्रियो जितक्रोधस्तत्त्वज्ञानविचिन्तकः /
ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्नित्यं न पत्नीमपि संश्रयेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
yastu patnyā vanaṃ gatvā maithunaṃ kāmataścaret /
tad vrataṃ tasya lupyeta prāyaścittīyate dvijaḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु पत्न्या वनं गत्वा मैथुनं कामतश्चरेत् /
तद् व्रतं तस्य लुप्येत प्रायश्चित्तीयते द्विजः //
text_mt:
If one who has gone to the forest with his wife should engage in sexual intercourse through desire,
that vow of his would be broken, and the twice-born must perform an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yo jāyate garbho na saṃspṛśyo dvijātibhiḥ /
na hi vede 'dhikāro 'sya tadvaṃśepyevameva hi //
meaning:
तत्र यो जायते गर्भो न संस्पृश्यो द्विजातिभिः /
न हि वेदे ऽधिकारो ऽस्य तद्वंशेप्येवमेव हि //
text_mt:
The child that is born there is not to be touched by the twice-born;
for he has no right to the Veda, and the same holds true for his lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ śayīta satataṃ sāvitrījāpyatatparaḥ /
śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃvibhāgaparaḥ sadā //
meaning:
अधः शयीत सततं सावित्रीजाप्यतत्परः /
शरण्यः सर्वभूतानां संविभागपरः सदा //
text_mt:
He should constantly sleep on the ground, devoted to the chanting of the Sāvitrī,
a refuge for all beings, always intent on sharing [with others].

sanskrit_iast:
parivādaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ nidrālasyaṃ vivarjayet /
ekāgniraniketaḥ syāt prokṣitāṃ bhūmimāśrayet //
meaning:
परिवादं मृषावादं निद्रालस्यं विवर्जयेत् /
एकाग्निरनिकेतः स्यात् प्रोक्षितां भूमिमाश्रयेत् //
text_mt:
He should avoid slander, falsehood, sleep, and laziness;
he should maintain a single fire, be homeless, and resort to sprinkled ground.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaiḥ saha cared vāsaṃ taiḥ sahaiva ca saṃvaset /
śilāyāṃ śarkarāyāṃ vā śayīta susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
मृगैः सह चरेद् वासं तैः सहैव च संवसेत् /
शिलायां शर्करायां वा शयीत सुसमाहितः //
text_mt:
He should move about dwelling with deer, and he should dwell together with them;
he should sleep on a flat rock or gravel, perfectly collected in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syānmāsasaṃcayiko 'pi vā /
ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syāt samānicaya eva vā //
meaning:
सद्यः प्रक्षालको वा स्यान्माससंचयिको ऽपि वा /
षण्मासनिचयो वा स्यात् समानिचय एव वा //
text_mt:
He may wash [his food] immediately, or store for a month,
or he may store for six months, or store for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
tyajedāśvayuje māsi saṃpannaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam /
jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni ca //
meaning:
त्यजेदाश्वयुजे मासि संपन्नं पूर्वसंचितम् /
जीर्णानि चैव वासांसि शाकमूलफलानि च //
text_mt:
In the month of Āśvayuja, he should discard what was previously collected and accumulated,
as well as worn-out clothes, vegetables, roots, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
dantolūkhaliko vāsyāt kāpotīṃ vṛttimāśrayet /
aśmakuṭṭo bhaved vāpi kālapakvabhugeva vā //
meaning:
दन्तोलूखलिको वास्यात् कापोतीं वृत्तिमाश्रयेत् /
अश्मकुट्टो भवेद् वापि कालपक्वभुगेव वा //
text_mt:
He may use his teeth as a mortar, or adopt the lifestyle of pigeons,
or he may be a pounder with stones, or eat only what is ripened by time.

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ cānna samaśnīyād divā cāhṛtya śaktitaḥ /
caturthakāliko vā syāt syādvāpyaṣṭamakālikaḥ //
meaning:
नक्तं चान्न समश्नीयाद् दिवा चाहृत्य शक्तितः /
चतुर्थकालिको वा स्यात् स्याद्वाप्यष्टमकालिकः //
text_mt:
He should eat food at night, having gathered it during the day according to his ability;
or he may eat at every fourth meal-time, or even at every eighth meal-time.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇavidhānairvā śukle kṛṣṇe ca vartayet /
pakṣe pakṣe samaśnīyād yavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणविधानैर्वा शुक्ले कृष्णे च वर्तयेत् /
पक्षे पक्षे समश्नीयाद् यवागूं क्वथितां सकृत् //
text_mt:
Or he may subsist according to the rules of the Cāndrāyaṇa penance during the bright and dark fortnights;
he may eat boiled barley gruel once in each fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamūlaphalairvāpi kevalairvartayet sadā /
svābhāvikaiḥ svayaṃ śīrṇairvaikhānasamate sthitaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पमूलफलैर्वापि केवलैर्वर्तयेत् सदा /
स्वाभाविकैः स्वयं शीर्णैर्वैखानसमते स्थितः //
text_mt:
He may also sustain himself always on flowers, roots, and fruits alone,
naturally fallen of their own accord, adhering to the Vaikhānasa doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau vā parivarteta tiṣṭhed vā prapadairdinam /
sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharenna kvacid dhairyamutsṛjet //
meaning:
भूमौ वा परिवर्तेत तिष्ठेद् वा प्रपदैर्दिनम् /
स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरेन्न क्वचिद् धैर्यमुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt:
He may roll upon the earth, or remain on the tips of his feet for a day;
he should pass his time standing and sitting, and never abandon fortitude.

sanskrit_iast:
grīṣme pañcatapāśca syād varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ /
ārdravāsāstu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃstapaḥ //
meaning:
ग्रीष्मे पञ्चतपाश्च स्याद् वर्षास्वभ्रावकाशकः /
आर्द्रवासास्तु हेमन्ते क्रमशो वर्धयंस्तपः //
text_mt:
In summer he should practice the five fires, in the rainy seasons remain exposed to the clouds,
and in the cold season wear wet clothes, gradually increasing his ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśya triṣavaṇaṃ pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet /
ekapādena tiṣṭheta marīcīn vā pibet tadā //
meaning:
उपस्पृश्य त्रिषवणं पितृदेवांश्च तर्पयेत् /
एकपादेन तिष्ठेत मरीचीन् वा पिबेत् तदा //
text_mt:
Having bathed at the three junctures of the day, he should offer libations to the ancestors and gods;
he should stand on one foot, or then drink rays [of the sun].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāgnirdhūmapo vā syāduṣmapaḥ somapo 'pi vā /
payaḥ pibecchuklapakṣe kṛṣṇāpakṣe tu gomayam /
śīrṇaparṇāśano vā syāt kṛcchrair vā vartayet sadā //
meaning:
पञ्चाग्निर्धूमपो वा स्यादुष्मपः सोमपो ऽपि वा /
पयः पिबेच्छुक्लपक्षे कृष्णापक्षे तु गोमयम् /
शीर्णपर्णाशनो वा स्यात् कृच्छ्रैर् वा वर्तयेत् सदा //

sanskrit_iast:
yogābhyāsarataśca syād rudrādhyāyī bhavet sadā /
atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā vedāntābhyāsatatparaḥ //
meaning:
योगाभ्यासरतश्च स्याद् रुद्राध्यायी भवेत् सदा /
अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता वेदान्ताभ्यासतत्परः //
text_mt:
He should be devoted to the practice of yoga and always recite the Śatarudrīya;
he should study the Atharvaśiras Upaniṣad, devoted to the practice of Vedānta.

sanskrit_iast:
yamān seveta satataṃ niyamāṃścāpyatandritaḥ /
kṛṣṇājinī sottarīyaḥ śuklayajñopavītavān //
meaning:
यमान् सेवेत सततं नियमांश्चाप्यतन्द्रितः /
कृष्णाजिनी सोत्तरीयः शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतवान् //
text_mt:
He should constantly observe the restraints and observances without sloth,
wearing a black antelope skin and an upper garment, possessing a white sacrificial thread.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cāgnīn samāropya svātmani dhyānatatparaḥ /
anagniraniketaḥ syānmunirmokṣaparo bhavet //
meaning:
अथ चाग्नीन् समारोप्य स्वात्मनि ध्यानतत्परः /
अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्मुनिर्मोक्षपरो भवेत् //
text_mt:
Then, having deposited the fires within himself, intent upon meditation,
fireless and homeless, a silent sage, he should become intent upon liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tāpaseṣveva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣamāharet /
gṛhamedhiṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu //
meaning:
तापसेष्वेव विप्रेषु यात्रिकं भैक्षमाहरेत् /
गृहमेधिषु चान्येषु द्विजेषु वनवासिषु //
text_mt:
He should collect only as much alms as is needed for sustenance among ascetic brāhmaṇas,
householders, and other twice-born forest dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmādāhṛtya vāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān vane vasan /
pratigṛhya puṭenaiva pāṇinā śakalena vā //
meaning:
ग्रामादाहृत्य वाश्नीयादष्टौ ग्रासान् वने वसन् /
प्रतिगृह्य पुटेनैव पाणिना शकलेन वा //
text_mt:
Or, dwelling in the forest, he should eat eight mouthfuls brought from a village,
receiving them in a leaf-cup, in his bare hand, or in an earthen potsherd.

sanskrit_iast:
vividhāścopaniṣada ātmasaṃsiddhaye japet /
vidyāviśeṣān sāvitrīṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
विविधाश्चोपनिषद आत्मसंसिद्धये जपेत् /
विद्याविशेषान् सावित्रीं रुद्राध्यायं तथैव च //
text_mt:
For the perfection of the Self he should softly recite various Upaniṣads,
special forms of sacred knowledge, the Sāvitrī mantra, and likewise the Śatarudrīya.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāprāsthānikaṃ cāsau kuryādanaśanaṃ tu vā /
agnipraveśamanyad vā brarhmārpaṇavidhau sthitaḥ //
meaning:
महाप्रास्थानिकं चासौ कुर्यादनशनं तु वा /
अग्निप्रवेशमन्यद् वा ब्रर्ह्मार्पणविधौ स्थितः //
text_mt:
And he may undertake the Great Departure, or fasting unto death,
or entry into fire, or another [death], established in the rite of dedicating all to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu samyagimamāśramaṃ śivaṃ
saṃśrayedaśivapuñjanāśanam /
tāpasaḥ sa paramaiśvaraṃ padaṃ
yāti yatra jagato 'sya saṃsthitiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptaviśo 'dhyāya
meaning:
यस्तु सम्यगिममाश्रमं शिवं
संश्रयेदशिवपुञ्जनाशनम् /
तापसः स परमैश्वरं पदं
याति यत्र जगतो ऽस्य संस्थितिः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सप्तविशो ऽध्याय
text_mt:
The ascetic who properly resorts to this auspicious stage of life,
which destroys the mass of inauspiciousness,
goes to the supreme state of the Lord,
wherein lies the foundation of this world.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evaṃ vanāśrame sthitvā tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ /
caturthamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ saṃnyāsena nayet kramāt //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एवं वनाश्रमे स्थित्वा तृतीयं भागमायुषः /
चतुर्थमायुषो भागं संन्यासेन नयेत् क्रमात् //
title: aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
Having thus lived in the forest stage of life for the third portion of one's lifespan,
one should duly spend the fourth portion of life in renunciation.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīnātmanī saṃsthāpya dvijaḥ pravrajito bhavet /
yogābhyāsarataḥ śānto brahmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अग्नीनात्मनी संस्थाप्य द्विजः प्रव्रजितो भवेत् /
योगाभ्यासरतः शान्तो ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणः //
text_mt:
Having placed the sacred fires within himself, a twice-born should become a mendicant,
devoted to the practice of yoga, tranquil, intent upon the knowledge of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā manasi saṃjātaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ sarvavastuṣu /
tadā saṃnyāsamicchecca patitaḥ syād viparyaye //
meaning:
यदा मनसि संजातं वैतृष्ण्यं सर्ववस्तुषु /
तदा संन्यासमिच्छेच्च पतितः स्याद् विपर्यये //
text_mt:
When freedom from thirst for all things has arisen in the mind,
then one may desire renunciation; if it is otherwise, he falls.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭimāgneyīmathavā punaḥ /
dāntaḥ pakvakaṣāyo 'sau brahmāśramamupāśrayet //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यां निरूप्येष्टिमाग्नेयीमथवा पुनः /
दान्तः पक्वकषायो ऽसौ ब्रह्माश्रममुपाश्रयेत् //
text_mt:
Having performed the Prājāpatya sacrifice, or else the Āgneya sacrifice,
self-controlled, his impurities burned away, he should resort to the stage of life devoted to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānasaṃnyāsinaḥ kecid vedasaṃnyāsinaḥ pare /
karmasaṃnyāsinastvanye trividhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानसंन्यासिनः केचिद् वेदसंन्यासिनः परे /
कर्मसंन्यासिनस्त्वन्ये त्रिविधाः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
Some are renunciants through knowledge; others are renunciants through the Veda;
and others are renunciants through ritual action—three kinds are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvasaṅganirmukto nirdvandvaścaiva nirbhayaḥ /
procyate jñānasaṃnyāsī svātmanyeva vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
यः सर्वसङ्गनिर्मुक्तो निर्द्वन्द्वश्चैव निर्भयः /
प्रोच्यते ज्ञानसंन्यासी स्वात्मन्येव व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt:
He who is completely freed from all attachment, beyond the dualities, and fearless,
established in his own self alone, is called a renunciant through knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
vedamevābhyasennityaṃ nirāśī niṣparigrahaḥ /
procyate vedasaṃnyāsī mumukṣurvijitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं निराशी निष्परिग्रहः /
प्रोच्यते वेदसंन्यासी मुमुक्षुर्विजितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt:
He who continually studies only the Veda, devoid of desire, without possessions,
a mumukṣu whose senses are conquered, is called a renunciant through the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
yastvagnīnātmasātkṛtvā brahmārpaṇaparo dvijaḥ /
jñeyaḥ sa karmasaṃnyāsī mahāyajñaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
यस्त्वग्नीनात्मसात्कृत्वा ब्रह्मार्पणपरो द्विजः /
ज्ञेयः स कर्मसंन्यासी महायज्ञपरायणः //
text_mt:
The twice-born who, having internalized the fires, is intent on dedicating all to Brahman
and devoted to the great sacrifices, should be known as a renunciant through ritual action.

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ jñānī tvabhyadhiko mataḥ /
na tasya vidyate kāryaṃ na liṅgaṃ vā vipaścitaḥ //
meaning:
त्रयाणामपि चैतेषां ज्ञानी त्वभ्यधिको मतः /
न तस्य विद्यते कार्यं न लिङ्गं वा विपश्चितः //
text_mt:
Yet among these three, the possessor of knowledge is considered pre-eminent;
for that wise one there is no obligation, nor any external emblem.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmamo nirbhayaḥ śānto nirdvandvaḥ parṇabhojanaḥ /
jīrṇakaupīnavāsāḥ syānnagno vā dhyānatatparaḥ //
meaning:
निर्ममो निर्भयः शान्तो निर्द्वन्द्वः पर्णभोजनः /
जीर्णकौपीनवासाः स्यान्नग्नो वा ध्यानतत्परः //
text_mt:
Free from mineness, fearless, tranquil, beyond the dualities, eating leaves,
wearing a worn loincloth, or naked, he should be intent on meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacārī mitāhāro grāmādannaṃ samāharet /
adhyātmamatirāsīta nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचारी मिताहारो ग्रामादन्नं समाहरेत् /
अध्यात्ममतिरासीत निरपेक्षो निरामिषः //
text_mt:
Celibate, eating measured food, he should collect alms-food from a village;
he should sit with his mind fixed on the Self, free from expectation and free from desire.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaiva sahāyena sukhārthaṃ vicarediha /
nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam //
meaning:
आत्मनैव सहायेन सुखार्थं विचरेदिह /
नाभिनन्देत मरणं नाभिनन्देत जीवितम् //
text_mt:
He should wander in this world with only himself as his companion for the sake of happiness;
he should not rejoice at death, nor should he rejoice at life.

sanskrit_iast:
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā /
nādhyetavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ na kadācana /
evaṃ jñātvā paro yogī brahmabhūyāya kalpate //
meaning:
कालमेव प्रतीक्षेत निदेशं भृतको यथा /
नाध्येतव्यं न वक्तव्यं श्रोतव्यं न कदाचन /
एवं ज्ञात्वा परो योगी ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते //

sanskrit_iast:
ekavāsāthavā vidvān kaupīnācchādanastathā /
muṇḍī śikhī vātha bhavet tridaṇḍī niṣparigrahaḥ /
kāṣāyavāsāḥ satataṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
एकवासाथवा विद्वान् कौपीनाच्छादनस्तथा /
मुण्डी शिखी वाथ भवेत् त्रिदण्डी निष्परिग्रहः /
काषायवासाः सततं ध्यानयोगपरायणः //

sanskrit_iast:
grāmānte vṛkṣamūle vā vased devālaye 'pi vā /
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ /
bhaikṣyeṇa vartayennityaṃ naikānnādī bhavet kvacit //
meaning:
ग्रामान्ते वृक्षमूले वा वसेद् देवालये ऽपि वा /
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः /
भैक्ष्येण वर्तयेन्नित्यं नैकान्नादी भवेत् क्वचित् //

sanskrit_iast:
yastu mohena vālasyādekānnādī bhaved yatiḥ /
na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ kācid dharmaśāstreṣu kathyate //
meaning:
यस्तु मोहेन वालस्यादेकान्नादी भवेद् यतिः /
न तस्य निष्कृतिः काचिद् धर्मशास्त्रेषु कथ्यते //
text_mt:
The ascetic who, through delusion or laziness, eats food from a single household,
for him no expiation is stated in the treatises on duty.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgadveṣavimuktātmā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ /
prāṇihaṃsānivṛttaśca maunī syāt sarvanispṛhaḥ //
meaning:
रागद्वेषविमुक्तात्मा समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः /
प्राणिहंसानिवृत्तश्च मौनी स्यात् सर्वनिस्पृहः //
text_mt:
His self freed from passion and hatred, regarding a clod of earth, a stone, and gold as equal,
ceasing from harming living beings, he should remain silent and free from all craving.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet /
satyapūtāṃ vaded vāṇīṃ manaḥ pūtaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत् पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत् /
सत्यपूतां वदेद् वाणीं मनः पूतं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
He should set down his foot purified by sight; he should drink water purified by cloth;
he should speak speech purified by truth; he should perform what is purified by the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
naikatra nivased deśe varṣābhyo 'nyatra bhikṣukaḥ /
snānaśaucarato nityaṃ kamaṇḍalukaraḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
नैकत्र निवसेद् देशे वर्षाभ्यो ऽन्यत्र भिक्षुकः /
स्नानशौचरतो नित्यं कमण्डलुकरः शुचिः //
text_mt:
The mendicant should not dwell in one place except during the rainy season;
always devoted to bathing and purification, holding a water-pot in his hand, pure.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryarato nityaṃ vanavāsarato bhavet /
mokṣaśāstreṣu nirato brahmasūtrī jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नित्यं वनवासरतो भवेत् /
मोक्षशास्त्रेषु निरतो ब्रह्मसूत्री जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt:
Always devoted to celibacy, he should be fond of dwelling in the forest,
devoted to the treatises on liberation, wearing the sacred thread of Brahman, with senses conquered.

sanskrit_iast:
dambhāhaṅkāranirmukto nindāpaiśunyavarjitaḥ /
ātmajñānaguṇopeto yatirmokṣamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
दम्भाहङ्कारनिर्मुक्तो निन्दापैशुन्यवर्जितः /
आत्मज्ञानगुणोपेतो यतिर्मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Freed from deceit and egoism, free from censure and slander,
endowed with the virtues of knowledge of the Self, the ascetic will attain liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyaset satataṃ vedaṃ praṇavākhyaṃ sanātanam /
snātvācamya vidhānena śucirdevālayādiṣu //
meaning:
अभ्यसेत् सततं वेदं प्रणवाख्यं सनातनम् /
स्नात्वाचम्य विधानेन शुचिर्देवालयादिषु //
text_mt:
He should constantly study the eternal Veda named the Praṇava,
having bathed and sipped water according to the rule, pure in temples of the gods and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopavītī śāntātmā kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ /
dhautakāṣāyavasano bhasmacchannatanūrahaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञोपवीती शान्तात्मा कुशपाणिः समाहितः /
धौतकाषायवसनो भस्मच्छन्नतनूरहः //
text_mt:
Wearing a sacrificial thread, tranquil-minded, holding kuśa grass in hand, collected in mind,
wearing washed ochre robes, his bodily hair covered in ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
adhiyajñaṃ brahma japedādhidaivikameva ca /
ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
अधियज्ञं ब्रह्म जपेदाधिदैविकमेव च /
आध्यात्मिकं च सततं वेदान्ताभिहितं च यत् //
text_mt:
He should constantly recite Brahman relating to sacrifice, relating to the divinities,
and relating to the inner Self, which is taught in the Vedānta.

sanskrit_iast:
putreṣu vātha nivasan brahmacārī yatirmuniḥ /
vedamevābhyasennityaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
पुत्रेषु वाथ निवसन् ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्मुनिः /
वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt:
Or dwelling among his sons as a celibate ascetic sage,
he should continually study the Veda alone; he goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ param /
kṣamā dayā ca satoṣo vratānyasya viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं तपः परम् /
क्षमा दया च सतोषो व्रतान्यस्य विशेषतः //
text_mt:
Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, supreme austerity,
forbearance, compassion, and contentment are especially his observances.

sanskrit_iast:
vedāntajñānaniṣṭho vā pañca yajñān samāhitaḥ /
kuryādaharahaḥ snātvā bhikṣānnenaiva tena hi //
meaning:
वेदान्तज्ञाननिष्ठो वा पञ्च यज्ञान् समाहितः /
कुर्यादहरहः स्नात्वा भिक्षान्नेनैव तेन हि //
text_mt: Or, devoted to the knowledge of the Vedānta, composed in mind, / having bathed day after day, he should perform the five sacrifices indeed with begged food.

sanskrit_iast:
homamantrāñjapennityaṃ kāle kāle samāhitaḥ /
svādhyāyaṃ cānvahaṃ kuryāt sāvitrīṃ saṃdhyayorjapet //
meaning:
होममन्त्राञ्जपेन्नित्यं काले काले समाहितः /
स्वाध्यायं चान्वहं कुर्यात् सावित्रीं संध्ययोर्जपेत् //
text_mt: He should constantly murmur the fire-offering mantras at the proper times, composed; / he should perform daily recitation of the Veda every day, and murmur the Sāvitrī verse at both twilights.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyīta satataṃ devamekānte parameśvaram /
ekānnaṃ varjayennityaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham //
meaning:
ध्यायीत सततं देवमेकान्ते परमेश्वरम् /
एकान्नं वर्जयेन्नित्यं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् //
text_mt: He should constantly meditate in solitude on the god, the Supreme Lord; / he should always avoid food from a single source, lust, anger, and possessions.

sanskrit_iast:
ekavāsā dvivāsā vā śikhī yajñopavītavān /
kamaṇḍalukaro vidvān tridaṇḍī yāti tatparam //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge 'ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एकवासा द्विवासा वा शिखी यज्ञोपवीतवान् /
कमण्डलुकरो विद्वान् त्रिदण्डी याति तत्परम् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे ऽष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Wearing one garment or two garments, wearing a tuft of hair and a sacred thread, / carrying a water pot in hand, wise, carrying three staffs, he attains that supreme state.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter in the latter section of the compilation consisting of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
evaṃ svāśramaniṣṭhānāṃ yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām /
bhaikṣeṇa vartanaṃ proktaṃ phalamūlairathāpi vā //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
एवं स्वाश्रमनिष्ठानां यतीनां नियतात्मनाम् /
भैक्षेण वर्तनं प्रोक्तं फलमूलैरथापि वा //
title: ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Thus livelihood by begging or with fruits and roots / has been proclaimed for ascetics devoted to their own stage of life, who are self-restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ na prasajyeta vistare /
bhaikṣe prasakto hi yatirviṣayeṣvapi sajjati //
meaning:
एककालं चरेद् भैक्षं न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे /
भैक्षे प्रसक्तो हि यतिर्विषयेष्वपि सज्जति //
text_mt: He should beg alms once a day; he should not become attached to abundance; / for an ascetic attached to begging becomes attached to sense objects as well.

sanskrit_iast:
saptāgāraṃ cared bhaikṣamalābhāt tu punaścaret /
prakṣālya pātre bhuñjīyādadbhiḥ prakṣālayet tu tat //
meaning:
सप्तागारं चरेद् भैक्षमलाभात् तु पुनश्चरेत् /
प्रक्षाल्य पात्रे भुञ्जीयादद्भिः प्रक्षालयेत् तु तत् //
text_mt: He should beg alms at seven houses; if he obtains nothing, he may beg again; / having washed [it], he should eat in a bowl, and wash it with water.

sanskrit_iast:
athavānyadupādāya pātre bhuñjīta nityaśaḥ /
bhuktvā tat saṃtyajet pātraṃ yātrāmātramalolupaḥ //
meaning:
अथवान्यदुपादाय पात्रे भुञ्जीत नित्यशः /
भुक्त्वा तत् संत्यजेत् पात्रं यात्रामात्रमलोलुपः //
text_mt: Or, taking another [vessel], he may eat in a vessel every day; / having eaten, he should discard that vessel, free from greed, [seeking] only sustenance.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhūme sannamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane /
vṛtte śarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret //
meaning:
विधूमे सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने /
वृत्ते शरावसंपाते भिक्षां नित्यं यतिश्चरेत् //
text_mt: When the smoke is gone, when the pestle is laid down, when the embers are extinguished, when the people have eaten, / and when the setting down of dishes has ceased, the ascetic should regularly beg for alms.

sanskrit_iast:
godohamātraṃ tiṣṭheta kālaṃ bhikṣuradhomukhaḥ /
bhikṣetyuktvā sakṛt tūṣṇīmaśnīyād vāgyataḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
गोदोहमात्रं तिष्ठेत कालं भिक्षुरधोमुखः /
भिक्षेत्युक्त्वा सकृत् तूष्णीमश्नीयाद् वाग्यतः शुचिः //
text_mt: The mendicant should stand with his head bowed for only the time it takes to milk a cow; / having said 'Alms' once, he should eat in silence, restrained in speech and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca samācamya yathāvidhi /
āditye darśayitvānnaṃ bhuñjīta prāṅmukhottaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य पाणिपादौ च समाचम्य यथाविधि /
आदित्ये दर्शयित्वान्नं भुञ्जीत प्राङ्मुखोत्तरः //
text_mt: Having washed both hands and feet, and having sipped water according to the rule, / having presented the food to the sun, he should eat facing east or north.

sanskrit_iast:
hutvā prāṇāhutīḥ pañca grāsānaṣṭau samāhitaḥ /
ācamya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhyāyīta parameśvaram //
meaning:
हुत्वा प्राणाहुतीः पञ्च ग्रासानष्टौ समाहितः /
आचम्य देवं ब्रह्माणं ध्यायीत परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Having offered the five oblations of the vital breath, composed in mind, [he should eat] eight mouthfuls; / having sipped water, he should meditate on the god Brahmā, the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tataḥ /
catvāri yatipātrāṇi manurāha prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
अलाबुं दारुपात्रं च मृण्मयं वैणवं ततः /
चत्वारि यतिपात्राणि मनुराह प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: A bottle gourd, a wooden vessel, an earthen [vessel], and next one made of bamboo: / Manu Prajāpati stated that these four are the vessels for an ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgrātre pararātre ca madhyarātre tathaiva ca /
saṃdhyāsvahni viśeṣeṇa cintayennityamīśvaram //
meaning:
प्राग्रात्रे पररात्रे च मध्यरात्रे तथैव च /
संध्यास्वह्नि विशेषेण चिन्तयेन्नित्यमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: In the early night, in the late night, and likewise at midnight, / and especially at the twilights and during the day, he should constantly contemplate the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā hṛtpadmanilaye viśvākhyaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam /
ātmānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parastāt tamasaḥ sthitam //
meaning:
कृत्वा हृत्पद्मनिलये विश्वाख्यं विश्वसंभवम् /
आत्मानं सर्वभूतानां परस्तात् तमसः स्थितम् //
text_mt: Having placed in the abode of the heart-lotus the one called 'all,' the source of all, / the Self of all beings, who abides beyond darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasyādhārabhūtānāmānandaṃ jyotiravyayam /
pradhānapuruṣātītamākāśaṃ dahanaṃ śivam //
meaning:
सर्वस्याधारभूतानामानन्दं ज्योतिरव्ययम् /
प्रधानपुरुषातीतमाकाशं दहनं शिवम् //
text_mt: the foundation of all, bliss, imperishable light, / beyond primordial matter and the spirit, space, fire, auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
tadantaḥ sarvabhāvānāmīśvaraṃ brahmarūpiṇam /
dhyāyedanādimadvaitamānandādiguṇālayam //
meaning:
तदन्तः सर्वभावानामीश्वरं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् /
ध्यायेदनादिमद्वैतमानन्दादिगुणालयम् //
text_mt: within that, he should meditate on the Lord of all states of being, who has the form of Brahman, / beginningless, non-dual, the abode of bliss and other qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāntaṃ paramaṃ brahma puruṣaṃ satyamavyayam /
sitetarāruṇākāraṃ maheśaṃ viśvarūpiṇam //
meaning:
महान्तं परमं ब्रह्म पुरुषं सत्यमव्ययम् /
सितेतरारुणाकारं महेशं विश्वरूपिणम् //
text_mt: the great, supreme Brahman, the spirit, true, imperishable, / having a white, dark, and red form, the Great Lord, possessing universal form.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārānte 'tha cātmānaṃ saṃsthāpya paramātmani /
ākāśe devamīśānaṃ dhyāyītākāśamadhyagam //
meaning:
ओङ्कारान्ते ऽथ चात्मानं संस्थाप्य परमात्मनि /
आकाशे देवमीशानं ध्यायीताकाशमध्यगम् //
text_mt: And having established oneself in the Supreme Self at the end of the sound Oṃ, / he should meditate on the god, Īśāna, in the space [of the heart], dwelling in the midst of space,

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇaṃ sarvabhāvānāmānandaikasamāśrayam /
purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhyāyan mucyeta bandhanāt //
meaning:
कारणं सर्वभावानामानन्दैकसमाश्रयम् /
पुराणं पुरुषं शंभुं ध्यायन् मुच्येत बन्धनात् //
text_mt: the cause of all states of being, the sole resort of bliss, / the ancient spirit, Śambhu; meditating [on him], he is freed from bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā guhāyāṃ prakṛtau jagatsaṃmohanālaye /
vicintya paramaṃ vyoma sarvabhūtaikakāraṇam //
meaning:
यद्वा गुहायां प्रकृतौ जगत्संमोहनालये /
विचिन्त्य परमं व्योम सर्वभूतैककारणम् //
text_mt: Or, having contemplated in the cave, in primordial matter, the abode of the delusion of the world, / the supreme space, the sole cause of all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yatra lokaḥ pralīyate /
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūkṣmaṃ yat paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ //
meaning:
जीवनं सर्वभूतानां यत्र लोकः प्रलीयते /
आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः सूक्ष्मं यत् पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः //
text_mt: the life of all beings, where the world dissolves, / the subtle bliss of Brahman that seekers of liberation behold,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye nihitaṃ brahma kevalaṃ jñānalakṣaṇam /
anantaṃ satyamīśānaṃ vicintyāsīta saṃyataḥ //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये निहितं ब्रह्म केवलं ज्ञानलक्षणम् /
अनन्तं सत्यमीशानं विचिन्त्यासीत संयतः //
text_mt: the pure Brahman placed within it, characterized by knowledge, / infinite, true, Īśāna—having contemplated [him], he should remain restrained.

sanskrit_iast:
guhyād guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ yatīnāmetadīritam /
yo 'nutiṣṭhenmaheśena so 'śnute yogamaiśvaram //
meaning:
गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं यतीनामेतदीरितम् /
यो ऽनुतिष्ठेन्महेशेन सो ऽश्नुते योगमैश्वरम् //
text_mt: This is declared as the knowledge most secret of secrets for ascetics; / he who practices it with the Great Lord enjoys divine yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād dhyānarato nityamātmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ /
jñānaṃ samabhyased brāhmaṃ yena mucyeta bandhanāt //
meaning:
तस्माद् ध्यानरतो नित्यमात्मविद्यापरायणः /
ज्ञानं समभ्यसेद् ब्राह्मं येन मुच्येत बन्धनात् //
text_mt: Therefore, constantly intent on meditation, devoted to knowledge of the Self, / he should thoroughly cultivate knowledge of Brahman, by which he is freed from bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
matvā pṛthak svamātmānaṃ sarvasmādeva kevalam /
ānandamajaraṃ jñānaṃ dhyāyīta ca punaḥ param //
meaning:
मत्वा पृथक् स्वमात्मानं सर्वस्मादेव केवलम् /
आनन्दमजरं ज्ञानं ध्यायीत च पुनः परम् //
text_mt: Considering his own self as distinct from everything, pure, / bliss, ageless, knowledge, he should again meditate on the Supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt bhavanti bhūtāni yad gatvā neha jāyate /
sa tasmādīśvaro devaḥ parasmād yo 'dhitiṣṭhati //
meaning:
यस्मात् भवन्ति भूतानि यद् गत्वा नेह जायते /
स तस्मादीश्वरो देवः परस्माद् यो ऽधितिष्ठति //
text_mt: from whom beings arise, and having gone to whom one is not born here again; / he is therefore the Lord, the god who presides beyond the supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
yadantare tad gaganaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamavyayam /
yadaṃśastatparo yastu sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यदन्तरे तद् गगनं शाश्वतं शिवमव्ययम् /
यदंशस्तत्परो यस्तु स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः //
text_mt: within whom is that space—eternal, auspicious, imperishable; / he who is devoted to that which is his portion, that god is the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
vratāni yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ tathaivopavratāni ca /
ekaikātikrame teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
व्रतानि यानि भिक्षूणां तथैवोपव्रतानि च /
एकैकातिक्रमे तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते //
text_mt: Whatever vows belong to mendicants, and likewise minor vows: / upon the transgression of each one of them, an expiation is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
upetya ca striyaṃ kāmāt prāyaścittaṃ samāhitaḥ /
prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaṃ kuryāt sāṃtapanaṃ śuciḥ //
meaning:
उपेत्य च स्त्रियं कामात् प्रायश्चित्तं समाहितः /
प्राणायामसमायुक्तं कुर्यात् सांतपनं शुचिः //
text_mt: Having approached a woman out of desire, composed and pure, / he should perform the sāṃtapana expiation accompanied by breath-control.

sanskrit_iast:
tataścareta niyamāt kṛcchraṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ /
punarāśramamāgamya cared bhiśruratandritaḥ //
meaning:
ततश्चरेत नियमात् कृच्छ्रं संयतमानसः /
पुनराश्रममागम्य चरेद् भिश्रुरतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: Then, according to rule, he should perform the kṛcchra penance with a restrained mind; / having returned to his stage of life, the mendicant should wander unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
na dharmayuktamanṛtaṃ hinastīti manīṣiṇaḥ /
tathāpi ca na kartavyaṃ prasaṅgo hyeṣa dāruṇaḥ //
meaning:
न धर्मयुक्तमनृतं हिनस्तीति मनीषिणः /
तथापि च न कर्तव्यं प्रसङ्गो ह्येष दारुणः //
text_mt: 'An untruth connected with duty does not cause harm,' so say the wise; / even so, it must not be done, for this attachment is severe.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarātropavāsaśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā /
uktvānṛtaṃ prakartavyaṃ yatinā dharmalipsunā //
meaning:
एकरात्रोपवासश्च प्राणायामशतं तथा /
उक्त्वानृतं प्रकर्तव्यं यतिना धर्मलिप्सुना //
text_mt: Fasting for one night and a hundred breath-controls: / having spoken an untruth, [this] must be performed by an ascetic desiring duty.

sanskrit_iast:
paramāpadgatenāpi na kāryaṃ steyamanyataḥ /
steyādabhyadhikaḥ kaścinnāstyadharma iti smṛtiḥ /
hiṃsā caiṣāparā diṣṭā yā cātmajñānanāśikā //
meaning:
परमापद्गतेनापि न कार्यं स्तेयमन्यतः /
स्तेयादभ्यधिकः कश्चिन्नास्त्यधर्म इति स्मृतिः /
हिंसा चैषापरा दिष्टा या चात्मज्ञाननाशिका //
text_mt: Even when fallen into extreme distress, theft must not be committed against another; / the traditional text says there is no adharma greater than theft; / and this is declared to be a further violence that destroys knowledge of the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
yadetad draviṇaṃ nāma prāṇa hyete bahiśvarāḥ /
sa tasya harati prāṇān yo yasya harate dhanam //
meaning:
यदेतद् द्रविणं नाम प्राण ह्येते बहिश्वराः /
स तस्य हरति प्राणान् यो यस्य हरते धनम् //
text_mt: This thing called wealth—these are indeed external vital breaths; / he who steals another's wealth steals his vital breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtvā sa duṣṭātmā bhinnavṛtto vratāccyutaḥ /
bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścareccāndrāyaṇavratam //
meaning:
एवं कृत्वा स दुष्टात्मा भिन्नवृत्तो व्रताच्च्युतः /
भूयो निर्वेदमापन्नश्चरेच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम् //
text_mt: Having done this, evil-minded, broken in conduct, fallen from his vow, / having attained revulsion [from the world] again, he should perform the cāndrāyaṇa vow,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena saṃvatsaramiti śrutiḥ /
bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścared bhikṣuratandritaḥ //
meaning:
विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन संवत्सरमिति श्रुतिः /
भूयो निर्वेदमापन्नश्चरेद् भिक्षुरतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: for a year according to the rule found in sacred tradition—so says the scripture; / having attained revulsion again, the mendicant should wander unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
akasmādeva hiṃsāṃ tu yadi bhikṣuḥ samācaret /
kuryātkṛchrātikṛcchraṃ tu cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā //
meaning:
अकस्मादेव हिंसां तु यदि भिक्षुः समाचरेत् /
कुर्यात्कृछ्रातिकृच्छ्रं तु चान्द्रायणमथापि वा //
text_mt: If a mendicant should commit violence unexpectedly, / he should perform the kṛcchrātikṛcchra or the cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
skandedindriyadaurbalyāt striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatiryadi /
tena dhārayitavyā vai prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa /
divāskande trirātraṃ syāt prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā //
meaning:
स्कन्देदिन्द्रियदौर्बल्यात् स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा यतिर्यदि /
तेन धारयितव्या वै प्राणायामास्तु षोडश /
दिवास्कन्दे त्रिरात्रं स्यात् प्राणायामशतं तथा //
text_mt: If an ascetic emits semen out of weakness of the senses upon seeing a woman, / he must indeed perform sixteen breath-controls; / for an emission during the day, there should be a three-night fast and a hundred breath-controls.

sanskrit_iast:
ekānne madhumāṃse ca navaśrāddhe tathaiva ca /
pratyakṣalavaṇe coktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśodhanam //
meaning:
एकान्ने मधुमांसे च नवश्राद्धे तथैव च /
प्रत्यक्षलवणे चोक्तं प्राजापत्यं विशोधनम् //
text_mt: For [eating] food from a single source, honey, meat, at a recent ancestral offering rite, / and for visible salt, the prājāpatya penance is prescribed as a purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaniṣṭhasya satataṃ naśyate sarvapātakam /
tasmānmaheśvaraṃ jñātvā tasya dhyānaparo bhavet //
meaning:
ध्याननिष्ठस्य सततं नश्यते सर्वपातकम् /
तस्मान्महेश्वरं ज्ञात्वा तस्य ध्यानपरो भवेत् //
text_mt: All sins of one who is constantly devoted to meditation are destroyed; / therefore, having known the Great Lord, one should be intent on meditation on him.

sanskrit_iast:
yad brahma paramaṃ jyotiḥ pratiṣṭhākṣaramadvayam /
yo 'ntarātra paraṃ brahma sa vijñeyo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यद् ब्रह्म परमं ज्योतिः प्रतिष्ठाक्षरमद्वयम् /
यो ऽन्तरात्र परं ब्रह्म स विज्ञेयो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: That Brahman which is the supreme light, the firm foundation, the imperishable, non-dual, / he who is within the supreme Brahman, he is to be known as the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa devo mahādevaḥ kevalaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ /
tadevākṣaramadvaitaṃ tadādityāntaraṃ param //
meaning:
एष देवो महादेवः केवलः परमः शिवः /
तदेवाक्षरमद्वैतं तदादित्यान्तरं परम् //
text_mt: This god is Mahādeva, pure, supreme Śiva; / that alone is the imperishable, non-dual, that supreme [light] within the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmānmahīyate devaḥ svadhāmni jñānasaṃjñite /
ātmayogāhvaye tattve mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
यस्मान्महीयते देवः स्वधाम्नि ज्ञानसंज्ञिते /
आत्मयोगाह्वये तत्त्वे महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Because the god is exalted in his own abode named knowledge, / in the reality called yoga of the Self, he is therefore commemorated as Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyad devānmahādevād vyatiriktaṃ prapaśyati /
tamevātmānamanveti yaḥ sa yāti paraṃ padam //
meaning:
नान्यद् देवान्महादेवाद् व्यतिरिक्तं प्रपश्यति /
तमेवात्मानमन्वेति यः स याति परं पदम् //
text_mt: He who sees nothing else distinct from the god Mahādeva, / and pursues that very Self, he goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
manyate ye svamātmānaṃ vibhinnaṃ parameśvarāt /
na te paśyanti taṃ devaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ pariśramaḥ //
meaning:
मन्यते ये स्वमात्मानं विभिन्नं परमेश्वरात् /
न ते पश्यन्ति तं देवं वृथा तेषां परिश्रमः //
text_mt: Those who consider their own self to be distinct from the Supreme Lord / do not see that god; their labor is in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
ekameva paraṃ brahma vijñeyaṃ tattvamavyayam /
sa devastu mahādevo naitad vijñāya badhyate //
meaning:
एकमेव परं ब्रह्म विज्ञेयं तत्त्वमव्ययम् /
स देवस्तु महादेवो नैतद् विज्ञाय बध्यते //
text_mt: The highest Brahman alone is to be known as the one imperishable reality; / that god is Mahādeva, and having known this, one is not bound.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād yateta niyataṃ yatiḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ /
jñānayogarataḥ śānto mahādevaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद् यतेत नियतं यतिः संयतमानसः /
ज्ञानयोगरतः शान्तो महादेवपरायणः //
text_mt: Therefore, the ascetic should always strive with a controlled mind, / devoted to the yoga of knowledge, tranquil, and intent upon Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vaḥ kathito vipro yatīnāmāśramaḥ śubhaḥ /
pitāmahena vibhunā munīnāṃ pūrvamīritam //
meaning:
एष वः कथितो विप्रो यतीनामाश्रमः शुभः /
पितामहेन विभुना मुनीनां पूर्वमीरितम् //
text_mt: This auspicious stage of life for ascetics has been told to you, O brāhmaṇas; / it was spoken previously to the sages by the all-pervading Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
nāputraśiṣyayogibhyo dadyādidamanuttamam /
jñānaṃ svayaṃbhuvā proktaṃ yatidharmāśrayaṃ śivam //
meaning:
नापुत्रशिष्ययोगिभ्यो दद्यादिदमनुत्तमम् /
ज्ञानं स्वयंभुवा प्रोक्तं यतिधर्माश्रयं शिवम् //
text_mt: One should not impart to non-sons, non-disciples, or non-yogins this unsurpassable, / auspicious knowledge resting upon the duty of ascetics, spoken by the Self-born.

sanskrit_iast:
iti yatiniyamānāmetaduktaṃ vidhānaṃ
paśupatiparitoṣe yad bhavedekahetuḥ /
na bhavati punareṣāmudbhavo vā vināśaḥ
praṇihitamanaso ye nityamevācaranti //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति यतिनियमानामेतदुक्तं विधानं
पशुपतिपरितोषे यद् भवेदेकहेतुः /
न भवति पुनरेषामुद्भवो वा विनाशः
प्रणिहितमनसो ये नित्यमेवाचरन्ति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus has been declared this rule for the observances of ascetics, / which is the single cause of the satisfaction of Paśupati; / there is no further rebirth or destruction for those / who, with concentrated mind, constantly practice it.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravalakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham /
hitāya sarvaviprāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmapanuttaye //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
अतः परं प्रवलक्ष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम् /
हिताय सर्वविप्राणां दोषाणामपनुत्तये //
title: triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Hereafter I shall explain the auspicious rule of expiation / for the welfare of all brāhmaṇas, for the removal of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā vihitaṃ karma kṛtvā ninditameva ca /
doṣamāpnoti puruṣaḥ prāyaścittaṃ viśodhanam //
meaning:
अकृत्वा विहितं कर्म कृत्वा निन्दितमेव च /
दोषमाप्नोति पुरुषः प्रायश्चित्तं विशोधनम् //
text_mt: By failing to perform prescribed action and by performing what is censured, / a person incurs sin; expiation is the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu na tiṣṭhed brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit /
yad brūyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntā vidvāṃsastatsamācaret //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तमकृत्वा तु न तिष्ठेद् ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् /
यद् ब्रूयुर्ब्राह्मणाः शान्ता विद्वांसस्तत्समाचरेत् //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa should not remain anywhere without having performed expiation; / whatever tranquil, learned brāhmaṇas declare, that he should carry out.

sanskrit_iast:
vedārthavittamaḥ śānto dharmakāmo 'gnimān dvijaḥ /
sa eva syāt paro dharmo yameko 'pi vyavasyati //
meaning:
वेदार्थवित्तमः शान्तो धर्मकामो ऽग्निमान् द्विजः /
स एव स्यात् परो धर्मो यमेको ऽपि व्यवस्यति //
text_mt: A twice-born man who knows the meaning of the Vedas best, is tranquil, loves duty, and maintains the sacred fire— / that alone would be the supreme duty which even he alone resolves.

sanskrit_iast:
anāhitāgnayo viprāstrayo vedārthapāragāḥ /
yad brūyurdharmakāmāste tajjñeyaṃ dharmasādhanam //
meaning:
अनाहिताग्नयो विप्रास्त्रयो वेदार्थपारगाः /
यद् ब्रूयुर्धर्मकामास्ते तज्ज्ञेयं धर्मसाधनम् //
text_mt: Three brāhmaṇas who do not maintain the sacred fires but have mastered the meaning of the Vedas, / loving duty—what they declare, that should be known as the means of duty.

sanskrit_iast:
anekadharmaśāstrajñā ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ /
vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ saptaite parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अनेकधर्मशास्त्रज्ञा ऊहापोहविशारदाः /
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाः सप्तैते परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Those who know many texts of duty, are skilled in deductive and inductive reasoning, / and are endowed with the study of the Vedas—seven of these are proclaimed [as an assembly].

sanskrit_iast:
mīmāṃsājñānatattvajñā vedāntakuśalā dvijāḥ /
ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyātāḥ prayāścittaṃ vadanti vai //
meaning:
मीमांसाज्ञानतत्त्वज्ञा वेदान्तकुशला द्विजाः /
एकविंशतिसंख्याताः प्रयाश्चित्तं वदन्ति वै //
text_mt: Twice-born men who know the true nature of the knowledge of Mīmāṃsā and are skilled in the Vedānta, / numbering twenty-one, declare an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahā madyapaḥ steno gurutalpaga eva ca /
mahāpātakinastvete yaścaitaiḥ saha saṃvaset //
meaning:
ब्रह्महा मद्यपः स्तेनो गुरुतल्पग एव च /
महापातकिनस्त्वेते यश्चैतैः सह संवसेत् //
text_mt: The slayer of a brāhmaṇa, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the violator of the Guru's bed— / these are the committers of the great sins, and whoever associates with them.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsaraṃ tu patitaiḥ saṃsargaṃ kurute tu yaḥ /
yānaśayyāsanairnityaṃ jānan vai patito bhavet //
meaning:
संवत्सरं तु पतितैः संसर्गं कुरुते तु यः /
यानशय्यासनैर्नित्यं जानन् वै पतितो भवेत् //
text_mt: He who associates with fallen persons for a year / knowingly through vehicles, beds, and seats, becomes fallen indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ tathaivādhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ /
kṛtvā sadyaḥ patejjñānāt saha bhojanameva ca //
meaning:
याजनं योनिसंबन्धं तथैवाध्यापनं द्विजः /
कृत्वा सद्यः पतेज्ज्ञानात् सह भोजनमेव च //
text_mt: A twice-born man who knowingly performs sacrifice for them, forms a marital alliance with them, or teaches them, / as well as eating together with them, falls immediately.

sanskrit_iast:
avijñāyātha yo mohāt kuryādadhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ /
saṃvatsareṇa patati sahādhyayanameva ca //
meaning:
अविज्ञायाथ यो मोहात् कुर्यादध्यापनं द्विजः /
संवत्सरेण पतति सहाध्ययनमेव च //
text_mt: Moreover, a twice-born man who should teach [them] through delusion without knowing, / falls after a year, as well as by studying together [with them].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāhā dvādaśābdāni kuṭiṃ kṛtvā vane vaset /
bhaikṣamātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtvā śavaśirodhvajam //
meaning:
ब्रह्माहा द्वादशाब्दानि कुटिं कृत्वा वने वसेत् /
भैक्षमात्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं कृत्वा शवशिरोध्वजम् //
text_mt: The slayer of a brāhmaṇa should dwell in the forest for twelve years, having built a hut, / begging for alms for self-purification, making a corpse's skull his banner.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāvasathān sarvān devāgārāṇi varjayet /
vinindan svayamātmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ ca saṃsmaran //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणावसथान् सर्वान् देवागाराणि वर्जयेत् /
विनिन्दन् स्वयमात्मानं ब्राह्मणं तं च संस्मरन् //
text_mt: He should avoid all residences of brāhmaṇas and temples of gods, / censuring himself and constantly remembering that brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkalpitayogyāni saptāgārāṇi saṃviśet /
vidhūme śanakairnityaṃ vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane //
meaning:
असंकल्पितयोग्यानि सप्तागाराणि संविशेत् /
विधूमे शनकैर्नित्यं व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने //
text_mt: He should enter seven suitable, unplanned houses / slowly, when the smoke has ceased, the coals are extinguished, and the people have eaten.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ doṣaṃ vikhyāpayan nṛṇām /
vanyamūlaphalairvāpi vartayed dhairyamākṣitaḥ //
meaning:
एककालं चरेद् भैक्षं दोषं विख्यापयन् नृणाम् /
वन्यमूलफलैर्वापि वर्तयेद् धैर्यमाक्षितः //
text_mt: He should wander for alms once a day, proclaiming his sin to men, / or he may subsist on wild roots and fruits, resting upon fortitude.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālapāṇiḥ khaṭvāṅgī brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ /
pūrṇe tu dvādaśe varṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
कपालपाणिः खट्वाङ्गी ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः /
पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: With a skull in his hand, carrying a staff topped with a skull, intent on celibacy, / upon the completion of the twelfth year he dispels the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittamidaṃ śubham /
kāmato maraṇācchuddhirjñeyā nānyena kenacit //
meaning:
अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तमिदं शुभम् /
कामतो मरणाच्छुद्धिर्ज्ञेया नान्येन केनचित् //
text_mt: This auspicious expiation is when the sin is committed unintentionally; / when done intentionally, purification is known to be by death, not by any other means.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādanaśanaṃ vātha bhṛgoḥ patanameva vā /
jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ jalaṃ vā praviśet svayam //
meaning:
कुर्यादनशनं वाथ भृगोः पतनमेव वा /
ज्वलन्तं वा विशेदग्निं जलं वा प्रविशेत् स्वयम् //
text_mt: He should undertake fasting to death, or jumping from a cliff, / or enter a blazing fire, or plunge into water himself.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā samyak prāṇān parityajet /
brahmahatyāpanodārthamantarā vā mṛtasya tu //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा सम्यक् प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमन्तरा वा मृतस्य तु //
text_mt: He may fully abandon his life for the sake of a brāhmaṇa or for the sake of cows, / or if he dies in the meantime to remove the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāmayānvitaṃ vipraṃ kṛtvānāmayameva tu /
dattvā cānnaṃ sa durbhikṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
दीर्घामयान्वितं विप्रं कृत्वानामयमेव तु /
दत्त्वा चान्नं स दुर्भिक्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: Making free from illness a brāhmaṇa afflicted with a long illness, / and giving food in a famine, he dispels the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhāvabhṛthake snātvā vā śudhyate dvijaḥ /
sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāya pradāya tu //
meaning:
अश्वमेधावभृथके स्नात्वा वा शुध्यते द्विजः /
सर्वस्वं वा वेदविदे ब्राह्मणाय प्रदाय तु //
text_mt: Or the twice-born man is purified by bathing at the concluding bath of a horse sacrifice, / or by giving all his possessions to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyāstvaruṇayā saṃgame lokaviśrute /
śudhyet triṣavaṇasnānāt trirātropoṣito dvijaḥ //
meaning:
सरस्वत्यास्त्वरुणया संगमे लोकविश्रुते /
शुध्येत् त्रिषवणस्नानात् त्रिरात्रोपोषितो द्विजः //
text_mt: At the world-famous confluence of the Sarasvatī with the Aruṇā, / a twice-born man fasting for three nights is purified by bathing at the three junctures of the day.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā rāmeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ snātvā caiva mahodadhau /
brahmacaryādibhiryukto dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ vimucyate //
meaning:
गत्वा रामेश्वरं पुण्यं स्नात्वा चैव महोदधौ /
ब्रह्मचर्यादिभिर्युक्तो दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Going to the holy Rāmeśvara and bathing in the great ocean, / endowed with celibacy and the like, seeing Rudra, he is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālamocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ /
snātvābhyarcya pitṝn bhaktyā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
कपालमोचनं नाम तीर्थं देवस्य शूलिनः /
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पितॄन् भक्त्या ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: There is a sacred ford named Kapālamocana of the Trident-bearing God; / having bathed there and worshipped the ancestors with devotion, he dispels the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra devādidevena bharaveṇāmitaujasā /
kapālaṃ sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र देवादिदेवेन भरवेणामितौजसा /
कपालं स्थापितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Where previously the skull of the supreme Brahmā / was deposited by the foremost God of gods, Bhairava of immeasurable splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
samabhyarcya mahādevaṃ tatra bhairavarūpiṇam /
tarpapitvā pitṝn snātvā mucyate brahmahatyayā //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge triśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
समभ्यर्च्य महादेवं तत्र भैरवरूपिणम् /
तर्पपित्वा पितॄन् स्नात्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having worshipped Mahādeva there in the form of Bhairava, / having satisfied the ancestors and bathed, one is freed from the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand [verses] in the holy Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devena rudreṇa śaṅkareṇāmitaujasā /
kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpitaṃ dehajaṃ bhuvi //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं देवेन रुद्रेण शङ्करेणामितौजसा /
कपालं ब्रह्मणः पूर्वं स्थापितं देहजं भुवि //
title: ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / How was the bodily skull of Brahmā formerly / deposited on earth by the god Rudra, Śaṅkara of immeasurable splendor?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm /
māhātmyaṃ devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
शृणुध्वमृषयः पुण्यां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् /
माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Listen, O sages, to the holy story that destroys sin, / the greatness of the God of gods, the wise Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
purā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ meruśṛṅge maharṣayaḥ /
procuḥ praṇamya lokādiṃ kimekaṃ tattvamavyayam //
meaning:
पुरा पितामहं देवं मेरुशृङ्गे महर्षयः /
प्रोचुः प्रणम्य लोकादिं किमेकं तत्त्वमव्ययम् //
text_mt: Long ago, on the peak of Meru, the great sages bowed down / to the god, the Grandfather, the origin of the world, and asked: “What is the one imperishable reality?”

sanskrit_iast:
sa māyayā maheśasya mohito lokasaṃbhavaḥ /
avijñāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ prāha dharṣiṇam //
meaning:
स मायया महेशस्य मोहितो लोकसंभवः /
अविज्ञाय परं भावं स्वात्मानं प्राह धर्षिणम् //
text_mt: Deluded by the illusory creative power of the Great Lord, the origin of the worlds, / not knowing the highest state, spoke arrogantly of himself:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ dhātā jagadyoniḥ svayaṃbhūreka īśvaraḥ /
anādimatparaṃ brahma māmabhyarcya vimucyate //
meaning:
अहं धाता जगद्योनिः स्वयंभूरेक ईश्वरः /
अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म मामभ्यर्च्य विमुच्यते //
text_mt: “I am the creator, the womb of the universe, the self-born, the sole Lord, / the highest Brahman without beginning; having worshipped me, one is liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ /
na vidyate cābhyadhiko matto lokeṣu kaścana //
meaning:
अहं हि सर्वदेवानां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः /
न विद्यते चाभ्यधिको मत्तो लोकेषु कश्चन //
text_mt: For I am the impeller and the withdrawer of all the gods, / and there is no one in the worlds superior to me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ manyamānasya jajñe nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ /
provāca prahasan vākyaṃ roṣatāmravilocanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैवं मन्यमानस्य जज्ञे नारायणांशजः /
प्रोवाच प्रहसन् वाक्यं रोषताम्रविलोचनः //
text_mt: While he was thinking thus, [a sage] born from a portion of Nārāyaṇa appeared; / laughing, with eyes copper-red with anger, he spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāraṇamidaṃ brahman vartate tava sāṃpratam /
ajñānayogayuktasya na tvetaducitaṃ tava //
meaning:
किं कारणमिदं ब्रह्मन् वर्तते तव सांप्रतम् /
अज्ञानयोगयुक्तस्य न त्वेतदुचितं तव //
text_mt: “What is the cause of this which now exists in you, O Brahman? / For you are joined with the application of ignorance; this is indeed not proper for you.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ dhātā hi lokānāṃ yajño nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ /
na māmṛte 'sya jagato jīvanaṃ sarvadā kvacit //
meaning:
अहं धाता हि लोकानां यज्ञो नारायणः प्रभुः /
न मामृते ऽस्य जगतो जीवनं सर्वदा क्वचित् //
text_mt: For I am the creator of the worlds, the sacrifice, Nārāyaṇa, the Lord; / without me, there is never life anywhere for this universe.

sanskrit_iast:
ahameva paraṃ jyotirahameva parā gatiḥ /
matpreritena bhavatā sṛṣṭaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
अहमेव परं ज्योतिरहमेव परा गतिः /
मत्प्रेरितेन भवता सृष्टं भुवनमण्डलम् //
text_mt: I alone am the supreme light; I alone am the supreme goal; / by you impelled by me, the orb of the world was created.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vivadatormohāt parasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ /
ājagmuryatra tau devau vedāścatvāra eva hi //
meaning:
एवं विवदतोर्मोहात् परस्परजयैषिणोः /
आजग्मुर्यत्र तौ देवौ वेदाश्चत्वार एव हि //
text_mt: While the two of them were thus disputing out of delusion, desiring to defeat each other, / the four Vedas indeed arrived where those two gods were.

sanskrit_iast:
anvīkṣya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ yajñātmānaṃ ca saṃsthitam /
procuḥ saṃvignahṛdayā yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
अन्वीक्ष्य देवं ब्रह्माणं यज्ञात्मानं च संस्थितम् /
प्रोचुः संविग्नहृदया याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Seeing the god Brahmā and the embodied Sacrifice standing there, / their hearts agitated, they spoke the true nature of the Supreme Being.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgveda uvāca
yasyāntaḥ sthāni bhūtāni yasmātsarvaṃ pravartate /
yadāhustatparaṃ tattvaṃ sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ऋग्वेद उवाच
यस्यान्तः स्थानि भूतानि यस्मात्सर्वं प्रवर्तते /
यदाहुस्तत्परं तत्त्वं स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः //
text_mt: The Ṛgveda said: / “In whom all beings abide, from whom everything proceeds, / whom they call that supreme reality—that god is Maheśvara.”

sanskrit_iast:
yajurveda uvāca
yo yajñairakhilairīśo yogena ca samarcyate /
yamāhurīśvaraṃ devaṃ sa devaḥ syāt pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
यजुर्वेद उवाच
यो यज्ञैरखिलैरीशो योगेन च समर्च्यते /
यमाहुरीश्वरं देवं स देवः स्यात् पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt:
The Yajurveda said:
“The Lord who is worshipped by all sacrifices and by yoga,
whom they declare to be the divine Īśvara—that god is the Wielder of the Pināka.”

sanskrit_iast:
sāmaveda uvāca
yenedaṃ bhrāmyate cakraṃ yadākāśāntaraṃ śivam /
yogibhirvidyate tattvaṃ mahādevaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
सामवेद उवाच
येनेदं भ्राम्यते चक्रं यदाकाशान्तरं शिवम् /
योगिभिर्विद्यते तत्त्वं महादेवः स शङ्करः //
text_mt:
The Sāmaveda said:
“He by whom this wheel is spun, who is the auspicious interior of space,
the reality known by yogins—he is Mahādeva, Śaṅkara.”

sanskrit_iast:
atharvaveda uvāca
yaṃ prapaśyanti yogeśaṃ yatanto yatayaḥ param /
maheśaṃ puruṣaṃ rudraṃ sa devo bhagavān bhavaḥ //
meaning:
अथर्ववेद उवाच
यं प्रपश्यन्ति योगेशं यतन्तो यतयः परम् /
महेशं पुरुषं रुद्रं स देवो भगवान् भवः //
text_mt:
The Atharvaveda said:
“Whom the ascetics, striving, behold as the supreme Lord of Yoga,
the Great Lord, the Puruṣa, Rudra—that god is the blessed Bhava.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa bhagavān brahmā vedānāmīritaṃ śubham /
śrutvāha prahasan vākyaṃ viśvātmāpi vimohitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं स भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदानामीरितं शुभम् /
श्रुत्वाह प्रहसन् वाक्यं विश्वात्मापि विमोहितः //
text_mt:
Having thus heard the auspicious utterance of the Vedas,
the blessed Brahmā, though the soul of the universe, said laughingly, bewildered:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma sarvasaṅgavivarjitam /
ramate bhāryayā sārdhaṃ pramathaiścātigarvitaiḥ //
meaning:
कथं तत्परमं ब्रह्म सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितम् /
रमते भार्यया सार्धं प्रमथैश्चातिगर्वितैः //
text_mt:
“How can that supreme Brahman, devoid of all attachment,
sport with a wife and with exceedingly proud Pramathas?”

sanskrit_iast:
itirite 'tha bhagavān praṇavātmā sanātanaḥ /
amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā vacaḥ prāha pitāmaham //
meaning:
इतिरिते ऽथ भगवान् प्रणवात्मा सनातनः /
अमूर्तो मूर्तिमान् भूत्वा वचः प्राह पितामहम् //
text_mt:
When this was spoken, the blessed eternal embodiment of the Praṇava,
becoming embodied from the formless, addressed words to the Grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
praṇava uvāca
na hyeṣa bhagavān patnyā svātmano vyatiriktayā /
kadācid ramate rudrastādṛśo hi maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रणव उवाच
न ह्येष भगवान् पत्न्या स्वात्मनो व्यतिरिक्तया /
कदाचिद् रमते रुद्रस्तादृशो हि महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
The Praṇava said:
“Indeed, this blessed Rudra never sports with a wife
who is distinct from his own self, for such is the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ /
svānandabhūtā kathitā devī nāgantukā śivā //
meaning:
अयं स भगवानीशः स्वयञ्ज्योतिः सनातनः /
स्वानन्दभूता कथिता देवी नागन्तुका शिवा //
text_mt:
This is the blessed Lord, the eternal self-luminous one;
the goddess Śivā is declared to be his own bliss, not an external arrival.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamukte 'pi tadā yajñamūrterajasya ca /
nājñānamagamannāśamīśvarasyaiva māyayā //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्ते ऽपि तदा यज्ञमूर्तेरजस्य च /
नाज्ञानमगमन्नाशमीश्वरस्यैव मायया //
text_mt:
Even when this was said, the ignorance of the unborn one
whose form is sacrifice did not perish, owing to the illusory creative power of the Lord alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantare mahājyotirviriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ /
prāpaśyadadbhutaṃ divyaṃ pūrayan gaganāntaram //
meaning:
तदन्तरे महाज्योतिर्विरिञ्चो विश्वभावनः /
प्रापश्यदद्भुतं दिव्यं पूरयन् गगनान्तरम् //
text_mt:
Meanwhile, Viriñca, the creator of the universe,
beheld a great, wonderful, divine light filling the mid-region of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhyasaṃsthaṃ vimalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tejasojjvalam /
vyomamadhyagataṃ divyaṃ prādurāsīd dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
तन्मध्यसंस्थं विमलं मण्डलं तेजसोज्ज्वलम् /
व्योममध्यगतं दिव्यं प्रादुरासीद् द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
Situated in its midst, a pure orb shining with splendor,
gone into the middle of the sky, divine, appeared, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā vadanaṃ divyaṃ mūrdhni lokapitāmahaḥ /
tena tanmaṇjalaṃ ghoramālokayadaninditam //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा वदनं दिव्यं मूर्ध्नि लोकपितामहः /
तेन तन्मण्जलं घोरमालोकयदनिन्दितम् //
text_mt:
Having seen the divine face on his head,
with it the Grandfather of the worlds gazed upon that terrible, faultless orb.

sanskrit_iast:
prajajvālātikopena brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ /
kṣaṇādadṛśyata mahān puruṣo nīlalohitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रजज्वालातिकोपेन ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः /
क्षणाददृश्यत महान् पुरुषो नीललोहितः //
text_mt:
From intense anger, the fifth head of Brahmā blazed up;
in an instant, a great being, Nīlalohita, was seen.

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlapiṅgalo devo nāgayajñopavītavān /
taṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam //
meaning:
त्रिशूलपिङ्गलो देवो नागयज्ञोपवीतवान् /
तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा शङ्करं नीललोहितम् //
text_mt:
The god tawny with a trident, wearing a serpent as the sacred thread;
to that Śaṅkara, Nīlalohita, the blessed Brahmā said:

sanskrit_iast:
jānāmi bhavataḥ pūrvaṃ lalāṭādeva śaṅkara /
prādurbhāvaṃ maheśān māmeva śaraṇaṃ vraja //
meaning:
जानामि भवतः पूर्वं ललाटादेव शङ्कर /
प्रादुर्भावं महेशान् मामेव शरणं व्रज //
text_mt:
“I know your origin previously, O Śaṅkara, from my forehead alone;
O Great Lord, seek refuge in me alone!”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā sagarvavacanaṃ padmayoneratheśvaraḥ /
prāhiṇot puruṣaṃ kālaṃ bhairavaṃ lokadāhakam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा सगर्ववचनं पद्मयोनेरथेश्वरः /
प्राहिणोत् पुरुषं कालं भैरवं लोकदाहकम् //
text_mt:
Hearing the proud word of the lotus-born one, the Lord then
sent forth the person Kālabhairava, who burns the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kṛtvā sumahad yuddhaṃ brahmaṇā kālabhairavaḥ /
cakarta tasya vadanaṃ viriñcasyātha pañcamam //
meaning:
स कृत्वा सुमहद् युद्धं ब्रह्मणा कालभैरवः /
चकर्त तस्य वदनं विरिञ्चस्याथ पञ्चमम् //
text_mt:
Having fought a very great battle with Brahmā, that Kālabhairava
then cut off the fifth head of Viriñca.

sanskrit_iast:
nikṛttavadano devo brahmā devena śaṃbhunā /
mamāra ceśayogena jīvitaṃ prāpa viśvasṛk //
meaning:
निकृत्तवदनो देवो ब्रह्मा देवेन शंभुना /
ममार चेशयोगेन जीवितं प्राप विश्वसृक् //
text_mt:
With his head severed by the divine lord Śambhu, the god Brahmā
died, and through the yoga of the Lord the creator of the universe regained life.

sanskrit_iast:
athānupaśyad giriśaṃ maṇḍalāntarasaṃsthitam /
samāsīnaṃ mahādevyā mahādevaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
अथानुपश्यद् गिरिशं मण्डलान्तरसंस्थितम् /
समासीनं महादेव्या महादेवं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
Then he beheld the Dweller on the Mountain situated within the orb,
the eternal Mahādeva seated together with the Great Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
bhujaṅgarājavalayaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam /
koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ jaṭājūṭavirājitam //
meaning:
भुजङ्गराजवलयं चन्द्रावयवभूषणम् /
कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं जटाजूटविराजितम् //
text_mt:
having the king of serpents as a bracelet, adorned with a part of the moon,
resembling ten million suns, resplendent with matted hair,

sanskrit_iast:
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ divyamālāsamanvitam /
triśūlapāṇiṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ yoginaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
शार्दूलचर्मवसनं दिव्यमालासमन्वितम् /
त्रिशूलपाणिं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं योगिनं भूतिभूषणम् //
text_mt:
clad in a tiger skin, accompanied by a divine garland,
holding a trident in hand, difficult to behold, a yogin adorned with ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
yamantarā yoganiṣṭhāḥ prapaśyanti hṛdīśvaram /
tamādidevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ mahādevaṃ dadarśa ha //
meaning:
यमन्तरा योगनिष्ठाः प्रपश्यन्ति हृदीश्वरम् /
तमादिदेवं ब्रह्माणं महादेवं ददर्श ह //
text_mt:
Whom those intent on yoga behold within as the Lord in their heart,
that primeval god, the supreme creator, Mahādeva, he indeed beheld:

sanskrit_iast:
yasya sā paramā devī śaktirākāśasaṃsthitā /
so 'nantaiśvaryayogātmā maheśo dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
यस्य सा परमा देवी शक्तिराकाशसंस्थिता /
सो ऽनन्तैश्वर्ययोगात्मा महेशो दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Whose supreme goddess is the power situated in space,
he, whose essence is the yoga of infinite sovereignty, the Great Lord, is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam /
sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate //
meaning:
यस्याशेषजगद् बीजं विलयं याति मोहनम् /
सकृत्प्रणाममात्रेण स रुद्रः खलु दृश्यते //
text_mt:
By whose mere bow once performed the delusive seed of the entire world
goes to dissolution—that Rudra is truly seen;

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'tha nācāraniratān svabhaktāneva kevalam /
vimocayati lokānāṃ nāyako dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
यो ऽथ नाचारनिरतान् स्वभक्तानेव केवलम् /
विमोचयति लोकानां नायको दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Who frees only his own devotees and not those merely engaged in outward conduct,
the leader of the worlds, is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
yasya vedavidaḥ śāntā nirdvandvā brahmacāriṇaḥ /
vidanti vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sa śaṃbhurdṛśyate kila //
meaning:
यस्य वेदविदः शान्ता निर्द्वन्द्वा ब्रह्मचारिणः /
विदन्ति विमलं रूपं स शंभुर्दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Whose pure form the tranquil knowers of the Veda, free from dualities,
observing celibacy, know—that Śambhu is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
yasya brahmādayo devā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ /
arcayanti sadā liṅgaṃ viśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate //
meaning:
यस्य ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः /
अर्चयन्ति सदा लिङ्गं विश्वेशः खलु दृश्यते //
text_mt:
Whose liṅga the gods headed by Brahmā and the sages who discourse on Brahman
always worship—the Lord of the Universe is truly seen;

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam /
sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate //
meaning:
यस्याशेषजगद् बीजं विलयं याति मोहनम् /
सकृत्प्रणाममात्रेण स रुद्रः खलु दृश्यते //
text_mt:
By whose mere bow once performed the delusive seed of the entire world
goes to dissolution—that Rudra is truly seen;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyāsahāyo bhagavān yasyāsau maṇḍalāntaram /
hiraṇyagarbhaputro 'sāvīśvaro dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
विद्यासहायो भगवान् यस्यासौ मण्डलान्तरम् /
हिरण्यगर्भपुत्रो ऽसावीश्वरो दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Accompanied by Vidyā, the blessed one within whose orb
this unborn Lord, son of Hiraṇyagarbha, is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāśeṣajagatsūtirvijñānatanurīśvarī /
na muñcati sadā pārśvaṃ śaṅkaro 'sāvadṛśyata //
meaning:
यस्याशेषजगत्सूतिर्विज्ञानतनुरीश्वरी /
न मुञ्चति सदा पार्श्वं शङ्करो ऽसावदृश्यत //
text_mt:
Whom the sovereign lady, the source of the entire world, whose body is consciousness,
never leaves by his side—that Śaṅkara was seen;

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ vā yadi vā patraṃ yatpādayugale jalam /
dattvā tarati saṃsāraṃ rudro 'sau dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
पुष्पं वा यदि वा पत्रं यत्पादयुगले जलम् /
दत्त्वा तरति संसारं रुद्रो ऽसौ दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Giving a flower or even a leaf, or water at whose pair of feet
one crosses over the cycle of rebirth—that Rudra is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsannidhāne sakalaṃ niyacchati sanātanaḥ /
kālaḥ kila sa yogātmā kālakālo hi dṛśyate //
meaning:
तत्सन्निधाने सकलं नियच्छति सनातनः /
कालः किल स योगात्मा कालकालो हि दृश्यते //
text_mt:
In whose presence the eternal one restrains everything—
he whose nature is yoga, the death of Time, is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ trilokasyaiva bhūṣaṇam /
somaḥ sa dṛśyate devaḥ somo yasya vibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
जीवनं सर्वलोकानां त्रिलोकस्यैव भूषणम् /
सोमः स दृश्यते देवः सोमो यस्य विभूषणम् //
text_mt:
The life of all worlds, the ornament of the three worlds—
he is seen as the god Soma, and Soma is his ornament;

sanskrit_iast:
devyā saha sadā sākṣād yasya yogaḥ svabhāvataḥ /
gīyate paramā muktiḥ sa yogī dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
देव्या सह सदा साक्षाद् यस्य योगः स्वभावतः /
गीयते परमा मुक्तिः स योगी दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Whose direct union with the goddess naturally is always
sung as supreme liberation—that yogin is seen indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
yogino yogatattvajñā viyogābhimukhāniśam /
yogaṃ dhyāyanti devyāsau sa yogī dṛśyate kila //
meaning:
योगिनो योगतत्त्वज्ञा वियोगाभिमुखानिशम् /
योगं ध्यायन्ति देव्यासौ स योगी दृश्यते किल //
text_mt:
Yogins who know the truth of yoga, ever intent on disunion [from matter],
meditate upon that union with the goddess—that yogin is seen indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'nuvīkṣya mahādevaṃ mahādevyā sanātanam /
varāsane samāsīnamavāpa paramāṃ smṛtim //
meaning:
सो ऽनुवीक्ष्य महादेवं महादेव्या सनातनम् /
वरासने समासीनमवाप परमां स्मृतिम् //
text_mt:
