text_mt: Visiting sacred pilgrimage sites destroys all sins; / worshiping deities destroys all evils of men.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya yaḥ samārādhayecchivam /
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
अमावस्यां तिथिं प्राप्य यः समाराधयेच्छिवम् /
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: He who reaches the new moon day and worships Śiva, / having fed Brahmins, is liberated from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahādevaṃ tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm /
saṃpūjya brāhmaṇamukhe sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यां महादेवं तथा कृष्णचतुर्दशीम् /
संपूज्य ब्राह्मणमुखे सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Having worshiped Mahādeva on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, as well as on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / through the mouth of Brahmins, he is liberated from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanam /
dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां तथा रात्रौ सोपहारं त्रिलोचनम् /
दृष्ट्वेशं प्रथमे यामे मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: Likewise, on the thirteenth night, having beheld the three-eyed Lord with offerings / during the first watch, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ /
yamāca dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca //
meaning:
उपोषितश्चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे समाहितः /
यमाच धर्मराजाय मृत्यवे चान्तकाय च //
text_mt: Fasting on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, composed in mind, / to Yama, to Dharmarāja, to Mṛtyu, and to Antaka,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca /
pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyāt saptodakāñjalīn /
snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
वैवस्वताय कालाय सर्वभूतक्षयाय च /
प्रत्येकं तिलसंयुक्तान् दद्यात् सप्तोदकाञ्जलीन् /
स्नात्वा नद्यां तु पूर्वाह्ने मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: to Vaivasvata, to Kāla, and to the Destroyer of all beings, / he should give seven handfuls of water mixed with sesame seeds for each; / having bathed in a river in the forenoon, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāmupavāsaṃ dvijārcanam /
vrateṣveteṣu kurvota śāntaḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यमधः शय्यामुपवासं द्विजार्चनम् /
व्रतेष्वेतेषु कुर्वोत शान्तः संयतमानसः //
text_mt: Celibacy, sleeping on the ground, fasting, and worship of the twice-born— / he should observe these during vows, peaceful and self-controlled in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ samuddiśya pitāmaham /
brāhmaṇāṃstrīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
अमावस्यायां ब्रह्माणं समुद्दिश्य पितामहम् /
ब्राह्मणांस्त्रीन् समभ्यर्च्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: On the new moon, dedicating it to Brahmā the Grandfather, / having worshiped three Brahmins, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito devaṃ śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ /
saptamyāmarcayed bhānuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठ्यामुपोषितो देवं शुक्लपक्षे समाहितः /
सप्तम्यामर्चयेद् भानुं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: Fasting on the sixth day of the bright fortnight, composed in mind, / he should worship the sun on the seventh day; he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
bharaṇyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca śanaiścaradine yamam /
pūjayet saptajanmotthairmucyate pātakairnaraḥ //
meaning:
भरण्यां च चतुर्थ्यां च शनैश्चरदिने यमम् /
पूजयेत् सप्तजन्मोत्थैर्मुच्यते पातकैर्नरः //
text_mt: A man should worship Yama on the Bharaṇī constellation, on the fourth lunar day, and on Saturday; / he is freed from sins arising from seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam /
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
एकादश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम् /
द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य महापापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Abstaining from food on the eleventh, having worshiped Janārdana / on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight, he is liberated from great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tapo japastīrthasevā devabrāhmaṇapūjanam /
grahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu mahāpātakaśodhanam //
meaning:
तपो जपस्तीर्थसेवा देवब्राह्मणपूजनम् /
ग्रहणादिषु कालेषु महापातकशोधनम् //
text_mt: Austerity, recitation, visiting tirthas, and worshiping gods and Brahmins / during occasions such as eclipses purify great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvapāpayukto 'pi puṇyatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ /
niyamena tyajet prāṇān sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
यः सर्वपापयुक्तो ऽपि पुण्यतीर्थेषु मानवः /
नियमेन त्यजेत् प्राणान् स मुच्येत् सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: A man who, though tainted with all sins, gives up his life-breaths / at holy pilgrimage sites according to rule, would be freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ vā mahāpātakadūṣitam /
bhartāramuddharennārī praviṣṭā saha pāvakam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मघ्नं वा कृतघ्नं वा महापातकदूषितम् /
भर्तारमुद्धरेन्नारी प्रविष्टा सह पावकम् //
text_mt: Whether he is a slayer of a Brahmin, ungrateful, or corrupted by major sins, / a woman who enters the fire along with her husband rescues him.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva paraṃ strīṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ /
sarvapāpasamudbhūtau nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
एतदेव परं स्त्रीणां प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः /
सर्वपापसमुद्भूतौ नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: The wise know this alone to be the supreme expiation for women; / in the occurrence of all sins, there should be no hesitation regarding this.

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā tu yā nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇotsukā /
na tasyā vidyate pāpamiha loke paratra ca //
meaning:
पतिव्रता तु या नारी भर्तृशुश्रूषणोत्सुका /
न तस्या विद्यते पापमिह लोके परत्र च //
text_mt: For a chaste wife devoted to serving her husband, / no sin exists either in this world or in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
pativratā dharmaratā rudrāṇyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
nāsyāḥ parābhavaṃ kartuṃ śaknotīha janaḥ kvacit //
meaning:
पतिव्रता धर्मरता रुद्राण्येव न संशयः /
नास्याः पराभवं कर्तुं शक्नोतीह जनः क्वचित् //
text_mt: A chaste wife devoted to righteousness is Rudrāṇī herself, without doubt; / no person here can ever bring about her defeat.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā rāmasya subhagā sītā trailokyaviśrutā /
patnī dāśaratherdevī vijigye rākṣaseśvaram //
meaning:
यथा रामस्य सुभगा सीता त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता /
पत्नी दाशरथेर्देवी विजिग्ये राक्षसेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Just as Rāma's fortunate wife Sītā, renowned in the three worlds, / the divine wife of the son of Daśaratha, conquered the king of the Rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya bhāryāṃ vimalāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ /
sītāṃ viśālanayanāṃ cakame kālacoditaḥ //
meaning:
रामस्य भार्यां विमलां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः /
सीतां विशालनयनां चकमे कालचोदितः //
text_mt: Rāvaṇa, the king of the Rākṣasas, impelled by Time, / desired Sītā, the spotless, wide-eyed wife of Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā māyayā veṣaṃ carantīṃ vijane vane /
samāhartuṃ matiṃ cakre tāpasaḥ kila kāminīm //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा मायया वेषं चरन्तीं विजने वने /
समाहर्तुं मतिं चक्रे तापसः किल कामिनीम् //
text_mt: Assuming a disguise through illusory power, an ascetic, / he resolved to carry off the lovely woman as she wandered in the lonely forest.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāya sā ca tadbhāvaṃ smṛtvā dāśarathiṃ patim /
jagāma śaraṇaṃ vahnimāvasathyaṃ śucismitā //
meaning:
विज्ञाय सा च तद्भावं स्मृत्वा दाशरथिं पतिम् /
जगाम शरणं वह्निमावसथ्यं शुचिस्मिता //
text_mt: Understanding his intention and remembering her husband, the son of Daśaratha, / she of sweet smile took refuge in the domestic sacred fire.

sanskrit_iast:
upatasthe mahāyogaṃ sarvadoṣavināśanam /
kṛtāñjalī rāmapatnī śākṣāt patimivācyutam //
meaning:
उपतस्थे महायोगं सर्वदोषविनाशनम् /
कृताञ्जली रामपत्नी शाक्षात् पतिमिवाच्युतम् //
text_mt: Rāma's wife approached the great yoga, the destroyer of all faults, / with folded hands, as if approaching her husband, Acyuta himself, directly.

sanskrit_iast:
namasyāmi mahāyogaṃ kṛtāntaṃ gahanaṃ param /
dāhakaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśānaṃ kālarūpiṇam //
meaning:
नमस्यामि महायोगं कृतान्तं गहनं परम् /
दाहकं सर्वभूतानामीशानं कालरूपिणम् //
text_mt: "I bow to the great yoga, the End-maker, profound, supreme, / the burner of all beings, the Sovereign Lord whose form is Time."

sanskrit_iast:
namasye pāvakaṃ devaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ viśvatomukham /
ātmānaṃ dīptavapuṣaṃ sarvabhūtahṛdī sthitam //
meaning:
नमस्ये पावकं देवं साक्षिणं विश्वतोमुखम् /
आत्मानं दीप्तवपुषं सर्वभूतहृदी स्थितम् //
text_mt: I bow to the purifier, the god, the witness whose faces are everywhere, / the luminous-bodied Self abiding in the hearts of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye śaraṇaṃ vahniṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brahmarūpiṇam /
bhūteśaṃ kṛttivasanaṃ śaraṇyaṃ paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये शरणं वह्निं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् /
भूतेशं कृत्तिवसनं शरण्यं परमं पदम् //
text_mt: I take refuge in Fire, devoted to Brahman, whose form is Brahman, / the Lord of beings, clad in animal skins, the refuge, the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ prapadye jaganmūrtiṃ prabhavaṃ sarvatejasām /
mahāyogeśvaraṃ vahnimādityaṃ parameṣṭhinam //
meaning:
ओं प्रपद्ये जगन्मूर्तिं प्रभवं सर्वतेजसाम् /
महायोगेश्वरं वह्निमादित्यं परमेष्ठिनम् //
text_mt: Oṃ, I take refuge in the cosmic form, the source of all splendors, / the Lord of Great Yoga, Fire, the Sun, the Supreme Deity.

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ mahāgrāsaṃ triśūlinam /
kālāgniṃ yogināmīśaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये शरणं रुद्रं महाग्रासं त्रिशूलिनम् /
कालाग्निं योगिनामीशं भोगमोक्षफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: I take refuge in Rudra, the great devourer, the trident-bearer, / the fire of time, the Lord of yogins, the granter of the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ svarūpiṇam /
hiraṇyamaye gṛhe guptaṃ mahāntamamitaujasam //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये त्वां विरूपाक्षं भुर्भुवः स्वः स्वरूपिणम् /
हिरण्यमये गृहे गुप्तं महान्तममितौजसम् //
text_mt: I take refuge in you, the three-eyed one, the embodiment of earth, atmosphere, and heaven, / hidden within the golden chamber, the great one of boundless splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānaraṃ prapadye 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam /
havyakavyavahaṃ devaṃ prapadye vahnimīśvaram //
meaning:
वैश्वानरं प्रपद्ये ऽहं सर्वभूतेष्ववस्थितम् /
हव्यकव्यवहं देवं प्रपद्ये वह्निमीश्वरम् //
text_mt: I take refuge in Vaiśvānara, abiding within all beings; / I take refuge in the god Fire, the bearer of offerings to gods and ancestors, the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prapadye tatparaṃ tattvaṃ vareṇyaṃ savituḥ svayam /
bhargamagniparaṃ jyotī rakṣa māṃ havyavāhana //
meaning:
प्रपद्ये तत्परं तत्त्वं वरेण्यं सवितुः स्वयम् /
भर्गमग्निपरं ज्योती रक्ष मां हव्यवाहन //
text_mt: I take refuge in that supreme reality, the most excellent splendor of Savitṛ himself, / the supreme light beyond fire. Protect me, O bearer of oblations!

sanskrit_iast:
iti vahnyaṣṭakaṃ japtvā rāmapatnī yaśasvinī /
dhyāyantī manasā tasthau rāmamunmīlitekṣaṇā //
meaning:
इति वह्न्यष्टकं जप्त्वा रामपत्नी यशस्विनी /
ध्यायन्ती मनसा तस्थौ राममुन्मीलितेक्षणा //
text_mt: Having recited this octet to Fire, the illustrious wife of Rāma, / meditating in her mind, stood with opened eyes [thinking of] Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
athāvasathyād bhagavān havyavāho maheśvaraḥ /
āvirāsīt sudīptātmā tejasā pradahanniva //
meaning:
अथावसथ्याद् भगवान् हव्यवाहो महेश्वरः /
आविरासीत् सुदीप्तात्मा तेजसा प्रदहन्निव //
text_mt: Then, from the domestic fire, the venerable bearer of oblations, the Great Lord, / manifested with a brilliantly shining body, as though burning with brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
svaṣṭvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ sa rāvaṇavadhepsayā /
sītāmādāya dharmiṣṭhāṃ pāvako 'ntaradhīyata //
meaning:
स्वष्ट्वा मायामयीं सीतां स रावणवधेप्सया /
सीतामादाय धर्मिष्ठां पावको ऽन्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Having created an illusory Sītā with the desire to slay Rāvaṇa, / the Fire took the most righteous Sītā and vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ /
samādāya yayau laṅkāṃ sāgarāntarasaṃsthitām //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं सीतां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः /
समादाय ययौ लङ्कां सागरान्तरसंस्थिताम् //
text_mt: Seeing Sītā as such, Rāvaṇa, the lord of the rākṣasas, / seized her and went to Laṅkā situated within the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātha rāvaṇavadhaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ /
masādāyābhavat sītāṃ śaṅkākulitamānasaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वाथ रावणवधं रामो लक्ष्मणसंयुतः /
मसादायाभवत् सीतां शङ्काकुलितमानसः //
text_mt: Then, having slain Rāvaṇa, Rāma, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, / taking Sītā, had a mind agitated with doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sā pratyayāya bhūtānāṃ sītā māyāmīya punaḥ /
viveśa pāvakaṃ dīptaṃ dadāha jvalano 'pi tām //
meaning:
सा प्रत्ययाय भूतानां सीता मायामीय पुनः /
विवेश पावकं दीप्तं ददाह ज्वलनो ऽपि ताम् //
text_mt: To convince all beings, that illusory Sītā once again / entered the blazing fire, and the fire consumed her.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ /
rāmāyādarśayat sītāṃ pāvako 'bhūt surapriyaḥ //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा मायामयीं सीतां भगवानुग्रदीधितिः /
रामायादर्शयत् सीतां पावको ऽभूत् सुरप्रियः //
text_mt: Having burned the illusory Sītā, the venerable one of fierce rays, / Fire, beloved of the gods, displayed [the real] Sītā to Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
pragṛhya bhartuścaraṇau karābhyāṃ sā sumadhyamā /
cakāra praṇatiṃ bhūmau rāmāya janakātmajā //
meaning:
प्रगृह्य भर्तुश्चरणौ कराभ्यां सा सुमध्यमा /
चकार प्रणतिं भूमौ रामाय जनकात्मजा //
text_mt: Grasping her husband’s feet with both hands, that slender-waisted lady, / the daughter of Janaka, made prostration upon the ground to Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā rāmo vismayākulalocanaḥ /
nanāma vahniṃ sirasā toṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा हृष्टमना रामो विस्मयाकुललोचनः /
ननाम वह्निं सिरसा तोषयामास राघवः //
text_mt: Seeing [her], delighted in mind, his eyes wide with astonishment, / Rāghava bowed his head to Fire and gratified him.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca vahnerbhagavān kimeṣā varavarṇinī /
dagdhā bhagavatā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā matpārśvamāgatā //
meaning:
उवाच वह्नेर्भगवान् किमेषा वरवर्णिनी /
दग्धा भगवता पूर्वं दृष्टा मत्पार्श्वमागता //
text_mt: The venerable one said to Fire: “How is it that this lady of excellent complexion, / seen previously burned by the Lord, has come to my side?”

sanskrit_iast:
tamāha devo lokānāṃ dāhako havyavāhanaḥ /
yathāvṛttaṃ dāśarathiṃ bhūtānāmeva sannidhau //
meaning:
तमाह देवो लोकानां दाहको हव्यवाहनः /
यथावृत्तं दाशरथिं भूतानामेव सन्निधौ //
text_mt: The god who burns the worlds, the bearer of oblations, / told that son of Daśaratha what had happened, in the presence of all beings:

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ sā mithileśena pārvatīṃ rudravallabhām /
ārādhya labdhā tapasā devyāścātyantavallabhā //
meaning:
इयं सा मिथिलेशेन पार्वतीं रुद्रवल्लभाम् /
आराध्य लब्धा तपसा देव्याश्चात्यन्तवल्लभा //
text_mt: “This is she who was obtained by the king of Mithilā through austerities / having worshipped Pārvatī, beloved of Rudra; she is exceedingly dear to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇopetā suśīleyaṃ pativratā /
bhavānīpārśvamānītā mayā rāvaṇakāmitā //
meaning:
भर्तुः शुश्रूषणोपेता सुशीलेयं पतिव्रता /
भवानीपार्श्वमानीता मया रावणकामिता //
text_mt: Devoted to serving her husband, well-behaved, a faithful wife, / she, desired by Rāvaṇa, was brought by me to the presence of Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
yā nītā rākṣaseśena sītā bhagavatāhṛtā /
mayā māyāmayī sṛṣṭā rāvaṇasya vadhāya sā //
meaning:
या नीता राक्षसेशेन सीता भगवताहृता /
मया मायामयी सृष्टा रावणस्य वधाय सा //
text_mt: The Sītā who was carried away by the lord of the rākṣasas, taken by the venerable one, / was created by me as an illusory form for the destruction of Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarthaṃ bhavatā duṣṭo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ /
mayopasaṃhṛtā caiva hato lokavināśanaḥ //
meaning:
तदर्थं भवता दुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः /
मयोपसंहृता चैव हतो लोकविनाशनः //
text_mt: For that purpose, the wicked lord of the rākṣasas, Rāvaṇa, / the destroyer of the worlds, was slain by you, and she has been withdrawn by me.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇa vimalāmenāṃ jānakīṃ vacanānmama /
paśya nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svātmānaṃ prabhavāvyayam //
meaning:
गृहाण विमलामेनां जानकीं वचनान्मम /
पश्य नारायणं देवं स्वात्मानं प्रभवाव्ययम् //
text_mt: Accept this faultless daughter of Janaka at my word; / see God Nārāyaṇa, your own Self, the imperishable origin.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavāṃścaṇḍo viścārcirviśvatomukhaḥ /
mānito rāghaveṇāgnirbhūtaiścāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवांश्चण्डो विश्चार्चिर्विश्वतोमुखः /
मानितो राघवेणाग्निर्भूतैश्चान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the fierce Lord, of universal rays and facing everywhere, / honored by Rāghava and the beings, Fire vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
etate pativratānāṃ vaiṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā /
strīṇāṃ sarvāghaśamanaṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
एतते पतिव्रतानां वैं माहात्म्यं कथितं मया /
स्त्रीणां सर्वाघशमनं प्रायश्चित्तमिदं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: This greatness of faithful wives has thus been told by me; / this is remembered as an expiation for women that alleviates all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
aśeṣapāpayuktastu puruṣo 'pi susaṃyataḥ /
svadehaṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu tyaktvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt //
meaning:
अशेषपापयुक्तस्तु पुरुषो ऽपि सुसंयतः /
स्वदेहं पुण्यतीर्थेषु त्यक्त्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषात् //
text_mt: Even a man bound by endless sins, if he is fully self-controlled, / is freed from evil by abandoning his body at holy places.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā puṇyeṣu vā dvijaḥ /
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ samastairapi pūruṣaḥ //
meaning:
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नात्वा पुण्येषु वा द्विजः /
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः समस्तैरपि पूरुषः //
text_mt: By bathing in all the holy places on earth, or in sacred [waters], / a twice-born, indeed any person, is freed from all sins entirely.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
ityeṣa mānavo dharmo yuṣmākaṃ kathito mayā /
maheśārādhanārthāya jñānayogaṃ ca śāśvatam //
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
इत्येष मानवो धर्मो युष्माकं कथितो मया /
महेशाराधनार्थाय ज्ञानयोगं च शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: Vyāsa said: / Thus has this law of Manu been told to you by me, / as well as eternal yoga of knowledge for the worship of the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'nena vidhinā yuktaṃ jñānayogaṃ samācaret /
sa paśyati mahādevaṃ nānyaḥ kalpaśatairapi //
meaning:
यो ऽनेन विधिना युक्तं ज्ञानयोगं समाचरेत् /
स पश्यति महादेवं नान्यः कल्पशतैरपि //
text_mt: Whoever, endowed with this injunction, practices the yoga of knowledge, / he sees Mahādeva, and no other, even in hundreds of aeons.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpayed yaḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tatpārameśvaram /
na tasmādadhiko loke sa yogī paramo mataḥ //
meaning:
स्थापयेद् यः परं धर्मं ज्ञानं तत्पारमेश्वरम् /
न तस्मादधिको लोके स योगी परमो मतः //
text_mt: He who establishes the supreme duty, that knowledge of the Supreme Lord, / there is none greater than him in the world; he is considered a supreme yogin.

sanskrit_iast:
ya saṃsthāpayituṃ śakto na kuryānmohito janaḥ /
sa yogayukto 'pi munirnātyarthaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ //
meaning:
य संस्थापयितुं शक्तो न कुर्यान्मोहितो जनः /
स योगयुक्तो ऽपि मुनिर्नात्यर्थं भगवत्प्रियः //
text_mt: A person who is able to establish it but, deluded, does not do so, / even if he is a sage united with yoga, he is not exceedingly dear to the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sadaiva dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ /
dharmayukteṣu śānteṣu śraddhayā cānviteṣu vai //
meaning:
तस्मात् सदैव दातव्यं ब्राह्मणेषु विशेषतः /
धर्मयुक्तेषु शान्तेषु श्रद्धया चान्वितेषु वै //
text_mt: Therefore it should always be given, especially among Brāhmaṇas / who are endowed with righteousness, tranquil, and full of faith.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhed bhavatāṃ nityaṃ saṃvādaṃ mama caiva hi /
sarvapāpavinirmukto gaccheta paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
यः पठेद् भवतां नित्यं संवादं मम चैव हि /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो गच्छेत परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: He who daily recites this dialogue between you and me, / freed from all sins, would go to the supreme destination.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau /
paṭheta nityaṃ sumanāḥ śrotavyaṃ ca dvijātibhiḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धे वा दैविके कार्ये ब्राह्मणानां च सन्निधौ /
पठेत नित्यं सुमनाः श्रोतव्यं च द्विजातिभिः //
text_mt: At an ancestral offering rite or at a divine ceremony, and in the presence of Brāhmaṇas, / it should always be recited with a pure mind, and it should be heard by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
yor'thaṃ vicārya yuktātmā śrāvayed brāhmaṇān śucīn /
sa doṣakañcukaṃ tyaktvā yāti devaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
योर्ऽथं विचार्य युक्तात्मा श्रावयेद् ब्राह्मणान् शुचीन् /
स दोषकञ्चुकं त्यक्त्वा याति देवं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: One who, contemplating the meaning with composed mind, recites it to pure Brāhmaṇas, / shedding the sheath of faults, goes to the god, the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ /
samāśvāsya munīn sūtaṃ jagāma ca yathāgatam //
itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayastriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः /
समाश्वास्य मुनीन् सूतं जगाम च यथागतम् //
इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयस्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having said this much, the venerable Vyāsa, son of Satyavatī, / consoling the sages and Sūta, departed as he had come.

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
tīrthāni yāni loke 'smin viśrutāni māhanti ca /
tāni tvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa sāṃpratam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
तीर्थानि यानि लोके ऽस्मिन् विश्रुतानि माहन्ति च /
तानि त्वं कथयास्माकं रोमहर्षण सांप्रतम् //
title: catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The sages said: / Whatever holy places in this world are renowned and great, / please tell us about them now, O Romaharṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
romaharṣaṇa uvāca
śṛṇudhvaṃ kathayiṣye 'haṃ tīrthāni vividhāni ca /
kathitāni purāṇeṣu munibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
रोमहर्षण उवाच
शृणुध्वं कथयिष्ये ऽहं तीर्थानि विविधानि च /
कथितानि पुराणेषु मुनिभिर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: Romaharṣaṇa said: / Listen, I shall relate the various holy places / described in the Purāṇas by the sages who proclaim Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra snānaṃ japo homaḥ śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtam /
ekaikaśo muniśreṣṭhāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam //
meaning:
यत्र स्नानं जपो होमः श्राद्धदानादिकं कृतम् /
एकैकशो मुनिश्रेष्ठाः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम् //
text_mt: Where bathing, repetition of mantras, fire-offerings, ancestral offering rites, gifts, and the like are performed, / each one, O best of sages, purifies the lineage up to the seventh generation.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
prayāgaṃ prathitaṃ tīrthaṃ tasya māhātmyamīritam //
meaning:
पञ्चयोजनविस्तीर्णं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः /
प्रयागं प्रथितं तीर्थं तस्य माहात्म्यमीरितम् //
text_mt: Extending five yojanas, sacred to Brahmā the Supreme Deity, / Prayāga is celebrated as a holy place; its greatness is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kurūṇāṃ devavanditam /
ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं कुरूणां देववन्दितम् /
ऋषीणामाश्रमैर्जुष्टं सर्वपापविशोधनम् //
text_mt: And another foremost holy place of the Kurus, praised by gods, / frequented by the hermitages of the sages, cleanses all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā viśuddhātmā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ /
dadāti yatkiñcidapi punātyubhayataḥ kulam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा विशुद्धात्मा दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जितः /
ददाति यत्किञ्चिदपि पुनात्युभयतः कुलम् //
text_mt: Bathing there, purified in mind, free from deceit and envy, / whatever little one gives purifies one’s family on both sides.

sanskrit_iast:
gayātīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāti vallabham /
kṛtvā piṇḍapradānaṃ tu na bhūyo jāyate naraḥ //
meaning:
गयातीर्थं परं गुह्यं पितॄणां चाति वल्लभम् /
कृत्वा पिण्डप्रदानं तु न भूयो जायते नरः //
text_mt: The holy place Gayā is supreme, secret, and exceedingly dear to the ancestors; / having performed the offering of rice-balls there, a person is not born again.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛd gayābhigamanaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ dadāti yaḥ /
tāritāḥ pitarastena yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
सकृद् गयाभिगमनं कृत्वा पिण्डं ददाति यः /
तारिताः पितरस्तेन यास्यन्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Having gone to Gayā even once, he who offers a rice-ball, / by him the ancestors are delivered and will go to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra lokahitārthāya rudreṇa paramātmanā /
śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ tatra pitṝn prasādayet //
meaning:
तत्र लोकहितार्थाय रुद्रेण परमात्मना /
शिलातले पदं न्यस्तं तत्र पितॄन् प्रसादयेत् //
text_mt: There, for the welfare of the world, a foot was placed upon a slab of rock / by Rudra, the Supreme Self; there one should propitiate the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
gayābhigamanaṃ kartuṃ yaḥ śakto nābhigacchati /
śocanti pitarastaṃ vai vṛthā tasya pariśramaḥ //
meaning:
गयाभिगमनं कर्तुं यः शक्तो नाभिगच्छति /
शोचन्ति पितरस्तं वै वृथा तस्य परिश्रमः //
text_mt: He who is able to go to Gayā and does not go, / the ancestors surely grieve for him; his effort [in life] is in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyanti pitaro gāthāḥ kīrtayanti maharṣayaḥ /
gayāṃyāsyatiyaḥ kaścit so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati //
meaning:
गायन्ति पितरो गाथाः कीर्तयन्ति महर्षयः /
गयांयास्यतियः कश्चित् सो ऽस्मान् संतारयिष्यति //
text_mt:
The ancestors sing songs; the great sages proclaim:
‘Whosoever goes to Gayā will deliver us across.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi syāt pātakopetaḥ svadharmarativarjitaḥ /
gayāṃ yāsyati vaṃśyo yaḥ so 'smān saṃtārayiṣyati //
meaning:
यदि स्यात् पातकोपेतः स्वधर्मरतिवर्जितः /
गयां यास्यति वंश्यो यः सो ऽस्मान् संतारयिष्यति //
text_mt:
Even if he is fraught with sins and devoid of delight in his own duty,
that descendant who goes to Gayā will deliver us across.’

sanskrit_iast:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ /
teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet //
meaning:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्राः शीलवन्तो गुणान्विताः /
तेषां तु समवेतानां यद्येको ऽपि गयां व्रजेत् //
text_mt:
Many sons should be desired, well-behaved and endowed with virtues,
so that, of all of them gathered together, if even one goes to Gayā [all are saved].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ /
pradadyād vidhivat piṇḍān gayāṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणस्तु विशेषतः /
प्रदद्याद् विधिवत् पिण्डान् गयां गत्वा समाहितः //
text_mt:
Therefore, with every effort, a Brahmin especially,
having gone to Gayā with concentrated mind, should offer rice balls according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyāstu khalu te martyā gayāyāṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ /
kulānyubhayataḥ sapta samuddhṛtyāpnuyāt param //
meaning:
धन्यास्तु खलु ते मर्त्या गयायां पिण्डदायिनः /
कुलान्युभयतः सप्त समुद्धृत्याप्नुयात् परम् //
text_mt:
Indeed, blessed are those mortals who offer rice balls at Gayā;
having uplifted seven generations on both sides, one attains the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ siddhāvāsamudāhṛtam /
prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ yatrāste bhagavān bhavaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं सिद्धावासमुदाहृतम् /
प्रभासमिति विख्यातं यत्रास्ते भगवान् भवः //
text_mt:
And there is another excellent pilgrimage place, declared an abode of the perfected,
known as Prabhāsa, where the Lord Bhava dwells.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam /
kṛtvā lokamavāpnoti brahmaṇo 'kṣayyamuttamam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नानं तपः श्राद्धं ब्राह्मणानां च पूजनम् /
कृत्वा लोकमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मणो ऽक्षय्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Having performed bathing, austerity, an ancestral offering rite, and the worship of Brahmins there,
one attains the imperishable, highest world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ traiyambakaṃ nāma sarvadevanamaskṛtam /
pūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ jyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
तीर्थं त्रैयम्बकं नाम सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् /
पूजयित्वा तत्र रुद्रं ज्योतिष्टोमफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: The sacred site named Traiyambaka is revered by all the gods; / having worshiped Rudra there, one obtains the fruit of a Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇākṣaṃ mahādevaṃ samabhyarcya kapardinam /
brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu gāṇapatyaṃ labhed dhruvam //
meaning:
सुवर्णाक्षं महादेवं समभ्यर्च्य कपर्दिनम् /
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयित्वा तु गाणपत्यं लभेद् ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Having reverently worshiped Mahādeva, the wearer of matted hair, at Suvarṇākṣa, / and having honored the brāhmaṇas, one surely attains lordship among the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
someśvaraṃ tīrthavaraṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ /
sarvavyādhiharaṃ puṇyaṃ rudrasālokyakāraṇam //
meaning:
सोमेश्वरं तीर्थवरं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः /
सर्वव्याधिहरं पुण्यं रुद्रसालोक्यकारणम् //
text_mt: Someśvara is an excellent sacred site of Rudra, the supreme lord, / removing all diseases, holy, and a cause for residence in Rudra's realm.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vijayaṃ nāma śobhanam /
tatra liṅgaṃ maheśasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutam //
meaning:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं विजयं नाम शोभनम् /
तत्र लिङ्गं महेशस्य विजयं नाम विश्रुतम् //
text_mt: The supreme sacred site among sacred sites is the auspicious one named Vijaya; / there stands the renowned liṅga of Maheśa named Vijaya.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsān niyatāhāro brahmacārī samāhitaḥ /
uṣitvā tatra viprendrā yāsyanti paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
षण्मासान् नियताहारो ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः /
उषित्वा तत्र विप्रेन्द्रा यास्यन्ति परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Having dwelt there for six months, moderate in diet, celibate, and concentrated in mind, / the foremost among the twice-born will go to the highest abode.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ pūrvadeśe suśobhanam /
ekāmraṃ devadevasya gāṇapatyaphalapradam //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं पूर्वदेशे सुशोभनम् /
एकाम्रं देवदेवस्य गाणपत्यफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: There is another most excellent and very beautiful sacred site in the eastern region, / Ekāmra, belonging to the God of gods, granting the fruit of lordship among the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvātra śivabhaktānāṃ kiñcicchaśvanmahīṃ śubhām /
sārvabhaumo bhaved rājā mumukṣurmokṣamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
दत्त्वात्र शिवभक्तानां किञ्चिच्छश्वन्महीं शुभाम् /
सार्वभौमो भवेद् राजा मुमुक्षुर्मोक्षमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having given some auspicious land there perpetually to devotees of Śiva, / one becomes an emperor-king, or a seeker of liberation attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānadījalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam /
grahaṇe samupaspṛśya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
meaning:
महानदीजलं पुण्यं सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
ग्रहणे समुपस्पृश्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
text_mt: The water of the Mahānadī is holy and destroys all sins; / having touched water there during an eclipse, one is freed from all mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast:
anyā ca virajā nāma nadī trailokyaviśrutā /
tasyāṃ snātvā naro viprā brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
अन्या च विरजा नाम नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता /
तस्यां स्नात्वा नरो विप्रा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: There is another river named Virajā, renowned in the three worlds; / having bathed in it, O brāhmaṇas, a person is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇasyānyannāmnā tu puruṣottamam /
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānāste paramapūruṣaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थं नारायणस्यान्यन्नाम्ना तु पुरुषोत्तमम् /
तत्र नारायणः श्रीमानास्ते परमपूरुषः //
text_mt: There is another sacred site of Nārāyaṇa, named Puruṣottama; / there dwells the glorious Nārāyaṇa, the supreme spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ snātvā tatra dvijottamaḥ /
brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा परं विष्णुं स्नात्वा तत्र द्विजोत्तमः /
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयित्वा तु विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having worshiped the supreme Viṣṇu and bathed there, the best among the twice-born, / having then honored the brāhmaṇas, attains the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ gokarṇaṃ nāma viśrutam /
sarvapāpaharaṃ śaṃbhornivāsaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं गोकर्णं नाम विश्रुतम् /
सर्वपापहरं शंभोर्निवासः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: The supreme sacred site among sacred sites is the renowned Gokarṇa, / removing all sins, the dwelling of Śambhu, the supreme lord.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā liṃṅgaṃ tu devasya gokarṇeśvaramuttamam /
īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān rudrasya dayito bhavet //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा लिंङ्गं तु देवस्य गोकर्णेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान् रुद्रस्य दयितो भवेत् //
text_mt: Having seen the supreme liṅga of the god, Gokarṇeśvara, / one obtains desired wishes and becomes beloved of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
uttaraṃ cāpi gokarṇaṃ liṅgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ /
mahādevasyārcayitvā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
उत्तरं चापि गोकर्णं लिङ्गं देवस्य शूलिनः /
महादेवस्यार्चयित्वा शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: And having worshiped the liṅga of the trident-bearing god at Uttara Gokarṇa, / of Mahādeva, one attains complete union with Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devo mahādevaḥ sthāṇurityabhiviśrutaḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate tatkṣaṇānnaraḥ //
meaning:
तत्र देवो महादेवः स्थाणुरित्यभिविश्रुतः /
तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते तत्क्षणान्नरः //
text_mt: There the god Mahādeva is well known as Sthāṇu; / having seen him, a man is freed from all sins that very moment.

sanskrit_iast:
anyat kubjāmramatulaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ /
saṃpūjya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śvetadvīpe mahīyate //
meaning:
अन्यत् कुब्जाम्रमतुलं स्थानं विष्णोर्महात्मनः /
संपूज्य पुरुषं विष्णुं श्वेतद्वीपे महीयते //
text_mt: Another peerless place is Kubjāmra, belonging to the great-souled Viṣṇu; / having worshiped Viṣṇu, the Spirit, one is glorified in Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra nārāyaṇo devo rudreṇa tripurāriṇā /
kṛtvā yajñasya mathanaṃ dakṣasya tu visarjitaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र नारायणो देवो रुद्रेण त्रिपुरारिणा /
कृत्वा यज्ञस्य मथनं दक्षस्य तु विसर्जितः //
text_mt: Where the god Nārāyaṇa was dismissed by Rudra, the enemy of Tripura, / after destroying the sacrifice of Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
samantād yojanaṃ kṣetraṃ siddharṣigaṇavanditam /
puṇyamāyatanaṃ viṣṇostatrāste puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
समन्ताद् योजनं क्षेत्रं सिद्धर्षिगणवन्दितम् /
पुण्यमायतनं विष्णोस्तत्रास्ते पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: The holy precinct of Viṣṇu, celebrated by hosts of Siddhas and sages, / extends one yojana all around; there dwells the Supreme Spirit.

sanskrit_iast:
anyat kokāmukhaṃ viṣṇostīrthamadbhutakarmaṇaḥ /
mṛto 'tra pātakairmukto viṣṇusārūpyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अन्यत् कोकामुखं विष्णोस्तीर्थमद्भुतकर्मणः /
मृतो ऽत्र पातकैर्मुक्तो विष्णुसारूप्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Another sacred site of Viṣṇu, who performs wondrous deeds, is Kokāmukha; / having died here, freed from mortal sins, one attains similarity of divine form with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmaṃ mahātīrthaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītivivardhanam /
prāṇāṃstatra narastyaktvā hṛṣīkeṣaṃ prapaśyati //
meaning:
शालग्रामं महातीर्थं विष्णोः प्रीतिविवर्धनम् /
प्राणांस्तत्र नरस्त्यक्त्वा हृषीकेषं प्रपश्यति //
text_mt: Śālagrāma is a great sacred site that increases the love of Viṣṇu; / having cast off his life-breaths there, a man sees Hṛṣīkeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatīrthamiti khyātaṃ siddhāvāsaṃ supāvanam /
āste hayaśirā nityaṃ tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam //
meaning:
अश्वतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सिद्धावासं सुपावनम् /
आस्ते हयशिरा नित्यं तत्र नारायणः स्वयम् //
text_mt: The sacred site known as Aśvatīrtha is an abode of the Siddhas and exceedingly purifying; / there the horse-headed Nārāyaṇa himself dwells perpetually.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
puṣkaraṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ mṛtānāṃ brahmalokadam //
meaning:
तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः /
पुष्करं सर्वपापघ्नं मृतानां ब्रह्मलोकदम् //
text_mt: Puṣkara, the sacred site of Brahmā, the supreme lord, is renowned in the three worlds; / it destroys all sins and gives the world of Brahmā to those who have died [there].

sanskrit_iast:
manasā saṃsmared yastu puṣkaraṃ vai dvijottamaḥ /
pūyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakreṇa saha modate //
meaning:
मनसा संस्मरेद् यस्तु पुष्करं वै द्विजोत्तमः /
पूयते पातकैः सर्वैः शक्रेण सह मोदते //
text_mt: The best among the twice-born who even calls Puṣkara to mind, / is purified from all mortal sins and rejoices with Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ /
upāsate siddhasaṅghā brahmaṇaṃ padmasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः /
उपासते सिद्धसङ्घा ब्रह्मणं पद्मसंभवम् //
text_mt: There the gods, along with Gandharvas, Yakṣas, serpents, and Rākṣasas, / and hosts of Siddhas, worship Brahmā, the lotus-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra strātvā bhavecchuddho brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam /
pūjayitvā dvijavarān brahmāṇaṃ saṃprapaṣyati //
meaning:
तत्र स्त्रात्वा भवेच्छुद्धो ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् /
पूजयित्वा द्विजवरान् ब्रह्माणं संप्रपष्यति //
text_mt: Having bathed there, one becomes pure; having worshiped Brahmā, the supreme lord, / and having honored the best of the twice-born, one beholds Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrābhigamya deveśaṃ puruhūtamaninditam /
surūpo jāyate martyaḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
तत्राभिगम्य देवेशं पुरुहूतमनिन्दितम् /
सुरूपो जायते मर्त्यः सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Approaching there the Lord of gods, the blameless Indra, / a mortal becomes handsome and obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevitaṃ param /
pūjayitvā tatra rudramaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
सप्तसारस्वतं तीर्थं ब्रह्माद्यैः सेवितं परम् /
पूजयित्वा तत्र रुद्रमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Saptasārasvata is a supreme sacred site resorted to by Brahmā and other gods; / having worshiped Rudra there, one attains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra maṅkaṇako rudraṃ prapannaḥ parameśvaram /
ārādhayāmāsa haraṃ pañcakṣaraparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र मङ्कणको रुद्रं प्रपन्नः परमेश्वरम् /
आराधयामास हरं पञ्चक्षरपरायणः //
text_mt: Where Maṅkaṇaka took refuge in Rudra, the supreme Lord, / and propitiated Hara, devoted to the five syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śivāyeti muniḥ japan pañcākṣaraṃ param /
ārādhayāmāsa śivaṃ tapasā govṛṣadhvajam //
meaning:
नमः शिवायेति मुनिः जपन् पञ्चाक्षरं परम् /
आराधयामास शिवं तपसा गोवृषध्वजम् //
text_mt: Muttering the supreme five syllables, 'Obeisance to Śiva', / the sage propitiated Śiva, whose emblem is a bull, through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
prajajvālātha tapasā munirmaṅkaṇakastadā /
nanarta harṣavegena jñātvā rudraṃ samāgatam //
meaning:
प्रजज्वालाथ तपसा मुनिर्मङ्कणकस्तदा /
ननर्त हर्षवेगेन ज्ञात्वा रुद्रं समागतम् //
text_mt: Then the sage Maṅkaṇaka blazed with austerity; / knowing that Rudra had arrived, he danced with an outburst of joy.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prāha bhagavān rudraḥ kimarthaṃ nartitaṃ tvayā /
dṛṣṭvāpi devamīśānaṃ nṛtyati sma punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तं प्राह भगवान् रुद्रः किमर्थं नर्तितं त्वया /
दृष्ट्वापि देवमीशानं नृत्यति स्म पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: The blessed Rudra said to him: 'Why are you dancing?' / Even upon seeing the god Īśāna, he danced again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'nvīkṣya bhagavānīśaḥ sagarvaṃ garvaśāntaye /
svakaṃ dehaṃ vidāryāsmai bhasmarāśimadarśayat //
meaning:
सो ऽन्वीक्ष्य भगवानीशः सगर्वं गर्वशान्तये /
स्वकं देहं विदार्यास्मै भस्मराशिमदर्शयत् //
text_mt: Having observed him full of pride, the blessed Lord, in order to quiet his pride, / tore open his own body and showed him a pile of ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyemaṃ maccharīrotthaṃ bhasmarāśiṃ dvijottama /
māhātmyametat tapasastvādṛśo 'nyo 'pi vidyate //
meaning:
पश्येमं मच्छरीरोत्थं भस्मराशिं द्विजोत्तम /
माहात्म्यमेतत् तपसस्त्वादृशो ऽन्यो ऽपि विद्यते //
text_mt: 'Look, O best of the twice-born, at this pile of ashes arising from my body; / this is the greatness of austerity, and another like you exists as well.

sanskrit_iast:
yat sagarvaṃ hi bhavatā nartitaṃ munipuṅgava /
na yuktaṃ tāpasasyaitat tvattopyatrādhiko hyaham //
meaning:
यत् सगर्वं हि भवता नर्तितं मुनिपुङ्गव /
न युक्तं तापसस्यैतत् त्वत्तोप्यत्राधिको ह्यहम् //
text_mt: That you have danced with pride, O bull among sages, / this is not proper for an ascetic; indeed, I am superior even to you in this.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityābhāṣya muniśreṣṭhaṃ sa rudraḥ kila viśvadṛk /
āsthāya paramaṃ bhāvaṃ nanarta jagato haraḥ //
meaning:
इत्याभाष्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं स रुद्रः किल विश्वदृक् /
आस्थाय परमं भावं ननर्त जगतो हरः //
text_mt: Having thus addressed that best of sages, Rudra, the all-seeing, / assuming his supreme state, Hara danced the dance of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā bhūtvā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt /
daṃṣṭrākarālavadano jvālāmālī bhayaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा भूत्वा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् /
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनो ज्वालामाली भयङ्करः //
text_mt: Having become thousand-headed, thousand-eyed, thousand-footed, / with a face terrifying with fangs, garlanded with flames, frightening.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'nvapaśyadaśeṣasya pārśve tasya triśūlinaḥ /
viśālalocanamekāṃ devīṃ cāruvilāsinīm /
sūryāyutasamaprakhyāṃ prasannavadanāṃ śivām //
meaning:
सो ऽन्वपश्यदशेषस्य पार्श्वे तस्य त्रिशूलिनः /
विशाललोचनमेकां देवीं चारुविलासिनीम् /
सूर्यायुतसमप्रख्यां प्रसन्नवदनां शिवाम् //
text_mt: He saw at the side of that complete, trident-bearing god / a single large-eyed goddess, gracefully sportive, / resembling ten thousand suns, with a benevolent face, the auspicious Śivā.

sanskrit_iast:
sasmitaṃ prekṣya viśveśaṃ tiṣṭhantīmamitadyutim /
dṛṣṭvā saṃtrastahṛdayo vepamāno munīśvaraḥ /
nanāma śirasā rudraṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ japan vaśī //
meaning:
सस्मितं प्रेक्ष्य विश्वेशं तिष्ठन्तीममितद्युतिम् /
दृष्ट्वा संत्रस्तहृदयो वेपमानो मुनीश्वरः /
ननाम शिरसा रुद्रं रुद्राध्यायं जपन् वशी //
text_mt: Seeing her standing with an infinite splendor, looking smilingly at the Lord of the universe, / the lord among sages, his heart terrified and trembling, / bowed his head to Rudra, self-controlled and chanting the hymn to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno bhagavānīśastryambako bhaktavatsalaḥ /
pūrvaveṣaṃ sa jagrāha devī cāntarhitābhavat //
meaning:
प्रसन्नो भगवानीशस्त्र्यम्बको भक्तवत्सलः /
पूर्ववेषं स जग्राह देवी चान्तर्हिताभवत् //
text_mt: The blessed Lord Tryambaka, who is affectionate toward his devotees, became pleased; / he assumed his former appearance, and the goddess disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
āliṅgya bhaktaṃ praṇataṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃśivaḥ /
na bhetavyaṃ tvayā vatsa prāha kiṃ te dadāmyaham //
meaning:
आलिङ्ग्य भक्तं प्रणतं देवदेवः स्वयंशिवः /
न भेतव्यं त्वया वत्स प्राह किं ते ददाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Embracing the bowed devotee, the God of gods, Śiva himself, / said: 'You must not fear, my child; what shall I give to you?'

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya mūrdhnā giriśaṃ haraṃ tripurasūdanam /
vijñāpayāmāsa tadā hṛṣṭaḥ praṣṭumanā muniḥ //
meaning:
प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना गिरिशं हरं त्रिपुरसूदनम् /
विज्ञापयामास तदा हृष्टः प्रष्टुमना मुनिः //
text_mt: Bowing with his head to the mountain-dweller, Hara, the destroyer of Tripura, / the delighted sage, wishing to ask, then addressed him:

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te mahādeva maheśvara namo 'stu te /
kimetad bhagavadrūpaṃ sughoraṃ viśvatomukham //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते महादेव महेश्वर नमो ऽस्तु ते /
किमेतद् भगवद्रूपं सुघोरं विश्वतोमुखम् //
text_mt: 'Obeisance to you, Mahādeva; obeisance to you, Maheśvara! / What is this form of the Blessed One, so terrifying and facing all directions?

sanskrit_iast:
kā ca sā bhagavatpārśve rājamānā vyavasthitā /
antarhiteva sahasā sarvamicchāmi veditum //
meaning:
का च सा भगवत्पार्श्वे राजमाना व्यवस्थिता /
अन्तर्हितेव सहसा सर्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् //
text_mt: And who was she that stood shining at the side of the Blessed One, / appearing to have vanished all of a sudden? I wish to know everything.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte vyājahāramaṃ tathā maṅkaṇakaṃ haraḥ /
maheśaḥ svātmano yogaṃ devīṃ ca tripurānalaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्ते व्याजहारमं तथा मङ्कणकं हरः /
महेशः स्वात्मनो योगं देवीं च त्रिपुरानलः //
text_mt: When this was said, Hara, the fire that burned Tripura, / Maheśa, explained to Maṅkaṇaka the yoga of his own Self and the Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ sahasranayanaḥ sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ /
dāhakaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ kālaḥ kālakaro haraḥ //
meaning:
अहं सहस्रनयनः सर्वात्मा सर्वतोमुखः /
दाहकः सर्वपापानां कालः कालकरो हरः //
text_mt: 'I am thousand-eyed, the Self of all, facing all directions, / the burner of all sins, Time, the maker of end-time, Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ cetanācetanātmakam /
so 'ntaryāmī sa puruṣo hyahaṃ vai puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
मयैव प्रेर्यते कृत्स्नं चेतनाचेतनात्मकम् /
सो ऽन्तर्यामी स पुरुषो ह्यहं वै पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt: By me alone is this whole world, composed of the conscious and the unconscious, impelled; / I am that inner ruler, that Spirit, indeed the Supreme Spirit.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sā paramā māyā prakṛtistriguṇātmikā /
procyate munirbhiśaktirjagadyoniḥ sanātanī //
meaning:
तस्य सा परमा माया प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मिका /
प्रोच्यते मुनिर्भिशक्तिर्जगद्योनिः सनातनी //
text_mt:
That supreme illusory creative power of his, primordial matter composed of the three qualities,
is called by the sages the power, the eternal womb of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eṣa māyayā viśvaṃ vyāmohayati viśvavit /
nārāyaṇaḥ paro 'vyakto māyārūpa iti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
स एष मायया विश्वं व्यामोहयति विश्ववित् /
नारायणः परो ऽव्यक्तो मायारूप इति श्रुतिः //
text_mt:
He, the knower of all, deludes the universe through his illusory creative power;
revealed scripture states that Nārāyaṇa is the unmanifest supreme, having the form of illusory creative power.

sanskrit_iast:
evametajjagat sarvaṃ sarvadā sthāpayāmyaham /
yojayāmi prakṛtyāhaṃ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam //
meaning:
एवमेतज्जगत् सर्वं सर्वदा स्थापयाम्यहम् /
योजयामि प्रकृत्याहं पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम् //
text_mt:
Thus, I always establish this entire universe;
I unite the twenty-fifth principle, the conscious spirit, with primordial matter.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vai saṃgato devaḥ kūṭasthaḥ sarvago 'malaḥ /
sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ svamūrteḥ prakṛterajaḥ //
meaning:
तथा वै संगतो देवः कूटस्थः सर्वगो ऽमलः /
सृजत्यशेषमेवेदं स्वमूर्तेः प्रकृतेरजः //
text_mt:
Thus indeed united, the God, the immovable, all-pervading, taintless,
unborn one creates this entire world from primordial matter, which is his own form.

sanskrit_iast:
sa devo bhagavān brahmā viśvarūpaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
tavaitat kathitaṃ samyak straṣṭvatvaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
स देवो भगवान् ब्रह्मा विश्वरूपः पितामहः /
तवैतत् कथितं सम्यक् स्त्रष्ट्वत्वं परमात्मनः //
text_mt:
He is the Lord God Brahmā, of universal form, the Grandfather;
this nature of the Supreme Self as the creator has been fully told to you.

sanskrit_iast:
eko 'haṃ bhagavān kalo hyanādiścāntakṛd vibhuḥ /
samāsthāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ prokto rudro manīṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
एको ऽहं भगवान् कलो ह्यनादिश्चान्तकृद् विभुः /
समास्थाय परं भावं प्रोक्तो रुद्रो मनीषिभिः //
text_mt:
I alone am the Lord Time, indeed beginningless, bringing about the end, all-pervading;
having assumed the supreme state, I am proclaimed Rudra by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
mama vai sāparā śaktirdevī vidyeti viśrutā /
dṛṣṭā hi bhavatā nūnaṃ vidyādehastvahaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
मम वै सापरा शक्तिर्देवी विद्येति विश्रुता /
दृष्टा हि भवता नूनं विद्यादेहस्त्वहं ततः //
text_mt:
Indeed, that other power of mine is the goddess known as Wisdom;
she has certainly been seen by you; therefore I have Wisdom as my body.

sanskrit_iast:
evametāni tattvāni pradhānapuruṣeśvarāḥ /
viṣṇurbrahmā ca bhagavān rudraḥ kāla iti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
एवमेतानि तत्त्वानि प्रधानपुरुषेश्वराः /
विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा च भगवान् रुद्रः काल इति श्रुतिः //
text_mt:
Thus these principles are the primary matter, the conscious spirit, and the Lord;
revealed scripture states that Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and the Lord Rudra are Time.

sanskrit_iast:
trayametadanādyantaṃ brahmaṇyeva vyavasthitam /
tadātmakaṃ tadavyaktaṃ tadakṣaramiti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
त्रयमेतदनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्मण्येव व्यवस्थितम् /
तदात्मकं तदव्यक्तं तदक्षरमिति श्रुतिः //
text_mt:
This triad, without beginning or end, is established in Brahman alone;
revealed scripture states that it is of that nature, that unmanifest, that imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānandaparaṃ tattvaṃ cinmātraṃ paramaṃ padam /
ākāśaṃ niṣkalaṃ brahma tasmādanyanna vidyate //
meaning:
आत्मानन्दपरं तत्त्वं चिन्मात्रं परमं पदम् /
आकाशं निष्कलं ब्रह्म तस्मादन्यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt:
The supreme reality is the bliss of the Self, pure consciousness, the highest abode,
ether, the partless Brahman; other than that, nothing exists.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vijñāya bhavatā bhaktiyogāśrayeṇa tu /
saṃpūjyo vandanīyo 'haṃ tatastaṃ paśya śāśvatam //
meaning:
एवं विज्ञाय भवता भक्तियोगाश्रयेण तु /
संपूज्यो वन्दनीयो ऽहं ततस्तं पश्य शाश्वतम् //
text_mt:
Having understood this, by resorting to the yoga of devotion,
I should be worshipped and revered by you; then behold that eternal one.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvaduktvā bhagavāñjagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ /
tatraiva bhaktiyogena rudrāmārādhayanmuniḥ //
meaning:
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवाञ्जगामादर्शनं हरः /
तत्रैव भक्तियोगेन रुद्रामाराधयन्मुनिः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Lord Hara disappeared;
right there the sage worshipped Rudra through the yoga of devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
etat pavitramatulaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmarṣisevitam /
saṃsevya brāhmaṇo vidvān mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत् पवित्रमतुलं तीर्थं ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम् /
संसेव्य ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having resorted to this holy, peerless pilgrimage place frequented by Brahmin seers,
a wise Brahmin is freed from all sins.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
anyat pavitraṃ vipulaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
rudrakoṭiriti khyātaṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अन्यत् पवित्रं विपुलं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
रुद्रकोटिरिति ख्यातं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः //
title: pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt:
Sūta said:
There is another pure, vast pilgrimage place famous in the three worlds,
known as Rudrakoṭi, belonging to Rudra, the Supreme Being.

sanskrit_iast:
purā puṇyatame kāle devadarśanatatparāḥ /
koṭibrahmarṣayo dāntāstaṃ deśamagaman param //
meaning:
पुरा पुण्यतमे काले देवदर्शनतत्पराः /
कोटिब्रह्मर्षयो दान्तास्तं देशमगमन् परम् //
text_mt:
Long ago, in a most sacred time, intent upon beholding the God,
ten million self-controlled Brahmin seers went to that supreme region.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ drakṣyāmi giriśaṃ pūrvameva pinākinam /
anyo 'nyaṃ bhaktiyuktānāṃ vyāghāto jāyate kila //
meaning:
अहं द्रक्ष्यामि गिरिशं पूर्वमेव पिनाकिनम् /
अन्यो ऽन्यं भक्तियुक्तानां व्याघातो जायते किल //
text_mt:
‘I shall see Giriśa, the bearer of the Pināka, before anyone else!’
Thus an impediment arose mutually among those endowed with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā giriśo yogināṃ guruḥ /
koṭirūpo 'bhavad rudro rudrakoṭistataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां भक्तिं तदा दृष्ट्वा गिरिशो योगिनां गुरुः /
कोटिरूपो ऽभवद् रुद्रो रुद्रकोटिस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Beholding their devotion then, Giriśa, the teacher of yogins,
became ten million forms of Rudra; therefore it is remembered as Rudrakoṭi.

sanskrit_iast:
te sma sarve mahādevaṃ haraṃ giriguhāśayam /
paśyantaḥ pārvatīnāthaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭadhiyo 'bhavan //
meaning:
ते स्म सर्वे महादेवं हरं गिरिगुहाशयम् /
पश्यन्तः पार्वतीनाथं हृष्टपुष्टधियो ऽभवन् //
text_mt:
All of them, beholding Mahādeva, Hara, who rests in the mountain cave,
the lord of Pārvatī, became joyful and satisfied in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
anādyantaṃ mahādevaṃ pūrvamevāhamīśvaram /
dṛṣṭavāniti bhaktyā te rudranyastadhiyo 'bhavan //
meaning:
अनाद्यन्तं महादेवं पूर्वमेवाहमीश्वरम् /
दृष्टवानिति भक्त्या ते रुद्रन्यस्तधियो ऽभवन् //
text_mt:
‘I have seen the Lord Mahādeva, without beginning or end, before anyone else!’
Believing thus with devotion, their minds were fixed on Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ paśyanti sma mahattaram /
jyotistatraiva te sarve 'bhilaṣantaḥ paraṃ padam //
meaning:
अथान्तरिक्षे विमलं पश्यन्ति स्म महत्तरम् /
ज्योतिस्तत्रैव ते सर्वे ऽभिलषन्तः परं पदम् //
text_mt:
Then in the sky they beheld an immaculate, extremely great
radiance right there, desiring the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
etat sadeśādhyuṣitaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham /
dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ samabhyarcya rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एतत् सदेशाध्युषितं तीर्थं पुण्यतमं शुभम् /
दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं समभ्यर्च्य रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Having seen and thoroughly worshipped Rudra at this most sacred and auspicious
pilgrimage place inhabited by the virtuous, one attains nearness to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā madhuvanaṃ smṛtam /
tatra gatvā niyamavānindrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं नाम्ना मधुवनं स्मृतम् /
तत्र गत्वा नियमवानिन्द्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत् //
text_mt:
And there is another excellent pilgrimage place, remembered by the name Madhuvana;
having gone there, disciplined by vows, one obtains half of Indra's seat.

sanskrit_iast:
athānyatpuṣpanagarī deśaḥ puṇyatamaḥ śubhaḥ /
tatra gatvā pitṝn pūjya kulānāṃ tārayecchatam //
meaning:
अथान्यत्पुष्पनगरी देशः पुण्यतमः शुभः /
तत्र गत्वा पितॄन् पूज्य कुलानां तारयेच्छतम् //
text_mt:
Then there is another, Puṣpanagarī, a most sacred and auspicious region;
having gone there and worshipped the ancestors, one delivers a hundred families across.

sanskrit_iast:
kālañjaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ loke rudro maheśvaraḥ /
kālaṃ jaritavān devo yatra bhaktipriyo haraḥ //
meaning:
कालञ्जरं महातीर्थं लोके रुद्रो महेश्वरः /
कालं जरितवान् देवो यत्र भक्तिप्रियो हरः //
text_mt:
Kālañjara is a great pilgrimage place where Rudra Maheśvara, the God,
Hara who is fond of devotion, caused Time (Kāla) to age in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
śveto nāma śive bhakto rājarṣipravaraḥ purā /
tadāśīstannamaskāraḥ pūjayāmāsa śūlinam //
meaning:
श्वेतो नाम शिवे भक्तो राजर्षिप्रवरः पुरा /
तदाशीस्तन्नमस्कारः पूजयामास शूलिनम् //
text_mt:
Long ago, an eminent royal seer named Śveta was devoted to Śiva;
offering his blessings and obeisances to him, he worshipped the bearer of the trident.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya vidhinā liṅgaṃ bhaktiyogapuraḥ saraḥ /
jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य विधिना लिङ्गं भक्तियोगपुरः सरः /
जजाप रुद्रमनिशं तत्र संन्यस्तमानसः //
text_mt:
Having installed a liṅga according to rule, preceded by the yoga of devotion,
with his mind surrendered unto it, he chanted Rudra's [hymn] day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taṃ kālo 'tha dīptātmā śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam /
netumabhyāgato deśaṃ sa rājā yatra tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
स तं कालो ऽथ दीप्तात्मा शूलमादाय भीषणम् /
नेतुमभ्यागतो देशं स राजा यत्र तिष्ठति //
text_mt:
Then Time of blazing self, seizing a terrifying trident,
arrived to carry him away to that place where the king stood.

sanskrit_iast:
vīkṣya rājā bhayāviṣṭaḥ śūlahastaṃ samāgatam /
kālaṃ kālakaraṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ caṇḍadīdhitim //
meaning:
वीक्ष्य राजा भयाविष्टः शूलहस्तं समागतम् /
कालं कालकरं घोरं भीषणं चण्डदीधितिम् //
text_mt:
Seeing that terrible, fierce, frightful Time of scorching splendor,
who brings death, arrive with trident in hand, the king was overcome with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
ubābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ spṛṭvāsau liṅgamaiśvaram /
nanāma śirasā rudraṃ jajāpa śatarudriyam //
meaning:
उबाभ्यामथ हस्ताभ्यां स्पृट्वासौ लिङ्गमैश्वरम् /
ननाम शिरसा रुद्रं जजाप शतरुद्रियम् //
text_mt:
Then, touching the divine liṅga with both hands,
he bowed his head to Rudra and chanted the Śatarudriya.

sanskrit_iast:
japantamāha rājānaṃ namantamasakṛd bhavam /
ehyehīti puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāntaḥ prahasanniva //
meaning:
जपन्तमाह राजानं नमन्तमसकृद् भवम् /
एह्येहीति पुरः स्थित्वा कृतान्तः प्रहसन्निव //
text_mt:
Standing in front of the chanting king who repeatedly bowed to Bhava,
Death spoke to him as if laughing: ‘Come, come!’

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca bhayāviṣṭo rājā rudraparāyaṇaḥ /
ekamīśārcanarataṃ vihāyānyaṃ niṣūdaya //
meaning:
तमुवाच भयाविष्टो राजा रुद्रपरायणः /
एकमीशार्चनरतं विहायान्यं निषूदय //
text_mt:
Overcome with fear, the king, intent upon Rudra, said to him:
‘Leaving this one devoted to the worship of the Lord, slay another!’

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavantaṃ bhagavānabravīd bhītamānasam /
rudrārcanarato vānyo madvaśe ko na tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
इत्युक्तवन्तं भगवानब्रवीद् भीतमानसम् /
रुद्रार्चनरतो वान्यो मद्वशे को न तिष्ठति //
text_mt:
To him who had spoken thus, the Lord [Time] said to his frightened mind:
‘Whether devoted to the worship of Rudra or another, who does not stay under my control?’

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā sa rājānaṃ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ /
babandha pāśai rājāpi jajāpa śatarudriyam //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा स राजानं कालो लोकप्रकालनः /
बबन्ध पाशै राजापि जजाप शतरुद्रियम् //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to the king, Time, who drives forth the worlds,
bound [him] with nooses, yet the king still chanted the Śatarudriya.

sanskrit_iast:
athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ dīpyamānaṃ
tejorāśiṃ bhūtabhartuḥ purāṇam /
jvālāmālāsaṃvṛtaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ
prādurbhūtaṃ saṃsthitaṃ saṃdadarśa //
meaning:
अथान्तरिक्षे विमलं दीप्यमानं
तेजोराशिं भूतभर्तुः पुराणम् /
ज्वालामालासंवृतं व्याप्य विश्वं
प्रादुर्भूतं संस्थितं संददर्श //
text_mt:
Then in the sky he beheld the ancient mass of splendor
of the Lord of beings, spotless and blazing,
surrounded by garlands of flames, pervading the universe,
manifested and stationed [there].

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye 'sau puruṣaṃ rukmavarṇaṃ
devyā devaṃ candralekhojjvalāṅgam /
tejorūpaṃ paśyati smātihṛṣṭo
mene cāsmannātha āgacchatīti //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये ऽसौ पुरुषं रुक्मवर्णं
देव्या देवं चन्द्रलेखोज्ज्वलाङ्गम् /
तेजोरूपं पश्यति स्मातिहृष्टो
मेने चास्मन्नाथ आगच्छतीति //
text_mt:
In its midst he saw the Person of golden hue,
the God with the Goddess, his limbs shining with the crescent moon,
embodied as radiance; highly delighted, he thought: ‘Our Lord has come!’

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchantaṃ nātidūre 'tha dṛṣṭvā
kālo rudraṃ devadevyā maheśam /
vyapetabhīrakhileśaikanāthaṃ
rājarṣistaṃ netumabhyājagāma //
meaning:
आगच्छन्तं नातिदूरे ऽथ दृष्ट्वा
कालो रुद्रं देवदेव्या महेशम् /
व्यपेतभीरखिलेशैकनाथं
राजर्षिस्तं नेतुमभ्याजगाम //

sanskrit_iast:
ālokyāsau bhagavānugrakarmā
devo rudro bhūtabhartā purāṇaḥ /
ekaṃ bhaktaṃ matparaṃ māṃ smarantaṃ
dehītīmaṃ kālamūce mameti //
meaning:
आलोक्यासौ भगवानुग्रकर्मा
देवो रुद्रो भूतभर्ता पुराणः /
एकं भक्तं मत्परं मां स्मरन्तं
देहीतीमं कालमूचे ममेति //
text_mt:
Beholding this, that Lord of fierce deeds,
the God Rudra, the ancient Lord of beings,
said to Time: ‘Give [me] this single devotee who is devoted to me, remembering me as mine!’

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākhyaṃ gopaterugrabhāvaḥ
kālātmāsau manyamānaḥ svabhāvam /
baddhvā bhaktaṃ punarevātha pāśaiḥ
kruddho rudramabhidudrāva vegāt //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाख्यं गोपतेरुग्रभावः
कालात्मासौ मन्यमानः स्वभावम् /
बद्ध्वा भक्तं पुनरेवाथ पाशैः
क्रुद्धो रुद्रमभिदुद्राव वेगात् //
text_mt:
Hearing the words of the Lord of herds, he of ferocious nature,
whose nature is Time, asserting his own essence,
having bound the devotee again with nooses,
rushed furiously toward Rudra with speed.

sanskrit_iast:
prekṣyāyāntaṃ śailaputrīmatheśaḥ
so 'nvīkṣyānte viśvamāyāvidhijñaḥ /
sāvajñaṃ vai vāmapādena mṛtyuṃ
śvetasyainaṃ paśyato vyājaghāna //
meaning:
प्रेक्ष्यायान्तं शैलपुत्रीमथेशः
सो ऽन्वीक्ष्यान्ते विश्वमायाविधिज्ञः /
सावज्ञं वै वामपादेन मृत्युं
श्वेतस्यैनं पश्यतो व्याजघान //
text_mt: Then the Lord, who knows the working of all cosmic illusion, / seeing the Daughter of the Mountain and looking at the end, / contemptuously struck Death with his left foot / while Śveta looked on.

sanskrit_iast:
mamāra so 'tibhīṣaṇo maheśapādaghātitaḥ /
rarāja devatāpatiḥ sahomayā pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
ममार सो ऽतिभीषणो महेशपादघातितः /
रराज देवतापतिः सहोमया पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt: That most terrifying one, struck down by Maheśvara's foot, died; / and the Lord of deities, holder of the Pināka bow, shone forth along with Umā.

sanskrit_iast:
nirīkṣya devamīśvaraṃ prahṛṣṭamānaso haram /
nanāma sāmbamavyayaṃ sa rājapuṅgavastadā //
meaning:
निरीक्ष्य देवमीश्वरं प्रहृष्टमानसो हरम् /
ननाम साम्बमव्ययं स राजपुङ्गवस्तदा //
text_mt: Beholding the Lord, the deity Hara, with joyful mind, / that eminent king then bowed to the imperishable Lord with Ambā:

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhavāya hetave harāya viśvasaṃbhave /
namaḥ śivāya dhīmate namo 'pavargadāyine //
meaning:
नमो भवाय हेतवे हराय विश्वसंभवे /
नमः शिवाय धीमते नमो ऽपवर्गदायिने //
text_mt: "Salutations to Bhava, to the Cause, to Hara, the origin of the universe! / Salutations to Śiva the wise, salutations to the bestower of liberation!

sanskrit_iast:
namo namo namo 'stu te mahāvibhūtaye namaḥ /
vibhāgahīnarūpiṇe namo narādhipāya te //
meaning:
नमो नमो नमो ऽस्तु ते महाविभूतये नमः /
विभागहीनरूपिणे नमो नराधिपाय ते //
text_mt: Salutations, salutations, salutations be to you! Salutations to the one of great sovereign glory! / To the one whose form is indivisible, salutations to you, the sovereign ruler of men!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te gaṇeśvara prapannaduḥ khanāśana /
anādinityabhūtaye varāhaśṛṅgadhāriṇe //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते गणेश्वर प्रपन्नदुः खनाशन /
अनादिनित्यभूतये वराहशृङ्गधारिणे //
text_mt: Salutations be to you, Lord of the retinue, destroyer of the suffering of the surrendered! / To the one of beginningless and eternal sovereign glory, to the wearer of the boar's tusk!

sanskrit_iast:
namo vṛṣadhvajāya te kapālamāline namaḥ /
namo mahānaṭāya te namo vṛṣadhvajāya te //
meaning:
नमो वृषध्वजाय ते कपालमालिने नमः /
नमो महानटाय ते नमो वृषध्वजाय ते //
text_mt: Salutations to you whose banner is the bull, salutations to the wearer of the garland of skulls! / Salutations to you, the great dancer! Salutations to you whose banner is the bull!"

sanskrit_iast:
athānugṛhya śaṅkaraḥ praṇāmatatparaṃ nṛpam /
svagāṇapatyamavyayaṃ sarūpatāmatho dadau //
meaning:
अथानुगृह्य शङ्करः प्रणामतत्परं नृपम् /
स्वगाणपत्यमव्ययं सरूपतामथो ददौ //
text_mt: Then, having shown grace to the king devoted to bowing, Śaṅkara / bestowed his own imperishable leadership of the retinue and similarity of divine form.

sanskrit_iast:
sahomayā sapārṣadaḥ sarājapuṅgavo haraḥ /
munīśasiddhavanditaḥ kṣaṇādadṛśyatāmagāt //
meaning:
सहोमया सपार्षदः सराजपुङ्गवो हरः /
मुनीशसिद्धवन्दितः क्षणाददृश्यतामगात् //
text_mt: Hara, accompanied by Umā, his attendants, and the eminent king, / praised by eminent sages and Siddhas, vanished in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle maheśābhihate lokanāthaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
ayācata varaṃ rudraṃ sajīvo 'yaṃ bhavatviti //
meaning:
काले महेशाभिहते लोकनाथः पितामहः /
अयाचत वरं रुद्रं सजीवो ऽयं भवत्विति //
text_mt: When Death had been struck down by Maheśvara, the grandfather, the Lord of the worlds, / asked a boon of Rudra: "Let him become alive again!

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti kaścidapīśāna doṣaleśo vṛṣadhvaja /
kṛtāntasyaiva bhavatā tatkārye viniyojitaḥ //
meaning:
नास्ति कश्चिदपीशान दोषलेशो वृषध्वज /
कृतान्तस्यैव भवता तत्कार्ये विनियोजितः //
text_mt: There is not the least fault, O Īśāna, O you whose banner is the bull, / on the part of Death; he was merely appointed by you to that task."

sanskrit_iast:
sa devadevavacanād devadeveśvaro haraḥ /
tathāstvityāha viśvātmā so 'pi tādṛgvidho 'bhavat //
meaning:
स देवदेववचनाद् देवदेवेश्वरो हरः /
तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा सो ऽपि तादृग्विधो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: At the words of the god of gods, Hara, the sovereign Lord of the gods of gods and Soul of all, / said, "So be it"; and he too became as he had been.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ kālañjaramiti śrutam /
gatvābhyarcya mahādevaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ sa vindati //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येतत् परमं तीर्थं कालञ्जरमिति श्रुतम् /
गत्वाभ्यर्च्य महादेवं गाणपत्यं स विन्दति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this is the supreme sacred ford renowned as Kālañjara. / Having gone and worshipped Mahādeva there, one attains leadership of his retinue.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
idanamanyate paraṃ sthānaṃ guhyād guhyatamaṃ mahat /
mahādevasya devasya mahālayamiti śrutam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इदनमन्यते परं स्थानं गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं महत् /
महादेवस्य देवस्य महालयमिति श्रुतम् //
title: ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Now another supreme place is considered, most secret of secrets, great, / renowned as Mahālaya, belonging to the deity Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devādidevena rudreṇa tripurāriṇā /
śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam //
meaning:
तत्र देवादिदेवेन रुद्रेण त्रिपुरारिणा /
शिलातले पदं न्यस्तं नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम् //
text_mt: There, the first god of gods, Rudra, the enemy of Tripura, / placed his footprint upon a slab of rock as evidence for atheists.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra puśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ /
upāsate mahādevaṃ vedādhyayanatatparāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र पुशुपताः शान्ता भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः /
उपासते महादेवं वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः //
text_mt: There tranquil Pāśupatas, their bodies smeared with ash, / devoted to Vedic study, worship Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā tatra padaṃ śārvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktipuraḥ saram /
namaskṛtvātha śirasā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
स्नात्वा तत्र पदं शार्वं दृष्ट्वा भक्तिपुरः सरम् /
नमस्कृत्वाथ शिरसा रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having bathed there, beholding the footprint of Śarva with devotion, / and bowing with one's head, one attains proximity to Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ śaṃbhormahātmanaḥ /
kedāramiti vikhyātaṃ siddhānāmālayaṃ śubham //
meaning:
अन्यच्च देवदेवस्य स्थानं शंभोर्महात्मनः /
केदारमिति विख्यातं सिद्धानामालयं शुभम् //
text_mt: There is also another auspicious dwelling of the Siddhas, a place of the great-souled Śambhu, / the god of gods, celebrated as Kedāra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā mahādevamabhyarcya vṛṣaketanam /
pītvā caivodakaṃ śuddhaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवमभ्यर्च्य वृषकेतनम् /
पीत्वा चैवोदकं शुद्धं गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having bathed there, worshipped Mahādeva whose banner is the bull, / and drunk pure water, one attains leadership of his retinue.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtvā hyakṣyaṃ labhate phalam /
dvijātipravarairjuṣṭaṃ yogibhiryatamānasaiḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धदानादिकं कृत्वा ह्यक्ष्यं लभते फलम् /
द्विजातिप्रवरैर्जुष्टं योगिभिर्यतमानसैः //
text_mt: Performing ancestral offering rites, gifts, and the like, one obtains an imperishable fruit. / It is frequented by eminent twice-born people and by yogins with restrained minds.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ plakṣāvataraṇaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam /
tatrābhyarcya śrīnivāsaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तीर्थं प्लक्षावतरणं सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
तत्राभ्यर्च्य श्रीनिवासं विष्णुलोके महीयते //
text_mt: The sacred ford Plakṣāvataraṇa destroys all sins; / having worshipped the Abode of Śrī there, one is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
anyaṃ magadharājasya tīrthaṃ svargagatipradam /
akṣayaṃ vindati svargaṃ tatra gatvā dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यं मगधराजस्य तीर्थं स्वर्गगतिप्रदम् /
अक्षयं विन्दति स्वर्गं तत्र गत्वा द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt: There is another sacred ford belonging to the king of Magadha that grants the course to heaven; / having gone there, an excellent twice-born person attains imperishable heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam /
yatra devena rudreṇa yajño dakṣasya nāśitaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थं कनखलं पुण्यं महापातकनाशनम् /
यत्र देवेन रुद्रेण यज्ञो दक्षस्य नाशितः //
text_mt: The holy sacred ford Kanakhala destroys great sins, / where the sacrifice of Dakṣa was destroyed by the god Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gaṅgāmupaspṛśya śucirbhāvasamanvitaḥ /
mucyate sarvapāpaistu brahmalokaṃ labhenmṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र गङ्गामुपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भावसमन्वितः /
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु ब्रह्मलोकं लभेन्मृतः //
text_mt: Having touched the Gaṅgā there, pure and endowed with faith, / one is freed from all sins, and upon dying attains the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahātīrthamiti khyātaṃ puṇyaṃ nārāyaṇapriyam /
tatrābhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ nigacchati //
meaning:
महातीर्थमिति ख्यातं पुण्यं नारायणप्रियम् /
तत्राभ्यर्च्य हृषीकेशं श्वेतद्वीपं निगच्छति //
text_mt: The sacred ford renowned as Mahātīrtha is holy and dear to Nārāyaṇa; / having worshipped Hṛṣīkeśa there, one goes to Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā śrīparvataṃ śubham /
tatra prāṇān parityajya rudrasya dayito bhavet //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं नाम्ना श्रीपर्वतं शुभम् /
तत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य रुद्रस्य दयितो भवेत् //
text_mt: There is also an auspicious, excellent sacred ford named Śrīparvata; / having abandoned one's life-breaths there, one becomes beloved of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sannihito rudro devyā saha maheśvaraḥ /
snānapiṇḍādikaṃ tatra kṛtamakṣayyamuttamam //
meaning:
तत्र सन्निहितो रुद्रो देव्या सह महेश्वरः /
स्नानपिण्डादिकं तत्र कृतमक्षय्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: There Maheśvara Rudra is ever present along with the goddess; / bathing, offering funeral balls, and the like done there become imperishable and supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
godāvarī nadī puṇyā sarvapāpavināśanī /
tatra snātvā pitṝn devāṃstarpayitvā yathāvidhi /
sarvapāpavisuddhātmā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
गोदावरी नदी पुण्या सर्वपापविनाशनी /
तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन् देवांस्तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि /
सर्वपापविसुद्धात्मा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: The holy river Godāvarī destroys all sins; / having bathed there and gratified the ancestors and gods according to the rules, / purified of all sins, one obtains the fruit of a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrasalilā puṇyā kāverī vipulā nadī /
tasyāṃ snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ /
trirātropoṣitenātha ekarātroṣitena vā //
meaning:
पवित्रसलिला पुण्या कावेरी विपुला नदी /
तस्यां स्नात्वोदकं कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः /
त्रिरात्रोपोषितेनाथ एकरात्रोषितेन वा //
text_mt: The vast river Kāverī is holy, with pure waters; / having bathed and offered water in it after fasting for three nights or one night, / one is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātīnāṃ tu kathitaṃ tīrthānāmiha sevanam /
yasya vāṅmanaso śuddhe hastapādau ca saṃsthitau /
alolupo brahmacāro tīrthānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
द्विजातीनां तु कथितं तीर्थानामिह सेवनम् /
यस्य वाङ्मनसो शुद्धे हस्तपादौ च संस्थितौ /
अलोलुपो ब्रह्मचारो तीर्थानां फलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: This resort to sacred fords has been prescribed for the twice-born: / he whose speech and mind are pure, whose hands and feet are restrained, / who is free from greed and observes celibacy, obtains the fruit of sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmitīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
tatra sannihito nityaṃ skando 'maranamaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
स्वामितीर्थं महातीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् /
तत्र सन्निहितो नित्यं स्कन्दो ऽमरनमस्कृतः //
text_mt: Svāmitīrtha is a great sacred ford renowned in the three worlds; / Skanda, bowed to by the immortals, is ever present there.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā kumāradhārāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam /
ārādhya ṣaṇmukhaṃ devaṃ skandena saha modate //
meaning:
स्नात्वा कुमारधारायां कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम् /
आराध्य षण्मुखं देवं स्कन्देन सह मोदते //
text_mt: Having bathed in Kumāradhārā and performed the gratifications to gods and others, / and having worshipped the six-faced deity, one rejoices with Skanda.

sanskrit_iast:
nadī trailokyavikhyātā tāmraparṇoti nāmataḥ /
tatra snātvā pitṝn bhaktyā tarpayitvā yathāvidhi /
pāpakartṝnapi pitṝstārayennātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
नदी त्रैलोक्यविख्याता ताम्रपर्णोति नामतः /
तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन् भक्त्या तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि /
पापकर्तॄनपि पितॄस्तारयेन्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: There is a river renowned across the three worlds by the name Tāmraparṇī; / having bathed there and gratified the ancestors with devotion according to the rules, / one delivers even sin-committing ancestors—of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
candratīrthamiti khyātaṃ kāveryāḥ prabhave 'kṣayam /
tīrthaṃ tatra bhaved vastuṃ mṛtānāṃ svargatirdhruvā //
meaning:
चन्द्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं कावेर्याः प्रभवे ऽक्षयम् /
तीर्थं तत्र भवेद् वस्तुं मृतानां स्वर्गतिर्ध्रुवा //
text_mt: The imperishable sacred ford known as Candratīrtha is at the source of the Kāverī; / to dwell at that sacred ford ensures heaven for those who die there.

sanskrit_iast:
vindhyapāde prapaśyanti devadevaṃ sadāśivam /
bhaktyā ye te na paśyanti yamasya sadanaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
विन्ध्यपादे प्रपश्यन्ति देवदेवं सदाशिवम् /
भक्त्या ये ते न पश्यन्ति यमस्य सदनं द्विजाः //
text_mt: Those who with devotion behold the god of gods, Sadāśiva, at the foot of the Vindhya, / do not see the abode of Yama, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
devikāyāṃ vṛṣo nāma tīrthaṃ siddhaniṣevitam /
tatra snātvodakaṃ datvā yogasiddhiṃ ca vindati //
meaning:
देविकायां वृषो नाम तीर्थं सिद्धनिषेवितम् /
तत्र स्नात्वोदकं दत्वा योगसिद्धिं च विन्दति //
text_mt: On the Devikā is a sacred ford named Vṛṣa, frequented by Siddhas; / having bathed there and offered water, one attains success in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam /
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ tatrāpnoti phalaṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
दशानामश्वमेधानां तत्राप्नोति फलं नरः //
text_mt: The sacred ford Daśāśvamedhika destroys all sins; / a man attains there the fruit of ten horse sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍarīkaṃ mahātīrthaṃ brāhmaṇairupasevitam /
tatrābhigamya yuktātmā pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
पुण्डरीकं महातीर्थं ब्राह्मणैरुपसेवितम् /
तत्राभिगम्य युक्तात्मा पौण्डरीकफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: The great sacred ford Puṇḍarīka is frequented by brāhmaṇas; / having gone there with concentrated mind, one obtains the fruit of a Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthebhyaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmatīrthamiti śrutam /
brahmāṇamarcayitvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तीर्थेभ्यः परमं तीर्थं ब्रह्मतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् /
ब्रह्माणमर्चयित्वा तु ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: The sacred ford supreme among sacred fords is renowned as Brahmatīrtha; / having worshipped Brahmā there, one is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasvatyā vinaśanaṃ plakṣaprastravaṇaṃ śubham /
vyāsatīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mainākaṃ ca nagottamam /
yamunāprabhavaṃ caiva sarvapāpaviśodhanam //
meaning:
सरस्वत्या विनशनं प्लक्षप्रस्त्रवणं शुभम् /
व्यासतीर्थं परं तीर्थं मैनाकं च नगोत्तमम् /
यमुनाप्रभवं चैव सर्वपापविशोधनम् //
text_mt: The disappearance of the Sarasvatī, the auspicious Plakṣaprastravaṇa, / the supreme Vyāsatīrtha, Maināka the best of mountains, / and the source of the Yamunā purify all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ duhitā devī gandhakālīti viśrutā /
tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ yāti mṛto jātismaro bhavet //
meaning:
पितॄणां दुहिता देवी गन्धकालीति विश्रुता /
तस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं याति मृतो जातिस्मरो भवेत् //
text_mt: The goddess celebrated as Gandhakālī is the daughter of the ancestors; / having bathed in her, one goes to heaven, and when dead, remembers one's former births.

sanskrit_iast:
kuberatuṅgaṃ pāpaghnaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam /
prāṇāṃstatra parityajya kuberānucaro bhavet //
meaning:
कुबेरतुङ्गं पापघ्नं सिद्धचारणसेवितम् /
प्राणांस्तत्र परित्यज्य कुबेरानुचरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Kuberatuṅga destroys sin and is frequented by Siddhas and Cāraṇas; / having abandoned one's life-breaths there, one becomes an attendant of Kubera.

sanskrit_iast:
umātuṅgamiti khyātaṃ yatra sā rudravallabhā /
tatrābhyarcya mahādevīṃ kosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
उमातुङ्गमिति ख्यातं यत्र सा रुद्रवल्लभा /
तत्राभ्यर्च्य महादेवीं कोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: The peak known as Umātuṅga is where that beloved of Rudra dwells; / having worshipped the Great Goddess there, one obtains the fruit of a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgutuṅge tapastaptaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā kṛtam /
kulānyubhayataḥ sapta punātīti śrutirmama //
meaning:
भृगुतुङ्गे तपस्तप्तं श्राद्धं दानं तथा कृतम् /
कुलान्युभयतः सप्त पुनातीति श्रुतिर्मम //
text_mt: Austerity performed, ancestral offering rites, and gifts made on Bhṛgutuṅga / purify seven generations on both sides—such is my scriptural tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyapasya mahātīrthaṃ kālasarpiriti śrutam /
tatra śrāddhāni deyāni nityaṃ pāpakṣayecchayā //
meaning:
काश्यपस्य महातीर्थं कालसर्पिरिति श्रुतम् /
तत्र श्राद्धानि देयानि नित्यं पापक्षयेच्छया //
text_mt: The great holy place of Kaśyapa is known as Kālasarpi. / There ancestral offering rites should always be performed by one desiring the destruction of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
daśārṇāyāṃ tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ homastathā japaḥ /
akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvadā //
meaning:
दशार्णायां तथा दानं श्राद्धं होमस्तथा जपः /
अक्षयं चाव्ययं चैव कृतं भवति सर्वदा //
text_mt: Likewise, a gift, an ancestral offering rite, a fire oblation, and muttering [of mantras] at Daśārṇā, / once performed, always becomes imperishable and inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ dvijātibhirjuṣṭaṃ nāmnā vai kurujāṅgalam /
dattvā tu dānaṃ vidhivad brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तीर्थं द्विजातिभिर्जुष्टं नाम्ना वै कुरुजाङ्गलम् /
दत्त्वा तु दानं विधिवद् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: There is a holy place frequented by twice-born men, indeed named Kurujāṅgala; / having given a gift there according to rule, one is exalted in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vaitaraṇyāṃ mahātīrthe svarṇavedyāṃ tathaiva ca /
dharmapṛṣṭhe ca sarasi brahmaṇaḥ parame śubhe //
meaning:
वैतरण्यां महातीर्थे स्वर्णवेद्यां तथैव च /
धर्मपृष्ठे च सरसि ब्रह्मणः परमे शुभे //
text_mt: At the great holy place Vaitaraṇī, and likewise at Svarṇavedī, / and at Dharmapṛṣṭha, at the supremely auspicious lake of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
bharatasyāśrame puṇye puṇye śrāddhavaṭe śubhe /
mahāhrade ca kauśikyāṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam //
meaning:
भरतस्याश्रमे पुण्ये पुण्ये श्राद्धवटे शुभे /
महाह्रदे च कौशिक्यां दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: at the holy hermitage of Bharata, at the holy, auspicious Śrāddhavaṭa, / and at the great pool at Kauśikī, what is given becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
muñjapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyastaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā /
hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam //
meaning:
मुञ्जपृष्ठे पदं न्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता /
हिताय सर्वभूतानां नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम् //
text_mt: On Muñjapṛṣṭha a footprint was placed by wise Mahādeva / for the benefit of all beings, as a demonstration to atheists.

sanskrit_iast:
alpenāpi tu kālena naro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ /
pāpmānamutsṛjatyāśu jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ //
meaning:
अल्पेनापि तु कालेन नरो धर्मपरायणः /
पाप्मानमुत्सृजत्याशु जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः //
text_mt: Even in a short time, a person devoted to righteousness / quickly casts off sin, like a snake its worn-out skin.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnā kanakanandeti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
udīcyāṃ muñjapṛṣṭhasya brahmarṣigaṇasevitam //
meaning:
नाम्ना कनकनन्देति तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
उदीच्यां मुञ्जपृष्ठस्य ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम् //
text_mt: To the north of Muñjapṛṣṭha is a holy place celebrated in the three worlds, / named Kanakanandā, frequented by hosts of brahmin seers.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti saśarīrā dvijātayaḥ /
dattaṃ cāpi sadā śrāddhamakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam /
ṛṇaistribhirnaraḥ snātvā mucyate kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति सशरीरा द्विजातयः /
दत्तं चापि सदा श्राद्धमक्षयं समुदाहृतम् /
ऋणैस्त्रिभिर्नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते क्षीणकल्मषः //
text_mt: Having bathed there, twice-born men go bodily to heaven, / and an ancestral offering rite given there is declared to be forever imperishable. / Having bathed, a person is freed from the three debts, sins diminished.

sanskrit_iast:
mānase sarasi snātvā śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet /
uttaraṃ mānasaṃ gatvā siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām //
meaning:
मानसे सरसि स्नात्वा शक्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत् /
उत्तरं मानसं गत्वा सिद्धिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: Having bathed in Lake Mānasa, one obtains half the seat of Śakra; / having gone to Northern Mānasa, one attains unsurpassed perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnirvartayecchrāddhaṃ yathāśakti yathābalam /
kāmān salabhate divyān mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati //
meaning:
तस्मान्निर्वर्तयेच्छ्राद्धं यथाशक्ति यथाबलम् /
कामान् सलभते दिव्यान् मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति //
text_mt: Therefore, one should perform an ancestral offering rite according to one's capacity and strength; / one obtains divine desires and finds the means to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
parvato himavānnāma nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ /
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi so 'śītistvāyato giriḥ /
siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇo devarṣigaṇasevitaḥ //
meaning:
पर्वतो हिमवान्नाम नानाधातुविभूषितः /
योजनानां सहस्राणि सो ऽशीतिस्त्वायतो गिरिः /
सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णो देवर्षिगणसेवितः //
text_mt: There is a mountain named Himavat, adorned with various minerals; / that mountain extends eighty thousand yojanas in length, / crowded with siddhas and cāraṇas, frequented by hosts of celestial seers.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra puṣkariṇī ramyā suṣumnā nāma nāmataḥ /
tatra gatvā dvijo vidvān brahmahatyāṃ vimuñcati //
meaning:
तत्र पुष्करिणी रम्या सुषुम्ना नाम नामतः /
तत्र गत्वा द्विजो विद्वान् ब्रह्महत्यां विमुञ्चति //
text_mt: There is a lovely lotus pool there, Suṣumnā by name; / having gone there, a wise twice-born man is freed from the murder of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayyaṃ tatra dattaṃ mahodayam /
tārayecca pitṝn samyag daśa pūrvān daśāparān //
meaning:
श्राद्धं भवति चाक्षय्यं तत्र दत्तं महोदयम् /
तारयेच्च पितॄन् सम्यग् दश पूर्वान् दशापरान् //
