मुनिभिः कथिता पूर्वमीश्वरेण स्वयंभुवा //
title: ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Narmadā is the best of rivers, destroying all sins; / it was spoken of formerly by the sages and by the self-existent Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
munibhiḥ saṃstutā hyeṣā narmadā pravarā nadī /
rudragātrād viniṣkrāntā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
मुनिभिः संस्तुता ह्येषा नर्मदा प्रवरा नदी /
रुद्रगात्राद् विनिष्क्रान्ता लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: This excellent river Narmadā was indeed praised by the sages; / it emerged from the body of Rudra out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpaharā nityaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtā /
saṃstutā devagandharvairapyarobhistathaiva ca //
meaning:
सर्वपापहरा नित्यं सर्वदेवनमस्कृता /
संस्तुता देवगन्धर्वैरप्यरोभिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: It always removes all sins and is bowed to by all gods; / it is praised by gods, gandharvas, and likewise by apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare caiva tatkūle tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
nāmnā bhadreśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham /
tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha mohate //
meaning:
उत्तरे चैव तत्कूले तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
नाम्ना भद्रेश्वरं पुण्यं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दैवतैः सह मोहते //
text_mt: And on its northern bank is a pilgrimage site renowned throughout the three worlds, / named Bhadreśvara, holy, removing all sins, and auspicious; / bathing there, O king, a man rejoices along with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthamāmrātakeśvaram /
tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थमाम्रातकेश्वरम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to the pilgrimage site Āmrātakeśvara; / bathing there, O king, a man obtains the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'ṅgāreśvaraṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो ऽङ्गारेश्वरं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, restrained and eating measured food, one should go to Aṅgāreśvara; / his soul purified of all sins, he is glorified in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra kedāraṃ nāma puṇyadam /
tatra snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र केदारं नाम पुण्यदम् /
तत्र स्नात्वोदकं कृत्वा सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to the merit-yielding place called Kedāra; / having bathed there and offered water, one obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pippaleśaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam /
tatra snātvā mahārāja rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
पिप्पलेशं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Pippaleśa, which destroys all sins; / bathing there, O great king, he is glorified in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra vimaleśvaramuttamam /
tatra prāṇān parityajya rudralokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र विमलेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
तत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to supreme Vimaleśvara; / giving up one's life-breaths there, one attains the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra indrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र इन्द्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Puṣkariṇī and perform a bath there; / merely by bathing there, a man obtains half of Indra's throne.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra śūlabhedamiti śrutam /
tatra snātvārcayed devaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शूलभेदमिति श्रुतम् /
तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद् देवं गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to that which is known as Śūlabheda; / bathing there and worshiping the god, one obtains the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra balitīrthamanuttam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan sihāsanapatirbhavet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र बलितीर्थमनुत्तम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सिहासनपतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to the unsurpassed Balitīrtha; / bathing there, O king, a man becomes the master of a throne.

sanskrit_iast:
śakratīrthaṃ tato gacchet kūle caiva tu dakṣiṇe /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
शक्रतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् कूले चैव तु दक्षिणे /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि //
text_mt: Then one should go to Śakratīrtha, on the southern bank; / fasting for one night and performing a bath according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayenmahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim /
gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
आराधयेन्महायोगं देवं नारायणं हरिम् /
गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: one should venerate God Nārāyaṇa, Hari, the Great Yoga; / obtaining the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣitīrthaṃ tato gatvā sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām /
snātamātro narastatra śivaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ऋषितीर्थं ततो गत्वा सर्वपापहरं नृणाम् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र शिवलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, going to Ṛṣitīrtha, which takes away all sins of mortals, / merely by bathing there, a man is glorified in the realm of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradasya tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam /
snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
नारदस्य तु तत्रैव तीर्थं परमशोभनम् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: And right there is the supremely splendid pilgrimage site of Nārada; / merely by bathing there, a man obtains the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ nāradena surarṣiṇā /
pratīstasya dadau yogaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यत्र तप्तं तपः पूर्वं नारदेन सुरर्षिणा /
प्रतीस्तस्य ददौ योगं देवदेवो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Where austerities were formerly performed by the celestial sage Nārada, / pleased with him, the God of gods, Maheśvara, granted yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeśvaramiti śrutam /
yatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् /
यत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: The liṅga fashioned by Brahmā is known as Brahmeśvara; / bathing where, O king, a man is glorified in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sa ṛṇānmucyate dhruvam /
maheśvaraṃ tato gacchet paryāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam //
meaning:
ऋणतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स ऋणान्मुच्यते ध्रुवम् /
महेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् पर्याप्तं जन्मनः फलम् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Ṛṇatīrtha; he is certainly freed from debt; / then one should go to Maheśvara: the fruit of one's birth is complete.

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchet sarvavyādhivināśanam /
snātamātro narastatra sarvaduḥkhaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
भीमेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वदुःखैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Bhīmeśvara, which destroys all diseases; / merely by bathing there, a man is freed from all suffering.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam /
ahorātropavāsena trirātraphalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र पिङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
अहोरात्रोपवासेन त्रिरात्रफलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to supreme Piṅgaleśvara; / by fasting for a day and night, one obtains the fruit of three nights [of fasting].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃmastīrthe tu rājendra kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati /
yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca /
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तस्मिंमस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति /
यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि तत्प्रसूतिकुलेषु च /
तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Whoever gives a brown cow at that pilgrimage site, O best of kings, / for as many hairs as she and the line of her offspring have, / for so many thousands of years is he glorified in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu prāṇaparityāgaṃ kuryāt tatra narādhipa /
akṣayaṃ modate kālaṃ yāvaccandradivākarau //
meaning:
यस्तु प्राणपरित्यागं कुर्यात् तत्र नराधिप /
अक्षयं मोदते कालं यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ //
text_mt: And whoever gives up their life-breaths there, O ruler of men, / rejoices for an imperishable time, as long as the moon and sun endure.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadātaṭamāśritya tiṣṭhante ye tu mānavāḥ /
te mṛtāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā //
meaning:
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्ते ये तु मानवाः /
ते मृताः स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा //
text_mt: Those humans who stay relying on the bank of the Narmadā, / upon dying, go to heaven, just as good people who perform virtuous deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dīpteśvaraṃ gacched vyāsatīrthaṃ tapovanam /
nivartitā purā tatra vyāsabhītā mahānadī /
huṅkāritā tu vyāsena dakṣiṇena tato gatā //
meaning:
ततो दीप्तेश्वरं गच्छेद् व्यासतीर्थं तपोवनम् /
निवर्तिता पुरा तत्र व्यासभीता महानदी /
हुङ्कारिता तु व्यासेन दक्षिणेन ततो गता //
text_mt: Then one should go to Dīpteśvara, the penance grove Vyāsatīrtha; / there formerly the great river turned back, frightened of Vyāsa; / rebuked with a roar by Vyāsa, she then went to the south.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira /
prītastasya bhaved vyāso vāñchitaṃ labhate phalam //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर /
प्रीतस्तस्य भवेद् व्यासो वाञ्छितं लभते फलम् //
text_mt: Whoever circumambulates that pilgrimage site, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / Vyāsa becomes pleased with him, and he obtains his desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra ikṣunadyāstu saṃgamam /
trailokyaviśrutaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra sannihitaḥ śivaḥ /
tatra stanātvā naro rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र इक्षुनद्यास्तु संगमम् /
त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं पुण्यं तत्र सन्निहितः शिवः /
तत्र स्तनात्वा नरो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to the confluence of the Ikṣu river; / it is famous in the three worlds and holy, and Śiva is present there; / bathing there, O king, a man attains leadership of the gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
skandatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam /
ājanmanaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snātastīvraṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
स्कन्दतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् /
आजन्मनः कृतं पापं स्नातस्तीव्रं व्यपोहति //
text_mt: Then one should go to Skandatīrtha, which completely destroys all sins; / having bathed, he dispels the severe sin committed since birth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā bhavātmajamanuttamam /
upāsate mahātmānaṃ skandaṃ śaktidhiraṃ prabhum //
meaning:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा भवात्मजमनुत्तमम् /
उपासते महात्मानं स्कन्दं शक्तिधिरं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: There the gods, along with the Gandharvas, worship the unsurpassed son of Bhava, / the great-souled Lord Skanda, bearer of the spear.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gacchedāṅgirasaṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेदाङ्गिरसं स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Then one should go to Āṅgirasa and perform a bath there; / obtaining the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows, he goes to the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgirā yatra deveśaṃ brahmaputro vṛṣadhvajam /
tapasārādhya viśveśaṃ labdhavān yogamuttamam //
meaning:
अङ्गिरा यत्र देवेशं ब्रह्मपुत्रो वृषध्वजम् /
तपसाराध्य विश्वेशं लब्धवान् योगमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Where Aṅgiras, the son of Brahmā, worshiping the Lord of the universe, / the bull-bannered ruler of the gods, with ascetic penance, obtained supreme yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam /
snānaṃ tatra prakurvota aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
कुशतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् /
स्नानं तत्र प्रकुर्वोत अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Kuśatīrtha, which completely destroys all sins; / one should perform a bath there; one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam /
tatra strātvā naro rājyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
कोटितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् /
तत्र स्त्रात्वा नरो राज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Then one should go to Koṭitīrtha, which completely destroys all sins; / bathing there, a man attains kingship, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
candrabhāgāṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
चन्द्रभागां ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Candrabhāgā and perform a bath there; / merely by bathing there, a man is glorified in the realm of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle saṃgameśvaramuttamam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले संगमेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: On the southern bank of the Narmadā is supreme Saṃgameśvara; / bathing there, O king, a man obtains the fruit of all sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadāyottare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam /
ādityāyatanaṃ ramyamīśvareṇa tu bhāṣitam //
meaning:
नर्मदायोत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् /
आदित्यायतनं रम्यमीश्वरेण तु भाषितम् //
text_mt: On the northern bank of the Narmadā is a supremely splendid pilgrimage site, / a delightful abode of the Sun, declared by the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā tu rājendra dattvā dānaṃ tu śaktitaḥ /
tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa labhate cākṣayaṃ phalam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र दत्त्वा दानं तु शक्तितः /
तस्य तीर्थप्रभावेण लभते चाक्षयं फलम् //
text_mt: Bathing there, O best of kings, and giving a gift according to one's capacity, / through the power of that pilgrimage site, one obtains an imperishable fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
daridrā vyādhitā ye tu ye ca duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ /
mucyante sarvapāpebhyaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayānti ca //
meaning:
दरिद्रा व्याधिता ये तु ये च दुष्कृतकारिणः /
मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यः सूर्यलोकं प्रयान्ति च //
text_mt: Those who are poor, afflicted by disease, and those who commit bad deeds / are freed from all sins and go to the realm of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgeśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra svargalokamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
मार्गेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Mārgeśvara and perform a bath there; / merely by bathing there, a man attains the realm of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paścimato gacchenmarudālayamuttamam /
tatra snātvā tu rājendra śucirbhūtvā prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
ततः पश्चिमतो गच्छेन्मरुदालयमुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: Then one should go westward to the supreme Marudālaya; / having bathed there, O best of kings, and having carefully become pure,

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanaṃ tu dvijo dadyād yathāvibhavavistaram /
puṣpakeṇa vimānena vāyulokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
काञ्चनं तु द्विजो दद्याद् यथाविभवविस्तरम् /
पुष्पकेण विमानेन वायुलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: a twice-born should give gold according to the extent of his wealth; / by means of a Puṣpaka aerial chariot, he goes to the realm of Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra ahalyātīrthamuttamam /
snānamātrādapsarobhirmodate kālamakṣayam //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र अहल्यातीर्थमुत्तमम् /
स्नानमात्रादप्सरोभिर्मोदते कालमक्षयम् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O best of kings, to supreme Ahalyātīrtha; / merely from bathing, one rejoices with celestial nymphs for an imperishable time.

sanskrit_iast:
caitramāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe trayodaśī /
kāmadevadine tasminnahalyāṃ yastu pūjayet //
meaning:
चैत्रमासे तु संप्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशी /
कामदेवदिने तस्मिन्नहल्यां यस्तु पूजयेत् //
text_mt: When the month of Caitra arrives, on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, / on that day of Kāmadeva, whoever worships Ahalyā,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra tatra narotpanno varastatra priyo bhavet /
strīvallabho bhavecchrīmān kāmadeva ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र तत्र नरोत्पन्नो वरस्तत्र प्रियो भवेत् /
स्त्रीवल्लभो भवेच्छ्रीमान् कामदेव इवापरः //
text_mt: wherever that man is born, he becomes the best, beloved there, / dear to women, fortunate, like a second Kāmadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyāṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ śakrasya viśrutam /
snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
अयोध्यां तु समासाद्य तीर्थं शक्रस्य विश्रुतम् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Having reached Ayodhyā, the renowned pilgrimage site of Śakra, / merely by bathing there, a man obtains the fruit of [donating] a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
somatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
सोमतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Somatīrtha and perform a bath there; / merely by bathing there, a man is completely freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
somagrahe tu rājendra pāpakṣayakaraṃ bhavet /
trailokyaviśrutaṃ rājan somatīrthaṃ mahāphalam //
meaning:
सोमग्रहे तु राजेन्द्र पापक्षयकरं भवेत् /
त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं राजन् सोमतीर्थं महाफलम् //
text_mt: During an eclipse of the moon, O best of kings, it destroys sins; / Somatīrtha, renowned in the three worlds, O king, yields great fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatra tīrthe samāhitaḥ /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
यस्तु चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तत्र तीर्थे समाहितः /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सोमलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever, composed in mind, performs the cāndrāyaṇa penance at that pilgrimage site, / his soul purified of all sins, goes to the realm of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt somatīrthe narādhipa /
jale cānaśanaṃ vāpi nāsau martyo 'bhijāyate //
meaning:
अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् सोमतीर्थे नराधिप /
जले चानशनं वापि नासौ मर्त्यो ऽभिजायते //
text_mt: O king, he who enters fire at Somatīrtha, / or fasts unto death in the water, is not reborn as a mortal.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
स्तम्भतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Stambhatīrtha and perform a bath there; / as soon as he has bathed there, a man is glorified in the realm of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra viṣṇutīrthamanuttamam /
yodhanīpuramākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र विष्णुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् /
योधनीपुरमाख्यातं विष्णोः स्थानमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the unexcelled Viṣṇutīrtha, / proclaimed as Yodhanīpura, the unexcelled place of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
asurā yodhitāstatra vāsudevena koṭiśaḥ /
tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ viṣṇuśrīko bhavediha /
ahorātropavāsena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
असुरा योधितास्तत्र वासुदेवेन कोटिशः /
तत्र तीर्थं समुत्पन्नं विष्णुश्रीको भवेदिह /
अहोरात्रोपवासेन ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: There, millions of asuras were fought by Vāsudeva; / there the holy place arose. In this world he becomes endowed with the splendour of Viṣṇu, / and by fasting for a day and night he dispels the murder of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam /
kāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ yatra kāmor'cayad bhavam //
meaning:
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् /
कामतीर्थमिति ख्यातं यत्र कामोर्ऽचयद् भवम् //
text_mt: On the southern bank of the Narmadā is a most beautiful holy place, / known as Kāmatīrtha, where Kāma worshipped Bhava.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ /
kusumāyudharūpeṇa rudroloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा उपवासपरायणः /
कुसुमायुधरूपेण रुद्रोलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Having bathed in that holy place, devoted to fasting, / a man is glorified in the realm of Rudra with the form of the flower-weaponed [god].

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra brahmatīrthamanuttamam /
umāhakamiti khyātaṃ tatra saṃtarpayet pitṝn //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् /
उमाहकमिति ख्यातं तत्र संतर्पयेत् पितॄन् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the unexcelled Brahmatīrtha, / known as Umāhaka; there one should satisfy the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ śrdhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi /
gajarūpā śilā tatra toyamadhye vyavasthitā //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां श्र्धं कुर्याद् यथाविधि /
गजरूपा शिला तत्र तोयमध्ये व्यवस्थिता //
text_mt: On the full-moon day or the new-moon day, one should perform an ancestral offering rite according to rule; / there a stone in the shape of an elephant stands in the midst of the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃstu dāpayet piṇḍān vaiśākhyāntu viśeṣataḥ /
snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ /
tṛpyanti pitarastasya yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī //
meaning:
तस्मिंस्तु दापयेत् पिण्डान् वैशाख्यान्तु विशेषतः /
स्नात्वा समाहितमना दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जितः /
तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य यावत् तिष्ठति मेदिनी //
text_mt: Upon that [stone] one should offer rice balls, especially on the full-moon day of Vaiśākha; / having bathed with a focused mind, free from deceit and malice, / his ancestors remain satisfied as long as the earth endures.

sanskrit_iast:
siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra gāṇapatyapadaṃ labhet //
meaning:
सिद्धेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गाणपत्यपदं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Siddheśvara and perform a bath there; / as soon as he has bathed there, a man obtains the status of Gāṇapatya.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra liṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ /
tatra snātvā tu rājendra viṣṇuloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र लिङ्गो यत्र जनार्दनः /
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र विष्णुलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, where Janārdana is [present as] a liṅga; / having bathed there, O king of kings, he is glorified in the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra nārāyaṇo devo munonāṃ bhāvitātmanām /
svātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
यत्र नारायणो देवो मुनोनां भावितात्मनाम् /
स्वात्मानं दर्शयामास लिङ्गं तत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Where Lord Nārāyaṇa showed his own self / to the sages of cultivated minds—that liṅga is the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkolaṃ tu tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam /
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca tatraiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam /
piṇḍapridānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ pretyānantaphalapradam //
meaning:
अङ्कोलं तु ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
स्नानं दानं च तत्रैव ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् /
पिण्डप्रिदानं च कृतं प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: Then one should go to Aṅkola, which destroys all sins; / bathing and giving gifts right there, feeding brāhmaṇas, / and making offerings of rice balls, when performed, yields infinite fruit after death.

sanskrit_iast:
traiyambakena toyena yaścaruṃ śrapayet tataḥ /
aṅkolamūle dadyācca piṇḍāṃścaiva yathāvidhi /
tāritāḥ pitarastena tṛpyantyācandratārakam //
meaning:
त्रैयम्बकेन तोयेन यश्चरुं श्रपयेत् ततः /
अङ्कोलमूले दद्याच्च पिण्डांश्चैव यथाविधि /
तारिताः पितरस्तेन तृप्यन्त्याचन्द्रतारकम् //
text_mt: He who then cooks sacrificial porridge with Traiyambaka water, / and according to rule offers rice balls at the root of the aṅkola tree, / saves his ancestors; they are satisfied as long as the moon and stars [endure].

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra tāpaseśvaramuttamam /
tatra snātvā tu rājendra prāpnuyāt tapasaḥ phalam //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तापसेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र प्राप्नुयात् तपसः फलम् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Tāpaseśvara; / having bathed there, O king of kings, one obtains the fruit of asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam /
nāsti tena sama tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira //
meaning:
शुक्लतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् /
नास्ति तेन सम तीर्थं नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर //
text_mt: Then one should go to Śuklatīrtha, which destroys all sins; / there is no holy place equal to it on the Narmadā, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāt sparśanāt tasya snānadānatapojapāt /
homāccaivopavāsācca śuklatīrthe mahat phalam //
meaning:
दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् तस्य स्नानदानतपोजपात् /
होमाच्चैवोपवासाच्च शुक्लतीर्थे महत् फलम् //
text_mt: From seeing it, touching it, from bathing, giving, asceticism, and recitation [there], / and from fire offerings and fasting, there is great fruit at Śuklatīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanaṃ tat smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ devagandharvasevitam /
śuklatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam //
meaning:
योजनं तत् स्मृतं क्षेत्रं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् /
शुक्लतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापविनाशनम् //
text_mt: That sacred field is recorded to be a yojana [in extent], frequented by gods and gandharvas; / it is known as Śuklatīrtha, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
pādapāgreṇa dṛṣṭena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati /
devyā saha sadā bhargastatra tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
पादपाग्रेण दृष्टेन ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति /
देव्या सह सदा भर्गस्तत्र तिष्ठति शङ्करः //
text_mt: When the tip of its tree is seen, one dispels the murder of a brāhmaṇa; / Śaṅkara, Bharga, always abides there along with the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe māsi suvrata /
kailāsāccābhiniṣkramya tatra sannihito haraḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां वैशाखे मासि सुव्रत /
कैलासाच्चाभिनिष्क्रम्य तत्र सन्निहितो हरः //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Vaiśākha, O man of good vows, / Hara, having set out from Kailāsa, is present there.

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā /
gaṇāścāpsarasāṃ nāgāstatra tiṣṭhanti puṅgava //
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धविद्याधरास्तथा /
गणाश्चाप्सरसां नागास्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति पुङ्गव //
text_mt: Gods, dānavas, and gandharvas, as well as siddhas and vidyādharas, / and hosts of apsarases and nāgas abide there, O bull among men.

sanskrit_iast:
rajakena yathā vastraṃ śuklaṃ bhavati vāriṇā /
ājanmani kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuklatīrthe vyapohati /
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhamanantaṃ tatra dṛśyate //
meaning:
रजकेन यथा वस्त्रं शुक्लं भवति वारिणा /
आजन्मनि कृतं पापं शुक्लतीर्थे व्यपोहति /
स्नानं दानं तपः श्राद्धमनन्तं तत्र दृश्यते //
text_mt: Just as a garment becomes white through a washerman with water, / so one dispels sin committed since birth at Śuklatīrtha; / bathing, giving, asceticism, and ancestral offering rites are seen to be infinite there.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklatīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni mānavaḥ /
ahorātropavāsena śuklatīrthe vyapohati //
meaning:
शुक्लतीर्थात् परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
पूर्वे वयसि कर्माणि कृत्वा पापानि मानवः /
अहोरात्रोपवासेन शुक्लतीर्थे व्यपोहति //
text_mt: A holy place superior to Śuklatīrtha has not existed nor will exist; / having committed sinful deeds in his earlier life, / a mortal dispels them at Śuklatīrtha by fasting for a day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī /
ghṛtena snāpayed devamupoṣya parameśvaram /
ekaviṃśatkulopeto na cyavedaiśvarāt padāt //
meaning:
कार्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी /
घृतेन स्नापयेद् देवमुपोष्य परमेश्वरम् /
एकविंशत्कुलोपेतो न च्यवेदैश्वरात् पदात् //
text_mt: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of the month of Kārttika, / having fasted, one should bathe the supreme Lord, the god, with clarified butter; / accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, he does not fall from the state of Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñadānena vā punaḥ /
na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti śuklatīrthe tu yāṃ labhet //
meaning:
तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञदानेन वा पुनः /
न तां गतिमवाप्नोति शुक्लतीर्थे तु यां लभेत् //
text_mt: Through asceticism, through celibate studenthood, or through sacrifice and giving, / one does not attain that state which one obtains at Śuklatīrtha.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklatīrthaṃ mahātīrthamṛṣisiddhaniṣevitam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan punarjanma na vindati //
meaning:
शुक्लतीर्थं महातीर्थमृषिसिद्धनिषेवितम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् पुनर्जन्म न विन्दति //
text_mt: Śuklatīrtha is a great holy place, frequented by ṛṣis and siddhas; / having bathed there, O king, a man does not encounter rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
ayane vā caturdaśyāṃ saṃkrāntau viṣuve tathā /
snātvā tu sopavāsaḥ san vijitātmā samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
अयने वा चतुर्दश्यां संक्रान्तौ विषुवे तथा /
स्नात्वा तु सोपवासः सन् विजितात्मा समाहितः //
text_mt: At a solstice, or on the fourteenth day, or at a solar transit, or likewise at an equinox, / having bathed while fasting, self-controlled and focused,

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti prīyetāṃ hariśaṅkarau /
etat tīrthaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam //
meaning:
दानं दद्याद् यथाशक्ति प्रीयेतां हरिशङ्करौ /
एतत् तीर्थप्रभावेण सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम् //
text_mt: he should give a gift according to his means, so that Hari and Śaṅkara may be pleased; / by the power of this holy place, everything becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthaṃ durgataṃ vipraṃ nāthavantamathāpi vā /
udvādayati yastīrthe tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
अनाथं दुर्गतं विप्रं नाथवन्तमथापि वा /
उद्वादयति यस्तीर्थे तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु //
text_mt: He who, at the holy place, gives away [in marriage a maiden to] a brāhmaṇa, / whether destitute and helpless or possessed of a protector—hear the fruit of his merit:

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat tadromasaṃkhyā tu tatprasūtikuleṣu ca /
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
यावत् तद्रोमसंख्या तु तत्प्रसूतिकुलेषु च /
तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: for as many hairs as there are on her and in the families of her offspring, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra yamatīrtha manuttamam /
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māghamāse yudhiṣṭhira /
snānaṃ kṛtvā naktabhījī na paśyed yonisaṅkaṭam //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र यमतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् /
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां माघमासे युधिष्ठिर /
स्नानं कृत्वा नक्तभीजी न पश्येद् योनिसङ्कटम् //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the unexcelled Yamatīrtha; / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Māgha, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / having bathed and eating only at night, one will not see the distress of a womb.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam /
saṃgame tu naraḥ snāyādupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ /
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitāḥ //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र एरण्डीतीर्थमुत्तमम् /
संगमे तु नरः स्नायादुपवासपरायणः /
ब्राह्मणं भोजयेदेकं कोटिर्भवति भोजिताः //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Eraṇḍītīrtha; / a man devoted to fasting should bathe at the confluence; / if he feeds a single brāhmaṇa, ten million are fed.

sanskrit_iast:
eraṇḍīsaṃgame snātvā bhaktibhāvāt turañjitaḥ /
mṛttikāṃ śirasi sthāpya avagāhya ca tajjalam /
narmadodakasaṃmiśraṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ //
meaning:
एरण्डीसंगमे स्नात्वा भक्तिभावात् तुरञ्जितः /
मृत्तिकां शिरसि स्थाप्य अवगाह्य च तज्जलम् /
नर्मदोदकसंमिश्रं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः //
text_mt: Having bathed at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī, filled with devotion, / placing clay on his head and plunging into that water / mingled with the water of the Narmadā, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ kārṇāṭikeśvaram /
gaṅgāvatarate tatra dine puṇye na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं कार्णाटिकेश्वरम् /
गङ्गावतरते तत्र दिने पुण्ये न संशयः //
text_mt: Then one should go, O king of kings, to the holy place Kārṇāṭikeśvara; / the Gaṅgā descends there on an auspicious day, without a doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca dattvā caiva yathāvidhi /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च दत्त्वा चैव यथाविधि /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Having bathed and drunk there, and given gifts according to rule, / freed from all sins, he is glorified in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
nanditīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
prīyate tasya nandīśaḥ somaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
नन्दितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
प्रीयते तस्य नन्दीशः सोमलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Nanditīrtha and perform a bath there; / Nandīśa is pleased with him, and he is glorified in the realm of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ śubham /
tatra snātvā naro rājan narakaṃ naiva paśyati //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्वनरकं शुभम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् नरकं नैव पश्यति //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the auspicious tīrtha called Anaraka. / Having bathed there, O king, a man never sees hell.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra svānyasthīni vinikṣipet /
rūpavān jāyate loke dhanabhogasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र स्वान्यस्थीनि विनिक्षिपेत् /
रूपवान् जायते लोके धनभोगसमन्वितः //
text_mt: If a man casts the bones of his relatives into that tīrtha, O best of kings, / he is born handsome in this world, endowed with wealth and pleasures.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra kapilātīrtha muttamam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कपिलातीर्थ मुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Kapilātīrtha. / Having bathed there, O king, a man obtains the reward of a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhamāse tu saṃprāpte caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
tatropoṣya naro bhaktyā dadyād dīpaṃ ghṛtena tu //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठमासे तु संप्राप्ते चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः /
तत्रोपोष्य नरो भक्त्या दद्याद् दीपं घृतेन तु //
text_mt: When the month of Jyeṣṭha arrives, especially on the fourteenth day, / having fasted there, a man should devotedly offer a lamp with ghee.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena snāpayed rudraṃ saghṛtaṃ śrīphalaṃ dahet /
ghaṇṭābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kapilāṃ vai pradāpayet //
meaning:
घृतेन स्नापयेद् रुद्रं सघृतं श्रीफलं दहेत् /
घण्टाभरणसंयुक्तां कपिलां वै प्रदापयेत् //
text_mt: He should bathe Rudra with ghee, burn a bilva fruit with ghee, / and surely donate a brown cow adorned with bells and ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ /
śivatulyabalo bhūtvā śivavat krīḍate ciram //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः /
शिवतुल्यबलो भूत्वा शिववत् क्रीडते चिरम् //
text_mt: Adorned with all ornaments and revered by all the gods, / having acquired strength equal to Śiva's, he sports for a long time like Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ /
snāpayitvā śivaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu bhojanam //
meaning:
अङ्गारकदिने प्राप्ते चतुर्थ्यां तु विशेषतः /
स्नापयित्वा शिवं दद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु भोजनम् //
text_mt: When Tuesday arrives, especially on the fourth day [of the lunar fortnight], / having bathed Śiva, he should give food to brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhogasamāyukto vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ /
gatvā śakrasya bhavanaṃ śakreṇa saha modate //
meaning:
सर्वभोगसमायुक्तो विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः /
गत्वा शक्रस्य भवनं शक्रेण सह मोदते //
text_mt: Endowed with all enjoyments, [travelling] in aerial chariots granting every desire, / having gone to Śakra's abode, he rejoices with Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo dhanavān bhogavān bhavet /
aṅgārakanavamyāṃ tu amāvāsyāṃ tathaiva ca /
snāpayet tatra yatnena rūpavān subhago bhavet //
meaning:
ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो धनवान् भोगवान् भवेत् /
अङ्गारकनवम्यां तु अमावास्यां तथैव च /
स्नापयेत् तत्र यत्नेन रूपवान् सुभगो भवेत् //
text_mt: Thereafter, descending from heaven, he becomes wealthy and prosperous. / And on a Tuesday falling on a ninth day, and likewise on a new moon day, / one should diligently bathe [Śiva] there; he becomes handsome and fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra gaṇeśvaramanuttamam /
śrāvaṇe māsī saṃprāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र गणेश्वरमनुत्तमम् /
श्रावणे मासी संप्राप्ते कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Gaṇeśvara. / When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrives, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
snātamātro narastatra rudraloke mahīyate /
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate 'sāvṝṇatrayāt //
meaning:
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र रुद्रलोके महीयते /
पितॄणां तर्पणं कृत्वा मुच्यते ऽसावॄणत्रयात् //
text_mt: merely by bathing there, a man is exalted in the realm of Rudra. / Having made libations to the ancestors, he is freed from the three debts.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgeśvarasamīpe tu gaṅgāvadanamuttamam /
akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra snātvā tu mānavaḥ /
ājanmajanitaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
गङ्गेश्वरसमीपे तु गङ्गावदनमुत्तमम् /
अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र स्नात्वा तु मानवः /
आजन्मजनितैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Near Gaṅgeśvara is the excellent Gaṅgāvadana. / Whether free from desire or filled with desire, a man, having bathed there, / is freed from the sins born since birth; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya vai paścime deśe samīpe nātidūrataḥ /
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam //
meaning:
तस्य वै पश्चिमे देशे समीपे नातिदूरतः /
दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् //
text_mt: To the west of it, nearby and not too far, / is the Daśāśvamedhika tīrtha, renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ māsi bhādrapade śubhe /
amāvasyāṃ naraḥ snātvā pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां मासि भाद्रपदे शुभे /
अमावस्यां नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: Having fasted for one night in the auspicious month of Bhādrapada, / having bathed on the new moon day, a man should worship the one whose emblem is a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā /
gatvā rudrapuraṃ ramyaṃ rudreṇa saha modate //
meaning:
काञ्चनेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना /
गत्वा रुद्रपुरं रम्यं रुद्रेण सह मोदते //
text_mt: In a golden aerial chariot garlanded with nets of tinkling bells, / having gone to the delightful city of Rudra, he rejoices with Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra sarvadivase snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonacatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वत्र सर्वदिवसे स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
पितॄणां तर्पणं कुर्यादश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनचत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Everywhere and on every day, one should perform a bath there; / he should offer libations to the ancestors, and he obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
tato gaccheta rājendra bhṛgutīrtha manuttamam /
tatra devo bhṛguḥ purvaṃ rudramārādhayat purā //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भृगुतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् /
तत्र देवो भृगुः पुर्वं रुद्रमाराधयत् पुरा //
title: catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Bhṛgutīrtha. / There, in former times, the divine Bhṛgu anciently worshipped Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāt tasya devasya sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate /
etat kṣetraṃ suvipulaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
दर्शनात् तस्य देवस्य सद्यः पापात् प्रमुच्यते /
एतत् क्षेत्रं सुविपुलं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: From the vision of that god, one is instantly freed from sin. / This very extensive sacred place is the destroyer of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ /
upānahostathā yugmaṃ deyamannaṃ sakāñcanam /
bhojanaṃ ca yathāśakti tadasyākṣayamucyate //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः /
उपानहोस्तथा युग्मं देयमन्नं सकाञ्चनम् /
भोजनं च यथाशक्ति तदस्याक्षयमुच्यते //
text_mt: Those who die having bathed there go to heaven, free from rebirth. / A pair of sandals, food with gold, / and a meal should be given according to one's means; that is said to be imperishable for him.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaranti sarvadānāni yajñadānaṃ tapaḥ kriyā /
akṣayaṃ tat tapastaptaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira //
meaning:
क्षरन्ति सर्वदानानि यज्ञदानं तपः क्रिया /
अक्षयं तत् तपस्तप्तं भृगुतीर्थे युधिष्ठिर //
text_mt: All gifts, sacrifices, donations, and austerities perish, / [but] that austerity practiced at Bhṛgutīrtha is imperishable, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva tapasogreṇa tuṣṭena tripurāriṇā /
sānnidhyaṃ tatra kathitaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira //
meaning:
तस्यैव तपसोग्रेण तुष्टेन त्रिपुरारिणा /
सान्निध्यं तत्र कथितं भृगुतीर्थे युधिष्ठिर //
text_mt: By that very fierce austerity, the enemy of Tripura was pleased; / his presence there at Bhṛgutīrtha has been proclaimed, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra gautameśvaramuttamam /
yatrārādhya triśūlāṅkaṃ gautamaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र गौतमेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
यत्राराध्य त्रिशूलाङ्कं गौतमः सिद्धिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Gautameśvara, / where, having worshipped the god marked with the trident, Gautama attained perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā naro rājan upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ /
kāñcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् उपवासपरायणः /
काञ्चनेन विमानेन ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Having bathed there, O king, intent on fasting, / in a golden aerial chariot he is exalted in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣotsargaṃ tato gacchecchāśvataṃ padamāpnuyāt /
na jānanti narā mūḍhā viṣṇormāyāvimohitāḥ //
meaning:
वृषोत्सर्गं ततो गच्छेच्छाश्वतं पदमाप्नुयात् /
न जानन्ति नरा मूढा विष्णोर्मायाविमोहिताः //
text_mt: Then one should go to Vṛṣotsarga; he attains the eternal abode. / Deluded people do not know it, bewildered by the illusory creative power of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
dhautapāpaṃ tato gacched dhautaṃ yatra vṛṣeṇa tu /
narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ rājan sarvapātakanāśanam /
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
धौतपापं ततो गच्छेद् धौतं यत्र वृषेण तु /
नर्मदायां स्थितं राजन् सर्वपातकनाशनम् /
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति //
text_mt: Then one should go to Dhautapāpa, where [sin] was washed away by the bull; / situated on the Narmadā, O king, it destroys all grievous sins. / Having bathed at that tīrtha, a man cleanses away the murder of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ /
caturbhujastrinetraśca haratulyabalo bhavet //
meaning:
तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र प्राणत्यागं करोति यः /
चतुर्भुजस्त्रिनेत्रश्च हरतुल्यबलो भवेत् //
text_mt: He who relinquishes his life at that tīrtha, O best of kings, / becomes four-armed and three-eyed, with strength equal to Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
vaset kalpāyutaṃ sāgraṃ śivatulyaparākramaḥ /
kālena mahatā jātaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet //
meaning:
वसेत् कल्पायुतं साग्रं शिवतुल्यपराक्रमः /
कालेन महता जातः पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत् //
text_mt: He would dwell for a full ten thousand aeons with prowess equal to Śiva. / After a great length of time, born on earth, he becomes a sole monarch.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra haṃsatīrtha manuttamam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र हंसतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Haṃsatīrtha. / Having bathed there, O king, a man is exalted in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra siddho yatra janārdanaḥ /
varāhatīrtha mākhyātaṃ viṣṇulokagatipradam //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र सिद्धो यत्र जनार्दनः /
वराहतीर्थ माख्यातं विष्णुलोकगतिप्रदम् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to where Janārdana attained perfection; / it is celebrated as Varāhatīrtha, which grants attainment of the realm of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra candratīrthamanuttamam /
paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra candraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र चन्द्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् /
पौर्णमास्यां विशेषेण स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र चन्द्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Candratīrtha. / One should especially perform a bath there on the full moon day; / merely by bathing there, a man is exalted in the realm of Candra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra kanyātīrthamanuttamam /
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
snātamātro narastatra pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कन्यातीर्थमनुत्तमम् /
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायां स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Kanyātīrtha. / One should perform a bath there on the third day of the bright fortnight; / merely by bathing there, a man becomes a sole monarch on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
devatīrtha tato gacchet sarvadevanamakṛtam /
tatra snātvā ca rājendra daivataiḥ saha modate //
meaning:
देवतीर्थ ततो गच्छेत् सर्वदेवनमकृतम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा च राजेन्द्र दैवतैः सह मोदते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Devatīrtha, revered by all the gods. / Having bathed there, O best of kings, he rejoices with the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra śikhitīrthamanuttamam /
yat tatra dīyate dānaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शिखितीर्थमनुत्तमम् /
यत् तत्र दीयते दानं सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Śikhitīrtha. / Whatever gift is given there becomes multiplied ten-millionfold.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ śubham /
yattatra kriyate śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं पैतामहं शुभम् /
यत्तत्र क्रियते श्राद्धं सर्वं तदक्षयं भवेत् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the auspicious tīrtha of the Grandfather. / Whatever ancestral offering rite is performed there, all that becomes imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet /
vidhūya sarvapāpāni brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
विधूय सर्वपापानि ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: He who, having reached Sāvitrītīrtha, relinquishes his life, / having shaken off all sins, is exalted in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
manoharaṃ tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha modate //
meaning:
मनोहरं तु तत्रैव तीर्थं परमशोभनम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दैवतैः सह मोदते //
text_mt: In that very place is the exceedingly beautiful Manohara tīrtha. / Having bathed there, O king, a man rejoices with the deities.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra mānasaṃ tīrthamuttamam /
snātvā tatra naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र मानसं तीर्थमुत्तमम् /
स्नात्वा तत्र नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Mānasa tīrtha. / Having bathed there, O king, a man is exalted in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
svargabinduṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ devanamaskṛtam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan durgatiṃ naiva gacchati //
meaning:
स्वर्गबिन्दुं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं देवनमस्कृतम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दुर्गतिं नैव गच्छति //
text_mt: Then one should go to Svargabindu, a tīrtha revered by the gods. / Having bathed there, O king, a man never goes to an evil state of existence.

sanskrit_iast:
apsareśaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret /
krīḍate nākalokastho hyapsarobhiḥ sa modate //
meaning:
अप्सरेशं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् /
क्रीडते नाकलोकस्थो ह्यप्सरोभिः स मोदते //
text_mt: Then one should go to Apsareśa and perform a bath there. / Dwelling in the celestial realm, he sports and rejoices with the apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra bhārabhūtimanuttamam /
upoṣitor'cayedīśaṃ rudraloke mahīyate /
asmiṃstīrthe mṛto rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भारभूतिमनुत्तमम् /
उपोषितोर्ऽचयेदीशं रुद्रलोके महीयते /
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Bhārabhūti. / Having fasted and worshipped the Lord, he is exalted in the realm of Rudra. / If he dies at this tīrtha, O king, he attains leadership among the attendants.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike māsi deveśamarcayet pārvatīpatim /
aśvamedhād daśaguṇaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
कार्तिके मासि देवेशमर्चयेत् पार्वतीपतिम् /
अश्वमेधाद् दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः //
text_mt: In the month of Kārtika, one should worship the Lord of the gods, the husband of Pārvatī; / the wise proclaim it to be ten times [more meritorious] than a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tatra kundendusaprabham /
vṛṣayuktena yānena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
वृषभं यः प्रयच्छेत तत्र कुन्देन्दुसप्रभम् /
वृषयुक्तेन यानेन रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: He who gives a bull there, shining like jasmine or the moon, / goes to the realm of Rudra in a vehicle yoked with bulls.

sanskrit_iast:
etat tīrthaṃ samāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
एतत् तीर्थं समासाद्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: He who, having reached this tīrtha, relinquishes his life, / his self purified of all sins, goes to the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa /
haṃsayuktena yānena svargalokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप /
हंसयुक्तेन यानेन स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Whoever enters the water at that pilgrimage place, O king, / goes to the heavenly realm on a vehicle drawn by swans.

sanskrit_iast:
eraṇḍyā narmadāyāstu saṃgamaṃ lokaviśrutam /
tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
एरण्ड्या नर्मदायास्तु संगमं लोकविश्रुतम् /
तत्र तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: The confluence of the Eraṇḍī and the Narmadā is renowned across the worlds; / the sacred site there is exceedingly holy and destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ /
tatra snātvā tu rājendra mucyate brahmahatyayā //
meaning:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा नित्यं व्रतपरायणः /
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
text_mt: Devoted to fasting, perpetually dedicated to his vow, / one who bathes there, O best of kings, is freed from the killing of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra narmadodadhisaṃgamam /
jamadagniriti khyātaḥ siddho yatra janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र नर्मदोदधिसंगमम् /
जमदग्निरिति ख्यातः सिद्धो यत्र जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the confluence of the Narmadā and the ocean, / where Janārdana became perfected under the name Jamadagni.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā naro rājan narmadodadhisaṃgame /
triguṇaṃ cāśvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् नर्मदोदधिसंगमे /
त्रिगुणं चाश्वमेधस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः //
text_mt: A man who bathes there, O king, at the confluence of the Narmadā and the ocean, / obtains three times the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam /
tatra snātvā naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र पिङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् /
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Piṅgaleśvara; / bathing there, O king, a man is exalted in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram /
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam //
meaning:
तत्रोपवासं यः कृत्वा पश्येत विमलेश्वरम् /
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं हित्वा याति शिवालयम् //
text_mt: One who observes a fast there and beholds Vimaleśvara, / casting off the sin committed over seven lifetimes, goes to Śiva's abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gaccheta rājendra ālikātīrthamuttamam /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ niyato niyatāśanaḥ /
asya tīrthasya māhātmyānmucyate brahmahatyayā //
meaning:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र आलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां नियतो नियताशनः /
अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
text_mt: Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Ālikātīrtha. / Fasting for a single night, self-controlled and eating measured food, / by the greatness of this pilgrimage place one is freed from the killing of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
etāni tava saṃkṣepāt prādhānyāt kathitāni tu /
na śakyā vistarād vaktuṃ saṃkhyā tīrtheṣupāṇḍava //
meaning:
एतानि तव संक्षेपात् प्राधान्यात् कथितानि तु /
न शक्या विस्तराद् वक्तुं संख्या तीर्थेषुपाण्डव //
text_mt: These have been told to you in brief according to their importance; / it is not possible to describe in full detail the number of pilgrimage places, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā /
narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā //
meaning:
एषा पवित्रा विमला नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता /
नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा महादेवस्य वल्लभा //
text_mt: This river is pure, spotless, and renowned throughout the three worlds, / the Narmadā, the foremost of rivers, dear to Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā saṃsmaredyastu narmadāṃ vai yudhiṣṭhira /
cāndrāyaṇaśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
मनसा संस्मरेद्यस्तु नर्मदां वै युधिष्ठिर /
चान्द्रायणशतं साग्रं लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: He who remembers the Narmadā with his mind, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / obtains the full fruit of a hundred Cāndrāyaṇa fasts; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ /
patanti narake ghore ityāha parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा नास्तिक्यं घोरमाश्रिताः /
पतन्ति नरके घोरे इत्याह परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: Men devoid of faith, who resort to terrible godlessness, / fall into a dreadful hell—thus said the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ /
tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
नर्मदां सेवते नित्यं स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः /
तेन पुण्या नदी ज्ञेया ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The god Maheśvara himself continually frequents the Narmadā; / therefore, the river is to be known as holy, carrying away [even] the killing of a brahmin.

Thus ends the fortieth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
idaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ naimiśamuttamam /
mahādevapriyakaraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इदं त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं तीर्थं नैमिशमुत्तमम् /
महादेवप्रियकरं महापातकनाशनम् //
title: ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The Sūta said: / This excellent Naimiṣa is a sacred place renowned across the three worlds, / pleasing to Mahādeva, destroying the greatest sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaṃ didṛkṣūṇāmṛṣīṇaṇāṃ parameṣṭhinām /
brahāmaṇā nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ tapastaptuṃ dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
महादेवं दिदृक्षूणामृषीणणां परमेष्ठिनाम् /
ब्रहामणा निर्मितं स्थानं तपस्तप्तुं द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: For the highest sages wishing to behold Mahādeva, / Brahmā fashioned this place for practicing austerities, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
marīcayo 'trayo viprā vasiṣṭhāḥ kratavastathā /
bhṛgavo 'ṅgirasaḥ pūrvā brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam //
meaning:
मरीचयो ऽत्रयो विप्रा वसिष्ठाः क्रतवस्तथा /
भृगवो ऽङ्गिरसः पूर्वा ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम् //
text_mt: The foremost twice-born sages—the Marīcis, Atris, Vasiṣṭhas, / Kratus, Bhṛgus, and Aṅgirases—[approached] Brahmā born of the lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
sametya sarvavaradaṃ caturmūrti caturmukham /
pṛcchanti praṇipatyainaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam //
meaning:
समेत्य सर्ववरदं चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुखम् /
पृच्छन्ति प्रणिपत्यैनं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम् //
text_mt: having gathered before him who grants all boons, having four forms and four faces, / the maker of all, the imperishable one, bowing low, they questioned him.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkulīyā ūcuḥ
bhagavan devamīśānaṃ bhargamekaṃ kapardinam /
kenopāyena paśyāmo brūhi devanamaskṛtam //
meaning:
षट्कुलीया ऊचुः
भगवन् देवमीशानं भर्गमेकं कपर्दिनम् /
केनोपायेन पश्यामो ब्रूहि देवनमस्कृतम् //
text_mt: The sages of the six lineages said: / 'O Blessed One, the god Īśāna, Bharga, the sole one wearing matted hair— / by what means may we behold him who is venerated by the gods? Tell us.'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca
satraṃ sahasramāsadhvaṃ vāṅmanodoṣavarjitāḥ /
deśaṃ ca vaḥ pravakṣyāmi yasmin deśe cariṣyatha //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सत्रं सहस्रमासध्वं वाङ्मनोदोषवर्जिताः /
देशं च वः प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्मिन् देशे चरिष्यथ //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Perform a sacrificial session of a thousand [years], free from defects of speech and mind; / and I will tell you the region in which you shall wander.'

sanskrit_iast:
uktvā manomayaṃ cakraṃ sa sṛṣṭvā tānuvāca ha /
kṣiptametanmayā cakramanuvrajata mā ciram /
yatrāsya nemiḥ śīryeta sa deśaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ //
meaning:
उक्त्वा मनोमयं चक्रं स सृष्ट्वा तानुवाच ह /
क्षिप्तमेतन्मया चक्रमनुव्रजत मा चिरम् /
यत्रास्य नेमिः शीर्येत स देशः पुरुषर्षभाः //
text_mt: Having spoken, he created a discus made of mind and said to them: / 'This discus is thrown by me; follow it without delay. / The place where its rim shatters is the region [for you], O bulls among men.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato mumoca taccakraṃ te ca tatsamanuvrajan /
tasya vai vrajataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra nemiraśīryata /
naimisaṃ tatsmṛtaṃ nāmnā puṇyaṃ sarvatra pūjitam //
meaning:
ततो मुमोच तच्चक्रं ते च तत्समनुव्रजन् /
तस्य वै व्रजतः क्षिप्रं यत्र नेमिरशीर्यत /
नैमिसं तत्स्मृतं नाम्ना पुण्यं सर्वत्र पूजितम् //
text_mt: Then he released that discus, and they followed after it. / Where the rim of that swiftly rolling [discus] shattered, / that place is called by name Naimiṣa, holy and revered everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ yakṣagandharvasevitam /
sthānaṃ bhagavataḥ śaṃbhoretannaimiśamuttamam //
meaning:
सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णं यक्षगन्धर्वसेवितम् /
स्थानं भगवतः शंभोरेतन्नैमिशमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Crowded with Siddhas and Cāraṇas, attended by Yakṣas and Gandharvas, / this excellent Naimiṣa is the abode of the blessed Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ /
tapastaptvā purā devā lebhire pravarān varān //
meaning:
अत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः /
तपस्तप्त्वा पुरा देवा लेभिरे प्रवरान् वरान् //
text_mt: Here, in ancient times, the gods along with the Gandharvas, / Yakṣas, serpents, and Rākṣasas, having practiced austerities, obtained excellent boons.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ deśaṃ samāśritya ṣaṭkulīyāḥ samāhitāḥ /
satreṇārādhya deveśaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram //
meaning:
इमं देशं समाश्रित्य षट्कुलीयाः समाहिताः /
सत्रेणाराध्य देवेशं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Resorting to this region, concentrated in mind, the sages of the six lineages, / having worshipped the Lord of gods with a sacrificial session, beheld Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
atra dānaṃ tapastaptaṃ snānaṃ japyādikaṃ ca yat /
ekaikaṃ pāvayet pāpaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
अत्र दानं तपस्तप्तं स्नानं जप्यादिकं च यत् /
एकैकं पावयेत् पापं सप्तजन्मकृतं द्विजाः //
text_mt: Whatever gift, austerity performed, bathing, or recitation [of mantras] takes place here, / each one purifies the sin committed over seven lifetimes, O twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
atra pūrvaṃ sa bhagavānṛṣīṇāṃ satramāsatām /
provāca vāyurbrahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmabhāṣitam //
meaning:
अत्र पूर्वं स भगवानृषीणां सत्रमासताम् /
प्रोवाच वायुर्ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं ब्रह्मभाषितम् //
text_mt: Here formerly the blessed Vāyu, to the sages performing a sacrificial session, / proclaimed the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
atra devo mahādevo rudrāṇyā kila viśvakṛt /
ramate 'dhyāpi bhagavān pramathaiḥ parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
अत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्राण्या किल विश्वकृत् /
रमते ऽध्यापि भगवान् प्रमथैः परिवारितः //
text_mt: Here the god Mahādeva, the maker of all, together with Rudrāṇī, / even today the blessed lord sports, surrounded by his attendant spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
atra prāṇān parityajya niyamena dvijātayaḥ /
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyanti yatra gatvā na jāyate //
meaning:
अत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य नियमेन द्विजातयः /
ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यन्ति यत्र गत्वा न जायते //
text_mt: Abandoning their life-breaths here according to the rule, twice-born men / will go to the realm of Brahmā, having gone to which one is not reborn.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ jāpyeśvaramitiśrutam /
jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ yatra nandī mahāgaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं जाप्येश्वरमितिश्रुतम् /
जजाप रुद्रमनिशं यत्र नन्दी महागणः //
text_mt: There is also another foremost sacred site, renowned as Jāpyeśvara, / where the great attendant Nandī constantly chanted [prayers to] Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
prītastasya mahādevo devyā saha pinākadhṛk /
dadāvātmasamānatvaṃ mṛtyuvañcanameva ca //
meaning:
प्रीतस्तस्य महादेवो देव्या सह पिनाकधृक् /
ददावात्मसमानत्वं मृत्युवञ्चनमेव च //
text_mt: Pleased with him, Mahādeva, bearer of the Pināka, together with the goddess, / granted equality with himself and the deception of death.

sanskrit_iast:
abhūdṛṣiḥ sa dharmātmā śilādo nāma dharmavit /
ārādhayanmahādevaṃ putrārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
अभूदृषिः स धर्मात्मा शिलादो नाम धर्मवित् /
आराधयन्महादेवं पुत्रार्थं वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: There was a righteous sage, knower of righteousness, named Śilāda, / who worshipped Mahādeva, whose banner bears the bull, for the sake of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya varṣasahasrānte tapyamānasya viśvakṛt /
śarvaḥ somo gaṇavṛto varado 'smītyabhāṣata //
meaning:
तस्य वर्षसहस्रान्ते तप्यमानस्य विश्वकृत् /
शर्वः सोमो गणवृतो वरदो ऽस्मीत्यभाषत //
text_mt: At the end of a thousand years as he was performing austerities, the maker of all, / Śarva, accompanied by Umā and surrounded by his attendants, said, 'I am the granter of boons.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa vavre varamīśānaṃ vareṇyaṃ girijāpatim /
ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnaṃ dehi putraṃ tvayā samam //
meaning:
स वव्रे वरमीशानं वरेण्यं गिरिजापतिम् /
अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं देहि पुत्रं त्वया समम् //
text_mt: He chose a boon from Īśāna, the most worthy of choice, husband of the mountain-born goddess: / 'Give me a son not born of a womb, free from death, and equal to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathāstvityāha bhagavān devyā saha maheśvaraḥ /
paśyatastasya viprarṣerantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ //
meaning:
तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् देव्या सह महेश्वरः /
पश्यतस्तस्य विप्रर्षेरन्तर्धानं गतो हरः //
text_mt: The blessed Maheśvara along with the goddess said, 'So be it.' / While that brahmin-sage was watching, Hara vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yiyakṣuḥ svāṃ bhūmiṃ śilādo dharmavittamaḥ /
cakarṣa lāṅgalenorvoṃ bhittvādṛśyata śobhanaḥ //
meaning:
ततो यियक्षुः स्वां भूमिं शिलादो धर्मवित्तमः /
चकर्ष लाङ्गलेनोर्वों भित्त्वादृश्यत शोभनः //
text_mt: Then Śilāda, the foremost knower of righteousness, desiring to sacrifice, / ploughed his field with a plough; and splitting the earth, an auspicious one appeared,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartakānalaprakhyaḥ kumāraḥ prahasanniva /
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannastejasā bhāsayan diśaḥ //
meaning:
संवर्तकानलप्रख्यः कुमारः प्रहसन्निव /
रूपलावण्यसंपन्नस्तेजसा भासयन् दिशः //
text_mt: a youth resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution, smiling as it were, / endowed with beauty and charm, illuminating the quarters with his splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
kumāratulyo 'pratimo meghagambhīrayā girā /
śilādaṃ tāta tāteti prāha nandī punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
कुमारतुल्यो ऽप्रतिमो मेघगम्भीरया गिरा /
शिलादं तात तातेति प्राह नन्दी पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Equal to Kumāra, matchless, with a voice deep as a thundercloud, / Nandī said repeatedly to Śilāda, 'Father! Father!'

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandanaṃ jātaṃ śilādaḥ pariṣasvaje /
munibhyo darśayāmāsa ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा नन्दनं जातं शिलादः परिषस्वजे /
मुनिभ्यो दर्शयामास ये तदाश्रमवासिनः //
text_mt: Seeing that son born to him, Śilāda embraced him, / and showed him to the sages who were dwellers of that hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāstasya cakāra ha /
upanīya yathāśāstraṃ vedamadhyāpayat sutam //
meaning:
जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वाः क्रियास्तस्य चकार ह /
उपनीय यथाशास्त्रं वेदमध्यापयत् सुतम् //
text_mt: He performed for him all the rites, beginning with the birth rite; / having invested him with the sacred thread according to the treatises, he taught the Veda to his son.

sanskrit_iast:
adhītavedo bhagavān nandī matimanuttamām /
cakre maheśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ jeṣye mṛtyumiti prabhum //
meaning:
अधीतवेदो भगवान् नन्दी मतिमनुत्तमाम् /
चक्रे महेश्वरं द्रष्टुं जेष्ये मृत्युमिति प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Having studied the Vedas, the blessed Nandī formed the highest resolve / to behold the powerful Maheśvara, thinking, 'I shall conquer death.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā saritaṃ puṇyāmekāgraśraddhayānvitaḥ /
jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ maheśāsaktamānasaḥ //
meaning:
स गत्वा सरितं पुण्यामेकाग्रश्रद्धयान्वितः /
जजाप रुद्रमनिशं महेशासक्तमानसः //
text_mt: Having gone to a holy river, endowed with one-pointed faith, / he constantly chanted [prayers to] Rudra, his mind fixed upon the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya koṭyāṃ tu pūrṇāyāṃ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ /
āgatya sāmbaḥ sagaṇo varado 'smītyuvāca ha //
meaning:
तस्य कोट्यां तु पूर्णायां शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः /
आगत्य साम्बः सगणो वरदो ऽस्मीत्युवाच ह //
text_mt: When a crore was completed by him, Śaṅkara, affectionate to devotees, / arrived with the Mother and his attendants and said, 'I am the granter of boons.'

sanskrit_iast:
sa vavre punarevāhaṃ japeyaṃ koṭimīśvaram /
tāvadāyurmahādeva dehīti varamīśvara //
meaning:
स वव्रे पुनरेवाहं जपेयं कोटिमीश्वरम् /
तावदायुर्महादेव देहीति वरमीश्वर //
text_mt: He chose again: 'May I chant another crore [to] the Lord! / O Mahādeva, grant a lifespan of that duration, O sovereign Lord.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamastviti saṃprocya devo 'pyantaradhīyata /
jajāpa koṭiṃ bhagavān bhūyastadgatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
एवमस्त्विति संप्रोच्य देवो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत /
जजाप कोटिं भगवान् भूयस्तद्गतमानसः //
text_mt: Saying, 'So be it,' the god vanished; / and the blessed one chanted another crore, with his mind focused on him.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ ca koṭyāṃ vai saṃpūrṇāyāṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ /
āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयायां च कोट्यां वै संपूर्णायां वृषध्वजः /
आगत्य वरदो ऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः //
text_mt: And when the second crore was completed, he whose banner bears the bull, / surrounded by hosts of spirits, arrived and said, 'I am the granter of boons.'

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāṃ japtumicchāmi koṭiṃ bhūyo 'pi śaṅkara /
tathāstvityāha viśvātmā devo 'pyantaradhīyata //
meaning:
तृतीयां जप्तुमिच्छामि कोटिं भूयो ऽपि शङ्कर /
तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा देवो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत //
text_mt:
"I wish to recite another ten million, O Śaṅkara."
"Let it be so," said the Soul of all, and the god vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭitraye 'tha saṃpūrṇe devaḥ prītamanā bhṛśam /
āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
कोटित्रये ऽथ संपूर्णे देवः प्रीतमना भृशम् /
आगत्य वरदो ऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः //
text_mt:
Then, when the three sets of ten million were complete, the god, highly pleased in mind,
came surrounded by his hosts of beings and said, "I am the granter of boons."

sanskrit_iast:
japeyaṃ koṭimanyāṃ vai bhūyo 'pi tava tejasā /
ityukte bhagavānāha na japtavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ //
meaning:
जपेयं कोटिमन्यां वै भूयो ऽपि तव तेजसा /
इत्युक्ते भगवानाह न जप्तव्यं त्वया पुनः //
text_mt:
"May I recite yet another ten million by your splendor."
When this was said, the Blessed Lord replied, "You must not recite again.

sanskrit_iast:
amaro jarayā tyakto mama pārśvagataḥ sadā /
mahāgaṇapatirdevyāḥ putro bhava maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अमरो जरया त्यक्तो मम पार्श्वगतः सदा /
महागणपतिर्देव्याः पुत्रो भव महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
Immortal, freed from old age, always at my side,
become the great leader of the Gaṇas, the son of the Goddess, a great lord,

sanskrit_iast:
yogīśvaro yoganetā gaṇānāmīśvareśvaraḥ /
sarvalokādhipaḥ śrīmān sarvajño madbalānvitaḥ //
meaning:
योगीश्वरो योगनेता गणानामीश्वरेश्वरः /
सर्वलोकाधिपः श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञो मद्बलान्वितः //
text_mt:
a lord of yoga, a guide of yoga, lord of the lords among the Gaṇas,
sovereign of all the worlds, glorious, omniscient, endowed with my strength.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ tanmāmakaṃ divyaṃ hastāmalakavat tava /
ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī tato yāsyasi matpadam //
meaning:
ज्ञानं तन्मामकं दिव्यं हस्तामलकवत् तव /
आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी ततो यास्यसि मत्पदम् //
text_mt:
That divine knowledge of mine shall be yours, like an āmalaka fruit in the palm of your hand.
Remaining until the universal dissolution of beings, you will then go to my supreme abode."

sanskrit_iast:
etaduktvā mahādevo gaṇānāhūya śaṅkaraḥ /
abhiṣekeṇa yuktena nandīśvaramayojayat //
meaning:
एतदुक्त्वा महादेवो गणानाहूय शङ्करः /
अभिषेकेण युक्तेन नन्दीश्वरमयोजयत् //
text_mt:
Having said this, Mahādeva Śaṅkara, summoning the Gaṇas,
invested Nandīśvara with a suitable consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhayāmāsa ca taṃ svayameva pinākadhṛk /
marutāṃ ca śubhāṃ kanyāṃ suyaśeti ca viśrutām //
meaning:
उद्वाहयामास च तं स्वयमेव पिनाकधृक् /
मरुतां च शुभां कन्यां सुयशेति च विश्रुताम् //
text_mt:
And the Wielder of the Pināka himself gave him in marriage
to the auspicious daughter of the Maruts, renowned as Suyaśā.

sanskrit_iast:
etajjapyeśvaraṃ sthānaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ /
yatra tatra mṛto martyo rudraloke mahīyate //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतज्जप्येश्वरं स्थानं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः /
यत्र तत्र मृतो मर्त्यो रुद्रलोके महीयते //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This is the holy place Japyeśvara of the god of gods who bears the trident; / a mortal who dies anywhere there is glorified in the realm of Rudra.

Thus ends the forty-first chapter in the latter section of the six-thousand-verse compilation in the venerable Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ japyeśvarasamīpataḥ /
nāmnā pañcanadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं जप्येश्वरसमीपतः /
नाम्ना पञ्चनदं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
title: dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Near Japyeśvara is another excellent holy place / by the name of Pañcanada, sacred and destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātropoṣitastatra pūjayitvā maheśvaram /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितस्तत्र पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Fasting there for three nights and worshipping Maheśvara, / his self purified of all sins, he is glorified in the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ /
mahābhairavamityuktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं शङ्करस्यामितौजसः /
महाभैरवमित्युक्तं महापातकनाशनम् //
text_mt: There is another excellent holy place of Śaṅkara of boundless might, / known as Mahābhairava, destroying mortal sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ vitastā paramā nadī /
sarvapāpaharā puṇyā svayameva girīndrajā //
meaning:
तीर्थानां च परं तीर्थं वितस्ता परमा नदी /
सर्वपापहरा पुण्या स्वयमेव गिरीन्द्रजा //
text_mt: The supreme holy place among holy places is the Vitastā, the highest river, / removing all sins, holy, being none other than the daughter of the mountain king herself.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ pañcatapaṃ nāma śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ /
yatra devādidevena cakrārthaṃ pūjito bhavaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थं पञ्चतपं नाम शंभोरमिततेजसः /
यत्र देवादिदेवेन चक्रार्थं पूजितो भवः //
text_mt: There is a holy place named Pañcatapa of Śambhu of boundless splendour, / where Bhava was worshipped by the primeval god of gods in order to obtain the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍadānādikaṃ tatra pretyānantaphalapradam /
mṛtastatrāpi niyamād brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
पिण्डदानादिकं तत्र प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदम् /
मृतस्तत्रापि नियमाद् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Offering funeral cakes and other rites there bestows endless fruit after death; / and one who dies there, by rule, is glorified in the realm of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
kāyāvarohaṇaṃ nāma mahādevālayaṃ śubham /
yatra māheśvarā dharmā munibhiḥ saṃpravartitāḥ //
meaning:
कायावरोहणं नाम महादेवालयं शुभम् /
यत्र माहेश्वरा धर्मा मुनिभिः संप्रवर्तिताः //
text_mt: There is an auspicious shrine of Mahādeva named Kāyāvarohaṇa, / where the Māheśvara duties were set in motion by the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo homa upavāsastathākṣayaḥ /
parityajati yaḥ prāṇān rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
श्राद्धं दानं तपो होम उपवासस्तथाक्षयः /
परित्यजति यः प्राणान् रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt: Ancestral offering rites, gift-giving, austerity, fire-offerings, and fasting there become imperishable; / he who abandons his vital breaths goes to the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kanyātīrthamiti śrutam /
tatra gatvā tyajet prāṇāṃllokān prāpnoti śāśvatān //
meaning:
अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं कन्यातीर्थमिति श्रुतम् /
तत्र गत्वा त्यजेत् प्राणांल्लोकान् प्राप्नोति शाश्वतान् //
text_mt: There is another excellent holy place known as Kanyātīrtha; / going there, if one abandons his vital breaths, he attains eternal worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmadagnyasya tu śubhaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ /
tatra snātvā tīrtha vare gosahasraphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
जामदग्न्यस्य तु शुभं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः /
तत्र स्नात्वा तीर्थ वरे गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: There is the auspicious [place] of Rāma, son of Jamadagni, of untiring deeds; / bathing in that excellent holy place, one obtains the reward of a thousand cows.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
gatvā prāṇān parityajya gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
महाकालमिति ख्यातं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
गत्वा प्राणान् परित्यज्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Renowned throughout the three worlds is the holy place famous as Mahākāla; / going there and giving up one's vital breaths, one obtains the status of an attendant.

sanskrit_iast:
guhyād guhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ nakulīśvaramuttamam /
tatra sannihitaḥ śrīmān bhagavān nakulīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं तीर्थं नकुलीश्वरमुत्तमम् /
तत्र सन्निहितः श्रीमान् भगवान् नकुलीश्वरः //
text_mt: The most secret of secrets is the supreme holy place Nakulīśvara; / the blessed Lord Nakulīśvara is present there.

sanskrit_iast:
himavacchikhare ramye gaṅgādvāre suśobhane /
devyā saha mahādevo nityaṃ śiṣyaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये गङ्गाद्वारे सुशोभने /
देव्या सह महादेवो नित्यं शिष्यैश्च संवृतः //
text_mt: On a delightful peak of the Himālaya, at the highly adorned Gaṅgādvāra, / Mahādeva resides eternally together with the Goddess, surrounded by his disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā mahādevaṃ pūjayitvā vṛṣadhvajam /
sarvapāpairvimucyeta mṛtastajjñānamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवं पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम् /
सर्वपापैर्विमुच्येत मृतस्तज्ज्ञानमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Bathing there and worshipping Mahādeva whose banner bears a bull, / one is freed from all sins, and dying, attains that knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham /
bhīmeśvaramiti khyātaṃ gatvā muñcati pātakam //
meaning:
अन्यच्च देवदेवस्य स्थानं पुण्यतमं शुभम् /
भीमेश्वरमिति ख्यातं गत्वा मुञ्चति पातकम् //
text_mt: There is another most sacred, auspicious place of the god of gods, / renowned as Bhīmeśvara; going there, one sheds one's sin.

sanskrit_iast:
tathānyaccaṇḍavegāyāḥ saṃbhedaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ /
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate brahmahatyayā //
meaning:
तथान्यच्चण्डवेगायाः संभेदः पापनाशनः /
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
text_mt: Likewise, another is the confluence of the Caṇḍavegā, which destroys sins; / bathing there and drinking [its water], one is freed from the murder of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ paramā purī /
nāmnāvārāṇasī divyā koṭikoṭyayutādhikā //
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि चैतेषां तीर्थानां परमा पुरी /
नाम्नावाराणसी दिव्या कोटिकोट्ययुताधिका //
text_mt: And the supreme city surpassing all these holy places / is the divine Vārāṇasī, superior by hundreds of millions of ten thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ purastānmāhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ vo mayā tviha /
nānyatra labhyate muktiryogināpyekajanmanā //
meaning:
तस्याः पुरस्तान्माहात्म्यं भाषितं वो मया त्विह /
नान्यत्र लभ्यते मुक्तिर्योगिनाप्येकजन्मना //
text_mt: Its greatness was spoken of to you by me previously; / nowhere else is liberation obtained by a yogin in a single birth.

sanskrit_iast:
ete prādhānyataḥ proktā deśāḥ pāpaharā nṛṇām /
gatvā saṃkṣālayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam //
meaning:
एते प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ता देशाः पापहरा नृणाम् /
गत्वा संक्षालयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम् //
text_mt: These places, which remove the sins of men, have been proclaimed in main outline; / having gone there, one washes away sin committed in hundreds of other lifetimes.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svadharmān parityajya tīrthasevāṃ karoti hi /
na tasya phalate tīrthamahi loke paratra ca //
meaning:
यः स्वधर्मान् परित्यज्य तीर्थसेवां करोति हि /
न तस्य फलते तीर्थमहि लोके परत्र च //
text_mt: He who, abandoning his own duties, resorts to holy places— / for him the holy place bears no fruit in this world or in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittī ca vidhurastathā pāpacaro gṛhī /
prakuryāt tīrthasaṃsevāṃ ye cānye tādṛśā janāḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्ती च विधुरस्तथा पापचरो गृही /
प्रकुर्यात् तीर्थसंसेवां ये चान्ये तादृशा जनाः //
text_mt: One undergoing penance, a widower, and likewise a householder who has committed sin / should resort to holy places, as well as any other such people.

sanskrit_iast:
sahāgnirvā sapatnīko gacchet tīrthāni yatnataḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmukto yathoktāṃ gatimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
सहाग्निर्वा सपत्नीको गच्छेत् तीर्थानि यत्नतः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो यथोक्तां गतिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Or, keeping his sacred fires and together with his wife, he should visit holy places with care; / released from all sins, he attains the destination described.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya kuryād vā tīrthasevanam /
vidhāya vṛttiṃ putrāṇāṃ bhāryāṃ teṣu nidhāya ca //
meaning:
ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकृत्य कुर्याद् वा तीर्थसेवनम् /
विधाय वृत्तिं पुत्राणां भार्यां तेषु निधाय च //
text_mt: Or one may resort to holy places after discharging the three debts, / having provided a livelihood for his sons and entrusted his wife to them.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaprasaṅgena tīrthamāhātmyamīritam /
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तप्रसङ्गेन तीर्थमाहात्म्यमीरितम् /
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
In the context of expiation, the greatness of holy places has been declared; / whoever recites or hears it is freed from all mortal sins.

Thus ends the forty-second chapter in the latter section of the six-thousand-verse compilation in the venerable Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etadākarṇya vijñānaṃ nārāyaṇamukheritam /
kūrmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ papracchurmunayaḥ prabhum //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतदाकर्ण्य विज्ञानं नारायणमुखेरितम् /
कूर्मरूपधरं देवं पप्रच्छुर्मुनयः प्रभुम् //
title: tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: Sūta said: / Having heard this higher knowledge spoken from the mouth of Nārāyaṇa, / the sages questioned the Lord, the god who had assumed the form of a tortoise.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
kathitā bhavatā dharmā mokṣajñānaṃ savistaram /
lokānāṃ sargavistāraṃ vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
कथिता भवता धर्मा मोक्षज्ञानं सविस्तरम् /
लोकानां सर्गविस्तारं वंशमन्वन्तराणि च //
text_mt: The sages said: / You have told of righteous duties, the knowledge of liberation in detail, / the extensive creation of the worlds, dynasties, and cosmic eras of a Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
pratisargamidānīṃ no vaktumarhasī mādhava /
bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhavyeśa yathā pūrvaṃ tvayoditam //
meaning:
प्रतिसर्गमिदानीं नो वक्तुमर्हसी माधव /
भूतानां भूतभव्येश यथा पूर्वं त्वयोदितम् //
text_mt: Now you should speak to us, O Mādhava, of the secondary recreation / of living beings, O lord of what has been and what is to be, as previously stated by you.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavān kūrmarūpadhṛk /
vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtānāṃ pratisaṃcaram //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान् कूर्मरूपधृक् /
व्याजहार महायोगी भूतानां प्रतिसंचरम् //
text_mt: Sūta said: / Hearing their words then, the blessed Lord who bears the form of a tortoise, / the great yogin, spoke of the cosmic dissolution of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrma uvāca
nityo naimittikaścaiva prākṛtātyantikau tathā /
caturdhāyaṃ purāṇe 'smin procyate pratisaṃcaraḥ //
meaning:
कूर्म उवाच
नित्यो नैमित्तिकश्चैव प्राकृतात्यन्तिकौ तथा /
चतुर्धायं पुराणे ऽस्मिन् प्रोच्यते प्रतिसंचरः //
text_mt: Kūrma said: / Constant, occasional, material, and absolute: / in this Purāṇa, cosmic dissolution is declared to be fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate nityaṃ loke bhūtakṣayastviha /
nityaḥ saṃkīrtyate nāmnā munibhiḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽयं संदृश्यते नित्यं लोके भूतक्षयस्त्विह /
नित्यः संकीर्त्यते नाम्ना मुनिभिः प्रतिसंचरः //
