text_mt: That destruction of beings which is constantly observed here in the world / is proclaimed by sages under the name of constant dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmo naimittiko nāma kalpānte yo bhaviṣyati /
trailokyasyāsya kathitaḥ pratisargo manīṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको नाम कल्पान्ते यो भविष्यति /
त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य कथितः प्रतिसर्गो मनीषिभिः //
text_mt: The occasional [dissolution] of Brahmā, which will occur at the end of a cosmic age / for this threefold world, is called by the wise a secondary recreation [by dissolution].

sanskrit_iast:
mahādādyāṃ viśeṣāntaṃ yadā saṃyāti saṃkṣayam /
prākṛtaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ procyate kālacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
महादाद्यां विशेषान्तं यदा संयाति संक्षयम् /
प्राकृतः प्रतिसर्गो ऽयं प्रोच्यते कालचिन्तकैः //
text_mt: When from the Great Principle down to the gross elements everything undergoes destruction, / this is declared by thinkers on time to be material dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānādātyantikaḥ prokto yoginaḥ paramātmani /
pralayaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ kālacintāparairdvijaiḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानादात्यन्तिकः प्रोक्तो योगिनः परमात्मनि /
प्रलयः प्रतिसर्गो ऽयं कालचिन्तापरैर्द्विजैः //
text_mt: The absolute [dissolution] of the yogin into the Supreme Self through knowledge / is proclaimed as dissolution and recreation by the twice-born devoted to the thought of time.

sanskrit_iast:
ātyantikaśca kathitaḥ pralayo 'tra sasādhanaḥ /
naimittikamidānīṃ vaḥ kathayiṣye samāsataḥ //
meaning:
आत्यन्तिकश्च कथितः प्रलयो ऽत्र ससाधनः /
नैमित्तिकमिदानीं वः कथयिष्ये समासतः //
text_mt: The absolute dissolution has been described here along with its means; / now I shall declare to you the occasional [dissolution] in summary.

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugasahasrānte saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare /
svātmasaṃsthāḥ prajāḥ kartuṃ pratipede prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्युगसहस्रान्ते संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे /
स्वात्मसंस्थाः प्रजाः कर्तुं प्रतिपेदे प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: At the end of a thousand cycles of four ages, when the cosmic dissolution has arrived, / the Lord of Creatures undertook to withdraw the creatures into himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavatyanāvṛṣṭistīvrā sā śatavārṣikī /
bhūtakṣayakarī ghorā sarvabhūtakṣayaṅkarī //
meaning:
ततो भवत्यनावृष्टिस्तीव्रा सा शतवार्षिकी /
भूतक्षयकरी घोरा सर्वभूतक्षयङ्करी //
text_mt: Then there comes a severe drought lasting a hundred years, / bringing the destruction of beings, terrible, causing the ruin of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale /
tāni cāgre pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca //
meaning:
ततो यान्यल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि पृथिवीतले /
तानि चाग्रे प्रलीयन्ते भूमित्वमुपयान्ति च //
text_mt: Then whatever creatures are of little strength on the surface of the earth, / they dissolve first and turn into earth.

sanskrit_iast:
saptaraśmiratho bhūtvā samuttiṣṭhan divākaraḥ /
asahyaraśmirbhavati pibannambho gabhastibhiḥ //
meaning:
सप्तरश्मिरथो भूत्वा समुत्तिष्ठन् दिवाकरः /
असह्यरश्मिर्भवति पिबन्नम्भो गभस्तिभिः //
text_mt: Then the sun, rising and becoming seven-rayed, / becomes unbearable in its rays, drinking the water with its beams.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya te raśmayaḥ sapta pibantyambu mahārṇave /
tenāhāreṇa tā dīptāḥ sūryāḥ sapta bhavantyuta //
meaning:
तस्य ते रश्मयः सप्त पिबन्त्यम्बु महार्णवे /
तेनाहारेण ता दीप्ताः सूर्याः सप्त भवन्त्युत //
text_mt: Those seven rays of his drink the water in the great ocean; / through that fuel, blazing, they become seven suns.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste raśmayaḥ sapta sūryā bhūtvā caturdiśam /
caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ dahanti śikhinastathā //
meaning:
ततस्ते रश्मयः सप्त सूर्या भूत्वा चतुर्दिशम् /
चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्वं दहन्ति शिखिनस्तथा //
text_mt: Then those seven rays, having become suns on all four sides, / burn this entire fourfold world like fires.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpnuvantaśca te viprāstūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca raśmibhiḥ /
dīpyante bhāskarāḥ sapta yugāntāgnipratāpinaḥ //
meaning:
व्याप्नुवन्तश्च ते विप्रास्तूर्ध्वं चाधश्च रश्मिभिः /
दीप्यन्ते भास्कराः सप्त युगान्ताग्निप्रतापिनः //
text_mt: And pervading above and below with their rays, O brahmins, / the seven suns blaze, radiating heat like the fire at the end of the cosmic age.

sanskrit_iast:
te sūryā vāriṇā dīptā bahusāhastraraśmayaḥ /
khaṃ samāvṛtya tiṣṭhanti nirdahanto vasuṃdharām //
meaning:
ते सूर्या वारिणा दीप्ता बहुसाहस्त्ररश्मयः /
खं समावृत्य तिष्ठन्ति निर्दहन्तो वसुंधराम् //
text_mt: Those suns, blazing with water and possessing many thousands of rays, / remain covering the sky, burning the earth to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣāṃ pratāpena dahyamānā vasuṃdharā /
sādrinadyarṇavadvīpā nisnehā samapadyata //
meaning:
ततस्तेषां प्रतापेन दह्यमाना वसुंधरा /
साद्रिनद्यर्णवद्वीपा निस्नेहा समपद्यत //
text_mt: Then the earth, being burned by their heat / along with its mountains, rivers, oceans, and continents, became devoid of moisture.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptābhiḥ saṃtatābhiśca raśmibhirvai samantataḥ /
adhaścordhvaṃ ca lagnābhistiryak caiva samāvṛtam //
meaning:
दीप्ताभिः संतताभिश्च रश्मिभिर्वै समन्ततः /
अधश्चोर्ध्वं च लग्नाभिस्तिर्यक् चैव समावृतम् //
text_mt: Covered on all sides by continuous blazing rays / clinging below, above, and horizontally.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāgninā pramṛṣṭānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ parasparam /
ekatvamupayātānāmekajvālaṃ bhavatyuta //
meaning:
सूर्याग्निना प्रमृष्टानां संसृष्टानां परस्परम् /
एकत्वमुपयातानामेकज्वालं भवत्युत //
text_mt:
Of those wiped clean by the solar fire, brought into contact with one another,
and merged into oneness, there comes to be a single blazing flame.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokapraṇāśaśca so 'gnirbhūtvā sukuṇḍalī /
caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ nirdahatyātmatejasā //
meaning:
सर्वलोकप्रणाशश्च सो ऽग्निर्भूत्वा सुकुण्डली /
चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्वं निर्दहत्यात्मतेजसा //
text_mt:
And that fire, becoming well-coiled, bringing about the destruction of all the worlds,
burns up all these four worlds with its own brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pralīne sarvasmiñ jaṅgame sthāvare tathā /
nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmiḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhā prakāśate //
meaning:
ततः प्रलीने सर्वस्मिञ् जङ्गमे स्थावरे तथा /
निर्वृक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिः कूर्मपृष्ठा प्रकाशते //
text_mt:
Then, when everything moving and unmoving has dissolved,
the earth shines forth without trees, without grass, resembling the back of a tortoise.

sanskrit_iast:
ambarīṣamivābhāti sarvamāpūritaṃ jagat /
sarvameva tadarcirbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ jājvalyate punaḥ //
meaning:
अम्बरीषमिवाभाति सर्वमापूरितं जगत् /
सर्वमेव तदर्चिर्भिः पूर्णं जाज्वल्यते पुनः //
text_mt:
The whole world, completely filled, appears like a frying pan;
filled entirely with those flames, it blazes fiercely once more.

sanskrit_iast:
pātāle yāni sattvāni mahodadhigatāni ca /
tatastāni pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca //
meaning:
पाताले यानि सत्त्वानि महोदधिगतानि च /
ततस्तानि प्रलीयन्ते भूमित्वमुपयान्ति च //
text_mt:
The beings that were in the netherworld and in the great oceans
then dissolve and turn into earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva varṣāṇyatha mahodadhīn /
tān sarvān bhasmasāt kṛtvā saptātmā pāvakaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
द्वीपांश्च पर्वतांश्चैव वर्षाण्यथ महोदधीन् /
तान् सर्वान् भस्मसात् कृत्वा सप्तात्मा पावकः प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Having reduced the continents, the mountains, the continental realms, and the great oceans,
all of them, to ashes, the sevenfold, lordly fire,

sanskrit_iast:
samudrebhyo nadībhyaśca pātālebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ /
pibannapaḥ samiddho 'gniḥ pṛthivīmāśrito jvalan //
meaning:
समुद्रेभ्यो नदीभ्यश्च पातालेभ्यश्च सर्वशः /
पिबन्नपः समिद्धो ऽग्निः पृथिवीमाश्रितो ज्वलन् //
text_mt:
drinking water on all sides from the oceans, from the rivers, and from the nether regions,
blazing up and resting upon the earth, burns intensely.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃvartakaḥ śailānatikramya mahāṃstathā /
lokān dahati dīptātmā rudratejovijṝmbhitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः संवर्तकः शैलानतिक्रम्य महांस्तथा /
लोकान् दहति दीप्तात्मा रुद्रतेजोविजॄम्भितः //
text_mt:
Then the fire of cosmic dissolution, surpassing the great mountains,
burns the worlds, blazing with radiant nature, swelling with the splendor of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dagdhvā pṛthivīṃ devo rasātalamaśoṣayat /
adhastāt pṛthivīṃ dagdhvā divamūrdhvaṃ dahiṣyati //
meaning:
स दग्ध्वा पृथिवीं देवो रसातलमशोषयत् /
अधस्तात् पृथिवीं दग्ध्वा दिवमूर्ध्वं दहिष्यति //
text_mt:
Having burned the earth, the god dried up the netherworld;
having burned the earth below, he will burn heaven above.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ śatānīha sahasrāṇyayutāni ca /
uttiṣṭhanti śikhāstasya vahneḥ saṃvartakasya tu //
meaning:
योजनानां शतानीह सहस्राण्ययुतानि च /
उत्तिष्ठन्ति शिखास्तस्य वह्नेः संवर्तकस्य तु //
text_mt:
Flames of that fire of cosmic dissolution arise,
extending hundreds, thousands, and tens of thousands of yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāṃśca piśācāṃśca sayakṣoragarākṣasān /
tadā dahatyasau dīptaḥ kālarudrapracoditaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वांश्च पिशाचांश्च सयक्षोरगराक्षसान् /
तदा दहत्यसौ दीप्तः कालरुद्रप्रचोदितः //
text_mt:
Blazing and impelled by the Rudra of Time, he then burns
the Gandharvas and Piśācas, along with the Yakṣas, Uragas, and Rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca tathā mahaḥ /
dahedaśeṣaṃ kālāgniḥ kālo viśvatanuḥ svayam //
meaning:
भूर्लोकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं च तथा महः /
दहेदशेषं कालाग्निः कालो विश्वतनुः स्वयम् //
text_mt:
The Fire of Time, Time itself embodied in the universe,
would burn without remainder the earth-world, the mid-region, heaven, and Maharloka.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpteṣveteṣu lokeṣu tiryagūrdhvamathāgninā /
tat tejaḥ samanuprāpya kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ /
ayoguḍanibhaṃ sarvaṃ tadā caikaṃ prakāśate //
meaning:
व्याप्तेष्वेतेषु लोकेषु तिर्यगूर्ध्वमथाग्निना /
तत् तेजः समनुप्राप्य कृत्स्नं जगदिदं शनैः /
अयोगुडनिभं सर्वं तदा चैकं प्रकाशते //
text_mt:
When these worlds are pervaded horizontally and upwards by the fire,
having fully attained that brilliance, this entire world gradually
shines forth as one single mass, like an iron ball.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gajakulonnādāstaḍidbhiḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ /
uttiṣṭhanti tadā vyomni ghorāḥ saṃvartakā ghanāḥ //
meaning:
ततो गजकुलोन्नादास्तडिद्भिः समलङ्कृताः /
उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा व्योम्नि घोराः संवर्तका घनाः //
text_mt:
Then, roaring like herds of elephants, adorned with lightnings,
terrible clouds of cosmic dissolution arise in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
kecinnīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecit kumudasannibhāḥ /
dhūmravarṇāstathā kecit kecit pītāḥ payodharāḥ //
meaning:
केचिन्नीलोत्पलश्यामाः केचित् कुमुदसन्निभाः /
धूम्रवर्णास्तथा केचित् केचित् पीताः पयोधराः //
text_mt:
Some are dark as blue lotuses, some resemble white water-lilies;
some clouds are smoke-colored, and some are yellow.

sanskrit_iast:
kecid rāsabhavarṇāstu lākṣārasanibhāstathā /
śaṅkhakundanibhāścānye jātyañjananibhāḥ pare //
meaning:
केचिद् रासभवर्णास्तु लाक्षारसनिभास्तथा /
शङ्खकुन्दनिभाश्चान्ये जात्यञ्जननिभाः परे //
text_mt:
Some are colored like donkeys, others like lac-dye;
some resemble conch shells and kunda flowers, others are like black collyrium.

sanskrit_iast:
manaḥ śilābhāstvanye ca kapotasadṛśāḥ pare /
indragopanibhāḥ keciddharitālanibhāstathā /
indracāpanibhāḥ keciduttiṣṭhanti ghanā divi //
meaning:
मनः शिलाभास्त्वन्ये च कपोतसदृशाः परे /
इन्द्रगोपनिभाः केचिद्धरितालनिभास्तथा /
इन्द्रचापनिभाः केचिदुत्तिष्ठन्ति घना दिवि //
text_mt:
Others shine like red arsenic, others are like pigeons;
some clouds arise in the sky resembling cochineal insects, others like yellow orpiment, and some resembling rainbows.

sanskrit_iast:
kecit parvatasaṃkāśāḥ kecid gajakulopamāḥ /
kūṭāṅgāranibhāścānye kecinmīnakulodvahāḥ /
bahūrūpā ghorūpā ghorasvaraninādinaḥ //
meaning:
केचित् पर्वतसंकाशाः केचिद् गजकुलोपमाः /
कूटाङ्गारनिभाश्चान्ये केचिन्मीनकुलोद्वहाः /
बहूरूपा घोरूपा घोरस्वरनिनादिनः //

sanskrit_iast:
tadā jaladharāḥ sarve pūrayanti nabhaḥ sthalam /
tataste jaladā ghorā rāviṇo bhāskarātmajāḥ /
saptadhā saṃvṛtātmānastamagniṃ śamayantyuta //
meaning:
तदा जलधराः सर्वे पूरयन्ति नभः स्थलम् /
ततस्ते जलदा घोरा राविणो भास्करात्मजाः /
सप्तधा संवृतात्मानस्तमग्निं शमयन्त्युत //

sanskrit_iast:
tataste jaladā varṣaṃ muñcantīha mahaughavat /
sughoramaśivaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayanti ca pāvakam //
meaning:
ततस्ते जलदा वर्षं मुञ्चन्तीह महौघवत् /
सुघोरमशिवं सर्वं नाशयन्ति च पावकम् //
text_mt:
Then those clouds release rain like a mighty torrent here;
they destroy that fire, which was utterly terrible and inauspicious to all.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛṣṭe ca tadātyarthamambhasā pūryate jagat /
adbhistejobhibhūtatvāt tadāgniḥ praviśatyapaḥ //
meaning:
प्रवृष्टे च तदात्यर्थमम्भसा पूर्यते जगत् /
अद्भिस्तेजोभिभूतत्वात् तदाग्निः प्रविशत्यपः //
text_mt:
And when it rains exceedingly, the world is filled with water;
since fire is overcome by water, the fire then enters the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭe cāgnau varṣaśataiḥ payodāḥ kṣayasaṃbhavāḥ /
plāvayanto 'tha bhuvanaṃ mahājalaparistravaiḥ //
meaning:
नष्टे चाग्नौ वर्षशतैः पयोदाः क्षयसंभवाः /
प्लावयन्तो ऽथ भुवनं महाजलपरिस्त्रवैः //
text_mt:
When the fire has vanished, the clouds born of the cosmic dissolution,
flooding the world for hundreds of years with great streams of water,

sanskrit_iast:
dhārābhiḥ pūrayantīdaṃ codyamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā /
atyantasalilaughaiśca velā iva mahodadhiḥ //
meaning:
धाराभिः पूरयन्तीदं चोद्यमानाः स्वयंभुवा /
अत्यन्तसलिलौघैश्च वेला इव महोदधिः //
text_mt:
impelled by the Self-born, fill this [world] with downpours
and with extreme floods of water, as the great ocean fills its shores.

sanskrit_iast:
sādridvīpā tathā pṛthvī jalaiḥ saṃcchādyate śanaiḥ /
ādityaraśmibhiḥ pītaṃ jalamabhreṣu tiṣṭhati /
punaḥ patati tad bhūmau pūryante tena cārṇavāḥ //
meaning:
साद्रिद्वीपा तथा पृथ्वी जलैः संच्छाद्यते शनैः /
आदित्यरश्मिभिः पीतं जलमभ्रेषु तिष्ठति /
पुनः पतति तद् भूमौ पूर्यन्ते तेन चार्णवाः //

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samudrāḥ svāṃ velāmatikrāntāstu kṛtsnaśaḥ /
parvatāśca vilīyante mahī cāpsu nimajjati //
meaning:
ततः समुद्राः स्वां वेलामतिक्रान्तास्तु कृत्स्नशः /
पर्वताश्च विलीयन्ते मही चाप्सु निमज्जति //
text_mt:
Then the oceans completely transgress their shorelines,
the mountains dissolve, and the earth sinks into the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame /
yoganindrāṃ samāsthāya śete devaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे /
योगनिन्द्रां समास्थाय शेते देवः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt:
When the moving and unmoving have perished in that frightful single ocean,
the divine Prajāpati lies down, resorting to the sleep of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
caturyugasahasrāntaṃ kalpamāhurmaharṣayaḥ /
vārāho vartate kalpo yasya vistāra īritaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्युगसहस्रान्तं कल्पमाहुर्महर्षयः /
वाराहो वर्तते कल्पो यस्य विस्तार ईरितः //
text_mt:
Great sages say a kalpa ends after a thousand four-age cycles;
the Vārāha Kalpa, whose extent has been declared, is now current.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyātāstathā kalpā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ /
kathitā hi purāṇeṣu munibhiḥ kālacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
असंख्यातास्तथा कल्पा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकाः /
कथिता हि पुराणेषु मुनिभिः कालचिन्तकैः //
text_mt:
Innumerable kalpas composed of the nature of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva
have been proclaimed in the Purāṇas by the sages who contemplate Time.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikeṣvatha kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ /
tāmaseṣu harasyoktaṃ rājaseṣu prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
सात्त्विकेष्वथ कल्पेषु माहात्म्यमधिकं हरेः /
तामसेषु हरस्योक्तं राजसेषु प्रजापतेः //
text_mt:
In the sāttvika kalpas, the greatness of Hari is preeminent;
in the tāmasa ones, it is declared of Hara; in the rājasa ones, of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'yaṃ pravartate kalpo vārāhaḥ sāttviko mataḥ /
anye ca sāttvikāḥ kalpā mama teṣu parigrahaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽयं प्रवर्तते कल्पो वाराहः सात्त्विको मतः /
अन्ये च सात्त्विकाः कल्पा मम तेषु परिग्रहः //
text_mt:
This kalpa that is now proceeding, the Vārāha, is considered sāttvika;
other kalpas are also sāttvika, and my acceptance is in them.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaṃ tapastathā jñānaṃ labdhvā teṣveva yoginaḥ /
ārādhya giriśaṃ māṃ ca yānti tat paramaṃ padam //
meaning:
ध्यानं तपस्तथा ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा तेष्वेव योगिनः /
आराध्य गिरिशं मां च यान्ति तत् परमं पदम् //
text_mt:
Only in those [kalpas] do yogins, having attained meditation, austerity, and knowledge,
and having worshipped Giriśa and me, go to that supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ sattvaṃ samāsthāya māyī māyāmayīṃ svayam /
ekārṇave jagatyasmin yoganidrāṃ vrajāmi tu //
meaning:
सो ऽहं सत्त्वं समास्थाय मायी मायामयीं स्वयम् /
एकार्णवे जगत्यस्मिन् योगनिद्रां व्रजामि तु //
text_mt:
Resorting to sattva, I, the master of illusory creative power, myself go
into the sleep of yoga made of illusory power in this world turned into a single ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ paśyanti mahātmānaḥ suptaṃ kālaṃ maharṣayaḥ /
janaloke vartamānāstapasā yogacakṣuṣā //
meaning:
मां पश्यन्ति महात्मानः सुप्तं कालं महर्षयः /
जनलोके वर्तमानास्तपसा योगचक्षुषा //
text_mt:
The great-souled great sages residing in Janaloka
see me asleep as Time through austerity, with the eye of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ purāṇapuruṣo bhūrbhuvaḥ prabhavo vibhuḥ /
sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān sahasrāṃśuḥ sahasradṛk //
meaning:
अहं पुराणपुरुषो भूर्भुवः प्रभवो विभुः /
सहस्रचरणः श्रीमान् सहस्रांशुः सहस्रदृक् //
text_mt:
I am the Ancient Person, the origin of Bhūḥ and Bhuvaḥ, the all-pervading Lord,
thousand-footed, glorious, thousand-rayed, thousand-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
mantro 'gnirbrāhmiṇā gāvaḥ kuśāśca samidho hyaham /
prokṣaṇī ca śruvaścaiva somo ghṛtamathāsmyaham //
meaning:
मन्त्रो ऽग्निर्ब्राह्मिणा गावः कुशाश्च समिधो ह्यहम् /
प्रोक्षणी च श्रुवश्चैव सोमो घृतमथास्म्यहम् //
text_mt:
I am the mantra, the fire, the brāhmaṇas, the cows, the kuśa grass, and the kindling sticks;
I am the sprinkling water, the ladle, the soma, and the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartako mahānātmā pavitraṃ paramaṃ yaśaḥ /
vedo vedyaṃ prabhurgoptā gopatirbrahmaṇo mukham //
meaning:
संवर्तको महानात्मा पवित्रं परमं यशः /
वेदो वेद्यं प्रभुर्गोप्ता गोपतिर्ब्रह्मणो मुखम् //
text_mt:
I am the cosmic fire of destruction, the great soul, the purifier, supreme renown,
the Veda, that which is to be known, the lord, the protector, the lord of cattle, the mouth of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
anantastārako yogī gatirgatimatāṃ varaḥ /
haṃsaḥ prāṇo 'tha kapilo viśvamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अनन्तस्तारको योगी गतिर्गतिमतां वरः /
हंसः प्राणो ऽथ कपिलो विश्वमूर्तिः सनातनः //
text_mt:
I am Ananta, the deliverer, the yogin, the path, the best of those who have a destination,
the Swan, the breath of life, Kapila, the universal form, eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñaḥ prakṛtiḥ kālo jagadbījamathāmṛtam /
mātā pitā mahādevo matto hyanyanna vidyate //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञः प्रकृतिः कालो जगद्बीजमथामृतम् /
माता पिता महादेवो मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: [I am] the knower of the field, primordial matter, time, the seed of the universe, and the immortal nectar; / [I am] the mother, the father, Mahādeva: truly, nothing other than me exists.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityavarṇo bhuvanasya goptā
nārāyaṇaḥ puruṣo yogamūrtiḥ /
māṃ paśyanti yatayo yoganiṣṭhā
jñātvātmānamamṛtatvaṃ vrajanti //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
आदित्यवर्णो भुवनस्य गोप्ता
नारायणः पुरुषो योगमूर्तिः /
मां पश्यन्ति यतयो योगनिष्ठा
ज्ञात्वात्मानममृतत्वं व्रजन्ति //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Sun-colored, protector of the world, / Nārāyaṇa, the Spirit, the personification of yoga; / ascetics dedicated to yoga behold me, / and knowing the Self, attain immortality.

Thus ends the forty-third chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrma uvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratisargamanuttamam /
prākṛtaṃ hi samāsena śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama //
meaning:
कूर्म उवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिसर्गमनुत्तमम् /
प्राकृतं हि समासेन शृणुध्वं गदतो मम //
title: catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
text_mt: The Tortoise said: / Hereafter I shall explain the unsurpassed secondary recreation; / hear from me as I recount the dissolution into primordial matter in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
gate parārdhadvitaye kālo lokaprakālanaḥ /
kālāgnirbhasmasāt kartuṃ karoti nikilaṃ matim //
meaning:
गते परार्धद्वितये कालो लोकप्रकालनः /
कालाग्निर्भस्मसात् कर्तुं करोति निकिलं मतिम् //
text_mt: When the two halves of Brahmā's lifespan have passed, Time, who drives forth the worlds, / the fire of time, makes up his mind to turn everything to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmanyātmānamāveśya bhūtvā devo maheśvaraḥ /
dahedaśeṣaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam //
meaning:
स्वात्मन्यात्मानमावेश्य भूत्वा देवो महेश्वरः /
दहेदशेषं ब्रह्माण्डं सदेवासुरमानुषम् //
text_mt: Entering the Self within himself and becoming the divine Maheśvara, / he burns the entire cosmic egg together with gods, asuras, and humans.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāviśya mahādevo bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ /
karoti lokasaṃhāraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
तमाविश्य महादेवो भगवान्नीललोहितः /
करोति लोकसंहारं भीषणं रूपमाश्रितः //
text_mt: Entering him, the divine Lord Nīlalohita, / assuming a terrible form, effects the destruction of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya maṇḍalaṃ sauraṃ kṛtvāsau bahudhā punaḥ /
nirdahatyakhilaṃ lokaṃ saptasaptisvarūpadhṛk //
meaning:
प्रविश्य मण्डलं सौरं कृत्वासौ बहुधा पुनः /
निर्दहत्यखिलं लोकं सप्तसप्तिस्वरूपधृक् //
text_mt: Entering the solar orb and dividing himself repeatedly, / he burns down the entire world, assuming the form of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dagdhvā sakalaṃ sattvamastraṃ brahmaśiro mahat /
devatānāṃ śarīreṣu kṣipatyakhiladāhakam //
meaning:
स दग्ध्वा सकलं सत्त्वमस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो महत् /
देवतानां शरीरेषु क्षिपत्यखिलदाहकम् //
text_mt: Having burned all living beings, he hurls the great Brahmāśiras weapon, / which consumes everything, onto the bodies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdheṣvaśeṣadeveṣu devī girivarātmajā /
ekāsā sākṣiṇī śaṃbhostiṣṭhate vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
दग्धेष्वशेषदेवेषु देवी गिरिवरात्मजा /
एकासा साक्षिणी शंभोस्तिष्ठते वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: When all the gods have been burned, the goddess, the daughter of the best of mountains, / the Vedic revelation, stands alone as the sole witness to Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥ kapālairdevānāṃ kṛtastragvarabhūṣaṇaḥ /
ādityacandrādigaṇaiḥ pūrayan vyomamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
शिरः कपालैर्देवानां कृतस्त्रग्वरभूषणः /
आदित्यचन्द्रादिगणैः पूरयन् व्योममण्डलम् //
text_mt: Adorned with excellent garlands of the skulls of the gods, / filling the vault of heaven with the hosts of suns, moons, and stars,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasranayano devaḥ sahasrākṛtiriśvaraḥ /
sahasrahastacaraṇaḥ sahasrārcirmahābhujaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रनयनो देवः सहस्राकृतिरिश्वरः /
सहस्रहस्तचरणः सहस्रार्चिर्महाभुजः //
text_mt: the thousand-eyed god, the Lord of a thousand forms, / having a thousand hands and feet, a thousand rays, and mighty arms,

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ pradīptānalalocanaḥ /
triśūlī kṛttivasano yogamaiśvaramāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनः प्रदीप्तानललोचनः /
त्रिशूली कृत्तिवसनो योगमैश्वरमास्थितः //
text_mt: with fangs protruding in his terrifying mouth, eyes like blazing fire, / wielding a trident, clad in an animal skin, established in sovereign yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā tatparamānandaṃ prabhūtamamṛtaṃ svayam /
karoti tāṇḍavaṃ devīmālokya parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
पीत्वा तत्परमानन्दं प्रभूतममृतं स्वयम् /
करोति ताण्डवं देवीमालोक्य परमेश्वरः //
text_mt: having himself drunk that supreme bliss, the abundant immortal nectar, / the Supreme Lord performs the tāṇḍava dance as he gazes upon the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā nṛttāmṛtaṃ devī bhartuḥ paramamaṅgalā /
yogamāsthāya devasya dehamāyāti śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
पीत्वा नृत्तामृतं देवी भर्तुः परममङ्गला /
योगमास्थाय देवस्य देहमायाति शूलिनः //
text_mt: Having drunk the nectar of her husband's dance, the supremely auspicious goddess, / having resorted to yoga, enters the body of the trident-bearing god.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtyaktvā tāṇḍavarasaṃ svecchayaiva pinākadhṛk /
jyotiḥ svabhāvaṃ bhagavān dagdhvā brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
संत्यक्त्वा ताण्डवरसं स्वेच्छयैव पिनाकधृक् /
ज्योतिः स्वभावं भगवान् दग्ध्वा ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Relinquishing the delight of the tāṇḍava dance entirely by his own will, the trident-wielder, / the Lord whose nature is light, having burned the sphere of the cosmic egg,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthiteṣvatha deveṣu brahmaviṣṇupinākiṣu /
guṇairaśeṣaiḥ pṛthivīvilayaṃ yāti vāriṣu //
meaning:
संस्थितेष्वथ देवेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुपिनाकिषु /
गुणैरशेषैः पृथिवीविलयं याति वारिषु //
text_mt: when the gods Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the trident-wielder have passed away, / the earth dissolves into the waters along with all its qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vāritattvaṃ saguṇaṃ grasate havyavāhanaḥ /
tejastu guṇasaṃyuktaṃ vāyau saṃyāti saṃkṣayam //
meaning:
स वारितत्त्वं सगुणं ग्रसते हव्यवाहनः /
तेजस्तु गुणसंयुक्तं वायौ संयाति संक्षयम् //
text_mt: The carrier of oblations devours the element of water along with its quality, / and fire, endowed with its quality, dissolves into the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśe saguṇo vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti viśvabhṛt /
bhūtādau ca tathākāśaṃ līyate guṇasaṃyutam //
meaning:
आकाशे सगुणो वायुः प्रलयं याति विश्वभृत् /
भूतादौ च तथाकाशं लीयते गुणसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Endowed with its quality, the all-supporting wind dissolves into space, / and space dissolves, together with its quality, into the source of the elements.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi taijase yānti saṃkṣayam /
vaikārike devagaṇāḥ pralaṃya yānti sattamāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि तैजसे यान्ति संक्षयम् /
वैकारिके देवगणाः प्रलंय यान्ति सत्तमाः //
text_mt: All the senses dissolve into the fiery ego, / and the hosts of gods, O best of men, dissolve into the modifying ego.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiśceti sattamāḥ /
trividho 'yamahaṅkāro mahati pralaṃya vrajet //
meaning:
वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चेति सत्तमाः /
त्रिविधो ऽयमहङ्कारो महति प्रलंय व्रजेत् //
text_mt: The modifying, the fiery, and the source of the elements, O best of men— / this threefold ego dissolves into the great principle.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāntamebhiḥ sahitaṃ brahmāṇamatitejasam /
avyaktaṃ jagato yoniḥ saṃharedekamavyayam //
meaning:
महान्तमेभिः सहितं ब्रह्माणमतितेजसम् /
अव्यक्तं जगतो योनिः संहरेदेकमव्ययम् //
text_mt: The unmanifest, the womb of the universe, the one imperishable, / dissolves the great principle together with these, as well as Brahmā of great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃhṛtya bhūtāni tattvāni ca maheśvaraḥ /
viyojayati cānyonyaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ param //
meaning:
एवं संहृत्य भूतानि तत्त्वानि च महेश्वरः /
वियोजयति चान्योन्यं प्रधानं पुरुषं परम् //
text_mt: Having thus dissolved the elements and the cosmic principles, Maheśvara / separates primordial matter and the supreme Spirit from one another.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānapuṃsorajayoreṣa saṃhāra īritaḥ /
maheśvarecchājanito na svayaṃ vidyate layaḥ //
meaning:
प्रधानपुंसोरजयोरेष संहार ईरितः /
महेश्वरेच्छाजनितो न स्वयं विद्यते लयः //
text_mt: This dissolution of primordial matter and the Spirit, both unborn, is declared: / it is brought about by Maheśvara's will; dissolution does not occur by itself.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇasāmyaṃ tadavyaktaṃ prakṛtiḥ parigīyate /
pradhānaṃ jagato yonirmāyātattvamacetanam //
meaning:
गुणसाम्यं तदव्यक्तं प्रकृतिः परिगीयते /
प्रधानं जगतो योनिर्मायातत्त्वमचेतनम् //
text_mt: That equilibrium of the qualities, the unmanifest, is celebrated as primordial matter; / it is pradhāna, the womb of the universe, the insentient principle of māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṭasthaścinmayo hyātmā kevalaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ /
gīyate munibhiḥ sākṣī mahānekaḥ pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
कूटस्थश्चिन्मयो ह्यात्मा केवलः पञ्चविंशकः /
गीयते मुनिभिः साक्षी महानेकः पितामहः //
text_mt: The immutable Self, made of pure consciousness, solitary, the twenty-fifth principle, / the witness, the great, unique grandfather, is praised by sages.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃhārakaraṇī śaktirmāheśvarī dhruvā /
pradhānādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ dahed rudra iti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
एवं संहारकरणी शक्तिर्माहेश्वरी ध्रुवा /
प्रधानाद्यं विशेषान्तं दहेद् रुद्र इति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Thus, the power of Maheśvara is eternal, the agent of dissolution; / Rudra burns from pradhāna down to the gross elements: such is the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
yogināmatha sarveṣāṃ jñānavinyastacetasām /
ātyantikaṃ caiva layaṃ vidadhātīha śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
योगिनामथ सर्वेषां ज्ञानविन्यस्तचेतसाम् /
आत्यन्तिकं चैव लयं विदधातीह शङ्करः //
text_mt: Moreover, for all yogins whose minds are fixed on knowledge, / Śaṅkara here effects absolute liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa bhagavān rudraḥ saṃhāraṃ kurute vaśī /
sthāpikā mohanī śaktirnārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
इत्येष भगवान् रुद्रः संहारं कुरुते वशी /
स्थापिका मोहनी शक्तिर्नारायण इति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Thus this Lord Rudra, the self-controlled, brings about dissolution; / the sustaining and deluding power is Nārāyaṇa: such is the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhā bhagavān jagat sadasadātmakam /
sṛjedaśeṣaṃ prakṛtestanmayaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भा भगवान् जगत् सदसदात्मकम् /
सृजेदशेषं प्रकृतेस्तन्मयः पञ्चविंशकः //
text_mt: The divine Lord Hiraṇyagarbha creates the entire universe, / real and unreal, from primordial matter; he is composed of it, the twenty-fifth principle.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñāḥ sarvagāḥ śāntāḥ svātmanyevavyavasthitāḥ /
śaktayo brahmaviṇvīśā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञाः सर्वगाः शान्ताः स्वात्मन्येवव्यवस्थिताः /
शक्तयो ब्रह्मविण्वीशा भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः //
text_mt: Omniscient, all-pervading, tranquil, established in their very self, / the powers Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśa bestow the fruits of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvarāḥ sarvavandyāḥ śāśvatānantabhoginaḥ /
ekamevākṣaraṃ tattvaṃ puṃpradhāneśvarātmakam //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वराः सर्ववन्द्याः शाश्वतानन्तभोगिनः /
एकमेवाक्षरं तत्त्वं पुंप्रधानेश्वरात्मकम् //
text_mt: Lords of all, worthy of worship by all, eternal, experiencing endless bliss; / there is only one imperishable reality, consisting of the Spirit, pradhāna, and the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāśca śaktayo divyāḥ santi tatra sahasraśaḥ /
ijyante vividhairyajñaiḥ śakrādityādayo 'marāḥ //
meaning:
अन्याश्च शक्तयो दिव्याः सन्ति तत्र सहस्रशः /
इज्यन्ते विविधैर्यज्ञैः शक्रादित्यादयो ऽमराः //
text_mt: And there are thousands of other divine powers there; / the immortals such as Indra and the sun are worshipped with various sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasya sahasrāṇi dehānāṃ vai śatāni ca /
kathyante caiva māhātmyācchaktirekaiva nirguṇāḥ //
meaning:
एकैकस्य सहस्राणि देहानां वै शतानि च /
कथ्यन्ते चैव माहात्म्याच्छक्तिरेकैव निर्गुणाः //
text_mt: Of each one, thousands and hundreds of bodies / are proclaimed through his majesty; yet power without qualities is indeed one.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samādhāya svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ /
karoti dehān vividhān grasate caiva līlayā //
meaning:
तां तां शक्तिं समाधाय स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः /
करोति देहान् विविधान् ग्रसते चैव लीलया //
text_mt: Taking on this or that power, the divine Maheśvara himself / assumes various bodies and swallows them up in sport.

sanskrit_iast:
ijyate sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇairvedavādibhiḥ /
sarvakāmaprado rudra ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
इज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु ब्राह्मणैर्वेदवादिभिः /
सर्वकामप्रदो रुद्र इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: He is worshipped in all sacrifices by Brahmins who proclaim the Vedas; / Rudra grants all desires: such is the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
prādhānyena smṛtā devāḥ śaktayaḥ paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः /
प्राधान्येन स्मृता देवाः शक्तयः परमात्मनः //
text_mt: Among all the powers, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara / are remembered as the foremost gods, the powers of the Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyaḥ parastād bhagavān paramātmā sanātanaḥ /
gīyate sarvaśaktyātmā śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
आद्यः परस्ताद् भगवान् परमात्मा सनातनः /
गीयते सर्वशक्त्यात्मा शूलपाणिर्महेश्वरः //
text_mt: The primordial, transcendent, eternal Supreme Self, / Maheśvara, bearer of the trident, the soul of all powers, is sung.

sanskrit_iast:
enameke vadantyagniṃ nārāyaṇamathāpare /
indrameke pare viśvān brahmāṇamapare jaguḥ //
meaning:
एनमेके वदन्त्यग्निं नारायणमथापरे /
इन्द्रमेके परे विश्वान् ब्रह्माणमपरे जगुः //
text_mt: Some speak of him as Agni, others as Nārāyaṇa; / some call him Indra, others the All-gods, while others proclaim him as Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇavagnivaruṇāḥ sarve devāstatharṣayaḥ /
ekasyaivātha rudrasya bhedāste parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णवग्निवरुणाः सर्वे देवास्तथर्षयः /
एकस्यैवाथ रुद्रस्य भेदास्ते परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Agni, Varuṇa, all the gods, and likewise the sages— / they are declared to be differentiations of Rudra alone.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yaṃ bhedaṃ samāśritya yajanti parameśvaram /
tat tad rūpaṃ samāsthāya pradadāti phalaṃ śivaḥ //
meaning:
यं यं भेदं समाश्रित्य यजन्ति परमेश्वरम् /
तत् तद् रूपं समास्थाय प्रददाति फलं शिवः //
text_mt: Whatever differentiation they rely upon to worship the Supreme Lord, / assuming that very form, Śiva grants the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādekataraṃ bhedaṃ samāśrityāpi śāśvatam /
ārādhayanmahādevaṃ yāti tatparamaṃ padam //
meaning:
तस्मादेकतरं भेदं समाश्रित्यापि शाश्वतम् /
आराधयन्महादेवं याति तत्परमं पदम् //
text_mt: Therefore, even by relying upon one eternal differentiation / and worshipping Mahādeva, one attains that supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
kintu devaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvaśaktiṃ sanātanam /
ārādhayed vai giriśaṃ saguṇaṃ vātha nirguṇam //
meaning:
किन्तु देवं महादेवं सर्वशक्तिं सनातनम् /
आराधयेद् वै गिरिशं सगुणं वाथ निर्गुणम् //
text_mt: Yet one should worship the eternal god Mahādeva, all-powerful, / the mountain-dweller, either with qualities or devoid of qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā prokto hi bhavatāṃ yogaḥ prāgeva nirguṇaḥ /
ārurukṣustu saguṇaṃ pūjayet parameśvaram //
meaning:
मया प्रोक्तो हि भवतां योगः प्रागेव निर्गुणः /
आरुरुक्षुस्तु सगुणं पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम् //
text_mt: For I have already described to you the yoga devoid of qualities; / but one who desires to ascend should worship the Supreme Lord with qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
pinākinaṃ trinayanaṃ jaṭilaṃ kṛttivāsasam /
padmāsanasthaṃ rukmābhaṃ cintayed vaidikī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
पिनाकिनं त्रिनयनं जटिलं कृत्तिवाससम् /
पद्मासनस्थं रुक्माभं चिन्तयेद् वैदिकी श्रुतिः //
text_mt: One should meditate on the bearer of the bow, three-eyed, with matted hair, clad in an animal skin, / seated on a lotus posture, radiant as gold: so says the Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo munisattamāḥ /
tasmāt sarvān parityajya devān brahmapurogamān /
ārādhayed virūpākṣamādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
एष योगः समुद्दिष्टः सबीजो मुनिसत्तमाः /
तस्मात् सर्वान् परित्यज्य देवान् ब्रह्मपुरोगमान् /
आराधयेद् विरूपाक्षमादिमध्यान्तसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: This is declared to be yoga with seed, O best of sages. / Therefore, leaving aside all the gods headed by Brahmā, / one should worship the diverse-eyed one who abides in the beginning, middle, and end.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiyogasamāyuktaḥ svadharmanirataḥ śuciḥ /
tādṛśaṃ rūpamāsthāya samāyātyantikaṃ śivam //
meaning:
भक्तियोगसमायुक्तः स्वधर्मनिरतः शुचिः /
तादृशं रूपमास्थाय समायात्यन्तिकं शिवम् //
text_mt: Endowed with the yoga of devotion, dedicated to one's own duty, pure, / assuming such a form, one approaches Śiva closely.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo 'tyantabhāvane /
yathāvidhi prakurvāṇaḥ prāpnuyādaiśvaraṃ padam //
meaning:
एष योगः समुद्दिष्टः सबीजो ऽत्यन्तभावने /
यथाविधि प्रकुर्वाणः प्राप्नुयादैश्वरं पदम् //
text_mt: This is declared to be yoga with seed for supreme meditation; / practicing it according to the prescribed rules, one attains the state of the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyaśakto 'tha haraṃ viṣṇuṃ bahmāṇamarcayet /
atha cedasamarthaḥ syāt tatrāpi munipuṅgavāḥ /
tato vāyvagniśakrādīn pūjayed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
अत्राप्यशक्तो ऽथ हरं विष्णुं बह्माणमर्चयेत् /
अथ चेदसमर्थः स्यात् तत्रापि मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
ततो वाय्वग्निशक्रादीन् पूजयेद् भक्तिसंयुतः //
text_mt: If still unable even in this, one should then worship Hara, Viṣṇu, and Brahmā. / If one should be incapable even then, O best of sages, / one should then worship with devotion Vāyu, Agni, Indra, and the other [gods].

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye bhāvane śuddhe prāgukte bhavatāmiha /
athāpi kathito yogo nirbojaśca sabījakaḥ //
meaning:
ये चान्ये भावने शुद्धे प्रागुक्ते भवतामिह /
अथापि कथितो योगो निर्बोजश्च सबीजकः //
text_mt: And the other two pure concentrations which were mentioned earlier to you here— / moreover, the yoga without seed and with seed has been explained.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ taduktaṃ nirbojaṃ pūrvaṃ hi bhavatāṃ mayā /
viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ virañciṃ ca sabījaṃ bhāvayed budhaḥ /
sathavāgnyādikān devāṃstatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञानं तदुक्तं निर्बोजं पूर्वं हि भवतां मया /
विष्णुं रुद्रं विरञ्चिं च सबीजं भावयेद् बुधः /
सथवाग्न्यादिकान् देवांस्तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: That knowledge without seed was indeed taught to you by me previously; / the wise person should meditate on Viṣṇu, Rudra, and Brahmā as with seed, / or, devoted to that, with restrained senses, upon the gods beginning with Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayet puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ caturmūrtidharaṃ harim /
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
पूजयेत् पुरुषं विष्णुं चतुर्मूर्तिधरं हरिम् /
अनादिनिधनं देवं वासुदेवं सनातनम् //
text_mt: One should worship the Person, Viṣṇu, Hari bearing the four forms, / the eternal god Vāsudeva who is without beginning or end,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyonimākāśaṃ paramaṃ padam /
talliṅgadhārī niyataṃ tadbhaktastadapāśrayaḥ /
eṣa eva vidhirbrāhme bhāvane cāntike mataḥ //
meaning:
नारायणं जगद्योनिमाकाशं परमं पदम् /
तल्लिङ्गधारी नियतं तद्भक्तस्तदपाश्रयः /
एष एव विधिर्ब्राह्मे भावने चान्तिके मतः //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, the womb of the universe, space, the supreme abode. / Constantly wearing his emblems, devoted to him, taking refuge in him— / this very rule is considered to pertain to the concentration on Brahman and the immediate one.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat kathitaṃ jñānaṃ bhāvanāsaṃśrayaṃ param /
indradyumnāya munaye kathitaṃ yanmayā purā //
meaning:
इत्येतत् कथितं ज्ञानं भावनासंश्रयं परम् /
इन्द्रद्युम्नाय मुनये कथितं यन्मया पुरा //
text_mt: Thus this supreme knowledge based on concentration has been taught, / which was taught by me of old to the sage Indradyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktātmakamevedaṃ cetanācetanaṃ jagat /
tadīśvaraḥ paraṃ brahma tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat //
meaning:
अव्यक्तात्मकमेवेदं चेतनाचेतनं जगत् /
तदीश्वरः परं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्ममयं जगत् //
text_mt: This entire universe, conscious and unconscious, consists indeed of the Unmanifest; / its Lord is supreme Brahman, and therefore the universe is identical with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etāvaduktvā bhagavān virarāma janārdanaḥ /
tuṣṭuvurmunayo viṣṇuṃ śakreṇa saha mādhavam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विरराम जनार्दनः /
तुष्टुवुर्मुनयो विष्णुं शक्रेण सह माधवम् //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
Having spoken thus far, the blessed Janārdana paused. / The sages, together with Indra, praised Viṣṇu, Mādhava.

sanskrit_iast:
munaya ūcuḥ
namaste kūrmarūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane /
nārāyaṇāya viśvāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
मुनय ऊचुः
नमस्ते कूर्मरूपाय विष्णवे परमात्मने /
नारायणाय विश्वाय वासुदेवाय ते नमः //
text_mt:
The sages said:
Homage to you embodied as a tortoise, to Viṣṇu, the supreme Self, / to Nārāyaṇa, the All, to Vāsudeva—homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namo namaste kṛṣṇāya govindāya namo namaḥ /
mādhavāya namastubhyaṃ namo yajñeśvarāya ca //
meaning:
नमो नमस्ते कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय नमो नमः /
माधवाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमो यज्ञेश्वराय च //
text_mt: Homage, homage to Kṛṣṇa, to Govinda homage, homage! / Homage to you, Mādhava, and homage to the Lord of sacrifice!

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ /
namaḥ sahasrahastāya sahasracaraṇāya ca //
meaning:
सहस्रशिरसे तुभ्यं सहस्राक्षाय ते नमः /
नमः सहस्रहस्ताय सहस्रचरणाय च //
text_mt: To you of a thousand heads, homage to you of a thousand eyes! / Homage to him of a thousand hands and a thousand feet!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo jñānarūpāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe /
ānandāya namastubhyaṃ māyātītāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं नमो ज्ञानरूपाय परमात्मस्वरूपिणे /
आनन्दाय नमस्तुभ्यं मायातीताय ते नमः //
text_mt: Oṃ, homage to the embodiment of knowledge, whose essential nature is the supreme Self! / Homage to you, Bliss, homage to you who transcend illusory creative power!

sanskrit_iast:
namo gūḍhaśarīrāya nirguṇāya namo 'stu te /
puruṣāya purāṇāya sattāmātrasvarūpiṇe //
meaning:
नमो गूढशरीराय निर्गुणाय नमो ऽस्तु ते /
पुरुषाय पुराणाय सत्तामात्रस्वरूपिणे //
text_mt: Homage to him whose body is hidden; may homage be to you who are devoid of qualities, / to the ancient Person, whose essential nature is pure existence!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ sāṃkhyāya yogāya kevalāya namo 'stu te /
dharmajñānādhigamyāya niṣkalāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
नमः सांख्याय योगाय केवलाय नमो ऽस्तु ते /
धर्मज्ञानाधिगम्याय निष्कलाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage to Sāṃkhya, to Yoga; may homage be to you the absolute, / accessible through knowledge of duty, the undivided—homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
namostu vyomatattvāya mahāyogeśvarāya ca /
parāvarāṇāṃ prabhave vedavedyāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमोस्तु व्योमतत्त्वाय महायोगेश्वराय च /
परावराणां प्रभवे वेदवेद्याय ते नमः //
text_mt: May homage be to the essence of space, and to the great lord of yoga, / the source of higher and lower, who is to be known through the Vedas—homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namo buddhāya śuddhāya namo yuktāya hetave /
namo namo namastubhyaṃ māyine vedhase namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय नमो युक्ताय हेतवे /
नमो नमो नमस्तुभ्यं मायिने वेधसे नमः //
text_mt: Homage to the awakened, the pure, homage to the unified cause! / Homage, homage, homage to you, the wielder of illusory creative power, to the creator!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te varāhāya nārasiṃhāya te namaḥ /
vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ hṛṣīkeśāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते वराहाय नारसिंहाय ते नमः /
वामनाय नमस्तुभ्यं हृषीकेशाय ते नमः //
text_mt: May homage be to you the Boar; homage to you the Man-Lion; / to the Dwarf homage to you; to Hṛṣīkeśa homage to you!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu kālarudrāya kālarūpāya te namaḥ /
svargāpavargadātre ca namo 'pratihatātmane //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु कालरुद्राय कालरूपाय ते नमः /
स्वर्गापवर्गदात्रे च नमो ऽप्रतिहतात्मने //
text_mt: May homage be to Kālarudra, homage to you who have the form of Time, / and to the giver of heaven and liberation, homage to the unopposed Self!

sanskrit_iast:
namo yogādhigamyāya yogine yogadāyine /
devānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ devārtiśamanāya te //
meaning:
नमो योगाधिगम्याय योगिने योगदायिने /
देवानां पतये तुभ्यं देवार्तिशमनाय ते //
text_mt: Homage to him who is attained by yoga, the yogin, the giver of yoga, / to you the master of the gods, the alleviator of the distress of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena sarvasaṃsāranāśanam /
asmābhirviditaṃ jñānaṃ yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute //
meaning:
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन सर्वसंसारनाशनम् /
अस्माभिर्विदितं ज्ञानं यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते //
text_mt: O Lord, by your grace the knowledge that destroys all worldly existence / has been understood by us, knowing which one attains immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutāstu vividhā dharmā vaṃśā manvantarāṇi ca /
sargaśca pratisargaśca brahmāṇyasyāsya vistaraḥ //
meaning:
श्रुतास्तु विविधा धर्मा वंशा मन्वन्तराणि च /
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च ब्रह्माण्यस्यास्य विस्तरः //
text_mt: The diverse duties, genealogies, and cosmic eras of a Manu have been heard, / as well as primary creation, secondary recreation, and the vast expanse of this Brahmā-egg.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ hi sarvajagatsākṣī viśvo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ /
trātumarhasyanantātmaṃstvameva śaraṇaṃ gatiḥ //
meaning:
त्वं हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी विश्वो नारायणः परः /
त्रातुमर्हस्यनन्तात्मंस्त्वमेव शरणं गतिः //
text_mt: For you are the witness of the whole world, the universal, the supreme Nārāyaṇa; / you ought to protect [us], O infinite Self! You alone are the refuge and resort.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yogamokṣapradāyakam /
kaurmaṃ purāṇamakhilaṃ yajjagāda gadādharaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतद् वः कथितं विप्रा योगमोक्षप्रदायकम् /
कौर्मं पुराणमखिलं यज्जगाद गदाधरः //
text_mt:
Sūta said:
This has been told to you, O brāhmaṇas, granting yoga and liberation— / the entire Kūrma Purāṇa which the Mace-Bearer uttered.

sanskrit_iast:
asmin purāṇe lakṣmyāstu saṃbhavaḥ kathitaḥ purā /
mohāyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ vāsudevena yojanam //
meaning:
अस्मिन् पुराणे लक्ष्म्यास्तु संभवः कथितः पुरा /
मोहायाशेषभूतानां वासुदेवेन योजनम् //
text_mt: In this Purāṇa the origin of Lakṣmī was told earlier, / [and] her union with Vāsudeva for the delusion of all beings;

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatīnāṃ sargastu varṇadharmāśca vṛttayaḥ /
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yathāvallakṣaṇaṃ śubham //
meaning:
प्रजापतीनां सर्गस्तु वर्णधर्माश्च वृत्तयः /
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यथावल्लक्षणं शुभम् //
text_mt: the creation of the lords of creatures, and the duties and livelihoods of the social classes, / and the auspicious characteristics of duty, wealth, desire, and liberation in their true nature;

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahasya viṣṇośca maheśasya ca dhīmataḥ /
ekatvaṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ ca viśeṣaścopavarṇitaḥ //
meaning:
पितामहस्य विष्णोश्च महेशस्य च धीमतः /
एकत्वं च पृथक्त्वं च विशेषश्चोपवर्णितः //
text_mt: and the unity, difference, and distinction / of the Grandfather, Viṣṇu, and the wise Maheśa have been described;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ samācāraśca śobhanaḥ /
varṇāśramāṇāṃ kathitaṃ yathāvadiha lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
भक्तानां लक्षणं प्रोक्तं समाचारश्च शोभनः /
वर्णाश्रमाणां कथितं यथावदिह लक्षणम् //
text_mt: the characteristics of devotees were stated, and [their] virtuous conduct, / and the characteristics of the social classes and life-stages have been properly explained here;

sanskrit_iast:
ādisargastataḥ paścādaṇḍāvaraṇasaptakam /
hiraṇyagarbhasargaśca kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
आदिसर्गस्ततः पश्चादण्डावरणसप्तकम् /
हिरण्यगर्भसर्गश्च कीर्तितो मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: the first creation, and after that the seven coverings of the cosmic egg, / and the creation by Hiraṇyagarbha were glorified, O best of sages;

sanskrit_iast:
kālasaṃkhyāprakathanaṃ māhātmyaṃ ceśvarasya ca /
brahmaṇaḥ śayanaṃ cāpsu nāmanirvacanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कालसंख्याप्रकथनं माहात्म्यं चेश्वरस्य च /
ब्रह्मणः शयनं चाप्सु नामनिर्वचनं तथा //
text_mt: the reckoning of time and the greatness of the Lord, / the reclining of Brahmā upon the waters, and the etymological explanation of his names;

sanskrit_iast:
varāhavapuṣā bhūyo bhūmeruddharaṇaṃ punaḥ /
mukhyādisargakathanaṃ munisargastathāparaḥ //
meaning:
वराहवपुषा भूयो भूमेरुद्धरणं पुनः /
मुख्यादिसर्गकथनं मुनिसर्गस्तथापरः //
text_mt: the uplifting of the earth again through the form of the Boar, / the explanation of the primary creation and the rest, and also the creation of the sages;

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyato rudrasargaśca ṛṣisargaśca tāpasaḥ /
dharmasya ca prajāsargastāmasāt pūrvameva tu //
meaning:
व्याख्यतो रुद्रसर्गश्च ऋषिसर्गश्च तापसः /
धर्मस्य च प्रजासर्गस्तामसात् पूर्वमेव तु //
text_mt: the creation of Rudra has been explained, and the ascetic creation of the ṛṣis, / and the creation of offspring by Dharma, even before that arising from dark inertia;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuvivādaḥ syādantardehapraveśanam /
padmodbhavatvaṃ devasya mohastasya ca dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुविवादः स्यादन्तर्देहप्रवेशनम् /
पद्मोद्भवत्वं देवस्य मोहस्तस्य च धीमतः //
text_mt: the dispute between Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the entering inside the body, / the god's birth from a lotus, and the delusion of that wise one;

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ ca maheśasya māhātmyaṃ viṣṇuneritam /
divyadṛṣṭipradānaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
दर्शनं च महेशस्य माहात्म्यं विष्णुनेरितम् /
दिव्यदृष्टिप्रदानं च ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: the vision of Maheśa, and his greatness declared by Viṣṇu, / and the bestowing of divine sight upon Brahmā, the supreme Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstavo devadevasya brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā /
prasādo giriśasyātha varadānaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
संस्तवो देवदेवस्य ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना /
प्रसादो गिरिशस्याथ वरदानं तथैव च //
text_mt: the praise of the god of gods by Brahmā, the supreme Lord, / the grace of the Mountain-Dweller, and likewise the granting of a boon;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvādo viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ /
varadānaṃ tathāpūrvamantardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ //
meaning:
संवादो विष्णुना सार्धं शङ्करस्य महात्मनः /
वरदानं तथापूर्वमन्तर्धानं पिनाकिनः //
text_mt: the dialogue of the great-souled Śaṅkara with Viṣṇu, / the granting of an unprecedented boon, and the disappearance of the wielder of the Pināka;

sanskrit_iast:
vadhaśca kathito viprā madhukaiṭabhayoḥ purā /
avatāro 'tha devasya brahmaṇo nābhipaṅkajāt //
meaning:
वधश्च कथितो विप्रा मधुकैटभयोः पुरा /
अवतारो ऽथ देवस्य ब्रह्मणो नाभिपङ्कजात् //
text_mt: and the slaying of Madhu and Kaiṭabha was told earlier, O brāhmaṇas, / then the descent of the god Brahmā from the navel lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
ekībhāvaśca devasya viṣṇunā kathitastataḥ /
vimoho brahmaṇaścātha saṃjñālābho harestataḥ //
meaning:
एकीभावश्च देवस्य विष्णुना कथितस्ततः /
विमोहो ब्रह्मणश्चाथ संज्ञालाभो हरेस्ततः //
text_mt: and then the unification of the god with Viṣṇu was told, / and the delusion of Brahmā, and then Hari's regaining of consciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścaraṇamākhyātaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ /
prādurbhāvo maheśasya lalāṭāt kathitastataḥ //
meaning:
तपश्चरणमाख्यातं देवदेवस्य धीमतः /
प्रादुर्भावो महेशस्य ललाटात् कथितस्ततः //
text_mt: the performance of austerities by the wise god of gods was narrated, / and then the manifestation of Maheśa from his forehead was recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṇāṃ kathitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇaḥ pratiṣedhanam /
bhūtiśca devadevasya varadānopadeśakau //
meaning:
रुद्राणां कथिता सृष्टिर्ब्रह्मणः प्रतिषेधनम् /
भूतिश्च देवदेवस्य वरदानोपदेशकौ //
text_mt: the creation of the Rudras was described, the prohibition by Brahmā, / the manifestation of the god of gods, and his granting of a boon and instruction;

sanskrit_iast:
antardhānaṃ ca rudrasya tapaścaryāṇḍajasya ca /
darśanaṃ devadevasya naranārīśarīratā //
meaning:
अन्तर्धानं च रुद्रस्य तपश्चर्याण्डजस्य च /
दर्शनं देवदेवस्य नरनारीशरीरता //
text_mt: the disappearance of Rudra, and the performance of austerities by the egg-born [Brahmā], / the vision of the god of gods, and the having a body of half-man and half-woman;

sanskrit_iast:
devyā vibhāgakathanaṃ devadevāt pinākinaḥ /
devyāstu paścāt kathitaṃ dakṣaputrītvameva ca //
meaning:
देव्या विभागकथनं देवदेवात् पिनाकिनः /
देव्यास्तु पश्चात् कथितं दक्षपुत्रीत्वमेव च //
text_mt: the explanation of the goddess's division from the god of gods, the wielder of the Pināka, / and afterward the goddess's becoming the daughter of Dakṣa was recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
himavadduhitṛtvaṃ ca devyā māhātmyameva ca /
darśanaṃ divyarūpasya vaiśvarūpasya darśanam //
meaning:
हिमवद्दुहितृत्वं च देव्या माहात्म्यमेव च /
दर्शनं दिव्यरूपस्य वैश्वरूपस्य दर्शनम् //
text_mt: and her being the daughter of Himavat, and the majesty of the goddess, / the vision of the divine form, the vision of the universal form;

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kathitaṃ pitrā himavatā svayam /
upadeśo mahādevyā varadānaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
नाम्नां सहस्रं कथितं पित्रा हिमवता स्वयम् /
उपदेशो महादेव्या वरदानं तथैव च //
text_mt: the thousand names declared personally by her father Himavat, / the teaching of the Great Goddess, and likewise the granting of boons;

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvādīnāṃ prajāsargo rājñāṃ vaṃśasya vistaraḥ /
prācetasatvaṃ dakṣasya dakṣayajñavimardanam //
meaning:
भृग्वादीनां प्रजासर्गो राज्ञां वंशस्य विस्तरः /
प्राचेतसत्वं दक्षस्य दक्षयज्ञविमर्दनम् //
text_mt: the creation of offspring by Bhṛgu and the others, the expanse of the royal dynasty, / Dakṣa's status as son of Pracetas, and the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice;

sanskrit_iast:
dadhīcasya ca dakṣasya vivādaḥ kathitastadā /
tataśca śāpaḥ kathito munīnāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
दधीचस्य च दक्षस्य विवादः कथितस्तदा /
ततश्च शापः कथितो मुनीनां मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: and the dispute between Dadhīca and Dakṣa was then recounted, / and thereupon the curse of the sages was told, O best of sages;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāgatiḥ prasādaśca antardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ /
pitāmahasyopadeśaḥ kīrtyate rakṣaṇāya tu //
meaning:
रुद्रागतिः प्रसादश्च अन्तर्धानं पिनाकिनः /
पितामहस्योपदेशः कीर्त्यते रक्षणाय तु //
text_mt: the arrival of Rudra, his grace, and the disappearance of the wielder of the Pināka, / and the instruction given to the Grandfather for protection is celebrated;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣasya ca prajāsargaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ /
hiraṇyakaśipornāśo hiraṇyākṣavadhastathā //
meaning:
दक्षस्य च प्रजासर्गः कश्यपस्य महात्मनः /
हिरण्यकशिपोर्नाशो हिरण्याक्षवधस्तथा //
text_mt: and the creation of offspring by Dakṣa, and by the great-souled Kaśyapa, / the destruction of Hiraṇyakaśipu, and the slaying of Hiraṇyākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca śāpaḥ kathito devadāruvanaukasām /
nigrahaścāndhakasyātha gāṇapatyamanuttamam //
meaning:
ततश्च शापः कथितो देवदारुवनौकसाम् /
निग्रहश्चान्धकस्याथ गाणपत्यमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: And then the curse of the dwellers of the Pine Forest is recounted, / and the subjugation of Andhaka, and the peerless status of the commander of the Gaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
prahrādanigrahaścātha baleḥ saṃyamanaṃ tataḥ /
bāṇasya nigrahaścātha prasādastasya śūlinaḥ //
meaning:
प्रह्रादनिग्रहश्चाथ बलेः संयमनं ततः /
बाणस्य निग्रहश्चाथ प्रसादस्तस्य शूलिनः //
text_mt: and then the subjugation of Prahrāda, then the binding of Bali, / and the subjugation of Bāṇa, and the trident-bearer's grace toward him;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ vaṃśavistāro rājñāṃ vaṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
vasudevāt tato viṣṇorutpattiḥ svecchayā hareḥ //
meaning:
ऋषीणां वंशविस्तारो राज्ञां वंशाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
वसुदेवात् ततो विष्णोरुत्पत्तिः स्वेच्छया हरेः //
text_mt: the elaboration of the lineages of the sages, and the lineages of kings are proclaimed; / then the birth of Viṣṇu, Hari, from Vasudeva by his own will;

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ copamanyorvai tapaścaraṇameva ca /
varalābho mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmbaṃ trilocanam //
meaning:
दर्शनं चोपमन्योर्वै तपश्चरणमेव च /
वरलाभो महादेवं दृष्ट्वा साम्बं त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: and the meeting with Upamanyu, and indeed the practice of austerities, / and the receiving of boons upon seeing Mahādeva, the three-eyed Lord with Ambā;

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsagamanaṃ cātha nivāsastatra śārṅgiṇaḥ /
tataśca kathyate bhītirdvārivatyā nivāsinām //
meaning:
कैलासगमनं चाथ निवासस्तत्र शार्ङ्गिणः /
ततश्च कथ्यते भीतिर्द्वारिवत्या निवासिनाम् //
text_mt: and then the journey to Kailāsa, and the stay there of the wielder of the Śārṅga bow; / and then is related the terror of the inhabitants of Dvāravatī;

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣaṇaṃ garuḍenātha jitvā śatrūn mahābalān /
nārādāgamanaṃ caiva yātrā caiva garutmataḥ //
meaning:
रक्षणं गरुडेनाथ जित्वा शत्रून् महाबलान् /
नारादागमनं चैव यात्रा चैव गरुत्मतः //
text_mt: then their protection by Garuḍa, having conquered mighty enemies, / and the arrival of Nārada, and the journey of Garuḍa;

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca kṛṣṇāgamanaṃ munīnāmāgatistataḥ /
naityakaṃ vāsudevasya śivaliṅgārcanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
ततश्च कृष्णागमनं मुनीनामागतिस्ततः /
नैत्यकं वासुदेवस्य शिवलिङ्गार्चनं तथा //
text_mt: and then the return of Kṛṣṇa, then the arrival of the sages, / and the daily rites of Vāsudeva and the worship of the Śiva liṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyasya ca muneḥ praśnaḥ proktastataḥ param /
liṅgārcananimittaṃ ca liṅgasyāpi saliṅginaḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयस्य च मुनेः प्रश्नः प्रोक्तस्ततः परम् /
लिङ्गार्चननिमित्तं च लिङ्गस्यापि सलिङ्गिनः //
text_mt: and beyond that, the question of the sage Mārkaṇḍeya is related, / concerning the reason for worshiping the liṅga, and about the liṅga and the bearer of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
yathātmyakathanaṃ cātha liṅgāvirbhāva eva ca /
brahmaviṣṇostathā madhye kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
यथात्म्यकथनं चाथ लिङ्गाविर्भाव एव च /
ब्रह्मविष्णोस्तथा मध्ये कीर्तितो मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt:
And then the explanation of the true nature, and the manifestation of the liṅga
between Brahmā and Viṣṇu, O eminent sages, is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
mohastayostu kathito gamanaṃ cordhvato 'pyadhaḥ /
saṃstavo devadevasya prasādaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
मोहस्तयोस्तु कथितो गमनं चोर्ध्वतो ऽप्यधः /
संस्तवो देवदेवस्य प्रसादः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt:
and their bewilderment is told, and their going upward and downward,
the hymn of praise to the God of gods, and the grace of the Supreme Lord;

sanskrit_iast:
antardhānaṃ ca liṅgasya sāmbotpattistataḥ param /
kīrtitā cāniruddhasya samutpattirdvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्धानं च लिङ्गस्य साम्बोत्पत्तिस्ततः परम् /
कीर्तिता चानिरुद्धस्य समुत्पत्तिर्द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt:
and the disappearance of the liṅga; then after that, the birth of Sāmba
and the birth of Aniruddha is recounted, O best of the twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇasya gamane buddhirṛṣīṇāmāgatistathā /
anuvaśāsitaṃ ca kṛṣṇena varadānaṃ mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णस्य गमने बुद्धिरृषीणामागतिस्तथा /
अनुवशासितं च कृष्णेन वरदानं महात्मनः //
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa's intention to depart, and the arrival of the sages,
and Kṛṣṇa's instruction, and the granting of a boon by that great-souled one;

sanskrit_iast:
gamanaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya pārthasyāpi ca darśanam /
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasyoktā yugadharmāḥ sanātanāḥ //
meaning:
गमनं चैव कृष्णस्य पार्थस्यापि च दर्शनम् /
कृष्णद्वैपायनस्योक्ता युगधर्माः सनातनाः //
text_mt:
and the departure of Kṛṣṇa, and the vision of Pārtha;
and the eternal duties of the ages declared by Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana;

sanskrit_iast:
anugraho 'tha pārthasya vārāṇasīgatistataḥ /
pārāśaryasya ca munervyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अनुग्रहो ऽथ पार्थस्य वाराणसीगतिस्ततः /
पाराशर्यस्य च मुनेर्व्यासस्याद्भुतकर्मणः //
text_mt:
then grace shown to Pārtha, then the journey to Vārāṇasī
by the sage, the son of Parāśara, Vyāsa of wondrous deeds;

sanskrit_iast:
vāraṇasyāśca māhātmyaṃ tīrthānāṃ caiva varṇanam /
tīrthayātrā ca vyāsasya devyāścaivātha darśanam /
udvāsanaṃ ca kathitaṃ varadānaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
वारणस्याश्च माहात्म्यं तीर्थानां चैव वर्णनम् /
तीर्थयात्रा च व्यासस्य देव्याश्चैवाथ दर्शनम् /
उद्वासनं च कथितं वरदानं तथैव च //

sanskrit_iast:
prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ kṣetrāṇāmatha kīrtinam /
phalaṃ ca vipulaṃ viprā mārkaṇḍeyasya nirgamaḥ //
meaning:
प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं क्षेत्राणामथ कीर्तिनम् /
फलं च विपुलं विप्रा मार्कण्डेयस्य निर्गमः //
text_mt:
and the greatness of Prayāga, then the proclamation of the sacred fields
and the vast reward, O brahmins, and the departure of Mārkaṇḍeya;

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvanānāṃ svarūpaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ ca niveśanam /
kīrtyante caiva varṣāṇi nadīnāṃ caiva nirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
भुवनानां स्वरूपं च ज्योतिषां च निवेशनम् /
कीर्त्यन्ते चैव वर्षाणि नदीनां चैव निर्णयः //
text_mt:
and the true nature of the worlds, and the placement of the heavenly bodies;
and the continental realms are recounted, and the determination of the rivers;

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāṃ ca kathanaṃ sthānāni ca divaukasām /
dvīpānāṃ pravibhāgaśca śvetadvīpopavarṇanam //
meaning:
पर्वतानां च कथनं स्थानानि च दिवौकसाम् /
द्वीपानां प्रविभागश्च श्वेतद्वीपोपवर्णनम् //
text_mt:
and the description of the mountains, and the abodes of the gods,
and the division of the islands, and the description of Śvetadvīpa;

sanskrit_iast:
śayanaṃ keśavasyātha māhātmyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ /
manvantarāṇāṃ kathanaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca //
meaning:
शयनं केशवस्याथ माहात्म्यं च महात्मनः /
मन्वन्तराणां कथनं विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमेव च //
text_mt:
then the reclining of Keśava, and the greatness of the Great-souled One,
the account of the cosmic eras of Manus, and the greatness of Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ vyāsānāṃ kathanaṃ tataḥ /
avedasya ca vedānāṃ kathanaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
वेदशाखाप्रणयनं व्यासानां कथनं ततः /
अवेदस्य च वेदानां कथनं मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt:
the arrangement of the Vedic branches, then the account of the Vyāsas,
and the account of the loss of the Vedas and of the Vedas, O eminent sages;

sanskrit_iast:
yogeśvarāṇāṃ ca kathā śiṣyāṇāṃ cātha kīrtanam /
gītāśca vividhāguhyā īśvarasyātha kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
योगेश्वराणां च कथा शिष्याणां चाथ कीर्तनम् /
गीताश्च विविधागुह्या ईश्वरस्याथ कीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
and the story of the masters of yoga, and the recounting of their disciples,
and the various secret songs of the Lord are recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramāṇāmācārāḥ prāyaścittavidhistataḥ /
kapālitvaṃ ca rudrasya bhikṣācaraṇameva ca //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाणामाचाराः प्रायश्चित्तविधिस्ततः /
कपालित्वं च रुद्रस्य भिक्षाचरणमेव च //
text_mt:
the proper conduct of the castes and life-stages, then the rules of expiation,
and the skull-bearing nature of Rudra, and wandering for alms;

sanskrit_iast:
pativratāyāścākhyānaṃ tīrthānāṃ ca vinirṇayaḥ /
tathā maṅkaṇakasyātha nigrahaḥ kīrtyate dvijāḥ //
meaning:
पतिव्रतायाश्चाख्यानं तीर्थानां च विनिर्णयः /
तथा मङ्कणकस्याथ निग्रहः कीर्त्यते द्विजाः //
text_mt:
and the narrative of the faithful wife, and the ascertainment of sacred places;
likewise, the restraint of Maṅkaṇaka is recounted, O twice-born;

sanskrit_iast:
vadhaśca kathito viprāḥ kālasya ca samāsataḥ /
devadāruvane śaṃbhoḥ praveśo mādhavasya ca //
meaning:
वधश्च कथितो विप्राः कालस्य च समासतः /
देवदारुवने शंभोः प्रवेशो माधवस्य च //
text_mt:
and the slaying of Kāla is recounted in brief, O brahmins,
and the entry of Śambhu and Mādhava into the Deodar Forest;

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ ṣaṭkulīyānāṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ /
varadānaṃ ca devasya nandine tu prakīrtitam //
meaning:
दर्शनं षट्कुलीयानां देवदेवस्य धीमतः /
वरदानं च देवस्य नन्दिने तु प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt:
the vision of the wise God of gods by those of the six lineages,
and the granting of a boon by the Lord to Nandin is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikastu kathitaḥ pratisargastataḥ param /
prākṛtaḥ pralayaścordhvaṃ sabījo yoga eva ca //
meaning:
नैमित्तिकस्तु कथितः प्रतिसर्गस्ततः परम् /
प्राकृतः प्रलयश्चोर्ध्वं सबीजो योग एव च //
text_mt:
and after that, the occasional secondary recreation is told;
and next, the elemental dissolution, and yoga with seed.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jñātvā purāṇasya saṃkṣepaṃ kīrtayet tu yaḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
एवं ज्ञात्वा पुराणस्य संक्षेपं कीर्तयेत् तु यः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
Knowing it thus, whoever proclaims this summary of the Purāṇa
is freed from all sins and is magnified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktvā śriyaṃ devīmādāya puruṣottamaḥ /
saṃtyajya kūrmasaṃsthānaṃ svasthānaṃ ca jagāma ha //
meaning:
एवमुक्त्वा श्रियं देवीमादाय पुरुषोत्तमः /
संत्यज्य कूर्मसंस्थानं स्वस्थानं च जगाम ह //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, taking Goddess Śrī, the Supreme Spirit,
relinquishing his tortoise form, went indeed to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca sarve munayaḥ svāni sthānāni bhejire /
praṇamya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ gṛhītvā hyamṛtaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
देवाश्च सर्वे मुनयः स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे /
प्रणम्य पुरुषं विष्णुं गृहीत्वा ह्यमृतं द्विजाः //
text_mt:
And all the gods and sages went to their own abodes,
having bowed down to the Supreme Spirit Viṣṇu and taken the nectar, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
etat purāṇaṃ paramaṃ bhāṣitaṃ kūrmarūpiṇā /
sākṣād devādidenena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā //
meaning:
एतत् पुराणं परमं भाषितं कूर्मरूपिणा /
साक्षाद् देवादिदेनेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना //
text_mt:
This supreme Purāṇa was spoken by the one embodied as a tortoise,
by Viṣṇu himself, the God from before the gods, the source of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ martyo niyamena samāhitaḥ /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
यः पठेत् सततं मर्त्यो नियमेन समाहितः /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते //
text_mt:
Whatever mortal reads it constantly with restraint and composure
is freed from all sins and is magnified in the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
likhitvā caiva yo dadyād vaiśākhe māsi suvrataḥ /
viprāya vedaviduṣe tasya puṇyaṃ nibodhata //
meaning:
लिखित्वा चैव यो दद्याद् वैशाखे मासि सुव्रतः /
विप्राय वेदविदुषे तस्य पुण्यं निबोधत //
text_mt:
And having copied it, whoever, keeping good vows, should give it in the month of Vaiśākha
to a brahmin who knows the Veda, hear his merit:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ /
bhuktvā ca vipulānsvarge bhogāndivyānsuśobhanān //
meaning:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः /
भुक्त्वा च विपुलान्स्वर्गे भोगान्दिव्यान्सुशोभनान् //
text_mt:
Freed from all sins, endowed with all sovereignty,
and having enjoyed vast and splendid celestial pleasures in heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo viprāṇāṃ jāyate kule /
pūrvasaṃskāramāhātmyād brahmavidyāmavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो विप्राणां जायते कुले /
पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
then, fallen from heaven, he is born in a family of brahmins;
by the power of past impressions he will attain the knowledge of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhitvādhyāyamevaikaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
yor'thaṃ vicārayet samyak sa prāpnoti paraṃ padam //
meaning:
पठित्वाध्यायमेवैकं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
योर्ऽथं विचारयेत् सम्यक् स प्राप्नोति परं पदम् //
text_mt:
Having read even a single chapter, one is freed from all sins;
he who investigates its meaning properly attains the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyetavyamidaṃ nityaṃ vipraiḥ parvaṇi parvaṇi /
śrotavyaṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhā mahāpātakanāśanam //
meaning:
अध्येतव्यमिदं नित्यं विप्रैः पर्वणि पर्वणि /
श्रोतव्यं च द्विजश्रेष्ठा महापातकनाशनम् //
text_mt:
This should be recited constantly by brahmins on every festive occasion,
and it should be heard, O best of the twice-born, as it destroys great sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekatastu purāṇāni setihāsāni kṛtsnaśaḥ /
ekatra cedaṃ paramametadevātiricyate //
meaning:
एकतस्तु पुराणानि सेतिहासानि कृत्स्नशः /
एकत्र चेदं परममेतदेवातिरिच्यते //
text_mt:
On the one side all the Purāṇas together with the epics,
and on the other side this supreme [Purāṇa]—this alone surpasses them.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ jñānanaipuṇyakāminām /
idaṃ purāṇaṃ muktvaikaṃ nāstyanyat sādhanaṃ param //
meaning:
धर्मनैपुण्यकामानां ज्ञाननैपुण्यकामिनाम् /
इदं पुराणं मुक्त्वैकं नास्त्यन्यत् साधनं परम् //
text_mt:
For those who desire proficiency in duty, for those who desire proficiency in knowledge,
apart from this one Purāṇa there is no other supreme means.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvadatra bhagavān devo nārāyaṇo hariḥ /
kathyate hi yathā viṣṇurna tathānyeṣu suvratāḥ //
meaning:
यथावदत्र भगवान् देवो नारायणो हरिः /
कथ्यते हि यथा विष्णुर्न तथान्येषु सुव्रताः //
text_mt:
For as the Lord, the God Nārāyaṇa, Hari,
Viṣṇu, is spoken of properly here, it is not so in others, O those of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī paurāṇikī ceyaṃ saṃhitā pāpanāśanī /
atra tat paramaṃ brahma kīrtyate hi yathārthataḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी पौराणिकी चेयं संहिता पापनाशनी /
अत्र तत् परमं ब्रह्म कीर्त्यते हि यथार्थतः //
text_mt:
And this is the Brāhmī compilation belonging to the Purāṇa, destroying sins;
here that Supreme Brahman is indeed proclaimed as it truly is.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tapasāṃ ca paraṃ tapaḥ /
jñānānāṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ vratam //
meaning:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं तपसां च परं तपः /
ज्ञानानां परमं ज्ञानं व्रतानां परमं व्रतम् //
text_mt:
It is the supreme sacred place of sacred places, and the supreme asceticism of ascetic practices,
the supreme knowledge of knowledges, and the supreme vow of vows.

sanskrit_iast:
nādhyetavyamidaṃ śāstraṃ vṛṣalasya ca sannidhau /
yo 'dhīte sa tu mohātmā sa yāti narakān bahūn //
meaning:
नाध्येतव्यमिदं शास्त्रं वृषलस्य च सन्निधौ /
यो ऽधीते स तु मोहात्मा स याति नरकान् बहून् //
text_mt:
This treatise must not be studied in the presence of an outcaste;
he who studies it thus is deluded, and goes to many hells.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe vā daivike kārye śrāvaṇīyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ /
yajñānte tu viśeṣeṇa sarvadoṣaviśodhanam //
meaning:
श्राद्धे वा दैविके कार्ये श्रावणीयं द्विजातिभिः /
यज्ञान्ते तु विशेषेण सर्वदोषविशोधनम् //
text_mt:
It should be recited by the twice-born at an ancestral offering rite or during a rite for the gods,
and especially at the end of a sacrifice, purifying from all flaws.

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣūṇāmidaṃ śāstramadhyetavyaṃ viśeṣataḥ /
śrotavyaṃ cātha mantavyaṃ vedārthaparibṛṃhaṇam //
meaning:
मुमुक्षूणामिदं शास्त्रमध्येतव्यं विशेषतः /
श्रोतव्यं चाथ मन्तव्यं वेदार्थपरिबृंहणम् //
text_mt:
This treatise should be studied especially by seekers of liberation,
and should be heard and pondered, as it expands the meaning of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā yathāvad viprendrān śrāvayed bhaktisaṃyutān /
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा यथावद् विप्रेन्द्रान् श्रावयेद् भक्तिसंयुतान् /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Having understood it properly, one should recite it to the lords of brahmins filled with devotion;
freed from all sins, he will attain complete union with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'śraddadhāne puruṣe dadyāccādhārmike tathā /
sa pretya gatvā nirayān śunāṃ yoniṃ vrajatyadhaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽश्रद्दधाने पुरुषे दद्याच्चाधार्मिके तथा /
स प्रेत्य गत्वा निरयान् शुनां योनिं व्रजत्यधः //
text_mt:
He who gives it to a person lacking faith and likewise unrighteous,
having gone after death to the hells, sinks low into the womb of dogs.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtvā hariṃ viṣṇuṃ jagadyoniṃ sanātanam /
adhyetavyamidaṃ śāstraṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्वा हरिं विष्णुं जगद्योनिं सनातनम् /
अध्येतव्यमिदं शास्त्रं कृष्णद्वैपायनं तथा //
text_mt:
Having bowed to Hari, Viṣṇu, the eternal source of the universe,
and likewise to Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, this treatise should be studied.

sanskrit_iast:
ityājñā devadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ /
pārāśaryasya viprarṣervyāsasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
इत्याज्ञा देवदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः /
पाराशर्यस्य विप्रर्षेर्व्यासस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt:
Such is the command of the God of gods, Viṣṇu of boundless splendor,
and of the brahmin-seer, the son of Parāśara, the great-souled Vyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā nārāyaṇād divyāṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
gautamāya dadau pūrvaṃ tasmāccaiva parāśaraḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा नारायणाद् दिव्यां नारदो भगवानृषिः /
गौतमाय ददौ पूर्वं तस्माच्चैव पराशरः //
text_mt:
Having heard it, divine, from Nārāyaṇa, the venerable seer Nārada
formerly gave it to Gautama, and from him Parāśara [received it].

sanskrit_iast:
parāśaro 'pi bhagavāna gaṅgādvāre munīśvarāḥ /
munibhyaḥ kathayāmāsa dharmakāmārthamokṣadam //
meaning:
पराशरो ऽपि भगवान गङ्गाद्वारे मुनीश्वराः /
मुनिभ्यः कथयामास धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् //
text_mt:
The venerable Parāśara too, O lords of sages, at the Gate of the Gaṅgā,
told it to the sages, granting duty, desire, wealth, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sanakāya ca dhīmate /
sanatkumārāya tathā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं सनकाय च धीमते /
सनत्कुमाराय तथा सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt:
It was told formerly by Brahmā to the wise Sanaka
and likewise to Sanatkumāra, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
sanakād bhagavān sākṣād devalo yogavittamaḥ /
avāptavān pañcaśikho devalādidamuttamam //
meaning:
सनकाद् भगवान् साक्षाद् देवलो योगवित्तमः /
अवाप्तवान् पञ्चशिखो देवलादिदमुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
From Sanaka the venerable Devala himself, the best knower of yoga,
obtained it, and Pañcaśikha [obtained] this supreme [text] from Devala.

sanskrit_iast:
sanatkumārād bhagavān muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ /
lebhe purāṇaṃ paramaṃ vyāsaḥ sarvārthasaṃcayam //
meaning:
सनत्कुमाराद् भगवान् मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः /
लेभे पुराणं परमं व्यासः सर्वार्थसंचयम् //
text_mt:
From Sanatkumāra the venerable sage, the son of Satyavatī,
Vyāsa, received this supreme Purāṇa, a treasury of all aims.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmād vyāsādahaṃ śrutvā bhavatāṃ pāpanāśanam /
ūcivān vai bhavadbhiśca dātavyaṃ dhārmike jane //
meaning:
तस्माद् व्यासादहं श्रुत्वा भवतां पापनाशनम् /
ऊचिवान् वै भवद्भिश्च दातव्यं धार्मिके जने //
text_mt:
Having heard it from that Vyāsa, I have told it to you,
destroying sin; and it must be given by you to a righteous person.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai vyāsāya gurave sarvajñāya maharṣaye /
pārāśaryāya śāntāya namo nārāyaṇātmane //
meaning:
तस्मै व्यासाय गुरवे सर्वज्ञाय महर्षये /
पाराशर्याय शान्ताय नमो नारायणात्मने //
text_mt:
To that Vyāsa, the teacher, the all-knowing great seer,
the son of Parāśara, the tranquil one, whose self is Nārāyaṇa, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt saṃjāyate kṛtsanaṃ yatra caiva pralīyate /
namastasmai sureśāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe //
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
uparivibhāgaḥ samāptaḥ
iti śrīkūrmapurāṇaṃ samāptam
meaning:
यस्मात् संजायते कृत्सनं यत्र चैव प्रलीयते /
नमस्तस्मै सुरेशाय विष्णवे कूर्मरूपिणे //
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
उपरिविभागः समाप्तः
इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणं समाप्तम्
text_mt:
From whom the entire universe is born, and in whom it dissolves— / homage to that lord of the gods, Viṣṇu, embodied as a tortoise!

Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter in the latter section of the compilation of six thousand verses in the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa.

The latter section is complete.

Thus the glorious Kūrma Purāṇa is complete.
